attributes.description: Free-text or comma-separated description of the candidate's preferred workplace culture attributes (e.g., 'collaborative, fast-paced, diverse, mission-driven'). Used in qualitative matching for direct hire and FTE placements.
attributes.references: Bullhorn ATS/CRM - Candidate Preferences; SHRM Workplace Culture Standards

attributes.name: record_created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this availability record was first created in the system. Supports data lineage, audit trail, and GDPR/CCPA data retention compliance. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 5 (Accountability); CCPA; SOC 2 Type II Audit Trail Requirements

attributes.name: record_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this availability record was last modified. Used for change data capture (CDC) in the Databricks Silver Layer pipeline and for identifying recently updated availability records for recruiter workflows.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 5 (Accountability); CCPA; SOC 2 Type II Audit Trail Requirements

attributes.name: redeployment_candidate
attributes.description: Indicates whether this candidate has been flagged for proactive redeployment outreach before their current assignment ends. True = flagged for redeployment; False = not flagged. Supports bench management and redeployment workflows to reduce fall-off rate.
attributes.references: Bullhorn ATS/CRM - Redeployment Workflow; ASA Workforce Retention Standards

attributes.name: redeployment_target_date
attributes.description: Target date by which the recruiter aims to redeploy the candidate into a new assignment. Typically set relative to the current assignment end date. Drives redeployment pipeline reporting in Power BI.
attributes.references: Bullhorn ATS/CRM - Redeployment Workflow; ASA Workforce Retention Standards

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Identifies the operational system of record from which this availability record originated. Supports data lineage and master data management in the Silver Layer. Primary source is Bullhorn ATS/CRM.
attributes.references: Internal Data Governance Standard; SOC 2 Type II Data Lineage Requirements

attributes.name: source_system_record_ref
attributes.description: The native identifier of this availability record in the originating source system (e.g., Bullhorn candidate ID or availability record ID). Enables traceability back to the system of record for reconciliation and audit purposes.
attributes.references: Internal Data Governance Standard; SOC 2 Type II Data Lineage Requirements

attributes.name: sourcing_channel
attributes.description: The channel through which the candidate's current availability record was captured or updated (e.g., 'recruiter_call', 'job_board', 'referral', 'linkedin', 'career_site', 'vms_portal'). Supports sourcing channel attribution analytics in Power BI.
attributes.references: Bullhorn ATS/CRM - Candidate Source Tracking; Power BI Analytics Platform - Sourcing Analytics

attributes.name: travel_percentage_max
attributes.description: Maximum percentage of work time the candidate is willing to spend traveling (0–100). Used to qualify candidates for roles with travel requirements. Null if willing_to_travel is False.
attributes.references: Bullhorn ATS/CRM - Candidate Preferences; ASA Staffing Standards

attributes.name: willing_to_relocate
attributes.description: Indicates whether the candidate is open to relocating for a permanent or long-term placement opportunity. True = willing to relocate; False = not willing. Relevant for direct hire and FTE placement matching.
attributes.references: Bullhorn ATS/CRM - Candidate Preferences; SHRM Relocation Guidelines

attributes.name: willing_to_travel
attributes.description: Indicates whether the candidate is willing to travel for work assignments. True = willing to travel; False = not willing. Used in conjunction with travel_percentage_max for travel-intensive roles.
attributes.references: Bullhorn ATS/CRM - Candidate Preferences; ASA Staffing Standards

attributes.name: worker_classification_preference
attributes.description: Candidate's preferred worker classification for engagement: W-2 (employee of staffing firm), 1099 (independent contractor), EOR (Employer of Record), or C2C (Corp-to-Corp). Critical for IRS worker classification compliance and co-employment risk management.
attributes.references: IRS Worker Classification Rules (Section 530); DOL Independent Contractor Rule; FLSA (Fair Labor Standards Act)

products.name: status_history
products.description: Immutable audit log of all candidate lifecycle status transitions within the ATS workflow. Captures prior status, new status, transition reason code, transition trigger (system, recruiter, candidate, client), recruiter ID who made the change, associated job order ID (if applicable), transition timestamp, and notes. Status values include: new lead, in-progress, submitted, interviewed, placed, on assignment, bench, redeployed, inactive, do-not-place, fall-off. For do-not-place (DNP) transitions, additionally captures DNP scope (client-specific, program-specific, global), DNP reason code, DNP initiator, DNP expiration date, and review-required flag. Supports fall-off rate tracking, pipeline velocity, compliance audit trails, and DNP enforcement workflows.

attributes.name: status_history_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate primary key for each candidate status transition record in the immutable audit log.
attributes.references: ASA Data Governance Standards; SOC 2 Type II

attributes.name: assignment_id
attributes.description: Reference to the placement record associated with this status transition, applicable for on-assignment, fall-off, redeployment, and bench transitions.
attributes.references: Bullhorn ATS/CRM Placement Object; ASA Placement Tracking Standards

attributes.name: client_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the client account associated with this status transition, applicable when the transition is client-driven (e.g., client rejection, client-specific DNP, placement). Null for transitions not tied to a specific client.
attributes.references: Bullhorn ATS/CRM Client Object; ASA Client Relationship Standards

attributes.name: client_contact_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to client.contact. Business justification: Interview and client feedback stages require tracking which client contact conducted interview or provided feedback. Standard ATS practice for relationship management, audit trail, and candidate exper
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: corrected_record_status_history_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing identifier pointing to the original status_history record that this correction supersedes. Null when is_correction is false. Maintains immutable audit chain integrity.
attributes.references: SOC 2 Type II Data Integrity Requirements; ASA Data Governance Standards

attributes.name: location_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to client.location. Business justification: Status transitions often occur at specific client locations (on-site interview, location-specific offer, site assignment). Critical for compliance reporting, workers' comp classification, and candidat
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: office_location_id
attributes.description: Reference to the staffing branch or office responsible for managing this candidate's status transition. Supports branch-level pipeline reporting and recruiter performance analytics.
attributes.references: ASA Branch Operations Standards; Bullhorn ATS/CRM Branch/Department Object

attributes.name: order_header_id
attributes.description: Reference to the job order (requisition) associated with this status transition, if applicable. Null for status changes not tied to a specific req (e.g., global DNP, bench, inactive).
attributes.references: Bullhorn ATS/CRM Job Order Object; ASA Job Order Standards

attributes.name: profile_id
attributes.description: Reference to the candidate whose ATS lifecycle status changed. Core linkage to the candidate master record in Bullhorn.
attributes.references: Bullhorn ATS/CRM Candidate Object; ASA Workforce Data Standards

attributes.name: staff_profile_id
attributes.description: Reference to the recruiter or staffing coordinator who initiated or recorded this status transition. Null for fully automated system-triggered transitions.
attributes.references: Bullhorn ATS/CRM User Object; EEOC Recordkeeping Requirements

attributes.name: submittal_id
attributes.description: Reference to the candidate submittal record associated with this transition, applicable for submitted, interviewed, and placed status changes. Links to the Quality of Submission (QoS) tracking record.
attributes.references: Bullhorn ATS/CRM Submission Object; ASA Submittal Standards

attributes.name: ats_workflow_step
attributes.description: The specific ATS workflow step or stage name within Bullhorn that corresponds to this status transition (e.g., 'Initial Screen', 'Client Submittal', 'Offer Extended'). Provides granular workflow context beyond the high-level status.
attributes.references: Bullhorn ATS/CRM Workflow Configuration; ISO 30405:2016 Recruitment Process Steps

attributes.name: bench_start_date
attributes.description: The date the candidate entered bench status (unassigned but available for redeployment). Populated when new_status is 'bench'. Null for non-bench transitions.
attributes.references: ASA Bench Management Standards; SIA Contingent Workforce Analytics

attributes.name: compliance_hold
attributes.description: Indicates whether this status transition was triggered by or resulted in a compliance hold (e.g., pending I-9 verification, background check failure, credential expiration). Drives compliance workflow routing.
attributes.references: INA I-9 Compliance; FCRA Background Check Requirements; OSHA Credentialing Standards; DOL Compliance

attributes.name: compliance_hold_reason
attributes.description: The specific compliance issue causing the hold when compliance_hold is true: I-9 pending, background check (BGC) failed, drug screen pending, credential expired, E-Verify pending, or other. Null when compliance_hold is false.
attributes.references: INA I-9 Compliance; FCRA §604; E-Verify Program Requirements; DOL Credentialing Standards

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this status history record was first created in the Silver layer data product. Distinct from transition_timestamp (business event time). Supports data lineage and audit trail requirements.
attributes.references: SOC 2 Type II Audit Trail Requirements; GDPR Article 5(2) Accountability; CCPA §1798.100

attributes.name: days_in_prior_status
attributes.description: Number of calendar days the candidate spent in the prior status before this transition. Captured at transition time for pipeline velocity and Time-to-Fill (TTF) / Time-to-Start (TTS) analytics.
attributes.references: ISO 30405:2016 Recruitment Process Timing; ASA TTF/TTS KPI Standards; SIA Workforce Analytics

attributes.name: division_code
attributes.description: The business division or practice area code (e.g., IT, Healthcare, Finance, Light Industrial) under which this status transition is tracked. Enables division-level pipeline velocity and fill rate analytics.
attributes.references: ASA Industry Sector Classification; SIA Staffing Segment Definitions; Bullhorn ATS/CRM Division Configuration

attributes.name: dnp_expiration_date
attributes.description: The date on which the DNP restriction expires and the candidate becomes eligible for placement consideration again. Null for permanent DNP designations or non-DNP transitions.
attributes.references: ASA Staffing Industry Best Practices; FCRA §605; EEOC Adverse Action Review Requirements

attributes.name: dnp_initiator
attributes.description: The role or party that initiated the DNP designation: recruiter, branch_manager, compliance_officer, client, system (automated rule), or legal. Null for non-DNP transitions. Supports compliance audit and accountability tracking.
attributes.references: ASA Staffing Industry Best Practices; EEOC Adverse Action Requirements; SOC 2 Type II

attributes.name: dnp_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized reason code for the DNP designation (e.g., CONDUCT_VIOLATION, SAFETY_INCIDENT, CLIENT_REQUEST, BACKGROUND_FAILURE, POLICY_VIOLATION, PERFORMANCE_ISSUE). Null for non-DNP transitions. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: promote to reference product — values exceed 6]
attributes.references: ASA Staffing Industry Best Practices; EEOC Adverse Action Documentation; FCRA; OSHA Incident Reporting

attributes.name: dnp_review_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether this DNP designation requires a formal compliance or legal review before the restriction can be lifted or modified. Drives DNP enforcement workflow routing. Null for non-DNP transitions.
attributes.references: ASA Staffing Industry Best Practices; FCRA Adverse Action Review; EEOC Compliance Workflow

attributes.name: dnp_scope
attributes.description: Defines the breadth of the Do-Not-Place restriction: client_specific (restricted from a single client account), program_specific (restricted from a VMS/MSP program), or global (restricted from all placements across the enterprise). Null for non-DNP transitions.
attributes.references: ASA Staffing Industry Best Practices; EEOC Adverse Action Requirements; FCRA §604

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The business-effective date of the status transition, which may differ from the transition_timestamp (e.g., a backdated status change or a future-dated transition). Used for accurate pipeline and assignment reporting.
attributes.references: ASA Workforce Data Standards; Bullhorn ATS/CRM Effective Dating

attributes.name: fall_off_days
attributes.description: Number of days the candidate was on assignment before the fall-off occurred. Calculated at the time of the fall-off transition and stored for reporting. Null for non-fall-off transitions.
attributes.references: ASA Fall-Off Rate Metric Definition; SIA Staffing Industry KPI Standards

attributes.name: interview_outcome
attributes.description: Result of the interview when the transition involves an interview stage. Null for non-interview transitions. Drives pipeline conversion analytics.
attributes.references: Bullhorn ATS/CRM Interview Disposition; ISO 30405:2016 §6.4 Candidate Assessment

attributes.name: interview_type
attributes.description: Type of interview conducted when the transition is to the 'interviewed' status. Null for non-interview transitions.
attributes.references: Bullhorn ATS/CRM Interview Tracking; ISO 30405:2016 §6.4 Candidate Assessment

attributes.name: is_correction
attributes.description: Indicates whether this record represents a correction to a previously recorded status transition (e.g., a data entry error was corrected). When true, corrected_record_id should reference the original erroneous record.
attributes.references: SOC 2 Type II Data Integrity Requirements; ASA Data Governance Standards

attributes.name: is_dnp
attributes.description: Indicates whether this status transition represents a Do-Not-Place (DNP) designation. When true, the DNP-specific fields (dnp_scope, dnp_reason_code, dnp_initiator, dnp_expiration_date, dnp_review_required) are populated.
attributes.references: ASA Staffing Industry Best Practices; EEOC Adverse Action Documentation; FCRA Compliance

attributes.name: is_fall_off
attributes.description: Indicates whether this status transition represents a fall-off event — a placement that ended prematurely before the agreed assignment end date. Used for fall-off rate KPI tracking and recruiter performance analytics.
attributes.references: ASA Fall-Off Rate Metric Definition; SIA Staffing Industry KPI Standards

attributes.name: new_status
attributes.description: The candidate's ATS lifecycle status after this transition. Represents the current state entered as a result of this event. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: new_lead|in_progress|submitted|interviewed|placed|on_assignment|bench|redeployed|inactive|do_not_place|fall_off — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Bullhorn ATS/CRM Candidate Status Workflow; ASA Candidate Lifecycle Standards

attributes.name: pipeline_stage_sequence
attributes.description: Ordinal sequence number of this status transition within the candidate's overall ATS pipeline for a given job order. Enables pipeline velocity analysis and stage-by-stage conversion funnel reporting.
attributes.references: Bullhorn ATS/CRM Pipeline Analytics; ISO 30405:2016 Recruitment Process Metrics

attributes.name: placement_type
attributes.description: The type of placement associated with this status transition: temp (temporary), temp_to_perm (contract-to-hire), direct_hire (permanent placement), contract, or SOW (Statement of Work). Null for pre-placement transitions.
attributes.references: ASA Placement Type Definitions; SIA Staffing Industry Classification Standards

attributes.name: prior_status
attributes.description: The candidate's ATS lifecycle status immediately before this transition. Enables full before/after audit trail and pipeline velocity analysis. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: new_lead|in_progress|submitted|interviewed|placed|on_assignment|bench|redeployed|inactive|do_not_place|fall_off — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Bullhorn ATS/CRM Candidate Status Workflow; ASA Candidate Lifecycle Standards

attributes.name: redeployment_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether the candidate was flagged as eligible for redeployment at the time of this status transition (e.g., when transitioning to bench or end-of-assignment). Supports bench management and redeployment pipeline workflows.
attributes.references: ASA Redeployment Best Practices; SIA Contingent Workforce Management Standards

attributes.name: rejection_reason
attributes.description: Standardized reason for candidate rejection when the transition results from a client or internal rejection (e.g., OVERQUALIFIED, SALARY_MISMATCH, SKILLS_GAP, CLIENT_PREFERENCE). Null for non-rejection transitions. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: promote to reference product — values exceed 6]
attributes.references: EEOC Applicant Disposition Requirements; Bullhorn ATS/CRM Disposition Codes; ISO 30405:2016 §6.5

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: The operational system of record that originated this status transition event (e.g., Bullhorn ATS, Beeline VMS, SAP SuccessFactors, manual entry, API integration). Supports data lineage and reconciliation.
attributes.references: SOC 2 Type II Data Lineage Requirements; Bullhorn ATS/CRM Integration Standards

attributes.name: source_system_record_ref
attributes.description: The native record identifier from the originating source system (e.g., Bullhorn candidate history record ID, Beeline event ID). Enables traceability back to the system of record for reconciliation.
attributes.references: SOC 2 Type II; Bullhorn ATS/CRM API Reference

attributes.name: transition_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes entered by the recruiter or system describing the context, rationale, or details of the status transition. Supports compliance audit trails and recruiter activity documentation.
attributes.references: Bullhorn ATS/CRM Notes Object; SOC 2 Type II

attributes.name: transition_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized reason code explaining why the status transition occurred (e.g., CANDIDATE_WITHDREW, CLIENT_REJECTED, ASSIGNMENT_ENDED, SCREENING_FAILED, OFFER_ACCEPTED). Drives fall-off rate analysis and pipeline quality reporting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: promote to reference product — values exceed 6]
attributes.references: Bullhorn ATS/CRM Disposition Codes; EEOC Applicant Disposition Requirements; ASA Workforce Analytics Standards

attributes.name: transition_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise date and time when the candidate status transition occurred. This is the authoritative business event time used for pipeline velocity, TTF, and TTS calculations.
attributes.references: Bullhorn ATS/CRM Audit Log; ISO 30405:2016 Recruitment Process Timing; SOC 2 Type II

attributes.name: transition_trigger
attributes.description: Identifies the actor or mechanism that initiated the status transition: system (automated ATS rule), recruiter (manual recruiter action), candidate (candidate self-service or withdrawal), or client (client feedback or rejection).
attributes.references: Bullhorn ATS/CRM Workflow Automation; SOC 2 Type II Audit Trail Requirements

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this status history record was last modified in the Silver layer. Since this is an immutable audit log, updates should be rare and limited to corrections. Supports data quality monitoring.
attributes.references: SOC 2 Type II Audit Trail Requirements; GDPR Article 5(2) Accountability

attributes.name: vms_req_number
attributes.description: The requisition number from the Vendor Management System (VMS) such as Beeline, associated with this status transition for contingent workforce program candidates. Null for non-VMS placements.
attributes.references: Beeline VMS Requisition Object; ASA VMS/MSP Program Standards

attributes.name: worker_type
attributes.description: The employment classification of the candidate at the time of this status transition: W-2 (employee), 1099 (independent contractor), EOR (Employer of Record), or C2C (Corp-to-Corp). Relevant for compliance and payroll routing.
attributes.references: IRS Worker Classification Rules; FLSA §3(e); DOL Independent Contractor Rule; ASA Worker Classification Standards

products.name: interaction
products.description: Records all recruiter-to-candidate and system-to-candidate interaction events throughout the candidate lifecycle. Captures interaction type (call, email, SMS, in-person meeting, video interview, portal message), interaction direction (inbound, outbound), interaction channel, interaction subject/summary, recruiter ID, interaction timestamp, response received flag, response timestamp, sentiment tag (positive, neutral, negative), and linked job order ID if applicable. Supports NPS tracking, candidate experience measurement, recruiter activity KPI reporting, and SLA compliance monitoring in Bullhorn CRM. This is the transactional activity log for candidate communications — distinct from status_history which tracks lifecycle state changes.

attributes.name: interaction_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated identifier for each candidate interaction event record in the Bullhorn CRM activity log.
attributes.references: Bullhorn ATS/CRM

attributes.name: assignment_id
attributes.description: Optional reference to an active or historical placement associated with this interaction, used for assignment management communications, extension discussions, or offboarding events.
attributes.references: Bullhorn ATS/CRM

attributes.name: client_contact_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to client.contact. Business justification: Client-side interactions (hiring manager calls candidate, candidate calls client HR) require tracking which client contact participated. Essential for relationship management, communication audit trai
