attributes.name: honors
attributes.description: Academic honors designation awarded at graduation (e.g., Cum Laude, Magna Cum Laude, Summa Cum Laude). Used for premium candidate profiling and client-facing talent quality reporting.
attributes.references: SHRM Candidate Qualification Framework; Bullhorn ATS/CRM Education Object

attributes.name: institution_city
attributes.description: City where the educational institution is located. Used for geographic context in credential verification and compliance reporting.
attributes.references: ISO 30405:2016 Human Resource Management - Guidelines on Recruitment

attributes.name: institution_country
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code for the country where the educational institution is located. Supports international credential evaluation and EEOC/OFCCP reporting.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3; EEOC Reporting Standards

attributes.name: institution_name
attributes.description: Full legal name of the educational institution attended by the candidate (e.g., University of Michigan, DeVry Institute, Coursera). Used for qualification matching and credential verification workflows.
attributes.references: ISO 30405:2016 Human Resource Management - Guidelines on Recruitment

attributes.name: institution_state
attributes.description: Two-letter US state abbreviation (or equivalent province/territory code) where the educational institution is located. Used for regional compliance and credential verification routing.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-2:US

attributes.name: institution_type
attributes.description: Categorical classification of the educational institution. Drives qualification matching logic for job orders requiring specific institution types. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: university|community_college|trade_school|bootcamp|online_platform|high_school|vocational|seminary|other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ISO 30405:2016 Human Resource Management - Guidelines on Recruitment; American Staffing Association (ASA) Candidate Qualification Standards

attributes.name: is_accredited
attributes.description: Indicates whether the institution holds recognized regional or national accreditation (True). Many client job orders, particularly in healthcare, government, and defense, require degrees from accredited institutions. Drives qualification gate logic in the ATS.
attributes.references: U.S. Department of Education Accreditation Standards; ASA Compliance Standards; OFCCP Compliance

attributes.name: is_completed
attributes.description: Indicates whether the candidate completed and received the degree or certificate (True) or attended without completing (False). Critical for qualification matching — incomplete degrees may not satisfy job order minimum education requirements.
attributes.references: ISO 30405:2016; ASA Candidate Qualification Standards

attributes.name: is_deleted
attributes.description: Soft-delete flag indicating whether this education record has been logically deleted (True) from the active candidate profile without physical removal. Supports GDPR right-to-erasure workflows and CCPA deletion request processing while preserving audit history.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 17 (Right to Erasure); CCPA Section 1798.105; SOC 2 Type II

attributes.name: is_highest_degree
attributes.description: Flags this education record as the candidate's highest level of academic achievement (True). Used by ATS qualification matching logic to quickly identify the most advanced credential without scanning all education records.
attributes.references: Bullhorn ATS/CRM Education Object; ISO 30405:2016

attributes.name: is_international_credential
attributes.description: Indicates whether the education credential was earned at a non-US institution (True) and therefore may require foreign credential evaluation. Triggers the international credential evaluation workflow for EEOC and OFCCP compliance on federal contracts.
attributes.references: EEOC Reporting Standards; OFCCP Compliance; Immigration and Nationality Act (INA) - I-9 Compliance

attributes.name: is_verified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the education record has been independently verified by a third-party credential verification service (True) or is based solely on candidate self-reported data (False). Critical for compliance on job orders requiring verified credentials.
attributes.references: Fair Credit Reporting Act (FCRA); Sterling Background Check Credential Verification; ASA Compliance Standards

attributes.name: major
attributes.description: Primary academic concentration or major declared by the candidate within their degree program (e.g., Software Engineering, Accounting, Registered Nursing). Provides granular qualification detail beyond field of study for precise job order matching.
attributes.references: U.S. Department of Education Classification of Instructional Programs (CIP); Bullhorn ATS/CRM Education Object

attributes.name: minor
attributes.description: Secondary academic concentration or minor declared by the candidate within their degree program. Supplementary qualification data used for advanced candidate matching and talent pool analytics.
attributes.references: U.S. Department of Education Classification of Instructional Programs (CIP); Bullhorn ATS/CRM Education Object

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for recruiter or system-generated notes related to this education record (e.g., discrepancies found during verification, candidate clarifications, special circumstances). Supports recruiter workflow in Bullhorn ATS.
attributes.references: Bullhorn ATS/CRM Education Object; ASA Recruiter Workflow Standards

attributes.name: source_channel
attributes.description: The channel or method through which this education record was originally captured. Tracks whether data originated from automated resume parsing, candidate self-entry via portal, recruiter manual entry in Bullhorn, or a background check report. Supports data quality scoring and sourcing analytics. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: resume_parse|candidate_portal|recruiter_entry|ats_import|vms_import|background_check|linkedin_import|other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Bullhorn ATS/CRM Data Provenance Standards; SAP SuccessFactors Onboarding

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: The operational system of record from which this education record was ingested into the Silver Layer. Supports data lineage tracking and reconciliation between Bullhorn ATS, SAP SuccessFactors, and Sterling Background Check. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: bullhorn|sap_successfactors|sterling_bgc|candidate_portal|beeline_vms|manual|other — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SOC 2 Type II Data Lineage Requirements; Staffing Hr Data Governance Standards

attributes.name: source_system_record_ref
attributes.description: The native record identifier for this education entry in the originating source system (e.g., Bullhorn education record ID, SAP SuccessFactors education history ID). Enables bidirectional traceability between the lakehouse Silver Layer and operational systems.
attributes.references: SOC 2 Type II Data Lineage Requirements; Staffing Hr Data Governance Standards

attributes.name: start_date
attributes.description: Date the candidate began attending the educational institution or program. Used to calculate duration of study and to validate enrollment periods during credential verification.
attributes.references: ISO 30405:2016; Sterling Background Check Credential Verification Standards

attributes.name: thesis_title
attributes.description: Title of the candidate's thesis or dissertation for graduate-level degrees (Master's or Doctorate). Used for highly specialized technical placements where research expertise is a qualification criterion.
attributes.references: ISO 30405:2016; SHRM Candidate Qualification Framework

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this education record, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Used for change data capture (CDC) in the Databricks Silver Layer pipeline and SOC 2 Type II audit compliance.
attributes.references: SOC 2 Type II; GDPR Article 5; CCPA; Databricks Lakehouse CDC Standards

attributes.name: verification_date
attributes.description: Date on which the education credential was verified by the designated verification source. Used for compliance audit trails and to determine if re-verification is required based on credential age policies.
attributes.references: Fair Credit Reporting Act (FCRA); Sterling Background Check; ASA Compliance Standards

attributes.name: verification_reference_number
attributes.description: External reference or case number assigned by the credential verification provider (e.g., Sterling BGC order ID, National Student Clearinghouse transaction ID). Enables traceability back to the source verification record for audit and dispute resolution.
attributes.references: Fair Credit Reporting Act (FCRA); Sterling Background Check; SOC 2 Type II Audit Trail Requirements

attributes.name: verification_source
attributes.description: The source or method used to verify the education credential. Identifies whether verification was performed via Sterling Background Check, National Student Clearinghouse, direct institution contact, or is candidate self-reported. Required for FCRA compliance documentation.
attributes.references: Fair Credit Reporting Act (FCRA); Sterling Background Check; National Student Clearinghouse

products.name: pay_rate_agreement
products.description: Records the negotiated or agreed pay rate terms between the staffing firm and the candidate for a specific engagement context. Captures pay rate type (hourly, daily, weekly, salary), base pay rate, OT (overtime) rate, DT (double time) rate, per diem rate, currency, effective date, expiration date, pay rate basis (W-2, 1099, EOR), burden rate applied, negotiated by recruiter ID, and approval status. Distinct from the billing-side bill rate — this is the candidate-facing pay agreement. Supports payroll processing handoff to TempWorks.
products.reference: Candidate Pay Rate / Compensation Agreement (Bullhorn / TempWorks)

attributes.name: pay_rate_agreement_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated identifier for the pay rate agreement record. Primary key for this entity. Role: MASTER_AGREEMENT.
attributes.references: Staffing Hr Internal Data Standards

attributes.name: assignment_id
attributes.description: Reference to the placement or assignment record associated with this pay rate agreement. Populated once a placement is confirmed; nullable during negotiation phase.
attributes.references: Bullhorn ATS/CRM Placement Object

attributes.name: location_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to client.location. Business justification: Pay rates vary by client work location due to prevailing wage laws, cost-of-labor adjustments, and location-specific rate cards. Critical for payroll accuracy, compliance, and margin calculation. No e
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: order_header_id
attributes.description: Reference to the job order or requisition (Req) for which this pay rate agreement applies. Scopes the agreement to a specific engagement context.
attributes.references: Bullhorn ATS/CRM Job Order Object

attributes.name: pay_rate_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to payroll.pay_rate. Business justification: Links negotiated pay rate agreement (candidate domain) to operationalized payroll rate (payroll domain). Staffing firms negotiate rates with candidates during placement, then activate those rates in p
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: primary_pay_staff_profile_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the recruiter who negotiated and captured this pay rate agreement on behalf of the staffing firm. Supports accountability and commission tracking.
attributes.references: Bullhorn ATS/CRM User Object

attributes.name: profile_id
attributes.description: Reference to the candidate for whom this pay rate agreement is established. Links to the candidate master record in the Candidate domain.
attributes.references: Bullhorn ATS/CRM Candidate Object

attributes.name: wage_hour_determination_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.wage_hour_determination. Business justification: Wage/hour determinations validate FLSA classification, overtime eligibility, and minimum wage compliance for specific pay arrangements. Pay rate agreements must reference the compliance determination
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: agreement_number
attributes.description: Externally-visible business identifier for this pay rate agreement, used in payroll handoff documents, offer letters, and TempWorks Payroll integration. Format: PRA- followed by 8-12 digits.
attributes.references: TempWorks Payroll Pay Rate Object; ASA Staffing Standards

attributes.name: agreement_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the pay rate agreement. Draft indicates initial capture; pending_approval awaits manager sign-off; approved is authorized but not yet effective; active is currently in force; expired has passed its end date; cancelled was voided before activation.
attributes.references: TempWorks Payroll Workflow; ASA Staffing Standards

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: The current approval workflow status for this pay rate agreement. Pending awaits review; approved indicates authorization by the designated approver; rejected requires renegotiation; escalated has been referred to senior management for exception handling.
attributes.references: Bullhorn ATS/CRM Approval Workflow; Internal Staffing Firm Policy

attributes.name: approval_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time at which the pay rate agreement was formally approved by the designated approver. Null if not yet approved. Used for SLA tracking on approval turnaround time.
attributes.references: SOC 2 Type II; Bullhorn ATS/CRM; Internal Staffing Firm Policy

attributes.name: burden_rate_pct
attributes.description: The employer burden rate percentage applied on top of the base pay rate to account for employer-side costs including FICA, FUTA, SUTA, Workers Compensation (Workers Comp), and benefits. Expressed as a percentage (e.g., 18.50 for 18.50%). Used in gross margin and spread calculations.
attributes.references: IRS FICA Rules; FUTA (Federal Unemployment Tax Act); SUTA (State Unemployment Tax Act); Workers Compensation Insurance; TempWorks Payroll

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this pay rate agreement record was first created in the system. Audit trail field supporting SOC 2 Type II compliance and data lineage tracking.
attributes.references: SOC 2 Type II; GDPR Article 5 (Data Integrity); CCPA

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date on which this pay rate agreement becomes binding and active. Pay calculations in TempWorks Payroll use this date to determine which rate applies for a given pay period.
attributes.references: FLSA; DOL Wage Standards; TempWorks Payroll

attributes.name: engagement_type
attributes.description: The type of staffing engagement for which this pay rate agreement applies. Temp (temporary), contract, temp-to-perm (Contract-to-Hire), direct hire (permanent placement), or SOW (Statement of Work) project-based engagement. Drives payroll and billing treatment.
attributes.references: ASA Staffing Standards; IRS Worker Classification Rules; FLSA; Bullhorn ATS/CRM

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: The date on which this pay rate agreement ceases to be effective. Null for open-ended agreements. When populated, triggers a rate review or renewal workflow. Aligns with assignment end date or contract term.
attributes.references: FLSA; DOL Wage Standards; TempWorks Payroll; ASA Staffing Standards

attributes.name: flsa_exemption_status
attributes.business_glossary_term: Fair Labor Standards Act (FLSA) Exemption Status
attributes.description: Indicates whether the candidate is classified as exempt or non-exempt under the Fair Labor Standards Act (FLSA). Non-exempt workers are entitled to overtime pay; exempt workers are not. Critical for OT rate applicability and payroll compliance.
attributes.references: FLSA (Fair Labor Standards Act); DOL Wage and Hour Division; EEOC

attributes.name: holiday_rate_multiplier
attributes.description: The multiplier applied to the base pay rate for hours worked on designated holidays (e.g., 1.5 for time-and-a-half, 2.0 for double time). Null if no special holiday rate applies. Used in TempWorks Payroll holiday pay calculations.
attributes.references: FLSA; DOL; TempWorks Payroll; Client MSA Terms

attributes.name: is_rate_negotiable
attributes.description: Indicates whether the pay rate in this agreement is open to further negotiation by the candidate or recruiter. True if negotiable; False if the rate is fixed (e.g., set by a VMS program or client rate card). Supports recruiter workflow guidance.
attributes.references: Beeline VMS Rate Management; Bullhorn ATS/CRM; ASA Staffing Standards

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this pay rate agreement record was most recently modified. Audit trail field supporting change tracking, SOC 2 Type II compliance, and Silver layer incremental processing in Databricks.
attributes.references: SOC 2 Type II; GDPR Article 5 (Data Integrity); CCPA; Databricks Lakehouse Standards

attributes.name: max_weekly_hours
attributes.description: The maximum number of hours per week the candidate is authorized to work under this agreement before requiring manager or client approval for additional hours. Supports overtime cost control and ACA compliance monitoring.
attributes.references: FLSA; ACA (Affordable Care Act) Hour Thresholds; DOL; TempWorks Payroll

attributes.name: min_guaranteed_hours
attributes.description: The minimum number of hours per week or pay period guaranteed to the candidate under this agreement, regardless of actual hours worked. Common in certain contract arrangements. Null if no minimum guarantee applies.
attributes.references: DOL Wage Standards; FLSA; ASA Staffing Standards

attributes.name: msa_reference
attributes.description: Reference to the Master Service Agreement (MSA) or contract document that governs the terms under which this pay rate agreement was established. Links to DocuSign CLM contract records.
attributes.references: DocuSign CLM; MSA (Master Service Agreement); ASA Staffing Standards

attributes.name: negotiation_date
attributes.description: The date on which the pay rate was negotiated and agreed between the recruiter and the candidate. Represents the principal business event timestamp for this agreement. Distinct from the effective date when the rate becomes active.
attributes.references: Bullhorn ATS/CRM; ASA Staffing Standards

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for recruiter or manager notes related to this pay rate agreement, such as special negotiation context, candidate expectations, client constraints, or exception justifications. Supports operational context for payroll and compliance teams.
attributes.references: Bullhorn ATS/CRM; Internal Staffing Firm Policy

attributes.name: ot_threshold_hours
attributes.description: The number of hours worked in a week (or day, depending on state law) after which overtime rates apply. Defaults to 40 hours per week per FLSA but may be lower for certain states (e.g., 8 hours/day in California). Drives OT rate application in TempWorks Payroll.
attributes.references: FLSA (Fair Labor Standards Act); California Labor Code; DOL Wage and Hour Division

attributes.name: prevailing_wage_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this pay rate agreement is subject to prevailing wage requirements under the Davis-Bacon Act, Service Contract Act, or applicable state prevailing wage laws (common for government and public sector contracts). True if prevailing wage rules apply.
attributes.references: Davis-Bacon Act; Service Contract Act; DOL Wage and Hour Division; OFCCP

attributes.name: prevailing_wage_rate
attributes.description: The government-mandated prevailing wage rate applicable to this engagement when prevailing_wage_flag is True. The base_pay_rate must be equal to or greater than this value to maintain compliance. Null if prevailing wage does not apply.
attributes.references: Davis-Bacon Act; Service Contract Act; DOL Wage and Hour Division; OFCCP

attributes.name: rate_change_reason
attributes.description: Free-text or coded explanation for why this pay rate agreement was created or modified (e.g., initial placement, merit increase, market adjustment, assignment extension, client rate change, cost-of-living adjustment). Supports audit and analytics.
attributes.references: ASA Staffing Standards; Internal Staffing Firm Policy; SOC 2 Type II

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: The operational system of record from which this pay rate agreement originated. Bullhorn for ATS-driven agreements; TempWorks for payroll-initiated rates; Beeline for VMS-driven rate cards; Manual for agreements entered directly into the data platform.
attributes.references: Bullhorn ATS/CRM; TempWorks Payroll; Beeline VMS; SOC 2 Type II

attributes.name: source_system_ref
attributes.description: The native identifier of this pay rate agreement record in the originating source system (e.g., Bullhorn placement pay rate ID, TempWorks pay rate record ID). Supports data lineage, reconciliation, and integration traceability.
attributes.references: SOC 2 Type II; Data Lineage Standards; Bullhorn ATS/CRM; TempWorks Payroll

attributes.name: vms_rate_card_ref
attributes.business_glossary_term: Vendor Management System (VMS) Rate Card Reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier to the VMS (Vendor Management System) rate card or rate schedule that governs this pay rate agreement when the engagement is managed through a VMS program (e.g., Beeline). Null for non-VMS engagements.
attributes.references: Beeline VMS Rate Management; MSP Program Standards; ASA Staffing Standards

attributes.name: work_state_code
attributes.description: Two-letter US state code where the candidate performs work under this agreement. Determines applicable state wage laws, SUTA rates, workers comp rates, and state income tax withholding requirements.
attributes.references: DOL State Wage Laws; SUTA (State Unemployment Tax Act); IRS State Tax Withholding; FLSA

attributes.name: workers_comp_code
attributes.description: The NCCI or state-specific workers compensation class code assigned to this pay rate agreement based on the job duties and risk classification. Drives workers comp premium calculation in TempWorks Payroll.
attributes.references: NCCI Workers Compensation Classification; OSHA; State Workers Comp Regulations; TempWorks Payroll

products.name: right_to_represent
products.description: Tracks RTR (Right to Represent) grants issued by candidates authorizing the staffing firm to submit their profile to a specific client or job order. Captures candidate ID, job order ID, client ID, RTR grant method (verbal, email, portal consent, signed form), RTR grant timestamp, RTR expiration date, RTR scope (single req, client-wide, program-wide), revocation flag, revocation timestamp, and revocation reason. Critical for compliance with co-employment rules and preventing unauthorized submittals. Supports OFCCP and EEOC audit readiness.
products.reference: RTR (Right to Represent) Authorization (Bullhorn ATS / Compliance)

attributes.name: right_to_represent_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated identifier for each Right to Represent (RTR) grant record. Primary key for this entity. Role classification: TRANSACTION_HEADER.
attributes.references: Bullhorn ATS/CRM — Candidate Submittal Object

attributes.name: client_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the client account for which the RTR was granted. Required for client-wide or program-wide RTR scope; also populated for single-req scope to support client-level compliance reporting.
attributes.references: Bullhorn ATS/CRM — Client Account Object; OFCCP Compliance

attributes.name: client_contact_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to client.contact. Business justification: RTR is often granted by specific client contact (hiring manager, HR representative). Tracking who granted RTR supports dispute resolution, audit requirements, and relationship accountability. Role-pre
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: order_header_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific job order (requisition) for which the RTR was granted. Applicable when RTR scope is limited to a single requisition.
attributes.references: Bullhorn ATS/CRM — Job Order Object

attributes.name: primary_right_staff_profile_id
attributes.description: Reference to the internal recruiter or staffing consultant who obtained and recorded the RTR grant from the candidate. Used for accountability, audit, and performance tracking.
attributes.references: Bullhorn ATS/CRM — User/Recruiter Object; OFCCP Compliance

attributes.name: prior_rtr_right_to_represent_id
attributes.description: Reference to the previous RTR record that this record supersedes or replaces, enabling lineage tracking when an RTR is renewed, extended, or re-scoped. Null for original grants.
attributes.references: Bullhorn ATS/CRM — Submittal History; OFCCP Audit Readiness

attributes.name: profile_id
attributes.description: Reference to the candidate who granted the Right to Represent (RTR) authorization. Links to the candidate master record in the candidate domain.
attributes.references: Bullhorn ATS/CRM — Candidate Object

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to vendor.supplier. Business justification: In VMS/MSP programs, multiple staffing suppliers compete for the same requisitions. Right-to-represent tracks which supplier has submission rights for a specific candidate to a specific client/req. Th
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: vms_program_id
attributes.description: Reference to the VMS program (e.g., Beeline) under which this RTR was captured, applicable when rtr_scope is 'program_wide'. Null for non-VMS engagements.
attributes.references: Beeline VMS — Program Object; MSP Program Management

attributes.name: acknowledgment_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time the candidate formally acknowledged the RTR terms. Distinct from grant_timestamp in cases where consent is captured asynchronously (e.g., portal consent with delayed confirmation).
attributes.references: GDPR Article 7; OFCCP Audit Readiness

attributes.name: candidate_acknowledged
attributes.description: Indicates whether the candidate has explicitly acknowledged the RTR terms, including understanding that the staffing firm will represent them to the specified client or program. True = acknowledged; False = not yet acknowledged.
attributes.references: ASA Code of Ethics; Co-Employment Risk Management; OFCCP

attributes.name: candidate_ip_address
attributes.description: IP address of the device used by the candidate when granting RTR consent via a digital portal. Captured for audit and legal evidence purposes. Applicable when grant_method is 'portal_consent'. Classified as confidential PII per GDPR and CCPA.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; CCPA; SOC 2 Type II

attributes.name: consent_document_url
attributes.description: Secure URL or storage path to the RTR consent document (e.g., signed PDF, DocuSign completed envelope). Confidential as it may contain candidate signature and personal details. Null when no document was captured.
attributes.references: DocuSign CLM; SOC 2 Type II; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Audit timestamp recording when this RTR record was first created in the system. Distinct from grant_timestamp, which captures the real-world consent event.
attributes.references: SOC 2 Type II; GDPR Article 5(2); CCPA

attributes.name: dispute_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this RTR grant is subject to an active dispute, such as a competing vendor claiming prior right to represent the same candidate to the same client. True = disputed; False = undisputed.
attributes.references: ASA Code of Ethics; VMS Program Management; Beeline VMS

attributes.name: dispute_resolution_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes documenting the outcome and resolution of an RTR dispute, including the basis for the decision (e.g., timestamp comparison, client confirmation). Populated only when dispute_flag is True.
attributes.references: ASA Code of Ethics; VMS Program Management

attributes.name: eeoc_disposition_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Equal Employment Opportunity Commission (EEOC) Disposition Code
attributes.description: Standardized EEOC disposition code associated with the candidate's submittal outcome linked to this RTR, used for adverse action tracking and OFCCP/EEOC reporting. Populated after submittal disposition is determined. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: interviewed|not_selected|hired|withdrawn|no_show|position_cancelled — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: EEOC Uniform Guidelines on Employee Selection Procedures; OFCCP Compliance

attributes.name: email_thread_reference
attributes.description: Message ID or thread reference from the email system capturing the candidate's email-based RTR consent. Applicable when grant_method is 'email'. Used for audit evidence retrieval.
attributes.references: OFCCP Audit Readiness; ASA Best Practices

attributes.name: exclusivity_expiration_date
attributes.description: The date on which the exclusivity period of the RTR grant ends, after which the candidate may be submitted by other vendors. Null when exclusivity_flag is False or exclusivity is open-ended.
attributes.references: ASA Best Practices; VMS Program Management

attributes.name: exclusivity_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the RTR grant is exclusive to this staffing firm for the specified scope, preventing the candidate from being submitted by competing vendors to the same client or requisition. True = exclusive; False = non-exclusive.
attributes.references: ASA Best Practices; VMS Rate Management; Beeline VMS

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: The date on which the RTR grant expires and is no longer valid for new submittals. Null indicates no expiration (open-ended grant). Enforced by ATS workflow to prevent unauthorized submittals after expiry.
attributes.references: ASA Best Practices; Co-Employment Risk Management

attributes.name: grant_method
attributes.description: The channel or mechanism by which the candidate provided RTR consent. 'verbal' — spoken consent captured by recruiter; 'email' — written consent via email; 'portal_consent' — self-service ATS/candidate portal click-through; 'signed_form' — wet or e-signature on RTR document; 'vms_portal' — consent captured through a Vendor Management System (VMS) portal such as Beeline.
attributes.references: ASA Code of Ethics; OFCCP Audit Readiness; DocuSign CLM

attributes.name: grant_timestamp
attributes.description: The exact date and time the candidate granted the Right to Represent authorization. This is the principal business event timestamp for this transaction, distinct from the record audit timestamp.
attributes.references: ASA Best Practices; OFCCP Audit Readiness; FCRA

attributes.name: is_revoked
attributes.description: Indicates whether the candidate has revoked the RTR grant prior to its natural expiration. True = revoked; False = not revoked. Used as a fast-path filter in submittal eligibility checks.
attributes.references: ASA Code of Ethics; OFCCP Compliance

attributes.name: nda_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the client requires a Non-Disclosure Agreement (NDA) to be in place before the candidate's profile can be shared. True = NDA required prior to submittal; False = no NDA requirement.
attributes.references: DocuSign CLM; MSA Terms; Client Program Requirements

attributes.name: nda_signed
attributes.description: Indicates whether the required NDA has been executed by the candidate prior to or concurrent with the RTR grant. Relevant when nda_required is True. True = NDA signed; False = NDA not yet signed.
attributes.references: DocuSign CLM; OFCCP Compliance; Client MSA

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: General free-text notes entered by the recruiter or compliance team regarding this RTR grant, including any special conditions, client-specific requirements, or contextual information not captured in structured fields.
attributes.references: Bullhorn ATS/CRM — Notes Object; ASA Best Practices

attributes.name: ofccp_audit_ready
attributes.description: Indicates whether this RTR record has all required documentation and metadata to satisfy an Office of Federal Contract Compliance Programs (OFCCP) audit, including consent evidence, timestamps, and scope definition. True = audit-ready; False = documentation incomplete.
attributes.references: OFCCP Compliance Requirements; EEOC Guidelines; ASA Best Practices

attributes.name: placement_type
attributes.description: The worker classification and engagement type for which the RTR is being granted. 'w2_temp' — W-2 temporary placement; '1099_contract' — independent contractor (1099); 'contract_to_hire' — contract-to-hire (temp-to-perm); 'direct_hire' — direct placement/permanent; 'eor' — Employer of Record (EOR) arrangement.
attributes.references: IRS Worker Classification Rules; FLSA; ASA Best Practices

attributes.name: revocation_initiated_by
attributes.description: Identifies who initiated the revocation of the RTR grant. 'candidate' — candidate self-revoked; 'recruiter' — recruiter revoked on behalf of candidate; 'system' — automated revocation triggered by business rule (e.g., placement made); 'client' — client requested removal.
attributes.references: ASA Code of Ethics; OFCCP Compliance

attributes.name: revocation_reason
attributes.description: Free-text or categorized explanation provided by the candidate or recruiter for why the RTR was revoked. Examples: candidate accepted another offer, candidate withdrew from process, candidate requested removal from client consideration.
attributes.references: ASA Code of Ethics; GDPR Article 7(3); CCPA

attributes.name: revocation_timestamp
attributes.description: The exact date and time the candidate revoked the RTR grant. Null when is_revoked is False. Required for audit trail and to determine the window during which submittals were authorized.
attributes.references: ASA Code of Ethics; OFCCP Audit Readiness; GDPR Article 7(3)

attributes.name: rtr_number
attributes.description: Human-readable, externally referenceable identifier for the RTR grant, used in recruiter communications, audit trails, and submittal documentation. Format: RTR-YYYY-NNNNNN.
attributes.references: Bullhorn ATS/CRM — Submittal Reference; ASA Best Practices

attributes.name: rtr_scope
attributes.description: Defines the breadth of the RTR authorization. 'single_req' — limited to one specific requisition/job order; 'client_wide' — covers all open requisitions at the named client; 'program_wide' — covers all requisitions within a managed service program (MSP/VMS program).
attributes.references: ASA Best Practices; Co-Employment Risk Management; Beeline VMS

attributes.name: rtr_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the RTR grant. 'active' — valid and usable for submittal; 'expired' — past expiration date; 'revoked' — candidate withdrew consent; 'pending' — awaiting candidate confirmation; 'superseded' — replaced by a newer RTR for the same scope.
attributes.references: ASA Code of Ethics; OFCCP Compliance; EEOC Guidelines

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Identifies the originating system where the RTR consent was captured. 'bullhorn' — Bullhorn ATS/CRM; 'beeline_vms' — Beeline VMS portal; 'candidate_portal' — self-service candidate portal; 'email' — email-based capture; 'manual' — manually entered by recruiter.
attributes.references: Bullhorn ATS/CRM; Beeline VMS; SOC 2 Type II

attributes.name: source_system_rtr_ref
attributes.description: The native identifier of this RTR record in the originating source system (e.g., Bullhorn submittal ID, Beeline VMS consent token). Used for cross-system reconciliation and data lineage.
attributes.references: Bullhorn ATS/CRM; Beeline VMS; SOC 2 Type II

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Audit timestamp recording the most recent modification to this RTR record, including status changes, revocations, or scope updates.
attributes.references: SOC 2 Type II; GDPR Article 5(2)

attributes.name: valid_days_duration
attributes.description: The number of calendar days for which the RTR grant is valid from the grant_timestamp. Used to calculate expiration_date and to standardize RTR validity policies across client programs.
attributes.references: ASA Best Practices; VMS Program Rate Management

attributes.name: verbal_consent_notes
attributes.description: Recruiter-entered notes documenting the circumstances of a verbal RTR consent, including date, time, and summary of conversation. Required when grant_method is 'verbal' to satisfy audit requirements.
attributes.references: ASA Code of Ethics; OFCCP Audit Readiness

products.name: talent_pool_membership
products.description: Association entity tracking which curated talent pools or talent communities a candidate belongs to, including redeployment pool assignments when a candidate is being actively redeployed from an ending assignment

attributes.name: talent_pool_membership_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each talent pool membership record. Primary key for the talent_pool_membership entity in the candidate domain Silver layer.
attributes.references: ISO 30405:2016 Human Resource Management

attributes.name: client_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the client account for which this talent pool is specifically curated, if applicable. Null for general or non-client-specific talent pools. Supports client-specific bench management and VMS program alignment.
attributes.references: Bullhorn ATS/CRM - Client Account Object; Beeline VMS

attributes.name: location_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to client.location. Business justification: Talent pools often organized by client location ("pool for Chicago warehouse site") to support targeted sourcing, redeployment, and bench management. Standard MSP/VMS practice. No existing location FK
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: primary_talent_staff_profile_id
attributes.description: Reference to the recruiter or staffing coordinator who added the candidate to the talent pool. Supports accountability tracking and recruiter performance analytics.
attributes.references: Bullhorn ATS/CRM - User Object; ISO 30405:2016

attributes.name: profile_id
attributes.description: Reference to the candidate who is a member of the talent pool. Links to the candidate master record in the Bullhorn ATS/CRM candidate object.
attributes.references: Bullhorn ATS/CRM - Candidate Object

attributes.name: redeployment_assignment_id
attributes.description: Reference to the assignment that is ending and triggering the redeployment of this candidate into the talent pool. Null for non-redeployment pool memberships. Links to the placement.assignment product.
attributes.references: Bullhorn ATS/CRM - Placement/Assignment Object; ASA Redeployment Best Practices

attributes.name: talent_pool_id
attributes.description: Reference to the curated talent pool or talent community to which the candidate belongs. Talent pools may represent skill-based communities, redeployment pools, client-specific bench lists, or specialty practice groups.
attributes.references: Bullhorn ATS/CRM - Tearsheet/Talent Pool Object; ISO 30405:2016

attributes.name: vms_program_id
attributes.description: Reference to the Vendor Management System (VMS) program associated with this talent pool membership, if the pool is managed under a Managed Service Provider (MSP) or VMS-driven contingent workforce program via Beeline VMS.
attributes.references: Beeline VMS - Program Management; ASA MSP/VMS Program Guidelines

attributes.name: added_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the candidate was added to the talent pool. Used for tenure-in-pool analytics and redeployment SLA tracking.
attributes.references: ISO 30405:2016; ASA Staffing Industry Best Practices

attributes.name: availability_date
attributes.description: Date from which the candidate is available to begin a new assignment or placement. For redeployment candidates, this is typically the day after the current assignment ends. Critical for matching and dispatch workflows.
attributes.references: Bullhorn ATS/CRM - Candidate Availability; ISO 30405:2016

attributes.name: availability_type
attributes.description: The type of work engagement the candidate is available for within this talent pool context. Indicates whether the candidate is seeking full-time, part-time, contract, per diem, or flexible arrangements. Supports job order matching logic.
attributes.references: FLSA (Fair Labor Standards Act); ASA Workforce Guidelines

attributes.name: bgc_status
attributes.description: Current status of the candidate's background check (BGC) as it pertains to eligibility for placements from this talent pool. 'clear' indicates a passed background check; 'adverse_action' indicates a disqualifying result; 'expired' indicates the BGC has exceeded its validity period. Sourced from Sterling Background Check integration.
attributes.references: Fair Credit Reporting Act (FCRA); EEOC Background Check Guidelines; Sterling Background Check

attributes.name: contact_attempt_count
attributes.description: Total number of recruiter contact attempts made to the candidate since being added to this talent pool. Used to identify unresponsive candidates and trigger escalation or exit workflows.
attributes.references: Bullhorn ATS/CRM Activity Tracking; ASA Workforce Guidelines

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this talent pool membership record was first created in the system. Represents the audit creation time in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Used for data lineage, audit trails, and SLA measurement.
attributes.references: SOC 2 Type II; GDPR Article 5 (Data Integrity); CCPA

attributes.name: drug_screen_status
attributes.description: Current status of the candidate's drug screening result as it pertains to eligibility for placements from this talent pool. 'negative' indicates a passed drug screen; 'positive' indicates a failed result; 'expired' indicates the screen has exceeded its validity period. Sourced from Sterling Background Check.
attributes.references: DOL Drug-Free Workplace Guidelines; OSHA; Sterling Background Check; ASA Compliance Standards

attributes.name: engagement_score
attributes.description: Numeric score (0–100) reflecting the candidate's level of engagement with the talent pool, based on recruiter interactions, response rates, and activity signals. Higher scores indicate more responsive and engaged candidates. Used to prioritize outreach and predict placement likelihood.
attributes.references: ASA Workforce Analytics; SIA KPI Framework; Bullhorn ATS/CRM Engagement Tracking

attributes.name: everify_status
attributes.description: Current E-Verify employment authorization status for the candidate. E-Verify is the federal electronic employment eligibility verification system. Required for federal contractor placements and certain state-mandated programs. Sourced from compliance.everify_case.
attributes.references: Immigration and Nationality Act (INA); USCIS E-Verify Program; OFCCP Compliance

attributes.name: exit_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the candidate exited or was removed from the talent pool. Null if the membership is still active. Used for pool churn analysis and redeployment outcome tracking.
attributes.references: ISO 30405:2016; ASA Workforce Guidelines

attributes.name: exit_reason
attributes.description: Reason the candidate exited the talent pool. 'placed' indicates a successful placement was made; 'declined_offer' indicates the candidate declined a placement offer; 'unresponsive' indicates the candidate became unreachable; 'disqualified' indicates the candidate no longer meets pool criteria; 'converted_to_perm' indicates a temp-to-perm conversion occurred. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: placed|declined_offer|unresponsive|disqualified|converted_to_perm|pool_dissolved|candidate_request|credential_lapse — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ASA Workforce Guidelines; Bullhorn ATS/CRM Disposition Codes

attributes.name: i9_verified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the candidate has a valid, completed I-9 Employment Eligibility Verification on file, confirming work authorization in the United States. Required for all W-2 placements. Sourced from compliance.i9_verification.
attributes.references: Immigration and Nationality Act (INA) - I-9 Compliance; USCIS Form I-9; EEOC

attributes.name: interview_count
attributes.description: Number of client interviews the candidate has completed as a result of submittals from this talent pool membership. Used to measure pool conversion effectiveness and recruiter performance.
attributes.references: Bullhorn ATS/CRM - Interview Tracking; SIA KPI Framework; ISO 30405:2016

attributes.name: is_redeployment_candidate
attributes.description: Indicates whether this pool membership record was created as part of a formal redeployment workflow triggered by an ending assignment. True when the candidate is being actively redeployed; False for general talent pool members. Supports bench and redeployment tracking KPIs.
attributes.references: ASA Workforce Guidelines; Bullhorn ATS/CRM Redeployment Workflow

attributes.name: is_willing_to_relocate
attributes.description: Indicates whether the candidate is willing to relocate for a placement sourced from this talent pool. True if the candidate has expressed willingness to relocate; False if the candidate requires local placements only. Expands the geographic matching radius for job order fulfillment.
attributes.references: Bullhorn ATS/CRM - Candidate Preferences; ASA Workforce Guidelines

attributes.name: is_willing_to_travel
attributes.description: Indicates whether the candidate is willing to travel for assignments sourced from this talent pool. Relevant for travel nursing, per diem, and project-based staffing programs where travel is required.
attributes.references: Bullhorn ATS/CRM - Candidate Preferences; ASA Per Diem Guidelines

attributes.name: last_contact_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent recruiter contact or outreach activity with the candidate regarding this pool membership. Used to identify stale pool members who have not been contacted recently and to enforce pool maintenance SLAs.
attributes.references: ASA Workforce Guidelines; Bullhorn ATS/CRM Activity Tracking

attributes.name: membership_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the candidate's membership in the talent pool. 'active' indicates the candidate is actively managed within the pool; 'pending_review' indicates awaiting recruiter qualification; 'suspended' indicates temporarily paused; 'exited' indicates the candidate has been removed from the pool.
attributes.references: ISO 30405:2016 Human Resource Management; ASA Workforce Guidelines

attributes.name: membership_type
attributes.description: Classification of the nature of the candidate's pool membership. 'redeployment' indicates the candidate is being actively redeployed from an ending assignment; 'bench' indicates an unassigned worker available for dispatch; 'talent_community' indicates a passive talent community member; 'client_specific' indicates a pool curated for a specific client program; 'specialty_practice' indicates a domain-specific skill pool. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: redeployment|bench|talent_community|client_specific|specialty_practice|pipeline|vms_preferred|msp_approved — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ASA Workforce Guidelines; Bullhorn ATS/CRM Tearsheet Classification

attributes.name: pay_rate_currency
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the pay rate values (pay_rate_min, pay_rate_max). Defaults to 'USD' for domestic U.S. operations. Supports multi-currency operations for international staffing programs.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; IRS Tax Reporting Requirements

attributes.name: pay_rate_max
attributes.description: The maximum hourly or unit pay rate the candidate is targeting for placements sourced from this talent pool. Expressed in USD. Used alongside pay_rate_min to define the candidate's acceptable pay range for matching and negotiation.
attributes.references: FLSA (Fair Labor Standards Act); DOL Wage and Hour Division; ASA Pay Rate Guidelines

attributes.name: pay_rate_min
attributes.description: The minimum hourly or unit pay rate the candidate is willing to accept for placements sourced from this talent pool. Expressed in USD. Used by recruiters during job order matching to filter viable candidates. Supports spread and gross margin analysis.
attributes.references: FLSA (Fair Labor Standards Act); DOL Wage and Hour Division; ASA Pay Rate Guidelines

attributes.name: pool_qualification_date
attributes.description: Date on which the candidate was formally qualified and approved for inclusion in this talent pool by a recruiter or pool manager. May differ from added_date if a review/approval workflow is required before activation.
attributes.references: ISO 30405:2016; ASA Credentialing and Qualification Standards

attributes.name: preferred_location_city
attributes.description: The candidate's preferred city for work assignments sourced from this talent pool. Used for geographic matching of job orders to pool members. Supports workforce scheduling and dispatch workflows.
attributes.references: Bullhorn ATS/CRM - Candidate Preferences; ASA Workforce Guidelines

attributes.name: preferred_location_state
attributes.description: Two-letter U.S. state code for the candidate's preferred work location. Used for geographic filtering during job order matching and for state-specific compliance checks (SUTA, workers comp, wage-hour laws).
attributes.references: DOL State Wage and Hour Laws; SUTA Compliance; Bullhorn ATS/CRM

attributes.name: preferred_work_type
attributes.description: The candidate's preferred employment classification or engagement type within this pool. Reflects whether the candidate prefers W-2 temporary, 1099 independent contractor, Employer of Record (EOR), or direct hire arrangements. Informs compliance and worker classification checks.
attributes.references: IRS Worker Classification Rules; FLSA; ASA Workforce Guidelines

attributes.name: primary_skill_category
attributes.description: The primary skill category or discipline that qualifies the candidate for this talent pool (e.g., 'Information Technology', 'Healthcare - Nursing', 'Light Industrial', 'Finance & Accounting'). Used for pool segmentation and job order matching. Free-text aligned to the pool's defined skill taxonomy.
attributes.references: ISO 30405:2016; O*NET Occupational Classification; ASA Staffing Industry Analysts

attributes.name: priority_tier
attributes.description: Recruiter-assigned priority tier indicating the urgency and desirability of placing this candidate from the pool. Tier 1 represents highest priority (e.g., actively redeploying workers with imminent assignment end dates); Tier 4 represents passive pipeline members. Drives recruiter workflow prioritization.
attributes.references: ASA Workforce Guidelines; Staffing Industry Analysts (SIA) Talent Pool Management

attributes.name: qualification_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes entered by the recruiter or pool manager documenting the rationale for the candidate's inclusion in the talent pool, any qualification criteria met, or special considerations for placement matching.
attributes.references: Bullhorn ATS/CRM - Notes Object; ISO 30405:2016

attributes.name: redeployment_target_date
attributes.description: Target date by which the recruiter aims to redeploy the candidate into a new assignment. Typically aligned with or shortly after the ending assignment's end date. Used for redeployment SLA and Time to Start (TTS) tracking.
attributes.references: ASA Workforce Guidelines; SIA KPI Framework - Time to Start (TTS)

attributes.name: source_channel
attributes.description: The sourcing channel or mechanism through which the candidate was identified and added to this talent pool. 'redeployment' indicates the candidate was added as part of an assignment-end redeployment workflow; 'vms_import' indicates the candidate was sourced via Beeline VMS. Supports sourcing channel attribution analytics. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: ats_sourcing|redeployment|referral|vms_import|job_board|direct_apply|recruiter_outreach|social_media|campus|alumni — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Bullhorn ATS/CRM Source Tracking; ASA Staffing Industry Analysts (SIA) Sourcing Metrics

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: The operational system of record from which this talent pool membership record originated. Supports data lineage tracking and reconciliation in the Silver layer. 'bullhorn' indicates the record was sourced from Bullhorn ATS/CRM; 'beeline_vms' indicates a VMS-managed pool imported from Beeline.
attributes.references: SOC 2 Type II; Databricks Lakehouse Data Lineage Standards

attributes.name: source_system_record_ref
attributes.description: The native identifier of this talent pool membership record in the originating source system (e.g., Bullhorn Tearsheet Member ID or Beeline Pool Member ID). Used for cross-system reconciliation and deduplication in the Silver layer.
attributes.references: SOC 2 Type II; Databricks Lakehouse Data Lineage Standards

attributes.name: submittal_count
attributes.description: Number of times the candidate has been submitted (submitted to a client for consideration) from this talent pool membership. A submittal is a formal presentation of a candidate's profile to a client for a specific job order. Tracks pool productivity and Quality of Submission (QoS) metrics.
attributes.references: Bullhorn ATS/CRM - Submission Tracking; ASA QoS Metrics; SIA KPI Framework

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to this talent pool membership record. Used for change data capture (CDC), incremental ETL processing, and audit trail maintenance in the Databricks Silver layer.
attributes.references: SOC 2 Type II; GDPR Article 5 (Data Integrity); CCPA

attributes.name: worker_classification
attributes.description: The IRS and DOL worker classification applicable to this candidate within the context of this talent pool. Determines tax treatment, benefits eligibility, and co-employment risk. 'w2_employee' indicates a W-2 temporary employee; '1099_ic' indicates an Independent Contractor (IC); 'eor' indicates Employer of Record arrangement; 'corp_to_corp' indicates a business-to-business engagement.
attributes.references: IRS Worker Classification Rules (Section 530); FLSA; DOL; ASA Co-Employment Guidelines

products.name: diversity_profile
products.description: Stores voluntary self-identification data for EEOC, OFCCP, and diversity reporting purposes. Captures race/ethnicity (self-identified, per EEOC categories), gender identity, veteran status (non-veteran, protected veteran, active duty), disability status (per ADA/Section 503), collection method (voluntary self-ID form, portal), collection date, consent to use for reporting flag, and data classification level (restricted). Maintained separately from the core profile to enforce access control and comply with FCRA, EEOC, and OFCCP regulations.
products.reference: EEO-1 / OFCCP Self-Identification Data (EEOC / OFCCP Compliance)

attributes.name: diversity_profile_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the diversity profile record. Primary key for this data product in the candidate domain Silver layer.
attributes.references: ISO 30405:2016 Human Resource Management

attributes.name: privacy_request_id
attributes.description: Reference to a data subject access, deletion, or correction request that triggered a change to this diversity profile record. Links to the compliance domain privacy_request product for GDPR/CCPA audit trail.
attributes.references: GDPR Articles 15-17; CCPA; FCRA

attributes.name: profile_id
attributes.description: Reference to the candidate whose voluntary self-identification diversity data this record captures. Links to the core candidate profile in the candidate domain.
attributes.references: Bullhorn ATS/CRM; EEOC Uniform Guidelines

attributes.name: affirmative_action_plan_code
attributes.description: Identifier of the Affirmative Action Plan (AAP) under which this candidate's diversity data is tracked for OFCCP compliance. Links the candidate's self-ID data to the applicable AAP establishment for federal contractor reporting.
attributes.references: OFCCP 41 CFR Part 60-1; Executive Order 11246

attributes.name: anonymized_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the personally identifiable elements of this diversity profile record have been anonymized following data retention expiry or candidate deletion request. Anonymized records may be retained for aggregate statistical reporting.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 17; CCPA; FCRA; SOC 2 Type II

attributes.name: collection_date
attributes.description: The date on which the voluntary self-identification data was collected from the candidate. Used for compliance audit trails and to determine data currency for EEOC/OFCCP reporting cycles.
attributes.references: EEOC EEO-1; OFCCP 41 CFR Part 60-1; FCRA

attributes.name: collection_method
attributes.description: The method by which the voluntary self-identification data was collected from the candidate. Supports audit trail and data quality assessment for EEOC/OFCCP compliance reporting.
attributes.references: EEOC Uniform Guidelines; OFCCP 41 CFR Part 60-1; FCRA

attributes.name: collection_source_system
attributes.description: The operational system of record from which the self-identification data was collected or ingested. Supports data lineage and system-of-record traceability for compliance audits.
attributes.references: SOC 2 Type II; GDPR Article 30; CCPA

attributes.name: consent_date
attributes.description: The date on which the candidate provided consent for their diversity data to be used in reporting. Supports GDPR, CCPA, and FCRA consent audit requirements.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 7; CCPA; FCRA; EEOC

attributes.name: consent_to_report_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the candidate has provided explicit consent for their voluntary self-identification data to be used in EEOC, OFCCP, and internal diversity reporting. Required for lawful use of sensitive demographic data.
attributes.references: EEOC; OFCCP 41 CFR Part 60-1; GDPR Article 7; CCPA; FCRA

attributes.name: consent_withdrawn_date
attributes.description: The date on which the candidate withdrew consent for use of their diversity data in reporting. Nullable when consent has not been withdrawn. Triggers data suppression from active reporting.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 7; CCPA; FCRA

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this diversity profile record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail, data lineage, and compliance record-keeping requirements.
attributes.references: SOC 2 Type II; GDPR Article 30; OFCCP 41 CFR Part 60-1.12

attributes.name: data_classification_level
attributes.description: The data sensitivity classification level assigned to this diversity profile record. Diversity data is classified as 'restricted' by default per EEOC, OFCCP, FCRA, and internal data governance policy to enforce access control.
attributes.references: FCRA; EEOC; OFCCP; GDPR Article 9; CCPA; SOC 2 Type II

attributes.name: data_retention_expiry_date
attributes.description: The date after which this diversity profile record must be purged or anonymized per applicable data retention policies under GDPR, CCPA, FCRA, and OFCCP record-keeping requirements. Supports automated data lifecycle management.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 5(1)(e); CCPA; FCRA; OFCCP 41 CFR Part 60-1.12; DOL

attributes.name: disability_status_code
attributes.description: Voluntary self-identified disability status per ADA and Section 503 of the Rehabilitation Act. Captures whether the candidate identifies as having a disability as defined under Section 503 and ADA.
attributes.references: ADA Americans with Disabilities Act; Section 503 Rehabilitation Act; OFCCP 41 CFR Part 60-741

attributes.name: disability_type_description
attributes.description: Optional free-text description of the disability type if voluntarily provided by the candidate. Captured only when disability_status_code is 'yes_disability' and the candidate elects to provide additional detail.
attributes.references: ADA; Section 503 Rehabilitation Act; OFCCP 41 CFR Part 60-741

attributes.name: eeo1_snapshot_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Equal Employment Opportunity Commission (EEOC) EEO-1 Snapshot Date
attributes.description: The workforce snapshot date used for EEO-1 Component 1 reporting, typically a pay period between October 1 and December 31. Identifies which reporting cycle this record contributes to.
attributes.references: EEOC EEO-1 Component 1; 29 CFR Part 1602

attributes.name: eeoc_job_category_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Equal Employment Opportunity Commission (EEOC) Job Category Code
attributes.description: The EEOC EEO-1 job category code associated with the candidate's placement or role at time of data collection. Used to stratify diversity data by occupational category for EEO-1 Component 1 reporting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: exec_senior_officials|first_mid_officials|professionals|technicians|sales_workers|admin_support|craft_workers|operatives|laborers|service_workers — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: EEOC EEO-1 Component 1; 29 CFR Part 1602

attributes.name: form_version
attributes.description: Version identifier of the voluntary self-identification form used to collect the data. Tracks form revisions to ensure compliance with current EEOC/OFCCP category definitions and regulatory updates.
attributes.references: EEOC EEO-1; OFCCP 41 CFR Part 60-1; OFCCP 41 CFR Part 60-741

attributes.name: gender_identity_code
attributes.description: Voluntary self-identified gender identity of the candidate. Captured per EEOC and OFCCP reporting requirements. 'self_describe' allows free-text entry captured in gender_identity_description.
attributes.references: EEOC EEO-1; OFCCP 41 CFR Part 60-1; SHRM Gender Identity Guidelines

attributes.name: gender_identity_description
attributes.description: Free-text self-description of gender identity provided by the candidate when gender_identity_code is 'self_describe'. Nullable for all other gender identity codes.
attributes.references: EEOC EEO-1; SHRM Gender Identity Guidelines

attributes.name: included_in_aap_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Included in Affirmative Action Plan (AAP) Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this candidate's diversity data was included in the OFCCP Affirmative Action Plan (AAP) for the applicable reporting establishment and year.
attributes.references: OFCCP 41 CFR Part 60-1; Executive Order 11246

attributes.name: included_in_eeo1_report_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this candidate's diversity data was included in the annual EEOC EEO-1 Component 1 filing. Supports compliance audit and reconciliation between headcount and filed data.
attributes.references: EEOC EEO-1 Component 1; 29 CFR Part 1602

attributes.name: invitation_sent_date
attributes.description: The date on which the voluntary self-identification invitation was sent to the candidate. Required for OFCCP compliance to demonstrate that candidates were invited to self-identify at the appropriate stage of the hiring process.
attributes.references: OFCCP 41 CFR Part 60-741; OFCCP 41 CFR Part 60-300

attributes.name: lgbtq_identity_flag
attributes.description: Voluntary self-identification flag indicating whether the candidate identifies as LGBTQ+. Captured for internal diversity program tracking and inclusion reporting. Not used for EEOC/OFCCP mandatory filings.
attributes.references: SHRM Diversity and Inclusion Guidelines; ASA Diversity Best Practices

attributes.name: no_response_reason
attributes.description: Reason code explaining why no response was received from the candidate for the self-identification invitation. Nullable when response_received_flag is True. Supports OFCCP audit documentation.
attributes.references: OFCCP 41 CFR Part 60-741; OFCCP 41 CFR Part 60-300

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes entered by compliance or HR staff regarding this diversity profile record. May include data quality observations, correction history, or compliance review comments. Access restricted per data classification policy.
attributes.references: EEOC; OFCCP; SOC 2 Type II

attributes.name: ofccp_covered_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Office of Federal Contract Compliance Programs (OFCCP) Covered Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the candidate is associated with a federal contractor placement and therefore subject to OFCCP affirmative action and reporting obligations under Executive Order 11246, Section 503, and VEVRAA.
attributes.references: OFCCP 41 CFR Part 60-1; OFCCP 41 CFR Part 60-300; OFCCP 41 CFR Part 60-741; Executive Order 11246

attributes.name: post_offer_collection_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the self-identification data was collected after a job offer was extended. Post-offer collection is the standard timing for Section 503 disability self-ID per OFCCP regulations.
attributes.references: OFCCP 41 CFR Part 60-741; Section 503 Rehabilitation Act

attributes.name: pre_offer_collection_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the self-identification data was collected prior to a job offer being extended. OFCCP and EEOC require that self-ID data collected pre-offer be maintained separately and not used in selection decisions.
attributes.references: OFCCP 41 CFR Part 60-1; EEOC Uniform Guidelines on Employee Selection Procedures

attributes.name: race_ethnicity_code
attributes.description: Voluntary self-identified race/ethnicity category per EEOC standard classifications. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: hispanic_or_latino|white|black_or_african_american|native_hawaiian_or_pacific_islander|asian|american_indian_or_alaska_native|two_or_more_races|prefer_not_to_answer — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: EEOC EEO-1 Component 1 Race/Ethnicity Categories; 29 CFR Part 1602

attributes.name: race_ethnicity_label
attributes.description: Human-readable display label corresponding to the race/ethnicity code as reported by the candidate on the voluntary self-identification form. Stored for reporting clarity and audit trail.
attributes.references: EEOC EEO-1 Component 1; OFCCP 41 CFR Part 60-1

attributes.name: record_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the diversity profile record. 'active' indicates the current valid record; 'superseded' indicates a prior version replaced by a newer submission; 'withdrawn' indicates candidate-requested removal; 'pending_review' indicates data quality review in progress.
attributes.references: EEOC; OFCCP 41 CFR Part 60-1; GDPR Article 17; CCPA

attributes.name: reminder_sent_date
attributes.description: The date on which a reminder to complete the voluntary self-identification form was sent to the candidate. Supports OFCCP documentation requirements for outreach and invitation efforts.
attributes.references: OFCCP 41 CFR Part 60-741; OFCCP 41 CFR Part 60-300

attributes.name: reporting_year
attributes.description: The calendar year for which this diversity profile record is applicable for EEOC EEO-1 and OFCCP affirmative action plan reporting. Supports annual compliance filing cycles.
attributes.references: EEOC EEO-1; OFCCP 41 CFR Part 60-1; DOL

attributes.name: response_received_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the candidate responded to the voluntary self-identification invitation, regardless of whether they chose to disclose or selected 'prefer not to answer'. Supports OFCCP response rate tracking.
attributes.references: OFCCP 41 CFR Part 60-741; OFCCP 41 CFR Part 60-300

attributes.name: source_form_reference
attributes.description: The document or form reference number of the original voluntary self-identification form submitted by the candidate. Supports audit trail and document retrieval for OFCCP compliance reviews.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this diversity profile record was last modified. Tracks data currency and supports change audit trail for EEOC, OFCCP, GDPR, and CCPA compliance.

attributes.name: verified_by_recruiter_flag

attributes.name: veteran_status_code

[ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: non_veteran|protected_veteran|active_duty|recently_separated|armed_forces_service_medal|disabled_veteran|prefer_not_to_answer — promote to reference product]
