products.name: candidate_compliance
products.description: This association product represents the fulfillment status of compliance requirements by individual candidates in the staffing pipeline. It captures the operational tracking of which requirements each candidate has completed, when they were verified, their current status, and any waivers or exceptions granted. Each record links one candidate profile to one compliance requirement with attributes that exist only in the context of this specific candidate-requirement fulfillment relationship. Essential for onboarding clearance gates, placement eligibility determination, and regulatory audit readiness.. Existence Justification: In staffing operations, each candidate must satisfy multiple compliance requirements (I-9 employment eligibility, background checks, drug screens, industry certifications, client-specific training mandates), and each compliance requirement applies to many candidates across the talent pool. The business actively manages candidate compliance fulfillment as an operational process with dedicated compliance officers who track completion status, verification dates, expiration schedules, and waivers for each candidate-requirement pair. This is not a derived analytical correlation but a core operational workflow that gates onboarding clearance and placement eligibility.

attributes.name: candidate_compliance_id
attributes.description: Primary key for candidate_compliance

attributes.name: profile_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the candidate profile record whose compliance status is being tracked
attributes.references: Internal - M:N Association FK

attributes.name: requirement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the specific compliance requirement that must be fulfilled
attributes.references: Internal - M:N Association FK

attributes.name: assigned_date
attributes.description: Date on which this compliance requirement was assigned to this candidate (typically at application submission or placement offer acceptance). Used to calculate time-to-completion and identify overdue requirements based on grace_period_days.

attributes.name: completion_date
attributes.description: Date on which this candidate successfully completed and had verified this specific compliance requirement. Null if requirement_status is not_started, in_progress, or failed. Used to calculate time-to-compliance metrics and determine re-verification due dates. Identified in detection phase as relationship data.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when this candidate-requirement fulfillment record was first created in the compliance tracking system.

attributes.name: due_date
attributes.description: Calculated deadline by which this candidate must complete this requirement, derived from assigned_date plus grace_period_days from the compliance_requirement master. Used for escalation workflows and onboarding gate enforcement.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date on which this candidate's fulfillment of this requirement expires and requires re-verification. Calculated from completion_date plus re_verification_interval_days from the compliance_requirement master record. Null for one-time requirements that do not expire. Drives automated alerts for upcoming expirations. Identified in detection phase as relationship data.

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp of the most recent update to this candidate-requirement fulfillment record. Used for audit trails and change tracking.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for compliance officers and recruiters to document special circumstances, waiver justifications, verification issues, candidate-specific exceptions, or audit notes related to this specific candidate-requirement fulfillment. Identified in detection phase as relationship data.

attributes.name: requirement_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of this candidate's fulfillment of this specific requirement. not_started = requirement assigned but no action taken; in_progress = candidate has begun submission/verification; completed = requirement fully satisfied and verified; expired = previously completed but now past expiration date requiring re-verification; waived = requirement exempted for this candidate via approved waiver; failed = candidate did not meet requirement criteria. Identified in detection phase as relationship data.

attributes.name: verification_document_url
attributes.description: URL or document management system reference to the uploaded verification documents for this candidate-requirement fulfillment (e.g., scanned I-9, background check report PDF, certification scan). Supports audit evidence retrieval.

attributes.name: verification_source
attributes.description: The system, vendor, or process through which this requirement was verified for this candidate (e.g., 'E-Verify', 'Sterling Background Check', 'Manual HR Review', 'Client Portal Upload', 'Certemy License Verification'). Provides audit trail for compliance verification chain of custody. Identified in detection phase as relationship data.

attributes.name: verified_by
attributes.description: Name or employee ID of the compliance officer or HR staff member who verified and approved this candidate's fulfillment of this requirement. Provides accountability for verification decisions.

attributes.name: waiver_approval_date
attributes.description: Date on which the waiver was officially approved. Required when waiver_flag is true.

attributes.name: waiver_approved_by
attributes.description: Name or employee ID of the authorized individual who approved the waiver for this candidate-requirement combination. Required when waiver_flag is true. Provides accountability for compliance exceptions.

attributes.name: waiver_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this candidate has been granted an approved waiver or exception for this specific requirement. True = requirement waived for this candidate; False = standard requirement enforcement applies. Waivers must be documented with approval authority and business justification in notes field. Identified in detection phase as relationship data.

products.name: audit_sample
products.description: This association product represents the inclusion of a candidate profile in a compliance audit sample. It captures which candidates were selected for audit review, the selection criteria, findings specific to that candidate in that audit, and remediation status. Each record links one profile to one compliance_audit with attributes that exist only in the context of this audit sampling relationship. Critical for audit response, corrective action tracking, and regulatory compliance documentation.. Existence Justification: In staffing compliance operations, audits (I-9, OFCCP, wage/hour, client audits) routinely sample multiple candidate/worker records for review, and individual candidates may be included in multiple audits over time (e.g., an I-9 audit in Q1, an OFCCP audit in Q3, and a client compliance audit the following year). The business actively manages audit samples as operational records, tracking which candidates were selected, why they were selected, findings specific to each candidate in each audit, and remediation status for each candidate-audit combination.

attributes.name: audit_sample_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each audit sample record. Primary key for the association.

attributes.name: audit_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the compliance audit in which this candidate was sampled
attributes.references: Internal - M:N Association FK

attributes.name: profile_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the candidate profile included in the audit sample
attributes.references: Internal - M:N Association FK

attributes.name: auditor_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes recorded by the auditor during review of this candidate's records. May include observations, context, mitigating factors, or follow-up questions. Tagged PII as it may reference candidate-specific details.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when this audit sample record was created. Indicates when the candidate was added to the audit sample.

attributes.name: deficiency_description
attributes.description: Narrative description of compliance deficiencies, gaps, or findings identified for this candidate during the audit. May include documentation gaps (missing I-9, incomplete background check), process failures (late tax filing), or regulatory breaches (misclassification). Tagged PII as it may reference candidate-specific details.

attributes.name: finding_count
attributes.description: Number of audit findings identified for this specific candidate within this audit. A candidate may have zero findings (clean record) or multiple findings across different compliance areas. Aggregates to the audit-level total_findings_count.

attributes.name: inclusion_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this candidate profile was included in the final audit sample (true) or was initially considered but excluded (false). Tracks both sampled and non-sampled candidates for audit trail purposes.

attributes.name: remediation_completed_date
attributes.description: Actual date on which corrective action for this candidate's audit findings was completed and verified. Used to track compliance with remediation timelines and regulatory commitments. Null if remediation not yet complete.

attributes.name: remediation_due_date
attributes.description: Target date by which corrective action for this candidate's audit findings must be completed. Set by compliance team based on finding severity and regulatory requirements. Null if no findings or no remediation required.

attributes.name: remediation_status
attributes.description: Current status of corrective action or remediation for findings related to this candidate in this audit. Tracks lifecycle from identification through closure. Not_applicable indicates no findings were identified for this candidate.

attributes.name: risk_rating
attributes.description: Risk severity rating assigned to findings for this candidate in this audit. Critical findings require immediate escalation and remediation. Aggregates to audit-level overall_risk_rating. Null if no findings identified.

attributes.name: sample_selection_reason
attributes.description: The methodology or rationale for why this candidate was selected for inclusion in the audit sample. Indicates whether selection was random, risk-based, regulatory-mandated, or client-requested. Critical for audit defensibility and statistical validity.

attributes.name: sample_sequence_number
attributes.description: Sequential number assigned to this candidate within the audit sample. Used for audit workpaper organization and tracking progress through the sample. Supports audit methodology documentation.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp of the most recent update to this audit sample record. Tracks changes to findings, remediation status, or auditor notes.

products.name: talent_pool

domains.name: client
domains.description: SSOT for all client (employer) identity and commercial relationship data. Owns client company profiles, contacts, account hierarchies, locations, MSA agreements, rate cards, VMS integrations, SLA configurations, NPS scores, and CRM engagement history sourced from Bullhorn and Salesforce. Serves as the authoritative source for WHO the business serves on the demand side, supporting both direct clients and VMS/MSP program relationships.

products.name: client_account
products.description: Master record for every client (employer) organization that Staffing Hr serves. SSOT for client company identity, classification, and billing configuration. Sourced from Bullhorn ATS/CRM and Salesforce Revenue Cloud. Captures legal entity name, DBA name, DUNS number, FEIN, industry classification (NAICS/SIC), company size tier, client type (direct, VMS/MSP, RPO), account status (prospect, active, inactive, on-hold, terminated), primary business address, website, and CRM account owner. Also owns billing preferences: invoice delivery method, invoice frequency, invoice grouping rules (by location, department, cost center, or consolidated), PO number requirements, payment method (ACH, check, wire), billing contact, and preferred payment portal. Demand-side anchor entity for all job orders, placements, billing, and commercial relationships.

attributes.name: client_account_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate primary key for each client account record in the Staffing Hr system. System-generated identifier used as the anchor key for all downstream job orders, placements, billing, and commercial relationships.
attributes.references: ISO 30405:2016 Human Resource Management

attributes.name: client_crm_account_owner_staff_profile_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Crm Account Owner Staff Profile Id (Foreign Key)
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to employee.staff_profile. Business justification: CRM account ownership is core to sales territory management, commission calculation, and client relationship accountability. Crm_account_owner is denormalized text; FK enables territory assignment tra
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: client_staff_profile_id
attributes.description: FK to employee.staff_profile.staff_profile_id — Every client account must identify the assigned account manager for relationship management, revenue accountability, and commission attribution.

attributes.name: legal_entity_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.legal_entity. Business justification: Clients contract with specific legal entities of the staffing firm. Essential for intercompany elimination, statutory reporting, tax compliance, and legal liability tracking. Fundamental to multi-enti
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: account_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the client account. Drives operational eligibility for job order creation, placement activity, and billing. Values: prospect (pre-contract sales stage), active (current client with open MSA), inactive (no current activity but relationship intact), on_hold (temporarily suspended per SLA or compliance issue), terminated (relationship ended).
attributes.references: ASA Best Practices; Bullhorn ATS/CRM — Account Lifecycle; Salesforce Revenue Cloud — Account Status

attributes.name: billing_contact_email
attributes.description: Email address of the designated billing contact at the client organization. Primary channel for electronic invoice delivery, payment reminders, and accounts receivable communications.
attributes.references: Salesforce Revenue Cloud — Billing Contact; GDPR Article 4; CCPA; Oracle NetSuite ERP — AR

attributes.name: billing_contact_name
attributes.description: Full name of the designated billing contact at the client organization responsible for receiving and approving invoices. Used by Salesforce Revenue Cloud and accounts receivable for invoice delivery and payment follow-up.
attributes.references: Salesforce Revenue Cloud — Billing Contact; Oracle NetSuite ERP — Accounts Receivable

attributes.name: bullhorn_client_code
attributes.description: The native record identifier assigned to this client account within Bullhorn ATS/CRM. Used for cross-system reconciliation and data lineage tracing between the Silver layer and the operational source system.
attributes.references: Bullhorn ATS/CRM — Company Record

attributes.name: client_type
attributes.description: Classifies the commercial relationship model under which Staffing Hr serves this client. attributes.name: company_size_tier

Used for account segmentation, service tier assignment, pricing strategy, and sales territory management. Values: small (<100 FTE), mid_market (100–999 FTE), enterprise (1,000–9,999 FTE), global_enterprise (10,000+ FTE).
attributes.references: SIA Market Segmentation Standards; ASA Account Classification Best Practices

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when the client account record was first created in the system of record (Bullhorn ATS/CRM or Salesforce Revenue Cloud). Represents the audit trail creation event and is used for data lineage, compliance reporting, and record age analysis.

attributes.name: credit_limit

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all billing and financial transactions with this client (e.g., USD, CAD, GBP). Defaults to USD for domestic clients. Required for multi-currency revenue recognition in Oracle NetSuite ERP.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; Oracle NetSuite ERP — Multi-Currency; GAAP Revenue Recognition

attributes.name: dba_name

attributes.references: ASA Best Practices; Bullhorn ATS/CRM — Company Record

attributes.name: duns_number

attributes.name: employee_headcount

attributes.name: fein

attributes.name: invoice_delivery_method

attributes.name: invoice_frequency

attributes.name: main_phone

attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; CCPA; Bullhorn ATS/CRM — Company Record

attributes.name: manager_name

attributes.name: msa_effective_date

attributes.name: naics_code

attributes.name: nda_on_file

attributes.name: primary_postal_code

attributes.name: primary_state
