attributes.description: External identifier from Salesforce Revenue Cloud corresponding to the survey response record. Enables bidirectional traceability between the Silver layer and the Salesforce system of record for reconciliation and audit.
attributes.references: Salesforce Revenue Cloud — Survey Response Object; Staffing Hr System Integration Standards

attributes.name: sentiment_score
attributes.description: Numeric sentiment polarity score derived from NLP analysis of the verbatim_comment field, ranging from -1.0000 (most negative) to 1.0000 (most positive). Computed by the analytics pipeline and stored for account health scoring and retention risk modeling inputs. Not a manually entered field.
attributes.references: Power BI Analytics Platform — Sentiment Analysis; SIA Workforce Analytics Standards; ASA Client Satisfaction Best Practices

attributes.name: service_line
attributes.description: The staffing service line associated with the NPS survey trigger (e.g., temporary staffing, direct hire, temp-to-perm, RPO, MSP, EOR, consulting). Enables service-line-level NPS benchmarking and satisfaction trending. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: temporary_staffing|direct_hire|temp_to_perm|rpo|msp|eor|consulting — promote to reference product if service lines expand]
attributes.references: ASA Staffing Industry Classification; SIA Service Line Taxonomy

attributes.name: survey_channel
attributes.description: The delivery channel through which the NPS survey was administered to the respondent (e.g., email, phone, in-app, SMS, web portal). Enables channel-level response rate and score analysis.
attributes.references: Salesforce Revenue Cloud — Survey Distribution; ASA Client Satisfaction Standards

attributes.name: survey_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the client respondent submitted the NPS survey response. Used as the primary business event date for satisfaction trending and cohort analysis.
attributes.references: ASA Best Practices for Client Satisfaction Measurement; SIA Workforce Solutions Buyer Survey Standards

attributes.name: survey_language
attributes.description: ISO 639-1 two-letter language code indicating the language in which the NPS survey was presented and completed (e.g., en, es, fr). Supports multilingual operations and ensures verbatim comments are processed with the correct language model.
attributes.references: ISO 639-1 Language Codes; GDPR Article 12 (communication in clear language)

attributes.name: survey_sent_timestamp
attributes.description: Exact date and time the NPS survey invitation was dispatched to the respondent. Used to calculate response latency (time from send to submission) and survey expiry enforcement.
attributes.references: Salesforce Revenue Cloud — Survey Distribution Log; ASA Client Satisfaction Standards

attributes.name: survey_trigger
attributes.description: The business event or schedule that initiated this NPS survey distribution. Classifies whether the survey was triggered by a periodic cadence (quarterly, annual) or a specific business event (post-placement, post-fill, post-onboarding). Enables trigger-level benchmarking. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: quarterly|post_placement|post_fill|post_onboarding|annual|ad_hoc — promote to reference product if additional triggers are added]
attributes.references: ASA Best Practices for Client Satisfaction Measurement; SIA Workforce Solutions Buyer Survey Standards

attributes.name: survey_version
attributes.description: Version identifier of the NPS survey instrument used to collect this response (e.g., 'v2.1', 'Q3-2024'). Enables longitudinal comparability analysis when survey questions or scales are updated over time.
attributes.references: ASA Client Satisfaction Best Practices; Salesforce Revenue Cloud — Survey Version Management

attributes.name: theme_tags
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of business theme labels extracted from the verbatim_comment via text classification (e.g., 'candidate_quality,speed_of_fill,account_manager_responsiveness'). Populated by the analytics pipeline. Enables theme-level satisfaction trending and root cause analysis without parsing free text.
attributes.references: Power BI Analytics Platform — Text Analytics; ASA Client Satisfaction Best Practices; SIA KPI Framework

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to this NPS response record in the Silver layer. Tracks resolution status changes, follow-up updates, and data corrections. Required for change data capture and audit trail compliance.
attributes.references: SOC 2 Type II; GDPR Article 5 (accountability); Staffing Hr Data Governance Policy

attributes.name: verbatim_comment
attributes.description: Free-text qualitative feedback provided by the respondent explaining their NPS score. Captured verbatim without modification. Used for sentiment analysis, theme identification, and account manager coaching. Subject to data retention policies under GDPR and CCPA.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; CCPA; ASA Client Satisfaction Best Practices

products.name: account_segment
products.description: Commercial segmentation and classification record for a client account, defining strategic tier, revenue potential, and service model. Captures segment tier (strategic, key, growth, transactional), vertical industry focus, geographic market, annual revenue band, headcount band, estimated annual staffing spend, wallet share estimate, primary service line (temp staffing, direct hire, RPO, MSP), account manager assignment, and segment review date. Used for territory planning, resource allocation, and go-to-market prioritization.

attributes.name: account_segment_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the account segment record. Primary key for the account_segment data product in the client domain. Entity role: MASTER_RESOURCE — this product defines a commercial segmentation and classification record for a client account, carrying its own identity, lifecycle, and quantitative facts.
attributes.references: Staffing Hr Internal Data Standards

attributes.name: client_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent client account record in the client.client_account product. Establishes which client employer this segmentation record belongs to.
attributes.references: Bullhorn ATS/CRM — Account Object; Salesforce Revenue Cloud — Account Object

attributes.name: managed_program_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to client.managed_program. Business justification: Account segments have msp_program_flag and rpo_program_flag indicating managed program participation, but lack the FK to identify which specific managed program. This enables segmentation analysis by
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: primary_strategic_account_executive_staff_profile_id
attributes.description: Reference to the senior strategic account executive or VP-level sponsor assigned to strategic and key tier accounts. Applicable primarily to strategic and key segment tiers. Supports executive relationship management and escalation routing.
attributes.references: Bullhorn ATS/CRM — Executive Sponsor; Salesforce Revenue Cloud — Executive Sponsor Field

attributes.name: vms_program_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to client.vms_program. Business justification: Account segments have vms_program_flag indicating VMS program participation, but lack the FK to identify which specific VMS program. This enables segmentation analysis by VMS program. One segment can
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: active_placement_count
attributes.description: Current number of active worker placements (temporary assignments and permanent placements) at this account segment as of the last data refresh. Key operational metric for workforce density and account health assessment. Sourced from Bullhorn ATS/CRM placement records.
attributes.references: Bullhorn ATS/CRM — Placement Count; ASA Workforce Metrics; SIA Staffing Industry Benchmarks

attributes.name: active_req_count
attributes.description: Current number of open job requisitions (Reqs) active for this account segment at the time of the last data refresh. Provides a real-time demand signal for recruiter capacity planning and segment health monitoring. Sourced from Bullhorn ATS/CRM job order data.
attributes.references: Bullhorn ATS/CRM — Job Order Count; ASA Demand Planning Standards; SIA Workforce Demand Metrics

attributes.name: annual_revenue_band
attributes.description: Banded classification of the client company's estimated annual revenue, used for market sizing, credit risk assessment, and service tier alignment. Bands: under_1m, 1m_to_10m, 10m_to_50m, 50m_to_250m, over_250m (USD). Confidential business intelligence used in go-to-market prioritization.
attributes.references: SIA Market Intelligence; Staffing Hr Credit Policy; Oracle NetSuite ERP — Customer Revenue Classification

attributes.name: conversion_fee_pct
attributes.description: Agreed conversion fee percentage charged to the client when a temporary worker converts to a permanent (direct hire) employee, expressed as a percentage of the converted worker's first-year salary. Applicable for temp-to-perm and contract-to-hire arrangements. Confidential commercial term.
attributes.references: Staffing Hr MSA Template — Conversion Fee Clause; ASA Temp-to-Perm Fee Standards; FLSA (Fair Labor Standards Act)

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this account segment record was first created in the system, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Serves as the RECORD_AUDIT_CREATED category for this entity. Used for data lineage, audit trail, and compliance reporting.
attributes.references: SOC 2 Type II — Audit Trail Requirements; GDPR Article 5 — Data Integrity and Accountability; Staffing Hr Data Governance Policy

attributes.name: credit_limit
attributes.description: Maximum outstanding accounts receivable balance (in USD) approved for this account segment before new placements or timesheets are placed on hold. Segment-level credit limit may be more restrictive than the parent client_account credit limit for specific service lines or geographies.
attributes.references: Oracle NetSuite ERP — Customer Credit Limit; Staffing Hr Credit Policy; Salesforce Revenue Cloud — Credit Management

attributes.name: direct_hire_fee_pct
attributes.description: Agreed placement fee percentage charged to the client for direct hire (permanent placement) engagements, expressed as a percentage of the placed candidate's first-year base salary. Confidential commercial pricing term negotiated at the account segment level.
attributes.references: Staffing Hr MSA Template — Direct Hire Fee Clause; ASA Direct Hire Fee Standards; Salesforce Revenue Cloud — Fee Schedule

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date on which this segment classification became effective and began driving territory planning, resource allocation, and go-to-market prioritization decisions. Serves as the EFFECTIVE_FROM category for this MASTER_RESOURCE entity.
attributes.references: Staffing Hr Internal Data Standards; ASA Account Management Guidelines

attributes.name: estimated_annual_staffing_spend
attributes.description: Estimated total annual spend (in USD) the client account allocates to contingent and permanent staffing services across all providers. Used to calculate wallet share and prioritize account investment. This is the principal quantitative fact (MEASUREMENT_OR_VALUE) for this MASTER_RESOURCE entity. Sourced from Salesforce Revenue Cloud opportunity data and market intelligence.
attributes.references: SIA Staffing Spend Analytics; Salesforce Revenue Cloud — Account Spend Estimate; Staffing Hr Revenue Intelligence Policy

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date on which this segment classification expires and is subject to review or reclassification. Nullable for open-ended segment assignments. Serves as the EFFECTIVE_UNTIL category for this MASTER_RESOURCE entity.
attributes.references: Staffing Hr Internal Data Standards; ASA Account Management Guidelines

attributes.name: fall_off_rate_pct
attributes.description: Percentage of placements at this account segment that ended prematurely (fall-offs) within the trailing 12-month period, calculated as (fall-off placements / total placements) * 100. Fall-off rate is a key quality metric in staffing, indicating placement quality and candidate-client fit. Used to assess recruiter performance and account health.
attributes.references: ASA Quality of Service (QoS) Standards; SIA Placement Quality Benchmarks; Staffing Hr Recruiter Performance Policy

attributes.name: geographic_market
attributes.description: Primary geographic market or territory associated with this client account segment, used for territory planning and regional resource allocation (e.g., Northeast, Southeast, Midwest, West, National, International). Drives assignment of regional account managers and branch coverage. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: northeast|southeast|midwest|west|southwest|national|international — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Staffing Hr Territory Planning Standards; SIA Geographic Market Definitions

attributes.name: gross_margin_target_pct
attributes.description: Target gross margin percentage for this account segment, representing the spread (bill rate minus pay rate and burden costs) as a percentage of the bill rate. Used to evaluate account profitability and guide pricing decisions. Confidential financial target data.
attributes.references: Staffing Hr Financial Policy; Oracle NetSuite ERP — Gross Margin Reporting; SIA Financial Benchmarks

attributes.name: headcount_band
attributes.description: Banded classification of the client company's total employee headcount, used to estimate staffing demand potential and align service model complexity. Bands represent total FTE (Full-Time Equivalent) employees at the client organization.
attributes.references: SIA Workforce Demand Sizing; ASA Client Segmentation Guidelines; Bullhorn ATS/CRM — Company Size

attributes.name: last_reviewed_date
attributes.description: Date on which this account segment classification was most recently reviewed and confirmed or updated by the account management team. Used to track review cadence compliance and identify stale segment assignments.
attributes.references: Staffing Hr Territory Planning Policy; Salesforce Revenue Cloud — Last Review Date

attributes.name: markup_pct
attributes.description: Standard markup percentage applied to pay rates to derive bill rates for this account segment, expressed as a decimal percentage (e.g., 45.00 = 45%). Markup covers burden costs (FICA, FUTA, SUTA, Workers Comp), overhead, and gross margin. Confidential commercial pricing data. Sourced from Salesforce Revenue Cloud rate card configuration.
attributes.references: Staffing Hr Pricing Policy; Salesforce Revenue Cloud — Rate Card; ASA Pricing Best Practices; IRS — Employer Tax Obligations (FICA, FUTA)

attributes.name: msp_program_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this client account is managed through a Managed Service Provider (MSP) program, where a third-party MSP intermediary manages the contingent workforce program on behalf of the client. Affects supplier tier, rate card access, and billing routing.
attributes.references: Beeline VMS — MSP Configuration; SIA MSP Market Report; ASA MSP Program Standards

attributes.name: nps_score
attributes.description: Most recent Net Promoter Score (NPS) recorded for this account segment, ranging from -100 to 100. NPS measures client loyalty and likelihood to recommend Staffing Hr's services. Segment-level NPS may differ from the parent client_account NPS if multiple business units or service lines are surveyed independently.
attributes.references: ASA Client Satisfaction Standards; SIA NPS Benchmarks; Staffing Hr Client Experience Policy

attributes.name: nps_survey_date
attributes.description: Date on which the most recent NPS (Net Promoter Score) survey was conducted for this account segment. Used to assess recency of satisfaction data and trigger follow-up surveys per client experience policy.
attributes.references: ASA Client Satisfaction Standards; Staffing Hr Client Experience Policy

attributes.name: on_site_program_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this client account has an on-site staffing program where a Staffing Hr on-site manager or coordinator is physically embedded at the client location to manage the contingent workforce. Drives on-site headcount budgeting and operational cost allocation.
attributes.references: ASA On-Site Program Standards; Staffing Hr Operational Delivery Policy

attributes.name: payment_terms_days
attributes.description: Number of days from invoice date within which the client is contractually required to remit payment for this account segment (e.g., Net 30, Net 45, Net 60). May differ from the parent client_account default payment terms if segment-specific terms have been negotiated.
attributes.references: Oracle NetSuite ERP — Customer Payment Terms; Salesforce Revenue Cloud — Payment Terms; Staffing Hr Credit Policy

attributes.name: preferred_supplier_status
attributes.description: Staffing Hr's supplier status designation within the client's vendor program. Preferred indicates highest-priority routing of requisitions. Tier_1 and Tier_2 reflect VMS/MSP program supplier tiers. Approved indicates active but non-preferred status. Not_listed indicates no formal supplier agreement in place.
attributes.references: Beeline VMS — Supplier Tier Configuration; ASA Supplier Diversity Standards; SIA Supplier Management Best Practices

attributes.name: primary_service_line
attributes.description: The principal staffing service line through which this client account is primarily served. Temp Staffing (temporary placement), Direct Hire (permanent placement), RPO (Recruitment Process Outsourcing), MSP (Managed Service Provider program), Contract-to-Hire (temp-to-perm), SOW (Statement of Work-based project staffing). Drives billing model, recruiter assignment, and operational workflow.
attributes.references: ASA Staffing Service Line Definitions; SIA Service Line Classification; Bullhorn ATS/CRM — Opportunity Type

attributes.name: prior_segment_tier
attributes.description: The segment tier assigned to this account immediately before the most recent reclassification event. Enables trend analysis of account movement across tiers (upgrades vs. downgrades). Null if this is the initial segment assignment.
attributes.references: Staffing Hr Territory Planning Policy; SIA Account Segmentation Analytics

attributes.name: reclassification_reason
attributes.description: Free-text or coded reason explaining why this account segment was reclassified from a prior tier or service model. Supports audit trail and trend analysis of segment movement (e.g., 'Revenue decline below key tier threshold', 'New MSP program win — upgraded to strategic'). Populated only when a reclassification event occurs.
attributes.references: Staffing Hr Data Governance Policy; Salesforce Revenue Cloud — Account Change Reason

attributes.name: rpo_program_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this client account has an active Recruitment Process Outsourcing (RPO) engagement with Staffing Hr, where Staffing Hr manages some or all of the client's permanent hiring process. Drives RPO-specific SLA tracking and dedicated recruiter team assignment.
attributes.references: ASA RPO Program Standards; SIA RPO Market Report; ISO 30405:2016 Human Resource Management — Guidelines on Recruitment

attributes.name: secondary_service_lines
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of additional staffing service lines the client account utilizes beyond the primary service line (e.g., 'direct_hire,sow'). Supports cross-sell analysis and multi-service account management. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: temp_staffing|direct_hire|rpo|msp|contract_to_hire|sow|per_diem|payrolling — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ASA Staffing Service Line Definitions; Salesforce Revenue Cloud — Opportunity Product Lines

attributes.name: segment_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric code uniquely identifying this segment classification record, used in territory planning reports, go-to-market materials, and CRM tagging (e.g., SEG-STRAT-001). Serves as the BUSINESS_IDENTIFIER for this MASTER_RESOURCE entity.
attributes.references: Salesforce Revenue Cloud — Account Segment Code; ASA Segmentation Best Practices

attributes.name: segment_notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for account managers and strategic planners to capture qualitative context about this account segment, including competitive intelligence, relationship history, strategic initiatives, or special handling instructions not captured in structured fields.
attributes.references: Bullhorn ATS/CRM — Account Notes; Salesforce Revenue Cloud — Account Comments; Staffing Hr CRM Usage Policy

attributes.name: segment_review_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next periodic review and potential reclassification of this account segment. Ensures segment tiers remain current with client revenue performance and strategic fit. Typically set on an annual or semi-annual cadence per territory planning policy.
attributes.references: Staffing Hr Territory Planning Policy; ASA Account Management Best Practices; Salesforce Revenue Cloud — Account Review Date

attributes.name: segment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the account segment record. Active indicates the segmentation is in force and driving territory and resource decisions. Under_review indicates a pending reclassification. Inactive indicates the segment assignment has lapsed. Archived indicates historical record retained for audit. Serves as the LIFECYCLE_STATUS for this MASTER_RESOURCE entity.
attributes.references: Staffing Hr Internal Data Governance Policy; Salesforce Revenue Cloud — Record Status

attributes.name: segment_tier
attributes.description: Strategic classification tier assigned to the client account, defining the level of investment, service intensity, and executive attention. Values: strategic (top-tier, highest revenue potential), key (established high-value), growth (emerging high-potential), transactional (volume-based, lower-touch). Serves as the primary CLASSIFICATION_OR_TYPE for this entity.
attributes.references: Staffing Industry Analysts (SIA) — Account Segmentation Framework; ASA Best Practices

attributes.name: sla_tier
attributes.description: SLA (Service Level Agreement) tier assigned to this account segment, defining the contractual service performance standards including Time to Fill (TTF), Time to Start (TTS), submittal quality, and response time commitments. Platinum and Gold tiers carry the most stringent SLA obligations. Distinct from the sla_tier on client_account which may reflect the MSA-level SLA; this field reflects the segment-specific SLA classification.
attributes.references: ASA SLA Best Practices; Staffing Hr MSA Template — SLA Exhibit; Beeline VMS — SLA Configuration

attributes.name: target_ttf_days
attributes.description: Target number of business days from job order receipt to candidate submittal, as defined for this account segment's SLA tier. TTF (Time to Fill) is a core KPI in staffing operations. Used to set recruiter performance expectations and measure delivery quality against segment commitments.
attributes.references: ASA KPI Standards — Time to Fill; SIA Operational Benchmarks; Staffing Hr SLA Policy

attributes.name: target_tts_days
attributes.description: Target number of calendar days from job order receipt to candidate start date, as defined for this account segment's SLA tier. TTS (Time to Start) measures the full cycle from requisition to placement and is a key client satisfaction metric in staffing.
attributes.references: ASA KPI Standards — Time to Start; SIA Operational Benchmarks; Staffing Hr SLA Policy

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this account segment record was most recently modified, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Used for change detection, incremental data pipeline processing, and audit trail maintenance.
attributes.references: SOC 2 Type II — Audit Trail Requirements; GDPR Article 5 — Data Integrity and Accountability; Staffing Hr Data Governance Policy

attributes.name: vertical_industry
attributes.description: Primary industry vertical the client account operates in, used to align staffing service delivery, recruiter specialization, and go-to-market strategy (e.g., Healthcare, Technology, Manufacturing, Financial Services, Logistics). Aligns with NAICS/SIC classification on the parent client_account record. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: healthcare|technology|manufacturing|financial_services|logistics|retail|energy|government|education|professional_services — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: NAICS (North American Industry Classification System); SIC (Standard Industrial Classification); SIA Industry Vertical Taxonomy

attributes.name: vms_program_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this client account operates through a Vendor Management System (VMS) program, requiring Staffing Hr to submit candidates and timesheets through a third-party VMS platform (e.g., Beeline, SAP Fieldglass, Coupa). Drives operational workflow routing and VMS compliance requirements.
attributes.references: Beeline VMS — Program Configuration; SIA VMS Market Report; ASA Contingent Workforce Program Standards

attributes.name: wallet_share_pct
attributes.description: Estimated percentage of the client's total annual staffing spend currently captured by Staffing Hr, expressed as a decimal percentage (e.g., 35.50 = 35.5%). Calculated as (Staffing Hr annual billings / estimated_annual_staffing_spend) * 100. Used to identify whitespace and cross-sell opportunities. Stored as a raw business estimate, not a computed KPI.
attributes.references: SIA Wallet Share Methodology; Staffing Hr Revenue Intelligence Policy; Salesforce Revenue Cloud — Share of Wallet

products.name: program_supplier
products.description: Association record linking a staffing supplier (vendor) to a specific VMS program, capturing the supplier's participation terms and performance within a client-managed contingent workforce program. Captures supplier tier (preferred, approved, backup), category authorization (which job categories the supplier can fill), markup cap for this supplier within the program, submission limit per requisition, performance score, program enrollment date, certification/compliance status within the program, and supplier status (active, suspended, removed). Sourced from Beeline VMS. Note: supplier/vendor identity and master data are owned by the vendor domain; this product owns only the program-specific participation terms, tier assignments, and performance metrics within the client's program context.
products.reference: Beeline Supplier Program Enrollment / VMS Supplier Tier

attributes.name: program_supplier_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the program supplier association record. Primary key for this entity in the Databricks Silver Layer. Entity role: JUNCTION (extended) — links a staffing supplier/vendor to a specific VMS program and carries its own participation terms, tier assignments, and performance metrics.
attributes.references: Beeline VMS — Supplier Program Enrollment

attributes.name: client_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the client account that owns and manages this VMS contingent workforce program. Establishes the demand-side context for the supplier participation record.
attributes.references: Bullhorn ATS/CRM — Client Account; Beeline VMS — Program Owner

attributes.name: managed_program_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to client.managed_program. Business justification: Suppliers can participate in managed programs (RPO/MSP) in addition to VMS programs. This allows tracking supplier participation across both VMS and managed program types. One supplier association to
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Reference to the staffing supplier/vendor master record in the vendor domain. Vendor identity and master data are owned by the vendor domain; this product owns only the program-specific participation terms.
attributes.references: Beeline VMS — Supplier Master

attributes.name: vms_program_id
attributes.description: Reference to the VMS contingent workforce program this supplier is enrolled in. Links to the client-managed program record within the Beeline VMS platform.
attributes.references: Beeline VMS — Program Management

attributes.name: active_assignment_count
attributes.description: Current number of active worker assignments placed by this supplier within the program at the time of the last data refresh. Provides a real-time headcount view of the supplier's workforce contribution to the program. Sourced from Beeline VMS.
attributes.references: Beeline VMS — Assignment Management; SIA Contingent Workforce Metrics

attributes.name: authorized_job_categories
attributes.description: Comma-delimited list of job category codes or names that this supplier is authorized to fill within the program (e.g., IT, Finance, Engineering, Light Industrial). Restricts the supplier's submission eligibility to approved labor categories only.
attributes.references: Beeline VMS — Category Authorization; ASA Staffing Classification Standards

attributes.name: avg_time_to_fill_days
attributes.description: Average number of calendar days from requisition release to candidate placement for this supplier within the program. A core SLA and KPI metric used to evaluate supplier responsiveness and efficiency. Sourced from Beeline VMS supplier scorecard.
attributes.references: Beeline VMS — Supplier Scorecard; SIA Time to Fill (TTF) Benchmark

attributes.name: beeline_supplier_program_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Beeline Vendor Management System (VMS) Supplier Program ID
attributes.description: The externally-known unique identifier assigned by Beeline VMS to this supplier-program enrollment record. Used for cross-system reconciliation and integration with the source VMS platform.
attributes.references: Beeline VMS — Supplier Program Enrollment

attributes.name: compliance_status
attributes.description: Certification and compliance status of the supplier within the program. Reflects whether the supplier has met all program-required compliance obligations including insurance certificates, diversity certifications, background check protocols, I-9 compliance, and contractual requirements.
attributes.references: Beeline VMS — Compliance Management; DOL Compliance Requirements; EEOC; OFCCP

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this program supplier association record was first created in the system. Represents the audit creation time in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Used for data lineage and audit trail purposes.
attributes.references: SOC 2 Type II — Audit Trail Requirements; GDPR Article 5 (Accountability)

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code applicable to all monetary rate fields for this supplier-program record (e.g., USD, CAD, GBP). Supports multi-currency VMS programs for multinational clients.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; Beeline VMS — Multi-Currency Rate Management

attributes.name: diversity_certification_type
attributes.description: The specific type of diversity certification held by this supplier, if applicable. Used for OFCCP compliance reporting and corporate diversity spend analytics. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: MBE|WBE|SDVOSB|HUBZone|LGBTBE|DVBE|none — promote to reference product if additional types are needed]
attributes.references: OFCCP Diversity Supplier Requirements; SBA Small Business Certification Programs

attributes.name: diversity_certified
attributes.description: Indicates whether this supplier holds a recognized diversity certification (e.g., MBE, WBE, SDVOSB, HUBZone). Many enterprise VMS programs track diversity supplier participation for OFCCP compliance and corporate diversity spend reporting.
attributes.references: OFCCP Diversity Supplier Requirements; Beeline VMS — Supplier Diversity Tracking

attributes.name: enrollment_date
attributes.description: The date on which the supplier was formally enrolled and activated within the VMS program. Marks the effective start of the supplier's participation terms and eligibility to receive requisitions.
attributes.references: Beeline VMS — Supplier Enrollment; ISO 30405:2016 Recruitment Guidelines

attributes.name: enrollment_end_date
attributes.description: The date on which the supplier's participation in the VMS program is scheduled to end or was terminated. Null for open-ended enrollments. Used for contract lifecycle management and program renewal tracking.
attributes.references: Beeline VMS — Supplier Enrollment; DocuSign CLM — Contract Lifecycle

attributes.name: fall_off_rate_percent
attributes.description: Percentage of placements made by this supplier within the program that ended prematurely (before the scheduled assignment end date). High fall-off rates indicate poor candidate quality or fit. Used in tier review and supplier performance management.
attributes.references: Beeline VMS — Supplier Scorecard; ASA Fall-Off Rate Standards

attributes.name: fill_rate_percent
attributes.description: Percentage of requisitions assigned to this supplier that were successfully filled within the program period. Calculated as filled requisitions divided by total requisitions routed to the supplier. Key KPI for supplier performance evaluation and tier assignment.
attributes.references: Beeline VMS — Supplier Scorecard; SIA Staffing Industry KPI Framework

attributes.name: insurance_expiration_date
attributes.description: The expiration date of the supplier's most recently verified insurance certificate on file for this program. Used to trigger renewal alerts and compliance reviews before coverage lapses.
attributes.references: Beeline VMS — Compliance Management; DOL Workers Compensation Requirements

attributes.name: insurance_verified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the supplier's required insurance certificates (general liability, workers compensation, professional liability) have been verified and are current within the program. Required for program participation and compliance.
attributes.references: Beeline VMS — Compliance Management; DOL Workers Compensation Requirements; OSHA

attributes.name: last_performance_review_date
attributes.description: The date of the most recent formal performance review conducted for this supplier within the program. Used to track review cadence and ensure timely tier reassessment based on performance metrics.
attributes.references: Beeline VMS — Supplier Scorecard; SIA Supplier Performance Management

attributes.name: markup_cap_percent
attributes.description: The maximum markup percentage this supplier is permitted to apply above the pay rate when billing within this program. Enforced by the VMS platform at submission time. Expressed as a percentage (e.g., 35.00 = 35%). Represents the Spread/Markup ceiling negotiated for this supplier within the program.
attributes.references: Beeline VMS — Rate Management; ASA Pricing Standards

attributes.name: max_bill_rate
attributes.description: The maximum bill rate (in the program's currency) that this supplier is authorized to submit for any candidate within this program. Acts as a rate ceiling enforced by the VMS platform at submission time. Distinct from the markup cap percentage.
attributes.references: Beeline VMS — Rate Management; ASA Bill Rate Standards

attributes.name: msa_effective_date
attributes.description: The effective start date of the Master Service Agreement (MSA) governing this supplier's participation in the program. Distinct from the enrollment date; the MSA may predate or postdate the program enrollment.
attributes.references: DocuSign CLM — Contract Lifecycle Management; ASA MSA Standards

attributes.name: msa_expiration_date
attributes.description: The expiration date of the Master Service Agreement (MSA) governing this supplier's participation in the program. Null for evergreen agreements. Used for contract renewal management and compliance tracking.
attributes.references: DocuSign CLM — Contract Lifecycle Management; ASA MSA Standards

attributes.name: msa_on_file
attributes.business_glossary_term: Master Service Agreement (MSA) On File Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a fully executed Master Service Agreement (MSA) between the client and this supplier is on file and active for this program. MSA is a prerequisite for program participation in most enterprise VMS programs.
attributes.references: DocuSign CLM — MSA Management; Beeline VMS — Supplier Compliance

attributes.name: nda_on_file
attributes.description: Indicates whether a Non-Disclosure Agreement (NDA) is on file between the client and this supplier for this program. Required by many enterprise clients to protect confidential workforce and business information shared during the recruitment process.
attributes.references: DocuSign CLM — NDA Management; GDPR Article 28; CCPA

attributes.name: next_performance_review_date
attributes.description: The scheduled date for the next formal performance review of this supplier within the program. Supports proactive program management and ensures regular supplier evaluation cadence.
attributes.references: Beeline VMS — Supplier Scorecard; SIA Supplier Performance Management

attributes.name: onboarding_complete
attributes.description: Indicates whether the supplier has completed all required onboarding steps for this program, including document submission, compliance verification, system access provisioning, and training acknowledgments. Prerequisite for receiving live requisitions.
attributes.references: Beeline VMS — Supplier Onboarding; ASA Supplier Onboarding Standards

attributes.name: performance_score
attributes.description: Composite performance score for this supplier within the program, calculated by the VMS platform based on fill rate, time-to-fill (TTF), quality of submission (QoS), assignment completion rate, and fall-off rate. Typically expressed on a 0–100 scale. Used for tier review and program renewal decisions.
attributes.references: Beeline VMS — Supplier Scorecard; SIA Supplier Performance Metrics; ASA KPI Standards

attributes.name: preferred_worker_type
attributes.description: The worker classification type(s) this supplier primarily places within the program (W-2 employees, 1099 independent contractors, Corp-to-Corp, or Employer of Record). Relevant for IRS worker classification compliance and co-employment risk management.
attributes.references: IRS Worker Classification Rules; DOL FLSA; Beeline VMS — Worker Type Configuration

attributes.name: program_contact_email
attributes.description: Email address of the primary contact person at the supplier organization for this program. Used for requisition notifications, compliance alerts, and program communications via Beeline VMS.
attributes.references: Beeline VMS — Supplier Contact Management; GDPR Article 4; CCPA

attributes.name: program_contact_name
attributes.description: Full name of the primary contact person at the supplier organization responsible for managing this program relationship. This is the supplier-side account manager or program coordinator for the VMS engagement.
attributes.references: Beeline VMS — Supplier Contact Management

attributes.name: requisition_routing_order
attributes.description: Numeric sequence position determining the order in which this supplier receives requisition notifications within the program tier. Lower numbers receive requisitions first. Used to implement tiered routing logic (e.g., preferred suppliers receive reqs before approved suppliers).
attributes.references: Beeline VMS — Requisition Routing Rules; ASA VMS Program Management

attributes.name: response_time_sla_hours
attributes.business_glossary_term: Response Time Service Level Agreement (SLA) Hours
attributes.description: The maximum number of hours within which this supplier is contractually required to respond to a new requisition notification within the program. Defines the SLA commitment for supplier responsiveness. Tracked against actual response times for SLA compliance reporting.
attributes.references: Beeline VMS — SLA Configuration; ASA SLA Standards

attributes.name: submission_limit_per_req
attributes.description: Maximum number of candidate submittals this supplier is allowed to make per open requisition within the program. Controls Quality of Submission (QoS) and prevents requisition flooding. Enforced by Beeline VMS at the time of submittal.
attributes.references: Beeline VMS — Submission Rules; ASA Quality of Submission (QoS) Standards

attributes.name: supplier_status
attributes.description: Current participation status of the supplier within this specific VMS program. Active suppliers can receive and respond to requisitions; suspended suppliers are temporarily blocked; removed suppliers have been permanently disqualified from the program.
attributes.references: Beeline VMS — Supplier Status Management; ASA Contingent Workforce Best Practices

attributes.name: supplier_tier
attributes.description: Tier classification of the supplier within the VMS program, determining routing priority for requisitions. Preferred suppliers receive first-look on new requisitions; approved suppliers are standard participants; backup suppliers are used when preferred/approved cannot fill; probationary suppliers are under performance review.
attributes.references: Beeline VMS — Supplier Tier Management; ASA Contingent Workforce Best Practices

attributes.name: suspension_date
attributes.description: The date on which the supplier was suspended or removed from the program. Populated when supplier_status transitions to 'suspended' or 'removed'. Used for compliance audit trails and program governance reporting.
attributes.references: Beeline VMS — Supplier Status Management; ASA Program Governance

attributes.name: suspension_reason
attributes.description: Free-text description of the reason for supplier suspension or removal from the program, if applicable. Populated when supplier_status is 'suspended' or 'removed'. Supports audit trail and program governance documentation.
attributes.references: Beeline VMS — Supplier Status Management; ASA Program Governance

attributes.name: total_submittals_ytd
attributes.description: Total number of candidate submittals made by this supplier within the program in the current calendar year. Used to assess supplier engagement level and submission volume relative to program activity.
attributes.references: Beeline VMS — Submittal Tracking; SIA Staffing Metrics

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this program supplier association record was most recently modified. Tracks the last update event for change detection, incremental ETL processing, and audit trail compliance in the Databricks Silver Layer.
attributes.references: SOC 2 Type II — Audit Trail Requirements; GDPR Article 5 (Accountability)

attributes.name: vms_supplier_code
attributes.description: The supplier code or identifier assigned by the client's VMS platform (Beeline) to this supplier within the program. Used as the operational reference key in VMS-generated reports, requisition routing, and timesheet approvals.
attributes.references: Beeline VMS — Supplier Master

products.name: sla_measurement
products.description: Periodic performance measurement record capturing actual results against a defined SLA configuration for a specific reporting window. Captures measurement period (start/end date), SLA config reference, measured value, target value, variance, compliance flag (met/missed), requisition count in scope, fill count, TTF (Time to Fill) actual average, TTS (Time to Start) actual average, QoS (Quality of Submission) actual rate, fill rate actual, and measurement source system. Generated from operational data in the recruitment and placement domains. Enables SLA compliance reporting, client QBR (Quarterly Business Review) preparation, penalty/bonus calculation triggers, and account health scoring.

attributes.name: sla_measurement_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate primary key for each SLA measurement record. Identifies a single periodic performance measurement instance against a defined SLA configuration. Entity role: TRANSACTION_HEADER — a discrete business event capturing actual vs. target SLA performance for a reporting window.
attributes.references: ASA Best Practices; ISO 30405:2016

attributes.name: client_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the client (employer) account for whom this SLA measurement is being evaluated. Serves as the PARTY_REFERENCE linking this measurement to the demand-side client entity in the client domain.
attributes.references: Bullhorn ATS/CRM; Salesforce Revenue Cloud

attributes.name: managed_program_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to client.managed_program. Business justification: SLA measurements can apply to managed programs (RPO/MSP) in addition to VMS programs. This allows tracking SLA performance for managed workforce programs. One measurement for one managed program.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: reviewed_by_staff_profile_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Reviewed By Staff Profile Id (Foreign Key)
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to employee.staff_profile. Business justification: SLA measurements require internal staff review for compliance validation, dispute resolution, and QBR preparation. Reviewed_by is text field; FK enables audit trail for penalty/bonus calculations, per
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: sla_id
attributes.description: Reference to the SLA configuration record that defines the metric type, target thresholds, and measurement rules governing this measurement. Links the measurement to its governing SLA definition.
attributes.references: ASA Best Practices; SIA Workforce Solutions Buyer Survey

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to vendor.supplier. Business justification: SLA measurements frequently track supplier-specific metrics (fill rate, time-to-fill, quality of submission) within VMS/MSP programs. Linking measurements to suppliers enables performance reporting, s
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: vms_program_id
attributes.description: The program identifier from the Beeline VMS or equivalent VMS platform for clients operating under a VMS/MSP (Managed Service Provider) program. Enables correlation of SLA measurements with VMS-tracked requisitions and submittals.
attributes.references: Beeline VMS; ASA Best Practices; SIA Workforce Solutions Buyer Survey

attributes.name: account_health_score
attributes.description: A composite numeric score (0–100) representing the overall health of the client account based on this measurement period's SLA performance. Derived from weighted SLA compliance results and used for account risk segmentation and QBR preparation.
attributes.references: ASA Best Practices; Power BI Analytics Platform; Salesforce Revenue Cloud

attributes.name: bonus_amount
attributes.description: The contractual bonus dollar amount earned by over-performance in this measurement period, as calculated per the bonus formula in the SLA configuration. Populated only when bonus_triggered is True. Used for billing adjustments and incentive tracking.
attributes.references: ASA Best Practices; DocuSign CLM; Salesforce Revenue Cloud; Oracle NetSuite ERP

attributes.name: bonus_triggered
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the SLA over-performance in this measurement period has triggered a contractual bonus or incentive clause. True = bonus applies; False = no bonus. Drives positive billing adjustments in Salesforce Revenue Cloud.
attributes.references: ASA Best Practices; DocuSign CLM; Salesforce Revenue Cloud

attributes.name: compliance_direction
attributes.description: Indicates whether a higher or lower measured value represents better performance for this metric type. 'higher_is_better' applies to fill_rate, qos, retention_rate; 'lower_is_better' applies to TTF and TTS (fewer days is better). Required to correctly interpret variance sign for compliance determination.
attributes.references: ASA Best Practices; ISO 30405:2016

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this SLA measurement record was first created in the system. Serves as the RECORD_AUDIT_CREATED field for data lineage, audit trail, and Silver layer ingestion tracking.
attributes.references: SOC 2 Type II; GDPR Article 5; CCPA

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code applicable to penalty_amount and bonus_amount fields (e.g., USD, CAD, GBP). Supports multi-currency client engagements in international staffing operations.
attributes.references: ISO 4217; Oracle NetSuite ERP; Salesforce Revenue Cloud

attributes.name: dispute_reason
attributes.description: Free-text description of the client's stated reason for disputing this SLA measurement result. Populated only when measurement_status is 'disputed'. Supports dispute resolution workflows and MSA compliance documentation.
attributes.references: ASA Best Practices; DocuSign CLM; Salesforce Revenue Cloud

attributes.name: dispute_resolved_date
attributes.description: The date on which a disputed SLA measurement was formally resolved between the staffing firm and the client. Populated only when a dispute has been closed. Used to track dispute resolution cycle times and SLA governance compliance.
attributes.references: ASA Best Practices; DocuSign CLM

attributes.name: excluded_req_count
attributes.description: Number of requisitions excluded from the SLA measurement scope due to agreed exclusion criteria (e.g., client holds, force majeure, late job order submissions). Provides transparency into the effective denominator used in SLA calculations.
attributes.references: ASA Best Practices; DocuSign CLM; Bullhorn ATS/CRM

attributes.name: exclusion_reason
attributes.description: Describes any agreed-upon exclusions applied to the measurement scope (e.g., client-caused delays, force majeure, requisitions excluded per MSA terms). Populated when certain requisitions or placements were removed from the SLA calculation denominator.
attributes.references: ASA Best Practices; DocuSign CLM; ISO 30405:2016

attributes.name: fall_off_count
attributes.description: Number of placements that ended prematurely (fall-offs) during the measurement period before the expected assignment end date. High fall-off counts negatively impact retention rate SLA metrics and may trigger penalty clauses.
attributes.references: ASA Best Practices; Bullhorn ATS/CRM

attributes.name: fill_count
attributes.description: Number of requisitions that were successfully filled (placement confirmed) within the measurement period. Used as the numerator in fill rate calculations and as a direct performance indicator for talent acquisition effectiveness.
attributes.references: Bullhorn ATS/CRM; ASA Best Practices; ISO 30405:2016

attributes.name: fill_rate_actual
attributes.description: The actual fill rate for the measurement period expressed as a percentage (0–100), calculated as fill_count divided by req_count multiplied by 100. Measures the staffing firm's ability to fulfill client demand within the period.
attributes.references: ASA Best Practices; SIA KPI Framework; ISO 30405:2016

attributes.name: finalized_date
attributes.description: The date on which this SLA measurement record was locked and finalized for reporting. Represents the BUSINESS_EVENT_TIMESTAMP for the finalization lifecycle event. Once finalized, the record is immutable for audit and billing purposes.
attributes.references: SOC 2 Type II; ASA Best Practices; Salesforce Revenue Cloud

attributes.name: is_compliant
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the measured performance met or exceeded the SLA target for this measurement period. True = SLA met (compliant); False = SLA missed (breach). Primary compliance indicator used in account health scoring and QBR reporting.
attributes.references: ASA Best Practices; SIA Workforce Solutions Buyer Survey; ISO 30405:2016

attributes.name: measured_value
attributes.description: The actual observed performance value for the SLA metric during the measurement period. Interpretation depends on sla_metric_type: for TTF/TTS this is average calendar days; for fill_rate/qos/retention_rate this is a percentage (0–100); for submittal_ratio this is a ratio. This is the QUANTITATIVE_RESULT for this transaction.
attributes.references: ASA Best Practices; Power BI Analytics Platform; ISO 30405:2016

attributes.name: measurement_notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for account managers or operations staff to document contextual notes about this measurement record, such as explanations for SLA misses, data quality caveats, client-agreed exclusions, or force majeure circumstances affecting performance.
attributes.references: ASA Best Practices; Bullhorn ATS/CRM

attributes.name: measurement_number
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier for this measurement record, used in client-facing QBR (Quarterly Business Review) reports, penalty/bonus calculations, and audit trails. Format: SLA-MEAS-{YYYY}-{NNNNNN}.
attributes.references: Salesforce Revenue Cloud; Power BI Analytics Platform

attributes.name: measurement_source_system
attributes.description: The operational system of record from which the measurement data was sourced. Identifies data lineage for audit and reconciliation purposes. 'manual' indicates data was entered directly by an account manager outside of automated system feeds.
attributes.references: SOC 2 Type II; ASA Best Practices; Power BI Analytics Platform

attributes.name: measurement_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the SLA measurement record. 'draft' indicates data is being collected; 'pending_review' awaits account manager sign-off; 'finalized' is locked for reporting; 'disputed' is under client challenge; 'voided' has been invalidated.
attributes.references: ASA Best Practices; Salesforce Revenue Cloud

attributes.name: penalty_amount
attributes.description: The contractual penalty dollar amount triggered by this SLA breach, as calculated per the penalty formula in the SLA configuration. Populated only when penalty_triggered is True. Used for billing credit adjustments and financial reporting.
attributes.references: ASA Best Practices; DocuSign CLM; Salesforce Revenue Cloud; Oracle NetSuite ERP

attributes.name: penalty_triggered
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the SLA breach in this measurement period has triggered a contractual penalty clause as defined in the MSA or SLA addendum. True = penalty applies; False = no penalty. Drives billing adjustments in Salesforce Revenue Cloud.
attributes.references: ASA Best Practices; DocuSign CLM; Salesforce Revenue Cloud

attributes.name: period_end_date
attributes.description: The last calendar date of the reporting window for which SLA performance is being measured. Defines the close of the measurement interval and determines which requisitions, placements, and timesheets fall within scope.
attributes.references: ISO 30405:2016; ASA Best Practices

attributes.name: period_start_date
attributes.description: The first calendar date of the reporting window for which SLA performance is being measured. Combined with period_end_date, defines the exact scope of the measurement interval (weekly, monthly, quarterly, etc.).
attributes.references: ISO 30405:2016; ASA Best Practices

attributes.name: period_type
attributes.description: Categorizes the cadence of the measurement window. Determines how frequently SLA compliance is evaluated and reported to the client. Drives QBR preparation and penalty/bonus calculation cycles.
attributes.references: ASA Best Practices; SIA Workforce Solutions Buyer Survey

attributes.name: qbr_period_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this measurement record falls within a QBR reporting period and should be included in the formal Quarterly Business Review package presented to the client. True = include in QBR; False = standard operational measurement only.
attributes.references: ASA Best Practices; Salesforce Revenue Cloud; Power BI Analytics Platform

attributes.name: qos_actual_rate
attributes.description: The actual QoS rate for the measurement period, expressed as a percentage (0–100). Typically calculated as the ratio of client-accepted submittals to total submittals, or interview-to-submittal ratio. Measures the quality and relevance of candidate submittals.
attributes.references: ASA Best Practices; SIA KPI Framework; Bullhorn ATS/CRM

attributes.name: req_count
attributes.description: Total number of open requisitions (job orders) that fell within the measurement period scope and were included in the SLA calculation. Provides the denominator context for fill rate and submittal ratio calculations.
attributes.references: Bullhorn ATS/CRM; ASA Best Practices

attributes.name: retention_rate_actual
attributes.description: The actual assignment retention rate for the measurement period expressed as a percentage (0–100). Measures the proportion of placed workers who remained on assignment through the expected end date, excluding early terminations and fall-offs.
attributes.references: ASA Best Practices; SIA KPI Framework; Bullhorn ATS/CRM

attributes.name: sla_metric_type
attributes.description: The specific KPI (Key Performance Indicator) being measured in this record. TTF = Time to Fill; TTS = Time to Start; fill_rate = percentage of requisitions filled; QoS = Quality of Submission rate; submittal_ratio = submittals per req; retention_rate = assignment retention. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: ttf|tts|fill_rate|qos|submittal_ratio|retention_rate|on_time_start|absence_rate — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ASA Best Practices; SIA KPI Framework; ISO 30405:2016

attributes.name: submittal_count
attributes.description: Total number of candidate submittals made to the client across all in-scope requisitions during the measurement period. Used in QoS (Quality of Submission) and submittal ratio calculations.
attributes.references: Bullhorn ATS/CRM; ASA Best Practices

attributes.name: target_value
attributes.description: The contractually agreed performance threshold for the SLA metric as defined in the SLA configuration. Represents what was promised to the client in the MSA (Master Service Agreement) or SLA addendum. Used as the benchmark for compliance determination.
attributes.references: ASA Best Practices; DocuSign CLM; ISO 30405:2016

attributes.name: ttf_actual_avg_days
attributes.business_glossary_term: Time to Fill (TTF) Actual Average Days
attributes.description: The actual average number of calendar days from requisition open date to confirmed placement (fill) across all in-scope requisitions during the measurement period. Core TTF KPI metric used in SLA compliance evaluation and client QBR reporting.
attributes.references: ASA Best Practices; SIA KPI Framework; ISO 30405:2016

attributes.name: tts_actual_avg_days
attributes.business_glossary_term: Time to Start (TTS) Actual Average Days
attributes.description: The actual average number of calendar days from requisition open date to the worker's first day on assignment across all in-scope placements during the measurement period. TTS measures end-to-end speed including onboarding and credentialing.
attributes.references: ASA Best Practices; SIA KPI Framework; ISO 30405:2016

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this SLA measurement record was last modified. Serves as the RECORD_AUDIT_UPDATED field for change tracking, data freshness monitoring, and Silver layer delta processing.
attributes.references: SOC 2 Type II; GDPR Article 5; CCPA

attributes.name: variance_pct
attributes.description: The variance expressed as a percentage of the target value ((measured_value - target_value) / target_value * 100). Enables normalized comparison of SLA performance across different metric types and clients regardless of unit scale.
attributes.references: ASA Best Practices; Power BI Analytics Platform

attributes.name: variance_value
attributes.description: The arithmetic difference between measured_value and target_value (measured_value minus target_value). Positive variance indicates over-performance; negative variance indicates under-performance. Used to quantify the degree of SLA compliance or breach for penalty/bonus triggers.
attributes.references: ASA Best Practices; Salesforce Revenue Cloud

products.name: credit_profile
products.description: Client credit and financial risk assessment record used to evaluate and monitor a client's creditworthiness and ability to pay invoices on agreed terms. Captures credit score (D&B PAYDEX, internal composite score), credit limit, approved payment terms (net days), credit hold flag, credit hold reason, last credit review date, next scheduled review date, DSO (Days Sales Outstanding) actual, aging bucket summary (current, 30, 60, 90+ days), bank reference, trade references, credit decision (approved, conditional, declined), decision date, approving authority, and risk tier (low, medium, high, watch). Sourced from D&B Direct, internal AR aging reports, and credit committee decisions. Critical for staffing firms managing significant accounts receivable exposure — supports go/no-go decisions on new business, headcount expansion approvals, and credit hold enforcement during invoice generation.

attributes.name: credit_profile_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the credit profile record. Primary key.
attributes.references: Internal Data Management Standard

attributes.name: client_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the client account this credit profile belongs to. Links to the client_account master record.
attributes.references: Internal Data Management Standard

attributes.name: credit_analyst_staff_profile_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Credit Analyst Staff Profile Id (Foreign Key)
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to employee.staff_profile. Business justification: Credit analysis is internal finance/risk function requiring staff assignment for audit trail, SOX compliance, and credit decision accountability. Credit_analyst_name is denormalized text; FK enables w
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: aging_30_days_amount
attributes.description: Total outstanding receivables aged 31-60 days past invoice date. Indicates early payment delays.
attributes.references: Financial Accounting Standards

attributes.name: aging_60_days_amount
attributes.description: Total outstanding receivables aged 61-90 days past invoice date. Signals moderate collection risk.
attributes.references: Financial Accounting Standards

attributes.name: aging_90_plus_days_amount
attributes.description: Total outstanding receivables aged 91+ days past invoice date. High collection risk; may require write-off or legal action.
attributes.references: Financial Accounting Standards

attributes.name: aging_current_amount
attributes.description: Total outstanding receivables in the current bucket (0-30 days past invoice date). Part of AR aging summary.
attributes.references: Financial Accounting Standards

attributes.name: approving_authority
attributes.description: Name or role of the individual or committee who approved the credit decision (e.g., Credit Manager, CFO, Credit Committee).
attributes.references: Internal Credit Policy

attributes.name: available_credit
attributes.description: Remaining credit capacity calculated as credit_limit minus total_outstanding_balance. Negative values indicate over-limit condition.
attributes.references: Internal Credit Policy

attributes.name: bank_reference
attributes.description: Name and contact information of the clients primary banking institution, used for credit verification and reference checks.
attributes.references: Fair Credit Reporting Act (FCRA)

attributes.name: bankruptcy_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent bankruptcy filing, if applicable. Null if no bankruptcy on record.
attributes.references: U.S. Bankruptcy Code

attributes.name: bankruptcy_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the client has an active or recent bankruptcy filing on record. True triggers automatic credit hold and legal review.
attributes.references: U.S. Bankruptcy Code

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this credit profile record was first created in the system. Audit trail for record creation.
attributes.references: Internal Data Management Standard

attributes.name: credit_decision
attributes.description: Final credit decision outcome from the most recent review. Approved allows full credit; conditional requires additional controls; declined blocks business.
attributes.references: Internal Credit Policy

attributes.name: credit_hold_date
attributes.description: Date when the credit hold was placed. Null if client is not on hold.
attributes.references: Internal Credit Management Standard

attributes.name: credit_hold_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the client is currently on credit hold. True blocks new placements, timesheet approvals, and invoice generation until resolved.
attributes.references: Internal Credit Policy

attributes.name: credit_hold_reason
attributes.description: Reason code explaining why the client is on credit hold. None if credit_hold_flag is false. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: exceeded_limit|past_due_aging|bankruptcy|litigation|fraud_risk|manual_review|none — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Internal Credit Policy

attributes.name: credit_limit
attributes.description: Maximum outstanding accounts receivable balance approved for this client. Exceeding this limit triggers credit hold and approval escalation.
attributes.references: Internal Credit Policy

attributes.name: credit_score_internal
attributes.description: Internally calculated composite credit score combining D&B data, payment history, DSO trends, and account behavior. Scale 0-1000.
attributes.references: Internal Credit Scoring Model

attributes.name: credit_score_paydex
attributes.description: D&B PAYDEX score ranging from 1-100, measuring payment performance. Scores 80+ indicate prompt payment; scores below 50 indicate slow payment or default risk.
attributes.references: Dun & Bradstreet PAYDEX Methodology

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for credit limit and financial amounts (e.g., USD, CAD, GBP).
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes

attributes.name: decision_date
attributes.description: Date when the credit decision was finalized and approved by the credit authority.
attributes.references: Internal Credit Policy

attributes.name: dnb_credit_rating
attributes.description: D&B composite credit rating code (e.g., 5A1, 4A2) indicating financial strength and risk classification. Higher ratings indicate stronger credit.
attributes.references: Dun & Bradstreet Rating Methodology

attributes.name: dnb_report_date
attributes.description: Date when the most recent D&B credit report was pulled for this client. Used to determine report freshness and review cadence.
attributes.references: Dun & Bradstreet Reporting Standards

attributes.name: dso_actual_days
attributes.description: Actual Days Sales Outstanding for this client, calculated as average number of days to collect payment. Lower is better; values exceeding payment terms indicate collection risk.
attributes.references: Financial Accounting Standards

attributes.name: duns_number
attributes.description: Nine-digit Data Universal Numbering System identifier assigned by Dun & Bradstreet. Used to retrieve D&B credit reports and PAYDEX scores.
attributes.references: Dun & Bradstreet DUNS Standard

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date when this credit profile became effective and active for credit decisions. Typically the date of initial credit approval.
attributes.references: Internal Credit Management Standard

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date when this credit profile expires and requires renewal or re-review. Null for profiles without expiration.
attributes.references: Internal Credit Policy

attributes.name: insurance_expiration_date
attributes.description: Expiration date of the credit insurance policy. Requires renewal before this date to maintain coverage.
attributes.references: Internal Credit Policy

attributes.name: insurance_policy_number
attributes.description: Policy number for credit insurance or surety bond covering this client, if applicable. Null if insurance not required or not on file.
attributes.references: Internal Credit Policy

attributes.name: insurance_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether credit insurance or bonding is required for this client due to elevated risk. True requires proof of coverage before extending credit.
attributes.references: Internal Credit Policy

attributes.name: last_credit_review_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent credit review conducted by the credit committee or credit analyst.
attributes.references: Internal Credit Policy

attributes.name: litigation_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the client is currently involved in litigation with the company or has unresolved legal disputes affecting creditworthiness.
attributes.references: Internal Legal and Credit Policy

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this credit profile record was last modified. Audit trail for tracking changes to credit terms, limits, or status.
attributes.references: Internal Data Management Standard

attributes.name: next_review_date
attributes.description: Date when the next periodic credit review is scheduled. Typically annual for low-risk clients, quarterly for high-risk.
attributes.references: Internal Credit Policy

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes capturing credit review findings, special conditions, payment arrangements, or other relevant credit management information.
attributes.references: Internal Credit Management Standard

attributes.name: payment_terms_days

products.name: rate_card_line
products.description: This association product represents the pricing line items within a client rate card, linking negotiated rates to specific job categories. Each record captures the bill rates, pay guidance, markup, and effective dates that apply when a specific job category is priced under a specific client rate card. This is the operational pricing matrix used daily in job order creation, candidate submittal pricing, and invoice generation.. Existence Justification: In staffing operations, a single rate card negotiated with a client contains pricing for multiple job categories (e.g., Software Engineer, Project Manager, Business Analyst), and each job category appears across multiple client rate cards with different negotiated rates. The rate card is a pricing matrix, not a single-category document. Recruiters and account managers actively manage these rate card lines when creating job orders, pricing candidate submittals, and generating invoices.

attributes.name: markup_percentage

products.name: location_budget_allocation
products.description: This association product represents the allocation of financial budgets to specific client work site locations in the staffing enterprise. It captures the distribution of operating, capital, and headcount budgets across physical and virtual work sites, enabling location-level financial planning, cost tracking, and variance analysis. Each record links one location to one budget with allocation percentage, effective period, and status attributes that exist only in the context of this relationship.. Existence Justification: In staffing operations, client locations require budget allocations for workforce planning and cost control. A single location can have multiple budgets allocated to it (operating budget for temp labor, capital budget for equipment, project-specific budgets for client programs), and a single enterprise or regional budget can be distributed across multiple locations with specific allocation percentages. Finance teams actively manage these allocations with effective dates, expiration dates, allocation percentages, and approval workflows.

attributes.name: allocation_percentage

Used when a single budget is distributed across multiple locations (e.g., regional budget split across branch offices). Sum of allocation_percentage across all locations for a given budget should equal 100.00.

products.name: program_credential_requirement
products.description: This association product represents the credential requirements mandated by each VMS program. It captures which credentials are required for worker placement eligibility within a specific VMS program, along with program-specific verification standards and compliance rules. Each record links one VMS program to one credential with attributes that define the requirement context, mandatory status, verification level, and effective dates for that program-credential combination.. Existence Justification: VMS programs mandate multiple credentials for worker placement eligibility (background checks, drug screens, licenses, certifications, immunizations), and each credential type applies across multiple VMS programs with program-specific verification standards and mandatory status. The business actively manages these credential requirements as part of VMS program setup and compliance enforcement, tracking which credentials are required, at what verification level, and with what effective dates for each program.

products.name: program_compliance_requirement
products.description: This association product represents the binding relationship between a managed workforce program and a compliance requirement. It captures program-specific enforcement rules, waiver status, effective dates, and client-specific thresholds that govern how each compliance requirement is applied within the context of a specific managed program. Each record links one managed_program to one compliance_requirement with attributes that exist only in the context of this relationship.. Existence Justification: In staffing operations, a single managed workforce program (MSP/RPO) must comply with multiple federal and client-specific compliance requirements (I-9, E-Verify, background checks, drug screening, client contractual mandates). Conversely, a single compliance requirement (e.g., I-9 verification) applies across multiple managed programs operated for different clients. The business actively manages this relationship by configuring program-specific enforcement rules, waivers, thresholds, and governance responsibilities for each program-requirement combination.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date on which this SLA target becomes binding and measurement begins. Aligns with the MSA or program contract start date. Used to determine which SLA version applies to a given job order or measurement period.

attributes.name: exclusion_criteria

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: The date on which this SLA target ceases to be binding. Null for open-ended SLA targets that remain active until explicitly superseded or suspended. Used in SLA version management and client contract renewal workflows.

attributes.name: job_level

attributes.name: measurement_basis
attributes.description: Defines the unit of analysis for SLA measurement. per_requisition: measured individually for each job order/req. per_period: aggregate performance across all reqs in the measurement period. per_program: aggregate across the entire MSP/RPO program. per_category: aggregate within a job order category.
attributes.references: ASA Best Practices; SIA KPI Framework; Beeline VMS Reporting

attributes.name: measurement_frequency
attributes.description: How often performance against this SLA target is formally measured and reported. Weekly: high-cadence operational programs. Monthly: standard client business reviews. Quarterly: strategic RPO program reviews. Annually: contract renewal assessments.
attributes.references: ASA Best Practices; SIA KPI Reporting Standards

attributes.name: measurement_unit
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the target_value. Defines how the SLA target is quantified: business_days (for TTF/TTS), count (for submittal_count), rating (for QoS on a numeric scale), percentage (for fill_rate), ratio (for interview_to_offer_ratio).
attributes.references: ASA Best Practices; SIA KPI Framework

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional context, negotiation history, special conditions, or operational guidance related to this SLA target. Used by account managers and program directors for internal documentation.

attributes.name: penalty_clause_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a contractual financial penalty applies upon breach of this SLA target. True: breach triggers a financial penalty per the MSA. False: breach results in remediation obligations only, without financial penalty. Sensitive commercial information.
attributes.references: DocuSign CLM MSA Management; ASA Contract Standards

attributes.name: penalty_description
attributes.description: Textual description of the contractual penalty terms applicable upon SLA breach, such as credit amounts, service fee reductions, or remediation obligations. Populated only when penalty_clause_flag is True. Confidential commercial contract data.
attributes.references: DocuSign CLM MSA Management; ASA Contract Standards

attributes.name: placement_type
attributes.description: Specifies the type of placement engagement this SLA target governs. Values: temporary, contract, temp_to_perm (Contract-to-Hire), direct_hire (Permanent Placement), sow (Statement of Work). Different placement types typically carry different SLA expectations.

attributes.name: reporting_label

attributes.name: review_due_date
