attributes.name: scope_type
attributes.description: Indicates whether this SLA target is specific to a named client, applies as a default across an MSP/RPO program, is a default for a job order category, or is a global organizational default. Drives SLA resolution hierarchy during measurement.
attributes.references: Beeline VMS SLA Configuration; ASA MSP Standards

attributes.name: scorecard_category
attributes.description: The scorecard category or section under which this SLA target is reported in MSP client business reviews and RPO program scorecards. Examples: 'Speed', 'Quality', 'Compliance', 'Diversity'. Used for Power BI scorecard dashboard grouping.
attributes.references: ASA MSP Standards; SIA Scorecard Framework; Power BI Analytics

attributes.name: sla_name
attributes.description: Descriptive name for the SLA target, such as 'Time-to-Fill Target – IT Contracts' or 'Submittal Count SLA – Healthcare RPO Program'. Used for display in client business reviews and Power BI dashboards.
attributes.references: ASA Best Practices; SIA SLA Framework

attributes.name: sla_number
attributes.description: Externally-known, human-readable reference number for the SLA target record, used in client communications, MSP scorecards, and RPO program documentation. Sourced from Bullhorn ATS or Beeline VMS.
attributes.references: ASA Best Practices; Beeline VMS SLA Configuration

attributes.name: sla_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the SLA target record. Draft: under negotiation or configuration. Active: currently in force and being measured. Suspended: temporarily paused by mutual agreement. Expired: past the expiration_date. Superseded: replaced by a newer SLA target version.
attributes.references: ASA Best Practices; DocuSign CLM Contract Lifecycle

attributes.name: sla_type
attributes.description: Classifies the category of SLA target being defined. Values: time_to_fill (TTF target in business days), time_to_start (TTS target in calendar days), submittal_count (minimum number of qualified submittals per requisition), qos_min_rating (minimum Quality of Submission rating), interview_to_offer_ratio (minimum ratio of interviews resulting in offers), fill_rate (minimum percentage of requisitions filled within period).
attributes.references: ASA Best Practices; SIA KPI Framework; ISO 30405:2016

attributes.name: target_value
attributes.description: The numeric threshold that defines the SLA commitment. Interpretation depends on sla_type and measurement_unit: e.g., 5.0 (business days for TTF), 3.0 (submittals for submittal_count), 4.5 (rating for qos_min_rating), 0.85 (85% fill rate). This is the contractually agreed performance target.

attributes.name: tolerance_percentage
attributes.description: Allowable percentage variance from the target_value before a warning or breach is triggered. Expressed as a percentage (e.g., 10.00 = 10%). Provides a configurable buffer for minor performance fluctuations without triggering formal breach procedures.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this SLA target record was most recently modified. Used for change detection in incremental data loads, audit trails, and SLA version management workflows.
attributes.references: SOC 2 Type II; GDPR Article 5 (Data Integrity); CCPA

attributes.name: version_number

attributes.name: warning_threshold_value

attributes.description: The actual measured value of the SLA metric at the time of breach (e.g., actual days taken to fill, actual number of submittals delivered, actual QoS score achieved). Compared against sla_threshold_value to quantify the breach magnitude.

attributes.name: breach_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the SLA breach formally occurred — i.e., the date the agreed SLA threshold was crossed. Used for period-based breach reporting and trend analysis.

[ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: ttf_exceeded|submittal_count_missed|qos_below_threshold|tts_exceeded|interview_sla_missed|offer_sla_missed — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: American Staffing Association (ASA); SIA KPI Framework; ISO 30405:2016

attributes.name: client_dispute_reason
attributes.description: Free-text description of the reason provided by the client when disputing the SLA breach classification or penalty. Populated only when breach_status is 'disputed'. Used for dispute resolution tracking.

attributes.name: client_notification_date

attributes.name: client_notified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the client has been formally notified of this SLA breach. True = client notification sent; False = client not yet notified. Supports compliance with contractual notification obligations in the MSA.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this SLA breach record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: days_to_resolve

attributes.name: delivery_model
attributes.description: The recruitment delivery model under which the breached SLA was operating. 'direct' = standard direct staffing; 'rpo' = Recruitment Process Outsourcing (RPO); 'msp' = Managed Service Provider (MSP); 'vms' = Vendor Management System (VMS)-driven program. Affects SLA terms and penalty structures.
attributes.references: Beeline VMS; American Staffing Association (ASA); SIA

attributes.name: escalation_level
attributes.description: The organizational escalation level to which this breach has been raised. 'none' = no escalation; 'recruiter' = handled at recruiter level; 'manager' = escalated to recruiting manager; 'director' = escalated to director; 'executive' = escalated to executive leadership. Tracks escalation path for critical breaches.
attributes.references: American Staffing Association (ASA); SIA Best Practices

attributes.name: internal_review_notes

attributes.name: is_repeat_breach
attributes.description: Indicates whether this breach is a repeat occurrence of the same breach type for the same client within the current contract period. True = repeat breach; False = first occurrence. Used for pattern analysis and escalation triggers.
attributes.references: American Staffing Association (ASA); ISO 30405:2016

attributes.name: job_title
attributes.description: The job title of the position associated with the breached job order. Captured as a denormalized field to support breach analysis by role type without requiring a join to the job order table.

attributes.name: penalty_amount
attributes.description: The financial penalty or credit amount assessed against the staffing firm for this SLA breach, as defined in the client's MSA. Expressed in USD. Populated only when penalty_applicable is True. Used for financial impact reporting and accounts receivable adjustments.

attributes.name: penalty_applicable
attributes.description: Indicates whether a contractual financial penalty or credit is applicable to this SLA breach per the terms of the client's Master Service Agreement (MSA). True = penalty applies; False = no penalty (e.g., first offense, waived, or non-penalized SLA tier).
attributes.references: DocuSign CLM; American Staffing Association (ASA); MSA Penalty Frameworks

attributes.name: placement_type

attributes.references: American Staffing Association (ASA); Bullhorn ATS/CRM

attributes.name: remediation_action

attributes.name: remediation_notes

attributes.name: repeat_breach_count

attributes.name: reporting_period_end

attributes.name: reporting_period_start
attributes.description: The start date of the SLA measurement reporting period in which this breach occurred. Used to align breach records with client SLA reporting cycles (weekly, monthly, quarterly).

attributes.name: resolution_date

attributes.references: American Staffing Association (ASA); ISO 30405:2016

attributes.name: root_cause_category

attributes.references: American Staffing Association (ASA); ISO 30405:2016; SIA Best Practices

attributes.name: sla_measurement_period

attributes.name: sla_threshold_unit

attributes.name: sla_threshold_value

attributes.name: source_system

products.name: submittal_compliance_check
products.description: This association product represents the compliance verification checkpoint between a candidate submittal and a specific compliance requirement. It captures the requirement-by-requirement compliance status for each submittal, including verification dates, waiver grants, blocking status, and documentation completeness. Each record links one submittal to one compliance requirement with attributes that exist only in the context of this verification relationship. Central to pre-placement compliance workflows and submittal clearance processes.. Existence Justification: In staffing operations, each candidate submittal must satisfy multiple compliance requirements (I-9 verification, background checks, drug screens, client-specific mandates, industry credentials), and each compliance requirement applies to many submittals across different candidates and job orders. The compliance team actively manages requirement-by-requirement verification status for each submittal, tracking verification dates, waivers, blocking status, and documentation completeness as part of the pre-placement clearance workflow.

attributes.name: submittal_compliance_check_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for this submittal-requirement verification record. Primary key.

attributes.business_glossary_term: Submittal Compliance Check - Compliance Requirement Id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the specific compliance requirement being verified
attributes.references: Internal - M:N Association FK

attributes.name: submittal_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the candidate submittal being verified for compliance
attributes.references: Internal - M:N Association FK

attributes.name: blocking_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether failure to meet this requirement blocks the submittal from progressing to placement. True means the submittal cannot proceed without satisfying this requirement.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this compliance check record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: documentation_complete
attributes.description: Indicates whether all required documentation for this compliance requirement has been collected and verified for this submittal.

attributes.name: documentation_received_date
attributes.description: The date on which the required documentation for this compliance requirement was received from the candidate for this submittal.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: The date on which this compliance verification expires and must be re-verified for this submittal (e.g., annual background check, drug screen validity period).

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes capturing additional context, issues, or special circumstances related to this requirement verification for this submittal.

attributes.name: requirement_met_date
attributes.description: The date on which this specific compliance requirement was successfully verified and met for this submittal. Null if requirement is still pending or failed.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this compliance check record was last modified.

attributes.name: verification_date
attributes.description: Timestamp when the compliance verification was performed for this requirement on this submittal.

attributes.name: verification_status
attributes.description: Current state of compliance verification for this submittal-requirement combination. Indicates whether the requirement has been met, is pending documentation, has been waived, or has failed verification.

attributes.name: verified_by
attributes.description: Reference to the compliance staff member who performed the verification of this requirement for this submittal.

attributes.name: waiver_expiration_date
attributes.description: The date on which the granted waiver expires and the requirement must be re-verified or the submittal becomes non-compliant. Null if no waiver granted or waiver is permanent.

attributes.name: waiver_granted
attributes.description: Indicates whether a compliance waiver has been granted for this specific requirement on this submittal, allowing progression despite non-compliance.

attributes.name: waiver_granted_by
attributes.description: Reference to the staff member (compliance officer or authorized manager) who granted the waiver for this requirement on this submittal.

attributes.name: waiver_reason
attributes.description: Free-text explanation of why a compliance waiver was granted for this requirement on this submittal.

domains.name: joborder
domains.description: SSOT for all client requisitions (reqs) and job order demand data. Owns job order headers, position requirements, skill specifications, headcount targets, duration, bill rates, pay rates, markup percentages, SLA commitments, TTF and TTS targets, and fulfillment status lifecycle. Tracks the complete job order lifecycle from intake through closure including extensions, modifications, and cancellations. Central operational hub connecting client demand to candidate supply.

products.name: order_header
products.description: Core master entity representing a client requisition (req) — the authoritative job order header record and central hub of the joborder domain. Captures the full lifecycle of a client demand request from intake through closure. Stores requisition number, job title, position type (temp, contract-to-hire, direct placement, SOW), employment classification (W-2, 1099, C2C), headcount target (total positions authorized, positions filled, positions remaining), backfill indicator, priority level, order status (open, filled, cancelled, on-hold, closed), intake date, target start date, assignment end date, and originating source (VMS, CRM, direct). Central hub connecting client demand to candidate supply in the ATS/CRM. All other joborder products reference this entity via req_id.

attributes.references: Beeline VMS Requisition Object

attributes.name: work_location_type
attributes.description: Specifies whether the position requires the worker to be physically on-site, fully remote, or a hybrid arrangement. Impacts candidate sourcing geography, per diem eligibility, and tax nexus determination.
attributes.references: Bullhorn ATS/CRM JobOrder.workFromHome; DOL Remote Work Guidelines; IRS Tax Nexus Rules

products.name: position_requirement
products.description: Defines the detailed position specifications attached to a requisition. Captures job description, required education level, years of experience, work location type (on-site, remote, hybrid), shift type, travel requirements, physical demands, security clearance level, drug screen requirement, background check requirement, and any client-specific screening criteria. Represents the structured demand profile that drives candidate matching and submittal qualification.

attributes.name: position_requirement_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the position requirement record. Primary key for this entity in the Silver Layer lakehouse. Entity role: MASTER_RESOURCE — represents a structured demand profile (position specification) attached to a job order requisition.
attributes.references: Bullhorn ATS/CRM — Job Order / Position Spec Object

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Position requirements often specify client cost center for budget authorization and departmental charge-back, enabling budget validation before submittal and accurate client billing allocation in ente
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: order_header_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent job order requisition that this position requirement is attached to. Links the position specification back to the demand record in the Job Order domain.
attributes.references: Bullhorn ATS/CRM — Job Order Object; ISO 30405:2016 Section 5

attributes.name: bgc_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether a background check (BGC) is required for candidates submitting to this position. Drives the credentialing workflow in Sterling Background Check and compliance tracking.
attributes.references: Fair Credit Reporting Act (FCRA); Sterling Background Check; EEOC BGC Guidance; ASA Best Practices

attributes.name: bgc_type
attributes.description: Specifies the type(s) of background check required (e.g., criminal, employment verification, education verification, credit, motor vehicle record). Drives the BGC package selection in Sterling Background Check. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: criminal|employment_verification|education_verification|credit|motor_vehicle|sex_offender_registry|federal — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Fair Credit Reporting Act (FCRA); Sterling Background Check; EEOC BGC Guidance

attributes.name: bill_rate
attributes.description: The agreed-upon hourly or periodic rate charged to the client for this position. Used in revenue recognition, spread calculation (Bill Rate minus Pay Rate), and gross margin analysis. Sourced from Bullhorn Job Order or Beeline VMS rate card.
attributes.references: Bullhorn ATS/CRM — Bill Rate; Beeline VMS — Rate Management; Salesforce Revenue Cloud; ASA Pricing Standards

attributes.name: certifications_required
attributes.description: Comma-delimited list of mandatory professional certifications or licenses required for the position (e.g., PMP, RN, CPA, CDL). Drives the credentialing verification workflow and readiness status checks.
attributes.references: Credentialing Domain — credential_requirement; ISO 30405:2016 Section 6.3; SHRM Certification Standards

attributes.name: client_screening_criteria
attributes.description: Free-text field capturing any client-specific screening requirements beyond standard criteria (e.g., proprietary assessments, client interviews, specific onboarding steps, NDA requirements). Sourced from client MSA or VMS program requirements.
attributes.references: Bullhorn ATS/CRM — Custom Fields; Beeline VMS — Screening Requirements; DocuSign CLM — MSA Terms

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this position requirement record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail, TTF calculation baseline, and data lineage tracking. Aligns with SOC 2 Type II audit requirements.
attributes.references: SOC 2 Type II — Audit Trail Requirements; GDPR Article 5 (Accountability); Bullhorn ATS/CRM — Date Added

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for all monetary rate fields on this position requirement (pay_rate_min, pay_rate_max, bill_rate). Supports multi-currency international staffing operations.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; GDPR Article 3 (international operations); Oracle NetSuite ERP — Multi-Currency

attributes.name: drug_screen_panel
attributes.description: Specifies the drug screening panel type required for this position (e.g., 5-panel, 10-panel, 12-panel, hair follicle, oral fluid). Drives the specific test order in Sterling Background Check.
attributes.references: Sterling Background Check; DOL Drug-Free Workplace Act; SAMHSA Drug Testing Guidelines

attributes.name: drug_screen_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether a pre-placement drug screen is required for this position. Triggers the drug screening workflow in Sterling Background Check and credentialing readiness tracking.
attributes.references: Sterling Background Check; DOL Drug-Free Workplace Act; OSHA Drug Testing Guidelines; ASA Best Practices

attributes.name: education_field_of_study
attributes.description: Specific academic discipline or field of study required or preferred for the position (e.g., Computer Science, Nursing, Accounting). Complements education_level for precise candidate qualification.
attributes.references: Bullhorn ATS/CRM; ISO 30405:2016 Section 6.3; EEOC Job Relatedness Standards

attributes.name: education_level
attributes.description: Minimum educational attainment required for the position. Used as a screening criterion in candidate qualification. Values align with standard U.S. education levels: none, high_school, associate, bachelor, master, doctorate, professional_cert. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: none|high_school|associate|bachelor|master|doctorate|professional_cert — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Bullhorn ATS/CRM — Education Level; EEOC Job Relatedness Standards; DOL Education Classification

attributes.name: employment_type
attributes.description: Classification of the engagement type for this position. Drives billing model, pay structure, and compliance requirements. Values: contract (temporary staffing), temp_to_perm (Temp-to-Perm conversion eligible), direct_hire (Direct Placement/FTE), contract_to_hire (Contract-to-Hire), per_diem (Per Diem assignment), sow (Statement of Work engagement).
attributes.references: American Staffing Association (ASA) Workforce Classification; IRS Worker Classification Rules; FLSA

attributes.name: end_date
attributes.description: Expected or confirmed end date for the position assignment. Drives assignment duration tracking, extension planning, redeployment workflows, and bench management. Nullable for permanent/direct hire positions.
attributes.references: Bullhorn ATS/CRM — End Date; Assignment End Date; ASA Assignment Management; FLSA

attributes.name: everify_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether E-Verify employment eligibility verification is required for this position. Mandatory for federal contractors and certain state-regulated engagements.
attributes.references: Immigration and Nationality Act (INA) — I-9 Compliance; E-Verify Program (USCIS); OFCCP Federal Contractor Requirements

attributes.name: headcount
attributes.description: Number of open positions (headcount) to be filled for this position requirement. Drives sourcing volume targets, TTF SLA tracking, and workforce planning analytics.
attributes.references: Bullhorn ATS/CRM — Openings Count; Beeline VMS — Headcount; ISO 30405:2016 Section 5; SIA Workforce Analytics

attributes.name: hours_per_week
attributes.description: Expected number of hours per week for the position. Used to determine full-time equivalent (FTE) status, overtime eligibility under FLSA, and bill/pay rate calculations.
attributes.references: FLSA Full-Time/Part-Time Classification; DOL FTE Definition; ASA Workforce Standards

attributes.name: job_category
attributes.description: Broad occupational category classifying the position (e.g., Information Technology, Healthcare, Finance, Engineering, Administrative). Used for workforce analytics, reporting, and candidate pool segmentation. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: Information Technology|Healthcare|Finance|Engineering|Administrative|Manufacturing|Legal|Creative|Sales|Operations — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: U.S. Department of Labor (DOL) Standard Occupational Classification (SOC); EEOC Job Category Codes

attributes.name: job_description
attributes.description: Full narrative job description including responsibilities, duties, and role overview as provided by the client. Used for candidate matching, job postings, and submittal qualification. Sourced from Bullhorn Job Order description field.
attributes.references: Bullhorn ATS/CRM — Job Description; ISO 30405:2016 Section 6.2; EEOC Job Relatedness Standards

attributes.name: job_title
attributes.description: The official job title for the open position as specified by the client. Used in candidate matching, submittal qualification, and job postings. Sourced from the Bullhorn Job Order title field.
attributes.references: Bullhorn ATS/CRM — Job Title; ISO 30405:2016 Section 6.2

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this position requirement record was last updated. Used for change tracking, SLA monitoring, and incremental data pipeline processing in the Silver Layer.
attributes.references: SOC 2 Type II — Audit Trail Requirements; GDPR Article 5 (Accountability); Bullhorn ATS/CRM — Date Last Modified

attributes.name: max_submittals
attributes.description: Maximum number of candidate submittals the client will accept for this position. Enforces quality of submission (QoS) discipline and prevents submittal flooding in VMS-managed programs.
attributes.references: Beeline VMS — Submittal Limits; Client SLA/MSA Terms; ASA QoS Best Practices

attributes.name: max_years_experience
attributes.description: Maximum number of years of relevant professional experience acceptable for the position. Used to prevent over-qualification mismatches and manage bill rate expectations.
attributes.references: Bullhorn ATS/CRM — Experience Field; EEOC Job Relatedness Standards

attributes.name: min_years_experience
attributes.description: Minimum number of years of relevant professional experience required for the position. Used as a hard filter in candidate screening and submittal qualification.
attributes.references: Bullhorn ATS/CRM — Experience Field; EEOC Job Relatedness Standards; ISO 30405:2016 Section 6.3

attributes.name: pay_rate_max
attributes.description: Maximum pay rate (per hour or per period) approved for this position. Defines the upper bound of the pay rate range. Used in candidate offer negotiations and gross margin planning.
attributes.references: Bullhorn ATS/CRM — Pay Rate; DOL Wage and Hour Division; FLSA; ASA Rate Management

attributes.name: pay_rate_min
attributes.description: Minimum pay rate (per hour or per period) approved for this position. Defines the lower bound of the pay rate range used in candidate offer negotiations and spread/margin calculations.
attributes.references: Bullhorn ATS/CRM — Pay Rate; DOL Wage and Hour Division; FLSA Minimum Wage; ASA Rate Management

attributes.name: physical_demands
attributes.description: DOL physical exertion classification for the position. Used for workers compensation risk rating, OSHA compliance, and candidate physical qualification screening. Aligns with DOL Dictionary of Occupational Titles (DOT) physical demand levels.
attributes.references: DOL Dictionary of Occupational Titles (DOT); OSHA Physical Demands Standards; Workers Compensation Classification

attributes.name: position_req_number
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric business identifier for this position requirement, used in client communications, VMS portals, and ATS workflows. May align with the client's internal requisition number or Beeline VMS position code.
attributes.references: Bullhorn ATS/CRM; Beeline VMS — Position/Req Number

attributes.name: position_requirement_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the position requirement. Drives operational workflows: draft (intake in progress), open (actively sourcing), on_hold (client paused), filled (placement made), cancelled (client withdrew), closed (naturally ended), expired (TTF deadline passed without fill). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|open|on_hold|filled|cancelled|closed|expired — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Bullhorn ATS/CRM — Job Order Status; ISO 30405:2016 Section 7

attributes.name: preferred_skills
attributes.description: Comma-delimited or free-text list of desired but non-mandatory skills that enhance candidate suitability. Used for secondary ranking in candidate matching and quality of submission (QoS) scoring.
attributes.references: Bullhorn ATS/CRM — Skills Field; ISO 30405:2016 Section 6.3

attributes.name: priority_level
attributes.description: Business priority assigned to this position requirement, used to triage recruiter effort and sourcing resources. Critical positions receive immediate attention; low priority positions are worked as capacity allows.
attributes.references: Bullhorn ATS/CRM — Priority Field; ASA Recruiter Workflow Best Practices; SIA KPI Frameworks

attributes.name: rate_type
attributes.description: Specifies the billing and pay rate period for this position. Determines how bill_rate and pay_rate_min/max are interpreted in payroll and billing calculations.
attributes.references: Bullhorn ATS/CRM — Rate Type; TempWorks Payroll; Salesforce Revenue Cloud; FLSA Pay Period Rules

attributes.name: required_skills
attributes.description: Comma-delimited or free-text list of mandatory technical and functional skills required for the position. Used as primary filter criteria in ATS candidate matching and submittal qualification scoring (QoS).
attributes.references: Bullhorn ATS/CRM — Skills Field; ISO 30405:2016 Section 6.3

attributes.name: security_clearance_level
attributes.description: U.S. government security clearance level required for the position. Critical for federal staffing engagements and OFCCP compliance. Values: none, public_trust, confidential, secret, top_secret, TS/SCI (Top Secret/Sensitive Compartmented Information).
attributes.references: OFCCP Compliance; Executive Order 12968 — Access to Classified Information; DNI Security Clearance Standards

attributes.name: shift_type
attributes.description: The work shift schedule required for the position. Drives scheduling, differential pay calculations, and candidate availability matching in Kronos Workforce Ready.
attributes.references: Kronos Workforce Ready — Shift Scheduling; FLSA Overtime Rules; DOL Wage and Hour Division

attributes.name: start_date
attributes.description: Target or confirmed start date for the position. Used in Time to Start (TTS) SLA measurement, assignment scheduling, and onboarding planning.
attributes.references: Bullhorn ATS/CRM — Start Date; ISO 30405:2016 Section 7; ASA TTS KPI Definition

attributes.name: travel_requirement
attributes.description: Expected travel frequency for the position. Used in candidate screening and per diem/expense planning. Values represent percentage of time traveling: none, occasional, up to 25%, up to 50%, up to 75%, frequent (75%+).
attributes.references: Bullhorn ATS/CRM — Travel Requirements; IRS Per Diem Rules; DOL Travel Time Compensation

attributes.name: ttf_target_days
attributes.description: Client-agreed or internal SLA target for the number of calendar days to fill this position from requisition open date. Key KPI for recruiter performance and SLA compliance reporting.
attributes.references: ASA KPI Standards — Time to Fill (TTF); SIA Staffing Industry KPIs; Client SLA/MSA Terms

attributes.name: tts_target_days
attributes.description: Client-agreed or internal SLA target for the number of calendar days from candidate selection to worker start date. Distinct from TTF; measures onboarding and credentialing speed.
attributes.references: ASA KPI Standards — Time to Start (TTS); SIA Staffing Industry KPIs; Client SLA/MSA Terms

attributes.name: work_city
attributes.description: City where the position is physically located or where the worker is expected to report. Used for geographic candidate matching, tax jurisdiction determination, and workers compensation classification.
attributes.references: Bullhorn ATS/CRM — Job Location; DOL Wage and Hour Division; SUTA/FUTA Jurisdiction Rules

attributes.name: work_country
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code for the country where the position is located. Required for international staffing operations, GDPR applicability determination, and EOR arrangement identification.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3; GDPR Article 3; Immigration and Nationality Act (INA) — I-9 Compliance

attributes.name: work_location_type
attributes.description: Specifies whether the position requires the worker to be physically present at the client site (on_site), work fully remotely (remote), or a combination of both (hybrid). Drives candidate geographic filtering and sourcing strategy.
attributes.references: Bullhorn ATS/CRM — Remote/On-Site Flag; ASA Workforce Trends; FLSA Telework Guidance

attributes.name: work_state
attributes.description: U.S. state (or equivalent jurisdiction) where the position is located. Critical for state-specific labor law compliance, SUTA tax assignment, workers compensation policy selection, and wage/hour determination.
attributes.references: DOL Wage and Hour Division; SUTA State Jurisdiction; Workers Compensation State Rules; FLSA

attributes.name: worker_classification
attributes.description: Tax and legal classification of the worker for this position. W-2 (employee on payroll), 1099 (Independent Contractor), Corp-to-Corp (IC through their own entity), or EOR (Employer of Record arrangement). Critical for IRS compliance and co-employment risk management.
attributes.references: IRS Worker Classification Rules; FLSA; EEOC; American Staffing Association (ASA)

products.name: skill_requirement
products.description: Captures the individual skill, competency, and technology requirements associated with a requisition. Stores skill name, skill category (technical, soft, industry-specific), proficiency level required (beginner, intermediate, expert), whether the skill is mandatory or preferred, years of experience required for the skill, and certification requirement flag. Enables structured skill-based candidate matching and QoS (Quality of Submission) scoring within the ATS.

attributes.name: skill_requirement_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the skill requirement record. Primary key for the skill requirement entity.

attributes.name: order_header_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent job order (requisition) that this skill requirement belongs to. Links the skill requirement to the specific client requisition.
attributes.references: Bullhorn ATS Job Order Object

attributes.name: primary_skill_staff_profile_id
attributes.description: Reference to the user (recruiter, account manager, or system administrator) who created this skill requirement record. Used for audit trail and accountability.
attributes.references: Bullhorn ATS User Object; SOC 2 Type II Audit Trail Requirements

attributes.name: tertiary_skill_deactivated_by_user_staff_profile_id
attributes.description: Reference to the user who deactivated this skill requirement. Null if the requirement is still active. Used for audit trail and accountability.
attributes.references: Bullhorn ATS User Object; SOC 2 Type II Audit Trail Requirements

attributes.name: active_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this skill requirement is currently active for the job order. True if active and used in candidate matching; False if deprecated or removed from requirements. Used for requirement lifecycle management.
attributes.references: Bullhorn ATS Job Order Management; ASA Requisition Management Standards

attributes.name: alternative_skill_names
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of synonyms or alternative names for this skill. Used to improve candidate search and matching. Examples: Java could include J2EE, Java EE, Jakarta EE.
attributes.references: Bullhorn ATS Skill Synonym Configuration; O*NET Skill Taxonomy

attributes.name: assessment_method
attributes.description: The primary method used to evaluate candidate proficiency in this skill. Resume review indicates screening from candidate documents; technical test indicates formal assessment; behavioral interview indicates structured questioning; practical demonstration indicates hands-on evaluation; certification verification indicates credential validation; reference check indicates third-party validation.
attributes.references: ASA Candidate Assessment Best Practices; SHRM Talent Acquisition Standards

attributes.name: certification_name
attributes.description: The name of the specific certification or credential required if certification_required_flag is True. Examples include PMP, CPA, RN, AWS Certified Solutions Architect, or Certified Welder. Null if no certification is required.
attributes.references: Industry-Specific Certification Bodies; Bullhorn ATS Certification Object

attributes.name: certification_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a formal certification or credential is required for this skill. True if certification is mandatory; False if experience alone is sufficient. Used for credentialing and compliance verification.
attributes.references: Bullhorn ATS Certification Tracking; ISO 30405:2016 Recruitment Guidelines

attributes.name: client_specific_terminology
attributes.description: Client-specific name or terminology for this skill if different from the standard skill_name. Used to align with client vocabulary in submittals and communications. Null if client uses standard terminology.
attributes.references: Bullhorn ATS Client Configuration; ASA Client Relationship Management

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this skill requirement record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and requirement lifecycle tracking.
attributes.references: ISO 8601 Timestamp Standard; SOC 2 Type II Audit Trail Requirements

attributes.name: deactivated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this skill requirement was deactivated or removed from the job order. Null if the requirement is still active. Used for requirement lifecycle analysis.
attributes.references: Bullhorn ATS Job Order Management; ASA Requisition Lifecycle Standards

attributes.name: deactivation_reason
attributes.description: Free-text explanation of why this skill requirement was deactivated or removed from the job order. Examples include client request, requirement change, skill no longer needed, or job order modification. Null if still active.
attributes.references: Bullhorn ATS Job Order Change Management; ASA Requisition Management Standards

attributes.name: last_market_rate_survey_date
attributes.description: The date when market rate data for this skill was last surveyed or updated. Used to ensure pay rate and bill rate competitiveness. Null if no market survey has been conducted.
attributes.references: Staffing Industry Analysts (SIA) Rate Surveys; ASA Compensation Benchmarking

attributes.name: market_demand_level
attributes.description: Assessment of current market demand for this skill. Low indicates abundant supply; moderate indicates balanced supply/demand; high indicates competitive market; critical indicates severe shortage. Used for sourcing strategy and rate negotiations.
attributes.references: Staffing Industry Analysts (SIA) Market Intelligence; ASA Workforce Trends

attributes.name: minimum_score_threshold
attributes.description: The minimum acceptable score (0-100 scale) a candidate must achieve for this skill to be considered qualified. Used in automated candidate screening and QoS evaluation.
attributes.references: Bullhorn ATS Screening Configuration; ASA Candidate Qualification Standards

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this skill requirement record was last modified. Used for audit trail and change tracking.
attributes.references: ISO 8601 Timestamp Standard; SOC 2 Type II Audit Trail Requirements

attributes.name: proficiency_level
attributes.description: The level of expertise or mastery required for this skill. Beginner indicates basic familiarity; intermediate indicates working knowledge; advanced indicates deep expertise; expert indicates subject matter expertise; master indicates industry-recognized authority.
attributes.references: Dreyfus Model of Skill Acquisition; SFIA (Skills Framework for the Information Age)

attributes.name: requirement_type
attributes.description: Indicates whether the skill is mandatory (must-have for candidate consideration), preferred (strongly desired but not required), or nice-to-have (beneficial but not critical). Used for candidate screening and Quality of Submission (QoS) scoring.
attributes.references: Bullhorn ATS Skill Requirement Configuration; ASA Candidate Matching Best Practices

attributes.name: skill_category
attributes.description: Classification of the skill type. Technical skills include programming languages and technical tools; soft skills include communication and leadership; industry-specific skills include domain knowledge; certifications include professional credentials; languages include spoken/written languages; tools and platforms include software applications. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: technical|soft|industry_specific|certification|language|tool|platform — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: O*NET Content Model; ASA Skill Classification Framework

attributes.name: skill_code
attributes.description: Standardized code or identifier for the skill from an external taxonomy or classification system. Examples include O*NET skill codes, SOC codes, or client-specific skill identifiers.
attributes.references: O*NET Skill Codes; SOC (Standard Occupational Classification)

attributes.name: skill_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the skill requirement including specific technologies, methodologies, or competencies expected. Provides context for recruiters and candidates beyond the skill name.
attributes.references: O*NET Detailed Work Activities; Bullhorn ATS Job Description Standards

attributes.name: skill_name
attributes.description: The name of the skill, competency, or technology required for the job order. Examples include Java, Project Management, SAP, Nursing, Welding, or Communication Skills.
attributes.references: O*NET Skills Taxonomy; Bullhorn ATS Skill Object

attributes.name: skill_obsolescence_date
attributes.description: The date when this skill is expected to become obsolete or significantly less relevant. Used for workforce planning and skill gap analysis. Null if the skill has no known obsolescence timeline.
attributes.references: Staffing Industry Analysts (SIA) Workforce Trends; ASA Skill Evolution Framework

attributes.name: skill_priority_rank
attributes.description: Numeric ranking indicating the relative importance of this skill within the job order. Lower numbers indicate higher priority. Used for weighted candidate matching and QoS scoring algorithms.
attributes.references: Bullhorn ATS Skill Weighting; ASA Quality of Submission Framework

attributes.name: skill_source_system
attributes.description: The name of the source system or taxonomy from which this skill requirement was derived. Examples include O*NET, client-provided skill list, internal skill taxonomy, or VMS skill catalog.
attributes.references: Bullhorn ATS Integration; Beeline VMS Skill Taxonomy

attributes.name: skill_verification_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether formal verification or validation of this skill is required before candidate submission or placement. True if verification is mandatory; False if self-reported skill is acceptable. Used for compliance and quality assurance.
attributes.references: Sterling Background Check Integration; ASA Quality Assurance Standards

attributes.name: skill_weight_percentage
attributes.description: The percentage weight assigned to this skill in the overall candidate evaluation and QoS scoring. All skill weights for a job order should sum to 100. Used in ATS matching algorithms.
attributes.references: Bullhorn ATS Matching Algorithm; ASA Candidate Scoring Best Practices

attributes.name: training_available_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether training or upskilling programs are available for candidates who do not fully meet this skill requirement. True if training is offered; False if candidates must possess the skill prior to placement.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Learning Management; ASA Workforce Development Programs

attributes.name: training_duration_hours
attributes.description: The estimated number of hours required to complete training for this skill if training_available_flag is True. Used for onboarding planning and Time to Start (TTS) calculations. Null if no training is available.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Learning Management; ASA Training Standards

attributes.name: years_of_experience_required
attributes.description: The minimum number of years of hands-on experience required for this specific skill. Used in candidate screening and QoS scoring. Supports fractional years (e.g., 2.5 years).
attributes.references: Bullhorn ATS Job Order Requirements; FLSA Experience Classification

products.name: rate_override
products.description: Stores the approved bill rate, pay rate, markup percentage, spread (bill rate minus pay rate), burden rate, and gross margin targets for a requisition. Captures OT (overtime) bill rate, DT (double time) bill rate, per diem allowance, and any client-negotiated rate caps or floors. Tracks rate effective dates, rate approval status, and the rate source (MSA rate schedule, VMS rate card, negotiated). Serves as the financial backbone of the job order connecting to billing and payroll domains.
products.reference: Bill Rate / Pay Rate / Rate Card

attributes.name: rate_override_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the rate override record. Primary key.

attributes.name: contract_rate_schedule_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to contract.contract_rate_schedule. Business justification: Rate overrides deviate from contracted baseline rates. Linking the source schedule enables approval workflows (overrides exceeding contract terms require escalation), variance tracking for client bill
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: gl_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.gl_account. Business justification: Rate overrides impact revenue and margin, requiring GL account mapping for proper revenue classification, financial statement accuracy, and audit support—critical when overrides change revenue recogni

attributes.name: order_header_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent job order (requisition) for which this rate override applies.

attributes.name: vendor_rate_card_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Vendor Management System (VMS) Rate Card ID
attributes.description: External identifier of the VMS rate card from which this override was derived or against which it was validated. Links to Beeline or other VMS platform.
attributes.references: Beeline VMS - Rate Card Management

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: The date on which this rate override was formally approved by the authorized approver (internal management or client stakeholder).

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the person who approved this rate override. May be internal manager, finance director, or client procurement contact.

attributes.name: bill_rate
attributes.description: The hourly or unit rate charged to the client for this job order. This is the revenue rate that appears on client invoices.
attributes.references: Staffing Industry Analysts (SIA) - Rate Structure Standards

attributes.name: burden_rate
attributes.description: The total burden cost per hour including payroll taxes (FICA, FUTA, SUTA), workers compensation insurance, benefits, and other statutory costs. Applied on top of pay rate.
attributes.references: Internal Revenue Service (IRS) - Employer Tax Requirements; TempWorks Payroll - Burden Calculation

attributes.name: client_approval_date
attributes.description: The date on which the client formally approved this rate override. Nullable if client approval is not required or not yet received.

attributes.name: client_approval_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether this rate override requires explicit client approval before activation. True if client sign-off is mandatory per MSA or VMS rules.
attributes.references: Beeline VMS - Rate Approval Workflow

attributes.name: client_approver_name
attributes.description: Name of the client contact who approved this rate override. Typically a procurement manager, hiring manager, or VMS program manager.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this rate override record was first created in the system. Part of audit trail.
attributes.references: SOC 2 Type II - Audit Trail Requirements

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary amounts in this rate override (e.g., USD, CAD, GBP).
attributes.references: ISO 4217 - Currency Codes

attributes.name: dt_bill_rate
attributes.description: The hourly bill rate charged to the client for double-time hours (typically hours worked on holidays or beyond a certain threshold). Usually 2x the regular bill rate.
attributes.references: State Labor Laws - Premium Pay Requirements

attributes.name: dt_pay_rate
attributes.description: The hourly pay rate paid to the worker for double-time hours. Typically 2x the regular pay rate, may be required by state law or client policy.
attributes.references: State Labor Laws - Premium Pay Requirements

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: The date on which this rate override expires or is no longer applicable. Nullable for open-ended rate agreements.
attributes.references: American Staffing Association (ASA) - Rate Management Best Practices

attributes.name: effective_start_date

attributes.description: The number of workers (headcount or FTE) who are on the staffing firms payroll but not currently assigned to a billable client engagement. Key metric for capacity planning and redeployment.
attributes.references: Staffing Industry Analysts (SIA) Workforce Management Standards

attributes.name: billable_hours
attributes.description: The total number of hours that are billable to the client during the snapshot period. May differ from total hours worked if certain hours are non-billable (training, bench time, etc.).
attributes.references: Staffing Industry Analysts (SIA) Billing Standards

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this FTE actuals record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage.
attributes.references: Data Governance Standards

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: The three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary values in this record (USD, EUR, GBP, CAD, etc.).
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes

attributes.name: data_source
attributes.description: The source system or process that generated this FTE actuals snapshot (e.g., Kronos Workforce Ready, TempWorks Payroll, manual calculation). Used for data lineage and quality assessment.
attributes.references: Data Governance Standards

attributes.name: department_name
attributes.description: The name of the client department or business unit to which these FTE actuals are allocated. Enables organizational analysis.
attributes.references: Client Organizational Standards

attributes.name: double_time_hours
attributes.description: The total number of double-time hours worked during the snapshot period. Typically hours worked on holidays or beyond daily/weekly overtime thresholds per contract terms.
attributes.references: Fair Labor Standards Act (FLSA) Overtime Standards

attributes.name: fte_variance
attributes.description: The difference between actual FTE and planned FTE (actual minus planned). Positive values indicate overstaffing; negative values indicate understaffing relative to plan.
attributes.references: Workforce Analytics Standards

attributes.name: fte_variance_percentage
attributes.description: The FTE variance expressed as a percentage of planned FTE. Calculated as (actual FTE - planned FTE) / planned FTE * 100. Enables normalized comparison across programs of different sizes.
attributes.references: Workforce Analytics Standards

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this FTE actuals record was last modified. Used for audit trail and change tracking.
attributes.references: Data Governance Standards

attributes.name: new_hire_count
attributes.description: The number of new workers hired and onboarded into this segment during the snapshot period. Used for recruitment velocity and onboarding capacity analysis.
attributes.references: Talent Acquisition Standards

attributes.name: non_billable_hours
attributes.description: The total number of hours worked that are not billable to the client (training, administrative time, bench time, paid time off). Used for utilization analysis.
attributes.references: Staffing Industry Analysts (SIA) Utilization Standards

attributes.name: overtime_hours
attributes.description: The total number of overtime hours worked during the snapshot period. Typically hours worked beyond 40 hours per week or 8 hours per day, depending on jurisdiction and contract terms.
attributes.references: Fair Labor Standards Act (FLSA) Overtime Standards

attributes.name: planned_fte
attributes.description: The planned or target FTE count for this client program, job category, and workforce mix type as of the snapshot date. Used for variance analysis against actual FTE.
attributes.references: Workforce Planning Standards

attributes.name: projected_cost
attributes.description: The projected cost (payroll and burden) for this segment based on actual FTE, average pay rate, burden rate, and expected hours. Used for cost forecasting and margin analysis.
attributes.references: Cost Accounting Standards

attributes.name: projected_gross_margin
attributes.description: The projected gross margin (revenue minus cost) for this segment. Key profitability metric for program and portfolio management.
attributes.references: Staffing Industry Analysts (SIA) Financial Metrics Standards

attributes.name: projected_revenue
attributes.description: The projected revenue for this segment based on actual FTE, average bill rate, and expected hours. Used for financial forecasting and variance analysis.
attributes.references: Revenue Recognition Standards

attributes.name: redeployment_count
attributes.description: The number of workers who were redeployed from bench or another assignment to this client program during the snapshot period. Measures internal mobility and talent optimization.
attributes.references: Workforce Planning Standards

attributes.name: regular_hours
attributes.description: The total number of regular (non-overtime) hours worked during the snapshot period. Excludes overtime and double-time hours.
attributes.references: Fair Labor Standards Act (FLSA) Timekeeping Standards

attributes.name: shift_type
attributes.description: The primary shift schedule for workers in this segment (first shift, second shift, third shift, rotating, weekend, on-call). Used for scheduling and premium pay analysis.
attributes.references: Workforce Scheduling Standards

attributes.name: snapshot_date
attributes.description: The date on which this FTE actuals snapshot was taken. Represents the point-in-time measurement of actual headcount and FTE values.
attributes.references: Workforce Analytics Standards

attributes.name: snapshot_period_type
attributes.description: The granularity or frequency of the FTE actuals snapshot measurement (daily, weekly, monthly, quarterly, annual).
attributes.references: Workforce Planning Standards

attributes.name: snapshot_status
attributes.description: The status of this FTE actuals snapshot (draft, preliminary, final, revised). Indicates whether the data is still being validated or is approved for reporting.
attributes.references: Data Quality Standards

attributes.name: termination_count
attributes.description: The number of workers who terminated or completed their assignments in this segment during the snapshot period. Used for attrition and retention analysis.
attributes.references: Workforce Analytics Standards

attributes.name: total_hours_worked
attributes.description: The total number of hours worked by all workers in this segment during the snapshot period. Used to calculate actual FTE and for billing and payroll validation.
attributes.references: Fair Labor Standards Act (FLSA) Timekeeping Standards

attributes.name: union_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether workers in this segment are covered by a union collective bargaining agreement (union, non-union, mixed). Critical for labor relations and compliance.
attributes.references: National Labor Relations Act (NLRA) Standards

attributes.name: utilization_rate
attributes.description: The percentage of total hours worked that are billable to clients. Calculated as billable hours / total hours worked * 100. Key performance indicator for staffing firm profitability.
attributes.references: Staffing Industry Analysts (SIA) Key Performance Indicator (KPI) Standards

attributes.name: work_location_type
attributes.description: The primary work location arrangement for workers in this segment (onsite at client location, remote, hybrid). Used for workforce planning and real estate analysis.
attributes.references: Workforce Management Standards

attributes.name: worker_classification
attributes.description: The tax and legal classification of workers included in this FTE count (W-2 employee, 1099 independent contractor). Critical for compliance and payroll tax reporting.
attributes.references: Internal Revenue Service (IRS) Worker Classification Rules

attributes.name: workforce_mix_type
attributes.description: The employment classification or workforce segment type (temporary, contract, contract-to-hire, temp-to-perm, direct hire, permanent, independent contractor). Critical for analyzing workforce composition and contingent vs. permanent labor mix. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: temporary|contract|contract_to_hire|temp_to_perm|direct_hire|permanent|independent_contractor — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: American Staffing Association (ASA) Workforce Classification Standards

attributes.name: conversion_date

attributes.name: conversion_fee

attributes.name: cost_center

attributes.name: department

attributes.name: drug_screen_status

attributes.name: end_reason

attributes.name: extension_count
attributes.description: The number of times this assignment's end date has been extended. Used to track assignment longevity, client satisfaction, and redeployment planning. Incremented each time a new scheduled end date is set beyond the prior one.

attributes.description: Indicates whether the worker is eligible for redeployment to another assignment upon completion of this one. Used by recruiters to proactively manage bench workers and reduce time-to-fill on new requisitions.

attributes.name: is_remote

attributes.name: job_title

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp

attributes.name: markup_percentage

attributes.name: ot_bill_rate

attributes.name: ot_pay_rate

attributes.name: pay_rate

attributes.name: per_diem_eligible
