attributes.description: Current status of the pre-employment drug screening for the candidate in this direct hire placement. Sourced from Sterling Background Check integration. Required for compliance with client-specific and DOT/OSHA regulated positions.
attributes.references: Sterling Background Check; OSHA Drug-Free Workplace Standards; DOT Drug Testing Regulations

attributes.name: eeoc_job_category
attributes.business_glossary_term: Equal Employment Opportunity Commission (EEOC) Job Category
attributes.description: The EEOC EEO-1 job category code assigned to the placed position (e.g., Officials and Managers, Professionals, Technicians). Required for EEOC and OFCCP regulatory reporting on workforce composition.
attributes.references: EEOC EEO-1 Component 1 Reporting; OFCCP Federal Contractor Compliance; DOL Regulatory Reporting

attributes.name: employment_type
attributes.description: Classification of the employment arrangement for the direct hire placement. Full-Time Equivalent (FTE) is the standard for direct hire; part-time direct hire is less common but supported.
attributes.references: FLSA Employment Classification; DOL Employment Standards; IRS Worker Classification Rules

attributes.name: exempt_status
attributes.description: Fair Labor Standards Act (FLSA) classification of the placed position as exempt (salaried, not eligible for overtime) or non-exempt (eligible for overtime pay). Critical for client compliance and workforce analytics.
attributes.references: FLSA Fair Labor Standards Act; DOL Wage and Hour Division; EEOC Compliance

attributes.name: fall_off_date
attributes.description: The date on which the placed candidate left or was terminated from the client, triggering a fall-off event within the guarantee period. Null if the placement has not fallen off. Used to calculate fall-off rate KPI and assess recruiter performance.
attributes.references: Bullhorn ATS/CRM Permanent Placement Module; SIA Fall-Off Rate Metrics; ASA Direct Hire Standards

attributes.name: fall_off_reason
attributes.description: The categorized reason why a direct hire placement fell off within the guarantee period. Used for root cause analysis, recruiter coaching, and quality of submission (QoS) reporting. Null if placement has not fallen off. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: candidate_resigned|candidate_terminated|offer_rescinded|failed_bgc|failed_drug_screen|personal_reasons|compensation_mismatch|other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Bullhorn ATS/CRM Permanent Placement Module; SIA Fall-Off Rate Metrics; ASA Quality Standards

attributes.name: fee_collected
attributes.description: Indicates whether the conversion fee has been fully collected (payment received) from the client for this direct hire placement. Used for cash flow reporting and accounts receivable aging analysis.
attributes.references: Salesforce Revenue Cloud; Oracle NetSuite ERP Accounts Receivable; ASA Financial Standards

attributes.name: fee_invoiced
attributes.description: Indicates whether the conversion fee invoice has been generated and sent to the client for this direct hire placement. Used to track billing completeness and revenue recognition readiness.
attributes.references: Salesforce Revenue Cloud; Oracle NetSuite ERP Revenue Recognition; ASA Billing Standards

attributes.name: fee_payment_terms
attributes.description: The agreed-upon payment terms for the conversion fee invoice. Defines when the client is obligated to remit payment after the placement start date or invoice date. Sourced from the client MSA.
attributes.references: Bullhorn ATS/CRM Permanent Placement Module; DocuSign CLM MSA Module; Salesforce Revenue Cloud

attributes.name: fee_percentage
attributes.description: The agreed-upon percentage of the candidate's first-year base salary charged as the conversion fee. Typically ranges from 15% to 30% for direct hire placements. Defined in the client's Master Service Agreement (MSA).
attributes.references: Bullhorn ATS/CRM Permanent Placement Module; DocuSign CLM MSA Module; ASA Fee Standards

attributes.name: guarantee_end_date
attributes.description: The calculated date on which the guarantee period expires (start_date + guarantee_period_days). After this date, the staffing firm has no replacement obligation. Used for fall-off risk monitoring and financial liability tracking.
attributes.references: Bullhorn ATS/CRM Permanent Placement Module; ASA Direct Hire Standards; SIA Fall-Off Rate Metrics

attributes.name: guarantee_period_days
attributes.description: The number of calendar days from the candidate's start date during which the staffing firm is obligated to provide a free replacement if the candidate leaves or is terminated (fall-off window). Typically 30, 60, or 90 days. Defined in the client MSA.
attributes.references: Bullhorn ATS/CRM Permanent Placement Module; DocuSign CLM MSA Module; ASA Direct Hire Standards

attributes.name: i9_verified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the candidate's I-9 Employment Eligibility Verification has been completed and verified for this direct hire placement. Mandatory under the Immigration and Nationality Act (INA) for all U.S. employees.
attributes.references: INA Immigration and Nationality Act; USCIS I-9 Form Requirements; EEOC Compliance

attributes.name: job_title
attributes.description: The job title of the position the candidate is being permanently placed into at the client organization. Captured at time of placement as the agreed-upon title.
attributes.references: Bullhorn ATS/CRM Permanent Placement Module; DOL Standard Occupational Classification (SOC)

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for recruiter or account manager notes related to this direct hire placement, including special client requirements, candidate considerations, or placement context not captured in structured fields.
attributes.references: Bullhorn ATS/CRM Permanent Placement Module

attributes.name: offer_date
attributes.description: The date on which the formal employment offer was extended to the candidate by the client. BUSINESS_EVENT_TIMESTAMP (date precision) per TRANSACTION_HEADER canonical role. Key metric for Time to Fill (TTF) calculation.
attributes.references: Bullhorn ATS/CRM Permanent Placement Module; ISO 30405:2016; ASA TTF Metrics

attributes.name: onboarding_status
attributes.description: Current status of the candidate onboarding process for this direct hire placement, including I-9 verification, document collection, and system provisioning. Tracked to ensure readiness for the confirmed start date.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Onboarding Module; INA I-9 Compliance; DOL Onboarding Standards

attributes.name: placement_number
attributes.description: Human-readable, externally-known business identifier for this direct hire placement record (e.g., DH-2024-00123). Used in client communications, invoicing, and reporting. BUSINESS_IDENTIFIER per TRANSACTION_HEADER canonical role.
attributes.references: Bullhorn ATS/CRM Permanent Placement Module; ASA Direct Hire Standards

attributes.name: placement_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the direct hire placement. Tracks the progression from offer through active employment or fall-off. LIFECYCLE_STATUS per TRANSACTION_HEADER canonical role. Values: offered (offer extended to candidate), accepted (candidate accepted offer), started (candidate began employment), fell_off (candidate did not start or left within guarantee period), replaced (replacement candidate provided per guarantee obligation).
attributes.references: Bullhorn ATS/CRM Permanent Placement Module; ASA Direct Hire Standards; SIA Permanent Placement Metrics

attributes.name: placement_type
attributes.description: Classification of the permanent placement engagement type. Direct Hire is a full-time permanent placement from the outset; Temp-to-Perm and Contract-to-Hire indicate a conversion from a temporary or contract assignment to permanent employment.
attributes.references: ASA Staffing Industry Classification Standards; SIA Workforce Solutions Taxonomy

attributes.name: replacement_obligation
attributes.description: Indicates whether the staffing firm is currently obligated to provide a free replacement candidate due to a fall-off within the guarantee period. True when placement_status is fell_off and the guarantee period has not expired.
attributes.references: Bullhorn ATS/CRM Permanent Placement Module; DocuSign CLM MSA Module; ASA Direct Hire Standards

attributes.name: salary_currency
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the base salary (e.g., USD, CAD, GBP). Supports multi-currency operations for international placements. MONETARY_TRIPLET component per TRANSACTION_HEADER canonical role.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; GDPR Article 4 (international operations)

attributes.name: sourcing_channel
attributes.description: The channel or method through which the candidate was originally sourced for this direct hire placement. Used for sourcing effectiveness analytics and recruiter performance reporting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: job_board|referral|linkedin|direct_sourcing|internal_database|rpo|other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Bullhorn ATS/CRM Sourcing Module; SIA Sourcing Analytics; ISO 30405:2016

attributes.name: start_date
attributes.description: The confirmed date on which the candidate begins employment with the client. Used to calculate Time to Start (TTS) and triggers the guarantee period window. Key operational milestone for billing and fall-off monitoring.
attributes.references: Bullhorn ATS/CRM Permanent Placement Module; ASA TTS Metrics; SIA Direct Hire Standards

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this direct hire placement record was most recently modified. RECORD_AUDIT_UPDATED per TRANSACTION_HEADER canonical role. Used for change detection, incremental ETL processing, and audit compliance.
attributes.references: SOC 2 Type II Audit Trail Requirements; GDPR Article 5 (data integrity); CCPA

attributes.name: work_arrangement
attributes.description: The agreed-upon work location arrangement for the permanent placement. Onsite requires physical presence at the client location; remote is fully off-site; hybrid is a combination. Captured at time of placement.
attributes.references: Bullhorn ATS/CRM Permanent Placement Module; DOL Remote Work Guidelines

products.name: assignment_extension
products.description: Transactional record capturing each extension event on a temporary or contract assignment. Tracks the prior end date, new end date, extension reason, extension request date, approver, revised bill rate (if renegotiated), revised pay rate, extension sequence number, and extension status (pending, approved, rejected, executed). Enables fall-off rate monitoring and redeployment planning by providing a complete extension history per assignment. Sourced from Bullhorn assignment extension workflow.

attributes.name: assignment_extension_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate primary key for each assignment extension event record in the placement domain. Globally unique identifier for this transactional record.
attributes.references: Bullhorn ATS/CRM Assignment Extension Workflow

attributes.name: client_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the client account for whom the worker is assigned. Supports client-level extension analytics and SLA tracking.
attributes.references: Bullhorn ATS/CRM Client Account Object

attributes.name: docusign_envelope_id
attributes.description: The DocuSign envelope identifier for the executed extension agreement or amendment document. Provides traceability to the signed contract artifact in the DocuSign CLM system.
attributes.references: DocuSign CLM Contract Lifecycle Management; ASA Contract Standards; SOC 2 Type II

attributes.name: order_header_id
attributes.description: Reference to the job order (requisition) under which the assignment extension is being processed. Links the extension to the client demand record.
attributes.references: Bullhorn ATS/CRM Job Order Object

attributes.name: primary_assignment_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent temporary or contract assignment record that is being extended. Core linkage to the placement assignment lifecycle.
attributes.references: Bullhorn ATS/CRM Placement/Assignment Object

attributes.name: primary_assignment_staff_profile_id
attributes.description: Reference to the internal user or manager who approved or rejected the extension request. Required for approval workflow audit trail.
attributes.references: Bullhorn ATS/CRM User Object; ASA Workforce Management Standards

attributes.name: profile_id
attributes.description: Reference to the candidate (worker) whose assignment is being extended. Enables fall-off rate monitoring and redeployment planning at the worker level.
attributes.references: Bullhorn ATS/CRM Candidate Object

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to vendor.supplier. Business justification: Extensions need direct supplier link for supplier scorecard metrics (extension approval rate, time-to-extend). While inherited from parent assignment, direct link enables supplier performance reportin
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: The business date on which the extension request was formally approved or rejected by the designated approver. Used for SLA measurement and approval cycle time reporting.
attributes.references: Bullhorn ATS/CRM Assignment Extension Workflow; ASA SLA Standards

attributes.name: bullhorn_extension_reference
attributes.description: The native record identifier assigned to this extension event in the Bullhorn ATS/CRM source system. Used for data lineage, reconciliation, and cross-system traceability between the lakehouse silver layer and the operational system of record.
attributes.references: Bullhorn ATS/CRM Assignment Extension Workflow; SOC 2 Type II Data Lineage

attributes.name: client_approver_email
attributes.description: Email address of the client-side manager or supervisor who authorized the extension. Used for extension confirmation communications and audit trail.
attributes.references: Bullhorn ATS/CRM; GDPR Article 4; CCPA

attributes.name: client_approver_name
attributes.description: Name of the client-side manager or supervisor who authorized the extension request. Captured as a denormalized field from the extension workflow for audit and reporting purposes.
attributes.references: Bullhorn ATS/CRM Assignment Extension Workflow; ASA Co-Employment Standards

attributes.name: conversion_eligible_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the worker becomes eligible for temp-to-perm conversion upon completion of the extended assignment period. Triggers conversion fee tracking and direct hire workflow.
attributes.references: ASA Temp-to-Perm Conversion Standards; IRS Worker Classification Rules; FLSA

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this extension record was first created in the system, in ISO 8601 format with timezone offset. Provides the audit trail entry point for the extension lifecycle.
attributes.references: SOC 2 Type II Audit Trail Requirements; GDPR Article 5 Data Integrity

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code applicable to the bill rate and pay rate fields on this extension record (e.g., USD, CAD, GBP). Supports multi-currency staffing operations.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; Oracle NetSuite ERP Multi-Currency

attributes.name: executed_date
attributes.description: The business date on which the approved extension was formally executed and the new end date was applied to the assignment record. Marks the completion of the extension lifecycle.
attributes.references: Bullhorn ATS/CRM Assignment Extension Workflow; DocuSign CLM Contract Execution

attributes.name: extension_duration_days
attributes.description: Number of calendar days added to the assignment by this extension event, calculated as new_end_date minus prior_end_date. Stored as a business field to support workforce planning and analytics without requiring date arithmetic at query time.
attributes.references: SIA Workforce Analytics Standards; ASA Staffing Operations Standards

attributes.name: extension_number
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier for this extension event, generated by the Bullhorn assignment extension workflow. Used for cross-system reference and client communication.
attributes.references: Bullhorn ATS/CRM Assignment Extension Workflow

attributes.name: extension_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized reason code categorizing why the assignment extension was requested. Supports analytics on extension drivers and workforce planning. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: project_continuation|headcount_backfill|client_request|worker_request|sow_extension|other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ASA Staffing Operations Standards; SIA Workforce Analytics Standards

attributes.name: extension_reason_notes
attributes.description: Free-text narrative providing additional context or justification for the extension beyond the standardized reason code. Captured from the client or staffing coordinator during the extension request workflow.
attributes.references: Bullhorn ATS/CRM Assignment Extension Workflow

attributes.name: extension_sequence_number
attributes.description: Ordinal position of this extension event within the full extension history of the assignment (e.g., 1 = first extension, 2 = second extension). Enables tracking of cumulative extensions per assignment for fall-off rate and redeployment analytics.
attributes.references: Bullhorn ATS/CRM Assignment Extension Workflow; SIA Workforce Analytics Standards

attributes.name: extension_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the extension request within the approval and execution workflow. Drives operational actions such as rate renegotiation, onboarding updates, and redeployment planning.
attributes.references: Bullhorn ATS/CRM Assignment Extension Workflow; ASA Staffing Operations Standards

attributes.name: fall_off_risk_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this extension event has been flagged as at risk of fall-off (early termination before the new end date). Supports fall-off rate monitoring and proactive account management.
attributes.references: ASA Fall-Off Rate Monitoring Standards; SIA KPI Benchmarks

attributes.name: msp_program_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this extension is managed under a Managed Service Provider (MSP) program, requiring VMS workflow compliance and additional approval routing.
attributes.references: Beeline VMS; ASA MSP Program Standards; SIA Contingent Workforce Standards

attributes.name: new_end_date
attributes.description: The revised assignment end date established by this extension event. Becomes the active end date on the parent assignment record upon execution. Drives redeployment planning and workforce scheduling.
attributes.references: Bullhorn ATS/CRM Assignment Extension Workflow; Kronos Workforce Ready Scheduling

attributes.name: prior_bill_rate
attributes.description: The hourly bill rate charged to the client that was in effect on the assignment immediately before this extension event. Stored for rate change audit and spread analysis.
attributes.references: Salesforce Revenue Cloud Rate Management; ASA Pricing Standards; FLSA Rate Documentation

attributes.name: prior_end_date
attributes.description: The assignment end date that was in effect immediately before this extension event was applied. Critical for auditing the extension history and calculating the duration of each extension increment.
attributes.references: Bullhorn ATS/CRM Placement Object; FLSA Assignment Duration Tracking

attributes.name: prior_pay_rate
attributes.description: The hourly pay rate paid to the worker that was in effect on the assignment immediately before this extension event. Stored for rate change audit and gross margin analysis.
attributes.references: TempWorks Payroll Rate Management; FLSA Pay Rate Documentation; IRS Worker Classification Rules

attributes.name: rate_change_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this extension event included a renegotiation of the bill rate or pay rate. True when either revised_bill_rate or revised_pay_rate differs from the prior rate. Enables quick filtering of rate-change extensions for financial impact analysis.
attributes.references: Salesforce Revenue Cloud; Beeline VMS Rate Management; ASA Pricing Standards

attributes.name: redeployment_candidate_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the worker has been flagged for redeployment planning as part of this extension review. True when the extension is not approved or when the new end date triggers a redeployment workflow.
attributes.references: ASA Redeployment Best Practices; SIA Workforce Planning Standards

attributes.name: rejection_reason
attributes.description: Free-text explanation provided by the approver when an extension request is rejected. Populated only when extension_status is 'rejected'. Supports process improvement and client communication.
attributes.references: Bullhorn ATS/CRM Assignment Extension Workflow; ASA Staffing Operations Standards

attributes.name: request_date
attributes.description: The business date on which the extension request was formally submitted by the client or staffing coordinator. Used to measure lead time and SLA compliance for extension processing.
attributes.references: Bullhorn ATS/CRM Assignment Extension Workflow; ASA SLA Standards

attributes.name: revised_bill_rate
attributes.description: The renegotiated hourly bill rate to be charged to the client effective upon execution of this extension. Null if the bill rate was not renegotiated as part of this extension event.
attributes.references: Salesforce Revenue Cloud Rate Management; Beeline VMS Rate Management; ASA Pricing Standards

attributes.name: revised_pay_rate
attributes.description: The renegotiated hourly pay rate to be paid to the worker effective upon execution of this extension. Null if the pay rate was not renegotiated as part of this extension event.
attributes.references: TempWorks Payroll Rate Management; FLSA Pay Rate Documentation; IRS Worker Classification Rules

attributes.name: spread_prior
attributes.business_glossary_term: Prior Spread (Bill Rate minus Pay Rate)
attributes.description: The gross spread (bill rate minus pay rate) in effect on the assignment before this extension event. Stored as a business field to support margin trend analysis across extension history without requiring rate arithmetic at query time.
attributes.references: ASA Gross Margin Standards; SIA Financial Analytics; Salesforce Revenue Cloud

attributes.name: spread_revised
attributes.business_glossary_term: Revised Spread (Bill Rate minus Pay Rate)
attributes.description: The gross spread (revised bill rate minus revised pay rate) applicable after this extension event. Null if no rate change occurred. Supports margin impact analysis for renegotiated extensions.
attributes.references: ASA Gross Margin Standards; SIA Financial Analytics; Salesforce Revenue Cloud

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this extension record was most recently modified, in ISO 8601 format with timezone offset. Supports incremental data loading, change detection, and audit compliance.
attributes.references: SOC 2 Type II Audit Trail Requirements; GDPR Article 5 Data Integrity

attributes.name: vms_req_number
attributes.description: The requisition or extension request number assigned by the client's Vendor Management System (VMS) such as Beeline. Required for MSP-managed programs to reconcile extension events between the staffing firm's ATS and the client's VMS.
attributes.references: Beeline VMS Contingent Workforce Program Management; ASA MSP/VMS Standards

attributes.name: work_location_type
attributes.description: Classification of the work arrangement for the extended assignment period. May differ from the original assignment if the extension includes a change in work modality.
attributes.references: DOL Remote Work Guidelines; FLSA; ASA Workforce Management Standards

attributes.name: worker_classification
attributes.description: Tax and employment classification of the worker on this assignment at the time of extension. Drives payroll processing, tax withholding, and co-employment compliance requirements.
attributes.references: IRS Worker Classification Rules; FLSA; DOL Joint Employment Standards; EEOC
