attributes.references: American Staffing Association (ASA); DocuSign CLM MSA Management

attributes.name: fee_amount
attributes.description: The gross conversion fee charged to the client for the temp-to-perm or contract-to-hire conversion. Typically calculated as a percentage of the converted worker's first-year annual salary or as a flat fee per the MSA. Critical for revenue recognition and billing in Salesforce Revenue Cloud and Oracle NetSuite ERP.
attributes.references: Salesforce Revenue Cloud; Oracle NetSuite ERP Revenue Recognition; American Staffing Association (ASA)

attributes.name: fee_basis_type
attributes.description: Indicates the method used to calculate the conversion fee. 'percentage_of_salary' = fee is a percentage of the converted worker's first-year annual salary; 'flat_fee' = fixed dollar amount per the MSA rate card; 'negotiated' = custom fee agreed upon for this specific conversion.
attributes.references: American Staffing Association (ASA); DocuSign CLM MSA Management

attributes.name: fee_currency
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the conversion fee amount (e.g., USD, CAD, GBP). Supports multi-currency operations for international staffing engagements.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; Oracle NetSuite ERP

attributes.name: fee_percentage
attributes.description: The percentage of the converted worker's first-year annual salary used to calculate the conversion fee, when fee_basis_type is 'percentage_of_salary'. Expressed as a decimal percentage (e.g., 15.00 = 15%). Null when fee_basis_type is 'flat_fee'.
attributes.references: American Staffing Association (ASA); DocuSign CLM MSA Management

attributes.name: fee_waiver_approved_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the internal approver (e.g., account manager, branch manager, or VP) who authorized the conversion fee waiver. Required for audit and revenue exception tracking.
attributes.references: SOC 2 Type II; American Staffing Association (ASA)

attributes.name: fee_waiver_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the conversion fee has been waived for this conversion event. True = fee waived; False = fee applies. Fee waivers may occur due to MSA terms, client relationship considerations, or minimum tenure provisions.
attributes.references: DocuSign CLM MSA Management; American Staffing Association (ASA)

attributes.name: fee_waiver_reason
attributes.description: The business reason for waiving the conversion fee when fee_waiver_flag is True. 'msa_tenure_clause' = worker met minimum tenure hours per MSA; 'client_relationship' = strategic client concession; 'negotiated_waiver' = pre-negotiated waiver in contract; 'minimum_hours_met' = minimum billable hours threshold reached; 'other' = other documented reason.
attributes.references: DocuSign CLM MSA Management; American Staffing Association (ASA)

attributes.name: guarantee_period_days
attributes.description: The number of days after the permanent start date during which the staffing agency guarantees the placement. If the converted worker leaves within this period, a replacement or fee credit may be owed per the MSA. Sourced from the applicable MSA terms.
attributes.references: DocuSign CLM MSA Management; American Staffing Association (ASA)

attributes.name: invoice_date
attributes.description: The date on which the conversion fee invoice was issued to the client. Used for accounts receivable aging and revenue recognition timing in Oracle NetSuite ERP.
attributes.references: Oracle NetSuite ERP Revenue Recognition; Salesforce Revenue Cloud

attributes.name: job_title
attributes.description: The job title of the permanent position the converted worker is being hired into at the client organization. May differ from the temporary assignment title and is used for workforce planning and conversion analytics.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Core HR; EEOC; OFCCP

attributes.name: minimum_tenure_hours
attributes.business_glossary_term: Minimum Tenure Hours for Fee Waiver
attributes.description: The minimum number of billable hours the temporary worker must have worked on the assignment before the conversion fee is waived per the MSA terms. Used to determine fee_waiver_flag eligibility when fee_waiver_reason is 'minimum_hours_met'.
attributes.references: DocuSign CLM MSA Management; American Staffing Association (ASA)

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for documenting additional context, special circumstances, or operational notes related to the conversion event. Examples include negotiation details, client-specific conditions, or exception handling notes.
attributes.references: Bullhorn ATS/CRM Placement Conversion Workflow

attributes.name: notice_date
attributes.description: The date on which the client formally notified the staffing agency of their intent to convert the temporary worker to a permanent employee. Used to calculate notice period compliance per the Master Service Agreement (MSA) terms.
attributes.references: DocuSign CLM MSA Management; American Staffing Association (ASA)

attributes.name: payment_due_date
attributes.description: The date by which the client is contractually required to remit payment for the conversion fee invoice, per the payment terms defined in the MSA.
attributes.references: Oracle NetSuite ERP Accounts Receivable; DocuSign CLM MSA Management

attributes.name: payment_received_date
attributes.description: The date on which payment for the conversion fee was received from the client. Used for cash application, revenue recognition, and accounts receivable reconciliation.
attributes.references: Oracle NetSuite ERP Accounts Receivable; Salesforce Revenue Cloud

attributes.name: permanent_start_date
attributes.description: The date on which the converted worker officially begins permanent employment with the client. May differ from conversion_date if there is a gap between conversion confirmation and the first day of permanent employment.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Core HR; American Staffing Association (ASA)

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Identifies the operational system of record from which this conversion record was sourced. Supports data lineage tracking and reconciliation in the Silver Layer lakehouse.
attributes.references: SOC 2 Type II; Bullhorn ATS/CRM

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this conversion record was last modified in the data platform. Used for change data capture (CDC), incremental processing, and audit trail compliance. Conforms to ISO 8601 format yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: SOC 2 Type II; GDPR Article 5; CCPA

products.name: assignment_status_history
products.description: Audit trail of all status transitions for a worker assignment throughout its lifecycle (e.g., offered → confirmed → active → extended → ended, or active → cancelled). Captures prior status, new status, transition timestamp, changed-by user, change reason code, and any associated notes. Enables SLA compliance tracking (TTF, TTS), fall-off rate analysis, and regulatory audit requirements. Supports Bullhorn status change event log.

attributes.name: assignment_status_history_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each assignment status history record. Primary key for this audit trail entity. Role: EVENT_LOG — append-only record of immutable status transition events for worker assignments.
attributes.references: ASA Data Governance Standards; Bullhorn ATS/CRM Audit Log

attributes.name: client_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the client account for which this assignment is being fulfilled. Denormalized to enable direct client-level SLA compliance and fall-off rate reporting without joining through the placement or job order records.
attributes.references: Bullhorn ATS/CRM Client Account Object; ASA Client Relationship Standards; SIA Client Analytics

attributes.name: order_header_id
attributes.description: Reference to the job order (requisition) associated with this assignment. Supports TTF (Time to Fill) and TTS (Time to Start) SLA tracking by linking status transitions back to the originating job order.
attributes.references: Bullhorn ATS/CRM Job Order Object; SIA Staffing Metrics Standards

attributes.name: primary_assignment_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent worker assignment record for which this status transition event was recorded. EVENT_SOURCE_REFERENCE — the assignment entity that emitted this status change event.
attributes.references: Bullhorn ATS/CRM Placement/Assignment Object; ASA Workforce Standards

attributes.name: primary_assignment_staff_profile_id
attributes.description: Reference to the internal user (recruiter, account manager, or system process) who triggered the status transition. Required for regulatory audit trails and SOC 2 Type II access control evidence.
attributes.references: SOC 2 Type II CC6.1; OFCCP Recordkeeping; Bullhorn ATS/CRM User Object

attributes.name: profile_id
attributes.description: Reference to the candidate (worker) whose assignment status changed. Enables candidate-level fall-off rate analysis, redeployment tracking, and SLA compliance reporting across all assignments for a given worker.
attributes.references: Bullhorn ATS/CRM Candidate Object; EEOC Recordkeeping Requirements

attributes.name: quaternary_assignment_approved_by_user_staff_profile_id
attributes.description: Reference to the user who formally approved this status transition when approval_required_flag is true. Null when no approval was required. Supports SOC 2 Type II segregation of duties and OFCCP audit trail requirements.
attributes.references: SOC 2 Type II CC6.1; OFCCP Recordkeeping; Bullhorn ATS/CRM Approval Workflow

attributes.name: tertiary_assignment_account_manager_staff_profile_id
attributes.description: Reference to the account manager responsible for the client relationship at the time of this status transition. Supports account manager-level SLA compliance and client satisfaction reporting.
attributes.references: Bullhorn ATS/CRM User/Account Manager Object; SIA Account Management KPI Standards

attributes.name: vms_program_id
attributes.description: Reference to the VMS (Vendor Management System) program under which this assignment operates, if applicable. Links to Beeline VMS program configuration for contingent workforce programs. Null for direct-client assignments not managed through a VMS.
attributes.references: Beeline VMS Program Management; ASA MSP/VMS Standards; SIA Contingent Workforce Standards

attributes.name: actual_transition_hours
attributes.description: The actual elapsed time in hours between the triggering business event and this status transition. Compared against sla_target_hours to determine SLA compliance. Supports TTF and TTS metric calculation in Power BI Analytics dashboards.
attributes.references: SIA TTF/TTS Metric Standards; ASA SLA Compliance; Power BI Analytics KPI Dashboards

attributes.name: approval_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this status transition required a formal approval step (e.g., client approval for an extension, manager approval for a conversion). Supports workflow compliance and audit trail requirements.
attributes.references: Bullhorn ATS/CRM Approval Workflow; Beeline VMS Approval Rules; SOC 2 Type II CC6.1

attributes.name: approval_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the status transition was formally approved by the approving user. Null when no approval was required. Used to measure approval cycle time for SLA compliance and process efficiency analytics.
attributes.references: SOC 2 Type II CC6.1; Bullhorn ATS/CRM Approval Workflow; ASA SLA Compliance

attributes.name: assignment_end_date
attributes.description: The scheduled or actual end date of the worker assignment at the time of this status transition. Captures the end date as it was known at the moment of the status change, supporting extension tracking and fall-off analysis.
attributes.references: ASA Assignment Lifecycle Standards; SIA Workforce Analytics; DOL FLSA Recordkeeping

attributes.name: change_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized reason code explaining why the status transition occurred. Drives fall-off rate analysis, redeployment eligibility, and regulatory reporting. Values: voluntary_resignation, client_termination, assignment_end, extension_approved, no_show, fall_off, conversion. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: voluntary_resignation|client_termination|assignment_end|extension_approved|no_show|fall_off|conversion|medical_leave|performance|background_check_fail — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ASA Fall-Off Rate Standards; SIA Workforce Analytics; DOL Separation Reason Codes; EEOC Recordkeeping

attributes.name: change_reason_description
attributes.description: Free-text narrative providing additional context for the status transition beyond the standardized change_reason_code. Captures recruiter or account manager notes entered at the time of the change. Supports regulatory audit and dispute resolution.
attributes.references: Bullhorn ATS/CRM Note/Comment Field; SOC 2 Type II Audit Trail; OFCCP Recordkeeping

attributes.name: client_contact_notified_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the client contact (hiring manager or program manager) was notified of this status transition. Critical for client relationship management and SLA compliance evidence, particularly for fall-off and cancellation events.
attributes.references: ASA Client Communication Standards; Bullhorn ATS/CRM Client Notification Log; SIA SLA Standards

attributes.name: compliance_hold_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this status transition was triggered by or resulted in a compliance hold — for example, a failed background check (BGC), incomplete I-9 verification, E-Verify mismatch, or missing credentialing. Links to compliance domain for regulatory audit.
attributes.references: FCRA Background Check Compliance; INA I-9 Compliance; E-Verify Program Requirements; OFCCP Recordkeeping; Sterling BGC Integration

attributes.name: compliance_hold_reason
attributes.description: Standardized reason code for a compliance hold when compliance_hold_flag is true. Values: bgc_pending (Background Check pending), bgc_failed, i9_incomplete (I-9 incomplete), everify_mismatch (E-Verify mismatch), credential_missing, drug_screen_pending, drug_screen_failed. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: bgc_pending|bgc_failed|i9_incomplete|everify_mismatch|credential_missing|drug_screen_pending|drug_screen_failed — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: FCRA; INA I-9 Compliance; E-Verify Program; OFCCP; Sterling BGC; ASA Compliance Standards

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: RECORD_AUDIT_CREATED — the date and time when this status history record was first captured in the data platform. Distinct from transition_timestamp (the business event time). Used for data pipeline monitoring and audit trail completeness verification.
attributes.references: SOC 2 Type II CC7.2; ASA Data Governance; GDPR Article 5 (Data Integrity); CCPA

attributes.name: days_in_prior_status
attributes.description: The number of calendar days the assignment spent in the prior_status before this transition. Calculated at ingestion time and stored for efficient SLA compliance analysis (e.g., how long an assignment was in 'offered' before 'confirmed'). Supports TTF and TTS KPI reporting.
attributes.references: SIA TTF/TTS Metric Standards; ASA SLA Compliance Reporting; Power BI Analytics KPI Dashboards

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The business-effective date on which the new status takes operational effect. May differ from transition_timestamp when a status change is backdated or future-dated (e.g., an extension approved today but effective next Monday).
attributes.references: ASA Assignment Lifecycle Standards; DOL FLSA Recordkeeping Requirements

attributes.name: is_backfill
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this assignment is a backfill — replacing a worker who left a position. Backfill assignments are tracked separately for workforce planning analytics and client relationship management reporting.
attributes.references: ASA Workforce Planning Standards; SIA Staffing Analytics; Bullhorn ATS/CRM Backfill Tracking

attributes.name: is_conversion
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this status transition represents a temp-to-perm or contract-to-hire conversion event, where the temporary worker is being converted to a permanent employee of the client. Triggers conversion fee billing processes.
attributes.references: ASA Temp-to-Perm Conversion Standards; SIA Conversion Rate KPI; Bullhorn ATS/CRM Conversion Tracking

attributes.name: is_extension
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this status transition represents an assignment extension event, where the original end date has been pushed forward. Extensions are a key revenue retention metric and trigger redeployment planning suppression.
attributes.references: ASA Assignment Extension Standards; SIA Revenue Analytics; Bullhorn ATS/CRM Extension Tracking

attributes.name: is_fall_off
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this status transition represents a fall-off event — a placement that ended prematurely before the originally scheduled end date. Fall-off rate is a critical KPI (Key Performance Indicator) for staffing firm quality and recruiter performance measurement.
attributes.references: SIA Fall-Off Rate KPI Standards; ASA Quality Metrics; Bullhorn ATS/CRM Fall-Off Tracking

attributes.name: is_redeployment_eligible
attributes.description: Flag set at the time of this status transition indicating whether the worker is eligible for redeployment to a new assignment. Drives bench management workflows and proactive candidate outreach to minimize bench time and maximize utilization.
attributes.references: ASA Redeployment Best Practices; SIA Bench Management Standards; Bullhorn ATS/CRM Redeployment Workflow

attributes.name: new_status
attributes.description: The assignment status value after this transition event. This is the EVENT_TYPE_OR_CHANNEL discriminator for the kind of status change. Common values include: offered, confirmed, active, on_hold, extended, ended, cancelled, no_show, fall_off. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: offered|confirmed|active|on_hold|extended|ended|cancelled|no_show|fall_off|pending_start — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Bullhorn ATS/CRM Assignment Status Codes; ASA Assignment Lifecycle Standards; SIA Staffing Metrics

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes field capturing any additional context, observations, or instructions associated with this status transition event. Mirrors the Bullhorn ATS/CRM note/comment field attached to status change events. Supports recruiter communication and audit trail documentation.
attributes.references: Bullhorn ATS/CRM Note Object; ASA Documentation Standards; SOC 2 Type II Audit Trail

attributes.name: notification_sent_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether automated notifications (to the candidate, client contact, or internal team) were triggered and sent as a result of this status transition. Supports communication audit trails and onboarding/offboarding workflow compliance.
attributes.references: Bullhorn ATS/CRM Automation Rules; ASA Onboarding/Offboarding Standards; SOC 2 Type II

attributes.name: placement_type
attributes.description: Classification of the placement type at the time of this status transition. Denormalized here to support efficient analytics without joining to the placement record. Values: temporary, contract_to_hire (CTH), temp_to_perm, direct_hire, sow (Statement of Work).
attributes.references: ASA Placement Classification Standards; SIA Staffing Industry Taxonomy; IRS Worker Classification Rules

attributes.name: prior_status
attributes.description: The assignment status value immediately before this transition event. Together with new_status, defines the state transition vector. Common values include: offered, confirmed, active, on_hold, extended, ended, cancelled, no_show, fall_off. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: offered|confirmed|active|on_hold|extended|ended|cancelled|no_show|fall_off|pending_start — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Bullhorn ATS/CRM Assignment Status Codes; ASA Assignment Lifecycle Standards; SIA Staffing Metrics

attributes.name: sequence_number
attributes.description: Monotonically increasing sequence number for status transitions within a single assignment, starting at 1 for the first transition. Enables ordered reconstruction of the full assignment status lifecycle and identification of the current (latest) status without relying on timestamp ordering alone.
attributes.references: Bullhorn ATS/CRM Status Change Event Log; ASA Assignment Lifecycle Standards; SIA Workforce Analytics

attributes.name: sla_breach_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this status transition occurred outside the agreed SLA (Service Level Agreement) window for the associated client program or VMS program. Enables SLA compliance tracking and client reporting for MSP/VMS programs managed through Beeline.
attributes.references: ASA SLA Standards; Beeline VMS SLA Compliance; SIA KPI Reporting; MSA SLA Terms

attributes.name: sla_target_hours
attributes.description: The SLA target response time in hours for this specific status transition type, as defined in the client's MSA (Master Service Agreement) or VMS program configuration. Used to evaluate whether sla_breach_flag should be set.
attributes.references: ASA SLA Standards; Beeline VMS SLA Configuration; MSA Contract Terms; SIA KPI Standards

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: The operational system of record that originated this status change event. Enables data lineage tracing and reconciliation across Bullhorn ATS/CRM, Beeline VMS, SAP SuccessFactors, TempWorks, and Kronos Workforce Ready.
attributes.references: SOC 2 Type II Data Lineage; ASA Data Governance; Bullhorn ATS/CRM Integration Standards

attributes.name: source_system_event_reference
attributes.description: The native event or record identifier from the originating source system (e.g., Bullhorn status change event ID, Beeline VMS transaction ID). Enables exact record traceability back to the system of record for audit and reconciliation purposes.
attributes.references: SOC 2 Type II CC7.2; Bullhorn ATS/CRM Audit Log; Beeline VMS Event Log

attributes.name: transition_source
attributes.description: Indicates how the status transition was initiated. Distinguishes between manual recruiter actions, automated system rules, VMS (Vendor Management System) sync events from Beeline, API integrations, or bulk update operations. Critical for data lineage and audit integrity.
attributes.references: SOC 2 Type II CC7.2; Bullhorn ATS/CRM Integration Log; Beeline VMS Sync Events

attributes.name: transition_timestamp
attributes.description: The exact date and time when the status transition occurred. EVENT_TIMESTAMP — the principal real-world event time for this status change. Used for TTS (Time to Start) and TTF (Time to Fill) SLA calculations and fall-off rate analysis.
attributes.references: Bullhorn ATS/CRM Status Change Event Log; SIA TTF/TTS Metric Standards; ASA SLA Compliance

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: RECORD_AUDIT_UPDATED — the date and time when this status history record was last modified in the data platform. While status history records are ideally immutable, corrections or enrichments may update this field. Supports data quality monitoring.
attributes.references: SOC 2 Type II CC7.2; ASA Data Governance; GDPR Article 5 (Data Integrity)

attributes.name: worker_type
attributes.description: Classification of the worker's employment arrangement at the time of this status transition. Values: w2_employee (W-2), 1099_contractor (independent contractor), corp_to_corp, eor (Employer of Record). Critical for IRS worker classification compliance and co-employment risk management.
attributes.references: IRS Worker Classification Rules (Rev. Rul. 87-41); DOL FLSA; ASA Co-Employment Guidelines; NAPEO EOR Standards

products.name: redeployment
products.description: Tracks redeployment events and pipeline management for workers coming off active assignments (bench management). Records the ending assignment reference, redeployment target date, redeployment status (bench, in-process, redeployed, separated), candidate availability date, preferred work type, preferred location, redeployment coordinator, days on bench, and outcome (redeployed to new assignment, converted, separated). Enables proactive bench management and reduces time-to-redeploy KPI. Sourced from Bullhorn redeployment workflow.

attributes.name: redeployment_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated identifier for each redeployment event record. Primary key for the redeployment data product within the placement domain. Entity role: TRANSACTION_HEADER — tracks a discrete lifecycle event of a worker transitioning off an assignment into the redeployment pipeline.
attributes.references: Bullhorn ATS/CRM Redeployment Workflow

attributes.name: bench_roster_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to placement.bench_roster. Business justification: Redeployment events often originate from bench roster entries when workers become available after assignment end. Linking redeployment to bench_roster enables tracking of bench-to-redeployment pipelin
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: order_header_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific job order (requisition) being pursued for this worker's redeployment. Null until a specific job order match is identified by the coordinator.
attributes.references: Bullhorn ATS/CRM Job Order Object

attributes.name: profile_id
attributes.description: Reference to the candidate (worker) who is entering the redeployment pipeline. Links to the candidate master record in the Candidate domain. Serves as the PARTY_REFERENCE required for TRANSACTION_HEADER role.
attributes.references: Bullhorn ATS/CRM Candidate Object

attributes.name: redeployment_assignment_id
attributes.description: Reference to the active or recently ended placement/assignment that triggered this redeployment event. Establishes the originating assignment context for bench management tracking.
attributes.references: Bullhorn ATS/CRM Placement Object

attributes.name: redeployment_client_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the client account associated with the ending assignment. Used to track which client the worker is departing from and to identify potential redeployment opportunities within the same client account.
attributes.references: Bullhorn ATS/CRM Client Object; Salesforce Revenue Cloud

attributes.name: staff_profile_id
attributes.description: Reference to the internal recruiter or staffing coordinator responsible for managing this redeployment event and driving the worker back to active placement.
attributes.references: Bullhorn ATS/CRM User Object; ASA Workforce Management Standards

attributes.name: submittal_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to recruitment.submittal. Business justification: Redeployment candidates reference original submittal for skills verification, client preference history, and prior RTR agreements. Essential for bench management and rapid redeployment to similar role
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to vendor.supplier. Business justification: Redeployment tracks original supplier for bench management, redeployment success rate metrics, and supplier obligation to assist in redeployment. Used in MSP programs where suppliers maintain responsi
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: target_client_client_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the client account being targeted for the worker's next placement during the redeployment process. Null until a specific client opportunity is identified.
attributes.references: Bullhorn ATS/CRM Client Object

attributes.name: target_placement_assignment_id
attributes.description: Reference to the new placement record created as the successful outcome of this redeployment event. Null until the worker is successfully redeployed to a new assignment.
attributes.references: Bullhorn ATS/CRM Placement Object

attributes.name: actual_redeploy_date
attributes.description: The date on which the worker was successfully placed on a new assignment or converted. Null until redeployment outcome is achieved. Used to calculate actual time-to-redeploy against the target.
attributes.references: Bullhorn ATS/CRM Placement Object; SIA Time-to-Redeploy KPI Standards

attributes.name: assignment_end_date
attributes.description: The actual or scheduled end date of the ending assignment that triggered this redeployment event. Used to calculate days on bench and drive proactive outreach timelines. Serves as the BUSINESS_EVENT_TIMESTAMP anchor for the redeployment lifecycle.
attributes.references: Bullhorn ATS/CRM Placement Object; FLSA Assignment Tracking

attributes.name: availability_date
attributes.description: The date on which the candidate becomes fully available for a new assignment. May differ from assignment_end_date due to notice periods, PTO, or contractual obligations. Critical input for redeployment scheduling and coordinator outreach.
attributes.references: Bullhorn ATS/CRM Candidate Availability; ASA Workforce Management Standards

attributes.name: bench_cost_risk
attributes.description: Estimated financial exposure (in pay_rate_currency) associated with the worker remaining on bench, calculated as the worker's pay rate multiplied by projected bench days. Stored as a point-in-time snapshot for financial risk reporting. Confidential financial data.
attributes.references: Oracle NetSuite ERP Financial Reporting; SIA Workforce Analytics; Power BI KPI Dashboards

attributes.name: conversion_fee
attributes.description: Fee charged to the client when a temporary worker is converted to a permanent hire (temp-to-perm conversion). Applicable when redeployment_type is 'temp_to_perm'. Confidential financial data tied to the MSA/contract terms.
attributes.references: Salesforce Revenue Cloud Billing; MSA Contract Terms; ASA Conversion Fee Standards

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this redeployment record was first created in the system. Serves as the RECORD_AUDIT_CREATED field for the TRANSACTION_HEADER role. Formatted as yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: SOC 2 Type II Audit Trail Requirements; GDPR Article 5 Data Integrity

attributes.name: interviews_count
attributes.description: Number of client interviews the worker attended during this redeployment event. Used to measure conversion rate from submittal to interview and assess redeployment pipeline health.
attributes.references: Bullhorn ATS/CRM Interview Tracking; SIA Workforce Analytics

attributes.name: is_backfill
attributes.description: Indicates whether this redeployment event is associated with a backfill scenario, where the worker is being redeployed to replace another departing worker at the same or different client site.
attributes.references: Bullhorn ATS/CRM Placement Backfill Tracking; ASA Workforce Management Standards

attributes.name: last_outreach_date
attributes.description: The most recent date on which the coordinator made contact or attempted contact with the worker regarding redeployment opportunities. Used to identify stale redeployment records requiring follow-up.
attributes.references: Bullhorn ATS/CRM Activity Tracking; ASA Bench Management Standards

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text coordinator notes capturing context, candidate preferences, client feedback, or special circumstances relevant to this redeployment event. Supports qualitative tracking alongside structured fields.
attributes.references: Bullhorn ATS/CRM Activity Notes

attributes.name: outcome
attributes.description: Final disposition of the redeployment event. 'redeployed' = placed on new assignment; 'converted' = temp-to-perm conversion; 'separated' = worker left the workforce pool; 'extended' = original assignment extended; 'declined' = worker declined available opportunities; 'no_show' = worker became unresponsive.
attributes.references: Bullhorn ATS/CRM Redeployment Workflow; ASA Fall-off Rate Standards; SIA Workforce Analytics

attributes.name: outreach_attempts
attributes.description: Count of coordinator contact attempts made to the worker during the redeployment process (calls, emails, texts). Used to measure engagement effort and trigger escalation workflows when thresholds are exceeded.
attributes.references: Bullhorn ATS/CRM Activity Tracking; ASA Bench Management Standards

attributes.name: pay_rate_currency
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the pay rate fields (e.g., USD). Supports multi-currency operations for international staffing engagements.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; IRS Worker Classification Rules

attributes.name: pay_rate_min
attributes.description: The minimum hourly or salary pay rate the worker is willing to accept for a new assignment. Used by coordinators to filter job orders and negotiate placements during redeployment. Confidential business data.
attributes.references: Bullhorn ATS/CRM Candidate Pay Expectations; FLSA Minimum Wage Standards

attributes.name: preferred_location
attributes.description: The worker's preferred geographic area or city/state for their next assignment. Free-text or structured location string used by coordinators to filter and match available job orders during redeployment outreach.
attributes.references: Bullhorn ATS/CRM Candidate Preferences

attributes.name: preferred_work_state
attributes.description: Two-letter US state code representing the worker's preferred state for redeployment. Used for geographic filtering in job order matching and workforce planning analytics.
attributes.references: USPS State Abbreviation Standard; Bullhorn ATS/CRM Candidate Preferences

attributes.name: preferred_work_type
attributes.description: The worker's stated preference for the type of engagement on their next assignment. Guides coordinator matching and job order targeting during the redeployment process.
attributes.references: Bullhorn ATS/CRM Candidate Preferences; ASA Workforce Management Standards

attributes.name: primary_skill
attributes.description: The worker's primary professional skill or job title used as the lead matching criterion during redeployment job order search. Sourced from the candidate profile in Bullhorn ATS.
attributes.references: Bullhorn ATS/CRM Candidate Skills Object; O*NET Occupational Classification

attributes.name: priority_level
attributes.description: Coordinator-assigned urgency level for this redeployment event. 'critical' = worker at risk of separation or has specialized skills in high demand; 'high' = near-term bench cost risk; 'medium' = standard pipeline; 'low' = worker has indicated flexibility or is not immediately available.
attributes.references: Bullhorn ATS/CRM Redeployment Workflow; ASA Bench Management Standards

attributes.name: redeployment_number
attributes.description: Externally-visible business identifier for this redeployment event, used in coordinator workflows, reporting, and communications. Format: RDP- followed by 7 digits. Serves as the BUSINESS_IDENTIFIER for the TRANSACTION_HEADER role.
attributes.references: Bullhorn ATS/CRM Redeployment Workflow; ASA Bench Management Standards

attributes.name: redeployment_source
attributes.description: Indicates how this redeployment record was created. 'bullhorn_workflow' = auto-generated by Bullhorn redeployment workflow trigger; 'manual_entry' = coordinator manually created; 'vms_notification' = triggered by Beeline VMS assignment end notification; 'coordinator_initiated' = proactive coordinator action; 'system_auto' = automated rule-based creation.
attributes.references: Bullhorn ATS/CRM Redeployment Workflow; Beeline VMS Integration

attributes.name: redeployment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the redeployment event. 'bench' = worker is unassigned and available; 'in_process' = active outreach and submittal activity underway; 'redeployed' = successfully placed on a new assignment; 'converted' = temp-to-perm conversion occurred; 'separated' = worker exited the workforce pool. Serves as the LIFECYCLE_STATUS for the TRANSACTION_HEADER role.
attributes.references: Bullhorn ATS/CRM Redeployment Workflow; ASA Staffing Industry Standards; SIA Workforce Analytics

attributes.name: redeployment_type
attributes.description: Classification of the redeployment pathway. 'internal_transfer' = moved to another assignment within same client; 'new_client' = placed with a different client; 'temp_to_perm' = converted to permanent hire; 'contract_extension' = existing assignment extended; 'reactivation' = previously separated worker re-engaged.
attributes.references: Bullhorn ATS/CRM Redeployment Workflow; ASA Workforce Management Standards

attributes.name: remote_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether the worker is eligible and willing to accept a fully remote or hybrid assignment. Used to expand redeployment matching to remote job orders.
attributes.references: Bullhorn ATS/CRM Candidate Preferences; ASA Workforce Management Standards

attributes.name: separation_reason
attributes.description: Reason code for why the worker separated from the workforce pool when redeployment_outcome is 'separated'. Used for fall-off rate analysis and workforce retention reporting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: voluntary_resignation|involuntary_termination|retirement|contract_end|declined_opportunities|no_response|other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: DOL Separation Reporting; EEOC Workforce Analytics; ASA Fall-off Rate Standards

attributes.name: skill_category
attributes.description: Broad occupational category grouping for the worker's primary skill (e.g., Information Technology, Healthcare, Light Industrial, Finance, Administrative). Used for workforce planning segmentation and bench analytics.
attributes.references: Bullhorn ATS/CRM Candidate Classification; O*NET SOC Codes; SIA Workforce Analytics

attributes.name: source_system_record_reference
attributes.description: The native identifier of this redeployment record in the originating source system (Bullhorn ATS/CRM). Enables traceability back to the operational system of record for reconciliation and lineage purposes.
attributes.references: Bullhorn ATS/CRM Redeployment Workflow; SOC 2 Type II Data Lineage

attributes.name: submittals_count
attributes.description: Number of candidate submittals made to client job orders during this redeployment event. Tracks the volume of active placement attempts and supports QoS (Quality of Submission) analytics.
attributes.references: Bullhorn ATS/CRM Submittal Object; SIA QoS Metrics

attributes.name: target_redeploy_date
attributes.description: The goal date by which the coordinator aims to have the worker placed on a new assignment. Used to measure time-to-redeploy KPI performance and drive urgency in the redeployment pipeline.
attributes.references: Bullhorn ATS/CRM Redeployment Workflow; SIA Time-to-Redeploy KPI Standards

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this redeployment record was last modified. Serves as the RECORD_AUDIT_UPDATED field for the TRANSACTION_HEADER role. Used for incremental data pipeline processing and audit trail compliance. Formatted as yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: SOC 2 Type II Audit Trail Requirements; GDPR Article 5 Data Integrity

attributes.name: willing_to_relocate
attributes.description: Indicates whether the worker is open to relocating for a new assignment beyond their preferred location. Expands the matching pool for coordinators when set to true.
attributes.references: Bullhorn ATS/CRM Candidate Preferences; ASA Workforce Management Standards

attributes.name: worker_classification
attributes.description: The tax and employment classification of the worker for the redeployment engagement. W-2 = employee on payroll; 1099 = independent contractor; C2C = corp-to-corp; EOR = employer of record arrangement. Drives payroll, tax, and compliance handling for the new assignment.
attributes.references: IRS Worker Classification Rules (Section 530); FLSA; DOL Independent Contractor Guidelines

products.name: backfill
products.description: Transactional record tracking backfill requests and fulfillment when a placed worker must be replaced on an active assignment due to early termination, no-show, client request, or injury. Records original assignment reference, backfill trigger reason, backfill request date, required fill date, backfill status (open, filled, cancelled), replacement assignment reference, and days-to-backfill metric. Drives client SLA compliance, fall-off rate monitoring, and recruiter workload prioritization. Sourced from Bullhorn assignment backfill workflow.

attributes.name: backfill_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated identifier for the backfill request record. Primary key for the backfill data product in the placement domain.
attributes.references: Bullhorn ATS/CRM - Assignment Backfill Workflow

attributes.name: backfill_original_assignment_id
attributes.description: Reference to the original placement assignment that triggered the backfill request. Links the backfill event to the specific assignment that ended prematurely or requires replacement.
attributes.references: Bullhorn ATS/CRM - Assignment Object

attributes.name: backfill_profile_id
attributes.description: Reference to the candidate or worker from the original assignment who is being replaced. Used for fall-off rate monitoring, redeployment tracking, and recruiter performance analysis.
attributes.references: Bullhorn ATS/CRM - Candidate Object

attributes.name: backfill_replacement_assignment_id
attributes.description: Reference to the new placement assignment created to fulfill the backfill request. Populated once a replacement worker has been placed and the backfill is resolved. Null if backfill is still open or cancelled.
attributes.references: Bullhorn ATS/CRM - Assignment Object

attributes.name: backfill_replacement_candidate_profile_id
attributes.description: Reference to the candidate placed as the replacement worker to fulfill the backfill. Populated once a suitable replacement has been identified and placed. Null if backfill is open or cancelled.
attributes.references: Bullhorn ATS/CRM - Candidate Object

attributes.name: client_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the client account at which the backfill position exists. Used for SLA compliance tracking, client relationship management, and fall-off rate reporting.
attributes.references: Bullhorn ATS/CRM - Client Account Object; ASA Staffing Industry Standards

attributes.name: order_header_id
attributes.description: Reference to the job order or requisition associated with the position requiring backfill. Used to link the backfill event to the originating client requirement and job details.
attributes.references: Bullhorn ATS/CRM - Job Order Object

attributes.name: osha_incident_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.osha_incident. Business justification: Backfill requests are frequently triggered by workplace injuries/OSHA recordable incidents. Business process: linking replacement staffing needs to safety incidents for root cause tracking, client sit
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: replacement_submittal_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to recruitment.submittal. Business justification: Backfill process tracks which submittal successfully filled replacement need for SLA compliance reporting, time-to-backfill metrics, and recruiter performance on urgent fills. Role-prefixed because or
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: staff_profile_id
attributes.description: Reference to the recruiter responsible for fulfilling the backfill request. Drives recruiter workload prioritization and performance measurement for backfill resolution speed.
attributes.references: Bullhorn ATS/CRM - User/Staff Object

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to vendor.supplier. Business justification: Backfill requests are routed to suppliers based on tier classification, allocation rules, and original supplier obligation. Tracks which supplier is responsible for filling the vacancy. Essential for
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: work_location_id
attributes.description: Reference to the client work location where the backfill position is based. Used for geographic workforce planning, dispatch coordination, and on-site supervisor notification.
attributes.references: client.location; Bullhorn ATS/CRM - Location Object

attributes.name: backfill_number
attributes.description: Externally-visible, human-readable business identifier for the backfill request. Used in client communications, SLA reporting, and recruiter workflow queues. Sourced from Bullhorn backfill workflow numbering.
attributes.references: Bullhorn ATS/CRM - Assignment Backfill Workflow

attributes.name: backfill_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the backfill request. 'open' indicates active search for replacement; 'filled' indicates a replacement has been placed; 'cancelled' indicates the position was not refilled; 'on_hold' indicates temporarily paused; 'escalated' indicates elevated priority due to SLA risk.
attributes.references: Bullhorn ATS/CRM - Assignment Backfill Workflow; ASA Staffing Industry Standards

attributes.name: bill_rate
attributes.description: The hourly or unit bill rate charged to the client for the backfill position. Captured at the time of the backfill request to preserve the rate context for the replacement assignment and financial continuity analysis.
attributes.references: Bullhorn ATS/CRM - Placement Rate Object; Salesforce Revenue Cloud; ASA Pricing Standards

attributes.name: cancelled_date
attributes.description: The date on which the backfill request was cancelled, indicating the client no longer requires a replacement worker for this position. Null if backfill was filled or remains open.
attributes.references: Bullhorn ATS/CRM - Assignment Backfill Workflow

attributes.name: client_supervisor_name
attributes.description: Name of the client-side supervisor or hiring manager responsible for the position requiring backfill. Used for direct communication during the backfill process and for on-site coordination of the replacement worker.
attributes.references: Bullhorn ATS/CRM - Contact Object; GDPR Article 4; CCPA

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the backfill record was first created in the system. Serves as the audit trail creation marker and is used for data lineage, compliance reporting, and SLA measurement baseline.
attributes.references: SOC 2 Type II Audit Trail Requirements; GDPR Article 5 - Data Integrity

attributes.name: days_to_backfill
attributes.description: The number of calendar days elapsed between the backfill request_date and the filled_date. Key operational metric for measuring recruiter responsiveness, SLA compliance, and client service quality. Populated only when backfill_status is 'filled'.
attributes.references: Bullhorn ATS/CRM - Assignment Backfill Workflow; ASA KPI Standards; SIA Workforce Analytics

attributes.name: department
attributes.description: The client's internal department or cost center where the backfill position is assigned. Used for client billing allocation, workforce planning, and headcount reporting.
attributes.references: Bullhorn ATS/CRM - Job Order Object; Oracle NetSuite ERP - Cost Center

attributes.name: escalation_date
attributes.description: The date on which the backfill request was escalated to senior management or account management. Populated only when escalation_flag is True. Used to measure escalation response time and SLA risk management effectiveness.
attributes.references: Bullhorn ATS/CRM - Assignment Backfill Workflow; ASA SLA Standards

attributes.name: escalation_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this backfill request has been escalated to senior management or account management due to SLA risk, client dissatisfaction, or inability to fill within the required timeframe. Triggers escalation workflow notifications.
attributes.references: Bullhorn ATS/CRM - Assignment Backfill Workflow; ASA SLA Standards

attributes.name: fall_off_reason_category
attributes.description: High-level categorization of the root cause for the fall-off event associated with this backfill. Used for recruiter quality analysis, process improvement, and ASA fall-off rate benchmarking. Populated only when is_fall_off is True.
attributes.references: ASA Fall-Off Rate Standards; SIA KPI Benchmarks; Bullhorn ATS/CRM

attributes.name: filled_date
attributes.description: The date on which the backfill request was successfully fulfilled by placing a replacement worker. Used to calculate days-to-backfill and assess SLA compliance against the required_fill_date. Null if backfill is still open or was cancelled.
attributes.references: Bullhorn ATS/CRM - Assignment Backfill Workflow; ASA SLA Standards

attributes.name: is_fall_off
attributes.description: Indicates whether the original assignment termination that triggered this backfill is classified as a fall-off event for recruiter performance and quality metrics. True if the assignment ended before the agreed minimum tenure threshold, contributing to the fall-off rate KPI.
attributes.references: Bullhorn ATS/CRM - Assignment Backfill Workflow; ASA Fall-Off Rate Standards; SIA KPI Benchmarks

attributes.name: is_redeployment_candidate
attributes.description: Indicates whether the original worker from the terminated assignment has been flagged as a candidate for redeployment to another open assignment. Supports bench management and redeployment workflow prioritization.
attributes.references: Bullhorn ATS/CRM - Candidate Redeployment Workflow; ASA Workforce Management Standards

attributes.name: job_title
attributes.description: The job title or position title for the role requiring backfill. Captured directly on the backfill record to preserve the position context at the time of the backfill event, independent of any subsequent job order changes.
attributes.references: Bullhorn ATS/CRM - Job Order Object; DOL FLSA Job Classification Standards

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for recruiter or account manager notes related to the backfill request, including candidate search progress, client communication summaries, and any special requirements for the replacement worker.
attributes.references: Bullhorn ATS/CRM - Assignment Backfill Workflow

attributes.name: original_assignment_end_date
attributes.description: The actual date the original worker's assignment ended, triggering the backfill need. May differ from the originally scheduled assignment end date in cases of early termination, no-show, or injury.
attributes.references: Bullhorn ATS/CRM - Assignment Object; ASA Staffing Industry Standards

attributes.name: pay_rate
attributes.description: The hourly or unit pay rate for the worker filling the backfill position. Captured at the time of the backfill request to support payroll continuity and spread/margin analysis for the replacement assignment.
attributes.references: Bullhorn ATS/CRM - Placement Rate Object; TempWorks Payroll; DOL FLSA Wage Standards

attributes.name: placement_type
attributes.description: The type of placement associated with the original assignment requiring backfill. Determines the nature of the replacement search and applicable fee structures. Aligns with the placement domain's assignment classification.
attributes.references: Bullhorn ATS/CRM - Placement Object; ASA Staffing Industry Standards

attributes.name: priority_level
attributes.description: Business-assigned urgency level for the backfill request, used to prioritize recruiter workload and resource allocation. 'critical' indicates immediate client impact or contractual penalty risk; 'high' indicates SLA risk within 24-48 hours; 'medium' and 'low' indicate standard processing timelines.
attributes.references: Bullhorn ATS/CRM - Assignment Backfill Workflow; ASA SLA Standards

attributes.name: rate_currency
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code applicable to the bill_rate and pay_rate fields for this backfill record. Supports multi-currency operations for international staffing engagements.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; Oracle NetSuite ERP - Multi-Currency

attributes.name: request_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the backfill request was formally initiated, typically when the original assignment termination was confirmed. Used as the start point for days-to-backfill metric calculation and SLA compliance measurement.
attributes.references: Bullhorn ATS/CRM - Assignment Backfill Workflow; ASA SLA Standards

attributes.name: required_fill_date
attributes.description: The target date by which the client requires the replacement worker to be on-site and active. Drives SLA compliance tracking and recruiter urgency prioritization. Typically negotiated with the client at time of backfill request.
attributes.references: Bullhorn ATS/CRM - Assignment Backfill Workflow; client.sla_measurement; ASA SLA Standards

attributes.name: sla_met
attributes.description: Indicates whether the backfill was fulfilled within the contractually agreed SLA target days. True if filled_date is on or before required_fill_date and within sla_target_days; False otherwise. Null if backfill is still open or was cancelled.
attributes.references: client.sla_measurement; ASA SLA Standards; SIA KPI Benchmarks

attributes.name: sla_target_days
attributes.description: The contractually agreed maximum number of days within which the backfill must be fulfilled per the client's Master Service Agreement (MSA) or SLA terms. Used to determine whether the backfill was completed within SLA compliance thresholds.
attributes.references: client.sla_measurement; DocuSign CLM - MSA Object; ASA SLA Standards

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: The operational system of record from which this backfill record originated. Primarily Bullhorn ATS/CRM for standard backfill workflows, Beeline VMS for client-initiated VMS backfill requests, or manual for records entered outside automated workflows.
attributes.references: Bullhorn ATS/CRM; Beeline VMS; ASA Data Governance Standards

attributes.name: source_system_backfill_reference
attributes.description: The native identifier for this backfill record in the originating operational system (e.g., Bullhorn internal backfill record ID). Supports data lineage, reconciliation, and cross-system traceability between the Silver layer and the system of record.
attributes.references: Bullhorn ATS/CRM - Assignment Backfill Workflow; SOC 2 Type II Data Lineage

attributes.name: trigger_detail
attributes.description: Free-text narrative providing additional context about the specific reason the original assignment ended and the backfill was initiated. Supplements the structured trigger_reason field with qualitative detail for recruiter and account manager review.
attributes.references: Bullhorn ATS/CRM - Assignment Backfill Workflow

attributes.name: trigger_reason
attributes.description: The business reason that caused the original assignment to end and necessitated the backfill request. Drives fall-off rate categorization, SLA compliance analysis, and recruiter quality metrics. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: early_termination|no_show|client_request|injury|job_abandonment|performance|other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Bullhorn ATS/CRM - Assignment Backfill Workflow; ASA Fall-Off Rate Standards; OSHA Injury Reporting

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the backfill record was most recently modified. Used for change tracking, data synchronization between source systems and the Silver layer, and audit compliance.
attributes.references: SOC 2 Type II Audit Trail Requirements; GDPR Article 5 - Data Integrity

attributes.name: vms_req_number
attributes.description: The requisition or work order number assigned by the client's Vendor Management System (VMS) for the backfill position. Required for VMS-managed programs to track the backfill through the client's procurement workflow in systems such as Beeline.
attributes.references: Beeline VMS - Requisition Object; ASA VMS Program Standards

products.name: rate
products.description: Master record for all negotiated rate components associated with a specific assignment or direct hire placement. Each rate record represents a single rate type — standard bill/pay rate, overtime (OT), double-time (DT), holiday, per diem (travel, lodging, meals, incidentals), or burden rate. Tracks effective date, expiration date, rate type, bill rate amount, pay rate amount, spread amount, markup percentage, gross margin percentage, burden rate, workers comp rate, IRS GSA rate reference (for per diem), taxable flag, reimbursement method, per diem daily allowance, per diem budget cap, rate approval status, and rate card source. Serves as the SSOT for all placement-level rate and per diem data feeding payroll and billing domains. Per diem rate types include travel, lodging, meals, and incidentals with IRS GSA compliance tracking. Sourced from Bullhorn rate card, Beeline VMS rate management, and TempWorks Payroll per diem configuration.

attributes.name: rate_id
attributes.description: Primary key for rate

attributes.name: assignment_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent placement or assignment record to which this rate applies. Links the rate to its associated job order and candidate assignment.
attributes.references: Bullhorn ATS/CRM Placement Object

attributes.name: client_rate_card_id
attributes.description: Reference to the client rate card from which this rate was sourced or negotiated. Links to the client.rate_card product for traceability of rate card origin.
attributes.references: Beeline VMS Rate Management; Bullhorn ATS/CRM Rate Card

attributes.name: direct_hire_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to placement.direct_hire. Business justification: Rate records need to support direct hire placements in addition to temporary assignments. The rate table currently only links to assignment via assignment_id, but direct hire placements also have nego
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: sow_engagement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to placement.sow_engagement. Business justification: Rate records need to support SOW-based engagements. SOW placements have distinct billing structures (milestone billing, deliverable-based rates) that differ from standard temp assignments. Adding sow_
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: vendor_rate_card_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to vendor.vendor_rate_card. Business justification: Placement rates reference negotiated vendor rate cards for bill/pay rate determination and markup validation. Ensures rate compliance with MSA terms and vendor agreements. Critical for rate card enfor
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Current workflow approval state of this rate record. Rates must be approved before feeding payroll and billing processes. Pending indicates awaiting review; approved indicates authorized for use; rejected indicates declined; expired indicates the approval window has lapsed.
attributes.references: Internal Rate Governance Policy; Beeline VMS Rate Management

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: The name or identifier of the individual or role who approved this rate record. Supports audit trail requirements for rate governance and compliance with client SLA and MSA terms.
attributes.references: Internal Rate Governance Policy; SOC 2 Type II Audit Controls; Beeline VMS

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this rate record was formally approved. Provides a precise audit trail event for rate governance, compliance reporting, and SLA tracking.
attributes.references: SOC 2 Type II Audit Controls; Internal Rate Governance Policy

attributes.name: bill_rate
attributes.description: The hourly or unit rate charged to the client for the worker's services. Represents the client-facing price component used in invoicing and revenue recognition. Expressed in the applicable currency unit.
attributes.references: Salesforce Revenue Cloud Billing; Bullhorn ATS/CRM; ASA Bill Rate Standards

attributes.name: burden_rate
attributes.description: The total employer-side cost loading rate applied on top of the pay rate, expressed as a decimal percentage. Encompasses FICA, FUTA, SUTA, workers compensation, and benefits costs. Used in true cost-of-labor calculations.
attributes.references: IRS FICA Regulations; FUTA (Federal Unemployment Tax Act); SUTA (State Unemployment Tax Act); TempWorks Payroll

attributes.name: conversion_fee
attributes.description: The one-time fee charged to the client when a temporary or contract-to-hire worker is converted to a permanent employee. Defined in the client MSA and applicable only for temp-to-perm placement types.
attributes.references: DocuSign CLM MSA Management; ASA Temp-to-Perm Conversion Standards; Salesforce Revenue Cloud

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this rate record was first created in the system. Provides the foundational audit trail entry for data lineage, compliance, and record lifecycle tracking.
attributes.references: SOC 2 Type II Audit Controls; GDPR Article 5 (Data Integrity); CCPA

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code applicable to all monetary rate fields in this record (e.g., USD, CAD). Supports multi-currency operations for international staffing engagements.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; Oracle NetSuite ERP General Ledger

attributes.name: direct_hire_fee_percentage
attributes.description: The percentage of the placed candidate's first-year annual salary charged as the direct hire placement fee. Applicable only for direct hire and permanent placement engagements. Defined in the client MSA.
attributes.references: DocuSign CLM MSA Management; ASA Direct Placement Fee Standards; Salesforce Revenue Cloud

attributes.name: dt_bill_rate
attributes.description: The hourly bill rate charged to the client for double-time hours, typically applicable on holidays or after extended daily thresholds per client contract or state law. Used in client invoicing for DT hours.
attributes.references: FLSA (Fair Labor Standards Act); State Labor Laws; Bullhorn ATS/CRM

attributes.name: dt_pay_rate
attributes.description: The hourly pay rate for double-time hours, typically 2x the regular pay rate. Applicable per client contract terms or state-mandated double-time rules. Used in payroll processing for DT-eligible hours.
attributes.references: FLSA (Fair Labor Standards Act); State Labor Laws; TempWorks Payroll

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date on which this rate record becomes active and applicable to payroll and billing calculations. Marks the start of the rate's binding period for the associated placement.
attributes.references: FLSA (Fair Labor Standards Act); ASA Staffing Industry Standards

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: The date on which this rate record ceases to be applicable. Null indicates an open-ended rate with no defined end. Used to manage rate versioning, extensions, and contract renewals.
attributes.references: Bullhorn ATS/CRM; Beeline VMS Rate Management

attributes.name: gross_margin_percentage
attributes.description: The gross margin expressed as a percentage of the bill rate, calculated as (Spread / Bill Rate). Represents the profitability ratio for this rate record and is a primary KPI for financial reporting and account management.
attributes.references: ASA Staffing Industry Financial Standards; Staffing Industry Analysts (SIA); Oracle NetSuite ERP Revenue Recognition

attributes.name: gsa_rate_reference
attributes.business_glossary_term: IRS GSA (General Services Administration) Rate Reference
attributes.description: The IRS General Services Administration (GSA) per diem rate reference code or location identifier used to validate per diem allowances against federally published rates. Applicable for per_diem rate types to ensure IRS compliance.
attributes.references: IRS GSA Per Diem Rate Schedule; IRS Publication 463; OFCCP Compliance

attributes.name: holiday_bill_rate
attributes.description: The hourly bill rate charged to the client for hours worked on designated holidays. Defined in the client MSA or SOW and used in holiday billing calculations.
attributes.references: DocuSign CLM MSA Management; Bullhorn ATS/CRM; Salesforce Revenue Cloud

attributes.name: holiday_pay_rate
attributes.description: The hourly pay rate for hours worked on designated holidays. Defined in the worker's assignment terms and used in payroll processing for holiday-worked hours.
attributes.references: FLSA (Fair Labor Standards Act); TempWorks Payroll; ASA Holiday Pay Guidelines

attributes.name: is_active
attributes.description: Indicates whether this rate record is currently active and eligible for use in payroll and billing calculations. A rate may be inactive due to expiration, supersession by a newer rate version, or manual deactivation.
attributes.references: Bullhorn ATS/CRM; Beeline VMS Rate Management; Internal Data Governance Standard

attributes.name: is_taxable
attributes.description: Indicates whether this rate or per diem allowance is subject to federal and state income tax withholding. Per diem amounts at or below GSA rates are typically non-taxable; amounts exceeding GSA rates are taxable as wages.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 463; IRS GSA Per Diem Rate Schedule; FICA Regulations; TempWorks Payroll Tax Filing

attributes.name: job_classification_code
attributes.description: The occupational classification code (e.g., DOL SOC code or client-defined job category code) associated with this rate. Drives workers compensation rate assignment, FLSA exemption status, and rate card categorization.
attributes.references: DOL Standard Occupational Classification (SOC); FLSA (Fair Labor Standards Act); OSHA; TempWorks Payroll

attributes.name: markup_percentage
attributes.description: The percentage markup applied over the pay rate to derive the bill rate, expressed as a decimal percentage (e.g., 0.35 = 35%). Used in rate negotiations, client proposals, and margin analysis reporting.
attributes.references: ASA Staffing Industry Financial Standards; Staffing Industry Analysts (SIA)

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for capturing additional context, negotiation history, special conditions, or exceptions associated with this rate record. Used by account managers and recruiters to document rate-specific business decisions.
attributes.references: Bullhorn ATS/CRM; Internal Data Governance Standard

attributes.name: ot_bill_rate
attributes.description: The hourly bill rate charged to the client for overtime hours worked beyond the standard threshold (typically 40 hours/week under FLSA). Distinct from the standard bill rate to support accurate client invoicing for OT hours.
attributes.references: FLSA (Fair Labor Standards Act); Bullhorn ATS/CRM; Salesforce Revenue Cloud

attributes.name: ot_pay_rate
attributes.description: The hourly pay rate for overtime hours, required to be at least 1.5x the regular pay rate under FLSA. Used in payroll processing for hours exceeding the standard weekly threshold.
attributes.references: FLSA (Fair Labor Standards Act); DOL Wage and Hour Division; TempWorks Payroll

attributes.name: pay_rate
attributes.description: The hourly or unit rate paid to the worker for services rendered. Represents the worker-facing compensation component used in payroll processing. Must comply with applicable minimum wage laws under FLSA.
attributes.references: FLSA (Fair Labor Standards Act); TempWorks Payroll; DOL Wage and Hour Division

attributes.name: per_diem_budget_cap
attributes.description: The maximum total per diem budget authorized for this rate record over the assignment period. Used to enforce spending controls and flag overages in per diem reimbursement processing.
attributes.references: IRS GSA Per Diem Rate Schedule; Internal Per Diem Policy; TempWorks Payroll

attributes.name: per_diem_category
attributes.description: Sub-classification of per diem rate type indicating the specific allowance category. Applicable only when rate_type = 'per_diem'. Aligns with IRS GSA per diem schedule categories for tax compliance and reimbursement tracking.
attributes.references: IRS GSA Per Diem Rate Schedule; IRS Publication 463; TempWorks Payroll Per Diem Configuration

attributes.name: per_diem_daily_allowance
attributes.description: The approved daily monetary allowance for the per diem category (travel, lodging, meals, or incidentals). Represents the maximum reimbursable or taxable daily amount for the applicable per diem category.
attributes.references: IRS GSA Per Diem Rate Schedule; IRS Publication 463; TempWorks Payroll Per Diem Configuration

attributes.name: placement_type

attributes.name: client_approved_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the client has formally approved the per diem arrangement as part of the MSA or SOW terms. Required for billable per diem pass-through arrangements and VMS program compliance.
attributes.references: MSA; SOW; Beeline VMS; ASA Best Practices

attributes.name: client_bill_rate
attributes.description: The daily per diem rate billed to the client when billable_to_client_flag is true. May differ from the worker daily_rate due to markup or administrative fee. Expressed in currency_code.
attributes.references: Salesforce Revenue Cloud; MSA; Rate Card

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the per diem arrangement record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail, data lineage, and SOC 2 compliance requirements.
attributes.references: SOC 2 Type II; GDPR Article 5; CCPA

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the per diem daily rate and budget amounts. Typically USD for domestic U.S. placements; may differ for international assignments.

attributes.name: daily_rate
attributes.description: The monetary amount paid or reimbursed to the worker per calendar day for this per diem type. Expressed in the currency defined by currency_code. Must not exceed applicable IRS GSA locality rate to maintain non-taxable status.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 463; GSA Federal Travel Regulation (FTR); FLSA; TempWorks Payroll

attributes.name: distance_from_home_miles
attributes.description: The calculated distance in miles between the worker's tax home and the work location. Used to validate per diem eligibility — IRS generally requires the work location to be far enough from the worker's tax home to require overnight lodging.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 463; DOL

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date on which the per diem allowance arrangement becomes active and eligible for payroll inclusion or expense reimbursement. Must align with or follow the assignment start date.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 463; GSA Federal Travel Regulation (FTR); TempWorks Payroll

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: The date on which the per diem arrangement ceases to be valid. Typically aligned with the assignment end date or extension date. Null indicates open-ended arrangement tied to assignment duration.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 463; GSA Federal Travel Regulation (FTR); TempWorks Payroll

attributes.name: first_payment_date
attributes.description: The date on which the first per diem payment was or is scheduled to be made to the worker. Used for payroll scheduling, cash flow forecasting, and worker communication.
