attributes.name: gsa_locality_rate
attributes.description: The IRS General Services Administration (GSA) published maximum per diem rate for the work location's locality and per diem type for the applicable fiscal year. Used as the compliance ceiling to determine taxable vs. non-taxable treatment of the allowance.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 463; GSA Federal Travel Regulation (FTR) 41 CFR Chapter 301

attributes.name: gsa_location_code
attributes.description: The GSA-assigned location code or city/county identifier used to look up the applicable per diem locality rate for the work site. Enables automated rate validation against the GSA rate table.
attributes.references: GSA Federal Travel Regulation (FTR) 41 CFR Chapter 301; IRS Publication 463

attributes.name: gsa_rate_year
attributes.description: The GSA fiscal year (October–September) for which the referenced GSA locality rate applies. Required for annual rate reconciliation and IRS compliance audits.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 463; GSA Federal Travel Regulation (FTR)

attributes.name: last_payment_date
attributes.description: The date on which the most recent per diem payment was made to the worker. Used for payment tracking, reconciliation, and identifying gaps in per diem disbursement.
attributes.references: TempWorks Payroll; DOL Wage and Hour Division

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional context, special conditions, exceptions, or operational notes related to the per diem arrangement. May include client-specific requirements, IRS exception documentation, or recruiter comments.
attributes.references: TempWorks Payroll; Bullhorn ATS/CRM

attributes.name: overnight_stay_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the assignment requires the worker to stay overnight away from their tax home, which is a prerequisite for non-taxable per diem treatment under IRS rules. Drives lodging and M&IE per diem eligibility.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 463; IRS Revenue Procedure 2019-48

attributes.name: pay_frequency
attributes.description: The frequency at which the per diem allowance is paid to the worker. Typically aligns with the payroll cycle but may differ for expense-based reimbursements processed per occurrence.
attributes.references: TempWorks Payroll; FLSA; DOL Wage and Hour Division

attributes.name: per_diem_number
attributes.description: Human-readable, externally referenceable business identifier for the per diem arrangement, used in payroll configuration, expense reporting, and client billing communications. Sourced from TempWorks Payroll per diem configuration.
attributes.references: TempWorks Payroll; IRS Publication 463

attributes.name: per_diem_type
attributes.description: Classification of the per diem allowance category as defined by IRS GSA guidelines. Travel covers transportation costs; lodging covers accommodation; meals covers food expenses; incidentals covers tips and minor expenses; meals_and_incidentals (M&IE) is the combined GSA rate category.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 463; GSA Federal Travel Regulation (FTR); U.S. Department of Labor (DOL)

attributes.name: reimbursement_method
attributes.description: The mechanism by which the per diem allowance is delivered to the worker. Payroll_included means the amount is added to the regular paycheck; separate_expense means it is processed as a standalone expense reimbursement; direct_deposit means a separate ACH payment; client_billed means the client reimburses the staffing firm directly.
attributes.references: TempWorks Payroll; IRS Publication 463; ASA Best Practices

attributes.name: taxable_amount
attributes.description: The portion of the daily per diem rate that exceeds the GSA locality rate and is therefore subject to income tax withholding and payroll taxes. Calculated as daily_rate minus gsa_locality_rate when taxable_flag is true; zero otherwise.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 463; IRS Revenue Procedure 2019-48; FICA; TempWorks Payroll

attributes.name: taxable_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the per diem allowance is subject to federal and state income tax withholding. True when the daily rate exceeds the applicable GSA locality rate or when the worker does not maintain a tax home away from the work location. Drives payroll tax treatment in TempWorks.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 463; IRS Revenue Procedure 2019-48; FICA; FUTA; SUTA; TempWorks Payroll

attributes.name: tempworks_per_diem_reference
attributes.description: The source system identifier for this per diem record in TempWorks Payroll per diem configuration module. Used for data lineage, reconciliation, and integration with payroll processing.
attributes.references: TempWorks Payroll

attributes.name: total_budget
attributes.description: The maximum total monetary amount authorized for this per diem arrangement over the full effective period of the assignment. Used for budget tracking, client billing caps, and financial forecasting. Expressed in currency_code.
attributes.references: TempWorks Payroll; Salesforce Revenue Cloud; Oracle NetSuite ERP

attributes.name: total_days_eligible
attributes.description: The total number of calendar or working days for which the worker is eligible to receive per diem under this arrangement, based on the effective and expiration dates and any exclusion rules (weekends, holidays, non-working days).
attributes.references: IRS Publication 463; TempWorks Payroll; GSA Federal Travel Regulation (FTR)

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the per diem arrangement record was most recently modified. Used for change tracking, incremental data loads, and audit compliance.
attributes.references: SOC 2 Type II; GDPR Article 5; CCPA

attributes.name: vms_req_number
attributes.description: The requisition or program identifier from the client's Vendor Management System (VMS) associated with this per diem arrangement. Required for MSP/VMS-managed programs where per diem must be tracked against the VMS requisition.
attributes.references: Beeline VMS; ASA Best Practices

attributes.name: weekend_eligible_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the worker is eligible to receive per diem on weekend days when not actively working. Relevant for lodging and incidental per diem where the worker remains at the remote location over weekends.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 463; GSA Federal Travel Regulation (FTR); TempWorks Payroll

attributes.name: worker_home_zip
attributes.description: The worker's permanent home ZIP code used to determine tax home status and eligibility for non-taxable per diem treatment. Required for IRS compliance when the work location is away from the worker's tax home.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 463; IRS Revenue Procedure 2019-48; CCPA; GDPR Article 4

products.name: assignment_compliance
products.description: This association product represents the compliance fulfillment relationship between a worker assignment and a regulatory or client-specific compliance requirement. It captures the operational tracking of which requirements must be satisfied for each assignment, the completion status, verification methods, and re-verification schedules. Each record links one assignment to one compliance requirement with attributes that exist only in the context of this specific assignment-requirement pairing, enabling the business to enforce compliance gates, track waivers, and manage re-verification workflows.. Existence Justification: In staffing operations, each worker assignment must satisfy multiple compliance requirements (I-9 employment eligibility, background checks, drug screens, client-specific credentials, industry certifications, training mandates). Simultaneously, each compliance requirement applies to many assignments across different workers, clients, and time periods. The business actively manages the fulfillment status of each assignment-requirement pairing, tracking completion dates, verification methods, waivers, expiration dates, and re-verification schedules as operational data that belongs to neither the assignment nor the requirement alone.

attributes.name: assignment_compliance_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each assignment-compliance requirement fulfillment record

attributes.name: assignment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the worker assignment record that must satisfy this compliance requirement
attributes.references: Internal - M:N Association FK

attributes.name: compliance_requirement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key to compliance.compliance_requirement.compliance_requirement_id

attributes.name: requirement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the specific compliance requirement that must be fulfilled for this assignment
attributes.references: Internal - M:N Association FK

attributes.name: staff_profile_id
attributes.description: Reference to the internal user (recruiter, compliance specialist, operations manager) who verified completion of this requirement for this assignment. Supports audit trail and accountability.

attributes.name: completion_date
attributes.description: The date on which this compliance requirement was successfully fulfilled for this assignment. Used to calculate re-verification due dates and track compliance history.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when this assignment-compliance requirement record was created, typically at assignment activation when requirements are evaluated and assigned

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: The date on which this completed requirement expires for this assignment and must be re-verified. Calculated from completion_date plus the requirement's re_verification_interval_days. Null if requirement does not expire.

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp of the most recent update to this assignment-compliance fulfillment record, tracking status changes, completions, and re-verifications

attributes.name: re_verification_due_date
attributes.description: The date by which this requirement must be re-verified for this assignment to maintain compliance. Typically set before expiration_date to allow processing time. Drives operational workflows and alerts.

attributes.name: requirement_status
attributes.description: Current status of this compliance requirement for this specific assignment: pending (not yet started), in_progress (documentation being collected), completed (requirement satisfied), waived (exception granted), expired (completed but now expired and needs re-verification), failed (requirement not met), not_applicable (requirement determined not to apply to this assignment)

attributes.name: verification_method
attributes.description: The method used to verify fulfillment of this requirement for this assignment: document_review (manual review of uploaded documents), background_check (third-party BGC vendor), drug_test (lab results), training_completion (LMS integration), credential_verification (license/certification check), client_attestation (client confirmation), system_integration (automated verification via API)

attributes.name: verification_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes captured by the verifying user regarding the fulfillment of this requirement for this assignment. May include document names, vendor confirmation numbers, or special circumstances.

attributes.name: waiver_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a waiver or exception was granted for this requirement on this assignment, allowing the assignment to proceed despite non-completion

attributes.name: waiver_reason
attributes.description: Business justification for granting a waiver for this requirement on this assignment. Required when waiver_flag is true. Captures approval authority and business rationale.

products.name: assignment_sla_measurement
products.description: This association product represents the measurement record between assignment and sla. It captures the actual performance measurement of a specific SLA metric against a specific assignment during a defined measurement period. Each record links one assignment to one sla with the actual measured value, target comparison, breach determination, and measurement period boundaries that exist only in the context of this specific measurement event.. Existence Justification: In staffing operations, each worker assignment is measured against multiple SLA commitments (time-to-fill, quality-of-hire, retention rate, first-day no-show rate), and each SLA metric applies to many assignments across the client portfolio. The business actively manages SLA measurement as an operational process: for each assignment, performance is measured against applicable SLAs during defined measurement periods, actual values are compared to targets, breaches are flagged, and penalties/credits are calculated. This measurement data is used for client QBRs, scorecard reporting, and contract compliance tracking.

attributes.name: breach_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this specific assignment breached the SLA commitment during this measurement period. Explicitly identified in detection phase relationship data.

attributes.name: measured_by
attributes.description: The system user or automated process that performed this SLA measurement calculation for this assignment.

attributes.name: measurement_period_end
attributes.description: The end date of the period during which this SLA metric was measured for this assignment. Explicitly identified in detection phase relationship data.

attributes.name: measurement_period_start
attributes.description: The start date of the period during which this SLA metric was measured for this assignment. Explicitly identified in detection phase relationship data.

attributes.name: measurement_timestamp

attributes.name: notes

attributes.name: variance_from_target

products.name: assignment_credential_compliance
products.description: This association product represents the compliance verification relationship between a worker assignment and a required credential. It captures the verification status, expiration tracking, and waiver management for each credential required for a specific assignment. Each record links one assignment to one credential with attributes that exist only in the context of ensuring placement compliance and regulatory adherence.. Existence Justification: In staffing operations, each assignment requires multiple credentials (professional licenses, safety certifications, immunizations, background checks, drug screens) and each credential type applies to many assignments over time. The business actively manages assignment-credential compliance as a distinct operational process, tracking verification dates, expiration monitoring, waiver approvals, and compliance status for each assignment-credential pair. This is not derivable from transaction history—it is an operational compliance management entity.

products.name: location_compliance_mandate
products.description: This association product represents the enforcement relationship between work locations and compliance requirements. It captures which federal, state, and client-specific compliance requirements are mandatory at each work location, along with site-specific enforcement parameters, audit history, and implementation status. Each record links one work location to one compliance requirement with attributes that exist only in the context of this site-specific mandate.. Existence Justification: In staffing operations, work locations are subject to multiple compliance requirements (OSHA postings, I-9 verification, state-specific rules, client contractual mandates, federal contractor obligations), and each compliance requirement applies to many work locations across the client portfolio. The compliance team actively manages which requirements are enforced at which sites, tracks site-specific enforcement levels (strict vs. advisory), conducts location-specific audits, and maintains site-specific implementation notes (e.g., 'Client requires bilingual OSHA postings'). This is an operational enforcement relationship, not a derivable correlation.

attributes.name: meal_break_waiver

attributes.name: ot_bill_rate

attributes.name: ot_hours
attributes.description: Total overtime hours worked during the pay period, typically hours exceeding 40 in a workweek under FLSA federal rules, or daily thresholds under state law (e.g., California 8-hour daily OT rule). attributes.name: pay_period_start_date

attributes.name: pay_period_type

attributes.name: pay_rate

Child record of the timesheet header. Incorporates shift-level schedule comparison, shift differential tracking, and dispatch-relevant shift metadata. Feeds both payroll and billing calculations. attributes.description: Per diem allowance amount (in USD) associated with this time entry for travel, lodging, or meal reimbursement when the worker is on a remote or travel assignment. Tracked separately from wages for IRS per diem tax treatment. Zero if no per diem applies.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 463 (Travel Expenses); GSA Per Diem Rates; TempWorks Payroll Per Diem Module

attributes.name: pto_hours
attributes.description: Number of paid time off (PTO) hours applied to this entry when the worker is absent but entitled to paid leave. Distinct from net_hours_worked (which reflects physically worked hours). Feeds PTO balance deduction in SAP SuccessFactors and payroll processing in TempWorks.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Leave Management; FLSA §213; State PTO Accrual Laws; ASA Staffing Standards

attributes.name: rejection_reason
attributes.description: Free-text or coded reason provided by the approver when a time entry is rejected (entry_status = rejected). Documents the basis for rejection to guide worker or supervisor correction. Null when entry is not in rejected status.
attributes.references: Kronos Workforce Ready Approval Workflow; ASA Staffing Standards; FLSA §516

attributes.name: rest_break_compliant
attributes.description: Indicates whether all required paid rest breaks were provided in compliance with applicable state law (e.g., California IWC Wage Orders require a 10-minute paid rest period for every 4 hours worked). True = compliant; False = potential premium pay obligation.
attributes.references: California IWC Wage Orders; FLSA §785.18; DOL Wage and Hour Division; SHRM Rest Break Policy

attributes.name: schedule_variance_hours
attributes.description: Delta between planned hours (derived from scheduled_start_time and scheduled_end_time) and actual net_hours_worked for this entry. Positive value indicates overtime relative to schedule; negative indicates early departure or absence. Key KPI for workforce scheduling compliance and dispatch analytics.
attributes.references: Kronos Workforce Ready Labor Analytics; SIA Workforce KPI Framework; ASA Staffing Standards

attributes.name: scheduled_end_time
attributes.description: The planned shift end date-time as defined in the worker's schedule. Paired with scheduled_start_time to derive planned shift duration for schedule variance and workforce planning analytics.
attributes.references: Kronos Workforce Ready Schedule Object; FLSA §516

attributes.name: scheduled_start_time
attributes.description: The planned shift start date-time as defined in the worker's schedule in Kronos Workforce Ready. Used to compute schedule variance (planned vs. actual hours delta) and to assess punctuality and dispatch compliance.
attributes.references: Kronos Workforce Ready Schedule Object; FLSA §516

attributes.name: shift_differential_code
attributes.description: Alphanumeric code identifying the applicable shift differential pay rule (e.g., EVE15, NIGHT20, WKD10). Maps to the differential rate table in TempWorks Payroll to apply the correct premium multiplier to base pay rate. Distinct from shift_type which is a broad category.
attributes.references: TempWorks Payroll Differential Rate Table; FLSA §207; ASA Staffing Standards

attributes.name: shift_type
attributes.description: Categorical classification of the shift period for differential pay and workforce scheduling analytics. Day, evening, night, weekend, and holiday shifts may carry different pay and bill rate differentials per the client MSA or worker agreement.
attributes.references: Kronos Workforce Ready Shift Definition; ASA Staffing Standards; FLSA §207

attributes.name: state_code
attributes.description: Two-letter US state code (e.g., CA, NY, TX) identifying the state where the work was physically performed. Determines applicable state wage and hour laws, state income tax withholding jurisdiction, SUTA rate, and state-specific break and overtime rules. Critical for multi-state payroll compliance.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 15; SUTA State Unemployment Tax; California Labor Code; FLSA §516; DOL

attributes.name: submitted_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the worker or supervisor submitted this time entry for approval. Satisfies TRANSACTION_LINE BUSINESS_EVENT_TIMESTAMP category. Used to measure submission timeliness against payroll cutoff deadlines and SLA compliance.
attributes.references: FLSA §516; Kronos Workforce Ready; ASA Staffing Standards

attributes.name: vms_time_entry_ref
attributes.business_glossary_term: Vendor Management System (VMS) Time Entry Reference
attributes.description: External reference identifier assigned by the client's Vendor Management System (VMS), such as Beeline, for this time entry when the client manages contingent labor through a VMS program. Enables reconciliation between Staffing Hr's internal records and the client's VMS for invoice matching and dispute resolution.
attributes.references: Beeline VMS Time Entry Object; ASA Staffing Standards; MSP Program Requirements

attributes.name: workers_comp_class_code
attributes.description: NCCI or state-specific workers' compensation classification code applicable to the work performed during this entry. Determined by the job type and worksite state. Used by TempWorks Payroll to calculate workers' comp premium allocation and for state insurance reporting.
attributes.references: NCCI Workers Comp Classification System; State Workers Comp Boards; TempWorks Payroll; OSHA

products.name: timesheet_approval_workflow
products.description: Tracks the multi-step approval workflow lifecycle for a timesheet submission. Captures each approval stage (worker submission, supervisor review, client approval, back-office audit), the approver identity, approval action (approved, rejected, escalated, auto-approved), action timestamp, rejection reason, and SLA compliance flag. Enables full audit trail of who approved what and when, supporting dispute resolution and compliance requirements.

attributes.name: timesheet_approval_workflow_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated identifier for each timesheet approval workflow record. Serves as the primary key for this entity. Role: TRANSACTION_HEADER — tracks the multi-step approval lifecycle for a single timesheet submission.
attributes.references: ASA Staffing Industry Standards; Kronos Workforce Ready

attributes.name: assignment_id
attributes.description: Reference to the worker placement or assignment associated with this timesheet approval workflow. Ties the approval to the specific contingent worker assignment and client engagement.
attributes.references: Bullhorn ATS/CRM; ASA Staffing Industry Standards

attributes.name: client_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the client organization for whom the contingent worker performed services. Used to route approval to the correct client contact and enforce client-specific SLA rules.
attributes.references: Bullhorn ATS/CRM; Beeline VMS; ASA Staffing Industry Standards

attributes.name: client_contact_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to client.contact. Business justification: Client-side timesheet approvers are contacts; approval routing, SLA tracking, and audit trails require knowing which client contact approved hours. Critical for dispute resolution and compliance audit
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: pay_period_id
attributes.description: Reference to the payroll pay period to which the approved timesheet hours will be applied. Links the approval workflow to downstream payroll processing and ensures hours are captured in the correct pay cycle.
attributes.references: TempWorks Payroll; FLSA; IRS Worker Classification Rules

attributes.name: primary_timesheet_staff_profile_id
attributes.description: Reference to the individual (supervisor, client contact, or back-office auditor) who performed the approval action at this workflow stage. Enables full audit trail of approver identity.
attributes.references: Kronos Workforce Ready; SOC 2 Type II; ASA Staffing Industry Standards

attributes.name: profile_id
attributes.description: Reference to the contingent worker (candidate) who submitted the timesheet being reviewed in this approval workflow. Supports worker-level audit trail and dispute resolution.
attributes.references: Bullhorn ATS/CRM; Kronos Workforce Ready; FLSA

attributes.name: tertiary_timesheet_delegated_approver_staff_profile_id
attributes.description: Reference to the individual who acted on behalf of the primary approver when delegation was in effect (e.g., during leave or absence). Populated only when approval_action is 'delegated'. Supports audit trail integrity.
attributes.references: Kronos Workforce Ready; SOC 2 Type II; ASA Staffing Industry Standards

attributes.name: timesheet_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent timesheet record for which this approval workflow instance was initiated. Links the approval workflow to the specific worker time submission being reviewed.
attributes.references: Kronos Workforce Ready; ASA Staffing Industry Standards

attributes.name: action_timestamp
attributes.description: The exact date and time when the approver performed the approval action at this workflow stage. Serves as the principal business event timestamp for this transaction. Critical for SLA compliance measurement and audit trail.
attributes.references: Kronos Workforce Ready; SOC 2 Type II; FLSA; ASA Staffing Industry Standards

attributes.name: approval_action
attributes.description: The specific action taken by the approver at this workflow stage. Distinct from approval_status in that it captures the discrete action event (e.g., delegated) rather than the resulting state. Used for audit trail and workflow analytics.
attributes.references: Kronos Workforce Ready; SOC 2 Type II; ASA Staffing Industry Standards

attributes.name: approval_channel
attributes.description: The interface or channel through which the approver submitted their approval action. Supports channel adoption analytics and helps identify approval bottlenecks by channel type.
attributes.references: Kronos Workforce Ready; Beeline VMS; ASA Staffing Industry Standards

attributes.name: approval_stage
attributes.description: The specific step in the multi-stage approval workflow at which this record applies. Stages include worker submission, supervisor review, client approval, back-office audit, and payroll release. Each stage represents a distinct checkpoint in the timesheet lifecycle.
attributes.references: Kronos Workforce Ready; ASA Staffing Industry Standards; FLSA

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of this approval workflow stage. Indicates whether the stage is awaiting action (pending), has been approved, rejected, escalated to a higher authority, auto-approved per system rules, or recalled by the submitter.
attributes.references: Kronos Workforce Ready; SOC 2 Type II; ASA Staffing Industry Standards

attributes.name: approver_role
attributes.description: The functional role of the approver at this workflow stage. Distinguishes between worker self-submission, direct supervisor review, client manager approval, back-office audit, payroll admin release, and MSP coordinator oversight.
attributes.references: Kronos Workforce Ready; Beeline VMS; ASA Staffing Industry Standards

attributes.name: auto_approval_rule_code
attributes.description: Identifier of the system-defined auto-approval rule that triggered automatic approval of this timesheet stage without manual intervention. Populated only when approval_action is 'auto_approved'. Enables audit of automated decisions.
attributes.references: Kronos Workforce Ready; SOC 2 Type II; ASA Staffing Industry Standards

attributes.name: bill_rate
attributes.description: The hourly rate at which the client is billed for the worker's time as defined in the client contract or VMS program. Used to validate that approved hours will generate the correct client invoice amount.
attributes.references: Beeline VMS; Salesforce Revenue Cloud; ASA Staffing Industry Standards

attributes.name: billing_released_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the approved timesheet hours have been released to the client billing system (Salesforce Revenue Cloud) for invoice generation. Enables reconciliation between approved hours and billed hours.
attributes.references: Salesforce Revenue Cloud; ASA Staffing Industry Standards

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this approval workflow record was first created in the system. Serves as the audit creation timestamp for data lineage and SOC 2 compliance purposes.
attributes.references: SOC 2 Type II; GDPR Article 5; CCPA

attributes.name: dispute_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this timesheet approval workflow record is associated with a formal dispute raised by the worker, client, or staffing agency. When True, the record is flagged for dispute resolution review and may be excluded from standard payroll processing until resolved.
attributes.references: ASA Staffing Industry Standards; FLSA; DOL

attributes.name: dispute_reference_number
attributes.description: The case or ticket number associated with a formal timesheet dispute. Populated when dispute_flag is True. Used to link the approval workflow record to the dispute management process for resolution tracking.
attributes.references: ASA Staffing Industry Standards; FLSA; DOL

attributes.name: escalation_reason
attributes.description: Free-text or coded explanation for why this approval stage was escalated to a higher authority. Populated when approval_action is 'escalated'. Supports escalation pattern analysis and workflow optimization.
attributes.references: Kronos Workforce Ready; ASA Staffing Industry Standards

attributes.name: final_approved_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this workflow record represents the final, fully-approved state of the timesheet across all required approval stages. When True, the timesheet is cleared for payroll processing and client billing. Enables efficient filtering for downstream payroll and billing feeds.
attributes.references: Kronos Workforce Ready; TempWorks Payroll; Salesforce Revenue Cloud; ASA Staffing Industry Standards

attributes.name: kronos_timesheet_ref
attributes.description: The source system reference identifier from Kronos Workforce Ready for the timesheet record associated with this approval workflow. Supports data lineage tracing and reconciliation with the system of record.
attributes.references: Kronos Workforce Ready; SOC 2 Type II

attributes.name: pay_rate
attributes.description: The hourly rate at which the contingent worker is compensated for approved hours. Used to validate payroll calculations downstream. The spread (bill_rate minus pay_rate) represents gross margin.
attributes.references: TempWorks Payroll; FLSA; DOL; ASA Staffing Industry Standards

attributes.name: payroll_released_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the approved timesheet hours have been released to the payroll processing system (TempWorks Payroll) for worker compensation. Distinct from final_approved_flag as it confirms the downstream handoff has occurred.
attributes.references: TempWorks Payroll; FLSA; IRS; ASA Staffing Industry Standards

attributes.name: per_diem_amount
attributes.description: The total per diem dollar amount claimed by the worker on this timesheet. Populated when per_diem_claimed is True. Subject to IRS per diem rate limits and client contract terms. Feeds into billing and payroll calculations.
attributes.references: IRS Per Diem Guidelines; TempWorks Payroll; ASA Staffing Industry Standards

attributes.name: per_diem_claimed
attributes.description: Indicates whether the worker claimed a per diem allowance (daily expense reimbursement for travel, meals, or lodging) on this timesheet. Per diem claims require separate approval validation against the assignment agreement.
attributes.references: IRS Per Diem Guidelines; TempWorks Payroll; ASA Staffing Industry Standards

attributes.name: rejection_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code indicating the reason the timesheet was rejected at this approval stage. Used for root-cause analysis of rejection patterns and worker coaching. Populated only when approval_action is 'rejected'. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: hours_discrepancy|missing_entries|unauthorized_overtime|unapproved_per_diem|policy_violation|duplicate_submission|other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Kronos Workforce Ready; ASA Staffing Industry Standards; FLSA

attributes.name: rejection_reason_notes
attributes.description: Free-text narrative provided by the approver explaining the specific reason for rejecting the timesheet at this stage. Supplements the rejection_reason_code with contextual detail for dispute resolution and worker communication.
attributes.references: Kronos Workforce Ready; ASA Staffing Industry Standards; FLSA

attributes.name: resubmission_count
attributes.description: The number of times the worker has resubmitted this timesheet after a rejection. A high resubmission count indicates recurring errors or disputes and is used for quality-of-submission (QoS) analytics and worker coaching.
attributes.references: Kronos Workforce Ready; ASA Staffing Industry Standards

attributes.name: sla_breach_minutes
attributes.business_glossary_term: Service Level Agreement (SLA) Breach Duration Minutes
attributes.description: The number of minutes by which the approval action exceeded the SLA deadline. Populated only when sla_compliant_flag is False. Zero or null when SLA was met. Enables severity-based SLA breach analysis and client reporting.
attributes.references: Beeline VMS; ASA Staffing Industry Standards; SLA governance

attributes.name: sla_compliant_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the approval action was completed within the SLA-defined deadline for this stage. True if the action_timestamp is on or before sla_due_timestamp; False if the SLA was breached. Supports SLA compliance reporting and client KPI dashboards.
attributes.references: Beeline VMS; ASA Staffing Industry Standards; SLA governance

attributes.name: sla_due_timestamp
attributes.description: The contractually or operationally defined deadline by which this approval stage must be completed per the applicable SLA. Derived from the SLA configuration for the client or program. Used to calculate SLA compliance.
attributes.references: Beeline VMS; ASA Staffing Industry Standards; SLA governance

attributes.name: stage_sequence_number
attributes.description: Numeric ordering of this approval stage within the overall workflow. Enables reconstruction of the full approval chain in chronological order and supports multi-step workflow analytics.
attributes.references: Kronos Workforce Ready; ASA Staffing Industry Standards

attributes.name: submission_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the worker originally submitted the timesheet that triggered this approval workflow. Used as the baseline for SLA elapsed time calculations and Time-to-Approve (TTA) reporting.
attributes.references: Kronos Workforce Ready; FLSA; ASA Staffing Industry Standards

attributes.name: total_dt_hours
attributes.description: Total number of double-time (DT) hours recorded on the timesheet, applicable in jurisdictions or contracts where hours beyond a threshold (e.g., 12 hours/day or 7th consecutive day) are compensated at double the regular rate.
attributes.references: Kronos Workforce Ready; FLSA; DOL; California Labor Code

attributes.name: total_ot_hours
attributes.description: Total number of overtime (OT) hours recorded on the timesheet, typically hours worked beyond 40 per week or 8 per day per FLSA or applicable state law. Requires explicit approval and is a common rejection trigger.
attributes.references: Kronos Workforce Ready; FLSA; DOL; ASA Staffing Industry Standards

attributes.name: total_regular_hours
attributes.description: Total number of straight-time (non-overtime) hours recorded on the timesheet being reviewed in this approval workflow. Used to validate hours against scheduled hours and client purchase order limits.
attributes.references: Kronos Workforce Ready; FLSA; ASA Staffing Industry Standards

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this approval workflow record was last modified. Tracks the most recent state change for audit trail purposes and supports incremental data pipeline processing.
attributes.references: SOC 2 Type II; GDPR Article 5; CCPA

attributes.name: vms_workflow_ref
attributes.description: The external workflow identifier assigned by the Vendor Management System (VMS), such as Beeline, for this timesheet approval transaction. Enables cross-system reconciliation between the internal approval record and the client's VMS portal.
attributes.references: Beeline VMS; ASA Staffing Industry Standards

attributes.name: work_week_end_date
attributes.description: The last day of the work week covered by the timesheet being approved. Used to align the approval workflow with payroll processing cycles and client billing periods.
attributes.references: Kronos Workforce Ready; FLSA; TempWorks Payroll

attributes.name: workflow_instance_number
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier for this approval workflow instance, used in communications, dispute resolution, and audit references. Typically formatted as a sequential or alphanumeric code (e.g., WF-2024-00123).
attributes.references: Kronos Workforce Ready; SOC 2 Type II; ASA Staffing Industry Standards

products.name: absence_record
products.description: Records worker absences, PTO usage, sick leave, FMLA leave, holiday observances, jury duty, bereavement, and unexcused absences within a pay period. Captures absence type, absence date range, hours absent, PTO balance consumed, leave reason code, approval status, paid/unpaid indicator, client notification flag, and replacement worker request trigger. Sourced from Kronos Workforce Ready leave management module. Feeds payroll deductions, workforce availability reporting, and client SLA compliance tracking. For contingent workers, unexcused absences may trigger assignment termination workflows. Subject to FMLA recordkeeping requirements (3-year retention) and state-specific paid sick leave laws (e.g., California Healthy Workplaces, Healthy Families Act).
products.reference: Kronos Workforce Ready - Leave / Absence Management

attributes.name: absence_record_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated identifier for each absence record. Primary key for the absence_record data product within the timesheet domain.
attributes.references: ISO 30405:2016 Human Resource Management

attributes.name: assignment_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the active placement or assignment during which the absence occurred. Used to associate the absence with the specific client engagement and job order.
attributes.references: Bullhorn ATS/CRM; Kronos Workforce Ready

attributes.name: client_account_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the client organization at whose worksite the worker was assigned when the absence occurred. Used for client SLA compliance tracking and notification workflows.
attributes.references: Bullhorn ATS/CRM; Beeline VMS

attributes.name: i9_verification_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.i9_verification. Business justification: Extended absences may trigger work authorization re-verification, especially for visa holders with expiring EADs. Staffing firms must track I-9 status during leave. Real business process: work authori
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: location_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to client.location. Business justification: Absences impact client site staffing levels and trigger replacement workflows; site managers need absence visibility for scheduling. Essential for client site headcount management and replacement requ
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: primary_absence_profile_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the contingent worker associated with this absence record. Links to the worker master record in the workforce management system.
attributes.references: Kronos Workforce Ready; FLSA

attributes.name: pto_accrual_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to payroll.pto_accrual. Business justification: Absence records consume PTO balances tracked in pto_accrual. This link enables leave balance reconciliation, ensures absence hours deducted match accrual transactions, and supports audit of PTO usage
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: timesheet_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the timesheet record for the pay period in which this absence falls. Links the absence to the authoritative hours record for payroll and billing.
attributes.references: Kronos Workforce Ready; TempWorks Payroll

attributes.name: absence_duration_days
attributes.description: Total calendar duration of the absence expressed in days (may be fractional for partial-day absences). Derived from absence_start_date and absence_end_date but stored for reporting efficiency and workforce availability analytics.
attributes.references: Kronos Workforce Ready; FMLA (29 CFR Part 825)

attributes.name: absence_end_date
attributes.description: The last calendar date of the absence period. Null for open-ended absences (e.g., ongoing FMLA leave). Combined with absence_start_date to determine total absence duration.
attributes.references: FMLA (29 CFR Part 825); Kronos Workforce Ready

attributes.name: absence_hours
attributes.description: Total number of scheduled work hours missed during the absence period. Used for payroll deduction calculations, PTO balance consumption, and workforce availability reporting.
attributes.references: FLSA; Kronos Workforce Ready; TempWorks Payroll

attributes.name: absence_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes entered by the worker, manager, or HR coordinator providing additional context for the absence (e.g., nature of illness, family emergency details). Classified as confidential due to potential sensitivity of leave-related information.
attributes.references: FMLA (29 CFR Part 825); GDPR Article 9; CCPA

attributes.name: absence_reference_number
attributes.description: Externally visible, human-readable reference number assigned to this absence record (e.g., ABS-2024-00123). Used in worker communications, manager approvals, and leave management correspondence.
attributes.references: Kronos Workforce Ready; ISO 30405:2016

attributes.name: absence_start_date
attributes.description: The first calendar date of the absence period. Used to calculate absence duration, determine pay period impact, and trigger FMLA tracking windows.
attributes.references: FMLA (29 CFR Part 825); Kronos Workforce Ready

attributes.name: absence_type
attributes.description: Classification of the absence by leave category as defined in the leave management policy. Drives payroll treatment (paid vs. unpaid), compliance recordkeeping, and workforce availability reporting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: PTO|Sick Leave|FMLA|Holiday|Jury Duty|Bereavement|Unexcused|Personal|Military|Workers Comp — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: FMLA (29 CFR Part 825); DOL; ASA; Kronos Workforce Ready

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Current workflow state of the absence request through the manager approval process. Drives payroll processing eligibility and client notification triggers. Pending = submitted awaiting review; Approved = manager authorized; Denied = rejected; Cancelled = worker withdrew; Under Review = escalated.
attributes.references: Kronos Workforce Ready; ASA; FMLA (29 CFR Part 825)

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or system identifier of the manager, supervisor, or automated workflow that approved or denied the absence request. Supports audit trail and accountability for leave decisions.
attributes.references: Kronos Workforce Ready; FMLA (29 CFR Part 825.500)

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the absence request was approved or denied by the authorized approver. Null if still pending. Used for approval workflow SLA tracking and audit trail.
attributes.references: Kronos Workforce Ready; ASA SLA Standards

attributes.name: client_notification_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the client was notified of the worker absence. Null if client_notified is False. Used to measure notification SLA compliance against MSA contractual obligations.
attributes.references: ASA; MSA SLA Standards; Beeline VMS

attributes.name: client_notified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the client organization has been notified of this worker absence (True) or not (False). Critical for client SLA compliance tracking — unnotified absences may breach MSA notification obligations.
attributes.references: ASA; Beeline VMS; MSA SLA Standards

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this absence record was first created in the system. Establishes the audit trail start point and is used for data lineage tracking in the Silver layer lakehouse.
attributes.references: SOC 2 Type II; GDPR Article 5; FMLA (29 CFR Part 825.500)

attributes.name: documentation_due_date
attributes.description: Deadline by which the worker must submit required leave documentation. Under FMLA, employers may require documentation within 15 calendar days of the leave request. Drives compliance follow-up workflows.
attributes.references: FMLA (29 CFR Part 825.305); DOL

attributes.name: documentation_received
attributes.description: Indicates whether required supporting documentation (e.g., physician certification for FMLA, jury summons, death certificate for bereavement) has been received and verified (True) or is outstanding (False).
attributes.references: FMLA (29 CFR Part 825.305); FCRA; Kronos Workforce Ready

attributes.name: fmla_hours_used
attributes.business_glossary_term: Family and Medical Leave Act (FMLA) Hours Used
attributes.description: Number of hours counted against the worker's annual FMLA entitlement (up to 480 hours / 12 weeks per year). Populated only when fmla_qualifying is True. Required for DOL FMLA recordkeeping compliance.
attributes.references: FMLA (29 CFR Part 825); DOL (29 CFR Part 825.500)

attributes.name: fmla_qualifying
attributes.business_glossary_term: Family and Medical Leave Act (FMLA) Qualifying Indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this absence qualifies under the Family and Medical Leave Act (FMLA) (True) or not (False). Triggers FMLA tracking, 3-year recordkeeping retention, and DOL compliance workflows.
attributes.references: FMLA (29 CFR Part 825); DOL

attributes.name: is_paid
attributes.description: Indicates whether the absence is compensated (True) or unpaid (False). Determines payroll treatment: paid absences draw from PTO/sick balances or holiday pay; unpaid absences result in payroll deductions.
attributes.references: FLSA; TempWorks Payroll; DOL

attributes.name: is_partial_day
attributes.description: Indicates whether the absence covers only part of a scheduled workday (True) rather than full days (False). Partial-day absences require hour-level tracking for accurate payroll deduction and FMLA intermittent leave accounting.
attributes.references: FMLA (29 CFR Part 825); FLSA; Kronos Workforce Ready

attributes.name: kronos_leave_ref
attributes.description: Source system identifier for this absence record as assigned by the Kronos Workforce Ready leave management module. Used for data lineage, reconciliation, and integration with the Silver layer from the operational system of record.
attributes.references: Kronos Workforce Ready

attributes.name: leave_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized reason code from the Kronos leave management module identifying the specific reason for the absence (e.g., FMLA-SELF, FMLA-FAMILY, PSL-CA, JURY, BRVMT-IMM). Supports regulatory reporting and state-specific paid sick leave law compliance.
attributes.references: FMLA (29 CFR Part 825); California Healthy Workplaces Healthy Families Act; DOL; Kronos Workforce Ready

attributes.name: pay_period_end_date
attributes.description: End date of the payroll pay period in which this absence record falls. Combined with pay_period_start_date to define the payroll processing window for this absence.
attributes.references: TempWorks Payroll; FLSA

attributes.name: pay_period_start_date
attributes.description: Start date of the payroll pay period in which this absence record falls. Used to align absence data with payroll processing cycles in TempWorks Payroll.
attributes.references: TempWorks Payroll; FLSA

attributes.name: payroll_processed
attributes.description: Indicates whether this absence record has been included in a completed payroll processing run (True) or is still pending payroll (False). Prevents double-processing and confirms the absence has been reflected in worker compensation.
attributes.references: TempWorks Payroll; FLSA; IRS

attributes.name: per_diem_applicable
attributes.description: Indicates whether the worker's per diem allowance is affected by this absence (True) or not (False). Per diem payments may be suspended or prorated for absent days depending on the assignment contract terms.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 463; TempWorks Payroll; DOL

attributes.name: pto_balance_before
attributes.business_glossary_term: Paid Time Off (PTO) Balance Before Absence
attributes.description: Worker's available PTO balance in hours immediately prior to this absence being applied. Provides a point-in-time snapshot for audit, dispute resolution, and worker self-service reporting.
attributes.references: TempWorks Payroll; DOL; SHRM

attributes.name: pto_hours_consumed
attributes.description: Number of accrued Paid Time Off (PTO) hours deducted from the worker's PTO balance to cover this absence. Zero for unpaid absences or absences covered by other leave types (e.g., FMLA, holiday pay).
attributes.references: TempWorks Payroll; DOL; California Healthy Workplaces Healthy Families Act

attributes.name: replacement_requested
attributes.description: Indicates whether a replacement worker has been requested to cover this absence (True) or not (False). Triggers workforce scheduling and dispatch workflows to source a backfill worker for the client site.
attributes.references: Kronos Workforce Ready; Bullhorn ATS/CRM; ASA

attributes.name: scheduled_hours
attributes.description: Total number of hours the worker was originally scheduled to work during the absence period. Provides the baseline against which absence_hours is measured for partial-day absence tracking.
attributes.references: Kronos Workforce Ready; FLSA

attributes.name: sla_breach_flag
