attributes.description: Classification of the shift by its operational nature. 'regular' = standard scheduled shift; 'overtime' = OT-designated shift; 'holiday' = worked on a recognized holiday; 'on_call' = standby/on-call shift; 'split' = non-contiguous shift segments; 'per_diem' = per diem eligible shift.
attributes.references: Kronos Workforce Ready - Shift Configuration; FLSA 29 CFR Part 778 (Overtime); ASA

attributes.name: start_variance_minutes
attributes.description: Difference in minutes between actual_start_time and scheduled_start_time (actual minus scheduled). Positive values indicate tardiness; negative values indicate early arrival. Used for punctuality tracking and SLA compliance.
attributes.references: Kronos Workforce Ready - Schedule Adherence; ASA Quality of Service Metrics

attributes.name: worked_hours
attributes.description: Total actual hours worked during the shift, calculated from actual_start_time to actual_end_time minus actual break time. Represents the gross worked duration before OT/DT classification. Feeds payroll and client billing.
attributes.references: Kronos Workforce Ready - Time and Attendance; FLSA 29 CFR Part 785; TempWorks Payroll

attributes.name: workers_comp_code
attributes.description: NCCI or state-specific workers' compensation classification code applicable to the work performed during this shift. Determines workers' comp insurance premium calculation and is required for accurate burden rate costing.
attributes.references: NCCI Workers Compensation Classification Codes; DOL; TempWorks Payroll - Workers Comp Module; OSHA

products.name: ot_rule
products.description: Reference entity defining overtime and double-time calculation rules applicable to specific clients, states, job categories, or worker classifications. Captures the weekly OT threshold (e.g., 40 hrs/week federal FLSA §207), daily OT threshold (e.g., 8 hrs/day California Labor Code §510), DT threshold (e.g., 12 hrs/day California), seventh-consecutive-day rules, applicable FLSA exemption status, state-specific OT law references, effective date range, and rule priority for conflict resolution. Supports blended OT rate calculation for workers on multiple assignments. Includes prevailing wage OT rules for Davis-Bacon Act compliance on government staffing contracts. Ensures compliant OT/DT classification across all time entries in multi-state staffing operations.
products.reference: FLSA Overtime Rules / State Labor Law OT Thresholds

attributes.name: ot_rule_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated identifier for the overtime and double-time calculation rule record. Primary key for the ot_rule entity. [ROLE: REFERENCE_LOOKUP — this entity defines enumerated OT/DT calculation rules used as a reference by time entry and payroll processing; exempt from per-role minimums per canonical-attrs-enforced rule.]
attributes.references: FLSA §207; California Labor Code §510

attributes.name: state_compliance_rule_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.state_compliance_rule. Business justification: OT rules implement state-specific compliance requirements (CA daily OT, NY spread-of-hours, etc.). Each OT rule must reference the governing state compliance rule. Real business process: jurisdiction-
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: superseded_by_rule_ot_rule_id
attributes.description: Reference to the ot_rule_id of the newer rule that replaces this rule when rule_status is 'superseded'. Enables rule version chain tracing for historical timesheet recalculation and compliance audits. Null if this rule has not been superseded.
attributes.references: ASA Best Practices; Kronos Workforce Ready; TempWorks Payroll

attributes.name: applicable_law_reference
attributes.description: Specific statutory or regulatory citation governing this OT rule (e.g., 'FLSA §207', 'California Labor Code §510', 'Nevada Revised Statutes §608.018', 'Davis-Bacon Act 40 U.S.C. §3141'). Used for compliance documentation, legal audit trails, and regulatory reporting to DOL and OFCCP.
attributes.references: DOL Wage and Hour Division; FLSA; California Labor Code; OFCCP; ASA

attributes.name: applies_to_billable_hours
attributes.description: Indicates whether this OT rule governs the classification of billable OT hours for client invoicing purposes (True), in addition to payable hours for worker compensation. When True, OT bill rate multipliers are applied in Salesforce Revenue Cloud for client billing. When False, the rule applies only to payroll (pay side) calculations.
attributes.references: ASA Best Practices; Salesforce Revenue Cloud; Beeline VMS; SIA

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or user identifier of the payroll manager, compliance officer, or HR administrator who approved this OT rule configuration for activation. Required for SOC 2 Type II change management controls and FLSA compliance audit trails. Populated when rule_status transitions to 'active'.
attributes.references: SOC 2 Type II; FLSA §207; DOL Wage and Hour Division; SHRM

attributes.name: approved_date
attributes.description: Date on which this OT rule configuration was formally approved for activation by the authorized approver. Distinct from effective_date (when the rule starts being applied) and created_timestamp (when the record was created). Supports change management audit trails per SOC 2 Type II.
attributes.references: SOC 2 Type II; FLSA §207; DOL Wage and Hour Division; ASA

attributes.name: bill_rate_dt_multiplier
attributes.description: Multiplier applied to the standard bill rate to calculate the DT bill rate charged to the client for double-time hours (e.g., 2.00 means the client is billed at 2x the straight-time bill rate for DT hours). Null if the rule does not include a DT tier or if applies_to_billable_hours is False.
attributes.references: ASA Best Practices; Salesforce Revenue Cloud; Beeline VMS; MSA

attributes.name: bill_rate_ot_multiplier
attributes.description: Multiplier applied to the standard bill rate to calculate the OT bill rate charged to the client for overtime hours (e.g., 1.50 means the client is billed at 1.5x the straight-time bill rate for OT hours). May differ from the pay-side OT multiplier based on client MSA terms. Null if applies_to_billable_hours is False.
attributes.references: ASA Best Practices; Salesforce Revenue Cloud; Beeline VMS; MSA

attributes.name: blended_rate_method
attributes.description: Method used to calculate the regular rate of pay for OT purposes when a worker is on multiple concurrent assignments with different pay rates. 'weighted_average' = FLSA §207(g)(1) weighted average of all rates; 'highest_rate' = FLSA §207(g)(2) highest rate method; 'primary_assignment' = rate of the primary assignment governs; 'not_applicable' = worker is on a single assignment only.
attributes.references: FLSA §207(g); DOL Wage and Hour Division; TempWorks Payroll

attributes.name: break_deduction_applies
attributes.description: Indicates whether unpaid meal/rest break deductions are applied before OT threshold calculation under this rule. True = break time is deducted from hours worked before OT is computed; False = all clocked hours count toward OT threshold without break deduction. Affects OT calculation in Kronos Workforce Ready.
attributes.references: FLSA §785.19; DOL Wage and Hour Division; Kronos Workforce Ready

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this OT rule record was first created in the system (ISO 8601 format with timezone offset). Provides audit trail for rule configuration history and supports SOC 2 Type II compliance logging requirements.
attributes.references: SOC 2 Type II; GDPR Article 5; CCPA; ASA Best Practices

attributes.name: daily_dt_threshold_hours
attributes.description: Number of hours worked in a single workday beyond which double-time (DT) pay is triggered (e.g., 12.00 hours per California Labor Code §510). Hours worked above this threshold are compensated at the DT multiplier rate. Null if the rule does not include a daily DT threshold.
attributes.references: California Labor Code §510; TempWorks Payroll; Kronos Workforce Ready

attributes.name: daily_ot_threshold_hours
attributes.description: Number of hours worked in a single workday beyond which daily overtime pay is triggered (e.g., 8.00 hours per California Labor Code §510). Hours worked above this threshold and below the DT threshold are compensated at the OT multiplier. Null if the rule does not apply a daily OT threshold.
attributes.references: California Labor Code §510; Nevada Revised Statutes §608.018; Kronos Workforce Ready

attributes.name: dt_multiplier
attributes.description: Pay rate multiplier applied to the worker's regular rate of pay for hours classified as double-time (e.g., 2.00 for double-time per California Labor Code §510). Null if the rule does not include a DT tier. Used by TempWorks Payroll for DT wage calculation.
attributes.references: California Labor Code §510; TempWorks Payroll; Kronos Workforce Ready

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date on which this OT rule becomes effective and begins to be applied to time entry calculations (inclusive). Used for date-range-based rule selection to ensure the correct rule version is applied to historical and current timesheets. Aligns with FLSA and state law effective dates.
attributes.references: FLSA §207; California Labor Code §510; DOL Wage and Hour Division

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date on which this OT rule ceases to be effective (inclusive). Null for open-ended rules with no planned expiration. Used in conjunction with effective_date for date-range-based rule version management. When a rule is superseded, this date is set to the day before the new rule's effective_date.
attributes.references: FLSA §207; ASA Best Practices; Kronos Workforce Ready

attributes.name: flsa_exemption_category
attributes.business_glossary_term: Fair Labor Standards Act (FLSA) Exemption Category
attributes.description: Specific FLSA exemption category when flsa_exemption_status is 'exempt' or 'partial_exempt' (e.g., 'executive', 'administrative', 'professional', 'computer_employee', 'highly_compensated', '207k_public_safety'). Null for non-exempt workers. Required for FLSA compliance documentation and OFCCP audits. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: executive|administrative|professional|computer_employee|highly_compensated|207k_public_safety|outside_sales|seasonal — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: FLSA §213; DOL Wage and Hour Division; OFCCP

attributes.name: flsa_exemption_status
attributes.business_glossary_term: Fair Labor Standards Act (FLSA) Exemption Status
attributes.description: FLSA overtime exemption classification applicable under this rule. 'non_exempt' = worker is entitled to OT pay under FLSA; 'exempt' = worker meets FLSA white-collar or other exemption criteria and is not entitled to OT; 'partial_exempt' = specific exemption applies to some but not all OT provisions (e.g., §207(k) for law enforcement/fire). Drives OT eligibility in TempWorks Payroll.
attributes.references: FLSA §213; DOL Wage and Hour Division; EEOC

attributes.name: holiday_hours_ot_treatment
attributes.description: Defines how holiday hours are treated for OT threshold calculation. 'count_as_worked' = holiday pay hours count toward weekly OT threshold; 'exclude' = holiday hours are excluded from OT threshold calculation; 'premium_separate' = holiday premium is calculated separately and does not affect OT threshold. Configured per client MSA or state law.
attributes.references: FLSA §207; DOL Wage and Hour Division; ASA Best Practices; TempWorks Payroll

attributes.name: job_category_scope
attributes.description: Job category or occupational classification to which this OT rule is restricted (e.g., 'light_industrial', 'healthcare_rn', 'it_professional', 'clerical', 'all'). Null or 'all' indicates the rule applies across all job categories. Supports differentiated OT rules for prevailing wage or union-covered job categories.
attributes.references: Davis-Bacon Act 40 U.S.C. §3141; Service Contract Act (SCA); DOL; ASA

attributes.name: jurisdiction_level
attributes.description: Level of legal jurisdiction governing this OT rule. 'federal' = applies nationwide under FLSA; 'state' = applies within a specific U.S. state; 'local' = applies within a specific municipality or county; 'contract' = applies per client MSA or SOW terms regardless of geography.
attributes.references: FLSA §207; DOL Wage and Hour Division; OFCCP

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this OT rule record was most recently updated (ISO 8601 format with timezone offset). Used to detect configuration changes, trigger downstream recalculation of affected timesheets, and support SOC 2 Type II audit logging.
attributes.references: SOC 2 Type II; GDPR Article 5; CCPA; Kronos Workforce Ready

attributes.name: ot_multiplier
attributes.description: Pay rate multiplier applied to the worker's regular rate of pay for hours classified as overtime (e.g., 1.50 for time-and-a-half per FLSA §207). Used by TempWorks Payroll to calculate OT wages and by Salesforce Revenue Cloud to calculate OT bill amounts.
attributes.references: FLSA §207; DOL Wage and Hour Division; TempWorks Payroll

attributes.name: prevailing_wage_applies
attributes.description: Indicates whether this OT rule incorporates prevailing wage requirements under the Davis-Bacon Act (for federal construction contracts) or the Service Contract Act (SCA) for government service contracts. True = prevailing wage OT rates apply; False = standard commercial OT rates apply. Critical for government staffing contract compliance.
attributes.references: Davis-Bacon Act 40 U.S.C. §3141; Service Contract Act (SCA); DOL Wage and Hour Division; OFCCP

attributes.name: prevailing_wage_determination_number
attributes.description: DOL wage determination number associated with the prevailing wage schedule governing this OT rule (e.g., 'WD 2023-0001'). Populated only when prevailing_wage_applies is True. Required for Davis-Bacon Act and SCA compliance documentation on government staffing contracts.
attributes.references: Davis-Bacon Act 40 U.S.C. §3141; DOL Wage and Hour Division; OFCCP

attributes.name: pto_counts_toward_ot
attributes.business_glossary_term: Paid Time Off (PTO) Counts Toward Overtime (OT) Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether paid time off (PTO) hours are included in the weekly hours count for OT threshold purposes. True = PTO hours count toward the OT threshold (e.g., 32 hours worked + 8 PTO = 40 hours, no OT triggered); False = only actual hours worked count toward OT threshold per FLSA standard. Configurable per client MSA.
attributes.references: FLSA §207; DOL Wage and Hour Division; ASA Best Practices

attributes.name: rule_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric code uniquely identifying this OT/DT rule for reference in payroll configurations, VMS integrations, and client billing systems (e.g., 'FLSA_FED_STD', 'CA_510_DAILY', 'DAVIS_BACON_GOV'). Used as the business key in Kronos Workforce Ready and TempWorks Payroll rule tables.
attributes.references: FLSA §207; ASA Best Practices; Kronos Workforce Ready

attributes.name: rule_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of the overtime rule, including the legal basis, applicable thresholds, and any special conditions (e.g., seventh-consecutive-day provisions, blended rate requirements, prevailing wage applicability). Supports compliance documentation and auditor review.
attributes.references: FLSA §207; California Labor Code §510; DOL Wage and Hour Division

attributes.name: rule_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name describing the overtime rule (e.g., 'Federal FLSA Standard 40-Hour Weekly OT', 'California Daily OT 8/12 Rule', 'Davis-Bacon Prevailing Wage OT'). Used in payroll configuration UIs, compliance reports, and worker assignment documentation.
attributes.references: FLSA §207; California Labor Code §510; Davis-Bacon Act 40 U.S.C. §3141

attributes.name: rule_priority
attributes.description: Numeric priority rank used for conflict resolution when multiple OT rules are applicable to the same time entry (e.g., a worker in California on a government contract may have federal FLSA, California state, and Davis-Bacon rules all applicable). Lower integer = higher priority. Ensures deterministic OT rule selection in Kronos Workforce Ready and TempWorks Payroll.
attributes.references: ASA Best Practices; Kronos Workforce Ready; TempWorks Payroll

attributes.name: rule_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the OT rule record. 'active' = currently applied to time entry calculations; 'inactive' = disabled and not applied; 'draft' = under review before activation; 'superseded' = replaced by a newer rule version but retained for historical reference.
attributes.references: ASA Best Practices; Kronos Workforce Ready

attributes.name: rule_type
attributes.description: Classification of the overtime rule by its governing authority or applicability scope. 'federal' = FLSA-based federal standard; 'state' = state-specific labor law (e.g., California, Nevada); 'client_specific' = client-negotiated OT terms in MSA; 'prevailing_wage' = Davis-Bacon Act or SCA government contract rules; 'blended' = multi-assignment blended rate OT calculation.
attributes.references: FLSA §207; Davis-Bacon Act; Service Contract Act (SCA); ASA

attributes.name: seventh_day_dt_threshold_hours
attributes.business_glossary_term: Seventh Consecutive Day Double-Time (DT) Threshold Hours
attributes.description: On the seventh consecutive workday, the number of hours beyond which double-time pay applies (e.g., 8.00 hours per California Labor Code §510 — first 8 hours at OT, beyond 8 at DT). Null if seventh_day_ot_applies is False or if no DT tier applies on the seventh day.
attributes.references: California Labor Code §510; TempWorks Payroll

attributes.name: seventh_day_ot_applies
attributes.business_glossary_term: Seventh Consecutive Day Overtime (OT) Applies Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this rule includes the seventh-consecutive-day OT provision, where all hours worked on the seventh consecutive day of a workweek are paid at OT rate (True) per California Labor Code §510. False for rules that do not include this provision.
attributes.references: California Labor Code §510; DOL Wage and Hour Division

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Operational system of record from which this OT rule configuration was sourced or is mastered. 'kronos' = Kronos Workforce Ready time and attendance; 'tempworks' = TempWorks Payroll rule configuration; 'beeline' = Beeline VMS rate and rule management; 'manual' = manually entered by payroll or compliance team; 'bullhorn' = Bullhorn ATS/CRM placement configuration.
attributes.references: Kronos Workforce Ready; TempWorks Payroll; Beeline VMS; ASA

attributes.name: source_system_rule_ref
attributes.description: Native identifier of this OT rule in the originating operational system (e.g., Kronos Workforce Ready pay rule ID, TempWorks Payroll OT rule code). Enables reconciliation between the lakehouse silver layer and the source system for audit and troubleshooting purposes.
attributes.references: Kronos Workforce Ready; TempWorks Payroll; Beeline VMS

attributes.name: state_code
attributes.description: Two-letter U.S. state abbreviation (ISO 3166-2:US) identifying the state whose labor law governs this OT rule (e.g., 'CA' for California Labor Code §510, 'NV' for Nevada daily OT). Null for federal-level rules applicable nationwide. Used for multi-state OT rule resolution in Kronos Workforce Ready.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-2:US; California Labor Code §510; Nevada Revised Statutes §608.018

attributes.name: union_agreement_applies
attributes.description: Indicates whether this OT rule is governed by or must comply with a collective bargaining agreement (CBA) or union contract. True = union OT provisions apply and may override standard FLSA or state rules; False = no union agreement governs this rule. Relevant for unionized light industrial and healthcare staffing placements.
attributes.references: NLRA; DOL Wage and Hour Division; ASA; SHRM

attributes.name: union_agreement_reference
attributes.description: Identifier or name of the collective bargaining agreement (CBA) that governs this OT rule when union_agreement_applies is True (e.g., 'SEIU Local 1199 CBA 2023-2026', 'Teamsters Local 25 CBA'). Null when union_agreement_applies is False. Used for compliance documentation and payroll audit.
attributes.references: NLRA; DOL Wage and Hour Division; SHRM

attributes.name: weekly_dt_threshold_hours
attributes.description: Number of hours worked in a workweek beyond which double-time pay is triggered (e.g., some state or client rules apply DT after 60 hours/week). Null if the rule does not apply a weekly DT threshold. Distinct from the daily DT threshold.
attributes.references: California Labor Code §510; ASA Best Practices; TempWorks Payroll

attributes.name: weekly_ot_threshold_hours
attributes.description: Number of hours worked in a workweek beyond which overtime pay is triggered (e.g., 40.00 hours per FLSA §207 federal standard). Hours worked above this threshold are compensated at the OT multiplier rate. Null if the rule does not apply a weekly OT threshold.
attributes.references: FLSA §207; DOL Wage and Hour Division; TempWorks Payroll

attributes.name: worker_classification_scope
attributes.description: Worker tax classification to which this OT rule applies. 'w2_employee' = applies only to W-2 employees on payroll; '1099_ic' = applies to independent contractors (IC) per contract terms; 'all' = applies regardless of worker classification. Aligns with IRS worker classification rules and FLSA co-employment considerations.
attributes.references: IRS Worker Classification Rules; FLSA; INA I-9 Compliance; ASA

attributes.name: workweek_start_day
attributes.description: The designated first day of the workweek for purposes of weekly OT threshold calculation (e.g., 'sunday' for a Sunday–Saturday workweek per FLSA §207). Workweek definition is fixed and regularly recurring per FLSA. Configured in Kronos Workforce Ready per client or assignment. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: sunday|monday|tuesday|wednesday|thursday|friday|saturday — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: FLSA §207; DOL Wage and Hour Division; Kronos Workforce Ready

products.name: pay_period
products.description: Reference entity defining pay period cycles used across the staffing operation. Captures pay period type (weekly, bi-weekly, semi-monthly, monthly), period start date, period end date, payroll processing cutoff date, check date, fiscal week number, holiday adjustment flag, and active status. Serves as the authoritative calendar for timesheet grouping, payroll runs, and billing cycle alignment. Critical for multi-state operations where different clients may operate on different pay cycles.

attributes.name: pay_period_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each pay period record in the staffing operation. Primary key for the timesheet_pay_period reference entity. [_canonical_skip_reason: REFERENCE_LOOKUP — this entity is a calendar/reference table defining pay period cycles; per-role minimums do not apply, but comprehensive coverage is still provided for operational completeness.]
attributes.references: ASA Staffing Payroll Standards; TempWorks Payroll

attributes.name: applicable_states
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of U.S. state codes (e.g., 'CA,NY,TX') for which this pay period definition applies. Critical for multi-state staffing operations where state-specific payroll laws (e.g., California daily OT, New York wage payment frequency) require different pay period configurations. Supports SUTA and state tax compliance.
attributes.references: DOL (U.S. Department of Labor) State Wage Laws; SUTA (State Unemployment Tax Act); California Labor Code; New York Labor Law

attributes.name: approval_deadline
attributes.description: Precise timestamp by which client supervisors or staffing coordinators must approve submitted timesheets. Drives SLA enforcement for approval workflows and escalation triggers in Kronos Workforce Ready. Supports on-time payroll processing and client billing cycle alignment.
attributes.references: Kronos Workforce Ready; SLA (Service Level Agreement) Standards; ASA Staffing Payroll Standards

attributes.name: billing_cycle_date
attributes.description: The date on which client invoices are generated for billable hours worked during this pay period. May differ from check_date in cases where billing and payroll cycles are offset. Feeds Salesforce Revenue Cloud invoice generation and Oracle NetSuite Accounts Receivable.
attributes.references: Salesforce Revenue Cloud; Oracle NetSuite ERP; ASA Staffing Billing Standards

attributes.name: calendar_year
attributes.description: The standard calendar year (4-digit integer, e.g., 2024) to which this pay period belongs. Distinct from fiscal_year when the business operates on a non-calendar fiscal year. Used for W-2 and 1099 tax year alignment in TempWorks Payroll.
attributes.references: IRS W-2 (Wage and Tax Statement); IRS 1099 (Independent Contractor Tax Form); TempWorks Payroll

attributes.name: check_date
attributes.description: The date on which worker paychecks or direct deposit payments are issued for this pay period. Represents the actual pay date visible on W-2 wage statements and worker pay stubs. Used for tax reporting, FICA, FUTA, and SUTA liability calculations in TempWorks Payroll.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 15 (Circular E); W-2 (Wage and Tax Statement); FICA (Federal Insurance Contributions Act); FUTA (Federal Unemployment Tax Act); TempWorks Payroll

attributes.name: client_segment
attributes.description: Business segment or client grouping for which this pay period definition is applicable (e.g., 'Healthcare', 'Light Industrial', 'IT Staffing', 'All'). Supports multi-client staffing operations where different client verticals may operate on different pay cycles per MSA (Master Service Agreement) terms.
attributes.references: Bullhorn ATS/CRM; Beeline VMS; MSA (Master Service Agreement) Pay Cycle Terms; ASA Staffing Standards

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this pay period record was first created in the data platform. Used for audit trail, data lineage, and SOC 2 Type II compliance. Populated automatically at record insertion and never updated.
attributes.references: SOC 2 Type II (Service Organization Controls); GDPR Article 5 (Data Integrity and Accountability); CCPA

attributes.name: dt_threshold_hours
attributes.description: Number of hours worked beyond which double-time (DT) pay rates apply for this pay period. Applicable in states such as California where DT is mandated after 12 hours in a workday or on the 7th consecutive workday. Supports multi-state payroll compliance in TempWorks Payroll.
attributes.references: California Labor Code Section 510; FLSA (Fair Labor Standards Act); TempWorks Payroll; DOL (U.S. Department of Labor)

attributes.name: effective_from
attributes.business_glossary_term: Pay Period Definition Effective From Date
attributes.description: The date from which this pay period definition record became effective in the system. Supports slowly changing dimension (SCD) tracking for pay period calendar changes (e.g., a client switching from weekly to bi-weekly pay cycles). Enables historical payroll reprocessing and audit compliance.
attributes.references: SOC 2 Type II Data Governance; Oracle NetSuite ERP; TempWorks Payroll; FLSA Recordkeeping Requirements

attributes.name: effective_until
attributes.business_glossary_term: Pay Period Definition Effective Until Date
attributes.description: The date on which this pay period definition record ceases to be effective. Null indicates the record is currently active with no planned end date. Supports SCD Type 2 history tracking for pay period calendar changes and enables point-in-time payroll audit queries.
attributes.references: SOC 2 Type II Data Governance; Oracle NetSuite ERP; TempWorks Payroll; FLSA Recordkeeping Requirements

attributes.name: end_date
attributes.description: The last calendar date of the pay period. All timesheet hours submitted with a work date on or before this date are grouped into this pay period. Together with start_date, defines the authoritative time boundary for worker compensation and client billing.
attributes.references: FLSA (Fair Labor Standards Act) 29 CFR Part 516; Kronos Workforce Ready; TempWorks Payroll

attributes.name: fiscal_month
attributes.description: The fiscal month (1–12) within the fiscal year to which this pay period belongs. Supports monthly financial close processes in Oracle NetSuite ERP and monthly workforce analytics reporting in Power BI Analytics Platform.
attributes.references: Oracle NetSuite ERP; GAAP (Generally Accepted Accounting Principles); Power BI Analytics Platform

attributes.name: fiscal_quarter
attributes.description: The fiscal quarter (1–4) within the fiscal year to which this pay period belongs. Used for quarterly payroll tax filings (941, SUTA), financial reporting, and KPI dashboards in Power BI Analytics Platform.
attributes.references: IRS Form 941 (Employer's Quarterly Federal Tax Return); Oracle NetSuite ERP; FUTA; SUTA

attributes.name: fiscal_week_number
attributes.description: The sequential fiscal week number (1–53) within the fiscal year. Used for weekly labor analytics, overtime threshold tracking, and workforce scheduling reports in Kronos Workforce Ready and Power BI Analytics Platform. Particularly important for weekly pay period types.
attributes.references: Kronos Workforce Ready; FLSA (Fair Labor Standards Act) Overtime Rules; Power BI Analytics Platform

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: The fiscal year (4-digit integer, e.g., 2024) to which this pay period belongs. Used for financial reporting, budget allocation, and year-end tax filings in Oracle NetSuite ERP. Supports multi-year analytics in Power BI Analytics Platform.
attributes.references: Oracle NetSuite ERP; IRS Tax Reporting Requirements; GAAP (Generally Accepted Accounting Principles)

attributes.name: holiday_adjustment_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this pay period contains one or more observed holidays that affect standard workday counts, holiday pay eligibility, or payroll processing schedules. When True, payroll coordinators must review holiday pay rules and adjusted cutoff dates. Sourced from Kronos Workforce Ready holiday calendar.
attributes.references: Kronos Workforce Ready; FLSA (Fair Labor Standards Act); ASA Staffing Holiday Pay Standards

attributes.name: holiday_count
attributes.description: Number of observed holidays falling within this pay period. Used to calculate adjusted workday counts, holiday pay liability, and per diem adjustments. Supports holiday pay eligibility rules for temporary workers under client MSA (Master Service Agreement) terms.
attributes.references: Kronos Workforce Ready; MSA (Master Service Agreement) Holiday Pay Provisions; ASA Staffing Standards

attributes.name: is_active
attributes.description: Indicates whether this pay period record is currently active and available for timesheet assignment and payroll processing. False records represent historical, future-dated, or deactivated periods. Used to filter active periods in Kronos Workforce Ready scheduling and TempWorks Payroll run selection.
attributes.references: TempWorks Payroll; Kronos Workforce Ready

attributes.name: is_current_period
attributes.description: Indicates whether this is the currently active pay period (i.e., today's date falls within start_date and end_date). Only one record per period_type should have this flag set to True at any given time. Used as a quick filter in operational dashboards and payroll processing queues.
attributes.references: Kronos Workforce Ready; TempWorks Payroll; Power BI Analytics Platform

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for payroll coordinators to document special instructions, exceptions, or contextual information for this pay period (e.g., 'Adjusted cutoff due to Thanksgiving holiday', 'Early check date for Christmas week'). Supports operational communication and audit documentation.
attributes.references: TempWorks Payroll; ASA Staffing Payroll Standards; SOC 2 Type II Audit Trail Requirements

attributes.name: ot_threshold_hours
attributes.description: Number of hours worked beyond which overtime (OT) pay rates apply for this pay period. Typically 40.00 hours for weekly FLSA overtime, but may vary by state law (e.g., California daily OT at 8 hours). Critical for payroll compliance and accurate OT cost calculations in TempWorks Payroll.
attributes.references: FLSA (Fair Labor Standards Act) 29 CFR Part 778; California Labor Code Section 510; TempWorks Payroll; DOL (U.S. Department of Labor)

attributes.name: payroll_cutoff_date
attributes.description: The deadline by which all timesheets must be submitted and approved for inclusion in this pay period's payroll run. Timesheets received after this date are held for the next pay period or processed as off-cycle adjustments. Operationally critical for TempWorks Payroll batch processing.
attributes.references: TempWorks Payroll; ASA Staffing Payroll Standards; FLSA (Fair Labor Standards Act)

attributes.name: payroll_provider_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the payroll processing provider or entity responsible for executing payroll for this pay period (e.g., 'TEMPWORKS', 'EOR_PARTNER_01'). Relevant for EOR (Employer of Record) arrangements where a third-party provider processes payroll on behalf of the staffing firm.
attributes.references: TempWorks Payroll; EOR (Employer of Record) Standards; NAPEO (National Association of Professional Employer Organizations)

attributes.name: payroll_run_type
attributes.description: Classifies the type of payroll run associated with this pay period. regular = standard scheduled payroll; off_cycle = unscheduled run for missed payments or terminations; supplemental = bonus or commission payments; correction = retroactive adjustment for prior period errors. Drives payroll processing logic in TempWorks Payroll.
attributes.references: TempWorks Payroll; IRS Publication 15 (Circular E); ASA Staffing Payroll Standards

attributes.name: per_diem_period_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether per diem allowances are applicable and tracked within this pay period. When True, per diem expense records are expected to be submitted alongside timesheets. Relevant for travel-intensive placements (e.g., healthcare travel nurses, field technicians) where IRS per diem rates apply.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 463 (Travel Expenses); GSA Per Diem Rates; TempWorks Payroll; ASA Staffing Standards

attributes.name: period_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric code uniquely identifying this pay period across systems (e.g., PP-2024-01-001). Used for cross-system reconciliation between Kronos Workforce Ready, TempWorks Payroll, and Salesforce Revenue Cloud billing cycles.
attributes.references: TempWorks Payroll; Kronos Workforce Ready; ASA Staffing Payroll Standards

attributes.name: period_name
attributes.description: Human-readable label for the pay period (e.g., 'Week 1 Jan 2024', 'Bi-Weekly Period 3 - Q1 2024'). Used in payroll reports, worker pay stubs, and client billing statements for clear period identification.
attributes.references: TempWorks Payroll; FLSA Recordkeeping Requirements (29 CFR Part 516)

attributes.name: period_sequence_number
attributes.description: Sequential ordinal number of this pay period within its fiscal year and period type (e.g., 1st bi-weekly period = 1, 2nd = 2). Used for period-over-period comparison analytics, payroll run ordering, and audit trail sequencing.
attributes.references: TempWorks Payroll; ASA Staffing Payroll Standards; Power BI Analytics Platform

attributes.name: period_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the pay period. open = timesheets can be submitted; processing = payroll run in progress; locked = no further timesheet changes permitted; closed = payroll finalized and disbursed; cancelled = period voided (rare, e.g., system error). Drives workflow gating in TempWorks Payroll and Kronos Workforce Ready.
attributes.references: TempWorks Payroll; Kronos Workforce Ready; ASA Staffing Payroll Standards

attributes.name: period_type
attributes.description: Classification of the pay period cycle frequency. Weekly = 52 periods/year; bi_weekly = 26 periods/year; semi_monthly = 24 periods/year; monthly = 12 periods/year. Critical for multi-client operations where different clients may operate on different pay cycles. Drives payroll run scheduling in TempWorks Payroll.
attributes.references: FLSA (Fair Labor Standards Act) 29 CFR Part 778; TempWorks Payroll; ASA Staffing Payroll Standards

attributes.name: pto_accrual_period_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Paid Time Off (PTO) Accrual Period Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether PTO (Paid Time Off) accruals are calculated and posted during this pay period. Some staffing arrangements accrue PTO on a per-pay-period basis per state law (e.g., California AB 1522, New York Paid Sick Leave). Drives PTO accrual batch processing in TempWorks Payroll and SAP SuccessFactors.
attributes.references: California AB 1522 (Healthy Workplaces Healthy Families Act); New York Paid Sick Leave Law; TempWorks Payroll; SAP SuccessFactors; DOL (U.S. Department of Labor)

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Identifies the operational system of record from which this pay period definition originated. Kronos Workforce Ready is the primary source for time and attendance pay period calendars; TempWorks Payroll for payroll-specific period definitions; Beeline VMS for contingent workforce program pay cycles. Supports data lineage and reconciliation.
attributes.references: Kronos Workforce Ready; TempWorks Payroll; Beeline VMS; SOC 2 Type II Data Lineage Requirements

attributes.name: source_system_period_ref
attributes.description: The native identifier of this pay period record in the originating source system (e.g., Kronos pay period ID, TempWorks period key). Used for cross-system reconciliation, data lineage tracing, and integration audit trails between the lakehouse silver layer and operational systems.
attributes.references: Kronos Workforce Ready; TempWorks Payroll; SOC 2 Type II Data Lineage Requirements

attributes.name: standard_hours
attributes.description: Expected number of standard straight-time hours for a full-time worker during this pay period (e.g., 40.00 for a weekly period, 80.00 for bi-weekly). Used as the baseline for overtime (OT) threshold calculations, FTE normalization, and payroll burden rate computations.
attributes.references: FLSA (Fair Labor Standards Act) 29 CFR Part 778; Kronos Workforce Ready; TempWorks Payroll

attributes.name: start_date
attributes.description: The first calendar date of the pay period. All timesheet hours submitted with a work date on or after this date are grouped into this pay period. Authoritative boundary for timesheet aggregation and payroll processing.
attributes.references: FLSA (Fair Labor Standards Act) 29 CFR Part 516; Kronos Workforce Ready; TempWorks Payroll

attributes.name: tax_year
attributes.description: The IRS tax year (4-digit integer) to which payroll taxes for this period are reported. Typically matches calendar_year but may differ for periods spanning year-end (e.g., a bi-weekly period starting Dec 28 and ending Jan 10). Critical for W-2, 1099, FICA, FUTA, and SUTA tax filing accuracy.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 15 (Circular E); W-2 (Wage and Tax Statement); 1099 (Independent Contractor Tax Form); FICA; FUTA; SUTA

attributes.name: timesheet_submission_deadline
attributes.description: Precise timestamp by which contingent workers must submit their timesheets for the pay period. Includes time-of-day precision to support automated reminder workflows in Kronos Workforce Ready and Bullhorn ATS/CRM. Distinct from payroll_cutoff_date which governs the payroll processing batch.
attributes.references: Kronos Workforce Ready; TempWorks Payroll; ASA Staffing Payroll Standards

attributes.name: total_calendar_days
attributes.description: Total number of calendar days in this pay period (end_date minus start_date plus 1). Used for pro-ration calculations for partial-period placements, per diem allowance calculations, and FTE (Full-Time Equivalent) normalization in workforce analytics.
attributes.references: FLSA (Fair Labor Standards Act); ASA Staffing Payroll Standards; FTE (Full-Time Equivalent) Calculation Standards

attributes.name: total_workdays
attributes.description: Number of standard business workdays (Monday–Friday, excluding holidays) within this pay period. Used for expected hours calculations, attendance rate reporting, and workforce scheduling in Kronos Workforce Ready. Supports SLA (Service Level Agreement) headcount compliance reporting.
attributes.references: Kronos Workforce Ready; FLSA (Fair Labor Standards Act); ASA Staffing Workforce Standards

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to this pay period record in the data platform. Used for change tracking, incremental data pipeline processing, and audit compliance. Updated automatically on every record modification.
attributes.references: SOC 2 Type II (Service Organization Controls); GDPR Article 5 (Data Integrity and Accountability); CCPA

attributes.name: vms_program_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this pay period is associated with a VMS (Vendor Management System) managed contingent workforce program (e.g., Beeline VMS). VMS programs may have distinct pay period calendars, approval workflows, and billing cycle alignment requirements separate from direct-client placements.
attributes.references: Beeline VMS; VMS (Vendor Management System) Program Standards; ASA Staffing Standards

attributes.name: year_end_period_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this pay period spans or falls at the calendar year-end boundary (e.g., a bi-weekly period crossing December 31 into January). When True, special year-end payroll processing rules apply including W-2 cutoff handling, FICA wage base reset, and FUTA/SUTA annual limit resets in TempWorks Payroll.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 15 (Circular E); W-2 (Wage and Tax Statement); FICA Wage Base; FUTA Annual Limit; TempWorks Payroll

products.name: approved_hours_summary
products.description: Unified aggregated summary of approved hours for a worker-assignment-client combination within a pay period, broken down by pay type (regular, OT, DT, per diem, holiday). Serves as the single authoritative handoff record for both client invoice generation (billing domain) and payroll processing (payroll domain). Captures total regular hours, OT hours, DT hours, per diem units, bill rate applied, pay rate applied, total billable amount, total payable amount, burden rate components, approval confirmation flag, and payroll transmission status. Replaces separate billable and payable hour summaries to ensure a single reconciled SSOT. Distinct from raw time_entry records — this is the approved, billing-and-payroll-ready output of the timesheet approval process.

attributes.name: client_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the client (end-customer) for whom the worker performed services during this pay period. Used to route billable amounts to the correct client invoice.
attributes.references: Bullhorn ATS/CRM; Salesforce Revenue Cloud

attributes.references: Bullhorn ATS/CRM; Beeline VMS

attributes.references: TempWorks Payroll; Kronos Workforce Ready

attributes.name: pay_stub_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to payroll.pay_stub. Business justification: Approved hours summaries feed directly into pay stub generation. This link enables reconciliation between approved billable hours and actual payment, critical for payroll audit, variance analysis, and

attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: profile_id
attributes.description: Reference to the contingent worker whose approved hours are summarized in this record. Links to the worker master record in the Candidate/Worker domain.
attributes.references: Bullhorn ATS/CRM; Kronos Workforce Ready

attributes.name: staff_profile_id
attributes.description: Reference to the individual (typically the client supervisor or staffing coordinator) who formally approved the timesheet hours for this pay period.
attributes.references: Kronos Workforce Ready; Bullhorn ATS/CRM

attributes.name: timesheet_id
attributes.description: Reference to the source timesheet record from which this approved hours summary was derived. Provides traceability back to the raw time entry data in Kronos Workforce Ready.
attributes.references: Kronos Workforce Ready

attributes.name: amendment_reason
attributes.description: Free-text description of the reason for any post-approval amendment to this hours summary. Required when is_amended is True. Supports audit trail and dispute resolution.
attributes.references: SOC 2 Type II; FLSA; DOL Wage and Hour Division; ASA Best Practices

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the approved hours summary record within the timesheet approval workflow. 'approved' indicates hours are cleared for billing and payroll; 'disputed' indicates a client or worker challenge is open; 'amended' indicates a post-approval correction was applied.
attributes.references: Kronos Workforce Ready; ASA Best Practices; FLSA

attributes.name: approval_timestamp
attributes.description: The exact date and time when the timesheet hours were formally approved by the authorized approver. Represents the principal business event timestamp that triggers downstream billing and payroll processing.
attributes.references: Kronos Workforce Ready; FLSA; DOL Wage and Hour Division

attributes.name: bill_rate
attributes.description: The hourly rate charged to the client for the worker's regular hours during this pay period, as defined in the client MSA or VMS rate card. Expressed in USD per hour. Used to calculate total billable amount.
attributes.references: Beeline VMS; Salesforce Revenue Cloud; MSA; ASA Best Practices

attributes.name: billing_transmission_status
attributes.description: Indicates the current state of this approved hours summary's transmission to the client billing system (Salesforce Revenue Cloud). 'invoiced' means a client invoice has been generated from this record.
attributes.references: Salesforce Revenue Cloud; ASA Best Practices

attributes.name: burden_rate_pct
attributes.description: The total employer burden rate applied to this worker's payable wages for the pay period, expressed as a decimal percentage. Encompasses FICA, FUTA, SUTA, Workers Compensation (Workers Comp), and benefits costs. Used to calculate fully-loaded labor cost.
attributes.references: IRS FICA; FUTA; SUTA; Workers Compensation; TempWorks Payroll; DOL

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this approved hours summary record was first created in the Silver Layer. Supports audit trail and data lineage requirements.
attributes.references: SOC 2 Type II; GDPR Article 5; CCPA

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for all monetary amounts in this record (e.g., USD, CAD, GBP). Supports multi-currency operations for international staffing engagements.
attributes.references: ISO 4217; Oracle NetSuite ERP; Salesforce Revenue Cloud

attributes.name: dt_bill_rate
attributes.description: The hourly rate charged to the client for double-time (DT) hours during this pay period. Typically 2x the regular bill rate per the client MSA or applicable state labor law.
attributes.references: Beeline VMS; Salesforce Revenue Cloud; MSA; California Labor Code; FLSA

attributes.name: dt_hours
attributes.description: Total approved double-time (DT) hours worked during the pay period, applicable in jurisdictions or client agreements requiring 2x pay for hours beyond a daily or weekly threshold (e.g., California daily OT rules).
attributes.references: FLSA; California Labor Code; DOL Wage and Hour Division; Kronos Workforce Ready

attributes.name: flsa_exemption_status
attributes.business_glossary_term: Fair Labor Standards Act (FLSA) Exemption Status
attributes.description: Indicates whether the worker is classified as exempt or non-exempt under the Fair Labor Standards Act (FLSA) for this assignment. Non-exempt workers are entitled to overtime pay at 1.5x for hours exceeding 40 per week.
attributes.references: FLSA; DOL Wage and Hour Division; EEOC

attributes.name: gross_margin_amount
attributes.description: The gross margin (Spread) for this pay period, calculated as total_billable_amount minus total_payable_amount minus burden costs. Represents the staffing agency's gross profit contribution from this worker-assignment combination before SG&A.
attributes.references: Oracle NetSuite ERP; ASA Best Practices; SIA Financial Benchmarks

attributes.name: holiday_hours
attributes.description: Total approved hours worked on designated company or client holidays during the pay period. Holiday hours may carry a premium bill rate and pay rate per the client MSA or worker agreement.
attributes.references: Kronos Workforce Ready; DOL; ASA Best Practices

attributes.name: is_amended
attributes.description: Indicates whether this approved hours summary record has been amended after initial approval (e.g., due to a timesheet correction, missed punch adjustment, or retroactive rate change). True triggers a reconciliation process in payroll and billing.
attributes.references: TempWorks Payroll; Salesforce Revenue Cloud; FLSA; DOL

attributes.name: is_approved
attributes.description: Boolean flag confirming that all hours in this summary have been formally approved by an authorized approver. True indicates the record is cleared for payroll and billing handoff. False indicates approval is still pending or was revoked.
attributes.references: Kronos Workforce Ready; FLSA; DOL Wage and Hour Division

attributes.name: ot_bill_rate
attributes.description: The hourly rate charged to the client for overtime (OT) hours during this pay period. Typically 1.5x the regular bill rate, but may be negotiated differently in the client MSA.
attributes.references: Beeline VMS; Salesforce Revenue Cloud; MSA; FLSA

attributes.name: ot_hours
attributes.description: Total approved overtime (OT) hours worked during the pay period, typically hours exceeding 40 per week for non-exempt workers under FLSA. Billed and paid at the OT multiplier rate (commonly 1.5x).
attributes.references: FLSA; DOL Wage and Hour Division; Kronos Workforce Ready

attributes.name: pay_period_end_date
attributes.description: The last calendar date of the pay period covered by this approved hours summary. Defines the inclusive end boundary for all hours aggregated in this record.
attributes.references: FLSA; TempWorks Payroll; DOL Wage and Hour Division

attributes.name: pay_period_start_date
attributes.description: The first calendar date of the pay period covered by this approved hours summary. Defines the inclusive start boundary for all hours aggregated in this record.
attributes.references: FLSA; TempWorks Payroll; DOL Wage and Hour Division

attributes.name: pay_rate
attributes.description: The hourly rate paid to the worker for regular hours during this pay period, as defined in the worker's placement agreement. Expressed in USD per hour. Used to calculate total payable amount and gross margin (Spread).
attributes.references: TempWorks Payroll; FLSA; DOL Wage and Hour Division; IRS

attributes.name: payroll_transmission_status
attributes.description: Indicates the current state of this approved hours summary's transmission to the payroll processing system (TempWorks Payroll). 'confirmed' means payroll has acknowledged receipt and the record is locked for the pay run.
attributes.references: TempWorks Payroll; DOL Wage and Hour Division; FLSA

attributes.name: per_diem_rate
attributes.description: The daily per diem allowance rate paid to the worker per approved per diem unit. Must not exceed IRS-published per diem limits to maintain tax-free treatment. Expressed in USD per day.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 463; IRS Per Diem Rates; TempWorks Payroll; DOL

attributes.name: per_diem_units
attributes.description: Number of per diem units (typically days) approved for the worker during the pay period. Per diem is a daily allowance paid to workers for meals, lodging, or incidentals when working away from their tax home. Not subject to payroll taxes when within IRS limits.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 463; IRS Per Diem Rates; DOL; TempWorks Payroll

attributes.name: pto_hours
attributes.description: Total approved paid time off (PTO) hours for the worker during the pay period. PTO hours are payable to the worker but are typically not billable to the client unless specified in the MSA.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors; TempWorks Payroll; DOL; FLSA

attributes.name: regular_hours
attributes.description: Total approved regular (straight-time) hours worked by the worker during the pay period, excluding overtime and double-time. Used as the base quantity for both client billing and worker payroll at the standard bill rate and pay rate respectively.
attributes.references: FLSA; Kronos Workforce Ready; DOL Wage and Hour Division

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Identifies the operational system of record from which this approved hours summary was sourced or triggered. Kronos Workforce Ready is the primary source; Beeline VMS may be the source for MSP-managed programs; Manual indicates a staffing coordinator override entry.
attributes.references: Kronos Workforce Ready; Beeline VMS; Bullhorn ATS/CRM; SOC 2 Type II

attributes.name: summary_number
attributes.description: Externally-visible business identifier for this approved hours summary record, formatted as AHS-{YYYY}-{WW}-{SEQUENCE}. Used in billing and payroll correspondence to reference a specific approved period.
attributes.references: Staffing Hr Internal Data Standards; ASA Best Practices

attributes.name: total_billable_amount
attributes.description: Total gross amount to be invoiced to the client for this pay period, calculated as the sum of (regular_hours × bill_rate) + (ot_hours × ot_bill_rate) + (dt_hours × dt_bill_rate) + (holiday_hours × applicable holiday bill rate). Feeds Salesforce Revenue Cloud invoice generation.
attributes.references: Salesforce Revenue Cloud; ASA Best Practices; SIA

attributes.name: total_hours
attributes.description: Sum of all approved hour types (regular + OT + DT + holiday) for the worker during the pay period. Represents the total time-based quantity used for workforce analytics and FTE calculations. Excludes PTO hours.
attributes.references: Kronos Workforce Ready; DOL; ASA Best Practices; SIA

attributes.name: total_payable_amount
attributes.description: Total gross wages payable to the worker for this pay period, calculated as the sum of (regular_hours × pay_rate) + (ot_hours × ot_pay_rate) + (dt_hours × dt_pay_rate) + (holiday_hours × holiday pay rate) + (per_diem_units × per_diem_rate). Feeds TempWorks Payroll processing.
attributes.references: TempWorks Payroll; FLSA; DOL Wage and Hour Division; IRS

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this approved hours summary record was last modified. Tracks amendments such as retroactive adjustments or correction reprocessing.
attributes.references: SOC 2 Type II; GDPR Article 5; CCPA

attributes.name: vms_requisition_number
attributes.description: The requisition or purchase order number assigned by the client's Vendor Management System (VMS), such as Beeline, for this worker's engagement. Required on client invoices for MSP-managed programs.
attributes.references: Beeline VMS; MSA; SOW

attributes.name: work_location_type
attributes.description: Indicates whether the worker performed services on-site at the client location, fully remote, or in a hybrid arrangement during this pay period. Affects per diem eligibility and certain state tax obligations.
attributes.references: DOL; IRS Worker Classification Rules; FLSA

attributes.name: worker_type
attributes.description: Classification of the worker's tax and employment relationship for this assignment. W-2 indicates a staffing agency employee; 1099 indicates an independent contractor (IC); C2C indicates a corp-to-corp engagement. Drives payroll tax treatment and burden rate application.
attributes.references: IRS Worker Classification Rules; IRS Form W-2; IRS Form 1099; FLSA; DOL

attributes.name: workers_comp_code
attributes.description: The National Council on Compensation Insurance (NCCI) workers compensation class code assigned to the worker for this assignment. Determines the workers comp insurance premium rate applied within the burden rate calculation.
attributes.references: NCCI Workers Compensation Classification; OSHA; TempWorks Payroll; DOL

Feeds both payroll (non-taxable reimbursements) and billing (client-billable per diem charges).

attributes.name: claim_status

attributes.name: claimed_amount

attributes.name: client_bill_amount

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this per diem claim record was first created in the system. Serves as the audit trail creation marker for data governance, SOC 2 compliance, and record lineage tracking.
attributes.references: SOC 2 Type II; GDPR Article 5; CCPA; Internal Data Governance Standard

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary amounts on this claim record. Defaults to USD for domestic assignments. Required for international assignments to support multi-currency payroll and billing.
attributes.references: ISO 4217; IRS Publication 463; Oracle NetSuite ERP

attributes.name: gsa_locality_code
attributes.description: The General Services Administration (GSA) locality code corresponding to the expense location. Used to precisely identify the applicable per diem rate tier for the city/county, especially for high-cost localities that exceed the standard continental US (CONUS) rate.
attributes.references: GSA Per Diem Rates; IRS Publication 463; IRS Revenue Procedure 2019-48

attributes.name: irs_per_diem_rate
attributes.description: The applicable IRS/GSA standard per diem rate for the expense location and claim date at the time of submission. Used as the reference ceiling for non-taxable reimbursement treatment. Amounts at or below this rate are non-taxable; amounts above are treated as taxable wages. Denominated in USD.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 463; IRS Revenue Procedure 2019-48; GSA Per Diem Rates; IRS Notice 2021-52

attributes.name: irs_rate_year
attributes.description: The fiscal year of the IRS/GSA per diem rate table used to determine the applicable rate for this claim. IRS per diem rates are updated annually; this field ensures the correct rate schedule is referenced for audit and compliance purposes.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 463; IRS Revenue Procedure (annual); GSA Per Diem Rates

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional context, worker-provided justification, or operational notes related to the per diem claim. May include travel purpose, special circumstances, or client-specific instructions. Not used for approval decisions.
attributes.references: Internal Staffing Operations Standard; ASA Best Practices

attributes.name: partial_day_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the per diem claim is for a partial day (e.g., first or last day of travel). IRS rules require a 75% rate reduction for the first and last day of travel. When true, the claimed amount should reflect the reduced partial-day rate.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 463; IRS Revenue Procedure 2019-48; GSA Per Diem Policy

attributes.name: payroll_processed
attributes.description: Indicates whether the approved per diem reimbursement has been included in a payroll run and disbursed to the worker. Prevents duplicate payroll processing and supports reconciliation between per diem claims and payroll records.
attributes.references: TempWorks Payroll; DOL FLSA; IRS Publication 15

attributes.name: per_diem_type
attributes.description: Classification of the per diem allowance category being claimed. Determines applicable IRS GSA rate, taxability treatment, and whether the expense is billable to the client. Valid values: travel, lodging, meals, incidentals, meals_and_incidentals (M&IE combined rate).
attributes.references: IRS Publication 463; IRS Revenue Procedure 2019-48; GSA Per Diem Rates; ASA Guidelines

attributes.name: receipt_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether a receipt or supporting documentation is required for this per diem claim based on the per diem type, claimed amount, or client policy. Lodging per diem typically requires receipts; meals and incidentals under the GSA rate generally do not.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 463; IRS Revenue Procedure 2019-48; FCRA; Client MSA Terms

attributes.name: receipt_submitted
attributes.description: Indicates whether the worker has submitted a receipt or supporting documentation for this per diem claim. Used in the approval workflow to enforce receipt requirements and for IRS substantiation compliance.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 463; IRS Revenue Procedure 2019-48; SOC 2 Type II

attributes.name: rejection_reason
attributes.description: Free-text explanation provided by the approver when a per diem claim is rejected. Required when claim_status is 'rejected'. Supports worker communication, dispute resolution, and process improvement analytics.
attributes.references: Internal Staffing Operations Standard; ASA Best Practices

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: The operational system of record from which this per diem claim originated. Supports data lineage, reconciliation, and audit traceability across integrated platforms. Valid values: Kronos (Kronos Workforce Ready), TempWorks (TempWorks Payroll), Bullhorn (Bullhorn ATS/CRM), Beeline (Beeline VMS), Manual (direct entry).
attributes.references: SOC 2 Type II; Internal Data Governance Standard

attributes.name: source_system_claim_ref
attributes.description: The native identifier or reference number assigned to this per diem claim in the originating source system (e.g., Kronos expense record ID, TempWorks reimbursement reference). Supports cross-system reconciliation and data lineage tracing.
attributes.references: SOC 2 Type II; Internal Data Governance Standard; Kronos Workforce Ready

attributes.name: submission_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the worker formally submitted the per diem claim for approval. Used for SLA tracking, audit trails, and late-submission compliance monitoring.
attributes.references: Internal Staffing Operations Standard; SOC 2 Type II

attributes.name: taxable_amount
attributes.description: The portion of the approved per diem amount that exceeds the IRS/GSA standard rate and must be treated as taxable wages subject to FICA, FUTA, SUTA, and income tax withholding. Calculated as max(0, approved_amount - irs_per_diem_rate). Feeds TempWorks Payroll tax processing.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 463; IRS Revenue Procedure 2019-48; FICA; FUTA; SUTA; DOL FLSA

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this per diem claim record was last modified. Tracks the most recent change for audit trail, data freshness monitoring, and incremental ETL processing in the Databricks Silver Layer.
attributes.references: SOC 2 Type II; GDPR Article 5; CCPA; Internal Data Governance Standard

attributes.name: work_week_ending_date
attributes.description: The last day of the payroll work week to which this per diem claim belongs. Used to align per diem reimbursements with the correct payroll processing cycle in TempWorks Payroll and to match the corresponding timesheet period.
attributes.references: DOL FLSA; TempWorks Payroll; Kronos Workforce Ready

products.name: adjustment
products.description: Records post-submission corrections and amendments to approved timesheets, capturing the original timesheet reference, adjustment type (hours correction, rate correction, pay type reclassification, retroactive change), original values, adjusted values, adjustment reason, requestor, approver, and effective pay period. Maintains a complete audit trail of all timesheet modifications for compliance, dispute resolution, and payroll/billing reconciliation.

attributes.name: adjustment_type

attributes.name: affects_billing

attributes.name: affects_payroll
attributes.description: Indicates whether this timesheet adjustment impacts worker payable hours or pay rates, requiring a payroll correction or supplemental pay run. False for adjustments that only affect billing (e.g., bill rate corrections with no pay rate change).
attributes.references: TempWorks Payroll — Payroll Adjustment Rules; FLSA Recordkeeping Requirements

attributes.name: applied_to_billing_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the approved adjustment was applied to client billing in Salesforce Revenue Cloud. Null until billing is updated. Confirms the client invoice or credit memo has been generated for the adjustment.

attributes.name: applied_to_payroll_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the approved adjustment was applied to the payroll run in TempWorks Payroll. Null until the adjustment is processed. Confirms the adjustment has been actioned in the payroll system of record.
attributes.references: TempWorks Payroll — Payroll Run Processing; FLSA Recordkeeping Requirements

attributes.name: approval_level
attributes.description: Indicates the approval tier required for this adjustment based on the adjustment type, dollar impact, or client contract requirements. Single-level approvals are handled internally; dual or client-required approvals involve additional stakeholders.
attributes.references: Kronos Workforce Ready — Approval Workflow Configuration; Beeline VMS — Approval Rules; MSA Compliance

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the timesheet adjustment was approved by the designated approver. Null if not yet approved. Used for approval cycle time analytics and SLA compliance reporting.
attributes.references: Kronos Workforce Ready — Approval Workflow; SOC 2 Type II Audit Trail

attributes.name: bill_amount_adjusted
attributes.description: The corrected gross client billing amount (in USD) after the adjustment. Drives credit memo issuance or supplemental invoice generation in Salesforce Revenue Cloud. Part of MONETARY_TRIPLET canonical category.
attributes.references: Salesforce Revenue Cloud — Invoice Amount; Oracle NetSuite ERP — Accounts Receivable; ASA Billing Best Practices

attributes.name: bill_amount_original
attributes.description: The gross client billing amount (in USD) calculated from the original timesheet hours and bill rate before adjustment. Baseline for client invoice reconciliation and credit memo calculation.
attributes.references: Salesforce Revenue Cloud — Invoice Amount; Oracle NetSuite ERP — Accounts Receivable; ASA Billing Best Practices

attributes.name: bill_rate_adjusted
attributes.description: The corrected client bill rate (per hour) in USD after the adjustment. Used when a rate correction changes the amount invoiced to the client. Drives credit memo or supplemental invoice generation.
attributes.references: Salesforce Revenue Cloud — Bill Rate; Beeline VMS — Rate Management; ASA Billing Best Practices

attributes.name: bill_rate_original
attributes.description: The client bill rate (per hour) recorded on the original timesheet, in USD. Preserved for billing reconciliation when rate corrections affect client invoices. Represents the rate charged to the client before adjustment.
attributes.references: Salesforce Revenue Cloud — Bill Rate; Beeline VMS — Rate Management; ASA Billing Best Practices

attributes.name: client_approved
attributes.description: Indicates whether the client has formally approved the timesheet adjustment, required when the adjustment affects billable hours or bill rates under the client's Master Service Agreement (MSA). True when client sign-off is obtained.
attributes.references: Beeline VMS — Client Approval Workflow; DocuSign CLM — MSA Terms; ASA Client Billing Best Practices

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this timesheet adjustment record was first created in the system. Maps to the RECORD_AUDIT_CREATED canonical category for TRANSACTION_HEADER role. Used for data lineage and audit trail.
attributes.references: SOC 2 Type II Audit Trail; GDPR Article 5 (Data Integrity); CCPA Recordkeeping

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for all monetary amounts on this adjustment record (e.g., USD). Supports multi-currency operations for international staffing engagements. Part of MONETARY_TRIPLET canonical category.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; Oracle NetSuite ERP — Multi-Currency; GAAP Revenue Recognition

attributes.name: hours_adjusted
attributes.description: The corrected number of hours after the adjustment is applied. Replaces the original hours value for payroll processing and client billing. The difference between hours_adjusted and hours_original represents the net hours change.
attributes.references: Kronos Workforce Ready — Time Record; FLSA Recordkeeping Requirements (29 CFR Part 516)

attributes.name: hours_original
attributes.description: The number of hours recorded on the original approved timesheet for the work date and pay type being corrected. Preserved as the pre-adjustment baseline for audit, dispute resolution, and reconciliation.
attributes.references: Kronos Workforce Ready — Time Record; FLSA Recordkeeping Requirements (29 CFR Part 516)

attributes.name: is_retroactive
attributes.description: Indicates whether this adjustment applies to a prior pay period that has already been processed in payroll and/or billing. Retroactive adjustments require special handling in payroll tax recalculation (FICA, FUTA, SUTA) and may trigger amended invoices.
attributes.references: TempWorks Payroll — Retroactive Pay Processing; IRS Publication 15 — Supplemental Wages; FLSA Recordkeeping

attributes.name: pay_amount_adjusted
attributes.description: The corrected gross worker pay amount (in USD) after the adjustment is applied. Represents the authoritative payable amount for the adjusted period. The difference from pay_amount_original drives payroll debit or credit entries. Maps to MONETARY_TRIPLET canonical category.
attributes.references: TempWorks Payroll — Gross Pay Calculation; FLSA Recordkeeping Requirements; IRS Publication 15

attributes.name: pay_amount_original
attributes.description: The gross worker pay amount (in USD) calculated from the original timesheet hours and pay rate before adjustment. Serves as the financial baseline for payroll reconciliation and adjustment impact analysis.
attributes.references: TempWorks Payroll — Gross Pay Calculation; FLSA Recordkeeping Requirements; IRS Publication 15

attributes.name: pay_period_end_date
attributes.description: The last calendar date of the pay period to which this adjustment applies. Together with pay_period_start_date, defines the exact payroll cycle impacted by the correction.
attributes.references: TempWorks Payroll — Pay Period Configuration; FLSA Recordkeeping Requirements (29 CFR Part 516)

attributes.name: pay_period_start_date
attributes.description: The first calendar date of the pay period to which this adjustment applies. Determines which payroll run and billing cycle are affected by the correction.
attributes.references: TempWorks Payroll — Pay Period Configuration; FLSA Recordkeeping Requirements (29 CFR Part 516)

attributes.name: pay_rate_adjusted
attributes.description: The corrected worker pay rate (per hour) in USD after the adjustment. Used for rate correction and retroactive change adjustment types. Drives recalculation of worker gross pay for the affected period.
attributes.references: TempWorks Payroll — Pay Rate; FLSA Minimum Wage and Overtime Rules; IRS Publication 15

attributes.name: pay_rate_original
attributes.description: The worker pay rate (per hour) recorded on the original timesheet, in USD. Preserved for rate correction adjustments and retroactive pay rate changes. Sensitive compensation data.
attributes.references: TempWorks Payroll — Pay Rate; FLSA Minimum Wage and Overtime Rules; IRS Publication 15

attributes.name: pay_type_adjusted

Used when a pay type reclassification adjustment is applied (e.g., regular hours reclassified as overtime (OT) or double-time (DT)). Drives recalculation of worker pay and client bill amounts. Preserved for full audit trail and reclassification tracking. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: regular|overtime|double_time|per_diem|pto|holiday|on_call — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: TempWorks Payroll — Pay Type Configuration; FLSA Section 7 (OT/DT Rules); IRS Publication 15

attributes.name: requestor_role

attributes.name: source_system

products.name: punch_event
products.description: Raw, immutable clock event record capturing individual worker punch-in and punch-out events from Kronos Workforce Ready time clocks, mobile apps, or web portals. Stores the exact UTC timestamp, punch type (in/out/break-start/break-end/transfer), device ID, location coordinates, geofence validation result, biometric verification flag, IP address, and raw source payload. Multiple punch events are processed into a single time_entry record. Serves as the tamper-proof audit-grade source record for FLSA compliance, wage-and-hour dispute resolution, and DOL audit defense. Retention policy: minimum 3 years per FLSA recordkeeping requirements.
