The FLSA workweek is fixed and recurring, defined per employer or client site. Critical for accurate overtime calculation — OT is calculated per workweek, not per pay period.
attributes.references: FLSA 29 CFR Part 778.105 — Workweek Defined; DOL Wage and Hour Division

attributes.name: geofence_validated
attributes.description: Indicates whether the punch event location coordinates fell within the approved geofence boundary for the assigned worksite at the time of the punch. True: worker was within the geofenced zone; False: worker was outside the boundary, triggering an exception alert. Null if geofence validation was not applicable (e.g., physical time clock punch).
attributes.references: Kronos Workforce Ready Geofence Configuration; FLSA 29 CFR Part 516

attributes.name: grace_period_applied
attributes.description: Indicates whether a Kronos grace period rule was applied to this punch event, allowing a small window (e.g., 5 minutes) before or after the scheduled time without triggering an exception or early/late flag. Supports schedule adherence reporting accuracy.
attributes.references: Kronos Workforce Ready Grace Period Configuration; FLSA 29 CFR Part 785

attributes.name: ingestion_timestamp
attributes.description: The UTC timestamp when this punch event record was first ingested into the Databricks Silver layer from the Kronos source system. Serves as the RECORD_AUDIT_CREATED marker for data lineage, SLA monitoring of data pipeline latency, and audit trail completeness.
attributes.references: SOC 2 Type II — Data Integrity; FLSA 29 CFR Part 516

attributes.name: ip_address
attributes.description: The IP address of the device or network from which the punch event was submitted (applicable for web portal and mobile app punches). Used for fraud detection, buddy-punch investigation, and network-level audit trails. May be considered PII under GDPR and CCPA in some jurisdictions.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; CCPA Section 1798.140; SOC 2 Type II — Logical Access Controls

attributes.name: job_code
attributes.description: The Kronos job code or labor category code associated with the work being performed at the time of the punch. Drives pay rate selection, bill rate application, and FLSA overtime classification. May change on a transfer punch when the worker switches tasks or roles mid-shift.
attributes.references: FLSA 29 CFR Part 541 — Exemptions; Kronos Workforce Ready Labor Distribution

attributes.name: kronos_punch_ref
attributes.description: The native punch event identifier assigned by the Kronos Workforce Ready source system. Preserved for cross-system reconciliation, data lineage tracing, and support ticket resolution. Enables exact record matching between the Databricks Silver layer and the Kronos operational system.
attributes.references: Kronos Workforce Ready API Documentation; SOC 2 Type II — Data Integrity

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The UTC timestamp when this punch event record was last modified in the Databricks Silver layer (e.g., status update from raw to validated, amendment applied). Supports incremental data pipeline processing and audit trail completeness.
attributes.references: SOC 2 Type II — Change Management; FLSA 29 CFR Part 516

attributes.name: latitude
attributes.description: GPS latitude coordinate (WGS-84 decimal degrees) captured at the moment of the punch event from a mobile device or GPS-enabled time clock. Used for geofence validation to confirm the worker was physically present at the designated worksite. Null if the device does not support GPS.
attributes.references: WGS-84 Geodetic Standard; FLSA 29 CFR Part 516

attributes.name: location_accuracy_meters
attributes.description: The GPS accuracy radius in meters reported by the mobile device at the time of the punch event. Lower values indicate higher precision. Used to qualify geofence validation results — punches with accuracy radius exceeding the geofence boundary tolerance may be flagged for manual review.
attributes.references: Kronos Workforce Ready Mobile GPS Specifications; WGS-84 Geodetic Standard

attributes.name: longitude
attributes.description: GPS longitude coordinate (WGS-84 decimal degrees) captured at the moment of the punch event from a mobile device or GPS-enabled time clock. Paired with latitude for geofence boundary validation and worksite presence verification.
attributes.references: WGS-84 Geodetic Standard; FLSA 29 CFR Part 516

attributes.name: pay_type
attributes.description: Classification of the pay category applicable to the hours captured by this punch event. regular: standard straight-time hours; overtime (OT): hours exceeding FLSA or state OT thresholds; double_time (DT): hours qualifying for double-time premium; per_diem: expense reimbursement-based pay; holiday: holiday premium pay; pto: Paid Time Off. Drives pay rate multiplier selection in TempWorks Payroll.
attributes.references: FLSA 29 CFR Part 778 — Overtime; TempWorks Payroll Pay Type Configuration; State Wage and Hour Laws

attributes.name: punch_source
attributes.description: The channel or interface through which the punch event was submitted. time_clock: physical Kronos hardware terminal; mobile_app: Kronos mobile application; web_portal: browser-based Kronos portal; supervisor_entry: manually entered by a supervisor on behalf of the worker; api: submitted via system integration. Supports fraud detection and channel-level analytics.
attributes.references: FLSA 29 CFR Part 516; Kronos Workforce Ready Integration Specifications

attributes.name: punch_status
attributes.description: Current processing state of the punch event record. raw: received from source device, not yet validated; validated: passed geofence, biometric, and schedule checks; amended: manually corrected by supervisor or payroll admin; rejected: failed validation rules; voided: nullified for audit purposes. Drives downstream time_entry aggregation eligibility.
attributes.references: FLSA 29 CFR Part 516; SOC 2 Type II — Change Management Controls

attributes.name: punch_timestamp
attributes.description: The exact UTC timestamp when the worker performed the clock action (punch-in, punch-out, break start, break end, or transfer). This is the authoritative real-world event time used for FLSA wage-and-hour calculations, DOL audit defense, and overtime determination. Stored in UTC per ISO 8601.
attributes.references: FLSA 29 CFR Part 516; ISO 8601; DOL Wage and Hour Division

attributes.name: punch_type
attributes.description: Discriminator indicating the nature of the clock action recorded. clock_in: worker begins a work period; clock_out: worker ends a work period; break_start: worker begins an unpaid or paid break; break_end: worker resumes work after a break; transfer: worker moves between cost centers, departments, or job codes mid-shift. Drives FLSA break compliance and hours calculation logic.
attributes.references: FLSA 29 CFR Part 785 — Hours Worked; Kronos Workforce Ready Punch Type Taxonomy

attributes.name: raw_payload
attributes.description: The complete raw JSON or XML payload received from the Kronos Workforce Ready source system for this punch event. Stored as an immutable string to support full audit reconstruction, dispute resolution, and re-processing in the event of transformation errors. Retention: minimum 3 years per FLSA recordkeeping requirements.
attributes.references: FLSA 29 CFR Part 516 — 3-Year Retention; SOC 2 Type II — Data Integrity; DOL Audit Defense

attributes.name: rounded_punch_timestamp
attributes.description: The effective punch timestamp after application of the configured Kronos rounding rule. Used as the basis for hours calculation in time_entry aggregation. Null if rounding_rule_applied is False. Stored separately from the raw punch_timestamp to preserve the original immutable record for FLSA audit defense.
attributes.references: FLSA 29 CFR Part 785.48; Kronos Workforce Ready Rounding Configuration

attributes.name: rounding_rule_applied
attributes.description: Indicates whether a Kronos time rounding rule was applied to the raw punch timestamp to produce the effective time used in hours calculations. True: rounding was applied (e.g., nearest 15-minute increment); False: raw timestamp used as-is. FLSA permits rounding only when it averages out over time and does not systematically undercount hours.
attributes.references: FLSA 29 CFR Part 785.48 — Rounding Practices; DOL Wage and Hour Division

attributes.name: scheduled_end_time
attributes.description: The UTC timestamp of the worker's scheduled shift end time as defined in Kronos. Compared against the actual clock-out punch_timestamp to calculate early departure or overtime variance for schedule adherence and FLSA overtime analysis.
attributes.references: Kronos Workforce Ready Scheduling Module; FLSA 29 CFR Part 778

attributes.name: scheduled_start_time
attributes.description: The UTC timestamp of the worker's scheduled shift start time as defined in Kronos. Compared against the actual punch_timestamp to calculate early/late arrival variance for schedule adherence reporting and SLA compliance tracking.
attributes.references: Kronos Workforce Ready Scheduling Module; SLA Performance Reporting

attributes.name: time_zone
attributes.description: The IANA time zone identifier (e.g., 'America/Chicago', 'America/New_York') of the worksite where the punch event occurred. Required to correctly convert UTC punch_timestamp to local work date for FLSA workweek boundary calculations and state wage-and-hour law compliance.
attributes.references: IANA Time Zone Database; FLSA 29 CFR Part 778; State Wage and Hour Laws

attributes.name: work_date
attributes.description: The calendar date (in the worker's local time zone) on which the punch event occurred. Used for daily timesheet aggregation, FLSA workweek calculations, overtime determination, and client billing period alignment. Derived from punch_timestamp adjusted to the site's configured time zone.
attributes.references: FLSA 29 CFR Part 778 — Overtime Compensation; DOL Wage and Hour Division

products.name: labor_category
products.description: Reference entity defining labor categories and work classifications used to categorize time entries for cost allocation, billing rate determination, and workforce analytics. Captures category code, category name, skill level, FLSA classification (exempt/non-exempt), prevailing wage indicator, prevailing wage rate (for Davis-Bacon Act compliance on government staffing contracts), union code applicability, SCA (Service Contract Act) labor category mapping, and default bill/pay rate tier. Used by clients and staffing operations to segment labor costs by function, skill, or contract type. Links to ot_rule for determining applicable overtime calculation rules.

attributes.description: Reference to the overtime rule set applicable to this labor category. Links to the ot_rule reference entity as specified in the product description.

attributes.name: vendor_rate_card_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to vendor.vendor_rate_card. Business justification: Labor categories must map to vendor-specific rate cards for rate validation, margin analysis, and vendor bill rate verification. When evaluating vendor submissions or processing timesheets, staffing f

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the business user or manager who approved this labor category definition and its associated rates. Required for governance and audit compliance in rate card management.

attributes.name: approved_date
attributes.description: Date on which this labor category record was formally approved by the designated approver. Used for governance, audit trail, and effective dating validation.
attributes.references: SOC 2 Type II — Change Management Controls; ASA Governance Standards

attributes.name: billable_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether time entries coded to this labor category are billable to the client. When true, hours are included in client invoicing. When false, hours are internal or non-billable (e.g., orientation, training, bench time).
attributes.references: Salesforce Revenue Cloud — Billing Rules; Kronos Workforce Ready; ASA

attributes.name: burden_rate_pct
attributes.description: The total employer burden rate percentage applied to the base pay rate for workers in this labor category. Includes employer-side FICA, FUTA, SUTA, workers comp, and benefits costs expressed as a percentage of base pay. Used for gross margin and spread analysis.
attributes.references: IRS — FICA (26 U.S.C. § 3111); DOL — FUTA; TempWorks Payroll; ASA Financial Benchmarking

attributes.name: category_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric code uniquely identifying the labor category. Used in timesheets, billing systems, and VMS integrations to reference the category. Sourced from Kronos Workforce Ready and synchronized to Beeline VMS and Salesforce Revenue Cloud.
attributes.references: Kronos Workforce Ready; Beeline VMS Rate Management; ASA Workforce Classification Standards

attributes.name: category_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of the labor category, including scope of work, typical duties, and applicable skill requirements. Used for client-facing documentation, MSA exhibits, and SOW labor category definitions.
attributes.references: DocuSign CLM — SOW Labor Category Exhibit; ASA

attributes.name: category_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the labor category (e.g., 'Software Engineer – Senior', 'Light Industrial – Forklift Operator', 'Administrative – Data Entry'). Displayed in timesheets, client invoices, and workforce analytics dashboards.
attributes.references: Kronos Workforce Ready; SIA Labor Category Taxonomy

attributes.name: category_type
attributes.description: Broad classification grouping the labor category into a workforce segment (e.g., professional, light industrial, clerical, technical, healthcare, executive, skilled trades). Drives workforce analytics segmentation and client billing tier assignment. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: professional|light_industrial|clerical|technical|healthcare|executive|skilled_trades — promote to reference product if additional values are needed]
attributes.references: SIA Staffing Industry Taxonomy; ASA Workforce Segmentation Standards

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this labor category record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail, data lineage, and record lifecycle management in the Databricks Lakehouse silver layer.
attributes.references: SOC 2 Type II — Audit Trail Requirements; GDPR Article 5 (Data Integrity); CCPA

attributes.name: default_bill_rate
attributes.description: Default hourly bill rate (in USD) charged to the client for workers assigned to this labor category. Serves as the baseline rate before client-specific or contract-specific overrides are applied. Used by Salesforce Revenue Cloud for invoice generation.
attributes.references: Salesforce Revenue Cloud — Rate Management; Beeline VMS Rate Card; ASA Billing Standards

attributes.name: default_dt_bill_rate
attributes.description: Default hourly double-time (DT) bill rate charged to the client for double-time hours worked by workers in this labor category. Applicable in states or contracts requiring double-time pay (e.g., California labor law).
attributes.references: Salesforce Revenue Cloud; California Labor Code Section 510; ASA

attributes.name: default_dt_pay_rate
attributes.description: Default hourly double-time (DT) pay rate paid to workers in this labor category for double-time hours. Applicable under state-specific labor laws or union agreements requiring double-time compensation.
attributes.references: TempWorks Payroll; California Labor Code Section 510; DOL

attributes.name: default_ot_bill_rate
attributes.description: Default hourly overtime (OT) bill rate charged to the client for overtime hours worked by workers in this labor category. Typically 1.5x the standard bill rate unless a client-specific rate card overrides it.
attributes.references: Salesforce Revenue Cloud; DOL FLSA Overtime Provisions; ASA

attributes.name: default_ot_pay_rate
attributes.description: Default hourly overtime (OT) pay rate paid to workers in this labor category for overtime hours. Must comply with FLSA overtime requirements (minimum 1.5x regular rate for non-exempt workers).
attributes.references: TempWorks Payroll; DOL FLSA Section 7; ASA Compliance Guidelines

attributes.name: default_pay_rate
attributes.description: Default hourly pay rate (in USD) paid to workers assigned to this labor category. Serves as the baseline rate before worker-specific or assignment-specific overrides are applied. Used by TempWorks Payroll for compensation calculation.
attributes.references: TempWorks Payroll — Pay Rate Configuration; DOL Wage and Hour Division

attributes.name: eeo_job_category
attributes.business_glossary_term: Equal Employment Opportunity Commission (EEOC) Job Category
attributes.description: EEOC EEO-1 job category assigned to this labor category for equal employment opportunity reporting. Required for federal contractors and employers with 100+ employees. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: executives_senior_officials|first_mid_officials|professionals|technicians|sales_workers|administrative_support|craft_workers|operatives|laborers_helpers|service_workers — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: EEOC — EEO-1 Component 1 Reporting; 29 CFR Part 1602; OFCCP

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date from which this labor category definition and its associated rates become effective. Supports rate versioning and historical rate lookups for timesheet processing and billing reconciliation.
attributes.references: Kronos Workforce Ready; Salesforce Revenue Cloud — Rate Effective Dating; ASA

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: The date on which this labor category definition and its associated rates expire. Null for open-ended categories. After this date, the category is no longer available for new timesheet entries unless renewed or superseded.
attributes.references: Kronos Workforce Ready; Salesforce Revenue Cloud — Rate Effective Dating

attributes.name: flsa_classification
attributes.description: Indicates whether workers in this labor category are classified as exempt or non-exempt under the Fair Labor Standards Act (FLSA). Non-exempt workers are entitled to overtime pay; exempt workers are not. Critical for overtime rule application and payroll compliance.
attributes.references: U.S. Department of Labor (DOL) — FLSA; 29 CFR Part 541; American Staffing Association (ASA) Compliance Guidelines

attributes.name: ic_eligible
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether workers in this labor category may be engaged as independent contractors (1099) rather than W-2 employees. Drives worker classification compliance checks per IRS worker classification rules and DOL economic reality test.
attributes.references: IRS — Worker Classification Rules (Rev. Rul. 87-41); DOL Economic Reality Test; INA; ASA IC Compliance Guidelines

attributes.name: job_function_code
attributes.description: Standardized job function code classifying the primary work function of this labor category (e.g., IT, Finance, Operations, Engineering, Healthcare). Aligns with O*NET or SOC occupational classification codes for workforce analytics and regulatory reporting.
attributes.references: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics — Standard Occupational Classification (SOC); O*NET; EEOC EEO-1 Job Category Codes

attributes.name: kronos_labor_category_ref
attributes.business_glossary_term: Kronos Workforce Ready Labor Category ID
attributes.description: The native labor category identifier in Kronos Workforce Ready, the system of record for time and attendance. Used for system integration and data lineage tracing between the lakehouse silver layer and the Kronos source system.
attributes.references: Kronos Workforce Ready — Labor Category Master; UKG (Kronos) Integration Standards

attributes.name: labor_category_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the labor category record. 'active' indicates the category is available for use in timesheet entries and billing; 'inactive' indicates it has been retired; 'pending' indicates it is awaiting approval; 'deprecated' indicates it has been superseded by a newer category.
attributes.references: Kronos Workforce Ready — Labor Category Lifecycle Management

attributes.name: markup_pct
attributes.description: Default markup percentage applied over the pay rate to derive the bill rate for this labor category. Represents the spread as a percentage of pay rate. Used in pricing models and profitability analysis. Markup = (Bill Rate - Pay Rate) / Pay Rate × 100.
attributes.references: ASA Financial Benchmarking; SIA Staffing Industry Financial Standards; Salesforce Revenue Cloud

attributes.name: max_bill_rate
attributes.description: Maximum allowable hourly bill rate for this labor category. Used as a ceiling in VMS rate card negotiations and client contract management. Bill rates above this ceiling require management approval.
attributes.references: Beeline VMS Rate Management; Salesforce Revenue Cloud; ASA Pricing Guidelines

attributes.name: min_pay_rate
attributes.description: Minimum allowable hourly pay rate for workers assigned to this labor category. Enforces compliance with applicable federal, state, or local minimum wage laws and prevailing wage requirements. Pay rates below this floor are rejected during payroll processing.
attributes.references: DOL — FLSA Minimum Wage (29 U.S.C. § 206); State Minimum Wage Laws; Davis-Bacon Act

attributes.name: per_diem_eligible
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether workers assigned to this labor category are eligible for per diem allowances (daily expense reimbursements for travel, lodging, or meals). Affects payroll processing and client billing for travel-based assignments.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 463 — Travel Expenses; GSA Per Diem Rates; TempWorks Payroll

attributes.name: prevailing_wage_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this labor category is subject to prevailing wage requirements under the Davis-Bacon Act or Service Contract Act (SCA) for government or federally funded contracts. When true, the prevailing_wage_rate field applies.
attributes.references: U.S. Department of Labor (DOL) — Davis-Bacon Act (40 U.S.C. §§ 3141–3148); Service Contract Act (SCA) 41 U.S.C. § 6701; OFCCP

attributes.name: prevailing_wage_rate
attributes.description: The federally or state-mandated prevailing wage rate (in USD per hour) applicable to this labor category for government or public works contracts. Determined by DOL wage determinations under the Davis-Bacon Act or SCA. Null when prevailing_wage_indicator is false.
attributes.references: U.S. Department of Labor (DOL) — Davis-Bacon Act Wage Determinations; SCA Wage Determinations; OFCCP

attributes.name: rate_tier_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the default bill/pay rate tier associated with this labor category. Rate tiers define pricing bands used across client contracts and VMS programs. Links to rate tier configuration in Beeline VMS and Salesforce Revenue Cloud.
attributes.references: Beeline VMS Rate Management; Salesforce Revenue Cloud — Rate Tier Configuration

attributes.name: sca_labor_category_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Service Contract Act (SCA) Labor Category Code
attributes.description: The official Service Contract Act (SCA) labor category code or title as defined in the applicable DOL wage determination. Used to map internal labor categories to SCA-compliant job classifications for federal service contracts. Required for compliance reporting on government staffing contracts.
attributes.references: U.S. Department of Labor (DOL) — Service Contract Act (SCA) 41 U.S.C. § 6701; DOL Wage Determinations Online (WDOL); OFCCP

attributes.name: skill_level
attributes.description: Proficiency or seniority tier associated with the labor category (e.g., entry, junior, mid, senior, lead, principal, executive). Used to differentiate bill/pay rate tiers and to support workforce planning analytics. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: entry|junior|mid|senior|lead|principal|executive — promote to reference product if additional values are needed]
attributes.references: Kronos Workforce Ready; SAP SuccessFactors Competency Framework; SIA

attributes.name: soc_code
attributes.description: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics Standard Occupational Classification (SOC) code mapped to this labor category. Used for EEOC reporting, DOL compliance, workforce analytics, and labor market benchmarking. Format: XX-XXXX (e.g., 15-1252 for Software Developers).
attributes.references: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics — SOC System (2018); EEOC EEO-1 Reporting; DOL

attributes.name: temp_to_perm_eligible
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether placements in this labor category are eligible for temp-to-perm conversion (contract-to-hire). When true, a conversion fee may apply upon permanent placement. Used in Bullhorn ATS/CRM for placement tracking and conversion fee calculation.
attributes.references: Bullhorn ATS/CRM — Placement Configuration; ASA Temp-to-Perm Guidelines

attributes.name: union_applicable
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this labor category is subject to a collective bargaining agreement (CBA) or union work rules. When true, the union_code field identifies the applicable union. Affects pay rates, overtime rules, and benefit requirements.
attributes.references: National Labor Relations Act (NLRA); DOL; ASA Labor Relations Guidelines

attributes.name: union_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the labor union or collective bargaining agreement (CBA) applicable to this labor category. Null when union_applicable is false. Used to apply union-specific pay rules, benefit contributions, and work rules in payroll processing.
attributes.references: National Labor Relations Act (NLRA); DOL; TempWorks Payroll — Union Configuration

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this labor category record was last modified. Used for change detection, incremental data loading, and audit trail maintenance in the Databricks Lakehouse silver layer.
attributes.references: SOC 2 Type II — Audit Trail Requirements; GDPR Article 5 (Data Integrity)

attributes.name: vms_category_code
attributes.description: The labor category code as defined in the client's Vendor Management System (VMS), specifically Beeline VMS. Used to map internal labor categories to VMS-defined categories for contingent workforce program management and rate card alignment.
attributes.references: Beeline VMS — Labor Category Configuration; SIA VMS Standards

attributes.name: workers_comp_code

attributes.description: Identifier of the specific internal staff member (coordinator, payroll analyst, or client manager) currently assigned to work the dispute. Enables individual-level SLA tracking and workload reporting.
attributes.references: Kronos Workforce Ready — Dispute Assignment; Bullhorn ATS/CRM

attributes.name: timesheet_id

attributes.name: bill_rate
attributes.description: The hourly bill rate charged to the client for the disputed timesheet period. Used to calculate the billable adjustment amount for client invoicing. Sourced from Beeline VMS or the client contract.

attributes.name: claimed_hours
attributes.description: The number of hours the dispute initiator asserts should have been recorded. Compared against recorded_hours to determine the hours discrepancy and calculate the disputed pay or bill amount.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the dispute record was first created in the data platform. Used for audit trail and data lineage. May differ from submitted_timestamp if there is a processing lag.

attributes.name: dispute_number

attributes.name: dispute_status

attributes.references: Kronos Workforce Ready — Dispute Workflow; ASA SLA Standards

attributes.name: dispute_type
attributes.description: Classification of the nature of the dispute. Drives routing, resolution workflow, and compliance reporting. Values: hours_discrepancy (worker claims hours differ from recorded), rate_dispute (bill rate or pay rate is incorrect), missing_time (hours not captured), unauthorized_ot (overtime not pre-approved), per_diem_dispute (per diem amount contested), other.
attributes.references: ASA Workforce Solutions Standards; FLSA — Overtime Provisions; Kronos Workforce Ready

attributes.name: disputed_amount
attributes.description: The gross monetary value under dispute, expressed in USD. Calculated as the difference between the claimed and recorded hours multiplied by the applicable pay or bill rate. Used for payroll adjustment and client billing reconciliation.
attributes.references: Salesforce Revenue Cloud — Billing Disputes; TempWorks Payroll; FLSA

attributes.name: disputed_hours
attributes.description: The number of hours being contested in the dispute. Represents the delta between what the worker claims and what was recorded, or the total hours in question for missing-time disputes. Used for payroll adjustment calculations.
attributes.references: FLSA — Hours Worked Standards; Kronos Workforce Ready; TempWorks Payroll

attributes.name: disputed_work_date
attributes.description: The specific calendar date on the timesheet that is being disputed. For multi-day disputes, this represents the start date of the disputed period.
attributes.references: FLSA — Recordkeeping Requirements (29 CFR Part 516); Kronos Workforce Ready

attributes.name: disputed_work_date_end
attributes.description: The end date of the disputed work period for multi-day disputes. Null for single-day disputes. Together with disputed_work_date defines the full disputed pay period window.
attributes.references: FLSA — Recordkeeping Requirements (29 CFR Part 516); Kronos Workforce Ready

attributes.name: dt_hours_disputed
attributes.description: The number of double-time hours specifically contested within the dispute. Applicable in states or contracts where double-time rates apply (e.g., California labor law). Null if no double-time hours are in dispute.
attributes.references: California Labor Code §510; FLSA; Kronos Workforce Ready

attributes.name: escalation_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the dispute has been escalated beyond the standard resolution workflow (e.g., to senior management, legal, or the client's MSP/VMS program). True when dispute_status is escalated or when SLA breach has occurred.
attributes.references: ASA SLA Standards; Beeline VMS — Escalation Management

attributes.name: escalation_reason
attributes.description: Free-text description of why the dispute was escalated. Captured when escalation_flag is True. Includes reasons such as SLA breach, high monetary value, repeated dispute by same worker, or client-requested escalation.
attributes.references: ASA Best Practices — Escalation Protocols; Beeline VMS

attributes.name: escalation_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the dispute was escalated. Used to measure escalation response time and track SLA compliance from the point of escalation.
attributes.references: ASA SLA Standards; Kronos Workforce Ready — Dispute Workflow

attributes.name: initiated_by
attributes.description: Party who raised the dispute. Determines the communication and resolution workflow. Values: worker (contingent worker self-reported), client (client contact raised the issue), back_office (internal staffing coordinator identified discrepancy), system (automated detection via Kronos or payroll reconciliation).
attributes.references: Kronos Workforce Ready; ASA Best Practices — Dispute Initiation

attributes.name: initiator_name
attributes.description: Full name of the individual who raised the dispute (worker name, client contact name, or back-office staff name). Captured at time of submission for audit trail purposes.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 5 — Data Minimisation; CCPA; ASA Recordkeeping Standards

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to the dispute record. Tracks status changes, note additions, and resolution updates for audit and SLA compliance.
attributes.references: SOC 2 Type II — Audit Trail Requirements; Kronos Workforce Ready

attributes.name: ot_hours_disputed
attributes.description: The number of overtime hours specifically contested within the dispute. Relevant for unauthorized_ot dispute types where the client or back-office challenges OT hours that were not pre-approved. Governed by FLSA overtime provisions.
attributes.references: FLSA — Overtime Provisions (29 CFR Part 778); Kronos Workforce Ready

attributes.name: pay_rate
attributes.description: The worker's hourly pay rate applicable to the disputed timesheet period. Used to calculate the payable adjustment amount for the worker. Sourced from TempWorks Payroll and the placement record.
attributes.references: TempWorks Payroll — Rate Management; FLSA — Minimum Wage and Overtime; DOL

attributes.name: per_diem_amount_disputed
attributes.description: The per diem reimbursement amount being contested in the dispute. Applicable when dispute_type is per_diem_dispute. Per diem rates are governed by IRS guidelines and client MSA terms.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 463 — Per Diem Rates; DOL; Placement MSA Terms

attributes.name: prior_dispute_count
attributes.description: The number of previously submitted disputes associated with the same worker and placement at the time this dispute was raised. Used for risk flagging, pattern detection, and compliance reporting. A high count may indicate a systemic timekeeping issue.
attributes.references: ASA Best Practices — Risk Management; Power BI Analytics Platform — Workforce Analytics

attributes.name: recorded_hours
attributes.description: The number of hours as originally recorded on the timesheet at the time the dispute was raised. Provides the baseline for comparison against the worker's or client's claimed hours.
attributes.references: Kronos Workforce Ready — Time and Attendance; FLSA 29 CFR Part 516

attributes.name: resolution_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the dispute was formally resolved and a resolution_outcome was recorded. Used to calculate actual resolution cycle time against SLA targets.
attributes.references: ASA SLA Standards; Kronos Workforce Ready — Dispute Management

attributes.name: resolution_notes
attributes.description: Free-text narrative documenting the findings, evidence reviewed, and rationale for the resolution outcome. Captured by the resolving party and retained for compliance and audit purposes.
attributes.references: SOC 2 Type II — Audit Trail; ASA Recordkeeping Standards; FCRA

attributes.name: resolution_outcome
attributes.description: The final determination of the dispute. Values: approved_in_full (all disputed hours/amounts accepted), approved_partial (partial adjustment granted), denied (dispute rejected), withdrawn (initiator retracted before resolution), no_action_required (investigation found no discrepancy). Null while dispute is open or under review.
attributes.references: ASA Best Practices — Dispute Resolution; Kronos Workforce Ready

attributes.name: resolved_amount
attributes.description: The final monetary adjustment amount approved as a result of the dispute resolution. Drives payroll correction entries in TempWorks and billing adjustments in Salesforce Revenue Cloud. Null until resolution_outcome is set.
attributes.references: TempWorks Payroll; Salesforce Revenue Cloud — Credit Memo; Oracle NetSuite ERP

attributes.name: resolved_hours
attributes.description: The final agreed-upon number of hours after dispute resolution. May equal claimed_hours (full approval), a value between recorded_hours and claimed_hours (partial), or recorded_hours (denial). Used to drive payroll and billing adjustments.
attributes.references: TempWorks Payroll — Adjustment Processing; Salesforce Revenue Cloud

attributes.name: responsible_party
attributes.description: The internal role or team currently responsible for investigating and resolving the dispute. Used for workload assignment, SLA accountability, and escalation routing. Values: staffing_coordinator, payroll_team, client_manager, vms_admin, escalation_team.
attributes.references: ASA Best Practices — Dispute Ownership; Kronos Workforce Ready

attributes.name: sla_breach_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the dispute resolution exceeded the defined SLA target hours. True when the dispute was not resolved within sla_target_hours of submitted_timestamp. Feeds SLA compliance reporting and client KPI dashboards.
attributes.references: ASA SLA Standards; MSA Terms; Power BI Analytics Platform — KPI Dashboards

attributes.name: sla_target_hours
attributes.business_glossary_term: Service Level Agreement (SLA) Target Resolution Hours
attributes.description: The contractually or operationally defined number of business hours within which the dispute must be resolved. Sourced from the client MSA or internal SLA policy. Used to calculate SLA compliance and breach status.
attributes.references: ASA SLA Standards; MSA Terms; DOL — Timely Payment Requirements

attributes.name: source_channel
attributes.description: The channel through which the dispute was submitted. Values: portal (worker or client self-service portal), email (submitted via email to back-office), phone (verbal submission logged by coordinator), vms (raised through Beeline VMS), ats (raised through Bullhorn ATS/CRM), manual (back-office data entry). Used for channel analytics and process improvement.
attributes.references: Kronos Workforce Ready; Beeline VMS; Bullhorn ATS/CRM

attributes.name: submitted_timestamp
attributes.description: The exact date and time when the dispute was formally submitted into the system. This is the principal business event timestamp used as the SLA clock start for dispute resolution tracking.
attributes.references: Kronos Workforce Ready — Dispute Management; ASA SLA Standards

attributes.name: supporting_document_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether supporting documentation (e.g., badge swipe records, supervisor sign-off, email correspondence, system logs) has been attached to the dispute record. True when at least one document has been submitted as evidence.
attributes.references: SOC 2 Type II — Evidence Management; FCRA; ASA Recordkeeping Standards

attributes.name: timesheet_week_ending_date
attributes.description: The week-ending date of the pay period associated with the disputed timesheet. Used to align the dispute with the correct payroll cycle and billing period for adjustment processing.
attributes.references: Kronos Workforce Ready — Pay Period Management; TempWorks Payroll

attributes.name: vms_dispute_reference
attributes.description: The dispute or ticket reference number assigned by the client's VMS platform (e.g., Beeline) when the dispute was raised through a managed service program. Enables cross-system traceability for MSP/VMS-managed accounts. Null for non-VMS clients.
attributes.references: Beeline VMS — Dispute Management; MSP Program Standards

products.name: vms_timesheet_sync
products.description: Tracks the bidirectional synchronization and reconciliation of timesheet records between the internal Kronos Workforce Ready system and client Vendor Management System (VMS) platforms such as Beeline, Fieldglass, VNDLY, or Coupa. Captures the VMS platform identifier, VMS timesheet reference ID, sync direction (push/pull), sync status (pending, synced, failed, rejected, partial), sync timestamp, error codes, field-level mapping discrepancies, retry count, manual override flags, and reconciliation outcome. Critical for MSP/VMS-managed programs where client approval occurs within the VMS portal and hours must match exactly between systems to avoid billing disputes.
products.reference: Beeline VMS - Timesheet Integration / VMS Time Approval

attributes.name: vms_timesheet_sync_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Vendor Management System (VMS) Timesheet Sync ID
attributes.description: Unique surrogate primary key for each VMS timesheet synchronization record in the Staffing Hr lakehouse Silver layer. Entity role: TRANSACTION_HEADER — represents a discrete sync event with its own lifecycle between Kronos Workforce Ready and a client VMS platform.
attributes.references: Staffing Hr Data Modeling Standards; ASA Data Governance Framework

attributes.name: assignment_id
attributes.description: Reference to the contingent worker placement record associated with this timesheet sync. Identifies the specific assignment under which the worker submitted hours, linking the sync event to the placement lifecycle in Bullhorn ATS/CRM.
attributes.references: Bullhorn ATS/CRM Placement Module; ASA Staffing Industry Standards

attributes.name: client_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the client organization whose VMS platform is the target or source of this synchronization. Identifies the MSP/VMS-managed program client for billing dispute resolution and program reporting.
attributes.references: Bullhorn ATS/CRM Client Module; Beeline VMS Client Configuration

attributes.name: managed_program_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to client.managed_program. Business justification: VMS sync occurs within managed programs (MSP/RPO); program-specific integration rules and SLA tracking require this link. Essential for managed program performance reporting and program-specific VMS r
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: profile_id
attributes.description: Reference to the contingent worker whose timesheet hours are being synchronized. Enables worker-level reconciliation reporting and audit trails for payroll and billing accuracy.
attributes.references: Kronos Workforce Ready Worker Profile; Bullhorn ATS/CRM Candidate Module

attributes.name: timesheet_id
attributes.description: Reference to the internal Kronos Workforce Ready timesheet record being synchronized. Links this sync event to the authoritative timesheet in the internal time-and-attendance system.
attributes.references: Kronos Workforce Ready Time and Attendance Module; ASA Workforce Data Standards

attributes.name: vms_enrollment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to vendor.vms_enrollment. Business justification: VMS timesheet synchronization requires vendor enrollment context to route data correctly to VMS platforms (Fieldglass, Beeline). Integration middleware must identify which vendor enrollment applies to
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: vms_program_id
attributes.description: The identifier of the MSP/VMS-managed contingent workforce program within the VMS platform. Used to segment sync records by client program for program-level reporting, SLA tracking, and billing reconciliation under MSP agreements.
attributes.references: Beeline VMS Program Configuration; SIA MSP Program Standards; ASA MSP/VMS Program Guidelines

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: The approval state of the timesheet within the client VMS platform. 'pending' = awaiting client manager approval; 'approved' = client approved in VMS; 'rejected' = client rejected in VMS; 'disputed' = under active dispute; 'recalled' = previously approved but recalled for correction. Drives billing eligibility.
attributes.references: Beeline VMS Approval Workflow; SIA VMS Data Standards; ASA Client Billing Standards

attributes.name: bill_rate
attributes.description: The hourly bill rate applied to this timesheet for client invoicing purposes, as agreed in the MSA or VMS rate card. Used to validate that the rate applied in the VMS matches the contracted rate in Kronos/Bullhorn. A mismatch triggers a billing dispute.
attributes.references: Beeline VMS Rate Management; Salesforce Revenue Cloud Billing; ASA Staffing Industry Standards; MSA Rate Schedule

attributes.name: cost_center_code
attributes.description: The client cost center code associated with this timesheet as recorded in the VMS platform. Used for client-side labor cost allocation and is a common source of field-level mapping discrepancies between Kronos and VMS systems.
attributes.references: Oracle NetSuite ERP General Ledger; Beeline VMS Cost Center Configuration; ASA Client Billing Standards

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this VMS timesheet sync record was first created in the Staffing Hr lakehouse. Serves as the RECORD_AUDIT_CREATED timestamp for data lineage and audit trail purposes.
attributes.references: SOC 2 Type II Audit Requirements; GDPR Article 5 (Data Integrity); ASA Data Governance Framework

attributes.name: dt_hours
attributes.description: Total double-time (DT) hours recorded on the timesheet being synchronized, applicable in states such as California where DT is mandated for hours beyond 12 in a day or 8 on the 7th consecutive day. Ensures accurate billing and payroll at DT rates.
attributes.references: California Labor Code Section 510; FLSA (Fair Labor Standards Act); DOL Wage and Hour Division; Kronos Workforce Ready OT Rules Engine

attributes.name: error_code
attributes.description: The error code returned by the VMS platform or integration middleware when a sync attempt fails or is rejected. Used for automated error classification, retry logic routing, and integration support triage. Null when sync_status is 'synced'.
attributes.references: Beeline VMS API Error Code Reference; Kronos Workforce Ready Integration Error Catalog; ASA Technology Standards

attributes.name: error_message
attributes.description: Human-readable error description returned by the VMS platform or integration layer when a sync fails or is rejected. Provides context for manual investigation and resolution of failed sync events. Null when sync_status is 'synced'.
attributes.references: Beeline VMS API Documentation; Kronos Workforce Ready Integration Guide; SOC 2 Type II Incident Management

attributes.name: field_mapping_discrepancies
attributes.description: A structured description of specific field-level mismatches identified between the Kronos Workforce Ready timesheet and the VMS timesheet record (e.g., cost center code mismatch, job code mismatch, worker ID format difference). Stored as a delimited string of field names with discrepancy details. Used for root-cause analysis and integration mapping corrections.
attributes.references: Beeline VMS Field Mapping Specification; Kronos Workforce Ready Data Dictionary; ASA Data Governance Framework

attributes.name: hours_variance
attributes.description: The difference between vms_total_hours and total_hours (VMS hours minus Kronos hours). A non-zero value indicates a discrepancy requiring reconciliation. Positive values mean the VMS recorded more hours; negative values mean Kronos recorded more hours. Used to prioritize reconciliation effort and assess billing risk.
attributes.references: ASA Billing Dispute Resolution Guidelines; Beeline VMS Reconciliation Specification; SIA VMS Data Standards

attributes.name: integration_batch_ref
attributes.description: The batch or job run identifier from the integration middleware that processed this sync record. Used for operational troubleshooting, replay of failed batches, and integration audit trails. Distinct from internal ETL metadata — this is a business-visible integration reference used by the integration operations team.
attributes.references: Kronos Workforce Ready Integration Middleware; Beeline VMS API Batch Processing; SOC 2 Type II Availability Controls

attributes.name: kronos_timesheet_ref_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Kronos Workforce Ready Timesheet Reference ID
attributes.description: The internal timesheet identifier as assigned by Kronos Workforce Ready. Used to cross-reference the internal time-and-attendance record with the VMS record during reconciliation and audit.
attributes.references: Kronos Workforce Ready Time and Attendance Module; ASA Workforce Data Standards

attributes.name: last_retry_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time of the most recent retry attempt for this synchronization record. Used alongside retry_count to calculate retry intervals, enforce exponential backoff policies, and identify stale failed syncs requiring manual intervention.
attributes.references: Kronos Workforce Ready Integration Retry Policy; Beeline VMS API Documentation; SOC 2 Type II Availability Controls

attributes.name: manual_override_by
attributes.description: The username or employee identifier of the Staffing Hr operator who applied the manual override to this sync record. Required for SOC 2 audit trail and accountability. Populated only when manual_override_flag is True.
attributes.references: SOC 2 Type II Access Control Requirements; GDPR Article 5 (Accountability); Staffing Hr Internal Audit Policy

attributes.name: manual_override_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a human operator manually overrode the automated sync result for this record (True = manual override applied; False = automated sync result). Manual overrides are required when automated reconciliation cannot resolve discrepancies. Triggers enhanced audit logging per SOC 2 controls.
attributes.references: SOC 2 Type II Change Management Controls; ASA Data Governance Framework; Staffing Hr Internal Audit Policy

attributes.name: manual_override_reason
attributes.description: Free-text explanation provided by the operator when a manual override is applied to this sync record. Required when manual_override_flag is True. Documents the business justification for the override for audit and compliance purposes.
attributes.references: SOC 2 Type II Change Management Controls; ASA Data Governance Framework; Staffing Hr Internal Audit Policy

attributes.name: ot_hours
attributes.description: Total overtime (OT) hours recorded on the timesheet being synchronized, typically hours worked beyond 40 per week or 8 per day per FLSA or applicable state law. Critical for accurate billing at OT bill rates and worker compensation at OT pay rates.
attributes.references: FLSA (Fair Labor Standards Act) Section 7; DOL Wage and Hour Division; Kronos Workforce Ready OT Rules Engine

attributes.name: pay_rate
attributes.description: The hourly pay rate for the contingent worker associated with this timesheet, as recorded in the payroll system. Used alongside bill_rate to calculate spread and gross margin. Confidential compensation data.
attributes.references: TempWorks Payroll Pay Rate Configuration; FLSA (Fair Labor Standards Act) Minimum Wage Requirements; DOL Wage and Hour Division

attributes.name: per_diem_amount
attributes.description: The per diem (daily expense allowance) amount included in this timesheet record, if applicable. Per diem is a non-taxable reimbursement for meals and incidentals for workers on travel assignments. Must be reconciled between Kronos and VMS to ensure accurate billing and payroll.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 463 (Travel Expenses); DOL Per Diem Regulations; ASA Staffing Industry Standards

attributes.name: reconciliation_outcome
attributes.description: The final outcome of the reconciliation process for this sync record. 'matched' = hours match exactly with no intervention; 'reconciled' = discrepancy resolved through manual or automated correction; 'unresolved' = discrepancy remains open; 'escalated' = referred to billing dispute team; 'voided' = timesheet voided and excluded from billing. Critical for billing dispute management and MSP program reporting.
attributes.references: ASA Billing Dispute Resolution Guidelines; Beeline VMS Reconciliation Workflow; SIA MSP Program Standards

attributes.name: reconciliation_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the reconciliation outcome was determined and recorded for this sync record. Used for SLA measurement of reconciliation cycle time and billing cutoff compliance.
attributes.references: ASA Billing Dispute Resolution Guidelines; Beeline VMS Reconciliation Workflow; SIA SLA Reporting Standards

attributes.name: regular_hours
attributes.description: Total regular (straight-time) hours recorded on the timesheet being synchronized. Used to verify that regular hours match between Kronos Workforce Ready and the VMS platform to prevent billing disputes.
attributes.references: FLSA (Fair Labor Standards Act); DOL Wage and Hour Division; Kronos Workforce Ready Time and Attendance Module

attributes.name: retry_count
attributes.description: The number of times this synchronization has been retried after an initial failure. Used to enforce maximum retry thresholds, trigger escalation workflows, and measure integration reliability. A high retry count may indicate a systemic VMS connectivity or data mapping issue.
attributes.references: Kronos Workforce Ready Integration Retry Policy; Beeline VMS SLA Requirements; ASA Technology Standards

attributes.name: sync_direction
attributes.description: Indicates the direction of the timesheet data flow: 'push' means Kronos Workforce Ready is sending hours to the VMS, 'pull' means the VMS-approved timesheet is being retrieved into Kronos. Determines the authoritative source for reconciliation.
attributes.references: Beeline VMS Integration Specification; Kronos Workforce Ready API Documentation; ASA Technology Standards

attributes.name: sync_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of this timesheet synchronization attempt. 'pending' = awaiting processing; 'synced' = successfully matched in both systems; 'failed' = technical error prevented sync; 'rejected' = VMS rejected the timesheet data; 'partial' = some fields synced but discrepancies remain. This is the LIFECYCLE_STATUS for the sync transaction.
attributes.references: Beeline VMS Integration Specification; Kronos Workforce Ready API Documentation; ASA Data Governance Framework

attributes.name: sync_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this synchronization attempt was executed. Represents the BUSINESS_EVENT_TIMESTAMP — the principal real-world event time of the sync operation. Stored in ISO 8601 format with timezone offset.
attributes.references: Kronos Workforce Ready API Documentation; Beeline VMS Integration Specification; ISO 8601

attributes.name: timesheet_source_system
attributes.description: Identifies the authoritative source system from which the timesheet data originated for this sync event. 'Kronos' = Kronos Workforce Ready is the source of record; 'VMS' = the client VMS platform is the source of record (pull scenario); 'Manual' = hours were entered manually outside of either system. Used for data lineage and audit.
attributes.references: Kronos Workforce Ready Data Governance; Beeline VMS Integration Specification; ASA Data Governance Framework

attributes.name: total_hours
attributes.description: Total billable hours on the timesheet (sum of regular, OT, and DT hours) as recorded in the source system. Used as the primary reconciliation figure between Kronos Workforce Ready and the VMS platform. Discrepancies in this field trigger billing dispute workflows.
attributes.references: ASA Staffing Industry Standards; Beeline VMS Timesheet Reconciliation; Kronos Workforce Ready Time and Attendance Module

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this VMS timesheet sync record was last modified, such as after a retry, manual override, or reconciliation outcome update. Serves as the RECORD_AUDIT_UPDATED timestamp.
attributes.references: SOC 2 Type II Audit Requirements; GDPR Article 5 (Data Integrity); ASA Data Governance Framework

attributes.name: vms_approved_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the client manager approved the timesheet within the VMS platform. Marks the point at which hours become billable and payable. Used for Time-to-Approve (TTA) SLA reporting and billing cycle cutoff determination.
attributes.references: Beeline VMS Approval Workflow; SIA SLA Reporting Standards; ASA Client Billing Standards

attributes.name: vms_approver_name
attributes.description: The name of the client manager or supervisor who approved or rejected the timesheet within the VMS platform. Required for audit trail, dispute resolution, and SLA compliance reporting under MSP/VMS program agreements.
attributes.references: Beeline VMS Approval Workflow; SOC 2 Type II Audit Requirements; ASA MSP Program Standards

attributes.name: vms_job_ref_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Vendor Management System (VMS) Job Reference ID
attributes.description: The job or requisition identifier as assigned by the client VMS platform. Used to associate the synced timesheet with the correct VMS job order or requisition for cost center allocation and client billing.
attributes.references: Beeline VMS Job Order Module; SAP Fieldglass Requisition Module; SIA VMS Data Standards

attributes.name: vms_platform
attributes.description: Name of the client Vendor Management System (VMS) platform involved in this synchronization event. Identifies whether the sync is with Beeline, SAP Fieldglass, VNDLY, Coupa, Workday, or another VMS. Critical for platform-specific error handling and integration routing. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: Beeline|Fieldglass|VNDLY|Coupa|Workday|Other — promote to reference product if additional platforms are onboarded]
attributes.references: Beeline VMS Integration Specification; SIA VMS Market Report; ASA Technology Standards

attributes.name: vms_timesheet_ref_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Vendor Management System (VMS) Timesheet Reference ID
attributes.description: The external timesheet identifier assigned by the client VMS platform (e.g., Beeline timesheet number, Fieldglass time sheet ID). Used for cross-system reconciliation and billing dispute resolution. This is the BUSINESS_IDENTIFIER for the sync transaction as known externally.
attributes.references: Beeline VMS API Specification; SAP Fieldglass Integration Guide; SIA VMS Data Standards

attributes.name: vms_total_hours
attributes.description: Total hours as recorded or approved within the client VMS platform for this timesheet period. Compared against total_hours from Kronos to identify discrepancies. A mismatch between this field and total_hours is the primary trigger for reconciliation workflows and billing dispute escalation.
attributes.references: Beeline VMS Timesheet Approval Workflow; SIA VMS Data Standards; ASA Billing Dispute Resolution Guidelines

attributes.name: vms_worker_ref_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Vendor Management System (VMS) Worker Reference ID
attributes.description: The worker identifier as assigned by the client VMS platform (e.g., Beeline worker ID, Fieldglass contingent worker number). Used to map the internal worker record to the VMS worker profile during sync and reconciliation. Distinct from the internal worker_id.
attributes.references: Beeline VMS Worker Profile; SAP Fieldglass Contingent Worker Module; SIA VMS Data Standards

attributes.name: work_week_end_date
attributes.description: The end date of the work week covered by the timesheet being synchronized. Together with work_week_start_date, defines the exact pay period for payroll and billing reconciliation.
attributes.references: FLSA (Fair Labor Standards Act) Work Week Definition; Kronos Workforce Ready Pay Period Configuration; DOL Wage and Hour Division

attributes.name: work_week_start_date
attributes.description: The start date of the work week covered by the timesheet being synchronized. Used to align the sync record with the correct pay period and billing cycle for payroll processing and client invoicing.
attributes.references: FLSA (Fair Labor Standards Act) Work Week Definition; Kronos Workforce Ready Pay Period Configuration; DOL Wage and Hour Division

domains.name: payroll
domains.description: Owns all worker pay and tax processing data. Covers gross pay calculation, pay rates, gross-to-net calculations, tax withholdings (FICA, FUTA, SUTA), burden rates, deductions, net pay, workers compensation insurance premiums, W-2 and 1099 tax form processing, payroll tax filing, PTO accruals, and benefits administration processed through TempWorks Payroll. Handles multi-state payroll compliance and supports EOR and co-employment payroll models.
domains.references: U.S. Department of Labor (DOL) / IRS Worker Classification Rules

products.name: pay_run
products.description: Master record for each payroll processing cycle executed through TempWorks Payroll. Captures the payroll run header including pay period start and end dates, pay date, pay frequency, run type (regular, off-cycle, adjustment, void-and-reissue), run status (open, processing, approved, posted, voided), total gross pay, total net pay, total tax withholdings, total deductions, total employer burden, worker count, processing timestamps, and approver. Serves as the authoritative anchor for all payroll transactions within a given cycle and the primary reconciliation point for payroll operations.

attributes.name: pay_run_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated identifier for each payroll processing cycle (pay run) executed through TempWorks Payroll. Serves as the primary key and authoritative anchor for all payroll transactions within a given cycle.
attributes.references: TempWorks Payroll — Pay Run Header

attributes.name: accounting_period_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.accounting_period. Business justification: Each pay run posts to a specific accounting period for expense recognition and period close. Required for accurate financial reporting, especially for pay runs spanning period boundaries or off-cycle
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: approved_by_staff_profile_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Approved By Staff Profile Id (Foreign Key)
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to employee.staff_profile. Business justification: Payroll runs require approval by internal staff (payroll manager, controller, CFO). Role-prefixed to distinguish from other approvals. Critical for payroll controls, SOX compliance, and audit trail.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: audit_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.compliance_audit. Business justification: Payroll runs are audited for wage/hour compliance, worker classification accuracy, and tax withholding correctness. DOL and state audits sample pay runs for FLSA compliance validation - audit sample s
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: journal_entry_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the GL journal entry batch in Oracle NetSuite ERP to which this payroll run's accounting entries were posted. Used for GL reconciliation and audit trail.
attributes.references: Oracle NetSuite ERP — Journal Entry Batch; SOC 2 Type II Audit Trail

attributes.name: legal_entity_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.legal_entity. Business justification: Pay runs are executed by specific legal entities for tax filing, compliance, and financial statement consolidation. Required for multi-entity staffing operations to track entity-specific payroll expen
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: gl_post_date

attributes.name: ic_worker_count

attributes.name: is_multi_state

attributes.name: pay_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date on which worker net pay is disbursed via direct deposit, check, or pay card. Determines the tax deposit due date per IRS deposit schedule rules.

attributes.name: pay_frequency
attributes.description: Frequency at which workers are paid within this run. Drives pay period date calculations and tax withholding schedules per IRS Publication 15 annualization tables.

attributes.name: pay_period_end_date

attributes.name: pay_period_start_date

attributes.references: FLSA — Pay Period Definition; TempWorks Payroll — Pay Period Configuration

attributes.name: payroll_state_codes
attributes.description: Comma-delimited list of two-letter US state codes (e.g., 'CA,TX,NY') representing all states in which workers were paid in this run. Drives multi-state tax filing obligations and SUTA rate application.
attributes.references: Multi-State Payroll Compliance; DOL State Unemployment Insurance; State Income Tax Withholding Laws

attributes.name: posted_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this payroll run was finalized and posted to the General Ledger in Oracle NetSuite ERP, making it immutable for the accounting period.
attributes.references: Oracle NetSuite ERP — GL Posting; GAAP Period Close Controls; SOC 2 Type II

attributes.name: processed_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when TempWorks Payroll completed the payroll calculation and tax computation processing for this run. Used for payroll operations SLA monitoring and processing time analytics.
attributes.references: TempWorks Payroll — Processing Log; SOC 2 Type II Operational Controls

attributes.name: run_number
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric identifier for the pay run, used in reconciliation, audit trails, and payroll operations communications. Format: PR-YYYY-MM-NNNN.
attributes.references: TempWorks Payroll — Pay Run Header; ASA Payroll Standards

attributes.name: run_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the payroll run within TempWorks Payroll workflow. Progresses from open (data entry) through processing, approved, and posted (finalized to GL). Voided indicates the run was reversed.
attributes.references: TempWorks Payroll — Pay Run Workflow; Oracle NetSuite ERP GL Integration

attributes.name: run_type
attributes.description: Classification of the payroll run indicating its operational purpose. Regular runs cover standard pay periods; off-cycle handles out-of-band payments; adjustment corrects prior-period errors; void-and-reissue replaces a voided run; supplemental covers bonuses or special payments.
attributes.references: TempWorks Payroll — Run Type Classification; IRS Publication 15 Supplemental Wages

attributes.name: tax_quarter
attributes.description: Calendar quarter (1–4) to which this payroll run belongs, used for IRS Form 941 quarterly payroll tax filing and FUTA/SUTA quarterly reporting.
attributes.references: IRS Form 941 — Employer's Quarterly Federal Tax Return; FUTA/SUTA Quarterly Reporting

attributes.name: tax_year
attributes.description: Calendar year to which this payroll run's earnings and withholdings are attributed for IRS W-2 and 1099 tax reporting purposes. Critical for year-end tax form generation.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 15 — Tax Year; IRS Form W-2 Instructions; IRS Form 1099-NEC Instructions

attributes.name: total_deductions
attributes.description: Sum of all voluntary and involuntary employee deductions (benefits, garnishments, 401k, health insurance premiums, etc.) withheld from worker gross pay in this run. Reconciles gross-to-net pay calculations.
attributes.references: TempWorks Payroll — Deductions Module; DOL Wage Garnishment Rules; ERISA Benefits Deductions

attributes.name: total_dt_pay
attributes.description: Sum of double time (DT) earnings for all workers in this run, applicable in states such as California where DT is mandated for hours exceeding 12 in a workday or 8 on the seventh consecutive day.
attributes.references: California Labor Code Section 510; TempWorks Payroll — DT Earnings; Multi-State Payroll Compliance

attributes.name: total_employer_burden
attributes.description: Sum of all employer-side payroll costs beyond gross wages in this run, including employer FICA, FUTA, SUTA, workers comp premiums, and employer-paid benefits. Used to calculate the burden rate and total cost of workforce deployment.
attributes.references: TempWorks Payroll — Burden Rate Calculation; ASA Staffing Cost Standards; SIA Workforce Cost Benchmarks

attributes.name: total_fica_employee
attributes.description: Sum of employee-side Federal Insurance Contributions Act (FICA) withholdings (Social Security 6.2% + Medicare 1.45%) across all workers in this run. Reported on IRS Form 941.
attributes.references: FICA — IRC Sections 3101–3102; IRS Form 941; IRS Publication 15

attributes.name: total_fica_employer
attributes.description: Sum of employer-side Federal Insurance Contributions Act (FICA) matching contributions (Social Security 6.2% + Medicare 1.45%) for all W-2 workers in this run. Included in total employer burden calculation.
attributes.references: FICA — IRC Sections 3111–3112; IRS Form 941; IRS Publication 15

attributes.name: total_futa_tax
attributes.business_glossary_term: Total Federal Unemployment Tax Act (FUTA) Tax
attributes.description: Sum of Federal Unemployment Tax Act (FUTA) employer tax accrued in this payroll run, calculated at 6.0% on the first $7,000 of each employee's wages (net of SUTA credit). Filed annually on IRS Form 940.
attributes.references: FUTA — IRC Section 3301; IRS Form 940; IRS Publication 15

attributes.name: total_gross_pay
attributes.description: Sum of all gross earnings for all workers in this payroll run before any deductions or tax withholdings. Includes regular pay, overtime (OT), double time (DT), per diem, and other earnings components.
attributes.references: TempWorks Payroll — Run Totals; FLSA Gross Earnings Definition; IRS Publication 15

attributes.name: total_net_pay
attributes.description: Sum of net pay disbursed to all workers in this run after all tax withholdings and deductions. Represents the total cash outflow for worker compensation and is the primary reconciliation figure against bank ACH/check totals.
attributes.references: TempWorks Payroll — Run Totals; Oracle NetSuite ERP — Accounts Payable Disbursement

attributes.name: total_ot_pay
attributes.description: Sum of overtime (OT) premium earnings for all workers in this run, calculated at 1.5x the regular rate for hours exceeding 40 per workweek per FLSA. Supports OT cost monitoring and client billing reconciliation.
attributes.references: FLSA Section 7 — Overtime Compensation; TempWorks Payroll — OT Earnings

attributes.name: total_per_diem_pay
attributes.description: Sum of per diem allowances paid to workers in this run for travel, lodging, and meal reimbursements. Per diem amounts within IRS GSA rates are non-taxable; amounts above are taxable wages.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 463 — Travel Expenses; GSA Per Diem Rates; TempWorks Payroll — Per Diem

attributes.name: total_pto_pay
attributes.description: Sum of paid time off (PTO) earnings disbursed in this payroll run, including vacation, sick, and holiday pay. Supports PTO accrual reconciliation and state-mandated paid leave compliance.
attributes.references: State Paid Leave Laws; TempWorks Payroll — PTO Earnings; SHRM PTO Policy Standards

attributes.name: total_regular_pay
attributes.description: Sum of straight-time (regular rate) earnings for all workers in this run, excluding overtime, double time, and premium pay components. Used for pay rate analytics and FLSA regular rate of pay calculations.
attributes.references: FLSA — Regular Rate of Pay; TempWorks Payroll — Earnings Breakdown

attributes.name: total_suta_tax
attributes.business_glossary_term: Total State Unemployment Tax Act (SUTA) Tax
attributes.description: Sum of State Unemployment Tax Act (SUTA) employer tax accrued across all applicable states in this payroll run. Rates and wage bases vary by state; critical for multi-state payroll compliance.
attributes.references: SUTA — State Unemployment Insurance Laws; DOL Unemployment Insurance Program; Multi-State Payroll Compliance

attributes.name: total_tax_withholding
attributes.description: Sum of all employee-side tax withholdings across all workers in this run, including federal income tax, state income tax, local taxes, and employee FICA (Social Security and Medicare). Used for IRS Form 941 and state tax deposit reconciliation.
attributes.references: IRS Form 941; IRS Publication 15 — Tax Withholding; FICA — IRC Section 3101

attributes.name: total_workers_comp_premium
attributes.description: Sum of workers compensation insurance premiums accrued for all workers in this payroll run, calculated based on payroll amounts and applicable workers comp class codes and rates. Supports insurance carrier reporting and burden rate analysis.
attributes.references: OSHA Workers Compensation Requirements; State Workers Comp Laws; TempWorks Payroll — Workers Comp Module

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this pay run record was last modified in TempWorks Payroll or the Silver Layer. Supports change data capture, data lineage, and audit trail requirements.
attributes.references: SOC 2 Type II — Audit Trail; GDPR Article 5 — Data Integrity; Databricks Silver Layer CDC

attributes.name: void_reason
attributes.description: Business justification or reason code for voiding this payroll run. Required when run_status = 'voided' to support audit compliance and payroll error tracking.
attributes.references: TempWorks Payroll — Void Reason Codes; SOC 2 Type II Audit Controls

attributes.name: voided_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this payroll run was voided, if applicable. Populated only for runs with run_status = 'voided'. Supports payroll reversal audit trail and GL correction tracking.
attributes.references: TempWorks Payroll — Void Processing; SOC 2 Type II Audit Trail; IRS Payroll Correction Guidance

attributes.name: w2_worker_count
attributes.description: Number of W-2 (Wage and Tax Statement) employees included in this payroll run. Distinguishes co-employed temporary workers from independent contractors for tax and compliance reporting.
attributes.references: IRS Form W-2; FICA Employer Obligations; FLSA Employee Classification

attributes.name: worker_count
attributes.description: Total number of workers (W-2 employees and 1099 independent contractors) included in this payroll run. Used for headcount reporting, payroll audit reconciliation, and workforce analytics.
attributes.references: TempWorks Payroll — Run Summary; ASA Workforce Analytics

products.name: pay_stub
products.description: Transactional record representing the individual worker pay statement generated for each pay run, including full pay disbursement details. Captures worker identifier, pay run reference, gross pay, regular hours, overtime hours, double-time hours, per diem amounts, gross-to-net calculation details, total deductions, total tax withholdings, net pay, and stub status. Disbursement attributes: pay delivery method (direct deposit, check, pay card), check number or ACH trace number, bank routing number, account number (masked), account type (checking, savings), deposit allocation type (full net, fixed amount, percentage split), allocation amounts for split-deposit configurations, deposit priority for multiple accounts, prenote status, account verification status, and pay card routing for unbanked workers. SSOT for individual worker earnings per pay period, associated payment disbursement instructions, and banking configuration — consolidates all direct deposit and ACH details formerly tracked separately.
