attributes.name: account_type
attributes.description: Type of bank account designated for direct deposit disbursement. 'checking' or 'savings' as required by NACHA ACH transaction codes (PPD). Determines the ACH SEC code used in the payment file. Null for check and pay card disbursements.
attributes.references: NACHA ACH Operating Rules; TempWorks Payroll

attributes.name: ach_trace_number
attributes.description: Unique 15-digit NACHA ACH trace number assigned to the direct deposit transaction for this pay stub. Null for check and pay card disbursements. Used for ACH payment tracing, return item resolution, and bank reconciliation.
attributes.references: NACHA ACH Operating Rules and Guidelines; TempWorks Payroll; Federal Reserve ACH

attributes.name: bank_account_number_masked
attributes.description: Worker's bank account number stored in masked format (e.g., '****6789') for display and audit purposes. Full account number is stored in a separate encrypted vault. Classified restricted/PII-financial. Null for check and pay card disbursements.
attributes.references: NACHA ACH Operating Rules; PCI DSS; CCPA; GDPR Article 5; TempWorks Payroll

attributes.name: bank_routing_number
attributes.description: Nine-digit ABA routing transit number identifying the worker's receiving financial institution for direct deposit. Classified restricted/PII-financial as it is a component of banking credentials. Null for check and pay card disbursements.
attributes.references: NACHA ACH Operating Rules; ABA Routing Number Registry; TempWorks Payroll; PCI DSS

attributes.name: check_number
attributes.description: Sequential check number printed on the physical paycheck when pay_delivery_method is 'check'. Null for direct deposit and pay card disbursements. Used for check reconciliation, stop-payment requests, and positive pay bank file matching.
attributes.references: TempWorks Payroll; Banking Positive Pay Standards

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this pay stub record was first created in the payroll system. Satisfies RECORD_AUDIT_CREATED requirement for TRANSACTION_HEADER role. Used for audit trails and payroll processing SLA measurement.
attributes.references: SOC 2 Type II; TempWorks Payroll

attributes.name: deposit_allocation_amount
attributes.description: Dollar amount or percentage value of net pay allocated to this account in a split-deposit arrangement. Populated when deposit_allocation_type is 'fixed_amount' or 'percentage'. Null when deposit_allocation_type is 'full_net'.
attributes.references: NACHA ACH Operating Rules; TempWorks Payroll

attributes.name: deposit_allocation_type
attributes.description: Specifies how net pay is allocated to this bank account in a split-deposit configuration. 'full_net' = entire net pay to one account; 'fixed_amount' = a specific dollar amount; 'percentage' = a defined percentage of net pay. Supports multi-account direct deposit configurations.
attributes.references: NACHA ACH Operating Rules; TempWorks Payroll; DOL Wage Payment Methods

attributes.name: deposit_priority
attributes.description: Numeric sequence (1 = highest priority) determining the order in which net pay is allocated across multiple bank accounts in a split-deposit configuration. Ensures correct disbursement sequencing when a worker has designated multiple accounts.
attributes.references: NACHA ACH Operating Rules; TempWorks Payroll

attributes.name: dt_earnings
attributes.description: Dollar amount of earnings for double-time hours (dt_hours × pay_rate × 2.0). Applicable in states with double-time mandates. Stored as a discrete earnings component for gross pay audit and state compliance reporting.
attributes.references: California Labor Code §510; TempWorks Payroll; DOL Wage and Hour Division

attributes.name: dt_hours
attributes.description: Total double-time hours worked during the pay period, subject to the 2x pay multiplier. Applicable in states such as California with daily double-time thresholds (e.g., hours beyond 12 in a workday). Required for accurate gross pay calculation in multi-state payroll.
attributes.references: California Labor Code §510; TempWorks Payroll; DOL Wage and Hour Division

attributes.name: federal_income_tax_withheld
attributes.description: Dollar amount of federal income tax withheld from the worker's wages for this pay period based on W-4 elections and IRS withholding tables. Required for W-2 reporting (Box 2) and federal tax deposit obligations.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 15; IRS Form W-4; IRS Form W-2 Box 2; 26 USC §3402

attributes.name: futa_taxable_wages
attributes.business_glossary_term: Federal Unemployment Tax Act (FUTA) Taxable Wages
attributes.description: Portion of the worker's gross wages subject to Federal Unemployment Tax Act (FUTA) employer tax for this pay period, up to the $7,000 annual wage base. Required for IRS Form 940 filing and employer burden rate reporting.
attributes.references: FUTA (26 USC §3301); IRS Form 940; IRS Publication 15; TempWorks Payroll

attributes.name: gross_pay
attributes.description: Total pre-deduction, pre-tax earnings for the pay period. Sum of regular_earnings, ot_earnings, dt_earnings, per_diem_amount, and any other pay components. Represents the gross-base amount in the MONETARY_TRIPLET for this transaction. Used as the basis for all tax withholding calculations.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 15; FLSA; TempWorks Payroll; ASA

attributes.name: medicare_tax_withheld
attributes.description: Employee share of Medicare (HI) tax withheld under FICA at the applicable rate (1.45%, plus 0.9% Additional Medicare Tax for high earners). Required for W-2 reporting (Box 6) and FICA deposit compliance.
attributes.references: FICA (26 USC §3101); IRS Form W-2 Box 6; IRS Publication 15; ACA §9015

attributes.name: net_pay
attributes.description: Final take-home amount disbursed to the worker after all deductions and tax withholdings (gross_pay − total_deductions − total_tax_withheld). Represents the net total in the MONETARY_TRIPLET. The amount actually paid via direct deposit, check, or pay card.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 15; TempWorks Payroll; FLSA; DOL

attributes.name: ot_earnings
attributes.description: Dollar amount of earnings for overtime hours (ot_hours × pay_rate × 1.5). Stored separately from regular earnings to support FLSA compliance reporting, overtime cost analytics, and client billing reconciliation.
attributes.references: FLSA (29 CFR Part 778); TempWorks Payroll; DOL Wage and Hour Division

attributes.name: ot_hours
attributes.description: Total overtime hours worked during the pay period, subject to the 1.5x pay multiplier under FLSA. Includes hours exceeding the standard weekly threshold or daily OT thresholds per applicable state law. Critical for gross pay calculation and FLSA compliance reporting.
attributes.references: FLSA (29 CFR Part 778); TempWorks Payroll; DOL Wage and Hour Division

attributes.name: pay_date
attributes.description: The actual date on which payment was or is scheduled to be disbursed to the worker. Represents the principal business event date (BUSINESS_EVENT_TIMESTAMP category). Used for cash flow reporting, tax period assignment, and worker payment scheduling.
attributes.references: TempWorks Payroll; IRS Publication 15; DOL Wage and Hour Division

attributes.name: pay_delivery_method
attributes.description: Method by which net pay is disbursed to the worker. 'direct_deposit' = ACH electronic transfer to bank account; 'check' = physical paper check; 'pay_card' = prepaid debit card for unbanked workers. Determines downstream disbursement routing logic.
attributes.references: TempWorks Payroll; NACHA ACH Operating Rules; DOL Wage Payment Methods

attributes.name: pay_frequency
attributes.description: Frequency at which the worker is paid, determining the pay period cadence for this stub. Drives payroll scheduling, tax withholding annualization, and benefit deduction timing. Most staffing workers are paid weekly or biweekly.
attributes.references: TempWorks Payroll; IRS Publication 15 (Employer's Tax Guide)

attributes.name: pay_period_end_date
attributes.description: Last calendar date of the pay period covered by this stub. Defines the closing boundary of the earnings window. Used for accrual cutoffs, overtime determination, and tax period assignment.
attributes.references: FLSA (29 CFR Part 516); TempWorks Payroll; IRS Publication 15

attributes.name: pay_period_start_date
attributes.description: First calendar date of the pay period covered by this stub. Combined with pay_period_end_date defines the exact earnings window. Required for FLSA overtime calculations and multi-state payroll compliance.
attributes.references: FLSA (29 CFR Part 516); TempWorks Payroll; DOL Wage and Hour Division

attributes.name: pay_rate
attributes.description: The worker's base hourly or unit pay rate applied during this pay period, expressed in USD. Represents the agreed compensation rate from the placement rate card. Used to calculate regular earnings and validate gross pay. Classified confidential as worker compensation data.
attributes.references: TempWorks Payroll; FLSA Minimum Wage Provisions; ASA Compensation Standards

attributes.name: pay_rate_type
attributes.description: Classification of the pay rate basis for this stub. 'hourly' = standard time-based; 'salary' = fixed periodic amount; 'per_diem' = daily allowance-based; 'piece_rate' = unit-of-output based. Determines gross pay calculation method and FLSA overtime applicability.
attributes.references: FLSA (29 CFR Part 778); TempWorks Payroll; IRS Worker Classification Rules

attributes.name: per_diem_amount
attributes.description: Non-taxable per diem allowance paid to the worker for travel, meals, or lodging during the pay period. Sourced from approved per diem claims. Tracked separately from taxable wages for IRS accountable plan compliance and gross pay composition.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 463; GSA Per Diem Rates; TempWorks Payroll; DOL

attributes.name: prenote_status
attributes.description: Status of the NACHA prenote (zero-dollar test transaction) process for this bank account. 'pending' = prenote initiated; 'sent' = prenote transmitted to bank; 'verified' = bank confirmed account valid; 'failed' = account validation failed. Governs whether live ACH disbursement is permitted.
attributes.references: NACHA ACH Operating Rules (Prenote Requirements); TempWorks Payroll

attributes.name: pto_accrual_balance
attributes.description: Worker's remaining PTO accrual balance as of this pay stub's pay period end date, expressed in hours. Snapshot value captured at time of pay run for worker statement display and leave liability reporting.
attributes.references: TempWorks Payroll; SAP SuccessFactors; State PTO Accrual Laws; ASA

attributes.name: pto_hours_used
attributes.description: Number of PTO hours applied to this pay stub for the pay period. Represents paid leave hours that contribute to gross pay but are not worked hours. Required for PTO accrual balance management and FLSA leave tracking.
attributes.references: TempWorks Payroll; SAP SuccessFactors; FLSA; State PTO Laws (e.g., CA, NY, IL)

attributes.name: regular_earnings
attributes.description: Dollar amount of earnings for regular straight-time hours (regular_hours × pay_rate). Core component of gross pay. Stored as a raw earnings component to support gross-to-net audit trail and payroll reconciliation.
attributes.references: FLSA (29 CFR Part 516); TempWorks Payroll; IRS Publication 15

attributes.name: regular_hours
attributes.description: Total straight-time hours worked by the worker during the pay period, up to the overtime threshold (typically 40 hours per week under FLSA). Sourced from approved timesheet records in Kronos Workforce Ready. Used to calculate regular earnings.
attributes.references: FLSA (29 CFR Part 516 and 778); Kronos Workforce Ready; TempWorks Payroll

attributes.name: social_security_tax_withheld
attributes.description: Employee share of Social Security (OASDI) tax withheld under FICA at the applicable rate (6.2% up to the annual wage base). Required for W-2 reporting (Box 4) and FICA tax deposit compliance.
attributes.references: FICA (26 USC §3101); IRS Form W-2 Box 4; IRS Publication 15

attributes.name: state_income_tax_withheld
attributes.description: Dollar amount of state income tax withheld for the primary work state during this pay period. Supports multi-state payroll compliance and state W-2 / equivalent reporting. May be zero for states with no income tax.
attributes.references: TempWorks Payroll; State Revenue Agencies; IRS Publication 15-T; SHRM Multi-State Payroll

attributes.name: stub_number
attributes.description: Externally visible, human-readable identifier for this pay stub as printed on the worker's pay statement (e.g., 'PS-2024-00045231'). Used for worker inquiries, audit trails, and payroll reconciliation. Satisfies BUSINESS_IDENTIFIER requirement for TRANSACTION_HEADER role.
attributes.references: TempWorks Payroll; FLSA Recordkeeping Requirements (29 CFR Part 516)

attributes.name: stub_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the pay stub within the payroll processing workflow. 'draft' = in calculation; 'calculated' = gross-to-net complete pending approval; 'approved' = authorized for disbursement; 'issued' = payment released to worker; 'voided' = cancelled before disbursement; 'reversed' = post-issuance correction applied. Satisfies LIFECYCLE_STATUS requirement.
attributes.references: TempWorks Payroll; DOL FLSA Recordkeeping

attributes.name: suta_taxable_wages
attributes.business_glossary_term: State Unemployment Tax Act (SUTA) Taxable Wages
attributes.description: Portion of the worker's gross wages subject to State Unemployment Tax Act (SUTA) employer tax for this pay period, up to the applicable state wage base. Required for state unemployment tax filing and workforce cost burden rate calculation.
attributes.references: SUTA (State-specific statutes); TempWorks Payroll; DOL Unemployment Insurance Program

attributes.name: tax_filing_status
attributes.description: Worker's federal income tax filing status as declared on IRS Form W-4, used to determine the correct withholding amount for this pay stub. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: single|married_filing_jointly|married_filing_separately|head_of_household|exempt|qualifying_surviving_spouse — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: IRS Form W-4; IRS Publication 15-T; 26 USC §3402; TempWorks Payroll

attributes.name: total_deductions
attributes.description: Aggregate dollar amount of all pre-tax and post-tax deductions applied to this pay stub, including benefits premiums, garnishments, voluntary deductions, and advances. Represents the adjustment component of the MONETARY_TRIPLET. Supports gross-to-net reconciliation.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 15; TempWorks Payroll; DOL Wage and Hour Division

attributes.name: total_tax_withheld
attributes.description: Aggregate dollar amount of all federal, state, and local taxes withheld from the worker's gross pay for this pay period. Includes FICA (Social Security and Medicare), federal income tax, and applicable state/local income taxes. Key component of gross-to-net calculation.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 15; FICA (26 USC §3101); FUTA (26 USC §3301); TempWorks Payroll

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this pay stub record. Satisfies RECORD_AUDIT_UPDATED requirement for TRANSACTION_HEADER role. Tracks corrections, reversals, and status transitions for audit compliance.
attributes.references: SOC 2 Type II; TempWorks Payroll

attributes.name: w2_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether this pay stub is associated with a W-2 employee (True) versus a 1099 independent contractor (False). Drives tax withholding applicability, FICA obligations, and year-end tax form generation routing in TempWorks Payroll.
attributes.references: IRS Form W-2; IRS Form 1099-NEC; IRS Worker Classification Rules; 26 USC §3401; TempWorks Payroll

attributes.name: work_state_code
attributes.description: Two-letter USPS state abbreviation for the state in which the worker performed services during this pay period. Determines applicable state income tax withholding, SUTA rate, workers compensation jurisdiction, and state-specific wage and hour laws.
attributes.references: USPS State Abbreviations; TempWorks Payroll; DOL Multi-State Compliance; SUTA

attributes.name: workers_comp_code
attributes.description: NCCI or state-specific workers compensation classification code assigned to the worker for this pay period based on job duties and work location. Drives workers comp premium calculation and is required for policy compliance and audit.
attributes.references: NCCI Workers Compensation Classification System; OSHA; TempWorks Payroll; compliance.workers_comp_policy

attributes.name: workers_comp_premium
attributes.description: Employer-paid workers compensation insurance premium allocated to this pay stub for the pay period, calculated as (workers_comp_rate × payroll_basis). Represents a key component of the employer burden rate and total labor cost.
attributes.references: NCCI; OSHA; TempWorks Payroll; ASA Workers Comp Guidelines

attributes.name: ytd_gross_pay
attributes.description: Cumulative gross pay earned by the worker from the start of the calendar year through this pay stub's pay period end date. Displayed on the worker's pay statement and used for W-2 wage box population, FICA wage base tracking, and annual compensation reporting.
attributes.references: IRS Form W-2; IRS Publication 15; TempWorks Payroll; FLSA

attributes.name: ytd_net_pay
attributes.description: Cumulative net pay disbursed to the worker from the start of the calendar year through this pay stub's pay period end date. Displayed on the worker's pay statement for annual earnings visibility and financial planning.
attributes.references: TempWorks Payroll; IRS Publication 15; ASA

attributes.name: ytd_tax_withheld
attributes.description: Cumulative total of all taxes withheld from the worker's pay from the start of the calendar year through this pay stub's pay period end date. Displayed on the pay statement and used for W-2 Box 2/4/6 population and tax deposit reconciliation.
attributes.references: IRS Form W-2; IRS Publication 15; TempWorks Payroll

products.name: pay_rate
products.description: Master record defining the pay rate structure for a worker on a specific assignment or job order. Captures regular pay rate, overtime (OT) rate multiplier, double-time (DT) rate multiplier, per diem rate, shift differential rate, effective start and end dates, rate type (hourly, salary, piece-rate, daily), pay frequency (weekly, bi-weekly, semi-monthly), currency, rate source (negotiated, VMS-driven, standard), and approval status. Supports multi-rate scenarios for workers on multiple assignments.

attributes.name: pay_rate_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated identifier for the pay rate record. Primary key for the pay_rate data product in the payroll domain.
attributes.references: TempWorks Payroll - Pay Rate Master

attributes.name: assignment_id
attributes.description: Reference to the worker assignment this pay rate applies to. Supports multi-rate scenarios where a worker may have different rates across concurrent assignments.
attributes.references: Bullhorn ATS/CRM - Placement/Assignment Object; TempWorks Payroll

Staffing operations require direct linkage for rate validation, markup verification, and client

attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to vendor.supplier. Business justification: Staffing agencies use subcontractor vendors to fulfill placements when internal candidate pools are insufficient. Pay rates must track which vendor supplied the worker for vendor invoice reconciliatio
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: vms_rate_id
attributes.description: External rate identifier assigned by the Vendor Management System (VMS), such as Beeline, when the rate is VMS-driven. Used for reconciliation between TempWorks Payroll and Beeline VMS rate management. Populated only when rate_source = 'vms_driven'.
attributes.references: Beeline VMS - Rate Management; ASA Staffing Industry Standards

attributes.name: wage_hour_determination_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.wage_hour_determination. Business justification: Pay rates require validated wage/hour determinations for FLSA exemption status, prevailing wage compliance, and minimum wage validation. Staffing firms must document compliant rate approval before ass

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Current workflow state of the pay rate record. Pending = awaiting manager or compliance approval; approved = active and payroll-eligible; rejected = denied; expired = past effective end date. Controls whether the rate can be used in payroll processing.
attributes.references: TempWorks Payroll - Rate Approval Workflow; ASA Staffing Industry Standards

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the manager, recruiter, or compliance officer who approved this pay rate. Provides audit trail for rate authorization in compliance with internal controls and OFCCP requirements.
attributes.references: OFCCP Compliance; SOC 2 Type II; ASA Staffing Standards; TempWorks Payroll

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the pay rate was formally approved. Part of the rate lifecycle audit trail. Required for SOC 2 Type II compliance and internal payroll controls.
attributes.references: SOC 2 Type II; OFCCP; TempWorks Payroll - Approval Audit

attributes.name: bill_rate
attributes.description: The rate charged to the client for each unit of the worker's time (typically per hour). Stored alongside the pay rate to enable spread and gross margin calculation. The spread (bill_rate minus regular_pay_rate) is the primary revenue metric in staffing. Sourced from the client rate card or VMS.
attributes.references: ASA Staffing Industry Financial Standards; Beeline VMS - Rate Management; Salesforce Revenue Cloud

attributes.name: conversion_fee_waiver_date
attributes.description: Date after which the client's conversion fee obligation is waived if the worker is converted to a permanent employee. Typically tied to a minimum number of hours worked or weeks on assignment per the MSA terms. Null if no conversion fee waiver applies.
attributes.references: ASA Staffing MSA Standards; DocuSign CLM - MSA Terms; Bullhorn ATS/CRM

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the pay rate record was first created in TempWorks Payroll. Provides the audit trail creation anchor for SOC 2 Type II compliance and data lineage tracking in the Databricks Silver Layer.
attributes.references: SOC 2 Type II; GDPR Article 5 (Data Integrity); TempWorks Payroll - Audit Log

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code in which all monetary rate fields are denominated (e.g., USD, CAD, GBP). Supports multi-currency payroll for international staffing operations.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; GDPR; CCPA; TempWorks Payroll

attributes.name: dt_rate_multiplier
attributes.description: Multiplier applied to the regular pay rate to calculate the double-time (DT) pay rate. Typically 2.0x, applicable in states such as California for hours over 12 in a day or on the 7th consecutive day. Applied by TempWorks Payroll for DT hours.
attributes.references: California Labor Code Section 510; FLSA; DOL; TempWorks Payroll

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: The date after which this pay rate is no longer active. Nullable for open-ended rates. When populated, payroll processing after this date must use a successor rate record. Supports rate versioning and assignment extensions.
attributes.references: FLSA; DOL Wage and Hour Division; TempWorks Payroll - Rate Effective Dating

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: The date from which this pay rate becomes active and applicable to payroll processing. Defines the beginning of the rate's binding period. Payroll transactions on or after this date use this rate.
attributes.references: FLSA; DOL Wage and Hour Division; TempWorks Payroll - Rate Effective Dating

attributes.name: fica_exempt
attributes.business_glossary_term: Federal Insurance Contributions Act (FICA) Exempt Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the worker is exempt from FICA (Social Security and Medicare) withholding for this assignment. True for certain visa holders (e.g., F-1, J-1 students) or specific worker classifications. Drives TempWorks Payroll tax withholding logic.
attributes.references: IRS FICA Regulations; IRC Section 3121; TempWorks Payroll - Tax Configuration

attributes.name: flsa_exempt
attributes.business_glossary_term: Fair Labor Standards Act (FLSA) Exempt Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the worker is classified as exempt from FLSA overtime requirements (True = exempt salaried; False = non-exempt hourly). Determines whether OT and DT multipliers apply. Critical for wage and hour compliance and DOL audit defense.
attributes.references: FLSA (Fair Labor Standards Act) Section 13; DOL Wage and Hour Division; TempWorks Payroll

attributes.name: is_blended_rate
attributes.description: Indicates whether this pay rate is a blended rate covering multiple job duties or skill levels within a single assignment. True = blended rate applies; False = single-role rate. Common in SOW engagements and multi-skill temporary placements.
attributes.references: ASA Staffing Contract Standards; Beeline VMS - SOW Rate Management

attributes.name: markup_pct
attributes.description: The percentage markup applied over the regular pay rate to arrive at the bill rate. Expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.45 = 45% markup). Used for pricing analysis, margin reporting, and VMS rate negotiations. Markup = (bill_rate - regular_pay_rate) / regular_pay_rate.
attributes.references: ASA Staffing Industry Financial Standards; SIA Staffing Industry Analysts Benchmarks; Salesforce Revenue Cloud

attributes.name: max_straight_time_hours
attributes.description: Maximum number of hours per week or pay period at the regular pay rate before overtime (OT) rates apply. Typically 40 hours per week under FLSA, but may be lower per client contract or state law (e.g., California daily OT threshold). Drives OT calculation trigger in TempWorks Payroll.
attributes.references: FLSA Section 7; California Labor Code Section 510; DOL; TempWorks Payroll

attributes.name: min_guaranteed_hours
attributes.description: Minimum number of hours per pay period the worker is guaranteed to be paid, regardless of actual hours worked. Common in certain staffing contracts and SOW engagements. Impacts gross pay floor calculation in TempWorks Payroll.
attributes.references: FLSA; DOL Wage and Hour Division; ASA Staffing Contract Standards

attributes.name: ot_rate_multiplier
attributes.description: Multiplier applied to the regular pay rate to calculate the overtime (OT) pay rate. Standard FLSA minimum is 1.5x for hours over 40 per week. May be higher per client contract or state law. Applied by TempWorks Payroll for OT hours on timesheets.
attributes.references: FLSA (Fair Labor Standards Act) Section 7; DOL Wage and Hour Division; TempWorks Payroll

attributes.name: pay_frequency
attributes.description: Frequency at which the worker is paid. Determines payroll cycle alignment in TempWorks Payroll. Weekly is most common for temporary staffing; bi-weekly and semi-monthly for salaried placements.
attributes.references: FLSA (Fair Labor Standards Act); TempWorks Payroll - Pay Cycle Configuration

attributes.name: pay_grade
attributes.description: Internal compensation band or grade classification assigned to this pay rate (e.g., G1, G2, Band A). Used for workforce analytics, compensation equity analysis, and EEOC/OFCCP reporting on pay equity across worker populations.
attributes.references: EEOC Pay Equity Guidelines; OFCCP Compliance; SAP SuccessFactors - Compensation Management

attributes.name: per_diem_rate
attributes.description: Daily non-taxable allowance paid to the worker for meals, lodging, and incidentals when working away from their tax home. Expressed in currency per day. Must comply with IRS per diem guidelines to maintain non-taxable status. Tracked separately from regular pay for tax reporting.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 463 - Travel Expenses; DOL; TempWorks Payroll; GSA Per Diem Rates

attributes.name: pto_accrual_eligible
attributes.business_glossary_term: Paid Time Off (PTO) Accrual Eligible Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the worker accrues Paid Time Off (PTO) under this pay rate configuration. Eligibility may depend on assignment duration, worker classification, or client program rules. Drives PTO accrual processing in TempWorks Payroll.
attributes.references: ASA Staffing Benefits Standards; State PTO Laws; TempWorks Payroll - Benefits Administration

attributes.name: pto_accrual_rate
attributes.description: Rate at which PTO hours accrue per hour worked or per pay period, expressed in hours. For example, 0.0385 hours of PTO per hour worked equates to approximately 1 week of PTO per year. Populated only when pto_accrual_eligible = True.
attributes.references: ASA Staffing Benefits Standards; State PTO Accrual Laws; TempWorks Payroll - PTO Module

attributes.name: rate_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric code uniquely identifying this pay rate configuration within TempWorks Payroll and Beeline VMS. Used for rate card lookups and VMS-driven rate matching.
attributes.references: TempWorks Payroll - Rate Code; Beeline VMS - Rate Management

attributes.name: rate_negotiation_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes documenting the rationale, context, or special conditions behind the negotiated pay rate. May include references to candidate counter-offers, market data justifications, or client-specific rate exceptions. Supports recruiter and account manager context for future rate reviews.
attributes.references: ASA Staffing Standards; TempWorks Payroll - Rate Notes

attributes.name: rate_source
attributes.description: Origin of the pay rate determination. Negotiated = individually agreed with worker; vms_driven = rate set by Vendor Management System (VMS) such as Beeline; standard = internal standard rate table; client_rate_card = derived from client-specific rate card agreement.
attributes.references: Beeline VMS - Rate Management; ASA Staffing Industry Standards

attributes.name: rate_type
attributes.description: Classification of how the worker is compensated. Hourly = per hour worked; salary = fixed periodic amount; piece_rate = per unit produced; daily = per day worked. Drives gross pay calculation logic in TempWorks Payroll.
attributes.references: FLSA (Fair Labor Standards Act); ASA Staffing Compensation Standards; TempWorks Payroll

attributes.name: regular_pay_rate
attributes.description: The base pay rate for the worker expressed in the applicable rate_type unit (e.g., dollars per hour for hourly workers, dollars per day for daily workers). This is the principal quantitative compensation fact. Used as the basis for gross pay calculation in TempWorks Payroll.
attributes.references: FLSA (Fair Labor Standards Act); DOL Wage and Hour Division; TempWorks Payroll

attributes.name: shift_differential_rate
attributes.description: Additional pay rate amount added to the regular pay rate for workers assigned to non-standard shifts (e.g., evening, overnight, weekend). Expressed as a flat dollar amount per hour or as a percentage add-on depending on the shift_differential_type field.
attributes.references: ASA Staffing Compensation Standards; TempWorks Payroll - Shift Differential Configuration

attributes.name: shift_differential_type
attributes.description: Indicates whether the shift_differential_rate is a flat dollar amount added per hour or a percentage of the regular pay rate. Determines how TempWorks Payroll calculates the effective shift pay.
attributes.references: TempWorks Payroll - Shift Differential Configuration; ASA Staffing Standards

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Identifies the operational system of record from which this pay rate record originated. Supports data lineage, reconciliation, and conflict resolution in the Databricks Silver Layer when rates are ingested from multiple upstream systems.
attributes.references: SOC 2 Type II; TempWorks Payroll; Beeline VMS; Bullhorn ATS/CRM

attributes.name: state_code
attributes.description: Two-letter US state code where the worker performs services under this pay rate. Determines applicable SUTA rate, state income tax withholding rules, state-specific overtime laws, and workers comp jurisdiction. Critical for multi-state payroll compliance.
attributes.references: DOL SUTA Regulations; State Labor Laws; IRS Multi-State Payroll Rules; TempWorks Payroll

attributes.name: suta_state_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: State Unemployment Tax Act (SUTA) State Code
attributes.description: Two-letter state code designating the state to which SUTA (State Unemployment Tax Act) taxes are remitted for this worker. May differ from work state_code in multi-state scenarios or when the worker's base state differs from the work location state.
attributes.references: DOL SUTA Regulations; IRS Publication 15; TempWorks Payroll - Tax Filing Module

attributes.name: temp_to_perm_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether the worker under this pay rate is eligible for conversion from temporary to permanent (temp-to-perm or contract-to-hire) placement. Affects conversion fee applicability and rate renegotiation triggers upon conversion.
attributes.references: ASA Staffing Industry Standards; Bullhorn ATS/CRM - Placement Conversion Tracking

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the pay rate record was last modified. Tracks rate amendments, approval status changes, and effective date adjustments. Required for change data capture (CDC) in the Databricks Silver Layer pipeline.
attributes.references: SOC 2 Type II; GDPR Article 5; TempWorks Payroll - Audit Log

attributes.name: worker_classification
attributes.description: Tax and employment classification of the worker for this pay rate. W-2 = employee on company payroll; 1099 = independent contractor (IC); corp_to_corp = contractor billing through their own entity; eor = Employer of Record arrangement. Drives tax withholding, FICA applicability, and payroll processing rules in TempWorks Payroll.
attributes.references: IRS Worker Classification Rules (Rev. Rul. 87-41); INA I-9 Compliance; FLSA; TempWorks Payroll

attributes.name: workers_comp_code
attributes.description: NCCI or state-specific workers compensation classification code associated with the job duties for this pay rate. Determines the workers comp insurance premium rate applied to the worker's wages. Critical for accurate burden rate calculation and insurance compliance.
attributes.references: NCCI Workers Compensation Classification Codes; OSHA; DOL; TempWorks Payroll - Workers Comp Module

products.name: earnings_line
products.description: Transactional line-item record capturing each individual earnings component within a worker pay stub. Covers regular pay, OT pay, DT pay, holiday pay, PTO payout, bonus, commission, per diem, expense reimbursement, shift differential, and other earning types. Stores hours or units, rate applied, earning code, earning description, taxability flag, and computed gross amount. Enables granular gross pay decomposition for reporting and compliance.

Enables full audit trail of payroll corrections and supports prior-period adjustment reporting. Null for original (non-adjustment) earnings lines.

attributes.name: pay_run_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the payroll processing run that generated this earnings line. Links to the payroll batch/run record in TempWorks Payroll. Used for payroll audit trails, reprocessing identification, and reconciliation of payroll runs against approved timesheets and pay stub totals.
attributes.references: TempWorks Payroll — Payroll Run/Batch; SOC 2 Type II

attributes.name: pay_stub_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the parent pay stub (TRANSACTION_HEADER) that this earnings line belongs to. Satisfies HEADER_REFERENCE minimum category for TRANSACTION_LINE role. Links the line item to the worker's gross-to-net pay stub record in TempWorks Payroll.
attributes.references: TempWorks Payroll — Pay Stub Header

attributes.name: profile_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the worker (temporary associate, contractor, or permanent employee) whose earnings this line represents. Satisfies PARTY_REFERENCE minimum category. Links to the candidate/worker master record in Bullhorn ATS/CRM and SAP SuccessFactors.
attributes.references: Bullhorn ATS/CRM — Candidate/Worker Record; SAP SuccessFactors — Core HR

attributes.name: sow_engagement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to placement.sow_engagement. Business justification: SOW engagements generate earnings when worker is W-2 employee. Milestone or hourly SOW work creates payroll earnings that must link to engagement for billing reconciliation and cost tracking.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: timesheet_id
attributes.description: Reference to the approved timesheet record from which this earnings line was derived. Links payroll earnings back to the source time and attendance data captured in Kronos Workforce Ready. Null for non-hour-based earnings such as bonuses or expense reimbursements.
attributes.references: Kronos Workforce Ready — Time and Attendance; timesheet.approved_hours_summary

attributes.name: wage_hour_determination_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.wage_hour_determination. Business justification: Each earnings line must comply with overtime rules, prevailing wage requirements, and FLSA classifications. Payroll systems validate earnings against wage/hour determinations to ensure compliant OT ca
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: work_location_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific client work location where the worker performed services during this pay period. Used for workers compensation premium allocation by location, multi-state tax nexus determination, and client billing reconciliation. Links to the placement work location record.
attributes.references: placement.work_location; TempWorks Payroll — Work Location; Workers Comp Premium Allocation

attributes.name: check_date
attributes.description: The date on which the worker's paycheck or direct deposit is issued. Represents the principal business event date for this earnings line. Used for tax period determination (W-2 year allocation), cash flow reporting, and worker payment confirmation. Satisfies BUSINESS_EVENT_TIMESTAMP minimum category.
attributes.references: TempWorks Payroll — Check Date; IRS Publication 15 — Tax Deposit Rules; DOL

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this earnings line record was first created in the payroll system. Satisfies RECORD_AUDIT_CREATED minimum category. Used for data lineage, audit trails, and SOC 2 Type II compliance. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: SOC 2 Type II — Audit Trail; TempWorks Payroll; GDPR Article 5 — Data Integrity

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the monetary amounts on this earnings line. Defaults to USD for domestic US staffing operations. Relevant for international EOR (Employer of Record) arrangements and cross-border staffing engagements. Supports multi-currency payroll processing for global staffing operations.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 — Currency Codes; GDPR (for international operations); EOR

attributes.name: earning_code
attributes.description: Standardized alphanumeric code identifying the type of earning component (e.g., REG for regular pay, OT for overtime, DT for double time, HOL for holiday, PTO for paid time off, BONUS, COMM for commission, PERDIEM, EXPREIM for expense reimbursement, SHFTDIFF for shift differential). Satisfies RESOURCE_REFERENCE minimum category as the classification key for the earning type resource. Drives tax treatment, GL account mapping, and compliance reporting.
attributes.references: TempWorks Payroll — Earning Code Table; FLSA (Fair Labor Standards Act); IRS Publication 15

attributes.name: earning_description
attributes.description: Human-readable description of the earning component as it appears on the worker's pay stub. Examples: 'Regular Hours', 'Overtime Pay', 'Holiday Pay - Labor Day', 'PTO Payout', 'Weekly Per Diem - Chicago Assignment'. Provides transparency to the worker and supports payroll audit trails.
attributes.references: TempWorks Payroll — Pay Stub Line Description; DOL Wage Statement Requirements

attributes.name: earning_type
attributes.description: Categorical classification of the earning component. Drives gross pay decomposition, tax withholding logic, and compliance reporting. Regular = straight-time wages; OT (Overtime) = FLSA-mandated 1.5x pay; DT (Double Time) = 2x pay per CBA or client agreement; PTO (Paid Time Off) = accrued leave payout; Per Diem = non-taxable daily allowance; Expense Reimbursement = accountable plan reimbursement. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: regular|overtime|double_time|holiday|pto|bonus|commission|per_diem|expense_reimbursement|shift_differential|other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: TempWorks Payroll — Earning Type; FLSA; IRS Publication 15; ASA Staffing Compensation Standards

attributes.name: flsa_exemption_status
attributes.business_glossary_term: Fair Labor Standards Act (FLSA) Exemption Status
attributes.description: FLSA overtime exemption classification for the worker on this earnings line. Non-exempt workers are entitled to OT pay at 1.5x for hours over 40/week. Exempt classifications (executive, administrative, professional, highly compensated) are not entitled to FLSA overtime. Drives overtime eligibility and compliance with DOL wage and hour regulations.
attributes.references: FLSA (Fair Labor Standards Act) §213; DOL Wage and Hour Division; compliance.worker_classification

attributes.name: gross_amount
attributes.description: Computed gross dollar amount for this earnings line, calculated as hours_quantity multiplied by pay_rate, or as a flat amount for non-hourly earnings. Represents the worker's pre-tax, pre-deduction compensation for this specific earning component. Satisfies LINE_VALUE_OR_RESULT minimum category for TRANSACTION_LINE role. Feeds into gross pay totals on the pay stub.
attributes.references: TempWorks Payroll — Gross Earnings; IRS Publication 15; DOL Wage Statement Requirements

attributes.name: hours_quantity
attributes.description: Number of hours or units associated with this earnings line. For hour-based earnings (regular, OT, DT, holiday, PTO), this is the number of hours worked or paid. For unit-based earnings (piece rate, per diem days), this represents the unit count. Null for flat-amount earnings such as bonuses or expense reimbursements. Satisfies LINE_QUANTITY minimum category for TRANSACTION_LINE role.
attributes.references: TempWorks Payroll — Hours/Units; Kronos Workforce Ready — Labor Analytics; FLSA

attributes.name: is_adjustment
attributes.description: Indicates whether this earnings line is a payroll adjustment or correction entry rather than an original earnings line. True for retroactive pay corrections, prior-period adjustments, and manual override entries. Adjustment lines may carry negative gross_amount values to reverse prior earnings. Used for payroll audit and SOX compliance.
attributes.references: TempWorks Payroll — Payroll Adjustments; SOC 2 Type II; GAAP

attributes.name: is_fica_subject
attributes.business_glossary_term: Federal Insurance Contributions Act (FICA) Subject Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this earning component is subject to FICA (Federal Insurance Contributions Act) taxes, comprising Social Security (6.2%) and Medicare (1.45%) withholding. False for per diem reimbursements, expense reimbursements under accountable plans, and certain non-cash fringe benefits. Critical for accurate payroll tax calculation and IRS Form 941 filing.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 15 — FICA; Internal Revenue Code §3101; FICA (Federal Insurance Contributions Act)

attributes.name: is_overtime
attributes.description: Indicates whether this earnings line represents overtime pay as defined under FLSA (Fair Labor Standards Act) — hours worked beyond 40 in a workweek compensated at a minimum of 1.5x the regular rate. Used for FLSA compliance reporting, overtime cost analytics, and client billing reconciliation where OT bill rates differ from straight-time rates.
attributes.references: FLSA (Fair Labor Standards Act) §207; DOL Wage and Hour Division; ASA

attributes.name: is_taxable
attributes.description: Indicates whether this earning component is subject to federal and state income tax withholding. True for wages, OT, DT, holiday pay, bonuses, and commissions. False for qualifying per diem allowances within IRS GSA limits, accountable plan expense reimbursements, and certain fringe benefits. Drives FICA, FUTA, SUTA, and income tax withholding calculations.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 15 — Employer's Tax Guide; IRS Publication 463 — Travel Expenses; FICA; FUTA; SUTA

attributes.name: labor_category_code
attributes.description: Classification code identifying the labor category or job classification for this earnings line (e.g., LIGHT_IND for light industrial, IT_PROF for IT professional, CLERICAL, HEALTHCARE). Used for workforce cost analytics, bill rate reconciliation, and compliance with prevailing wage determinations under DOL regulations. Aligns with timesheet.labor_category.
attributes.references: timesheet.labor_category; DOL Prevailing Wage; compliance.wage_hour_determination; Beeline VMS — Labor Category

attributes.name: line_sequence
attributes.description: Sequential line number ordering this earnings component within the parent pay stub. Satisfies LINE_SEQUENCE minimum category for TRANSACTION_LINE role. Used for display ordering on pay stubs and for deterministic processing order during gross pay calculation.
attributes.references: TempWorks Payroll — Earnings Line Sequence

attributes.name: line_status
attributes.description: Current processing status of this earnings line within the payroll workflow. Pending = awaiting payroll approval; Approved = authorized for payment; Processed = included in a completed payroll run; Voided = cancelled/reversed; Adjusted = corrected via an adjustment entry. Satisfies LIFECYCLE_STATUS minimum category for TRANSACTION_LINE role.
attributes.references: TempWorks Payroll — Earnings Line Status; DOL Wage Statement Requirements

attributes.name: ot_multiplier
attributes.description: The pay rate multiplier applied to the base pay rate for premium pay earnings. Standard values: 1.0000 for regular pay, 1.5000 for OT (overtime), 2.0000 for DT (double time). May reflect CBA (collective bargaining agreement) or client-specific premium rates. Used to validate gross_amount calculation and support FLSA compliance audits.
attributes.references: FLSA (Fair Labor Standards Act); DOL; TempWorks Payroll — Rate Multiplier

attributes.name: pay_frequency
attributes.description: The frequency at which the worker is paid, determining the pay period structure for this earnings line. Weekly is most common for temporary staffing workers. Biweekly and semimonthly are common for permanent placements. Drives payroll processing schedule in TempWorks Payroll and tax withholding table selection.
attributes.references: TempWorks Payroll — Pay Frequency; IRS Publication 15 — Withholding Tables; DOL

attributes.name: pay_period_end_date
attributes.description: Last calendar date of the pay period to which this earnings line applies. Defines the closing boundary of the work period being compensated. Used in conjunction with pay_period_start_date for FLSA overtime workweek calculations and state wage statement compliance.
attributes.references: TempWorks Payroll — Pay Period; FLSA; DOL Wage and Hour Division

attributes.name: pay_period_start_date
attributes.description: First calendar date of the pay period to which this earnings line applies. Combined with pay_period_end_date, defines the work period being compensated. Critical for multi-state payroll compliance, FLSA overtime calculation, and tax period allocation.
attributes.references: TempWorks Payroll — Pay Period; FLSA; DOL Wage and Hour Division

attributes.name: pay_rate
attributes.description: The hourly, daily, or unit rate applied to this earnings line to compute the gross amount. Represents the worker's agreed compensation rate for this earning type (e.g., straight-time rate, OT rate at 1.5x, DT rate at 2x). Sourced from the placement rate agreement in Bullhorn ATS/CRM. Confidential as it contains worker compensation data.
attributes.references: Bullhorn ATS/CRM — Placement Rate; placement.rate; FLSA Minimum Wage Standards; DOL

attributes.name: per_diem_rate_daily
attributes.description: The daily per diem rate applied for this earnings line when earning_type is per_diem. Compared against GSA (General Services Administration) published rates to determine taxability — amounts within GSA limits are non-taxable; excess amounts are taxable wages. Null for non-per-diem earning types.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 463; GSA Per Diem Rates; placement.per_diem; DOL

attributes.name: per_diem_type
attributes.description: Classification of per diem allowance type when earning_type is per_diem. Lodging = accommodation allowance; Meals and Incidentals (M&IE) = daily meal and incidental expense allowance; Combined = single daily rate covering both; None = not a per diem line. GSA per diem rates determine taxability thresholds. Null or 'none' for non-per-diem earning types.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 463 — Per Diem; GSA Per Diem Rates; placement.per_diem; DOL

attributes.name: prevailing_wage_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this earnings line is subject to prevailing wage requirements under the Davis-Bacon Act, Service Contract Act, or state prevailing wage laws. True for government contract assignments requiring certified payroll reporting. Triggers additional compliance reporting obligations to DOL and OFCCP.
attributes.references: Davis-Bacon Act; Service Contract Act; DOL Wage and Hour Division; OFCCP; compliance.wage_hour_determination

attributes.name: shift_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the work shift associated with this earnings line (e.g., DAY, EVE for evening, NIGHT, WKND for weekend). Used to apply shift differential pay rates and to reconcile earnings with Kronos Workforce Ready scheduling data. Relevant for shift_differential earning types.
attributes.references: Kronos Workforce Ready — Shift Scheduling; TempWorks Payroll — Shift Differential

attributes.name: source_system_ref
attributes.description: The native record identifier from the originating payroll system (TempWorks Payroll) for this earnings line. Enables traceability and reconciliation between the lakehouse silver layer and the operational system of record. Used for audit trails, data lineage, and dispute resolution.
attributes.references: TempWorks Payroll — Earnings Line Record ID; SOC 2 Type II — Data Lineage

attributes.name: tax_year
attributes.description: The calendar tax year (YYYY) to which this earnings line is attributed for W-2 or 1099 reporting purposes. Determined by the check_date. Critical for year-end tax form preparation, IRS reporting, and multi-year payroll analytics. Enables accurate W-2 box 1 (wages) and 1099-NEC box 1 (nonemployee compensation) aggregation.
attributes.references: IRS Form W-2; IRS Form 1099-NEC; IRS Publication 15; TempWorks Payroll — Tax Year

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this earnings line record was most recently modified. Satisfies RECORD_AUDIT_UPDATED minimum category. Tracks payroll corrections, status changes, and retroactive adjustments. Used for incremental data pipeline processing in the Databricks Lakehouse silver layer. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: SOC 2 Type II — Audit Trail; TempWorks Payroll; GDPR Article 5 — Data Integrity

attributes.name: work_state_code
attributes.description: Two-letter US state code where the work was performed for this earnings line. Drives state income tax withholding, SUTA (State Unemployment Tax Act) employer contributions, state-specific overtime rules, and workers compensation premium allocation. Critical for multi-state payroll compliance in staffing operations where workers may be deployed across multiple states.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 15 — Multi-State Payroll; SUTA; DOL; ANSI INCITS 38 — State Codes

attributes.name: worker_type
attributes.description: Tax and employment classification of the worker for this earnings line. W-2 Temp = temporary employee on agency payroll; W-2 Perm = permanent placed employee; 1099 IC (Independent Contractor) = self-employed contractor; EOR (Employer of Record) = worker employed through EOR arrangement. Determines tax withholding obligations, FICA applicability, FUTA/SUTA liability, and W-2 vs 1099 year-end tax form issuance.
attributes.references: IRS — Worker Classification Rules; IRS Form W-2; IRS Form 1099-NEC; EOR; compliance.worker_classification; FLSA

attributes.name: workers_comp_code
attributes.description: NCCI (National Council on Compensation Insurance) workers compensation class code applicable to this earnings line. Determines the workers comp insurance premium rate applied to the gross wages. Critical for accurate workers comp cost allocation, experience modification factor calculations, and compliance with state workers compensation insurance requirements.
attributes.references: NCCI Workers Compensation Class Codes; compliance.workers_comp_policy; OSHA; DOL

products.name: tax_line
products.description: Transactional record capturing all payroll tax obligations — both employee withholdings and employer-side taxes — per worker per pay stub within a pay run. Employee side: federal income tax, state income tax, local/city tax, FICA Social Security and Medicare employee shares, additional Medicare surtax, and supplemental withholdings. Employer side: FICA Social Security and Medicare employer match, FUTA, SUTA by state, and local employer taxes. Stores tax side discriminator (employee/employer), tax authority jurisdiction, tax type code, taxable wage base, tax rate applied, withholding method (percentage, flat, table-based), computed amount, YTD taxable wages, YTD amount, and multi-state jurisdiction details. SSOT for ALL payroll tax line items — both employee withholdings and employer taxes are unified in this single product with a tax_side discriminator. Critical for gross-to-net calculation, burden rate validation, multi-state payroll tax filing, and quarterly/annual tax reconciliation.

attributes.name: tax_line_id
attributes.description: Primary key for tax_line

attributes.name: gl_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.gl_account. Business justification: Tax withholdings and employer taxes post to specific GL liability and expense accounts (FICA payable, FUTA expense, SUTA expense). Required for accurate balance sheet, P&L, and tax liability reconcili

attributes.name: original_tax_line_id
attributes.description: Reference to the original tax line record that this adjustment line corrects or reverses. Null for original (non-adjustment) lines. Enables audit trail linking between original and corrected tax line records.
attributes.references: IRS Form 941-X; TempWorks Payroll; SOC 2 Type II Audit Trail

attributes.name: pay_run_id
attributes.description: Reference to the payroll processing run (batch) in which this tax line was computed. Supports reconciliation of all tax lines within a single payroll cycle.
attributes.references: TempWorks Payroll — Pay Run Entity

attributes.name: pay_stub_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent pay stub (paycheck) that this tax line belongs to. Establishes the header/detail relationship between the pay stub and its individual tax line items. TRANSACTION_LINE HEADER_REFERENCE category.
attributes.references: TempWorks Payroll — Pay Stub Entity

attributes.name: profile_id
attributes.description: Reference to the worker (W-2 employee or 1099 independent contractor) for whom this tax line is computed. TRANSACTION_LINE PARTY_REFERENCE category.
attributes.references: TempWorks Payroll — Worker Entity; IRS Worker Classification Rules

attributes.name: tax_filing_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to payroll.tax_filing. Business justification: Tax line records (individual tax obligations per pay stub) feed into aggregate tax filings (941, state quarterly filings). Adding FK tax_filing_id → tax_filing.payroll_tax_filing_id links each tax_lin
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link
