attributes.description: Foreign key linking to payroll.tax_withholding_election. Business justification: Tax withholding execution (tax_line) should reference the worker's tax withholding election (W-4 form data) that drove the calculation. tax_line currently has denormalized attributes filing_status, al
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: add_medicare_surtax_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this tax line represents the Additional Medicare Tax (0.9% surtax) applicable to high-earning employees whose wages exceed the IRS threshold ($200,000 for single filers). Employer does not match this surtax.
attributes.references: IRS Notice 2013-45; ACA Additional Medicare Tax (26 U.S.C. §3101(b)(2)); IRS Publication 15

attributes.name: adjustment_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this tax line is an adjustment or correction to a previously processed tax line (e.g., retroactive rate change, prior-period correction, amended return adjustment). When True, adjustment_reason should be populated.
attributes.references: IRS Form 941-X; IRS Publication 15; TempWorks Payroll

attributes.name: adjustment_reason
attributes.description: Free-text description of the reason for a tax line adjustment when adjustment_flag is True (e.g., 'Retroactive SUTA rate change Q1 2024', 'W-4 correction applied', 'Prior period underpayment correction').
attributes.references: IRS Form 941-X; IRS Publication 15; TempWorks Payroll

attributes.name: check_date
attributes.description: The date on which the paycheck or direct deposit was issued to the worker. Determines the tax deposit liability date and the calendar year to which the tax obligation is attributed for W-2 reporting purposes.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 15; IRS Tax Deposit Rules; TempWorks Payroll

attributes.name: computed_amount
attributes.description: The calculated tax dollar amount for this line in the current pay period (taxable_wage_base × tax_rate, or flat amount for flat-rate taxes). Core value used in gross-to-net calculation and payroll tax remittance. TRANSACTION_LINE LINE_VALUE_OR_RESULT category.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 15; FICA; FUTA; SUTA; TempWorks Payroll

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this tax line record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail, data lineage, and SOC 2 Type II compliance requirements. TRANSACTION_LINE RECORD_AUDIT_CREATED category.
attributes.references: SOC 2 Type II; GDPR Article 5(2); CCPA; Internal Data Governance Standard

attributes.name: deposit_schedule
attributes.description: The employer's IRS-assigned federal tax deposit schedule for this tax type (monthly, semi-weekly, or next-day for large deposits). Determines the tax_deposit_liability_date. State deposit schedules may differ.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 15 (Deposit Rules); IRS Form 941

attributes.name: futa_credit_rate
attributes.business_glossary_term: Federal Unemployment Tax Act (FUTA) State Credit Rate
attributes.description: The FUTA state tax credit rate (up to 5.4%) applied to reduce the gross FUTA rate of 6.0% when the employer has paid SUTA taxes in a credit-reduction state. Applies only to FUTA tax type lines.
attributes.references: FUTA (26 U.S.C. §3302); IRS Form 940; U.S. Department of Labor (DOL)

attributes.name: line_sequence
attributes.description: Sequential ordering number of this tax line within the parent pay stub. Enables deterministic ordering and display of all tax line items on a pay stub. TRANSACTION_LINE LINE_SEQUENCE category.
attributes.references: TempWorks Payroll — Tax Line Ordering

attributes.name: pay_period_end_date
attributes.description: The last calendar date of the pay period to which this tax line applies. Together with pay_period_start_date, defines the exact payroll period for tax obligation accrual and filing.
attributes.references: IRS Form 941; IRS Publication 15; TempWorks Payroll

attributes.name: pay_period_start_date
attributes.description: The first calendar date of the pay period to which this tax line applies. Used for period-over-period tax reporting, quarterly filing (Form 941/940), and annual W-2 reconciliation.
attributes.references: IRS Form 941; IRS Publication 15; TempWorks Payroll

attributes.name: remittance_status
attributes.description: Current status of the tax remittance for this line to the applicable tax authority. Tracks whether the tax has been deposited on time, is pending, was remitted late (triggering penalty exposure), has been adjusted, or voided. TRANSACTION_LINE LIFECYCLE_STATUS category.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 15; U.S. Department of Labor (DOL); FUTA; SUTA

attributes.name: source_system_record_code
attributes.description: The native record identifier from TempWorks Payroll (the system of record) for this tax line. Enables traceability and reconciliation between the lakehouse Silver layer and the operational payroll system.
attributes.references: TempWorks Payroll; SOC 2 Type II; Internal Data Governance Standard

attributes.name: suta_experience_rate
attributes.business_glossary_term: State Unemployment Tax Act (SUTA) Experience Rate
attributes.description: The employer's SUTA experience-rated tax rate for the applicable state, as assigned by the state unemployment agency based on the company's claims history. Applies only to SUTA tax type lines. Drives burden rate calculations.
attributes.references: SUTA; U.S. Department of Labor (DOL); State Unemployment Insurance Agencies

attributes.name: suta_state
attributes.business_glossary_term: State Unemployment Tax Act (SUTA) State Code
attributes.description: Two-letter state code identifying the state to which SUTA taxes are remitted for this worker. May differ from the worker's work state in multi-state assignments. Applies only to SUTA tax type lines.
attributes.references: SUTA; U.S. Department of Labor (DOL); American Staffing Association (ASA)

attributes.name: tax_authority_level
attributes.description: Level of government authority imposing this tax obligation. Supports multi-state payroll compliance and jurisdiction-level tax filing and reporting.
attributes.references: IRS; U.S. Department of Labor (DOL); FUTA; SUTA; FLSA

attributes.name: tax_deposit_liability_date
attributes.description: The date by which the employer must remit this tax to the applicable tax authority (IRS, state, or local). Determined by the employer's deposit schedule (monthly or semi-weekly for federal; varies by state). Critical for avoiding late deposit penalties.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 15 (Deposit Rules); IRS Form 941; U.S. Department of Labor (DOL)

attributes.name: tax_exempt_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the worker is exempt from this specific tax type (e.g., FICA exemption for certain visa holders, FUTA exemption for specific worker categories). When True, computed_amount is zero and the exemption basis should be documented.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 15; FICA Exemptions; Immigration and Nationality Act (INA) — Visa Tax Treaties

attributes.name: tax_exempt_reason
attributes.description: Reason or basis for the tax exemption when tax_exempt_flag is True (e.g., 'F-1 Visa FICA Exemption', 'W-4 Exempt Election', 'Agricultural Worker FUTA Exemption'). Required for compliance audit trail.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 15; Immigration and Nationality Act (INA); FICA Exemptions

attributes.name: tax_jurisdiction_fips
attributes.business_glossary_term: Tax Jurisdiction Federal Information Processing Standards (FIPS) Code
attributes.description: Five-digit FIPS code uniquely identifying the county or county-equivalent jurisdiction for this tax line. Enables precise multi-state and local tax jurisdiction mapping and filing.
attributes.references: U.S. Census Bureau FIPS Codes; IRS Publication 15; SUTA

attributes.name: tax_jurisdiction_locality
attributes.description: Name of the local taxing jurisdiction (city, county, municipality, school district) for local/city tax lines. Null for federal and state-level taxes. Supports local tax filing compliance.
attributes.references: U.S. Department of Labor (DOL); Local Tax Ordinances

attributes.name: tax_jurisdiction_state
attributes.description: Two-letter U.S. state code (USPS abbreviation) for the state in which this tax obligation applies. Null for federal-only taxes. Critical for multi-state payroll tax filing and SUTA rate management.
attributes.references: SUTA; IRS Publication 15-T; American Staffing Association (ASA) Multi-State Compliance

attributes.name: tax_quarter
attributes.description: Calendar quarter (1–4) in which this tax line falls, derived from the check date. Used for quarterly payroll tax filing (IRS Form 941, FUTA Form 940, and state equivalents) and quarterly reconciliation.
attributes.references: IRS Form 941; IRS Form 940; U.S. Department of Labor (DOL)

attributes.name: tax_rate
attributes.description: The effective tax rate (as a decimal fraction, e.g., 0.062000 for 6.2%) applied to the taxable wage base to compute the tax amount for this line. For flat-dollar taxes, this may be zero with the flat amount captured in computed_amount.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 15; FICA; FUTA; SUTA; U.S. Department of Labor (DOL)

attributes.name: tax_side
attributes.description: Discriminator indicating whether this tax line represents an employee-side withholding (deducted from worker gross pay) or an employer-side tax obligation (borne by the staffing company). Critical for gross-to-net calculation and burden rate validation. TRANSACTION_LINE LINE_VALUE_OR_RESULT category (discriminator).
attributes.references: IRS Publication 15 (Circular E); FICA; FUTA; SUTA

attributes.name: tax_type_code
attributes.description: Standardized code identifying the specific type of tax obligation on this line (e.g., FIT, SIT, FICA_SS_EE, FICA_MED_EE, FICA_SS_ER, FICA_MED_ER, FUTA, SUTA, LOCAL, ADD_MED, SUPP). Used for tax filing, reporting, and reconciliation. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: FIT|SIT|LOCAL|FICA_SS_EE|FICA_MED_EE|FICA_SS_ER|FICA_MED_ER|FUTA|SUTA|ADD_MED|SUPP — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: IRS Publication 15; FLSA; FUTA; SUTA; FICA (26 U.S.C. §3101–3128)

attributes.name: tax_type_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the tax type (e.g., 'Federal Income Tax', 'California State Income Tax', 'FICA Social Security Employee', 'Federal Unemployment Tax'). Displayed on pay stubs and tax reports.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 15; U.S. Department of Labor (DOL)

attributes.name: tax_year
attributes.description: Calendar year (e.g., 2024) to which this tax line is attributed for annual tax reporting, W-2/1099 issuance, and year-end reconciliation.
attributes.references: IRS Form W-2; IRS Form 1099-NEC; IRS Publication 15

attributes.name: taxable_wage_base
attributes.description: The portion of the worker's gross wages subject to this specific tax in the current pay period, after applying any applicable wage base caps (e.g., Social Security wage base, FUTA/SUTA wage base limits). TRANSACTION_LINE LINE_QUANTITY category.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 15; FICA (26 U.S.C. §3101); FUTA (26 U.S.C. §3301); SUTA

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this tax line record was last modified. Tracks adjustments, corrections, and status changes for audit trail and data lineage purposes. TRANSACTION_LINE RECORD_AUDIT_UPDATED category.
attributes.references: SOC 2 Type II; GDPR Article 5(2); CCPA; Internal Data Governance Standard

attributes.name: wage_base_annual_limit
attributes.description: The annual taxable wage base ceiling for this tax type (e.g., $168,600 for Social Security in 2024; $7,000 for FUTA). Once the worker's YTD wages exceed this limit, no further tax is assessed for this tax type in the calendar year.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 15; FICA (26 U.S.C. §3121(a)(1)); FUTA (26 U.S.C. §3306(b)); SUTA

attributes.name: wage_base_cap_reached
attributes.description: Indicates whether the worker has reached the annual taxable wage base ceiling for this tax type in the current calendar year. When True, no further tax is assessed for this tax type until the next calendar year reset.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 15; FICA; FUTA; SUTA

attributes.name: withholding_method
attributes.description: Method used to calculate the tax withholding for this line: percentage of taxable wages, flat dollar amount, IRS tax table lookup, supplemental flat rate, or exempt (no withholding). Drives the calculation logic applied in TempWorks Payroll.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 15-T; IRS Withholding Methods; TempWorks Payroll

attributes.name: worker_tax_form_type
attributes.description: Indicates whether the worker is classified as a W-2 employee (subject to withholding) or a 1099 independent contractor (IC) for this tax line. Drives which tax obligations apply and which annual tax form is issued. Aligns with IRS worker classification rules.
attributes.references: IRS Form W-2; IRS Form 1099-NEC; IRS Worker Classification Rules; Immigration and Nationality Act (INA)

attributes.name: ytd_tax_amount
attributes.description: Cumulative tax amount withheld or assessed for this worker under this tax type from the start of the calendar year through and including this pay period. Critical for quarterly (941/940) and annual (W-2/1099) tax reconciliation and filing.
attributes.references: IRS Form W-2; IRS Form 941; IRS Form 940; FICA; FUTA; SUTA

attributes.name: ytd_taxable_wages
attributes.description: Cumulative taxable wages for this worker under this tax type from the start of the calendar year through and including this pay period. Used to enforce annual wage base limits and for W-2/1099 annual reconciliation.
attributes.references: IRS Form W-2 Box 3/5; IRS Publication 15; FICA; FUTA; SUTA

products.name: deduction_line
products.description: Transactional line-item record for each voluntary or involuntary deduction applied to a worker pay stub, serving as the SSOT for all payroll deductions including benefit enrollment-driven withholdings. For benefit-type deductions: stores benefit plan name, plan type (medical, dental, vision, 401k, FSA, HSA, life, supplemental), coverage tier (employee only, employee+spouse, family), employee premium contribution, employer contribution, benefit carrier, enrollment effective and termination dates, and enrollment status. For garnishment-type deductions: references the governing garnishment order. For all deductions: stores deduction code, deduction type (pre-tax, post-tax, benefit, garnishment), deduction amount, deduction frequency, YTD deduction total, court order reference for garnishments, and deduction status (active, suspended, terminated). Consolidates benefit enrollment tracking with deduction processing — enrollment attributes drive premium withholding calculations each pay period.

attributes.name: deduction_line_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated identifier for each deduction line item on a worker pay stub. Primary key for the deduction_line product. Entity role: TRANSACTION_LINE — represents one deduction item within a payroll check/pay stub header.
attributes.references: TempWorks Payroll — Deduction Line Entity

attributes.name: benefit_enrollment_id
attributes.description: Reference to the benefit enrollment record that drives this deduction for benefit-type deductions (medical, dental, vision, 401k, FSA, HSA, life, supplemental). Null for non-benefit deductions such as garnishments or voluntary deductions not tied to a benefit plan.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors — Benefits Administration; TempWorks Payroll — Benefit Enrollment

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Employer contributions (benefits, 401k match) are cost center expenses impacting departmental burden rates and profitability. Required for accurate cost center P&L in staffing operations with multi-lo
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: garnishment_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the governing court or agency garnishment order for garnishment-type deductions (child support, tax levy, creditor garnishment). Null for non-garnishment deductions.
attributes.references: TempWorks Payroll — Garnishment Order Entity; U.S. Department of Labor (DOL) Wage Garnishment Rules; Consumer Credit Protection Act (CCPA) Title III

attributes.name: gl_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.gl_account. Business justification: Deductions post to liability accounts (401k payable, health insurance payable) and expense accounts (employer match). gl_account_code exists as denormalized; FK required for accurate balance sheet and
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: pay_run_id
attributes.description: Reference to the payroll processing run batch in which this deduction line was calculated and applied. Enables traceability of deductions back to a specific payroll cycle execution.
attributes.references: TempWorks Payroll — Payroll Run Entity

attributes.name: pay_stub_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent payroll check (pay stub) to which this deduction line belongs. TRANSACTION_LINE role: HEADER_REFERENCE — links this line to its parent payroll transaction header.
attributes.references: TempWorks Payroll — Paycheck/Pay Stub Entity

attributes.name: profile_id
attributes.description: Reference to the worker (employee, temporary associate, or contractor) whose pay is being reduced by this deduction. Supports multi-worker payroll processing across W-2 and 1099 classifications.
attributes.references: TempWorks Payroll — Worker/Employee Entity; FLSA; IRS Worker Classification Rules

attributes.name: annual_limit_amount
attributes.description: Maximum dollar amount that may be withheld for this deduction type in a calendar year, as set by IRS regulations or plan rules (e.g., IRS 401k elective deferral limit, FSA annual contribution cap, HSA annual contribution limit). Used to automatically stop withholding once the limit is reached. Null for deductions with no annual cap.
attributes.references: IRS 401(k) Contribution Limits (IRC § 402(g)); IRS FSA Limits (IRC § 125); IRS HSA Limits (IRC § 223); IRS Publication 15-B

attributes.name: arrears_amount
attributes.description: Dollar amount of deduction that was missed in a prior pay period and is being carried forward for collection in a subsequent period. Common for garnishments when disposable earnings were insufficient to cover the full order amount, or for benefit premiums missed during a leave of absence. Zero if no arrears exist.
attributes.references: DOL Wage Garnishment Rules; Consumer Credit Protection Act Title III; TempWorks Payroll — Arrears Processing

attributes.name: benefit_carrier_name
attributes.description: Name of the insurance carrier or financial institution administering the benefit plan associated with this deduction (e.g., 'Aetna', 'MetLife', 'Fidelity Investments', 'WageWorks'). Used for carrier remittance reconciliation and benefits vendor management. Null for non-benefit deductions.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors — Benefits Administration; TempWorks Payroll; ERISA

attributes.name: benefit_enrollment_status
attributes.description: Current enrollment status of the worker in the benefit plan driving this deduction. Determines whether premium withholding should be active. COBRA status indicates the worker is continuing coverage under COBRA after employment separation. Null for non-benefit deductions.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors — Benefits Enrollment; ERISA; COBRA (29 U.S.C. § 1161); ACA

attributes.name: benefit_plan_name
attributes.description: Name of the employer-sponsored benefit plan associated with this deduction (e.g., 'Aetna PPO Gold', 'Delta Dental Premier', 'VSP Vision Basic', 'Fidelity 401k Plan'). Populated only for benefit-type deductions. Sourced from the benefit enrollment record and used for benefits administration reporting and carrier remittance.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors — Benefits Administration; TempWorks Payroll; ERISA

attributes.name: benefit_plan_type
attributes.description: Classification of the benefit plan type driving this deduction. Used to categorize benefit deductions for ACA reporting, W-2 Box 12 coding, and benefits analytics. Null for non-benefit deductions. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: medical|dental|vision|401k|roth_401k|fsa|hsa|life|supplemental — 9 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: IRS Publication 15-B; ACA Reporting Requirements; W-2 Box 12 Codes; ERISA

attributes.name: check_date
attributes.description: The date on which the paycheck containing this deduction was issued to the worker. Represents the actual payment date used for tax deposit timing, W-2 year assignment, and garnishment remittance deadlines. TRANSACTION_LINE role: BUSINESS_EVENT_TIMESTAMP (date precision).
attributes.references: IRS Publication 15 — Tax Deposit Rules; TempWorks Payroll; FLSA

attributes.name: court_order_number
attributes.description: Official court case number or agency order reference for garnishment-type deductions (child support, tax levy, creditor garnishment). Required for legal compliance and remittance to the issuing court or agency. Null for non-garnishment deductions.
attributes.references: DOL Wage Garnishment Rules; Consumer Credit Protection Act Title III; IRS Tax Levy Procedures; Child Support Enforcement (Title IV-D)

attributes.name: coverage_tier
attributes.description: The coverage tier elected by the worker for this benefit plan, which determines the premium amount withheld. Applicable to medical, dental, and vision benefit deductions. Values: employee_only (single coverage), employee_spouse (worker plus spouse/domestic partner), employee_children (worker plus dependents), family (worker plus all dependents). Null for non-benefit deductions.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors — Benefits Enrollment; IRS Publication 15-B; ACA Employer Mandate Rules

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this deduction line record was first created in the source payroll system. Supports audit trail, data lineage, and Silver Layer ingestion tracking. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: SOC 2 Type II Audit Trail Requirements; GDPR Article 5 (Data Integrity); CCPA

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the deduction amount (e.g., USD). Supports multi-currency payroll processing for international staffing operations and EOR (Employer of Record) arrangements.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; IRS International Payroll Rules; EOR Compliance

attributes.name: deduction_amount
attributes.description: Dollar amount withheld from the worker's gross pay for this deduction line in the current pay period. For benefit deductions, represents the employee premium contribution. For garnishments, represents the court-ordered withholding amount. TRANSACTION_LINE role: LINE_VALUE_OR_RESULT — the principal monetary fact for this line.
attributes.references: TempWorks Payroll — Deduction Calculation; FLSA; IRS Publication 15; Consumer Credit Protection Act Title III

attributes.name: deduction_category
attributes.description: Granular business category of the deduction used for benefits administration reporting, compliance, and analytics. Distinguishes benefit plan types (medical, dental, vision, 401k, FSA, HSA, life, supplemental) from garnishment subtypes (child_support, tax_levy, creditor_garnishment, student_loan) and other voluntary deductions. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: medical|dental|vision|401k|roth_401k|fsa|hsa|life|supplemental|child_support|tax_levy|creditor_garnishment|student_loan|uniform|other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: IRS Publication 15-B; DOL Wage Garnishment Rules; ASA Benefits Administration Standards

attributes.name: deduction_code
attributes.description: Standardized alphanumeric code identifying the specific deduction type as configured in the payroll system (e.g., MED01, DENT01, 401K, GARNCS, UNIFEE). Maps to the deduction setup table in TempWorks Payroll and drives calculation rules, GL account mapping, and tax treatment.
attributes.references: TempWorks Payroll — Deduction Code Setup; IRS Publication 15-B

attributes.name: deduction_frequency
attributes.description: How often this deduction is applied to the worker's paycheck. Drives whether the deduction is taken every pay period or on a specific schedule (e.g., some benefit premiums are taken only on first and third paycheck of the month for semimonthly payroll). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: per_pay_period|weekly|biweekly|semimonthly|monthly|quarterly|annual|one_time — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: TempWorks Payroll — Deduction Frequency Setup; FLSA

attributes.name: deduction_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the deduction as it appears on the worker's pay stub (e.g., 'Medical Insurance - Employee', 'Child Support Garnishment', '401(k) Contribution'). Sourced from the deduction code setup in TempWorks Payroll.
attributes.references: TempWorks Payroll — Deduction Code Setup; FLSA Pay Stub Requirements

attributes.name: deduction_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of this deduction line: active (currently being withheld), suspended (temporarily halted, e.g., worker on leave), terminated (permanently stopped, e.g., benefit cancelled or garnishment satisfied), pending (set up but not yet effective), waived (worker or employer elected to waive for this period). TRANSACTION_LINE role: maps to LIFECYCLE_STATUS of the deduction arrangement.
attributes.references: TempWorks Payroll — Deduction Status Codes; DOL Wage Garnishment Rules

attributes.name: deduction_type
attributes.description: Classification of the deduction by tax treatment and origin: pre_tax (reduces taxable gross, e.g., 401k, FSA, HSA, Section 125 benefits), post_tax (applied after tax calculation, e.g., Roth 401k, after-tax life insurance), benefit (employer-sponsored benefit premium withholding), garnishment (court-ordered or agency-mandated wage withholding), voluntary (worker-elected non-benefit deduction). Drives gross-to-net calculation sequencing.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 15; IRS Publication 15-B; FLSA; TempWorks Payroll — Deduction Type Configuration

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date on which this deduction arrangement became active for the worker. For benefit deductions, aligns with the benefit enrollment effective date. For garnishments, aligns with the court order service date. Determines when withholding begins.
attributes.references: TempWorks Payroll — Deduction Setup; DOL Wage Garnishment Rules; IRS Publication 15-B

attributes.name: employer_contribution_amount
attributes.description: Dollar amount contributed by the employer toward this benefit deduction in the current pay period (e.g., employer share of medical premium, employer 401k match). Applicable only to benefit-type deductions. Zero or null for garnishments and purely employee-funded deductions. Used in total compensation reporting and burden rate calculations.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 15-B; SAP SuccessFactors Benefits Administration; TempWorks Payroll

attributes.name: enrollment_effective_date
attributes.description: Date on which the worker's benefit enrollment became effective, triggering the start of premium withholding for this deduction. May differ from the deduction effective_date if there is a retroactive enrollment adjustment. Null for non-benefit deductions.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors — Benefits Administration; IRS Publication 15-B; ACA Special Enrollment Rules

attributes.name: enrollment_termination_date
attributes.description: Date on which the worker's benefit enrollment ended, triggering cessation of premium withholding. Populated when a worker loses eligibility, voluntarily cancels coverage, or separates from employment. Null if enrollment is ongoing. Null for non-benefit deductions.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors — Benefits Administration; ERISA; COBRA; ACA

attributes.name: garnishment_issuing_agency
attributes.description: Name of the court, government agency, or child support enforcement agency that issued the garnishment order (e.g., 'Cook County Circuit Court', 'IRS', 'Illinois DCSS'). Used for remittance routing and compliance documentation. Null for non-garnishment deductions.
attributes.references: DOL Wage Garnishment Rules; IRS Tax Levy; Child Support Enforcement (Title IV-D)

attributes.name: garnishment_remittance_date
attributes.description: Date by which the withheld garnishment amount must be remitted to the issuing court or agency. Derived from the court order terms and state-specific remittance deadlines. Null for non-garnishment deductions.
attributes.references: DOL Wage Garnishment Rules; Consumer Credit Protection Act Title III; State Garnishment Remittance Laws

attributes.name: is_arrears_recovery
attributes.description: Indicates whether this deduction line represents a recovery of a previously missed (arrears) deduction amount rather than a standard current-period deduction. True when the deduction_amount includes or consists entirely of arrears recovery. Used to distinguish regular deductions from catch-up withholdings in payroll analytics.
attributes.references: TempWorks Payroll — Arrears Recovery; DOL Wage Garnishment Rules

attributes.name: is_fica_exempt
attributes.business_glossary_term: Is FICA (Federal Insurance Contributions Act) Exempt Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this deduction amount is exempt from FICA (Social Security and Medicare) taxes. True for qualified Section 125 benefit deductions and HSA employer contributions. False for most other deductions. Drives FICA taxable wage base calculation in payroll processing.
attributes.references: IRS FICA Rules; IRS Section 125; IRS Publication 15; FICA (26 U.S.C. § 3101)

attributes.name: is_pretax
attributes.description: Indicates whether this deduction reduces the worker's taxable gross wages before FICA, federal income tax, and applicable state income tax are calculated. True for Section 125 cafeteria plan deductions (medical, dental, vision, FSA), traditional 401k contributions, and HSA contributions. False for post-tax deductions such as Roth 401k and after-tax life insurance. Critical for accurate gross-to-net payroll calculation.
attributes.references: IRS Section 125 (Cafeteria Plans); IRS Publication 15; IRS Publication 15-B; FICA

attributes.name: line_sequence
attributes.description: Sequential ordering number of this deduction line within the parent paycheck. Enables ordered display of deductions on pay stubs and supports reconciliation of multiple deductions per pay period. TRANSACTION_LINE role: LINE_SEQUENCE.
attributes.references: TempWorks Payroll — Pay Stub Line Ordering

attributes.name: pay_period_end_date
attributes.description: Last calendar date of the pay period in which this deduction line was applied. Defines the close of the earnings window for this deduction calculation. Used in conjunction with pay_period_start_date for period boundary validation and compliance reporting.
attributes.references: TempWorks Payroll — Pay Period Definition; FLSA Record-Keeping Requirements

attributes.name: pay_period_start_date
attributes.description: First calendar date of the pay period in which this deduction line was applied. Combined with pay_period_end_date, defines the earnings period for which this deduction is calculated. Supports multi-state payroll compliance and period-over-period deduction analysis.
attributes.references: TempWorks Payroll — Pay Period Definition; FLSA Record-Keeping Requirements

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Operational system of record from which this deduction line record originated. Primarily TempWorks Payroll for payroll-processed deductions, SAP SuccessFactors for benefit enrollment-driven deductions, or manual for corrections entered directly. Supports data lineage and reconciliation in the Databricks Silver Layer.
attributes.references: TempWorks Payroll; SAP SuccessFactors; Databricks Lakehouse Data Lineage Standards

attributes.name: termination_date
attributes.description: Date on which this deduction arrangement was or is scheduled to be permanently stopped. For benefit deductions, aligns with benefit enrollment termination or coverage end date. For garnishments, the date the order is satisfied or released. Null if the deduction is ongoing with no defined end.
attributes.references: TempWorks Payroll — Deduction Termination; DOL Wage Garnishment Rules; IRS Publication 15-B

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this deduction line record was last modified in the source payroll system (e.g., amount correction, status change, suspension). Supports change data capture (CDC) processing in the Databricks Silver Layer and audit trail requirements. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: SOC 2 Type II Audit Trail Requirements; GDPR Article 5; TempWorks Payroll

attributes.name: w2_box_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: W-2 (Wage and Tax Statement) Box Code
attributes.description: IRS W-2 form box code under which this deduction amount must be reported at year-end (e.g., 'D' for 401k elective deferrals, 'W' for HSA employer contributions, 'DD' for employer-sponsored health coverage cost). Drives W-2 generation in TempWorks Payroll. Null for deductions not reportable on W-2.
attributes.references: IRS W-2 Instructions; IRS Publication 15-B; W-2 Box 12 Codes

attributes.name: work_state_code
attributes.description: Two-letter U.S. state code for the state in which the worker performed services during this pay period. Determines applicable state income tax withholding rules, state-specific garnishment limits, SUTA taxability, and state benefit deduction regulations. Critical for multi-state payroll compliance.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 15; SUTA State Regulations; Multi-State Payroll Compliance; DOL State Wage Laws

attributes.name: ytd_deduction_amount
attributes.description: Cumulative total of this deduction withheld from the worker's pay from the start of the calendar year through and including the current pay period. Used for W-2 reporting, IRS annual contribution limit enforcement (e.g., 401k IRS limit, FSA/HSA annual caps), and year-end tax reconciliation.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 15; IRS 401(k) Contribution Limits; IRS FSA/HSA Annual Limits; W-2 Reporting Requirements

products.name: burden_rate
products.description: Master record defining the employer burden rate structure applied to worker pay for cost modeling, spread calculation, and client billing markup in staffing operations. Captures burden components including FICA employer share percentage, FUTA rate, SUTA rate by state, workers compensation (WC) rate by NCCI class code (with state-specific overrides, class description, hazard category, and base rate per $100 of payroll), general liability rate, benefits load percentage, overhead percentage, and total burden percentage. Stores effective dates, state jurisdiction, WC policy reference, client or assignment applicability, and rate source (manual, system-calculated, carrier-provided). Used to compute total employer cost per worker hour, validate bill rate margins, and support spread analysis for staffing profitability reporting.

attributes.name: burden_rate_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated identifier for the burden rate record. Primary key for the burden_rate data product in the payroll domain.
attributes.references: TempWorks Payroll — Burden Rate Configuration

attributes.name: approved_by_staff_profile_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Approved By Staff Profile Id (Foreign Key)
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to employee.staff_profile. Business justification: Burden rate approvals by finance/operations staff. Role-prefixed for clarity. Reuses existing approved_by column pattern. Required for pricing accuracy, margin management, and financial controls.

attributes.name: assignment_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific placement assignment for which this burden rate is configured, when applicability_scope is 'assignment_specific'. Null for broader-scope rates. Links to the placement assignment record.
attributes.references: Bullhorn ATS/CRM — Placement; TempWorks Payroll — Assignment Rate Configuration

attributes.name: client_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the client account for which this burden rate is specifically configured, when applicability_scope is 'client_specific'. Null for enterprise-wide or assignment-specific rates. Links to the client account master in the CRM.
attributes.references: Bullhorn ATS/CRM — Client Account; Beeline VMS — Client Rate Management

High co-employment risk drives higher insurance loading, indemnification costs, and legal reserves - risk assessment

attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Burden rates (FICA, FUTA, SUTA, WC, benefits) are often cost-center-specific for overhead allocation and pricing. Required for accurate job costing and margin analysis by branch/division in staffing a
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: gl_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.gl_account. Business justification: Burden rate components (FICA, FUTA, SUTA, WC, benefits) map to specific GL expense accounts for costing and financial reporting. Required for accurate job costing and margin analysis in staffing opera
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: location_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to client.location. Business justification: Workers' comp rates, SUTA rates, and employer burden vary significantly by work location and state jurisdiction. Required for accurate cost modeling, pricing, and margin analysis by client location in
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: order_header_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to joborder.order_header. Business justification: Burden rates can be order-specific when negotiated client terms, special insurance requirements, or custom rate cards apply. Supports accurate order-level cost modeling, pricing validation, and margin
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: primary_ot_burden_rate_id
attributes.description: Reference to the burden rate record applicable to overtime (OT) hours for this worker classification and state. Overtime pay triggers different FICA and WC cost calculations. Null if the same burden rate applies to both regular and OT hours.
attributes.references: FLSA (Fair Labor Standards Act) — Overtime Regulations; IRS Publication 15; TempWorks Payroll — OT Rate Configuration

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to vendor.supplier. Business justification: Vendor-supplied workers often have different burden rates (FICA, SUTA, workers' comp) due to co-employment, PEO models, or vendor-specific insurance policies. Accurate cost modeling and bill rate calc
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: tertiary_superseded_by_burden_rate_id
attributes.description: Reference to the burden rate record that replaced this record when status is 'superseded'. Enables forward navigation in the rate version chain for audit and historical analysis.
attributes.references: TempWorks Payroll — Rate Versioning; SOC 2 Type II — Audit Trail Requirements

attributes.name: wc_policy_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to payroll.wc_policy. Business justification: Burden rate calculations include workers compensation premium components that are defined by specific WC policies. burden_rate currently has wc_policy_number: STRING which is a denormalized reference.

attributes.name: work_location_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to placement.work_location. Business justification: Workers comp rates, SUTA rates, and burden components vary by work location due to state jurisdiction and site hazard classification. Links burden structure to location for accurate cost modeling.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: applicability_scope
attributes.description: Defines the scope at which this burden rate is applied: enterprise_wide (default for all placements), client_specific (negotiated rate for a specific client account), assignment_specific (applied to a single placement or assignment), or branch_specific (applicable to a specific branch or division).
attributes.references: TempWorks Payroll — Rate Applicability Configuration; Beeline VMS — Rate Management

attributes.name: approved_date
attributes.description: Date on which this burden rate structure was formally approved by the authorized approver. Required for audit trail and SOC 2 change management compliance.
attributes.references: SOC 2 Type II — Change Management Controls; TempWorks Payroll — Approval Workflow

attributes.name: benefits_load_percent
attributes.description: Employer-paid benefits cost expressed as a percentage of gross wages included in the burden rate. Covers health insurance, dental, vision, 401(k) match, and other statutory or voluntary benefits provided to workers. Varies by worker classification and benefit plan enrollment.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 15-B — Employer's Tax Guide to Fringe Benefits; ERISA; TempWorks Payroll — Benefits Administration

attributes.name: branch_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the staffing branch or division to which this burden rate applies when applicability_scope is 'branch_specific'. Supports multi-branch operations where burden structures differ by geographic market or business unit.
attributes.references: TempWorks Payroll — Branch Configuration; Bullhorn ATS/CRM — Branch Management

attributes.name: burden_rate_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the burden rate record. 'active' indicates the rate is in use for payroll cost calculations; 'superseded' indicates a newer version has replaced this record; 'draft' indicates pending approval before activation.
attributes.references: TempWorks Payroll — Rate Lifecycle Management

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this burden rate record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail, data lineage, and SOC 2 Type II compliance requirements.
attributes.references: SOC 2 Type II — Audit Trail; GDPR Article 5 — Data Integrity and Accountability; TempWorks Payroll

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date from which this burden rate structure becomes effective and is applied to payroll cost calculations, spread analysis, and bill rate margin validation. Aligns with payroll period start dates.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 15 (Circular E); U.S. Department of Labor (DOL) Wage Regulations; TempWorks Payroll

attributes.name: employment_type
attributes.description: Type of staffing engagement to which this burden rate applies. Temporary and contract placements typically carry higher WC and benefits burden; direct hire placements may carry only a placement fee structure. Temp-to-perm engagements may have conversion fee implications.
attributes.references: ASA — Employment Classification Standards; DOL — Contingent Workforce Regulations

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date on which this burden rate structure ceases to be effective. Null indicates an open-ended rate with no scheduled expiration. Used to enforce rate versioning and ensure correct rate application during payroll processing.
attributes.references: TempWorks Payroll — Rate Versioning; ASA Rate Management Standards

attributes.name: fica_employer_rate
attributes.business_glossary_term: Federal Insurance Contributions Act (FICA) Employer Rate
attributes.description: Employer's share of FICA tax expressed as a percentage of gross wages (e.g., 7.6500 for 7.65%). Comprises Social Security (6.2%) and Medicare (1.45%) employer contributions. Applied to gross pay up to applicable wage bases per IRS regulations.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 15 (Circular E) — FICA Employer Tax Rates; Internal Revenue Code Section 3111; FICA (Federal Insurance Contributions Act)

attributes.name: futa_rate
attributes.description: Federal Unemployment Tax Act employer tax rate expressed as a percentage of gross wages (e.g., 0.6000 for 0.60% net after state credit). Applied to the first $7,000 of each employee's wages per calendar year per IRS regulations.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 15 (Circular E) — FUTA Tax Rate; Internal Revenue Code Section 3301; FUTA (Federal Unemployment Tax Act)

attributes.name: general_liability_rate
attributes.description: General liability insurance cost expressed as a percentage of gross payroll included in the employer burden structure. Covers third-party bodily injury and property damage claims arising from staffing operations.
attributes.references: ASA — Staffing Industry Insurance Standards; TempWorks Payroll — Burden Rate Configuration

attributes.name: is_eor_model
attributes.description: Indicates whether this burden rate applies to an Employer of Record (EOR) engagement model where the staffing firm acts as the legal employer of record for co-employment or client-directed workforce arrangements. EOR models carry distinct burden and compliance obligations.
attributes.references: IRS — EOR Worker Classification; NAPEO — PEO/EOR Standards; DOL Co-Employment Guidelines; EOR (Employer of Record)

attributes.name: is_peo_model
attributes.description: Indicates whether this burden rate applies to a Professional Employer Organization (PEO) co-employment model where the PEO assumes employer tax and benefits obligations. PEO burden structures differ from standard staffing burden rates.
attributes.references: NAPEO — PEO Standards; IRS — PEO Certification (CPEO); PEO (Professional Employer Organization)

attributes.name: markup_percent
attributes.description: Target markup percentage applied over the pay rate to derive the bill rate, incorporating the total burden and desired gross margin. Used in spread analysis and client billing validation. Expressed as a percentage of pay rate (e.g., 45.00 = 45% markup).
attributes.references: ASA — Staffing Industry Markup Standards; SIA — Bill Rate and Markup Benchmarks; Salesforce Revenue Cloud

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for payroll analysts or finance staff to document special conditions, exceptions, carrier negotiation details, or regulatory basis for this burden rate configuration. Supports audit documentation and knowledge transfer.
attributes.references: TempWorks Payroll — Rate Documentation; SOC 2 Type II — Documentation Standards

attributes.name: overhead_percent
attributes.description: Internal overhead allocation expressed as a percentage of gross wages included in the burden rate. Covers branch operating costs, recruiter commissions, back-office administration, and other indirect costs attributable to workforce deployment.
attributes.references: ASA — Staffing Industry Cost Modeling Standards; Staffing Industry Analysts (SIA) — Gross Margin Benchmarks

attributes.name: pay_rate_max
attributes.description: Maximum hourly pay rate threshold (in USD) at which this burden rate structure is applicable. Defines the upper bound of the pay rate band for this burden rate. Null indicates no upper limit.
attributes.references: TempWorks Payroll — Rate Banding Configuration; ASA — Rate Management Standards

attributes.name: pay_rate_min
attributes.description: Minimum hourly pay rate threshold (in USD) at which this burden rate structure is applicable. Used to define pay rate banding for tiered burden rate structures where different pay levels carry different overhead or benefits loads.
attributes.references: FLSA (Fair Labor Standards Act) — Minimum Wage; DOL Wage and Hour Division; TempWorks Payroll

attributes.name: rate_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric code uniquely identifying this burden rate structure (e.g., 'BR-CA-WC-5403-2024'). Used in billing systems, VMS integrations, and rate card references.
attributes.references: TempWorks Payroll — Rate Code Configuration; American Staffing Association (ASA) Rate Management Standards

attributes.name: rate_name
attributes.description: Human-readable descriptive name for the burden rate structure (e.g., 'California Light Industrial WC Class 5403 2024'). Used in reporting, dashboards, and analyst-facing tools.
attributes.references: TempWorks Payroll — Rate Configuration; Power BI Analytics Platform

attributes.name: rate_source
attributes.description: Origin of the burden rate values indicating how the rate was established: manual (entered by payroll/finance staff), system_calculated (derived by TempWorks Payroll engine), carrier_provided (supplied by WC or GL insurance carrier), or state_mandated (set by state regulatory authority).
attributes.references: TempWorks Payroll — Rate Source Audit; ASA — Rate Governance Standards

attributes.name: rate_type
attributes.description: Classification of the burden rate structure indicating its scope of applicability: standard (default enterprise-wide), client_specific (negotiated for a client), assignment_specific (tied to a single placement), state_override (state-level regulatory override), or wc_class_specific (Workers Compensation class-driven rate).
attributes.references: TempWorks Payroll — Rate Type Configuration; ASA Workforce Cost Standards

attributes.name: state_code
attributes.description: Two-letter U.S. state code (ISO 3166-2:US) identifying the state jurisdiction to which this burden rate applies. Critical for multi-state payroll compliance, SUTA rate assignment, and state-specific Workers Compensation rate overrides.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-2:US; U.S. Department of Labor (DOL) — Multi-State Payroll Compliance; SUTA State Regulations

attributes.name: suta_rate
attributes.description: State Unemployment Tax Act employer contribution rate expressed as a percentage of gross wages for the applicable state jurisdiction. Varies by state experience rating, industry classification, and annual state-assigned rate notices. Applied to state-specific taxable wage bases.
attributes.references: U.S. Department of Labor (DOL) — SUTA Rate Schedules; State Workforce Agency Rate Notices; SUTA (State Unemployment Tax Act)

attributes.name: suta_wage_base
attributes.business_glossary_term: State Unemployment Tax Act (SUTA) Taxable Wage Base
attributes.description: Maximum annual gross wages per employee subject to SUTA tax in the applicable state jurisdiction (e.g., $7,000 in some states, $56,500 in others). Required for accurate SUTA cost modeling and burden rate calculation.
attributes.references: U.S. Department of Labor (DOL) — State Taxable Wage Bases; State Workforce Agency Annual Notices

attributes.name: target_gross_margin_percent
attributes.description: Target gross margin percentage for placements using this burden rate structure, representing the desired spread (bill rate minus total employer cost) as a percentage of bill rate. Used in profitability reporting and bill rate validation.
attributes.references: SIA — Gross Margin Benchmarks; ASA — Staffing Profitability Standards; Salesforce Revenue Cloud

attributes.name: total_burden_percent
attributes.description: Aggregate employer burden rate expressed as a percentage of gross wages, representing the sum of all burden components (FICA employer share, FUTA, SUTA, WC, general liability, benefits load, and overhead). Used to compute total employer cost per worker hour and validate bill rate margins. Note: this is a stored configuration value, not a real-time computed aggregate.
attributes.references: ASA — Staffing Industry Burden Rate Standards; SIA — Spread and Markup Benchmarks; TempWorks Payroll

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this burden rate record was last modified. Used for change tracking, incremental data pipeline processing, and SOC 2 audit trail requirements.
attributes.references: SOC 2 Type II — Change Management Audit Trail; TempWorks Payroll — Rate Change Tracking

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: Sequential version number for this burden rate record, incremented each time the rate structure is updated. Supports rate versioning and historical rate lookups for payroll audits and retroactive adjustments.
attributes.references: TempWorks Payroll — Rate Version Control; SOC 2 Type II — Change Management Controls

attributes.name: wc_base_rate_per_100
attributes.business_glossary_term: Workers Compensation (WC) Base Rate per $100 of Payroll
attributes.description: Workers Compensation insurance premium base rate expressed as dollars per $100 of gross payroll for the applicable NCCI class code and state jurisdiction (e.g., 2.3500 = $2.35 per $100). This is the primary WC cost driver in the burden rate structure.
attributes.references: NCCI — Loss Cost Multipliers; State Workers Compensation Rating Bureaus; Workers Compensation Insurance Rating Bureau

attributes.name: wc_class_description
attributes.description: Human-readable description of the NCCI Workers Compensation class code (e.g., 'Carpentry — Construction', 'Clerical Office Employees'). Used in reporting, audits, and WC policy documentation.
attributes.references: NCCI — Classification Phraseology; Workers Compensation Insurance Rating Bureau

attributes.name: wc_experience_mod_factor
attributes.description: Experience modification factor (e-mod) applied to the WC base rate to adjust premiums based on the employer's actual loss history relative to industry average. Values below 1.0 indicate better-than-average loss history; above 1.0 indicates worse. Sourced from WC carrier or NCCI.
attributes.references: NCCI — Experience Rating Plan; Workers Compensation Insurance Rating Bureau

attributes.name: wc_hazard_category
attributes.description: Risk hazard category assigned to the WC NCCI class code indicating the relative injury risk level of the job duties. Used for internal risk segmentation, pricing decisions, and WC carrier negotiations.
attributes.references: NCCI — Hazard Group Classifications; OSHA — Hazard Classification Standards

attributes.name: wc_ncci_class_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Workers Compensation (WC) National Council on Compensation Insurance (NCCI) Class Code
attributes.description: Four-digit NCCI Workers Compensation classification code identifying the job duty category for WC premium calculation (e.g., '5403' for Carpentry, '8810' for Clerical Office). Drives WC base rate per $100 of payroll and is the primary driver of WC cost in staffing operations.
attributes.references: National Council on Compensation Insurance (NCCI) — Classification System; Workers Compensation Insurance Rating Bureau; FLSA (Fair Labor Standards Act)

attributes.name: worker_classification
attributes.description: Worker tax and employment classification to which this burden rate applies. W-2 employees carry full employer tax burden; 1099 independent contractors carry no employer FICA/FUTA/SUTA; EOR (Employer of Record) and PEO models have distinct burden structures. Aligns with IRS worker classification rules.
attributes.references: IRS — Worker Classification Rules (Rev. Rul. 87-41); FLSA (Fair Labor Standards Act); IRS Form W-2; IRS Form 1099; EOR (Employer of Record)

products.name: wc_policy
products.description: Master and transactional record for workers compensation insurance policies and premium calculations administered through TempWorks Payroll — unified SSOT for both WC policy administration and premium accrual. Policy attributes: policy number, insurance carrier, policy effective and expiration dates, state jurisdiction, experience modification factor (EMR), policy type (guaranteed cost, loss-sensitive), premium basis (payroll-based), audit frequency, and policy status. Premium transaction attributes: WC class code, NCCI class description, state jurisdiction, payroll amount subject to WC, WC rate applied per $100 of payroll, computed premium amount, experience modification factor applied, YTD premium total, premium period, and pay run reference. Supports multi-state WC compliance for temporary and contract workers, carrier reporting, premium audit reconciliation, accurate burden rate application, and cost allocation to client assignments.

attributes.description: Primary key for wc_policy

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to vendor.supplier. Business justification: Workers' comp policies for vendor-supplied workers are often held by the vendor, not the staffing agency. Certificate of insurance (COI) tracking, premium audit, and liability determination require li

attributes.name: work_location_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to placement.work_location. Business justification: Workers compensation policies are issued per work location and jurisdiction. Each site has specific WC class codes and rates. Links policy coverage to physical work location.

attributes.name: audit_adjustment_amount
attributes.description: The dollar amount of premium adjustment resulting from the most recent carrier audit, representing the difference between estimated premiums paid and actual earned premium based on audited payroll. Positive values indicate additional premium owed; negative values indicate a return premium credit.
attributes.references: NCCI Basic Manual for Workers Compensation and Employers Liability Insurance; TempWorks Payroll - Workers Compensation Module

attributes.name: audit_frequency
attributes.description: The frequency at which the insurance carrier conducts a premium audit to reconcile estimated premiums against actual payroll. Staffing firms with high payroll volume often negotiate more frequent audits to reduce year-end true-up exposure.
attributes.references: NCCI Basic Manual for Workers Compensation and Employers Liability Insurance; ASA Risk Management Standards

attributes.name: base_rate_per_100
attributes.business_glossary_term: Workers Compensation (WC) Base Rate per $100 of Payroll
attributes.description: The manual (base) WC premium rate expressed as a dollar amount per $100 of covered payroll for the associated class code and state jurisdiction, before application of the experience modification factor (EMR). Sourced from the applicable state rating bureau or NCCI.
attributes.references: NCCI Experience Rating Plan Manual; State Workers Compensation Rating Bureaus

attributes.name: burden_rate_wc_component
attributes.description: The WC premium cost expressed as a decimal rate applied to gross payroll, representing the WC component of the total employer burden rate. Used in bill rate calculations, spread analysis, and gross margin reporting. Derived from the modified rate and historical payroll mix for this class code.
attributes.references: ASA Staffing Industry Financial Benchmarks; TempWorks Payroll - Burden Rate Configuration

attributes.name: carrier_naic_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Insurance Carrier National Association of Insurance Commissioners (NAIC) Code
attributes.description: The five-digit NAIC company code assigned to the insurance carrier by the National Association of Insurance Commissioners. Used for regulatory identification and carrier verification in multi-state WC compliance.
attributes.references: NAIC Company Code Registry; State Insurance Department Regulations

attributes.name: carrier_name
attributes.description: The legal name of the insurance carrier or underwriter providing the workers compensation coverage under this policy. Used for carrier reporting, premium remittance, and audit correspondence.
attributes.references: NAIC (National Association of Insurance Commissioners) Carrier Registry

attributes.name: client_cost_allocation_code
attributes.description: The internal cost allocation code used to attribute WC premium costs to specific client accounts or job orders. Enables client-level WC cost reporting, profitability analysis, and accurate bill rate construction inclusive of WC burden.
attributes.references: Oracle NetSuite ERP - Cost Allocation Module; ASA Staffing Industry Financial Benchmarks

attributes.name: co_employment_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this WC policy record involves a co-employment arrangement where both the staffing firm and the client share employer responsibilities. Affects WC coverage determination and premium allocation between parties.
attributes.references: ASA Co-Employment Guidelines; DOL Joint Employment Standards; EEOC Co-Employment Guidance

attributes.name: computed_premium_amount
attributes.description: The calculated WC premium dollar amount for the premium period, computed as (payroll_subject_to_wc / 100) multiplied by the modified_rate_per_100. Represents the accrued WC cost for the period and is used in burden rate application and client cost allocation.
attributes.references: NCCI Basic Manual for Workers Compensation and Employers Liability Insurance; TempWorks Payroll - Workers Compensation Module

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this workers compensation policy record was first created in the payroll system. Provides audit trail for record provenance and data lineage in the Databricks Silver Layer.
attributes.references: SOC 2 Type II Audit Trail Requirements; GDPR Article 5 (Data Integrity and Accountability)

attributes.name: deductible_amount_per_claim
attributes.business_glossary_term: Workers Compensation (WC) Deductible Amount Per Claim
attributes.description: The per-claim deductible amount the employer is responsible for funding before the carrier pays WC benefits, applicable to large deductible programs. Zero for guaranteed cost policies. Impacts cash flow planning and loss reserve requirements.
attributes.references: NCCI Large Deductible Program Guidelines; ASA Risk Management Standards

attributes.name: deposit_premium_amount
attributes.description: The initial deposit premium paid to the carrier at policy inception, typically a percentage of the estimated annual premium. Represents the upfront cash outlay and is reconciled against actual earned premium at audit.
attributes.references: NCCI Basic Manual for Workers Compensation and Employers Liability Insurance

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date on which the workers compensation insurance policy becomes active and coverage begins. Used to determine coverage applicability for worker assignments and premium period calculations.
attributes.references: NCCI Workers Compensation Insurance Guidelines; DOL Workers Compensation Compliance

attributes.name: employer_liability_limit_disease_policy
attributes.description: The aggregate policy limit of employers liability coverage for bodily injury by disease. Distinct from the per-accident limit and the per-employee disease limit. Used for risk management reporting and MSA compliance verification.
attributes.references: NCCI Basic Manual for Workers Compensation and Employers Liability Insurance

attributes.name: employer_liability_limit_each_accident
attributes.description: The per-occurrence limit of employers liability coverage (Part B of the WC policy) for bodily injury by accident. Standard limits are $100,000, $500,000, or $1,000,000. Used for risk management and client contract compliance.
attributes.references: NCCI Basic Manual for Workers Compensation and Employers Liability Insurance; OSHA Compliance

attributes.name: eor_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this WC policy record applies to workers placed under an Employer of Record (EOR) arrangement, where the staffing firm acts as the legal employer for WC purposes. Drives co-employment risk management and premium allocation logic.
attributes.references: ASA Co-Employment Guidelines; IRS Worker Classification Rules; DOL Joint Employment Standards

attributes.name: estimated_annual_premium
attributes.description: The estimated total annual WC premium for this policy as projected at policy inception, based on estimated payroll and applicable rates. Used for budgeting, cash flow planning, and comparison against actual accrued premiums during the audit cycle.
attributes.references: NCCI Basic Manual for Workers Compensation and Employers Liability Insurance; ASA Risk Management Standards

attributes.name: experience_mod_factor
attributes.description: The experience modification rate (EMR) assigned by NCCI or the applicable state rating bureau, reflecting the employer's actual loss history relative to expected losses for the class. A factor below 1.0 indicates better-than-average loss experience; above 1.0 indicates worse. Applied to the base rate to compute the modified premium rate.
attributes.references: NCCI Experience Rating Plan Manual; ASA Risk Management Standards

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: The date on which the workers compensation insurance policy expires and coverage ends. Triggers renewal workflow and is used to validate coverage during assignment management and payroll processing.
attributes.references: NCCI Workers Compensation Insurance Guidelines; DOL Workers Compensation Compliance

attributes.name: last_audit_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Last Workers Compensation (WC) Premium Audit Date
attributes.description: The date of the most recently completed premium audit conducted by the insurance carrier. Used to track audit cycle compliance, identify overdue audits, and reconcile estimated versus actual premium balances.
attributes.references: NCCI Basic Manual for Workers Compensation and Employers Liability Insurance; ASA Risk Management Standards

attributes.name: loss_sensitive_program_type
attributes.description: For loss-sensitive policies, identifies the specific program structure. Retrospective rated programs adjust final premium based on actual losses; large deductible programs require the employer to fund losses up to a deductible threshold. Null or 'none' for guaranteed cost policies.
attributes.references: NCCI Retrospective Rating Plan Manual; ASA Risk Management Standards

attributes.name: minimum_premium_amount
attributes.description: The minimum premium amount guaranteed to the carrier regardless of actual payroll volume, as stipulated in the policy terms. Relevant for low-volume periods and ensures the carrier recovers minimum administrative costs.
attributes.references: NCCI Basic Manual for Workers Compensation and Employers Liability Insurance

attributes.name: modified_rate_per_100
attributes.business_glossary_term: Workers Compensation (WC) Modified Rate per $100 of Payroll
attributes.description: The effective WC premium rate per $100 of payroll after applying the experience modification factor (EMR) to the base rate. This is the rate used in actual premium calculations for payroll runs. Computed as base_rate_per_100 multiplied by experience_mod_factor.
attributes.references: NCCI Experience Rating Plan Manual; TempWorks Payroll - Workers Compensation Module

attributes.name: ncci_class_description
attributes.business_glossary_term: National Council on Compensation Insurance (NCCI) Class Code Description
attributes.description: The standard NCCI descriptive label for the workers compensation class code, as defined in the NCCI Scopes Manual. Provides human-readable context for the class code used in carrier reporting, premium audits, and cost allocation to client assignments.
attributes.references: NCCI Scopes Manual

attributes.name: next_audit_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Next Scheduled Workers Compensation (WC) Premium Audit Date
attributes.description: The scheduled date for the next premium audit by the insurance carrier. Used for audit preparation planning, payroll record retention compliance, and proactive reconciliation of estimated versus actual premiums.
attributes.references: NCCI Basic Manual for Workers Compensation and Employers Liability Insurance

attributes.name: payroll_subject_to_wc
attributes.business_glossary_term: Payroll Amount Subject to Workers Compensation (WC)
attributes.description: The gross payroll dollar amount for the premium period that is subject to workers compensation premium calculation for this class code and state jurisdiction. Excludes non-covered remuneration per NCCI rules (e.g., tips, certain overtime premiums). Used as the basis for premium computation.
attributes.references: NCCI Basic Manual for Workers Compensation and Employers Liability Insurance; IRS Publication 15

attributes.name: policy_notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for operational notes, underwriting conditions, endorsements, or special program terms associated with this WC policy record. Used by payroll and risk management teams to document carrier-specific requirements or exceptions.
attributes.references: TempWorks Payroll - Workers Compensation Module

attributes.name: policy_number
attributes.description: The externally-assigned policy number issued by the insurance carrier that uniquely identifies this workers compensation insurance policy. Used for carrier reporting, premium audit reconciliation, and regulatory filings.
attributes.references: American Staffing Association (ASA); NCCI Workers Compensation Insurance Guidelines

attributes.name: policy_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the workers compensation policy. Active policies are in force and covering workers; expired policies have passed their expiration date; cancelled policies were terminated before expiration; pending policies are bound but not yet effective.
attributes.references: TempWorks Payroll - Workers Compensation Module; DOL Workers Compensation Compliance

attributes.name: policy_type
attributes.description: Classification of the WC insurance policy structure. Guaranteed cost policies have fixed premiums; loss-sensitive policies (e.g., retrospective rated, large deductible) have premiums that vary based on actual loss experience. Drives premium calculation methodology and financial risk exposure.
attributes.references: NCCI Workers Compensation Insurance Guidelines; ASA Risk Management Standards

attributes.name: policy_year
attributes.description: The four-digit calendar or fiscal year of the workers compensation policy period. Used to group premium transactions for annual audit reconciliation, loss run reporting, and year-over-year cost trend analysis.
attributes.references: NCCI Experience Rating Plan Manual; ASA Risk Management Standards

attributes.name: premium_basis
attributes.description: The basis on which WC premiums are calculated. In staffing, the standard basis is payroll (gross remuneration subject to WC), but some specialty programs may use flat or per-capita bases. Determines how payroll_subject_to_wc is computed.
attributes.references: NCCI Basic Manual for Workers Compensation and Employers Liability Insurance

attributes.name: premium_period_end_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Workers Compensation (WC) Premium Period End Date
attributes.description: The end date of the payroll period for which this WC premium transaction was calculated. Together with premium_period_start_date, defines the coverage window for the premium accrual.
attributes.references: TempWorks Payroll - Workers Compensation Module; NCCI Basic Manual

attributes.name: premium_period_start_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Workers Compensation (WC) Premium Period Start Date
attributes.description: The start date of the payroll period for which this WC premium transaction was calculated. Defines the coverage window for the premium accrual and aligns with the pay run cycle.
attributes.references: TempWorks Payroll - Workers Compensation Module; NCCI Basic Manual

attributes.name: schedule_credit_debit_pct
attributes.description: The schedule rating credit (negative value) or debit (positive value) percentage applied to the manual premium, reflecting underwriter judgment on risk characteristics not captured by the experience modification factor. Expressed as a decimal (e.g., -0.10 for a 10% credit).
attributes.references: NCCI Basic Manual for Workers Compensation and Employers Liability Insurance; State Rating Bureau Filings

attributes.name: state_jurisdiction
attributes.description: The two-letter US state code representing the state jurisdiction under which this workers compensation policy is filed and governed. Critical for multi-state WC compliance, SUTA alignment, and state-specific rate application for temporary and contract workers.
attributes.references: NCCI State Workers Compensation Rating Bureau; DOL State Workers Compensation Laws

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this workers compensation policy record was most recently modified. Used for change data capture (CDC), incremental ETL processing, and audit trail maintenance in the Databricks Silver Layer.
attributes.references: SOC 2 Type II Audit Trail Requirements; GDPR Article 5 (Data Integrity and Accountability)

attributes.name: wc_class_code
attributes.description: The four-digit NCCI (National Council on Compensation Insurance) classification code that categorizes the type of work performed by covered workers. Determines the base WC rate applied per $100 of payroll. Each class code reflects the risk level of the job duties.
attributes.references: NCCI Scopes Manual; ISO Workers Compensation Classification System

attributes.name: workers_comp_code_source
attributes.business_glossary_term: Workers Compensation (WC) Classification Code Source Bureau
attributes.description: Identifies the rating bureau or authority that issued the WC class code and rates for this policy record. Most states use NCCI; California uses WCIRB; a few states have independent bureaus. Critical for multi-state compliance and rate validation. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: NCCI|WCIRB|NYBCOMP|DELAWARE|INDIANA|MICHIGAN|MINNESOTA|OTHER — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: NCCI; WCIRB (Workers Compensation Insurance Rating Bureau of California); State Independent Rating Bureaus

attributes.name: ytd_premium_total
attributes.description: The cumulative workers compensation premium accrued from the start of the policy year through the current premium period for this class code and state jurisdiction. Used for premium audit reconciliation, carrier reporting, and financial forecasting of WC costs.
attributes.references: NCCI Basic Manual for Workers Compensation and Employers Liability Insurance; TempWorks Payroll - Workers Compensation Module

products.name: tax_filing
products.description: Transactional record tracking payroll tax deposit and filing obligations submitted to federal, state, and local tax authorities. Captures filing type (941, 940, SUTA, state income tax), tax authority, filing period, total taxable wages, total tax liability, deposit amount, deposit date, filing due date, filing status (pending, deposited, filed, amended), confirmation number, and penalty/interest amounts if applicable. Supports multi-state tax compliance and IRS/DOL audit readiness.
products.reference: Payroll Tax Filing / Tax Deposit / Form 941

attributes.name: original_filing_tax_filing_id
attributes.description: Reference to the original payroll_tax_filing_id that this amended filing corrects. Null for original (non-amended) filings. Enables amendment chain tracking for IRS audit readiness.
attributes.references: IRS Form 941-X; IRS Publication 15; SOC 2 Type II

attributes.name: pay_run_id
attributes.description: Reference to the payroll run or payroll batch that generated the tax liabilities captured in this filing. Links the tax filing back to the source payroll processing event in TempWorks Payroll. Serves as the PARTY_REFERENCE (to a MASTER_AGREEMENT/processing entity) for this TRANSACTION_HEADER.
attributes.references: TempWorks Payroll — Payroll Run Module

attributes.name: amended_filing_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this record represents an amended or corrected tax filing (True) versus an original filing (False). Amended filings (e.g., Form 941-X) correct errors in previously submitted returns and are tracked separately for audit purposes.
attributes.references: IRS Form 941-X; IRS Publication 15; SOC 2 Type II; TempWorks Payroll

attributes.name: balance_due_amount
attributes.description: Remaining tax balance owed to the tax authority after applying all deposits and credits (tax_liability_amount minus deposit_amount minus prior_deposit_amount). A positive value indicates underpayment; zero or negative indicates overpayment or credit.
attributes.references: IRS Form 941 Line 14; IRS Publication 15; TempWorks Payroll

attributes.name: confirmation_number
attributes.description: Confirmation or acknowledgment number returned by the tax authority (e.g., EFTPS trace number, state portal confirmation) upon successful receipt of the tax deposit or filed return. Used for audit trail and dispute resolution.
attributes.references: IRS EFTPS; TempWorks Payroll; SOC 2 Type II Audit Trail

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this tax filing record was first created in TempWorks Payroll and ingested into the Silver Layer. Serves as the RECORD_AUDIT_CREATED field for this TRANSACTION_HEADER.
attributes.references: SOC 2 Type II; TempWorks Payroll Audit Trail

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for all monetary amounts on this filing record (e.g., 'USD'). Supports international operations and EOR arrangements. Part of the MONETARY_TRIPLET for this TRANSACTION_HEADER.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; GDPR (international operations); TempWorks Payroll

attributes.name: deposit_amount
attributes.description: Actual dollar amount deposited to the tax authority for this filing period. May differ from tax_liability_amount due to prior deposits, adjustments, or credits. Net amount remitted. Part of the MONETARY_TRIPLET for this TRANSACTION_HEADER.
attributes.references: IRS EFTPS; IRS Publication 15; TempWorks Payroll

attributes.name: deposit_date
attributes.description: Actual date on which the tax deposit was transmitted to the tax authority via EFTPS or state equivalent. Used to determine timeliness and calculate any late deposit penalties. Serves as the BUSINESS_EVENT_TIMESTAMP (date precision) for this TRANSACTION_HEADER.
attributes.references: IRS EFTPS (Electronic Federal Tax Payment System); IRS Publication 15; TempWorks Payroll

attributes.name: deposit_method
attributes.description: Method used to transmit the tax deposit to the tax authority. 'EFTPS' = IRS Electronic Federal Tax Payment System (mandatory for most employers); 'ACH' = Automated Clearing House bank transfer for state deposits; 'check' = paper check (rare); 'state_portal' = state-specific online payment portal.
