attributes.references: IRS EFTPS Enrollment Requirements; IRS Publication 15; State Tax Agency Payment Portals; TempWorks Payroll

attributes.name: due_date
attributes.description: Statutory deadline by which this tax deposit or return must be submitted to the tax authority to avoid penalties. Determined by IRS deposit schedule rules (semi-weekly or monthly) or statutory filing deadlines for annual/quarterly returns.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 15 (Circular E) — Deposit Due Dates; U.S. Department of Labor (DOL)

attributes.name: ein
attributes.description: IRS-assigned Employer Identification Number (EIN) of the legal entity filing this return. Required on all federal and state payroll tax filings. In EOR (Employer of Record) and co-employment models, this may reflect the EOR entity's EIN rather than the client's EIN.
attributes.references: IRS EIN Assignment; IRS Form SS-4; EOR/Co-Employment Compliance

attributes.name: eor_arrangement_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this tax filing is processed under an Employer of Record (EOR) or co-employment arrangement (True), where the staffing firm acts as the legal employer for tax purposes on behalf of a client. Affects EIN used and liability allocation.
attributes.references: IRS EOR/Co-Employment Guidance; NAPEO Standards; American Staffing Association (ASA); TempWorks Payroll

attributes.name: federal_income_tax_withheld
attributes.description: Total federal income tax withheld from worker wages and remitted to the IRS for this filing period. Reported on IRS Form 941 Line 3. Applies to W-2 employees; not applicable for 1099 independent contractors.
attributes.references: IRS Form 941; IRS Publication 15-T; IRC Section 3402; TempWorks Payroll

attributes.name: fica_employee_tax_amount
attributes.business_glossary_term: Federal Insurance Contributions Act (FICA) Employee Tax Amount
attributes.description: Employee share of FICA taxes (Social Security 6.2% + Medicare 1.45%) withheld from worker paychecks and remitted as part of this filing. Applicable for W-2 employees; not applicable for 1099 independent contractors.
attributes.references: IRC Sections 3101–3102; IRS Publication 15; FICA Tax Rates; TempWorks Payroll

attributes.name: fica_employer_tax_amount
attributes.business_glossary_term: Federal Insurance Contributions Act (FICA) Employer Tax Amount
attributes.description: Employer matching share of FICA taxes (Social Security 6.2% + Medicare 1.45%) owed by the staffing firm or EOR entity as the employer of record. Equal to the employee FICA amount under standard rules.
attributes.references: IRC Sections 3111–3112; IRS Publication 15; FICA Tax Rates; EOR Compliance; TempWorks Payroll

attributes.name: filed_timestamp
attributes.description: Exact date and time when the tax return was electronically submitted to the tax authority. Provides precise audit trail for compliance and IRS/DOL audit readiness. Null if return has not yet been filed.
attributes.references: IRS e-File Requirements; IRS Publication 15; SOC 2 Type II Audit Trail

attributes.name: filing_number
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric reference number assigned to this tax filing or deposit transaction, used for reconciliation with the tax authority and TempWorks Payroll records. Serves as the BUSINESS_IDENTIFIER for this TRANSACTION_HEADER.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 15 (Circular E); TempWorks Payroll — Tax Filing Module

attributes.name: filing_period_type
attributes.description: Frequency classification of the tax filing period. Determines deposit schedule (e.g., semi-weekly vs. monthly depositor rules under IRS Publication 15) and aligns with the form type (e.g., quarterly for 941, annual for 940).
attributes.references: IRS Publication 15 (Circular E) — Deposit Schedules; TempWorks Payroll

attributes.name: filing_status
attributes.description: Current workflow state of the payroll tax filing or deposit obligation. 'pending' = liability identified but not yet deposited; 'deposited' = funds transferred to tax authority; 'filed' = return submitted; 'amended' = corrected filing submitted; 'voided' = filing cancelled; 'rejected' = filing rejected by authority. Serves as the LIFECYCLE_STATUS for this TRANSACTION_HEADER.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 15 (Circular E); U.S. Department of Labor (DOL) Tax Deposit Rules; TempWorks Payroll

attributes.name: filing_type
attributes.description: The IRS or state tax form type associated with this filing obligation. Common values include: 941 (Employer's Quarterly Federal Tax Return), 940 (Federal Unemployment Tax Act annual return), 944 (annual federal tax return for small employers), W-2 (Wage and Tax Statement), 1099-NEC (Non-Employee Compensation), state SUTA return, state income tax withholding return. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: 941|940|944|W-2|1099-NEC|SUTA|state_income_tax|local_income_tax — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: IRS Forms 941, 940, 944, W-2, 1099-NEC; FUTA/SUTA Regulations; American Staffing Association (ASA)

attributes.name: futa_tax_amount
attributes.business_glossary_term: Federal Unemployment Tax Act (FUTA) Tax Amount
attributes.description: Federal Unemployment Tax Act (FUTA) tax liability for this filing period. Calculated at 6.0% on the first $7,000 of each employee's wages, net of SUTA credit (typically reducing effective rate to 0.6%). Reported on IRS Form 940.
attributes.references: IRC Section 3301; IRS Form 940; FUTA Wage Base; U.S. Department of Labor (DOL); TempWorks Payroll

attributes.name: interest_amount
attributes.description: Dollar amount of interest charged by the tax authority on late or underpaid tax deposits. Accrues from the deposit due date to the actual payment date. Zero if no interest assessed.
attributes.references: IRC Section 6601; IRS Publication 15; U.S. Department of Labor (DOL)

attributes.name: legal_entity_name
attributes.description: Full legal name of the employer entity as registered with the IRS and state tax authorities for this filing. Supports multi-entity payroll structures including EOR, PEO, and co-employment arrangements.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 15; EOR/PEO Compliance; NAPEO Standards

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments entered by payroll staff regarding this tax filing, such as reasons for amendments, penalty dispute details, or special handling instructions. Supports operational context for compliance reviews.
attributes.references: TempWorks Payroll — Tax Filing Module; SOC 2 Type II

attributes.name: overpayment_amount
attributes.description: Amount overpaid to the tax authority for this filing period. May be applied as a credit to the next period or requested as a refund. Null or zero if no overpayment exists.
attributes.references: IRS Form 941 Line 15; IRS Publication 15; TempWorks Payroll

attributes.name: payroll_period_end_date
attributes.description: Last date of the payroll period covered by this tax filing. Defines the end of the wage and tax liability window for this return.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 15 (Circular E); TempWorks Payroll

attributes.name: payroll_period_start_date
attributes.description: First date of the payroll period covered by this tax filing. Combined with payroll_period_end_date, defines the wage and tax liability window for this return.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 15 (Circular E); TempWorks Payroll

attributes.name: penalty_amount
attributes.description: Dollar amount of IRS or state-assessed penalties for late deposit, late filing, or underpayment of payroll taxes. Zero if no penalties assessed. Critical for compliance monitoring and SLA tracking.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 15 — Deposit Penalties; IRC Section 6656; U.S. Department of Labor (DOL)

attributes.name: prior_deposit_amount
attributes.description: Total tax deposits made in prior periods within the same filing period that are applied against the current tax liability. Used for reconciliation between cumulative deposits and the final return balance due.
attributes.references: IRS Form 941 Line 13; IRS Publication 15; TempWorks Payroll

attributes.name: state_code
attributes.description: Two-letter U.S. state or territory code (ISO 3166-2:US) for the jurisdiction of this filing. Null for federal-level filings. Critical for multi-state payroll tax compliance across all worker assignment states.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-2:US; IRS Multi-State Payroll Guidance; SUTA State Agencies

attributes.name: state_income_tax_withheld
attributes.description: Total state income tax withheld from worker wages and remitted to the state tax authority for this filing period. Applicable for states with income tax; null for states without state income tax (e.g., TX, FL, WA).
attributes.references: State Revenue Agencies; IRS Publication 15-T; Multi-State Payroll Compliance; TempWorks Payroll

attributes.name: suta_tax_amount
attributes.business_glossary_term: State Unemployment Tax Act (SUTA) Tax Amount
attributes.description: State Unemployment Tax Act (SUTA) tax liability for this filing period. Rate and wage base vary by state and employer experience rating. Critical for multi-state staffing operations where workers are assigned across multiple states.
attributes.references: State SUTA Agencies; U.S. Department of Labor (DOL) SUTA Guidelines; TempWorks Payroll

attributes.name: tax_authority_level
attributes.description: Jurisdictional level of the tax authority receiving this filing: 'federal' (IRS/DOL), 'state' (state revenue or unemployment agency), or 'local' (city/county tax authority). Supports multi-state payroll compliance reporting and audit readiness.
attributes.references: IRS; U.S. Department of Labor (DOL); FUTA/SUTA Regulations; FLSA

attributes.name: tax_authority_name
attributes.description: Name of the federal, state, or local tax authority to which this filing or deposit is submitted (e.g., 'IRS', 'California EDD', 'New York State DTF', 'City of Philadelphia Revenue Department'). Used for multi-jurisdiction payroll compliance tracking.
attributes.references: IRS; U.S. Department of Labor (DOL); State Revenue Agencies; FLSA Multi-State Compliance

attributes.name: tax_liability_amount
attributes.description: Total tax liability computed for this filing period based on taxable wages and applicable tax rates. Represents the gross amount owed to the tax authority before any prior deposits or credits are applied. Part of the MONETARY_TRIPLET for this TRANSACTION_HEADER.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 15; FICA Tax Rates; FUTA Rate (IRS Form 940); SUTA State Rate Schedules

attributes.name: tax_quarter
attributes.description: Calendar quarter (1–4) to which this filing applies. Applicable for quarterly filings such as IRS Form 941 and quarterly SUTA returns. Null for non-quarterly filing types.
attributes.references: IRS Form 941 Instructions; SUTA Quarterly Filing Requirements

attributes.name: tax_year
attributes.description: Four-digit calendar year to which this tax filing applies (e.g., 2024). Used for annual reconciliation, W-2/1099 processing, and IRS/DOL audit readiness.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 15; IRS Forms W-2, 1099-NEC; FUTA/SUTA Annual Filings

attributes.name: total_taxable_wages
attributes.description: Aggregate gross taxable wages subject to the specific tax type covered by this filing for the filing period. Basis for computing the total tax liability. Excludes non-taxable fringe benefits and pre-tax deductions where applicable.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 15; FICA Wage Base Rules; FUTA/SUTA Wage Base Limits; TempWorks Payroll

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this tax filing record, including status changes, amendments, or deposit updates. Serves as the RECORD_AUDIT_UPDATED field for this TRANSACTION_HEADER.
attributes.references: SOC 2 Type II; TempWorks Payroll Audit Trail

attributes.name: worker_classification
attributes.description: Classification of workers covered by this filing: 'W-2' for employees subject to withholding and employer taxes, '1099' for independent contractors (IC) subject only to self-employment tax reporting, or 'both' for filings covering mixed worker populations. Critical for IRS worker classification compliance.
attributes.references: IRS Worker Classification Rules (IRC Section 3401); IRS Form SS-8; FLSA; American Staffing Association (ASA); IRS Forms W-2 and 1099-NEC

attributes.name: worker_count
attributes.description: Number of workers (W-2 employees or 1099 contractors) included in this tax filing period. Reported on IRS Form 941 Line 1 as the number of employees who received wages. Supports headcount analytics and workforce planning.
attributes.references: IRS Form 941 Line 1; IRS Publication 15; Staffing Industry Analysts (SIA) Workforce Metrics

products.name: tax_form
products.description: Master record representing annual tax forms generated for both W-2 employees/temporary workers and 1099 independent contractors. For W-2 forms: captures Box 1 wages, Box 2 federal income tax withheld, Boxes 3-6 Social Security and Medicare wages and withholdings, state and local wages and withholdings, pre-tax benefit amounts (Box 12 codes), and W-2 filing status. For 1099 forms: captures 1099-NEC nonemployee compensation (Box 1), 1099-MISC miscellaneous income, backup withholding, and state income. Stores tax year, worker/contractor identifier, employer/payer EIN, form type discriminator (W-2, W-2c, 1099-NEC, 1099-MISC), filing status (draft, filed, corrected), e-file confirmation, and correction history. SSOT for ALL annual tax form reporting — unified W-2 and 1099 populations common in staffing operations where both employee and IC worker types coexist. Supports IRS e-filing, state filing, worker distribution, and year-end reconciliation.
products.reference: W-2 Wage and Tax Statement / IRS Form W-2

attributes.name: tax_form_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate primary key for each annual tax form record (W-2, W-2c, 1099-NEC, 1099-MISC) generated in TempWorks Payroll. Globally unique across all form types and tax years.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 15 (Circular E); TempWorks Payroll Tax Filing Module

attributes.name: contract_msa_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to contract.msa. Business justification: W-2/1099 forms must reference MSA for co-employment determination and tax responsibility allocation. Critical for EOR/PEO arrangements where legal employer status affects tax filing obligations and de
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: legal_entity_id
attributes.description: Reference to the employer or payer entity (staffing company legal entity) responsible for issuing this tax form. Determines the EIN used on the form.
attributes.references: IRS Form W-2 Box c; IRS Form 1099-NEC Payer; TempWorks Payroll

attributes.name: original_form_tax_form_id
attributes.description: Reference to the original tax_form record that this corrected form (W-2c or amended 1099) supersedes. Null for original (non-corrected) forms. Enables correction history chain tracking for audit and IRS reconciliation.
attributes.references: IRS Form W-2c Instructions; IRS Publication 1220; SOC 2 Type II Audit Trail

attributes.name: profile_id
attributes.description: Reference to the worker or independent contractor (IC) for whom this tax form was generated. Links to the candidate/worker master record in Bullhorn ATS or TempWorks Payroll.
attributes.references: IRS Form W-2; IRS Form 1099-NEC; TempWorks Payroll

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this tax form record was first created in TempWorks Payroll during the year-end tax form generation process. Supports audit trail and SOC 2 compliance.
attributes.references: SOC 2 Type II; GDPR Article 5; TempWorks Payroll

attributes.name: distribution_date
attributes.description: Date the worker's copy of the tax form was distributed (mailed, electronically delivered, or handed in person). Must be on or before January 31 of the year following the tax year per IRS requirements.
attributes.references: IRS Form W-2 Instructions; IRS Form 1099-NEC Instructions; IRS Publication 15

attributes.name: distribution_method
attributes.description: Method used to distribute the worker's copy of the tax form. Mail: physical paper mailed to worker address. Electronic: delivered via secure online portal (requires worker consent). In-person: handed directly to worker.
attributes.references: IRS Form W-2 Instructions; IRS Reg. 31.6051-1; GDPR Article 5; CCPA

attributes.name: efile_accepted_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the IRS FIRE system or SSA ACCUWAGE system accepted the e-file submission for this tax form. Null if not yet filed or if paper-filed. Critical for IRS filing deadline compliance.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 1220; SSA EFW2; IRS Filing Deadlines; TempWorks Payroll

attributes.name: efile_submission_reference
attributes.description: IRS or SSA-assigned submission identifier returned upon successful e-file transmission. For W-2s: SSA ACCUWAGE submission ID. For 1099s: IRS FIRE system submission ID. Used to track filing status and retrieve acknowledgements.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 1220 (FIRE System); SSA EFW2 Specifications; TempWorks Payroll Tax Filing Module

attributes.name: employer_ein
attributes.description: Federal Employer Identification Number (EIN) of the staffing company or EOR entity issuing the tax form. Appears in Box c of W-2 and Payer TIN field of 1099 forms. Required for IRS e-filing and state tax agency submissions.
attributes.references: IRS Form W-2 Box c; IRS Form 1099-NEC; IRS Publication 15; FLSA

attributes.name: filing_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the tax form. Draft: form generated but not yet submitted to IRS/SSA. Filed: successfully submitted. Corrected: a W-2c or amended 1099 has been issued. Voided: form cancelled. Accepted: IRS/SSA e-file acknowledgement received.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 1220; SSA EFW2 Specifications; TempWorks Payroll Tax Filing Module

attributes.name: form_type
attributes.description: Discriminator identifying the IRS tax form type. W-2 for W-2 employees and temporary workers; W-2c for corrected W-2s; 1099-NEC for independent contractor (IC) nonemployee compensation; 1099-MISC for miscellaneous income. Drives form-specific field population and filing rules.
attributes.references: IRS Form W-2; IRS Form W-2c; IRS Form 1099-NEC; IRS Form 1099-MISC; American Staffing Association (ASA)

attributes.name: is_corrected
attributes.description: True if this record represents a corrected tax form (W-2c or amended 1099). The corrected checkbox is checked on the physical form. Links to the original form via original_form_id for correction history tracking.
attributes.references: IRS Form W-2c Instructions; IRS Form 1099-NEC Corrected Checkbox; IRS Publication 1220

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this tax form record was most recently modified (e.g., correction applied, filing status updated, distribution recorded). Supports audit trail and change tracking.
attributes.references: SOC 2 Type II; GDPR Article 5; TempWorks Payroll

attributes.name: local_income_tax_withheld_box19
attributes.business_glossary_term: W-2 Box 19 Local Income Tax Withheld
attributes.description: W-2 Box 19: Total local income tax withheld from the worker's wages. Reported to the applicable local tax authority. Null if no local tax applies.
attributes.references: IRS Form W-2 Box 19 Instructions; Local Tax Compliance

attributes.name: local_wages_box18
attributes.description: W-2 Box 18: Total wages subject to local income tax withholding (e.g., city or county taxes). Applicable in jurisdictions such as New York City, Philadelphia, or Ohio municipalities. Null if no local tax applies.
attributes.references: IRS Form W-2 Box 18 Instructions; Local Tax Compliance

attributes.name: misc_other_income_box3
attributes.description: 1099-MISC Box 3: Other income payments not reportable in other boxes, such as prizes, awards, or taxable per diem amounts exceeding IRS limits. Null for W-2 and 1099-NEC form types.
attributes.references: IRS Form 1099-MISC Box 3 Instructions; IRS Publication 1220; Per Diem Rules

attributes.name: misc_rents_box1
attributes.description: 1099-MISC Box 1: Rent payments of $600 or more paid to a landlord or property owner. Applicable when staffing company pays office or facility rent to a non-corporate payee. Null for W-2 and 1099-NEC form types.
attributes.references: IRS Form 1099-MISC Box 1 Instructions; IRS Publication 1220

attributes.name: nec_compensation_box1
attributes.description: 1099-NEC Box 1: Total nonemployee compensation paid to an independent contractor (IC) during the tax year. Includes fees, commissions, prizes, and awards for services rendered. Null for W-2 form types. Threshold: $600 or more triggers filing requirement.
attributes.references: IRS Form 1099-NEC Box 1 Instructions; IRS Publication 1220; Worker Classification Rules; INA

attributes.name: nec_federal_tax_withheld_box4
attributes.business_glossary_term: 1099-NEC Box 4 Federal Income Tax Withheld (Backup Withholding)
attributes.description: 1099-NEC Box 4: Federal income tax withheld under backup withholding rules (24% rate) when the contractor failed to provide a valid TIN or IRS notified backup withholding is required. Null for W-2 form types.
attributes.references: IRS Form 1099-NEC Box 4 Instructions; IRS Publication 1281; Backup Withholding Rules

attributes.name: paper_filed
attributes.description: True if this tax form was submitted to the IRS/SSA via paper rather than electronic filing. Staffing companies filing 10 or more forms are required to e-file per IRS regulations. Tracks compliance with mandatory e-file thresholds.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 1220; IRS e-file Mandate; TempWorks Payroll

attributes.name: payer_tin
attributes.description: Payer's Taxpayer Identification Number (TIN) as reported on 1099 forms. Typically the same as the employer EIN but may differ for EOR or co-employment arrangements where a third-party PEO is the payer of record.
attributes.references: IRS Form 1099-NEC Payer TIN; IRS Form 1099-MISC; EOR Compliance; NAPEO

attributes.name: recipient_tin_type
attributes.description: Type of TIN used for the recipient/worker on this tax form. SSN for W-2 employees and individual contractors; EIN for contractors operating as a business entity; ITIN for foreign workers without an SSN. Drives IRS validation rules.
attributes.references: IRS Form W-2; IRS Form 1099-NEC; IRS Publication 1281; INA I-9 Compliance

attributes.name: state_code
attributes.description: Two-letter US state abbreviation for the primary state of employment reported on this tax form (W-2 Box 15 state code). Drives state tax agency filing and multi-state payroll compliance. For workers with wages in multiple states, the primary state is recorded here.
attributes.references: IRS Form W-2 Box 15; Multi-State Payroll Compliance; SUTA; DOL

attributes.name: state_employer_number
attributes.description: State-assigned employer identification number used for state income tax withholding reporting (W-2 Box 15). Required for state e-filing submissions. Format varies by state.
attributes.references: IRS Form W-2 Box 15; Multi-State Payroll Compliance; SUTA

attributes.name: state_filing_status
attributes.description: Current status of the state tax agency filing for this form. Not_required: state has no income tax or filing not required. Pending: prepared but not yet submitted. Filed: submitted to state agency. Accepted: state agency confirmed receipt. Supports multi-state payroll compliance tracking.
attributes.references: Multi-State Payroll Compliance; SUTA; DOL; TempWorks Payroll

attributes.name: state_income_tax_withheld_box17
attributes.business_glossary_term: W-2 Box 17 State Income Tax Withheld
attributes.description: W-2 Box 17: Total state income tax withheld from the worker's wages. Reported to the applicable state tax agency. Null for 1099 form types or states with no income tax.
attributes.references: IRS Form W-2 Box 17 Instructions; SUTA; Multi-State Payroll Compliance

attributes.name: state_wages_box16
attributes.description: W-2 Box 16: Total wages subject to state income tax withholding. May differ from Box 1 federal wages due to state-specific pre-tax exclusions. Supports multi-state payroll compliance. Null for 1099 form types.
attributes.references: IRS Form W-2 Box 16 Instructions; Multi-State Payroll Compliance; DOL

attributes.name: tax_year
attributes.description: The calendar tax year (e.g., 2024) for which this form reports wages, compensation, and withholdings. Drives IRS filing deadlines and year-end reconciliation cycles.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 15; IRS Form W-2 Instructions; IRS Form 1099-NEC Instructions

attributes.name: w2_box12_code_a_amount
attributes.business_glossary_term: W-2 Box 12 Code A Amount (Uncollected SS Tax on Tips)
attributes.description: W-2 Box 12 Code A: Uncollected Social Security tax on tips. One of up to four Box 12 entries capturing pre-tax benefit and special compensation amounts. Null if not applicable.
attributes.references: IRS Form W-2 Box 12 Instructions; IRS Publication 15

attributes.name: w2_box12_codes
attributes.description: Pipe-delimited list of IRS Box 12 codes reported on this W-2 (e.g., 'D|DD|W'). Code D = 401(k) elective deferrals; Code DD = employer-sponsored health coverage cost; Code W = HSA employer contributions; Code C = taxable cost of group-term life insurance. Supports multi-code scenarios common in staffing. Null for 1099 form types. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: A|B|C|D|DD|E|F|G|H|J|K|L|M|N|P|Q|R|S|T|V|W|Y|Z|AA|BB|DD|EE|FF|GG|HH — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: IRS Form W-2 Box 12 Instructions; IRS Publication 15

attributes.name: w2_box12_total_amount
attributes.business_glossary_term: W-2 Box 12 Total Pre-Tax Benefit Amount
attributes.description: Aggregate dollar amount across all Box 12 codes reported on this W-2. Used for year-end reconciliation of pre-tax benefit deductions (401k, HSA, health coverage). Null for 1099 form types.
attributes.references: IRS Form W-2 Box 12 Instructions; IRS Publication 15; ERISA

attributes.name: w2_federal_tax_withheld_box2
attributes.business_glossary_term: W-2 Box 2 Federal Income Tax Withheld
attributes.description: W-2 Box 2: Total federal income tax withheld from the worker's wages during the tax year. Reported to IRS and used by worker for federal tax return filing. Null for 1099 form types.
attributes.references: IRS Form W-2 Box 2 Instructions; IRS Publication 15; FICA

attributes.name: w2_medicare_tax_withheld_box6
attributes.description: W-2 Box 6: Employee's share of Medicare (FICA) tax withheld. Equals 1.45% of Box 5 wages, plus 0.9% Additional Medicare Tax for high earners. Null for 1099 form types.
attributes.references: IRS Form W-2 Box 6 Instructions; FICA; IRS Publication 15; ACA Additional Medicare Tax

attributes.name: w2_medicare_wages_box5
attributes.business_glossary_term: W-2 Box 5 Medicare Wages and Tips
attributes.description: W-2 Box 5: Total wages and tips subject to Medicare (FICA) tax. No wage base cap applies. Includes wages above the Social Security wage base. Null for 1099 form types.
attributes.references: IRS Form W-2 Box 5 Instructions; FICA; IRS Publication 15

attributes.name: w2_other_compensation_box14
attributes.description: W-2 Box 14: Employer-reported informational amounts such as state disability insurance (SDI) withheld, union dues, educational assistance, or other items not captured in other boxes. Null for 1099 form types.
attributes.references: IRS Form W-2 Box 14 Instructions; IRS Publication 15; FLSA

attributes.name: w2_retirement_plan_box13
attributes.description: W-2 Box 13 checkbox: True if the worker was an active participant in an employer-sponsored retirement plan (401k, SIMPLE IRA, etc.) during the tax year. Affects IRA deductibility on the worker's personal return. Null for 1099 form types.
attributes.references: IRS Form W-2 Box 13 Instructions; ERISA; IRS Publication 590-A

attributes.name: w2_ss_tax_withheld_box4
attributes.business_glossary_term: W-2 Box 4 Social Security Tax Withheld
attributes.description: W-2 Box 4: Employee's share of Social Security (FICA) tax withheld. Equals 6.2% of Box 3 wages up to the wage base. Null for 1099 form types.
attributes.references: IRS Form W-2 Box 4 Instructions; FICA; IRS Publication 15

attributes.name: w2_ss_wages_box3
attributes.description: W-2 Box 3: Total wages subject to Social Security (FICA) tax, capped at the annual Social Security wage base limit. Null for 1099 form types.
attributes.references: IRS Form W-2 Box 3 Instructions; FICA; IRS Publication 15

attributes.name: w2_statutory_employee_box13
attributes.description: W-2 Box 13 checkbox: True if the worker is classified as a statutory employee (e.g., certain drivers, traveling salespeople). Affects self-employment tax treatment. Null for 1099 form types.
attributes.references: IRS Form W-2 Box 13 Instructions; IRS Publication 15-A; Worker Classification Rules

attributes.name: w2_third_party_sick_pay_box13
attributes.business_glossary_term: W-2 Box 13 Third-Party Sick Pay Indicator
attributes.description: W-2 Box 13 checkbox: True if the worker received third-party sick pay (e.g., from an insurance carrier) that is included in wages. Common in staffing for workers on short-term disability. Null for 1099 form types.
attributes.references: IRS Form W-2 Box 13 Instructions; IRS Publication 15-A

attributes.name: w2_wages_box1
attributes.business_glossary_term: W-2 Box 1 Wages, Tips, Other Compensation
attributes.description: W-2 Box 1: Total taxable wages, tips, and other compensation subject to federal income tax withholding. Excludes pre-tax benefit deductions (401k, health insurance). Null for 1099 form types.
attributes.references: IRS Form W-2 Box 1 Instructions; IRS Publication 15; FLSA

attributes.name: worker_address_city
attributes.description: City of the worker's mailing address as printed on the tax form. Used for form distribution and state tax filing jurisdiction determination.
attributes.references: IRS Form W-2 Box f; IRS Form 1099-NEC; GDPR Article 4

attributes.name: worker_address_line1
attributes.description: First line of the worker's mailing address as printed on the tax form for distribution. Required for paper form mailing and IRS/SSA filing. Appears in Box f of W-2 and Recipient Address of 1099.
attributes.references: IRS Form W-2 Box f; IRS Form 1099-NEC; GDPR Article 4; CCPA

attributes.name: worker_address_state
attributes.description: Two-letter US state code of the worker's mailing address. Drives state tax filing jurisdiction and multi-state payroll compliance rules.
attributes.references: IRS Form W-2 Box f; FLSA; Multi-State Payroll Compliance

attributes.name: worker_address_zip
attributes.description: ZIP or ZIP+4 postal code of the worker's mailing address as printed on the tax form.
attributes.references: IRS Form W-2 Box f; IRS Form 1099-NEC

attributes.name: worker_copy_distributed
attributes.description: True if the worker's copy of the tax form (Copy B for W-2, Copy B for 1099) has been distributed to the worker by the IRS deadline (January 31). Tracks compliance with worker distribution requirements.
attributes.references: IRS Form W-2 Instructions; IRS Form 1099-NEC Instructions; IRS Publication 15; ASA

attributes.name: worker_legal_name
attributes.description: Full legal name of the worker or independent contractor as it appears on the tax form (W-2 Box e or 1099 Recipient Name). Must match SSA records for W-2 employees to avoid name/SSN mismatch errors.
attributes.references: IRS Form W-2 Box e; SSA EFW2 Specifications; IRS Form 1099-NEC

attributes.name: worker_ssn
attributes.description: Worker's Social Security Number (SSN) as reported on the tax form. Appears in Box a of W-2 and Recipient TIN field of 1099 forms. Masked in most operational views; full value required only for IRS e-filing and SSA submission. Governed by FCRA and IRS regulations.
attributes.references: IRS Form W-2 Box a; IRS Form 1099-NEC; SSA EFW2; FCRA; GDPR Article 9; CCPA

attributes.name: workers_comp_state
attributes.description: Two-letter state code for the state under which workers compensation (Workers Comp) insurance was carried for this worker during the tax year. Relevant for W-2 employees on temporary assignments. Used in year-end workers comp audit reconciliation.
attributes.references: OSHA; Workers Compensation Insurance; TempWorks Payroll; ASA

products.name: pto_accrual
products.description: Master and transactional record managing PTO policy definitions and worker-level accrual balances — unified SSOT for both policy rules and individual accrual tracking. Policy attributes: policy name, accrual method (hours-based, tenure-based, front-loaded), accrual rate per hour worked or per period, maximum accrual cap, rollover rules (use-it-or-lose-it, rollover with cap, unlimited), waiting period before accrual begins, payout-on-termination flag, state jurisdiction applicability, worker classification eligibility (W-2 temp, FTE, contract), and policy effective dates. Accrual transaction attributes: worker identifier, accrual period, hours accrued, hours used, hours forfeited, current PTO balance, YTD accrued and used hours, accrual trigger (pay stub reference), and balance as-of date. Supports compliance with state-mandated paid sick leave laws (California, New York, Oregon, etc.), PTO payout on separation, and staffing-specific scenarios where temporary workers accrue PTO across multiple client assignments.
products.reference: PTO Accrual / Paid Time Off Balance

attributes.name: pto_accrual_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated identifier for each PTO accrual policy or transaction record. Serves as the primary key for the pto_accrual data product in the payroll domain.
attributes.references: TempWorks Payroll — PTO Accrual Module

attributes.name: accounting_period_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.accounting_period. Business justification: PTO accruals are period-based liabilities for financial statement reporting (balance sheet liability, P&L expense). Required for accurate period close and GAAP compliance in staffing operations with a
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: assignment_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the client assignment or placement under which PTO is being accrued. Supports staffing-specific scenarios where temporary workers accrue PTO across multiple client assignments.
attributes.references: Bullhorn ATS/CRM — Placement Tracking; TempWorks Payroll

attributes.name: direct_hire_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to placement.direct_hire. Business justification: Direct hire employees accrue PTO when staffing firm is employer of record. Links benefit accruals to permanent placement for PTO policy administration and liability tracking.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: gl_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.gl_account. Business justification: PTO liability posts to specific GL liability accounts for balance sheet reporting and expense recognition. Required for accurate GAAP-compliant financial statements in staffing operations offering PTO
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: onboarding_engagement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to onboarding.onboarding_engagement. Business justification: PTO accrual eligibility and start dates are determined during onboarding based on policy assignment and hire date. Tracking the onboarding engagement supports accurate accrual calculations and resolve
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: order_header_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to joborder.order_header. Business justification: PTO accrual policies can vary by client contract and requisition in MSP/VMS programs. Some clients require specific PTO rules per engagement. Tracks which requisition's contract terms govern PTO accru
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: pay_stub_id
attributes.description: Reference to the payroll pay stub that triggered this accrual transaction. Serves as the accrual trigger linking PTO earned to a specific payroll processing event.
attributes.references: TempWorks Payroll — Payroll Processing

attributes.name: policy_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the PTO policy governing this accrual record. Links to the policy definition that specifies accrual method, rate, cap, rollover rules, and eligibility criteria.
attributes.references: TempWorks Payroll — PTO Policy Configuration

attributes.name: profile_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the worker (W-2 temporary, FTE, or contract employee) for whom this PTO accrual record applies. Links to the worker master record in TempWorks Payroll and SAP SuccessFactors.
attributes.references: TempWorks Payroll — Employee Master; SAP SuccessFactors Core HR

attributes.name: sow_engagement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to placement.sow_engagement. Business justification: W-2 workers on SOW engagements accrue PTO if engagement terms allow. Links accrual to SOW for benefit tracking during project-based work and liability management.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: state_compliance_rule_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.state_compliance_rule. Business justification: PTO accrual policies must comply with state-specific paid sick leave mandates and vacation payout laws. Staffing firms configure accrual rules per state compliance requirements - state rule validation
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: accrual_eligible_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the worker is currently eligible to accrue PTO under the applicable policy. May be false if the worker is in the waiting period, has exceeded the accrual cap, or is classified as ineligible (e.g., 1099 contractor).
attributes.references: TempWorks Payroll — PTO Policy Configuration; FLSA; ASA

attributes.name: accrual_eligible_start_date
attributes.description: The date on which the worker first became eligible to accrue PTO under the applicable policy, after satisfying any waiting period. Derived from worker_hire_date plus waiting_period_days but stored explicitly for audit and compliance purposes.
attributes.references: TempWorks Payroll — PTO Policy Configuration; California Healthy Workplaces Act; NY Paid Sick Leave Law

attributes.name: accrual_method
attributes.description: Method by which PTO is earned under the applicable policy. 'hours_based' accrues PTO per hour worked; 'tenure_based' adjusts rate by length of service; 'front_loaded' grants the full balance at the start of a period; 'per_period' grants a fixed amount each pay period; 'anniversary' grants on the worker's anniversary date.
attributes.references: TempWorks Payroll — PTO Policy Configuration; FLSA; ASA

attributes.name: accrual_period_end_date
attributes.description: The last date of the accrual period for which this PTO accrual transaction applies. Together with accrual_period_start_date, defines the exact window of time covered by this accrual record.
attributes.references: TempWorks Payroll — Payroll Processing; FLSA

attributes.name: accrual_period_start_date
attributes.description: The first date of the accrual period (pay period, week, month, or year) for which this PTO accrual transaction applies. Used to align PTO accrual with payroll processing cycles.
attributes.references: TempWorks Payroll — Payroll Processing; FLSA

attributes.name: accrual_rate
attributes.description: Rate at which PTO is earned, expressed as hours of PTO per hour worked (for hours-based) or hours per pay period (for per-period methods). For example, 0.033333 hours PTO per hour worked equals approximately 1 hour PTO per 30 hours worked.
attributes.references: TempWorks Payroll — PTO Policy Configuration; California Labor Code; NY Paid Sick Leave Law

attributes.name: accrual_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of this PTO accrual record. 'active' indicates ongoing accrual; 'suspended' indicates accrual paused (e.g., unpaid leave); 'closed' indicates the record is finalized (termination or policy end); 'pending' indicates awaiting payroll confirmation; 'forfeited' indicates balance was forfeited at year-end.
attributes.references: TempWorks Payroll — PTO Accrual Module; ASA

attributes.name: accrual_year
attributes.description: The calendar or fiscal year to which this accrual record belongs. Used for YTD calculations, annual cap enforcement, rollover processing, and year-end W-2 reporting.
attributes.references: TempWorks Payroll — PTO Accrual Module; IRS W-2 Reporting

attributes.name: accrual_year_type
attributes.description: Defines the basis for the accrual year used in this policy. 'calendar' uses Jan 1–Dec 31; 'fiscal' uses the company fiscal year; 'anniversary' resets on the worker's hire anniversary; 'hire_date' uses the worker's individual hire date as the year start.
attributes.references: TempWorks Payroll — PTO Policy Configuration; ASA; SHRM

attributes.name: adjustment_reason
attributes.description: Free-text description of the reason for any manual PTO hours adjustment recorded in hours_adjusted. Required when hours_adjusted is non-zero. Examples: 'Retroactive policy correction', 'System migration balance transfer', 'Manager-approved exception'.
attributes.references: TempWorks Payroll — PTO Accrual Module; SOC 2 Type II Audit Trail

attributes.name: balance_as_of_date
attributes.description: The effective date through which the current_balance_hours has been calculated. Ensures point-in-time accuracy for balance reporting, worker inquiries, and termination payout calculations.
attributes.references: TempWorks Payroll — PTO Accrual Module; California Labor Code §227.3

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this PTO accrual record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail, data lineage, and SOC 2 compliance. Follows ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX).
attributes.references: SOC 2 Type II; GDPR Article 5; CCPA

attributes.name: current_balance_hours
attributes.description: The worker's available PTO balance in hours as of the balance_as_of_date. Represents the running total of accrued minus used minus forfeited hours. This is the authoritative balance used for payroll processing and worker self-service.
attributes.references: TempWorks Payroll — PTO Accrual Module; SAP SuccessFactors

attributes.name: hours_accrued
attributes.description: Number of PTO hours earned by the worker during this specific accrual period. Calculated as hours_worked multiplied by accrual_rate for hours-based policies, or the fixed grant amount for front-loaded/per-period policies.
attributes.references: TempWorks Payroll — PTO Accrual Module; FLSA; California Labor Code

attributes.name: hours_adjusted
attributes.description: Manual adjustment to PTO hours applied during this period (positive for additions, negative for corrections). Used for retroactive corrections, policy changes, or administrative overrides. Requires an adjustment reason.
attributes.references: TempWorks Payroll — PTO Accrual Module

attributes.name: hours_forfeited
attributes.description: Number of PTO hours forfeited by the worker during this period due to use-it-or-lose-it policy rules, exceeding the maximum accrual cap, or rollover cap enforcement at year-end. Critical for compliance reporting in states with mandatory PTO payout laws.
attributes.references: TempWorks Payroll — PTO Accrual Module; California Labor Code §227.3; ASA

attributes.name: hours_used
attributes.description: Number of PTO hours consumed (taken) by the worker during this accrual period. Reduces the available PTO balance. Sourced from approved time-off requests processed through Kronos Workforce Ready.
attributes.references: TempWorks Payroll — PTO Accrual Module; Kronos Workforce Ready

attributes.name: hours_worked
attributes.description: Total hours worked by the worker during the accrual period that are eligible to generate PTO accrual. Used as the basis for hours-based accrual calculations.
attributes.references: Kronos Workforce Ready — Time and Attendance; FLSA; TempWorks Payroll

attributes.name: max_accrual_cap_hours
attributes.description: The maximum number of PTO hours a worker may accumulate under the applicable policy at any point in time. Once reached, no additional hours accrue until the balance is reduced. Enforced per policy and state jurisdiction.
attributes.references: TempWorks Payroll — PTO Policy Configuration; California Labor Code; ASA

attributes.name: payout_hours
attributes.description: Number of unused PTO hours paid out to the worker upon termination or separation. Populated only when payout_on_termination_flag is true and the worker has separated. Used to generate the termination PTO payout payroll transaction.
attributes.references: TempWorks Payroll — Termination Processing; California Labor Code §227.3; Colorado HELP Act

attributes.name: payout_on_termination_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether unused PTO hours must be paid out to the worker upon separation from employment. Mandatory in states such as California, Colorado, and Illinois. Drives termination payroll processing in TempWorks Payroll.
attributes.references: TempWorks Payroll — PTO Policy Configuration; California Labor Code §227.3; Colorado HELP Act; Illinois Wage Payment Act

attributes.name: payout_rate
attributes.description: The hourly pay rate used to calculate the monetary value of PTO payout upon termination. Typically the worker's regular pay rate at time of separation. Confidential financial data used in final paycheck processing.
attributes.references: TempWorks Payroll — Termination Processing; FLSA; California Labor Code §227.3

attributes.name: policy_effective_date
attributes.description: The date on which the PTO policy became effective and applicable to eligible workers. Used for policy versioning and to determine which policy rules apply to a given accrual period.
attributes.references: TempWorks Payroll — PTO Policy Configuration; DOL

attributes.name: policy_expiration_date
attributes.description: The date on which the PTO policy expires or is superseded by a new policy version. Null for currently active policies with no defined end date. Supports policy versioning and historical accrual audits.
attributes.references: TempWorks Payroll — PTO Policy Configuration; DOL

attributes.name: record_type
attributes.description: Discriminator indicating whether this record represents a policy definition, a periodic accrual transaction, a manual adjustment, a termination payout, or a year-end rollover event. Supports the unified SSOT design of this data product.
attributes.references: TempWorks Payroll — PTO Accrual Module

attributes.name: rollover_cap_hours
attributes.description: Maximum number of PTO hours that may be carried over from one accrual year to the next under a rollover-with-cap policy. Null for use-it-or-lose-it or unlimited rollover policies.
attributes.references: TempWorks Payroll — PTO Policy Configuration; State Paid Leave Laws

attributes.name: rollover_rule
attributes.description: Rule governing what happens to unused PTO hours at the end of the accrual year. 'use_it_or_lose_it' forfeits all unused hours; 'rollover_with_cap' carries over up to rollover_cap_hours; 'unlimited_rollover' carries over all unused hours. Must comply with state law (e.g., California prohibits use-it-or-lose-it for vacation).
attributes.references: TempWorks Payroll — PTO Policy Configuration; California Labor Code §227.3; NY Paid Sick Leave Law

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Identifies the operational system of record that originated this PTO accrual record. Supports data lineage, reconciliation, and audit traceability across TempWorks Payroll, Kronos Workforce Ready, and SAP SuccessFactors.
attributes.references: SOC 2 Type II; TempWorks Payroll; Kronos Workforce Ready; SAP SuccessFactors

attributes.name: state_jurisdiction
attributes.description: Two-letter US state code identifying the jurisdiction whose paid leave laws govern this PTO policy and accrual record. Critical for multi-state payroll compliance (e.g., CA, NY, OR, CO, IL). Determines mandatory accrual minimums, rollover rules, and payout-on-termination requirements.
attributes.references: DOL; California Labor Code; NY Paid Sick Leave Law; Oregon Sick Time Law; SHRM; ASA

attributes.name: termination_date
attributes.description: The date the worker's employment or assignment ended. Used to trigger final PTO balance calculation, determine payout-on-termination eligibility, and close the accrual record. Null for active workers.
attributes.references: TempWorks Payroll — Offboarding; California Labor Code §227.3; DOL

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this PTO accrual record was last modified. Used for change tracking, incremental data loads in the Databricks Silver Layer, and audit compliance.
attributes.references: SOC 2 Type II; GDPR Article 5; CCPA

attributes.name: waiting_period_days
attributes.description: Number of calendar days from the worker's hire or assignment start date before PTO accrual begins. Common in staffing for temporary workers (e.g., 90-day waiting period). Must comply with state-mandated sick leave laws that may restrict waiting periods.
attributes.references: TempWorks Payroll — PTO Policy Configuration; California Healthy Workplaces Act; NY Paid Sick Leave Law

attributes.name: worker_classification
attributes.description: Employment classification of the worker for PTO eligibility purposes. Determines which PTO policy applies. W-2 temporary workers, FTEs, and contract workers may have different accrual entitlements. 1099 independent contractors are generally ineligible. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: w2_temp|fte|contract|1099|eor — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: IRS Worker Classification Rules; FLSA; ASA; TempWorks Payroll

attributes.name: worker_hire_date
attributes.description: The date the worker was originally hired or began their first qualifying assignment. Used to calculate tenure for tenure-based accrual policies, waiting period eligibility, and anniversary-based accrual year resets.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Core HR; TempWorks Payroll; FLSA

attributes.name: ytd_hours_accrued
attributes.description: Cumulative PTO hours accrued by the worker from the start of the current accrual year through the current accrual period. Used for W-2 reporting, annual cap enforcement, and compliance with state-mandated accrual limits.
attributes.references: TempWorks Payroll — PTO Accrual Module; IRS W-2 Reporting; California SB 3

attributes.name: ytd_hours_used
attributes.description: Cumulative PTO hours used by the worker from the start of the current accrual year through the current accrual period. Used for annual usage reporting, compliance audits, and workforce analytics.
attributes.references: TempWorks Payroll — PTO Accrual Module; DOL Reporting

products.name: garnishment_order
products.description: Master record for court-ordered or agency-mandated wage garnishments applied to worker pay. Captures garnishment type (child support, creditor garnishment, student loan, tax levy, bankruptcy), issuing authority, case or order number, ordered amount or percentage, maximum withholding limit (per CCPA/FLSA disposable earnings rules), priority order when multiple garnishments exist, remittance payee, remittance address, effective date, expiration date, and garnishment status (active, suspended, satisfied, terminated).
products.reference: Wage Garnishment Order / Income Withholding Order

attributes.name: garnishment_order_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated surrogate key identifying a single court-ordered or agency-mandated wage garnishment record in the TempWorks Payroll system. TRANSACTION_HEADER primary key.
attributes.references: TempWorks Payroll — Garnishment Module

attributes.name: assignment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to placement.assignment. Business justification: Garnishment orders follow worker across assignments. Links order to current assignment for payroll withholding processing, remittance tracking, and compliance with court orders during active placement
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: direct_hire_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to placement.direct_hire. Business justification: Direct hire employees may have garnishment orders. When staffing firm processes payroll for direct hires, garnishments must be withheld and remitted. Links order to permanent placement.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: gl_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.gl_account. Business justification: Garnishments post to liability accounts (garnishment payable) for balance sheet reporting and remittance tracking. Required for accurate liability reporting and compliance with court-ordered withholdi
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: legal_entity_id
attributes.description: Reference to the payroll company or legal entity within TempWorks Payroll responsible for processing this garnishment. Relevant for multi-entity staffing organizations where workers may be employed under different legal entities (e.g., EOR entities, co-employment entities).
attributes.references: TempWorks Payroll — Company Setup; EOR (Employer of Record) Model

attributes.name: onboarding_engagement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to onboarding.onboarding_engagement. Business justification: Garnishment orders received during pre-employment screening or at hire must be linked to onboarding engagement for compliance documentation. Supports audit trail showing when garnishment was identifie
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: profile_id
attributes.description: Reference to the worker (employee or contractor) whose wages are subject to this garnishment order. Links to the worker master record in TempWorks Payroll / SAP SuccessFactors.
attributes.references: TempWorks Payroll — Employee Master; FLSA 29 CFR Part 870

attributes.name: regulatory_violation_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.regulatory_violation. Business justification: Garnishment orders may result from regulatory violations (child support enforcement failures, tax liens, court-ordered restitution). Compliance tracking links enforcement actions to payroll deduction
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: administrative_fee_amount
attributes.description: Dollar amount of the per-pay-period administrative fee the employer is permitted to charge the employee for processing the garnishment, as allowed by applicable state law. Typically $1–$5 per pay period. Zero if the state does not permit an administrative fee.
attributes.references: State Wage Garnishment Laws; FLSA 29 CFR Part 870; ASA Compliance Guidelines

attributes.name: arrears_amount
attributes.description: Dollar amount of past-due arrears included in the garnishment order, separate from the current ongoing obligation. Particularly relevant for child support orders where arrears withholding may be calculated at a different rate than current support.
attributes.references: Title IV-D Child Support Enforcement; FLSA 29 CFR Part 870

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this garnishment order record was first created in the TempWorks Payroll system. Serves as the audit trail creation marker per SOC 2 Type II and internal data governance requirements.
attributes.references: SOC 2 Type II; GDPR Article 5(2); CCPA

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date on which withholding under this garnishment order must begin, as specified by the issuing authority. Payroll must begin deducting no later than the first pay period that includes this date.
attributes.references: FLSA 29 CFR Part 870; IRS Publication 1494; Title IV-D

attributes.name: employer_response_date
attributes.description: The actual date on which the employer submitted its response to the issuing authority. Used to verify timely compliance with mandatory response deadlines and to support audit documentation.
attributes.references: Title IV-D; OMB Form 0970-0154; FLSA 29 CFR Part 870

attributes.name: employer_response_due_date
attributes.description: The deadline by which the employer must respond to the issuing authority confirming receipt and intent to comply with the garnishment order, or to contest the order if applicable. Typically within 10–15 business days of receipt for IWOs.
attributes.references: Title IV-D; OMB Form 0970-0154; IRS Publication 1494

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: The date on which the garnishment order expires or is scheduled to end. Null for open-ended orders (e.g., ongoing child support). Payroll must cease withholding after this date unless a renewal order is received.
attributes.references: FLSA 29 CFR Part 870; IRS Publication 1494

attributes.name: garnishment_order_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the garnishment order. Active: withholding is in progress. Suspended: temporarily halted per court or agency instruction. Satisfied: total obligation has been fully paid. Terminated: order cancelled or revoked. Pending: received but not yet activated in payroll.
attributes.references: TempWorks Payroll — Garnishment Module; FLSA 29 CFR Part 870

attributes.name: garnishment_type
attributes.description: Classification of the garnishment by legal category. Determines applicable withholding limits and priority rules under federal and state law. Values: child_support (Title IV-D orders), creditor_garnishment (civil court judgment), student_loan (Department of Education administrative garnishment), tax_levy (IRS or state tax levy), bankruptcy (Chapter 13 trustee payment).
attributes.references: FLSA 29 CFR Part 870; IRS Publication 1494; Title IV-D Child Support Enforcement; 20 U.S.C. § 1095a (HEA); 11 U.S.C. § 1325 (Bankruptcy)

attributes.name: is_arrears_order
attributes.description: Indicates whether this garnishment order includes or is exclusively for past-due arrears (True) versus a current ongoing obligation only (False). Relevant for child support orders where arrears withholding may trigger a higher CCPA cap (up to 65% vs. 50%).
attributes.references: CCPA 15 U.S.C. § 1673; Title IV-D; FLSA 29 CFR Part 870

attributes.name: is_income_withholding_order
attributes.description: Indicates whether this garnishment is an Income Withholding Order (IWO) issued under Title IV-D of the Social Security Act (True). IWOs have specific federal processing requirements including mandatory employer response timelines and standardized form usage (OMB 0970-0154).
attributes.references: Title IV-D; 42 U.S.C. § 666(b); OMB Form 0970-0154

attributes.name: issuing_authority_name
attributes.description: Name of the court, government agency, or administrative body that issued the garnishment order (e.g., 'Cook County Circuit Court', 'IRS — Automated Collection System', 'Illinois Department of Healthcare and Family Services — Child Support Division').
attributes.references: FLSA 29 CFR Part 870; IRS Publication 668-W; Title IV-D

attributes.name: issuing_state
attributes.description: Two-letter U.S. state or territory code of the jurisdiction that issued the garnishment order. Used to apply the correct state-specific withholding limits and priority rules, which may be more protective than federal CCPA limits.
attributes.references: CCPA 15 U.S.C. § 1673; State Wage Garnishment Laws

attributes.name: iwo_form_version
attributes.description: Version identifier of the standardized federal Income Withholding Order form used (e.g., 'OMB 0970-0154 Rev. 06/2021'). Required for audit and compliance tracking of IWO processing. Null when is_income_withholding_order is False.
attributes.references: Title IV-D; OMB Form 0970-0154; OCSE (Office of Child Support Enforcement)

attributes.name: max_withholding_pct
attributes.description: The maximum percentage of disposable earnings that may be withheld under this order, as governed by the Consumer Credit Protection Act (CCPA) and FLSA. Stored as a decimal fraction (e.g., 0.50 = 50%). Payroll must not exceed this cap even if the ordered amount would otherwise require it. Defaults vary by garnishment type (e.g., 50–65% for child support, 25% for creditor garnishments).
attributes.references: CCPA 15 U.S.C. § 1673; FLSA 29 CFR Part 870; DOL Fact Sheet #30

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for payroll staff to record additional context, special instructions from the issuing authority, or internal processing notes related to this garnishment order (e.g., 'Worker contested order — awaiting court ruling', 'SDU requires paper check until EFT enrollment complete').
attributes.references: TempWorks Payroll — Garnishment Module

attributes.name: order_number
attributes.description: The externally-issued case or order number assigned by the issuing court, agency, or government authority (e.g., court docket number, IRS levy notice number, state child support case number). This is the primary business identifier used to cross-reference with the issuing authority.
attributes.references: FLSA 29 CFR Part 870; IRS Publication 1494; CCPA 15 U.S.C. § 1673

attributes.name: priority_order
attributes.description: Integer ranking that determines the sequence in which this garnishment is applied when a worker has multiple simultaneous garnishment orders. Lower numbers indicate higher priority. Child support orders are federally mandated to take priority over other garnishments. Used by payroll to allocate available disposable earnings across competing orders.
attributes.references: FLSA 29 CFR Part 870; CCPA 15 U.S.C. § 1673; Title IV-D

attributes.name: received_date
attributes.description: The date on which the employer (Staffing Hr) received the garnishment order from the issuing authority. Triggers the employer's legal obligation to begin withholding within the required timeframe. Distinct from the effective_date specified in the order.
attributes.references: FLSA 29 CFR Part 870; Title IV-D; IRS Publication 1494

attributes.name: remittance_account_number
attributes.description: Bank account number for EFT/ACH remittance to the garnishment payee. Stored in masked or tokenized form per PCI/security policy. Null when remittance_method is 'check'.
attributes.references: Title IV-D; IRS Publication 1494; PCI DSS

attributes.name: remittance_address_line1
attributes.description: Primary street address line for mailing garnishment remittance payments to the payee. Used when electronic remittance (EFT/EFT) is not available.
attributes.references: Title IV-D; IRS Publication 1494

attributes.name: remittance_address_line2
attributes.description: Secondary address line (suite, PO Box, unit number) for the garnishment remittance payee mailing address.
attributes.references: Title IV-D; IRS Publication 1494

attributes.name: remittance_city
attributes.description: City of the garnishment remittance payee mailing address.
attributes.references: Title IV-D; IRS Publication 1494

attributes.name: remittance_frequency
attributes.description: How frequently withheld garnishment funds must be remitted to the payee. Most child support SDUs require remittance within 7 business days of the pay date. IRS levies may require per-payroll remittance.
attributes.references: Title IV-D (7-day SDU rule); IRS Publication 1494

attributes.name: remittance_method
attributes.description: Method by which withheld garnishment funds are transmitted to the remittance payee. EFT/ACH is required for most State Disbursement Units (SDUs) under Title IV-D. Check is used for payees that do not accept electronic payment.
attributes.references: Title IV-D (SDU EFT requirement); IRS Publication 1494

attributes.name: remittance_payee_name
attributes.description: Name of the entity to whom withheld funds must be remitted (e.g., 'State Disbursement Unit — Illinois', 'IRS — ACS', 'Chapter 13 Trustee — Northern District of Illinois'). Used to generate the payable in Oracle NetSuite ERP accounts payable.
attributes.references: Title IV-D (SDU requirement); IRS Publication 1494; 11 U.S.C. § 1325

attributes.name: remittance_reference_code
attributes.description: Payee-assigned reference code or FIPS code that must appear on each remittance payment to allow the receiving agency to correctly apply the payment to the correct case (e.g., SDU case number, IRS notice number, FIPS employer code).
attributes.references: Title IV-D; IRS Publication 1494

attributes.name: remittance_routing_number
attributes.description: ABA routing transit number for EFT/ACH remittance to the garnishment payee. Nine-digit number identifying the receiving financial institution. Null when remittance_method is 'check'.
attributes.references: Title IV-D; IRS Publication 1494; Federal Reserve Regulation J

attributes.name: remittance_state
attributes.description: Two-letter U.S. state or territory code of the garnishment remittance payee mailing address.
attributes.references: Title IV-D; IRS Publication 1494

attributes.name: remittance_zip
attributes.description: ZIP or ZIP+4 postal code of the garnishment remittance payee mailing address.
attributes.references: Title IV-D; IRS Publication 1494

attributes.name: source_system_record_code
attributes.description: The native record identifier assigned by TempWorks Payroll to this garnishment order in the operational system of record. Used for lineage tracing, reconciliation, and re-ingestion deduplication in the Databricks Silver Layer.
attributes.references: TempWorks Payroll — Garnishment Module; Databricks Lakehouse Silver Layer Conventions

attributes.name: suspension_reason
attributes.description: Free-text description of the reason the garnishment order was suspended (e.g., 'Court-ordered stay pending appeal', 'Worker on unpaid leave — no disposable earnings', 'Agency-issued suspension notice received'). Populated only when status is 'suspended'.
attributes.references: FLSA 29 CFR Part 870; TempWorks Payroll — Garnishment Module

attributes.name: termination_date
attributes.description: The date on which the garnishment order was terminated, satisfied, or revoked, resulting in cessation of withholding. Populated when status transitions to 'satisfied' or 'terminated'. Null while the order is active or pending.
attributes.references: FLSA 29 CFR Part 870; IRS Publication 1494

attributes.name: total_obligation_amount
attributes.description: The total dollar amount owed under this garnishment order as specified by the issuing authority (e.g., total judgment debt, total child support arrears). Null for ongoing orders with no defined total (e.g., current child support with no arrears). Used to determine when the order is satisfied.
attributes.references: FLSA 29 CFR Part 870; IRS Publication 1494

attributes.name: total_withheld_to_date
attributes.description: Cumulative dollar amount withheld from the worker's pay and remitted under this garnishment order since the effective date. Updated each payroll cycle. Used to track progress toward satisfying the total obligation and to determine when the order is fully paid.
attributes.references: TempWorks Payroll — Garnishment Module; FLSA 29 CFR Part 870

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this garnishment order record was most recently modified in the TempWorks Payroll system. Used for change data capture (CDC) in the Databricks Silver Layer pipeline and for audit trail compliance.
attributes.references: SOC 2 Type II; GDPR Article 5(2); TempWorks Payroll — Garnishment Module

attributes.name: withholding_amount
attributes.description: Fixed dollar amount to be withheld from the worker's pay per pay period when withholding_method is 'fixed_amount'. Null when withholding_method is 'percentage'. Expressed in USD.
attributes.references: FLSA 29 CFR Part 870; IRS Publication 1494; CCPA 15 U.S.C. § 1673

attributes.name: withholding_method
attributes.description: Indicates whether the garnishment is calculated as a fixed dollar amount per pay period or as a percentage of the worker's disposable earnings. Determines which of the two withholding fields (withholding_amount or withholding_percentage) is operative.
attributes.references: FLSA 29 CFR Part 870; CCPA 15 U.S.C. § 1673

attributes.name: withholding_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of the worker's disposable earnings to be withheld per pay period when withholding_method is 'percentage'. Stored as a decimal fraction (e.g., 0.25 = 25%). Null when withholding_method is 'fixed_amount'.
attributes.references: FLSA 29 CFR Part 870; CCPA 15 U.S.C. § 1673; Title IV-D

products.name: pay_adjustment
products.description: Transactional record capturing manual corrections, retroactive pay adjustments, voids, and reissues applied outside of a standard pay run. Covers adjustment types including pay correction, void and reissue, retroactive rate change, missed hours correction, tax correction, and deduction correction. Stores original pay stub reference, adjustment reason code, adjusted earnings or deduction amounts, approver, approval date, and adjustment processing status. Maintains audit trail for payroll corrections and supports SOX-adjacent controls.
products.reference: Payroll Adjustment / Pay Correction / Retroactive Pay

attributes.name: pay_adjustment_id
attributes.description: Primary key for pay_adjustment

attributes.name: accounting_period_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.accounting_period. Business justification: Payroll adjustments must be tracked by accounting period for audit trail, period close, and prior period adjustment reporting. Required for accurate financial statement preparation and SOX compliance
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: assignment_id
attributes.description: Reference to the staffing assignment or placement associated with the pay adjustment. Ties the correction to the specific client engagement and job order context.
attributes.references: Bullhorn ATS/CRM — Placement Tracking; TempWorks Payroll

attributes.name: contract_msa_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to contract.msa. Business justification: Pay adjustments (corrections, retro pay) must reference governing MSA for client billing adjustments and dispute resolution. Required to determine if adjustment triggers client invoice revision under
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: direct_hire_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to placement.direct_hire. Business justification: Direct hire placements may require payroll adjustments for signing bonuses, salary corrections, or guarantee period true-ups. Links adjustments to permanent placement for financial reconciliation.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: journal_entry_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the GL journal entry batch in Oracle NetSuite ERP to which this adjustment was posted. Supports financial reconciliation and audit trail between payroll and accounting systems.
attributes.references: Oracle NetSuite ERP — General Ledger; SOX Internal Controls

attributes.name: order_header_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to joborder.order_header. Business justification: Pay adjustments must link to job orders for client billing corrections, invoice adjustments, and accurate margin impact analysis when rates or hours are retroactively corrected. Essential for financia
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: original_pay_stub_id
attributes.description: Reference to the original pay stub or paycheck record that this adjustment corrects, voids, or reissues. Maintains the audit trail linking the correction back to the source pay event.
attributes.references: TempWorks Payroll — Pay Stub Module; SOX Internal Controls

attributes.name: pay_run_id
attributes.description: Reference to the pay run in which this adjustment was originally processed or to which it is being applied. Links the adjustment to the parent payroll cycle in TempWorks Payroll.
attributes.references: TempWorks Payroll — Pay Run Module

attributes.name: profile_id
attributes.description: Reference to the worker (W-2 employee or 1099 independent contractor) whose pay is being adjusted. PARTY_REFERENCE category per TRANSACTION_HEADER role requirements.
attributes.references: TempWorks Payroll; SAP SuccessFactors Core HR; FLSA

attributes.name: regulatory_violation_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.regulatory_violation. Business justification: Pay adjustments are often triggered by regulatory violations (wage/hour violations, misclassification back-pay, overtime corrections). Staffing firms track remediation payments linked to specific viol
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: adjusted_deduction_amount
attributes.description: Corrected total deduction amount applied in this adjustment. Covers benefit deductions, garnishments, and other pre/post-tax deductions that were incorrectly processed in the original pay run.
attributes.references: TempWorks Payroll; DOL Wage and Hour Division; Consumer Credit Protection Act (Garnishment)

attributes.name: adjusted_dt_pay
attributes.description: Corrected double time (DT) earnings component of the adjustment. Applicable for assignments with contractual or state-mandated double time provisions.
attributes.references: TempWorks Payroll; FLSA; State Wage and Hour Laws

attributes.name: adjusted_fica_employee
attributes.business_glossary_term: Adjusted Federal Insurance Contributions Act (FICA) Employee Amount
attributes.description: Corrected employee-side FICA (Social Security and Medicare) withholding amount. Required for tax correction adjustments and amended W-2 (W-2c) filings with the IRS.
attributes.references: TempWorks Payroll; IRS Publication 15; FICA; IRS Form W-2c

attributes.name: adjusted_fica_employer
attributes.business_glossary_term: Adjusted Federal Insurance Contributions Act (FICA) Employer Amount
attributes.description: Corrected employer-side FICA matching contribution amount. Required for employer tax liability recalculation and amended payroll tax filings (Form 941-X).
attributes.references: TempWorks Payroll; IRS Publication 15; FICA; IRS Form 941-X

attributes.name: adjusted_gross_pay
attributes.description: The corrected gross pay amount after the adjustment is applied. Represents the new gross earnings figure that replaces or supplements the original pay stub amount.
attributes.references: TempWorks Payroll; FLSA; IRS Publication 15; SOX Internal Controls

attributes.name: adjusted_hours
attributes.description: The corrected number of hours being applied in this adjustment. Used for missed hours corrections and retroactive rate change recalculations. Supports Kronos Workforce Ready time and attendance reconciliation.
attributes.references: TempWorks Payroll; Kronos Workforce Ready; FLSA; DOL Wage and Hour Division

attributes.name: adjusted_net_pay
attributes.description: The corrected net pay amount after all adjustments to gross pay, taxes, and deductions. Represents the actual dollar amount owed to or recovered from the worker. Part of MONETARY_TRIPLET — net total.
attributes.references: TempWorks Payroll; FLSA; IRS Publication 15; SOX Internal Controls

attributes.name: adjusted_ot_pay
attributes.description: Corrected overtime (OT) earnings component of the adjustment. Tracks overtime pay corrections separately to support FLSA overtime compliance auditing and reporting.
attributes.references: TempWorks Payroll; FLSA Section 7; DOL Wage and Hour Division

attributes.name: adjusted_pay_rate
attributes.description: The corrected pay rate to be applied in this adjustment. Used for retroactive rate change adjustments to document the rate that should have been applied.
attributes.references: TempWorks Payroll; Beeline VMS Rate Management; ASA Staffing Standards

attributes.name: adjusted_regular_pay
attributes.description: Corrected regular (straight-time) earnings component of the adjustment. Captures the regular hours pay correction separately from overtime and other pay components.
attributes.references: TempWorks Payroll; FLSA Section 7; DOL Wage and Hour Division

attributes.name: adjusted_tax_withholding
attributes.description: The corrected total employee tax withholding amount applied in this adjustment. Covers federal, state, and local income tax corrections. Supports IRS tax correction and amended W-2 processing.
attributes.references: TempWorks Payroll; IRS Publication 15; IRS Form W-2c; FICA

attributes.name: adjustment_date
attributes.description: The business effective date on which the payroll adjustment is applied. Represents the real-world event date of the correction, distinct from the record creation timestamp. BUSINESS_EVENT_TIMESTAMP category per TRANSACTION_HEADER role.
attributes.references: TempWorks Payroll; IRS Publication 15; FLSA

attributes.name: adjustment_number
attributes.description: Externally visible, human-readable identifier for the payroll adjustment (e.g., ADJ-2024-000123). Used in payroll operations, audit correspondence, and SOX control documentation. BUSINESS_IDENTIFIER category per TRANSACTION_HEADER role.
attributes.references: TempWorks Payroll — Adjustment Module; SOX Internal Controls

attributes.name: adjustment_status
attributes.description: Current workflow state of the payroll adjustment record. Tracks the adjustment through its lifecycle from initial entry through approval, processing, and final disposition. LIFECYCLE_STATUS category per TRANSACTION_HEADER role.
attributes.references: TempWorks Payroll — Workflow States; SOX Internal Controls

attributes.name: adjustment_type
attributes.description: Classification of the payroll adjustment by its business purpose. Values: pay_correction (general earnings correction), void_reissue (check voided and reissued), retro_rate_change (retroactive pay rate change applied), missed_hours (hours omitted from original pay run), tax_correction (withholding or tax filing correction), deduction_correction (benefit or garnishment deduction correction). CLASSIFICATION_OR_TYPE category.
attributes.references: TempWorks Payroll — Adjustment Types; IRS Publication 15; ASA Payroll Standards

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or user identifier of the payroll manager or authorized approver who approved this adjustment. Required for SOX-adjacent dual-control and segregation-of-duties compliance.
