attributes.references: TempWorks Payroll; SOX Internal Controls; SHRM Payroll Best Practices

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the payroll adjustment was formally approved by the authorized approver. Supports SOX audit trail and segregation-of-duties documentation.
attributes.references: TempWorks Payroll; SOX Internal Controls

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the payroll adjustment record was first created in the system. RECORD_AUDIT_CREATED category per TRANSACTION_HEADER role requirements. Supports SOX audit trail.
attributes.references: TempWorks Payroll; SOX Internal Controls; SHRM Payroll Best Practices

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for all monetary amounts in this adjustment record (e.g., USD). Supports multi-currency payroll for international EOR engagements.
attributes.references: ISO 4217; TempWorks Payroll; Oracle NetSuite ERP

attributes.name: disbursement_method
attributes.description: The payment disbursement method used to deliver the adjusted net pay to the worker. Determines the payment processing channel for off-cycle adjustments and reissued checks.
attributes.references: TempWorks Payroll; NACHA Electronic Payments Association

attributes.name: gl_post_date
attributes.description: The date on which the payroll adjustment entries were posted to the General Ledger in Oracle NetSuite ERP. Used for financial period close reconciliation and accrual management.
attributes.references: Oracle NetSuite ERP — General Ledger; SOX Internal Controls; GAAP

attributes.name: gross_pay_delta
attributes.description: The net difference between adjusted_gross_pay and original_gross_pay. Positive values indicate additional pay owed to the worker; negative values indicate overpayment recovery. Part of MONETARY_TRIPLET — adjustment component.
attributes.references: TempWorks Payroll; FLSA; SOX Internal Controls

attributes.name: is_off_cycle
attributes.description: Indicates whether this adjustment is processed as an off-cycle (out-of-band) payment rather than being included in the next scheduled pay run. Off-cycle adjustments incur additional processing costs and require separate disbursement.
attributes.references: TempWorks Payroll; ASA Payroll Standards

attributes.name: is_reissue
attributes.description: Indicates whether this adjustment record represents the reissued replacement check following a void. Paired with is_void to track the complete void-and-reissue cycle.
attributes.references: TempWorks Payroll; SOX Internal Controls

attributes.name: is_void
attributes.description: Indicates whether this adjustment represents a full void of the original paycheck. When true, the original pay stub is cancelled and a reissue record is expected. Supports void/reissue audit trail and SOX controls.
attributes.references: TempWorks Payroll; SOX Internal Controls; ASA Payroll Standards

attributes.name: original_gross_pay
attributes.description: The gross pay amount from the original pay stub prior to any adjustment. Serves as the baseline for calculating the adjustment delta and supports audit trail requirements. Part of MONETARY_TRIPLET category.
attributes.references: TempWorks Payroll; FLSA; IRS Publication 15; SOX Internal Controls

attributes.name: original_pay_date
attributes.description: The check date or pay date of the original pay stub being corrected. Critical for retroactive adjustments and void/reissue scenarios to identify the source payroll event.
attributes.references: TempWorks Payroll; IRS Publication 15

attributes.name: original_pay_rate
attributes.description: The pay rate (bill rate minus spread) in effect on the original pay stub. Required for retroactive rate change adjustments to document the rate that was incorrectly applied.
attributes.references: TempWorks Payroll; Beeline VMS Rate Management; ASA Staffing Standards

attributes.name: pay_period_end_date
attributes.description: End date of the pay period to which this adjustment applies. Used to correctly attribute the correction to the appropriate payroll period for tax and financial reporting.
attributes.references: TempWorks Payroll; FLSA; DOL Wage and Hour Division

attributes.name: pay_period_start_date
attributes.description: Start date of the pay period to which this adjustment applies. May differ from the current pay period when processing retroactive corrections or missed hours from a prior period.
attributes.references: TempWorks Payroll; FLSA; DOL Wage and Hour Division

attributes.name: processed_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the payroll adjustment was fully processed and posted in TempWorks Payroll. Marks the completion of the adjustment lifecycle.
attributes.references: TempWorks Payroll; SOX Internal Controls

attributes.name: reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code identifying the specific reason for the payroll adjustment (e.g., RATE_ERR, HOURS_MISS, TAX_RECALC, VOID_LOST_CHECK, RETRO_PROMO). Supports audit trail, SOX controls, and payroll error trend analysis. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: RATE_ERR|HOURS_MISS|TAX_RECALC|VOID_LOST_CHECK|RETRO_PROMO|DEDUCT_ERR|GARNISH_ADJ|BONUS_CORR|OT_RECALC|PTO_ADJ — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: TempWorks Payroll — Reason Codes; SOX Internal Controls; ASA Payroll Standards

attributes.name: reason_description
attributes.description: Free-text narrative explanation of why the payroll adjustment was initiated. Provides context beyond the reason code for audit review, SOX documentation, and payroll operations investigation.
attributes.references: TempWorks Payroll; SOX Internal Controls; SHRM Payroll Best Practices

attributes.name: requires_w2c
attributes.description: Indicates whether this adjustment requires the issuance of an amended W-2 (Form W-2c) to the worker and the IRS. Set to true when the adjustment affects a prior tax year's reported wages or withholdings.
attributes.references: IRS Form W-2c; IRS Publication 15; TempWorks Payroll

attributes.name: tax_quarter
attributes.description: The tax quarter (1–4) to which this adjustment applies. Required for quarterly payroll tax filing corrections (IRS Form 941-X, FUTA Form 940, SUTA state filings).
attributes.references: IRS Form 941-X; FUTA; SUTA; TempWorks Payroll

attributes.name: tax_year
attributes.description: The tax year to which this payroll adjustment applies. Critical for W-2c (amended W-2) and 1099 correction filings when the adjustment crosses calendar year boundaries.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 15; IRS Form W-2c; IRS Form 1099-NEC; TempWorks Payroll

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the payroll adjustment record was last modified. RECORD_AUDIT_UPDATED category per TRANSACTION_HEADER role requirements. Tracks changes through the approval and processing workflow.
attributes.references: TempWorks Payroll; SOX Internal Controls

attributes.name: work_state_code
attributes.description: Two-letter US state code where the worker performed the work subject to this adjustment. Determines applicable state income tax, SUTA, and workers compensation rules for multi-state payroll compliance.
attributes.references: TempWorks Payroll; DOL; SUTA; State Wage and Hour Laws; FLSA

attributes.name: worker_type
attributes.description: Classification of the worker for tax and payroll processing purposes. W-2 (Wage and Tax Statement employee), 1099 (Independent Contractor), or EOR (Employer of Record). Determines applicable tax withholding rules and adjustment processing logic.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 15; IRS Form 1099-NEC; INA I-9 Compliance; DOL Worker Classification Rules

products.name: tax_withholding_election
products.description: Master record capturing a worker's federal and state tax withholding elections as submitted via W-4 (federal) and equivalent state withholding forms. Stores filing status (single, married, head of household), number of allowances or Step 3 dependent credits (post-2020 W-4), additional withholding amount, exempt from withholding flag, state withholding form type, state-specific elections, effective date, and election source (paper form, electronic self-service). Drives tax withholding calculation in each pay run.
products.reference: W-4 / Tax Withholding Election / Employee Withholding Certificate

attributes.name: tax_withholding_election_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each tax withholding election record. Primary key for the tax_withholding_election data product in the payroll domain.
attributes.references: TempWorks Payroll - Tax Withholding Module

attributes.name: assignment_id
attributes.description: Reference to the active placement or assignment associated with this withholding election, enabling assignment-level tax configuration for multi-assignment workers.
attributes.references: TempWorks Payroll - Assignment Tax Configuration; Bullhorn ATS/CRM

attributes.name: direct_hire_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to placement.direct_hire. Business justification: Direct hire employees submit W-4 elections when staffing firm processes payroll under PEO or transition arrangements. Links tax elections to permanent placement for withholding compliance.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: legal_entity_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.legal_entity. Business justification: Withholding elections are entity-specific for multi-entity employers with different EINs. Required for accurate tax withholding and W-2 reporting in staffing operations with multiple legal entities em
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: onboarding_engagement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to onboarding.onboarding_engagement. Business justification: Tax withholding elections are collected during onboarding. Linking to onboarding engagement supports IRS compliance verification that W-4/state tax forms were obtained before first paycheck, required
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: profile_id
attributes.description: Reference to the worker (W-2 employee or 1099 independent contractor) whose tax withholding elections are captured in this record. Links to the candidate or worker master record.
attributes.references: TempWorks Payroll - Employee Master; IRS W-4 Instructions

attributes.name: superseded_by_election_tax_withholding_election_id
attributes.description: Reference to the newer tax_withholding_election record that replaced this one. Populated when election_status = 'superseded'. Enables forward-chaining of the election history for audit trails.
attributes.references: TempWorks Payroll - Tax Withholding Module; IRS Publication 15-T

attributes.name: work_authorization_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to credentialing.work_authorization. Business justification: Tax withholding setup requires work authorization verification to determine tax treaty eligibility, withholding method for visa holders, and FICA exemption status. Critical for international worker pa
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: worker_classification_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.worker_classification. Business justification: Tax withholding elections (W-4) are only applicable to W-2 employees, not independent contractors. Worker classification determines withholding eligibility and form type - misclassified workers trigge
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: additional_withholding_amount
attributes.description: Additional flat dollar amount the worker requests to be withheld from each paycheck beyond the calculated withholding. Entered in Step 4c of the 2020+ W-4 or the equivalent line on pre-2020 forms. Applied per pay period.
attributes.references: IRS W-4 Step 4c; IRS Publication 15-T; TempWorks Payroll

attributes.name: allowances_claimed
attributes.description: Number of withholding allowances claimed by the worker on pre-2020 W-4 forms. Each allowance reduces the amount of federal income tax withheld. Applicable only for W-4 forms prior to the 2020 redesign. Null for 2020+ W-4 forms which use the step-based approach.
attributes.references: IRS W-4 (Pre-2020); IRS Publication 15-T

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Username or employee ID of the payroll supervisor or manager who reviewed and approved this withholding election entry. Required for IRS lock-in letter overrides and exempt status elections as part of internal controls.
attributes.references: SOC 2 Type II; TempWorks Payroll Audit Trail; IRS Publication 15-T

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this withholding election record was first created in the payroll system. Supports audit trail, SOC 2 Type II compliance, and IRS record retention requirements for withholding forms.
attributes.references: SOC 2 Type II; IRS Publication 15-T Record Retention; TempWorks Payroll

attributes.name: deductions_amount
attributes.description: Dollar amount of itemized or other deductions entered in Step 4b of the 2020+ W-4. Reduces withholding by accounting for deductions that exceed the standard deduction. Null for pre-2020 W-4 forms.
attributes.references: IRS W-4 Step 4b (2020+); IRS Publication 15-T; IRS Schedule A

attributes.name: dependent_credit_amount
attributes.description: Dollar amount of qualifying dependent credits entered in Step 3 of the 2020+ redesigned W-4. Reduces the amount of income subject to withholding. Includes child tax credit ($2,000 per qualifying child under 17) and other dependent credits ($500 per other dependent). Null for pre-2020 W-4 forms.
attributes.references: IRS W-4 Step 3 (2020+); IRS Publication 972; IRS Publication 15-T

attributes.name: document_reference_code
attributes.description: Reference identifier for the physical or electronic withholding form document stored in the document management system (e.g., DocuSign CLM or SAP SuccessFactors document repository). Enables retrieval of the original signed form for audit and compliance verification.
attributes.references: DocuSign CLM; SAP SuccessFactors Onboarding; IRS Record Retention Requirements; FCRA

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date on which this withholding election becomes effective and begins driving tax withholding calculations in pay runs. Aligns with IRS requirement that new W-4 elections take effect no later than the start of the first payroll period ending on or after the 30th day after the form is received.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 15-T; IRS W-4 Instructions; TempWorks Payroll

attributes.name: election_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes entered by payroll staff regarding this withholding election. May include reasons for IRS lock-in overrides, documentation of verbal instructions, or notes on unusual withholding configurations.
attributes.references: TempWorks Payroll - Tax Withholding Module; SOC 2 Type II

attributes.name: election_number
attributes.description: Externally-visible business identifier for this withholding election record, used for audit trails, payroll processing references, and worker communications (e.g., TWE-2024-00123).
attributes.references: TempWorks Payroll - Tax Withholding Module; IRS Publication 15-T

attributes.name: election_source
attributes.description: The channel or method through which the withholding election was submitted. Paper form = physical W-4 or state form submitted; Electronic self-service = worker submitted via online portal (e.g., SAP SuccessFactors ESS); Employer default = system default applied when no form received; IRS lock-in = IRS-mandated withholding rate overriding worker election; Verbal instruction = documented verbal request.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 15-T; SAP SuccessFactors Onboarding; TempWorks Payroll; FCRA

attributes.name: election_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of this withholding election. Active = currently driving withholding calculations; Superseded = replaced by a newer election; Pending = submitted but not yet effective; Cancelled = voided before taking effect; Expired = past the expiration date.
attributes.references: TempWorks Payroll - Tax Withholding Module; IRS Publication 15-T

attributes.name: election_version
attributes.description: Sequential version number for withholding elections for the same worker and jurisdiction. Increments each time the worker submits a new withholding form. Enables tracking of election history and supersession chain for audit and compliance purposes.
attributes.references: TempWorks Payroll - Tax Withholding Module; IRS Publication 15-T Record Retention

attributes.name: entered_by
attributes.description: Username or employee ID of the payroll staff member or system process that entered this withholding election into TempWorks Payroll. Supports audit trail requirements for payroll compliance and SOC 2 Type II controls.
attributes.references: SOC 2 Type II; TempWorks Payroll Audit Trail; IRS Publication 15-T Record Retention

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date on which this withholding election expires and is no longer valid. Applicable for exempt-from-withholding elections which expire annually (February 15 of the following year per IRS rules), or for state-specific elections with defined validity periods.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 15-T; IRS W-4 Instructions; FLSA

attributes.name: filing_status
attributes.description: The worker's federal or state tax filing status as declared on the withholding form. Drives the applicable standard deduction and tax bracket used in withholding calculations. Values align with IRS filing status categories.
attributes.references: IRS W-4; IRS Publication 15-T; IRS Publication 501

attributes.name: flat_withholding_rate_pct
attributes.description: Fixed percentage rate applied to gross wages for income tax withholding when the withholding method is 'percentage' or 'flat_amount'. Expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.2200 = 22%). Used for supplemental wage withholding at the IRS flat supplemental rate or for state flat-rate withholding.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 15-T Supplemental Wage Withholding; TempWorks Payroll

attributes.name: form_type
attributes.description: The specific tax withholding form type submitted by the worker. Examples include W-4 (federal), W-4P (pension), state equivalents (e.g., CA DE-4, NY IT-2104, IL W-4, TX no state income tax). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: W-4|W-4P|W-4S|W-4V|DE-4|IT-2104|IL-W-4|VA-4|NC-4|GA-G-4 — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: IRS W-4; IRS Publication 15-T; State Revenue Agencies

attributes.name: irs_lock_in_allowances
attributes.description: The maximum number of withholding allowances permitted by the IRS lock-in letter, overriding the worker's own W-4 election. Employer must not allow the worker to claim more allowances than this value.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 15-T; IRS Lock-In Letter Program

attributes.name: irs_lock_in_filing_status
attributes.description: The filing status mandated by the IRS lock-in letter, overriding the worker's own W-4 election. Populated only when an IRS lock-in letter is in effect. Employer must use this status for withholding calculations.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 15-T; IRS Lock-In Letter Program

attributes.name: irs_lock_in_letter_date
attributes.description: Date of the IRS lock-in letter received by the employer mandating a specific withholding rate for this worker. When present, the employer must withhold at the IRS-specified rate regardless of the worker's W-4 elections. Null if no lock-in letter applies.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 15-T; IRS Lock-In Letter Program; IRS Notice 2017-67

attributes.name: is_exempt_from_withholding
attributes.description: Indicates whether the worker has claimed exemption from federal or state income tax withholding. True = worker claims exempt status and no income tax will be withheld. Exempt status expires February 15 each year and must be renewed. Employer must retain the exempt W-4 and notify IRS if required.
attributes.references: IRS W-4 Exempt Status; IRS Publication 15-T; IRS Notice 2018-92

attributes.name: is_state_exempt_from_withholding
attributes.description: Indicates whether the worker has claimed exemption from state income tax withholding on the state withholding form. Exempt criteria and renewal requirements vary by state.
attributes.references: State Revenue Agencies; TempWorks Payroll Multi-State Payroll

attributes.name: jurisdiction_type
attributes.description: Indicates whether this election applies to federal, state, or local tax withholding. Federal elections are governed by IRS W-4; state elections by equivalent state withholding forms; local elections by municipality-specific forms.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 15-T; U.S. Department of Labor (DOL); FLSA

attributes.name: locality_name
attributes.description: Name of the local taxing jurisdiction (city, county, or municipality) for local income tax withholding elections. Applicable in states with local income taxes such as Ohio, Pennsylvania, Kentucky, and New York City.
attributes.references: TempWorks Payroll Multi-State Payroll; U.S. Department of Labor (DOL)

attributes.name: multiple_jobs_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the worker checked the Step 2 multiple jobs checkbox on the 2020+ W-4, signaling they hold multiple concurrent jobs or their spouse also works. When true, withholding is calculated using the higher withholding rate tables to prevent under-withholding.
attributes.references: IRS W-4 Step 2 (2020+); IRS Publication 15-T

attributes.name: nonresident_alien_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the worker is a nonresident alien (NRA) for U.S. tax purposes. NRA workers are subject to special withholding rules under IRS Publication 15 and must follow specific W-4 instructions (cannot claim exempt, must add an additional amount to wages for withholding calculation). Relevant for staffing firms placing international workers.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 15; IRS Publication 515; Immigration and Nationality Act (INA); IRS W-4 NRA Instructions

attributes.name: other_income_amount
attributes.description: Dollar amount of other non-wage income (interest, dividends, retirement income) entered in Step 4a of the 2020+ W-4. Increases withholding to cover tax on non-wage income. Null for pre-2020 W-4 forms.
attributes.references: IRS W-4 Step 4a (2020+); IRS Publication 15-T

attributes.name: pay_frequency
attributes.description: The pay frequency associated with this withholding election, used to annualize wages for withholding table lookups. Must match the worker's actual pay frequency in the pay run. Drives the correct withholding amount per period.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 15-T; TempWorks Payroll Pay Frequency Configuration

attributes.name: received_date
attributes.description: Date the withholding election form was received by the employer or payroll department. Used to determine the required effective date per IRS rules (must take effect no later than the first payroll period ending on or after the 30th day after receipt).
attributes.references: IRS Publication 15-T; IRS W-4 Instructions

attributes.name: state_additional_withholding_amount
attributes.description: Additional flat dollar amount the worker requests to be withheld for state income tax beyond the calculated state withholding. Applied per pay period in addition to the standard state withholding calculation.
attributes.references: State Revenue Agencies; TempWorks Payroll Multi-State Payroll

attributes.name: state_allowances_claimed
attributes.description: Number of withholding allowances claimed on the state withholding form. Many states still use an allowance-based system independent of the federal W-4 redesign (e.g., California DE-4, New York IT-2104). Null for states with no income tax or states that have adopted the federal W-4.
attributes.references: State Revenue Agencies; TempWorks Payroll Multi-State Payroll

attributes.name: state_code
attributes.description: Two-letter USPS state abbreviation identifying the state jurisdiction for state or local withholding elections. Null for federal elections. Supports multi-state payroll compliance across all states where Staffing Hr places workers.
attributes.references: USPS State Abbreviations; SUTA (State Unemployment Tax Act); TempWorks Payroll Multi-State Payroll

attributes.name: state_filing_status
attributes.description: The worker's filing status as declared on the state withholding form, which may differ from the federal filing status. State-specific values vary by jurisdiction (e.g., California uses single, married, head of household with different withholding tables). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: single|married|married_higher_rate|head_of_household|exempt — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: State Revenue Agencies; TempWorks Payroll Multi-State Payroll; SUTA

attributes.name: supplemental_wage_method
attributes.description: Method used to withhold income tax on supplemental wages (bonuses, commissions, overtime, per diem above IRS threshold). Flat rate = mandatory 22% federal flat rate for supplemental wages under $1M; Aggregate = combined with regular wages using withholding tables; Optional flat = employer elects flat rate when not mandatory.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 15-T Supplemental Wages; IRS Revenue Ruling 2008-29

attributes.name: treaty_country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the country with which the worker claims a U.S. tax treaty benefit, potentially reducing or eliminating withholding on certain income types. Applicable for nonresident alien workers claiming treaty exemptions via Form 8233 or W-8BEN.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 515; IRS Form 8233; IRS Form W-8BEN; U.S. Tax Treaties

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this withholding election record was last modified. Tracks changes to election data for audit trail and data lineage purposes in the Databricks Silver Layer.
attributes.references: SOC 2 Type II; TempWorks Payroll Audit Trail; GDPR Article 5 (Data Integrity)

attributes.name: w4_form_version_year
attributes.description: The tax year version of the W-4 or equivalent withholding form submitted by the worker. Critical because the 2020 redesigned W-4 eliminated allowances and introduced a new step-based structure. Pre-2020 forms use allowances; 2020+ forms use Step 3 dependent credits and Step 4 adjustments.
attributes.references: IRS W-4 (2020 Redesign); IRS Publication 15-T

attributes.name: withholding_method
attributes.description: The calculation method used to compute income tax withholding for this worker. Percentage method uses IRS Publication 15-T tables; Wage bracket method uses bracket tables; Flat amount applies a fixed dollar amount; Annualized projects annual income for withholding; Cumulative adjusts for year-to-date withholding.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 15-T Withholding Methods; TempWorks Payroll

attributes.name: worker_type
attributes.description: Classification of the worker for tax withholding purposes. W-2 = employee subject to income tax withholding and FICA; 1099 = independent contractor (IC) not subject to employer withholding; EOR = Employer of Record arrangement where the EOR entity handles withholding. Drives whether withholding elections are applicable.
attributes.references: IRS Worker Classification Rules; IRS Publication 15; IRS Form 1099; W-2 (Wage and Tax Statement); 1099 (Independent Contractor Tax Form); EOR (Employer of Record)

products.name: eor_arrangement

Supports complex multi-entity payroll structures.

Staffing_hr = Staffing Hr sponsors; client = client sponsors; shared = joint sponsorship; none = no benefits provided.

attributes.name: benefits_eligibility_waiting_days

attributes.name: eeoc_reporting_responsibility

products.name: arrangement_compliance_requirement
products.description: This association product represents the compliance obligation assignment between EOR arrangements and regulatory/contractual compliance requirements. It captures which party (Staffing Hr as EOR vs. client as co-employer) is responsible for satisfying each compliance requirement within the context of a specific EOR arrangement, along with compliance status tracking, audit schedules, and effective dates. Each record links one EOR arrangement to one compliance requirement with responsibility allocation and compliance monitoring attributes that exist only in the context of this relationship.. Existence Justification: In staffing EOR operations, each EOR arrangement must satisfy multiple compliance requirements (I-9, E-Verify, EEOC reporting, OFCCP requirements, state-specific mandates, client-specific contractual requirements), and each compliance requirement applies to many EOR arrangements across different clients and worker populations. The business actively manages compliance obligation assignments, tracking which party (Staffing Hr as EOR vs. client as co-employer) is responsible for each requirement within each arrangement context, along with compliance status, audit schedules, and documentation. This is an operational compliance management process, not an analytical correlation.

products.name: pay_stub_compliance_validation
products.description: This association product represents the validation event between pay_stub and compliance_requirement. It captures the compliance verification status for each pay stub against each applicable federal and client-specific requirement. Each record links one pay stub to one compliance requirement with validation outcome, timestamp, method, and exception handling attributes that exist only in the context of this compliance check.. Existence Justification: In staffing operations, each pay stub must be validated against multiple compliance requirements (I-9 verification, wage/hour rules, tax withholding regulations, client-specific mandates), and each compliance requirement applies to many pay stubs across workers and pay periods. The compliance team actively manages validation records for audit defense, tracking which requirements were met, validation methods used, and exceptions granted for specific pay stub-requirement combinations.

attributes.name: pay_stub_compliance_validation_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated identifier for each compliance validation record. Primary key.

attributes.name: pay_stub_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Pay Stub Compliance Validation - Pay Stub Id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the pay stub being validated for compliance
attributes.references: Internal - M:N Association FK

attributes.name: requirement_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Pay Stub Compliance Validation - Compliance Requirement Id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the compliance requirement being validated against
attributes.references: Internal - M:N Association FK

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this validation record was first created in the compliance system.

attributes.name: exception_approved_by
attributes.description: User ID or name of the compliance officer who approved the exception for this validation. Null if no exception granted.

attributes.name: exception_expiration_date
attributes.description: Date on which the granted exception expires and the requirement must be re-validated. Null if no exception or exception is permanent.

attributes.name: exception_granted
attributes.description: Indicates whether a compliance exception was granted for this specific pay stub-requirement combination. True if exception approved, False otherwise.

attributes.name: exception_reason
attributes.description: Narrative explanation for why a compliance exception was granted for this validation. Null if no exception granted.

attributes.name: requirement_met_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether this specific compliance requirement was satisfied for this pay stub. True = compliant, False = non-compliant or pending.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this validation record, supporting audit trail requirements.

attributes.name: validation_method
attributes.description: Method by which the compliance requirement was validated for this pay stub. Automated system check, manual compliance team review, third-party verification service, or client attestation.

attributes.name: validation_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes from the compliance team regarding this specific validation, including findings, remediation steps, or audit references.

attributes.name: validation_timestamp

products.name: pto_policy
products.description: Master reference table for pto_policy. Referenced by policy_id.

attributes.name: pto_policy_id
attributes.description: Primary key for pto_policy

attributes.name: accrual_frequency
attributes.description: Frequency at which PTO hours are accrued under this policy. Not applicable for lump sum or unlimited policies.

attributes.name: accrual_rate
attributes.description: Rate at which PTO hours are earned per accrual period (e.g., 3.33 hours per pay period, 0.0385 hours per hour worked). Null for non-accrual policies.

attributes.name: accrual_start_event
attributes.description: Event that triggers the start of PTO accrual for an employee under this policy.

attributes.name: accrual_unit
attributes.description: Unit of measure for PTO accrual and balance tracking (hours or days).

attributes.name: advance_notice_required_days
attributes.description: Minimum number of days advance notice required for employees to request PTO usage. Zero if no advance notice required.

attributes.name: annual_allocation_amount
attributes.description: Total PTO amount granted per year for lump sum policies, or maximum accrual cap for accrual policies. Expressed in accrual units.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date when this PTO policy was officially approved for implementation.

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the HR executive or authority who approved this PTO policy.

attributes.name: blackout_periods_defined
attributes.description: Indicates whether this policy includes defined blackout periods during which PTO usage is restricted or prohibited.

attributes.name: carryover_allowed
attributes.description: Indicates whether unused PTO can be carried over to the next accrual period or calendar year.

attributes.name: carryover_maximum
attributes.description: Maximum amount of PTO that can be carried over to the next period if carryover is allowed. Null if no carryover or unlimited carryover.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this PTO policy record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date when the PTO policy ceases to be active. Null for open-ended policies.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date when the PTO policy becomes active and begins applying to eligible employees.

attributes.name: eligibility_criteria
attributes.description: Text description of employee eligibility requirements for this PTO policy (e.g., 'Full-time employees working 30+ hours per week', 'All W-2 employees after 90-day probation').

attributes.name: employment_type
attributes.description: Employment classification eligible for this PTO policy.

attributes.name: last_review_date
attributes.description: Date when this PTO policy was last reviewed for compliance and accuracy.

attributes.name: maximum_balance
attributes.description: Maximum PTO balance an employee can accumulate under this policy. Null for unlimited policies.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this PTO policy record was last modified in the system.

attributes.name: negative_balance_allowed
attributes.description: Indicates whether employees can use PTO before it is fully accrued, resulting in a negative balance.

attributes.name: negative_balance_limit
attributes.description: Maximum negative PTO balance allowed if negative balances are permitted. Expressed as a positive number representing the maximum deficit.

attributes.name: next_review_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next policy review to ensure ongoing compliance with labor laws and business needs.

attributes.name: payout_maximum
attributes.description: Maximum PTO balance that will be paid out on termination if payout is allowed. Null if full balance is paid or no payout.

attributes.name: payout_on_termination
attributes.description: Indicates whether unused PTO balance is paid out to the employee upon termination of employment.

attributes.name: policy_code
attributes.description: Externally-known unique business identifier for the PTO policy used in payroll processing and employee communications.

attributes.name: policy_description
attributes.description: Detailed text description of the PTO policy terms, conditions, and special provisions.

attributes.name: policy_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the PTO policy (e.g., 'Standard Full-Time PTO', 'Part-Time Accrual Plan').

attributes.name: policy_type
attributes.description: Classification of the PTO policy structure: accrual-based (earned over time), lump sum (granted upfront), unlimited (no cap), or hybrid (combination).

attributes.name: policy_version
attributes.description: Version number of the policy document for change tracking and compliance audit purposes (e.g., '1.0', '2.3').

attributes.name: proration_method
attributes.description: Method used to prorate PTO allocation for employees hired mid-period: none (no proration), hire_date (prorated from hire date), calendar_year (prorated within calendar year), anniversary_year (prorated within employment anniversary year).

attributes.name: state_jurisdiction
attributes.description: Two-letter US state code for which this PTO policy is designed to comply with state-specific labor laws. Null for policies that apply across all states.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the PTO policy. Active policies are in use; inactive policies are suspended; draft policies are under review; archived policies are historical.

attributes.name: usage_increment
attributes.description: Minimum increment in which PTO can be used (e.g., 0.25 for quarter-hour increments, 1.0 for full-hour increments, 8.0 for full-day increments).

attributes.name: waiting_period_days
attributes.description: Number of days an employee must wait after hire date before PTO accrual begins or before they can use accrued PTO. Zero if no waiting period.

attributes.name: worker_classification
attributes.description: Worker tax classification eligible for this PTO policy. W-2 employees typically receive PTO; 1099 contractors typically do not.

attributes.name: superseded_pto_policy_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on pto_policy (superseded_pto_policy_id)

domains.name: billing
domains.description: SSOT for all revenue and financial transaction data. Owns client invoice generation, bill rates, spread calculations (bill rate minus pay rate), markup calculations, gross margin tracking, payment terms, accounts receivable, payment processing, collections, credit memos, and dispute management sourced from Salesforce Revenue Cloud and Oracle NetSuite ERP. Supports various billing models including hourly time-and-materials, per-diem, project-based, SOW-based, and direct placement fee billing.

products.name: invoice
products.description: Core billing document issued to a client for staffing services rendered during a billing period. Captures invoice number, date, due date, billing period, total amount, tax amount, net amount, payment terms, status (draft, sent, paid, partially paid, disputed, void), billing model (time-and-materials, per-diem, project-based, SOW-based, direct placement fee), currency, PO number, and client billing account reference. SSOT for all client-facing billing documents across all staffing engagement types. Supports void-and-rebill workflows for retroactive billing corrections.

Invoice references campaign for cost recovery, ROI analysis, and campaign budget reconciliation. Real business need in managed pr

attributes.name: amount_paid
attributes.description: Total amount received from the client against this invoice to date. May be less than net_amount for partially paid invoices. Used to calculate the outstanding balance and drive collections workflows.
attributes.references: Salesforce Revenue Cloud; Oracle NetSuite ERP; GAAP ASC 310

attributes.name: bill_rate
attributes.description: The hourly or daily rate charged to the client for the staffing services on this invoice. For time-and-materials billing, this is the agreed bill rate per hour. For per-diem billing, this is the daily rate. Core input for spread and gross margin calculations. Sourced from the client rate card or VMS rate schedule.
attributes.references: Beeline VMS; Salesforce Revenue Cloud; Bullhorn ATS/CRM; ASA Rate Standards; DOL FLSA

attributes.name: billing_model
attributes.description: Classification of the billing methodology used for this invoice. Determines how line items are calculated and how revenue is recognized. 'time_and_materials' = hourly bill rate x hours worked; 'per_diem' = daily flat rate; 'project_based' = milestone or deliverable-based; 'sow_based' = Statement of Work (SOW) fixed-fee; 'direct_placement_fee' = one-time permanent placement fee.
attributes.references: Salesforce Revenue Cloud; ASA Billing Standards; GAAP ASC 606; SIA Industry Standards

attributes.name: billing_period_end
attributes.description: The last date of the service period covered by this invoice. Together with billing_period_start, defines the billing window for which staffing services are being charged.
attributes.references: Salesforce Revenue Cloud; Kronos Workforce Ready; GAAP ASC 606; DOL FLSA

attributes.name: billing_period_start
attributes.description: The first date of the service period covered by this invoice. For time-and-materials invoices, this is the start of the timesheet week or pay period. Used for revenue recognition period alignment and client billing reconciliation.
attributes.references: Salesforce Revenue Cloud; Kronos Workforce Ready; GAAP ASC 606; DOL FLSA

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time this invoice record was first created in the billing system. Audit trail field capturing when the invoice was generated, whether in draft or final form. Sourced from Salesforce Revenue Cloud system timestamp.
attributes.references: Salesforce Revenue Cloud; Oracle NetSuite ERP; SOC 2 Type II; GDPR Article 5; CCPA

attributes.name: credit_memo_number
attributes.description: Reference number of the credit memo issued against this invoice, if applicable. Populated when a credit adjustment is applied to resolve a dispute, correct a billing error, or process a void-and-rebill. Links to the corresponding credit memo record in Oracle NetSuite ERP.
attributes.references: Oracle NetSuite ERP; Salesforce Revenue Cloud; GAAP ASC 606

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for all monetary amounts on this invoice (e.g., USD, CAD, GBP). Supports multi-currency billing for international staffing engagements. Defaults to USD for domestic US operations.
attributes.references: ISO 4217; Salesforce Revenue Cloud; Oracle NetSuite ERP; GAAP ASC 830

attributes.name: delivery_method
attributes.description: The channel through which this invoice was or will be delivered to the client. Determines the transmission workflow in Salesforce Revenue Cloud. VMS portal delivery is required for clients using Beeline or similar VMS platforms.
attributes.references: Salesforce Revenue Cloud; Beeline VMS; ASA Billing Standards

attributes.name: discount_amount
attributes.description: Total discount or credit applied to the invoice, such as volume discounts, contractual rate adjustments, or promotional credits negotiated in the Master Service Agreement (MSA). Reduces the net amount payable.
attributes.references: Salesforce Revenue Cloud; Oracle NetSuite ERP; DocuSign CLM MSA Terms

attributes.name: dispute_reason
attributes.description: Description of the reason provided by the client for disputing this invoice. Populated when status is 'disputed'. Common reasons include rate discrepancies, unauthorized hours, missing PO number, or timesheet approval issues. Used for dispute resolution tracking and root cause analysis.
attributes.references: Salesforce Revenue Cloud; ASA Billing Standards; SIA Industry Standards

attributes.name: due_date
attributes.description: The date by which full payment is expected from the client, calculated from invoice_date plus the agreed payment terms (e.g., Net 30, Net 45). Drives accounts receivable aging buckets and collections escalation workflows.
attributes.references: Salesforce Revenue Cloud; Oracle NetSuite ERP; ASA Billing Standards; GAAP ASC 310

attributes.name: gross_amount
attributes.description: Total pre-tax, pre-discount invoice amount representing the sum of all billable charges before adjustments. Calculated as the sum of all line item bill rate charges for the billing period. Core component of the monetary triplet for revenue reporting.
attributes.references: Salesforce Revenue Cloud; Oracle NetSuite ERP; GAAP ASC 606; ASA Billing Standards

attributes.name: invoice_date
attributes.description: The date the invoice was formally issued to the client. Represents the principal business event timestamp for the invoice. Used as the basis for payment due date calculation and revenue recognition period assignment.
attributes.references: Salesforce Revenue Cloud; Oracle NetSuite ERP; GAAP ASC 606; IRS Publication 538

attributes.name: invoice_number
attributes.description: Externally-visible, human-readable invoice identifier issued to the client. Unique across all billing periods and client accounts. Used on client-facing documents and referenced in payment remittances. Sourced from Salesforce Revenue Cloud invoice numbering sequence.
attributes.references: Salesforce Revenue Cloud; Oracle NetSuite ERP; ASA Billing Standards

attributes.name: invoice_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the invoice. Drives accounts receivable workflows, collections actions, and revenue recognition. 'draft' = not yet issued; 'sent' = delivered to client; 'paid' = fully settled; 'partially_paid' = partial payment received; 'disputed' = client has raised a dispute; 'void' = cancelled, typically triggering a rebill.
attributes.references: Salesforce Revenue Cloud; Oracle NetSuite ERP; ASA Billing Standards; GAAP Revenue Recognition (ASC 606)

attributes.name: is_void
attributes.description: Indicates whether this invoice has been voided. True when the invoice has been cancelled and is no longer collectible. Voided invoices are retained for audit trail purposes and typically trigger a replacement invoice in void-and-rebill workflows.
attributes.references: Oracle NetSuite ERP; Salesforce Revenue Cloud; GAAP ASC 606; SOC 2 Type II

attributes.name: markup_percentage
attributes.description: The percentage markup applied over the pay rate to arrive at the bill rate, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.45 = 45%). Calculated as (bill_rate - pay_rate) / pay_rate. A standard staffing industry profitability metric used in client pricing negotiations and margin analysis.
attributes.references: Salesforce Revenue Cloud; SIA Financial Metrics; ASA Billing Standards; Power BI Analytics Platform

attributes.name: net_amount
attributes.description: Final amount due from the client after applying taxes and discounts. Calculated as gross_amount + tax_amount - discount_amount. This is the amount the client is expected to remit. Core component of the monetary triplet.
attributes.references: Salesforce Revenue Cloud; Oracle NetSuite ERP; GAAP ASC 606; ASA Billing Standards

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or special billing instructions associated with this invoice. May include client-specific billing requirements, dispute resolution comments, or internal processing notes. Not transmitted to the client unless explicitly included in the invoice document.
attributes.references: Salesforce Revenue Cloud; ASA Billing Standards

attributes.name: outstanding_balance
attributes.description: Remaining unpaid amount on the invoice, calculated as net_amount minus amount_paid. Drives accounts receivable aging reports and collections prioritization. Zero when invoice is fully paid.
attributes.references: Salesforce Revenue Cloud; Oracle NetSuite ERP; GAAP ASC 310; ASA Billing Standards

attributes.name: overtime_hours_billed
attributes.description: Number of overtime (OT) hours included in the total hours billed on this invoice. Overtime hours are billed at a premium rate per FLSA regulations (typically 1.5x the regular bill rate). Tracked separately for compliance reporting and client billing transparency.
attributes.references: Kronos Workforce Ready; Salesforce Revenue Cloud; DOL FLSA; ASA Billing Standards

attributes.name: paid_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time full payment was received and confirmed for this invoice. Populated when status transitions to 'paid'. Used for Days Sales Outstanding (DSO) calculation, cash flow reporting, and accounts receivable closure.
attributes.references: Salesforce Revenue Cloud; Oracle NetSuite ERP; GAAP ASC 310

attributes.name: pay_rate
attributes.description: The hourly or daily rate paid to the temporary worker for the services billed on this invoice. Used in conjunction with bill_rate to calculate the spread (bill rate minus pay rate) and gross margin. Sourced from TempWorks Payroll and the candidate pay rate agreement.
attributes.references: TempWorks Payroll; Bullhorn ATS/CRM; DOL FLSA; FICA; FUTA; SUTA

attributes.name: payment_terms
attributes.description: Contractual payment terms agreed with the client, defining the number of days from invoice date within which payment is due. Sourced from the client's Master Service Agreement (MSA). Drives due_date calculation and accounts receivable aging classification.
attributes.references: Salesforce Revenue Cloud; Oracle NetSuite ERP; DocuSign CLM MSA Terms; ASA Billing Standards

attributes.name: po_number
attributes.description: Client-issued Purchase Order (PO) number that authorizes the staffing services billed on this invoice. Required by many enterprise clients and Vendor Management System (VMS) programs for invoice approval and payment processing. Must match the PO number in the client's procurement system.
attributes.references: Beeline VMS; Salesforce Revenue Cloud; Oracle NetSuite ERP; ASA Billing Standards

attributes.name: revenue_recognition_date
attributes.description: The date on which revenue from this invoice is recognized in the general ledger per GAAP ASC 606 revenue recognition standards. May differ from invoice_date for milestone-based or deferred revenue scenarios. Critical for accurate financial period reporting.
attributes.references: Oracle NetSuite ERP; GAAP ASC 606; Salesforce Revenue Cloud

attributes.name: sent_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time the invoice was transmitted to the client via email, VMS portal, or EDI. Marks the transition from 'draft' to 'sent' status. Used for SLA measurement of billing cycle time and for dispute resolution (proof of delivery).
attributes.references: Salesforce Revenue Cloud; ASA Billing Standards; SLA Measurement

attributes.name: sow_number

attributes.references: DocuSign CLM; Salesforce Revenue Cloud; Beeline VMS; ASA SOW Standards

attributes.name: spread_amount
attributes.description: The difference between the bill rate and the pay rate (bill_rate minus pay_rate), representing the gross margin per unit before burden costs. A key profitability metric in staffing known as the 'Spread'. Stored at the invoice level for aggregate reporting; detailed spread is tracked at the line item level.
attributes.references: Salesforce Revenue Cloud; SIA Financial Metrics; ASA Billing Standards; Power BI Analytics Platform

attributes.name: tax_amount
attributes.description: Total tax charges applied to the invoice, including applicable state and local taxes on staffing services. Varies by jurisdiction and service type. Some staffing services may be tax-exempt depending on client tax status and state regulations.
attributes.references: Salesforce Revenue Cloud; Oracle NetSuite ERP; IRS Tax Code; State Tax Authorities; GAAP ASC 740

attributes.name: total_hours_billed

attributes.references: Kronos Workforce Ready; Salesforce Revenue Cloud; DOL FLSA; ASA Billing Standards

attributes.name: updated_timestamp

attributes.name: vms_invoice_number
