attributes.name: expense_type
attributes.description: Classification of the expense category incurred by the worker or staffing operation. Drives billing rules, markup applicability, and GL account mapping. Standard types include Per Diem (daily allowance), travel, lodging, mileage reimbursement, equipment, and training costs. Satisfies CLASSIFICATION_OR_TYPE category for TRANSACTION_HEADER role. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: per_diem|travel|lodging|mileage|equipment|training|meals|parking|communication|relocation — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: IRS Publication 463 (Travel, Gift, and Car Expenses); ASA Expense Guidelines; Oracle NetSuite ERP

attributes.name: is_billable
attributes.description: Indicates whether this expense charge is eligible to be passed through and billed to the client. Non-billable expenses are absorbed by the staffing firm and excluded from client invoices. Critical for revenue recognition and invoice generation logic.
attributes.references: Salesforce Revenue Cloud; GAAP ASC 606; ASA Billing Standards

attributes.name: is_reimbursable
attributes.description: Indicates whether the worker is entitled to reimbursement for this expense from the staffing firm, independent of whether it is billed to the client. Drives payroll reimbursement processing in TempWorks Payroll.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 463; TempWorks Payroll; FLSA

attributes.name: markup_amount
attributes.description: The calculated dollar value of the markup applied to the base expense amount (expense_amount × markup_percentage / 100). Stored as a discrete field for audit and invoice line transparency. Part of the MONETARY_TRIPLET adjustment component.
attributes.references: ASA Billing Standards; Oracle NetSuite ERP; GAAP ASC 606

attributes.name: markup_percentage
attributes.description: The percentage applied on top of the base expense amount to calculate the billable amount charged to the client. Represents the staffing firm's margin on pass-through expenses. Part of the MONETARY_TRIPLET adjustment component.
attributes.references: ASA Billing Standards; Salesforce Revenue Cloud; Oracle NetSuite ERP

attributes.name: mileage_rate
attributes.description: The per-mile or per-kilometer reimbursement rate applied to mileage expense charges. May reflect the IRS standard mileage rate or a client-negotiated rate. Used to validate that expense_amount equals mileage_units × mileage_rate.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 463; IRS Standard Mileage Rate; ASA

attributes.name: mileage_units
attributes.description: Number of miles or kilometers driven for mileage-type expense charges. Used to calculate reimbursement at the applicable IRS standard mileage rate or client-negotiated rate. Applicable only when expense_type is 'mileage'.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 463; IRS Standard Mileage Rate; DOL

attributes.name: per_diem_rate
attributes.description: The daily allowance rate applied for per diem expense charges, representing the authorized daily amount for meals, incidentals, or lodging. May reflect GSA federal per diem rates or client-negotiated rates. Applicable when expense_type is 'per_diem'.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 463; GSA Per Diem Rates; DOL; ASA

attributes.name: receipt_date
attributes.description: The date shown on the supporting receipt or expense documentation. May differ from expense_date in cases of delayed submission. Used for IRS substantiation compliance and audit purposes.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 463; SOC 2 Type II

attributes.name: receipt_reference
attributes.description: Document reference number or identifier for the supporting receipt or proof of expense. Used for audit trail, FCRA-compliant recordkeeping, and expense dispute resolution. May reference a document stored in DocuSign CLM or an external document management system.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 463; SOC 2 Type II; DocuSign CLM; GAAP

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: The operational system of record from which this expense charge record originated. Supports data lineage, reconciliation, and audit trail requirements across the billing domain's multi-system architecture.
attributes.references: SOC 2 Type II; Oracle NetSuite ERP; Salesforce Revenue Cloud

attributes.name: submitted_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the expense charge was submitted for approval by the worker or staffing coordinator. Used for aging analysis, SLA tracking, and expense cycle time reporting.
attributes.references: Salesforce Revenue Cloud; Kronos Workforce Ready; ASA

attributes.name: tax_amount
attributes.description: The calculated tax amount applied to the billable expense charge based on the applicable tax code and jurisdiction. Included on client invoices where tax applies. Supports tax remittance and compliance reporting.
attributes.references: IRS; Oracle NetSuite ERP; GAAP; DOL

attributes.name: tax_code
attributes.description: Tax jurisdiction or tax treatment code applicable to this expense charge. Determines whether sales tax, VAT, or GST applies to the billable amount based on client location and expense type. Used for tax compliance reporting.
attributes.references: IRS; Oracle NetSuite ERP; GAAP; CCPA; GDPR

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this expense charge record was last modified. Satisfies RECORD_AUDIT_UPDATED category for TRANSACTION_HEADER role. Used for change tracking, data lineage, and Silver layer incremental processing in Databricks.
attributes.references: SOC 2 Type II; GDPR Article 5; Oracle NetSuite ERP

attributes.name: vendor_name
attributes.description: Name of the external vendor or supplier from whom the expense was incurred (e.g., hotel chain, airline, equipment supplier). Used for vendor spend analysis, preferred vendor compliance, and accounts payable matching in Oracle NetSuite ERP.
attributes.references: Oracle NetSuite ERP; Beeline VMS; ASA

attributes.name: worker_name
attributes.description: Full name of the worker (temporary employee, contractor, or W-2 employee) who incurred the expense. Retained on the expense record for audit trail and dispute resolution purposes. Classified as restricted PII per GDPR, CCPA, and FCRA.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; CCPA; FCRA; IRS W-2 Reporting

products.name: sow_billing_milestone
products.description: Transactional record tracking billing milestones for Statement of Work (SOW) engagements. Captures milestone name, milestone number, SOW reference, milestone type (deliverable, phase completion, time-based, percent-complete), scheduled billing date, actual billing date, milestone amount, completion percentage, approval status, approver, invoice reference, and milestone status (pending, approved, invoiced, disputed). Enables project-based and SOW billing models distinct from time-and-materials hourly billing.

attributes.name: sow_billing_milestone_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Statement of Work (SOW) Billing Milestone ID
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each SOW billing milestone record in the Staffing Hr billing domain. Primary key for this transactional entity. Entity role: TRANSACTION_HEADER — represents a discrete billing event within a SOW engagement lifecycle.
attributes.references: Oracle NetSuite ERP; Salesforce Revenue Cloud

attributes.name: accounting_period_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.accounting_period. Business justification: Milestones recognized in specific periods for project-based revenue recognition and financial reporting.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: client_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the client account being billed for this SOW milestone. Serves as the PARTY_REFERENCE for this transaction, linking the billing event to the client in the CRM. Sourced from Salesforce Revenue Cloud and Bullhorn CRM.
attributes.references: Bullhorn ATS/CRM; Salesforce Revenue Cloud

attributes.name: gl_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.gl_account. Business justification: SOW milestones recognize revenue to specific GL accounts. Required for project-based revenue recognition and financial reporting.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: invoice_id
attributes.description: Reference to the invoice record generated for this milestone once it has been approved and invoiced. Null until the milestone reaches invoiced status.
attributes.references: Salesforce Revenue Cloud; Oracle NetSuite ERP

attributes.name: sow_engagement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to placement.sow_engagement. Business justification: SOW engagements are billed via milestones (deliverable-based or phase-based billing). Milestone billing links to specific SOW placements for revenue recognition and project billing. Essential for SOW
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: sow_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent Statement of Work (SOW) engagement under which this billing milestone is defined. Links the milestone to its governing SOW contract.
attributes.references: DocuSign CLM; Salesforce Revenue Cloud

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to vendor.supplier. Business justification: SOW-based project billing often involves vendor-supplied project teams; tracking supplier enables milestone-based vendor payment coordination, project margin analysis by supplier, vendor performance e
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: actual_billing_date
attributes.description: Date on which the invoice for this milestone was actually generated and sent to the client. Compared against scheduled_billing_date to measure billing timeliness and SLA adherence. Serves as the BUSINESS_EVENT_TIMESTAMP (date precision) for this transaction.
attributes.references: Salesforce Revenue Cloud; Oracle NetSuite ERP

attributes.name: adjusted_amount
attributes.description: Revised billing amount after any approved adjustments, credits, or change orders applied to the original milestone amount. Reflects the net billable value after modifications. Part of the MONETARY_TRIPLET adjustment component.
attributes.references: Salesforce Revenue Cloud; Oracle NetSuite ERP

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date on which the milestone completion was formally approved by the designated approver, authorizing invoice generation. Distinct from completion_date as approval may follow completion after a review period.
attributes.references: Salesforce Revenue Cloud; DocuSign CLM; SOC 2 Type II

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Current state of the internal and/or client approval workflow for this milestone. Distinct from milestone_status as it tracks the approval sub-process specifically. Values: pending_review, approved, rejected, escalated.
attributes.references: Salesforce Revenue Cloud; SOC 2 Type II; DocuSign CLM

attributes.name: approver_email
attributes.description: Email address of the designated approver for this milestone. Used for approval workflow notifications and audit trail. Classified as confidential PII as it identifies a specific individual.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; CCPA; SOC 2 Type II

attributes.name: approver_name
attributes.description: Full name of the individual (internal manager or client contact) who approved or is designated to approve this milestone. Retained for audit trail and dispute resolution purposes.
attributes.references: SOC 2 Type II; Salesforce Revenue Cloud

attributes.name: billing_model
attributes.description: Billing model applied to this milestone, indicating how charges are structured within the SOW. Supports fixed-fee, time-and-materials, per-diem, and milestone-based billing variants.
attributes.references: Salesforce Revenue Cloud; ASA; SIA

attributes.name: client_approver_name
attributes.description: Name of the client-side contact who provided formal acceptance or approval of the milestone deliverable. Required for SOW engagements where client sign-off is a billing prerequisite.
attributes.references: DocuSign CLM; Salesforce Revenue Cloud; MSA Terms

attributes.name: completion_date
attributes.description: Date on which the deliverable or work associated with this milestone was confirmed as complete by the delivery team. Triggers the approval and billing workflow.
attributes.references: Salesforce Revenue Cloud; DocuSign CLM

attributes.name: completion_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of work completed for this milestone at the time of last update, expressed as a value between 0.00 and 100.00. Used for percent-complete milestone types and progress reporting to clients and project managers.
attributes.references: Salesforce Revenue Cloud; ASA

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this SOW billing milestone record was first created in the system. Serves as the RECORD_AUDIT_CREATED field for audit trail and data lineage purposes. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: SOC 2 Type II; GDPR Article 5; Oracle NetSuite ERP

attributes.name: credit_memo_amount
attributes.description: Dollar value of any credit memo issued against this milestone invoice, representing adjustments, concessions, or dispute resolutions. Negative value reduces the net receivable for this milestone.
attributes.references: Oracle NetSuite ERP; Salesforce Revenue Cloud; GAAP

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for all monetary amounts on this milestone record (e.g., USD, CAD, GBP). Supports multi-currency SOW engagements for international staffing clients. Part of the MONETARY_TRIPLET currency component.
attributes.references: ISO 4217; Oracle NetSuite ERP

attributes.name: dispute_date
attributes.description: Date on which the billing dispute for this milestone was formally raised. Used to track dispute aging and SLA compliance for dispute resolution.
attributes.references: Salesforce Revenue Cloud; Oracle NetSuite ERP; ASA

attributes.name: dispute_reason
attributes.description: Free-text description of the reason provided by the client or internal team when a milestone billing is placed in disputed status. Populated only when milestone_status is 'disputed'. Supports dispute resolution and collections workflows.
attributes.references: Salesforce Revenue Cloud; Oracle NetSuite ERP

attributes.name: due_date
attributes.description: Contractual deadline by which the milestone deliverable must be completed per the SOW terms. Used for project tracking, SLA measurement, and identifying at-risk milestones.
attributes.references: DocuSign CLM; ASA; SLA Management

attributes.name: internal_notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for internal billing team notes regarding this milestone, such as special handling instructions, escalation context, or coordination notes. Not included on client-facing invoices.
attributes.references: Salesforce Revenue Cloud

attributes.name: invoiced_amount
attributes.description: Actual amount included on the invoice generated for this milestone. May differ from milestone_amount or adjusted_amount due to partial billing, credit memos, or dispute resolutions. Represents the net total in the MONETARY_TRIPLET.
attributes.references: Salesforce Revenue Cloud; Oracle NetSuite ERP; GAAP Revenue Recognition

attributes.name: is_retainage
attributes.description: Indicates whether this milestone represents a retainage billing — a withheld portion of the SOW contract value released upon final project acceptance. Common in project-based staffing and consulting SOW engagements.
attributes.references: Salesforce Revenue Cloud; ASA; GAAP

attributes.name: milestone_amount
attributes.description: Gross contractual billing amount for this milestone as defined in the SOW. Represents the base amount to be invoiced to the client upon milestone completion and approval. Part of the MONETARY_TRIPLET for this transaction.
attributes.references: Salesforce Revenue Cloud; Oracle NetSuite ERP; ASA

attributes.name: milestone_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of the deliverable, work product, or condition that must be met for this milestone to be considered complete and billable. Sourced from the SOW document and used in invoice line item descriptions.
attributes.references: DocuSign CLM; Salesforce Revenue Cloud; ASA

attributes.name: milestone_name
attributes.description: Descriptive name of the billing milestone as defined in the SOW (e.g., 'Phase 1 Completion', 'Go-Live Delivery', 'Final Acceptance'). Used in client-facing invoices and project tracking.
attributes.references: DocuSign CLM; Salesforce Revenue Cloud

attributes.name: milestone_number
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier for the milestone, typically formatted as MS-XXXXXXXX. Used in client communications, invoices, and SOW documentation to uniquely reference a specific billing milestone. Serves as the BUSINESS_IDENTIFIER for this transaction.
attributes.references: Salesforce Revenue Cloud; DocuSign CLM

attributes.name: milestone_sequence
attributes.description: Ordinal position of this milestone within the SOW billing schedule (e.g., 1, 2, 3). Enables ordered display and sequential billing logic across all milestones in a SOW.
attributes.references: Salesforce Revenue Cloud

attributes.name: milestone_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the billing milestone. Drives workflow routing and revenue recognition. Values: pending (not yet completed), approved (completion confirmed), invoiced (invoice generated and sent), disputed (client has raised a dispute), cancelled (milestone removed from billing schedule). Serves as the LIFECYCLE_STATUS for this transaction.
attributes.references: Salesforce Revenue Cloud; Oracle NetSuite ERP; ASA

attributes.name: milestone_type
attributes.description: Classification of the billing trigger for this milestone. Determines how completion is measured and billing is initiated. Values: deliverable (specific output delivered), phase_completion (project phase finished), time_based (calendar-driven), percent_complete (percentage of work done), acceptance (client formal sign-off). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: deliverable|phase_completion|time_based|percent_complete|acceptance — promote to reference product if additional types emerge]
attributes.references: Salesforce Revenue Cloud; ASA SOW Billing Standards

attributes.name: payment_due_date
attributes.description: Calculated date by which client payment for this milestone invoice is due, derived from actual_billing_date plus payment_terms. Used for accounts receivable aging and collections management.
attributes.references: Oracle NetSuite ERP; Salesforce Revenue Cloud

attributes.name: payment_terms
attributes.description: Contractual payment terms applicable to this milestone invoice, defining the number of days the client has to remit payment after invoice date (e.g., Net30, Net45). Sourced from the MSA or SOW payment terms.
attributes.references: Oracle NetSuite ERP; Salesforce Revenue Cloud; MSA Terms

attributes.name: po_number
attributes.description: Client-issued Purchase Order number associated with this milestone billing event. Required by many enterprise clients for invoice processing and accounts payable matching.
attributes.references: Oracle NetSuite ERP; Salesforce Revenue Cloud

attributes.name: retainage_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of the milestone amount withheld as retainage per the SOW contract terms. Applicable only when is_retainage is True. Expressed as a value between 0.00 and 100.00.
attributes.references: Salesforce Revenue Cloud; DocuSign CLM; GAAP

attributes.name: revenue_recognition_date
attributes.description: Date on which revenue for this milestone is recognized in the general ledger per ASC 606 / IFRS 15 revenue recognition standards. May differ from actual_billing_date based on performance obligation completion.
attributes.references: Oracle NetSuite ERP; ASC 606; IFRS 15; GAAP

attributes.name: scheduled_billing_date
attributes.description: Contractually planned date on which this milestone is expected to be billed to the client, as defined in the SOW billing schedule. Used for cash flow forecasting and accounts receivable planning.
attributes.references: Salesforce Revenue Cloud; DocuSign CLM; ASA

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Operational system of record from which this milestone record was sourced or originated. Supports data lineage tracking in the Databricks Silver Layer lakehouse.
attributes.references: SOC 2 Type II; Oracle NetSuite ERP; Salesforce Revenue Cloud

attributes.name: source_system_milestone_code
attributes.description: Native identifier of this milestone record in the originating operational system (e.g., Salesforce Revenue Cloud opportunity milestone ID or NetSuite project task ID). Enables reconciliation between the lakehouse Silver Layer and source systems.
attributes.references: SOC 2 Type II; Salesforce Revenue Cloud; Oracle NetSuite ERP

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this SOW billing milestone record. Serves as the RECORD_AUDIT_UPDATED field for change tracking and audit compliance. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: SOC 2 Type II; GDPR Article 5; Oracle NetSuite ERP

products.name: write_off
products.description: Transactional record documenting the write-off of uncollectible accounts receivable balances. Captures write-off date, write-off amount, write-off reason (bad debt, client bankruptcy, disputed and settled, aged beyond policy, small balance), original invoice reference, client billing account reference, approval authority, GL account code, tax impact flag, and recovery status (in case of subsequent collection). Supports bad debt management, financial reporting, and AR balance accuracy.

attributes.name: write_off_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated identifier for the write-off transaction record. Primary key for the billing.write_off data product.
attributes.references: Oracle NetSuite ERP - Accounts Receivable Module

attributes.name: accounting_period_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.accounting_period. Business justification: Write-offs must be recorded in correct periods for financial reporting, bad debt expense recognition, and tax reporting.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: ar_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.ar_account. Business justification: Write-offs reduce AR account balances and affect bad debt reserve calculations. Essential for AR reconciliation and financial reporting.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: assignment_id
attributes.description: Reference to the staffing placement associated with the original invoice being written off. Enables write-off analysis by placement type, recruiter, and business unit.
attributes.references: Bullhorn ATS/CRM - Placement Record; ASA Staffing Industry Standards

attributes.name: billing_dispute_id
attributes.description: Reference to the billing dispute record that led to this write-off, if the write-off reason is disputed_settled. Links the write-off to the dispute resolution workflow.
attributes.references: Salesforce Revenue Cloud - Dispute Management; Oracle NetSuite ERP

attributes.name: client_account_id
attributes.description: FK to client.client_account

attributes.name: client_billing_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the client billing account whose outstanding accounts receivable balance is being written off. Identifies the debtor entity in the AR ledger.
attributes.references: Salesforce Revenue Cloud - Account Object; Oracle NetSuite ERP - Customer Record

attributes.name: conversion_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to placement.conversion. Business justification: Uncollectible conversion fees require write-offs (client disputes, bankruptcy, bad debt). Write-off tracking links to specific conversions for financial reporting and revenue adjustments. Essential fo
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: credit_memo_id
attributes.description: Reference to an associated credit memo issued in connection with this write-off, if applicable. Relevant for disputed-and-settled write-offs where a credit memo was issued as part of the resolution.
attributes.references: Salesforce Revenue Cloud - Credit Memo Object; Oracle NetSuite ERP - Credit Memo

attributes.name: direct_hire_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to placement.direct_hire. Business justification: Uncollectible direct hire fees require write-offs (client bankruptcy, disputed fees, bad debt). Write-off tracking links to specific direct hire placements for financial reporting. Essential for bad d
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: invoice_id
attributes.description: Reference to the original invoice record against which this write-off is being applied. Links the write-off to the source billing transaction.
attributes.references: Salesforce Revenue Cloud - Invoice Object; Oracle NetSuite ERP - Accounts Receivable

attributes.name: legal_entity_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.legal_entity. Business justification: Write-offs recorded at legal entity level for financial statements and tax reporting.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: staff_profile_id
attributes.description: Reference to the internal user or authority who approved the write-off. Supports segregation of duties and audit trail requirements.
attributes.references: SOC 2 Type II - Change Management Controls; Oracle NetSuite ERP - Approval Workflow

attributes.name: amount
attributes.description: The gross dollar amount of the accounts receivable balance being written off. Represents the full uncollectible amount before any partial recovery adjustments.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 310-10; IRS Publication 535 - Business Expenses (Bad Debt); Oracle NetSuite ERP

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: The date on which the write-off was formally approved by the designated approval authority. Required for audit trail and segregation of duties compliance.
attributes.references: SOC 2 Type II - Change Management; Oracle NetSuite ERP - Approval Workflow

attributes.name: approval_level
attributes.description: The organizational authority level required and obtained to approve this write-off. Write-off approval thresholds typically escalate based on dollar amount per internal financial controls policy.
attributes.references: SOC 2 Type II - Financial Controls; GAAP Internal Controls; Oracle NetSuite ERP - Approval Routing

attributes.name: ar_aging_bucket
attributes.description: Aging classification of the invoice at the time of write-off, based on days outstanding. Used for bad debt reserve analysis, financial reporting, and write-off policy compliance.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 310-10; Salesforce Revenue Cloud - AR Aging Report; ASA Financial Reporting

attributes.name: billing_model
attributes.description: The billing model under which the original invoice was generated. Supports segmentation of write-off analysis by revenue type (e.g., hourly T&M vs. direct placement fee vs. SOW-based).
attributes.references: Salesforce Revenue Cloud - Billing Model; ASA Staffing Industry Billing Standards

attributes.name: branch_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the staffing branch or office that originated the client relationship and associated billing. Supports geographic and branch-level bad debt analysis.
attributes.references: Bullhorn ATS/CRM - Branch/Office; Oracle NetSuite ERP - Subsidiary

attributes.name: business_unit
attributes.description: The internal business unit or division responsible for the client relationship and original billing. Used for P&L attribution of bad debt expense and write-off reporting by division.
attributes.references: Oracle NetSuite ERP - Business Unit Segmentation; ASA Financial Reporting

attributes.name: collection_agency_name
attributes.description: Name of the third-party collection agency engaged to pursue recovery of the written-off balance. Populated when the account has been referred to external collections.
attributes.references: Fair Debt Collection Practices Act (FDCPA); Oracle NetSuite ERP - Collections Module

attributes.name: collection_referral_date
attributes.description: Date on which the written-off account was referred to a third-party collection agency. Supports collections lifecycle tracking and agency performance measurement.
attributes.references: Fair Debt Collection Practices Act (FDCPA); Oracle NetSuite ERP - Collections

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp recording when the write-off record was first created in the data platform. Supports audit trail, data lineage, and SLA compliance for financial record creation.
attributes.references: SOC 2 Type II - Audit Trail; GDPR Article 5 - Data Integrity; CCPA

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the write-off amount (e.g., USD, CAD, GBP). Supports multi-currency operations for international staffing engagements.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 - Currency Codes; GAAP ASC 830 - Foreign Currency Matters

attributes.name: days_outstanding_at_write_off
attributes.description: Number of days the invoice was outstanding (unpaid) at the time the write-off decision was made. Key metric for AR aging analysis and write-off policy compliance validation.
attributes.references: ASA Financial Reporting Standards; GAAP ASC 310-10; Salesforce Revenue Cloud - AR Aging

attributes.name: gl_account_code
attributes.description: The General Ledger account code to which the write-off expense is posted. Typically maps to a bad debt expense or allowance for doubtful accounts GL account in the chart of accounts.
attributes.references: Oracle NetSuite ERP - Chart of Accounts; GAAP ASC 310-10; IRS Publication 535

attributes.name: gl_period
attributes.description: The accounting period (YYYY-MM) in which the write-off is recognized in the General Ledger. Determines the financial reporting period for bad debt expense recognition.
attributes.references: Oracle NetSuite ERP - Accounting Periods; GAAP ASC 250 - Accounting Changes

attributes.name: netsuite_transaction_code
attributes.description: The internal transaction identifier assigned by Oracle NetSuite ERP when the write-off journal entry is posted. Enables direct traceability between the data lakehouse record and the ERP source system.
attributes.references: Oracle NetSuite ERP - Transaction ID; SOC 2 Type II - Data Lineage

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: General free-text notes field for additional context, internal communications, or supplementary documentation related to the write-off. May include collection correspondence summaries, legal counsel notes, or management commentary.
attributes.references: Oracle NetSuite ERP - Memo/Notes Field; SOC 2 Type II - Documentation

attributes.name: original_invoice_amount
attributes.description: The total billed amount on the original invoice at the time of issuance. Provides baseline for calculating the proportion of the invoice being written off versus any partial payments received.
attributes.references: Salesforce Revenue Cloud - Invoice Amount; GAAP ASC 606 - Revenue Recognition

attributes.name: partial_payment_received
attributes.description: Total amount previously collected against the original invoice prior to the write-off decision. Used to confirm the net uncollectible balance and validate the write-off amount.
attributes.references: Oracle NetSuite ERP - Payment Application; GAAP ASC 310-10

attributes.name: reason
attributes.description: Categorical reason code explaining why the accounts receivable balance is being written off. Drives bad debt classification, tax treatment, and financial reporting segmentation. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: bad_debt|client_bankruptcy|disputed_settled|aged_beyond_policy|small_balance_adjustment|client_insolvency — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: IRS Publication 535 - Bad Debt Deduction; GAAP ASC 310-10; ASA Financial Reporting

attributes.name: reason_detail
attributes.description: Free-text narrative providing additional context and justification for the write-off beyond the categorical reason code. Captures case-specific circumstances such as dispute resolution outcomes, bankruptcy case numbers, or collection agency notes.
attributes.references: SOC 2 Type II - Audit Trail Requirements; Oracle NetSuite ERP - Memo Field

attributes.name: recovered_amount
attributes.description: Dollar amount subsequently collected after the write-off was posted. Populated when recovery_status is partially_recovered or fully_recovered. Triggers a bad debt recovery journal entry in the GL.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 310-10 - Bad Debt Recovery; Oracle NetSuite ERP; IRS Publication 535

attributes.name: recovery_date
attributes.description: The date on which a subsequent payment was received against a previously written-off balance. Used to record the bad debt recovery accounting entry in the correct GL period.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 310-10; Oracle NetSuite ERP - Payment Date

attributes.name: recovery_status
attributes.description: Current status of any subsequent collection efforts against a previously written-off balance. Tracks whether the written-off amount has been partially or fully recovered after the write-off was posted.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 310-10 - Subsequent Recovery of Bad Debt; Oracle NetSuite ERP - AR Recovery

attributes.name: reversal_date
attributes.description: The date on which the write-off was reversed in the General Ledger. Populated only when reversal_flag is True. Used for GL period reconciliation.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 310-10; Oracle NetSuite ERP - Reversal Date

attributes.name: reversal_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this write-off has been reversed (True) due to subsequent full payment, error correction, or management override. A reversed write-off requires a corresponding GL reversal entry.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 310-10; Oracle NetSuite ERP - Transaction Reversal; SOC 2 Type II

attributes.name: reversal_reason
attributes.description: Reason code explaining why the write-off was reversed. Supports audit trail and financial control documentation for reversed write-off transactions.
attributes.references: SOC 2 Type II - Financial Controls; Oracle NetSuite ERP; GAAP ASC 310-10

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Identifies the operational system of record from which this write-off record originated. Supports data lineage tracking and reconciliation between the lakehouse silver layer and source systems.
attributes.references: SOC 2 Type II - Data Lineage; Oracle NetSuite ERP; Salesforce Revenue Cloud

attributes.name: tax_impact_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this write-off has a tax deductibility impact (True) or is a non-deductible write-off (False). Drives IRS bad debt deduction eligibility assessment and tax reporting workflows.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 535 - Business Bad Debts; IRS Revenue Ruling 93-27; U.S. Department of Treasury

attributes.name: tax_year

attributes.name: compliance_notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for compliance officers to document case-specific notes, exceptions, escalations, or remediation actions taken during the E-Verify process. Used for internal audit documentation and legal hold purposes. Sourced from Sterling BGC and manual compliance team entries.
attributes.references: SOC 2 Type II; DOL Audit Requirements; FCRA

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this E-Verify case record was first created in the Staffing Hr compliance data platform (Silver Layer). Represents the data ingestion audit trail timestamp, distinct from the case submission timestamp. Required for SOC 2 Type II audit controls.
attributes.references: SOC 2 Type II; GDPR Article 5; CCPA

attributes.name: dhs_case_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: Department of Homeland Security (DHS) E-Verify Case Number
attributes.description: The official case number assigned by the DHS/SSA E-Verify federal portal upon case creation. This is the externally-known identifier used to track and reference the case with federal authorities. Sourced from Sterling BGC and E-Verify federal portal integration.
attributes.references: DHS E-Verify Program; INA Section 274A

attributes.name: document_title_list_used
attributes.description: Indicates whether the worker presented a List A document (establishes both identity and employment authorization) or a combination of List B (identity) and List C (employment authorization) documents during I-9 verification. Relevant to E-Verify case processing rules.
attributes.references: DHS Form I-9; INA Section 274A; DHS E-Verify Program

attributes.name: employee_first_day_of_work
attributes.description: The date the employee began work for pay at Staffing Hr or the client site. E-Verify cases must be submitted within 3 business days of this date per federal program rules. Used to validate timely submission compliance.
attributes.references: DHS E-Verify Program; INA Section 274A; DOL

attributes.name: employer_case_creator
attributes.description: The name or identifier of the Staffing Hr staff member (recruiter, onboarding specialist, or compliance officer) who created and submitted the E-Verify case. Required for internal audit trails and accountability tracking per SOC 2 Type II controls.
attributes.references: SOC 2 Type II; DHS E-Verify Program; DOL Audit Requirements

attributes.name: employment_authorization_expiry_date
attributes.description: The expiration date of the worker's employment authorization document as recorded in the E-Verify case. Triggers re-verification requirements for workers with temporary employment authorization. Critical for ongoing compliance monitoring and assignment management.
attributes.references: DHS E-Verify Program; INA Section 274A; USCIS Employment Authorization

attributes.name: federal_closure_code
attributes.description: The standardized federal closure code assigned by the DHS E-Verify portal upon case closure. Used for regulatory reporting, federal audit reconciliation, and compliance tracking with DHS and DOL requirements.
attributes.references: DHS E-Verify Program; DOL Audit Requirements

attributes.name: federal_contractor_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this E-Verify case was submitted under the Federal Acquisition Regulation (FAR) E-Verify clause requirement for federal contractor placements. True = federal contractor case; False = standard commercial placement. Drives OFCCP compliance reporting.
attributes.references: FAR E-Verify Clause; OFCCP; DHS E-Verify Program

attributes.name: final_case_result
attributes.description: The conclusive result of the E-Verify case after all resolution steps (TNC contest, referral, continuance) have been completed. Used for final compliance determination and regulatory reporting to DOL and EEOC.
attributes.references: DHS E-Verify Program; DOL Audit Requirements; EEOC Compliance

attributes.name: further_action_notice_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: E-Verify Further Action Notice (FAN) Issuance Date
attributes.description: The date on which the Further Action Notice (FAN) was provided to the worker. Must be documented as part of the TNC resolution process. Null when no FAN was issued. Used for compliance audit trails and DOL regulatory reporting.
attributes.references: DHS E-Verify Program; DOL Audit Requirements

attributes.name: further_action_notice_issued
attributes.business_glossary_term: E-Verify Further Action Notice (FAN) Issued Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a Further Action Notice (FAN) was issued to the worker as part of the TNC process. True = FAN was issued and provided to the worker; False = no FAN issued. Required documentation step for TNC compliance per DHS E-Verify program rules.
attributes.references: DHS E-Verify Program; INA Section 274A; EEOC Anti-Discrimination Notice

attributes.name: initial_case_result
attributes.description: The first result returned by the E-Verify system upon initial case submission. Distinct from the final case status — captures the original determination before any TNC resolution or continuance. Key field for compliance audit trails required by DOL and IRS.
attributes.value_regex: Employment Authorized|Tentative Nonconfirmation|DHS Verification in Process|SSA Tentative Nonconfirmation
attributes.references: DHS E-Verify Program; DOL Audit Requirements; INA Section 274A

attributes.name: late_submission_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the E-Verify case was submitted after the federally mandated 3-business-day window from the employee's first day of work. True = late submission; False = timely submission. Used for compliance monitoring, SLA reporting, and DOL audit risk management.
attributes.references: DHS E-Verify Program; INA Section 274A; DOL Audit Requirements

attributes.name: photo_match_result
attributes.description: The result of the E-Verify photo matching step, where the photo on the worker's identity document is compared against DHS records. Applicable when the worker presents a document with a photo that E-Verify can match. Used for fraud detection and compliance documentation.
attributes.references: DHS E-Verify Program; INA Section 274A

attributes.name: re_verification_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the worker's employment authorization requires re-verification before the expiry date. True = re-verification is required; False = no re-verification needed (e.g., U.S. citizen). Drives compliance workflow alerts for assignment managers.
attributes.references: DHS E-Verify Program; INA Section 274A; USCIS

attributes.name: referral_agency
attributes.description: The federal agency (Social Security Administration or Department of Homeland Security) to which the worker was referred to resolve a Tentative Nonconfirmation (TNC). Determines the resolution process and timeline. Null or 'None' when no referral was required.
attributes.references: DHS E-Verify Program; SSA; INA Section 274A

attributes.name: referral_date
attributes.description: The date on which the worker was referred to the SSA or DHS to resolve a Tentative Nonconfirmation (TNC). Must occur within the federally mandated timeframe after TNC issuance. Null when no TNC referral was required. Tracked for DOL and DHS audit compliance.
attributes.references: DHS E-Verify Program; DOL Audit Requirements; INA Section 274A

attributes.name: referral_deadline_date
attributes.description: The federally mandated deadline by which the worker must be referred to SSA or DHS to contest a Tentative Nonconfirmation (TNC). Calculated from the TNC issuance date per DHS E-Verify program rules. Used for SLA monitoring and compliance alerting.
attributes.references: DHS E-Verify Program; INA Section 274A

attributes.name: resolution_deadline_date
attributes.description: The federally mandated deadline by which the TNC must be resolved by the referring agency (SSA or DHS). Staffing Hr must not terminate employment before this date solely due to TNC status. Tracked for EEOC anti-discrimination compliance and DOL audit.
attributes.references: DHS E-Verify Program; EEOC Anti-Discrimination Notice; DOL

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Identifies the operational system of record from which this E-Verify case record was sourced. Supports data lineage tracking and reconciliation between Sterling Background Check integration and the DHS E-Verify federal portal.
attributes.references: SOC 2 Type II; DHS E-Verify Program

attributes.name: sterling_case_reference
attributes.business_glossary_term: Sterling Background Check (BGC) E-Verify Case Reference
attributes.description: The case reference number assigned by Sterling Background Check system for this E-Verify submission. Used for reconciliation between Sterling BGC integration records and the DHS E-Verify federal portal. Enables cross-system audit trail.
attributes.references: Sterling BGC Integration; FCRA; DHS E-Verify Program

attributes.name: submission_timestamp
attributes.description: The exact date and time when the E-Verify case was submitted to the DHS/SSA federal portal. This is the principal business event timestamp for the case. Must occur within 3 business days of the employee's first day of work per federal E-Verify program rules.
attributes.references: DHS E-Verify Program; INA Section 274A; DOL

attributes.name: tnc_issuance_date
attributes.description: The date on which the Tentative Nonconfirmation (TNC) was issued by the E-Verify system. Triggers the mandatory referral and resolution timeline. Null when no TNC was issued. Critical for calculating referral and resolution deadlines.
attributes.references: DHS E-Verify Program; INA Section 274A

attributes.name: tnc_resolution_status
attributes.description: Tracks the worker's response and resolution outcome for a Tentative Nonconfirmation (TNC). Indicates whether the worker contested the TNC, did not contest, and the resulting resolution. Null when no TNC was issued. Required for OFCCP and DOL compliance audit trails.
attributes.references: DHS E-Verify Program; OFCCP; DOL Audit Requirements

attributes.name: tnc_type
attributes.description: Identifies whether the Tentative Nonconfirmation (TNC) was issued by the Social Security Administration (SSA), the Department of Homeland Security (DHS), or both. Null or 'None' when no TNC was issued. Drives the appropriate referral agency and resolution workflow.
attributes.value_regex: SSA TNC|DHS TNC|SSA and DHS TNC|None
attributes.references: DHS E-Verify Program; SSA; INA Section 274A

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this E-Verify case record was last modified in the Staffing Hr compliance data platform. Tracks all status changes, TNC updates, and closure events for audit trail purposes. Required for SOC 2 Type II and DOL audit compliance.
attributes.references: SOC 2 Type II; DOL Audit Requirements; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: worker_contested_tnc
attributes.description: Indicates whether the worker chose to contest the Tentative Nonconfirmation (TNC) with the issuing agency (SSA or DHS). True = worker contested; False = worker did not contest. Null when no TNC was issued. Critical for FLSA and EEOC anti-discrimination compliance.
attributes.references: DHS E-Verify Program; EEOC Anti-Discrimination Notice; INA Section 274A

products.name: worker_classification
products.description: Master record capturing FLSA worker classification determinations for each worker engagement — W-2 employee vs. 1099 independent contractor (IC). Stores classification type, determination basis (behavioral control, financial control, relationship type per IRS common law test), classification date, reviewing attorney or compliance officer, client-requested classification, override flags, co-employment risk rating, and IRS audit exposure notes. SSOT for IC vs. W-2 classification decisions.

attributes.name: worker_classification_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated identifier for each worker classification determination record. Primary key for the worker_classification data product.
attributes.references: IRS Common Law Test; FLSA Worker Classification Rules

attributes.name: assignment_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific placement or engagement for which this classification determination applies. A worker may have different classifications across different engagements.
attributes.references: FLSA; IRS Common Law Test

attributes.name: client_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the client account associated with this worker engagement and classification determination. Relevant for co-employment and joint employment risk assessment.
attributes.references: FLSA; Co-Employment Risk Management

attributes.name: coe_risk_assessment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.coe_risk_assessment. Business justification: Worker classification determination references the co-employment risk assessment that informed the classification decision. This normalizes co_employment_risk_rating and joint_employment_indicator whi

attributes.name: contract_msa_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to contract.msa. Business justification: MSAs define permissible worker classifications (W-2, 1099, IC) and co-employment risk mitigation clauses. Classification decisions must align with MSA terms to avoid contractual breach and misclassifi
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: ic_agreement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to contract.ic_agreement. Business justification: IC classifications require corresponding IC agreements. Real business need: 1:1 mapping between classification determination and executed IC contract for audit trail and misclassification defense.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: internal_staff_profile_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to employee.staff_profile. Business justification: Internal employees (especially remote recruiters, 1099 contractors converted to W-2, or multi-state staff) require worker classification determinations for tax compliance, unemployment insurance, and
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: onboarding_engagement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to onboarding.onboarding_engagement. Business justification: Worker classification (W2 vs 1099) must be determined during onboarding before payroll setup and assignment start. Links classification decision to specific onboarding engagement for compliance audit
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: order_header_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to joborder.order_header. Business justification: Worker classification determinations (W2 vs 1099, employee vs IC) are often made during job order intake based on client requirements, job structure, and MSA terms. Links classification decisions to o
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: profile_id
attributes.description: Reference to the worker (candidate or placed employee) whose classification is being determined. Links to the candidate or worker master record.
attributes.references: FLSA; IRS Publication 15-A

attributes.name: sow_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to contract.sow. Business justification: SOWs specify engagement types (temp, temp-to-perm, IC) that drive classification. Real business need: SOW-driven classification validation ensures compliance with engagement-specific terms.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: state_compliance_rule_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.state_compliance_rule. Business justification: Worker classification determinations follow state-specific rules (ABC test, IC tests vary by state). This normalizes state_law_jurisdiction which can be retrieved via JOIN to state_compliance_rule. Cl
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to vendor.supplier. Business justification: Worker classification determinations (IC vs. W-2) often require external legal counsel or compliance advisory firms. Track supplier for audit defense preparation, cost allocation to client/engagement,
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: abc_test_applicable
attributes.description: Indicates whether the state-level ABC Test (stricter than IRS Common Law Test) applies to this classification determination based on the work jurisdiction. True = ABC Test governs; False = IRS Common Law or DOL Economic Realities Test applies.
attributes.references: California AB5; Massachusetts MGL c.149 §148B; New Jersey ABC Test

attributes.name: abc_test_result
attributes.description: Outcome of the ABC Test evaluation where applicable. Pass = worker qualifies as independent contractor under all three prongs; Fail = worker must be classified as W-2 employee; Not Applicable = ABC Test does not govern this jurisdiction.
attributes.references: California AB5; Massachusetts MGL c.149 §148B; Dynamex Operations West v. Superior Court

attributes.name: behavioral_control_score
attributes.description: Numeric score (0–100) reflecting the degree of behavioral control the staffing firm or client exercises over the worker, per the IRS Common Law Test. Higher scores indicate greater control and stronger W-2 classification support.
attributes.references: IRS Common Law Test; IRS Publication 15-A

attributes.name: classification_number
attributes.description: Externally-known unique business identifier for this classification determination record, used in audit correspondence, legal filings, and IRS inquiries. Format: WC-YYYY-NNNNNN.
attributes.references: IRS Form SS-8; DOL Wage and Hour Division

attributes.name: classification_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of this classification determination. Pending = under review; Active = in force; Superseded = replaced by a newer determination; Appealed = under formal challenge; Revoked = withdrawn due to error or legal order.
attributes.references: IRS Common Law Test; DOL Wage and Hour Division

attributes.name: classification_type
attributes.description: The determined classification type for the worker engagement. W2 = W-2 employee (temporary or permanent); 1099_IC = Independent Contractor (1099-MISC); 1099_NEC = Non-Employee Compensation contractor; C2C = Corp-to-Corp engagement; EOR = Employer of Record arrangement. This is the SSOT for IC vs. W-2 decisions.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 15-A; IRS Form SS-8; FLSA Section 3(e); IRS Common Law Test

attributes.name: client_requested_classification
attributes.description: The worker classification type explicitly requested by the client in the job order, MSA, or SOW. May differ from the compliance-determined classification. Used to track client preference vs. legal determination and flag misalignment.
attributes.references: MSA; SOW; FLSA; IRS Common Law Test

attributes.name: compliance_notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for compliance officers or legal counsel to document additional observations, risk factors, remediation actions, or contextual information relevant to this classification determination. Retained for audit trail.
attributes.references: DOL Wage and Hour Division; IRS Common Law Test; ASA Best Practices

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this worker classification record was first created in the system. Audit trail field required for DOL, IRS, and SOC 2 compliance.
attributes.references: SOC 2 Type II; DOL Recordkeeping Requirements; IRS Recordkeeping

attributes.name: determination_basis
attributes.description: The legal or regulatory test framework used to arrive at the classification determination. Behavioral Control = IRS test on instruction/training; Financial Control = IRS test on investment/profit/loss; Relationship Type = IRS test on written contracts/benefits/permanency; ABC Test = state-level test (e.g., California AB5); Economic Realities = DOL FLSA test; Multi-Factor = combination of tests applied.
attributes.references: IRS Common Law Test (Rev. Rul. 87-41); DOL FLSA Economic Realities Test; California AB5

attributes.name: determination_date
attributes.description: The date on which the formal worker classification determination was made and recorded. This is the principal business event date for this record.
attributes.references: IRS Common Law Test; FLSA; DOL Wage and Hour Division

attributes.name: effective_from
attributes.description: The date from which this classification determination is binding and in effect for the worker engagement. May differ from determination_date if retroactive or prospective.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 15-A; FLSA

attributes.name: effective_until
attributes.description: The date on which this classification determination expires or is superseded. Null for open-ended classifications. Populated when a new determination replaces this one or the engagement ends.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 15-A; FLSA

attributes.name: financial_control_score
attributes.description: Numeric score (0–100) reflecting the degree of financial control the staffing firm or client exercises over the worker, per the IRS Common Law Test. Considers investment in tools, opportunity for profit/loss, and services available to the general market.
attributes.references: IRS Common Law Test; IRS Publication 15-A

attributes.name: flsa_exemption_status
attributes.business_glossary_term: Fair Labor Standards Act (FLSA) Exemption Status
attributes.description: FLSA overtime exemption classification for W-2 employees. Non-Exempt = entitled to overtime pay; Exempt categories follow the FLSA white-collar exemption tests (Executive, Administrative, Professional, Highly Compensated, Outside Sales). Drives OT and DT pay rule application. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: non_exempt|exempt_executive|exempt_administrative|exempt_professional|exempt_highly_compensated|exempt_outside_sales — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: FLSA Section 13(a)(1); 29 CFR Part 541; DOL Wage and Hour Division

attributes.name: ic_agreement_date
attributes.description: Date on which the Independent Contractor Agreement was executed. Used to verify agreement predates the engagement start and is current for the classification period.
attributes.references: IRS Common Law Test; FLSA; DocuSign CLM

attributes.name: ic_agreement_on_file
attributes.business_glossary_term: Independent Contractor (IC) Agreement on File Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a signed Independent Contractor Agreement is on file for this worker engagement. Required for 1099/IC classifications. Absence of a signed agreement increases misclassification risk.
attributes.references: IRS Common Law Test; FLSA; ASA IC Compliance Guidelines

attributes.name: irs_audit_exposure_notes
attributes.description: Free-text field capturing compliance officer or attorney notes regarding IRS audit exposure risk for this classification. Documents specific factors that could attract IRS scrutiny, misclassification penalties, or back-tax liability under IRC Section 3509.
attributes.references: IRS Form SS-8; IRC Section 3509; IRS Publication 15-A; DOL Wage and Hour Division

attributes.name: misclassification_risk_level
attributes.description: Overall assessed risk level that the current classification determination could be challenged or reversed by the IRS, DOL, or state labor authority. Drives compliance monitoring frequency and legal review escalation.
attributes.references: IRS Common Law Test; DOL FLSA Economic Realities Test; California AB5; NLRB

attributes.name: nda_on_file
attributes.description: Indicates whether a signed Non-Disclosure Agreement (NDA) is on file for this worker engagement. Tracked as part of the compliance documentation package for the classification record.
attributes.references: DocuSign CLM; ASA Best Practices; GDPR Article 28

attributes.name: non_compete_on_file
attributes.description: Indicates whether a signed Non-Compete Agreement is on file for this worker. Relevant to classification because non-compete clauses are more consistent with employee relationships and may affect IC classification defensibility.
attributes.references: FLSA; FTC Non-Compete Rule; State Non-Compete Laws; DocuSign CLM

attributes.name: override_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the final classification determination overrides the system-recommended or compliance-officer-recommended classification. True = an override was applied; False = determination follows standard process. Triggers mandatory documentation and senior review.
attributes.references: IRS Form SS-8; DOL Wage and Hour Division; ASA Best Practices

attributes.name: override_reason
attributes.description: Free-text explanation documenting the business or legal justification for overriding the standard classification recommendation. Required when override_flag is True. Retained for audit trail and IRS inquiry response.
attributes.references: IRS Form SS-8; DOL Wage and Hour Division

attributes.name: previous_classification_type
attributes.description: The prior classification type for this worker on this engagement, captured when a reclassification event occurs. Enables audit trail of classification changes and supports IRS back-period liability analysis.
attributes.references: IRS Form SS-8; IRC Section 3509; DOL Wage and Hour Division

attributes.name: reclassification_date
attributes.description: Date on which a worker's classification was changed from a prior type to the current classification_type. Null if this is the original classification with no prior change.
attributes.references: IRS Form SS-8; IRC Section 3509; DOL Wage and Hour Division

attributes.name: reclassification_trigger
attributes.description: The event or authority that triggered a reclassification of the worker. Captures whether the change was driven by an IRS audit, DOL investigation, state labor audit, client request, proactive internal compliance review, legal counsel advice, or court order. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: irs_audit|dol_audit|state_audit|client_request|internal_review|legal_counsel|court_order — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: IRS Form SS-8; DOL Wage and Hour Division; OFCCP; State Labor Agencies

attributes.name: relationship_type_score
attributes.description: Numeric score (0–100) reflecting the nature of the relationship between the worker and the engaging party, per the IRS Common Law Test. Considers written contracts, employee benefits, permanency of relationship, and integral business activity.
attributes.references: IRS Common Law Test; IRS Publication 15-A

attributes.name: reviewing_officer_name
attributes.business_glossary_term: Reviewing Compliance Officer or Attorney Name
attributes.description: Full name of the compliance officer, HR attorney, or legal counsel who reviewed and approved this classification determination. Required for audit trail and regulatory defense.
attributes.references: DOL Wage and Hour Division; IRS Form SS-8; OFCCP Compliance

attributes.name: reviewing_officer_title
attributes.description: Job title or role of the individual who reviewed and approved the classification determination (e.g., Chief Compliance Officer, Employment Attorney, HR Director).
attributes.references: DOL Wage and Hour Division; ASA Best Practices

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: The operational system of record from which this classification determination originated or was last updated. Supports data lineage and reconciliation across Bullhorn ATS/CRM, SAP SuccessFactors, TempWorks Payroll, Beeline VMS, or manual entry.
attributes.references: SOC 2 Type II; Data Lineage Best Practices

attributes.name: ss8_determination_result
attributes.description: The IRS's official determination result from Form SS-8 review. Employee = IRS determined worker is an employee; Independent Contractor = IRS confirmed IC status; Pending = IRS review in progress; Withdrawn = SS-8 filing was withdrawn.
attributes.references: IRS Form SS-8; IRS Publication 15-A

attributes.name: ss8_filed
attributes.description: Indicates whether IRS Form SS-8 (Determination of Worker Status for Purposes of Federal Employment Taxes and Income Tax Withholding) has been filed for this worker engagement. True = SS-8 filed with IRS; False = not filed.
attributes.references: IRS Form SS-8; IRS Publication 15-A

attributes.name: ss8_filed_date
attributes.description: Date on which IRS Form SS-8 was filed with the IRS for this worker engagement. Null if ss8_filed is False.
attributes.references: IRS Form SS-8; IRS Publication 15-A

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this worker classification record was most recently modified. Audit trail field required for DOL, IRS, and SOC 2 compliance. Tracks reclassification events and override changes.
attributes.references: SOC 2 Type II; DOL Recordkeeping Requirements; IRS Recordkeeping

attributes.name: voluntary_classification_settlement
attributes.business_glossary_term: Voluntary Classification Settlement Program (VCSP) Enrollment Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the staffing firm has enrolled this worker classification under the IRS Voluntary Classification Settlement Program (VCSP), which allows prospective reclassification of workers as employees with reduced tax liability.
attributes.references: IRS Announcement 2012-45; IRS VCSP; IRS Form 8952

attributes.name: workers_comp_exempt
attributes.description: Indicates whether the worker is exempt from Workers Compensation coverage based on their classification (e.g., 1099 IC workers are typically exempt). Drives payroll and insurance configuration in TempWorks Payroll.
attributes.references: State Workers Compensation Laws; OSHA; TempWorks Payroll

attributes.name: count_american_indian_alaska_native

attributes.name: count_asian
attributes.description: Total number of employees self-identified as Asian (not Hispanic or Latino) across all job categories in this filing. One of the seven EEOC-mandated race/ethnicity categories.

Used for trend analysis, root cause classification, and OSHA 300A summary reporting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: fall|struck_by|caught_in|overexertion|exposure|transportation|violence|other — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR Part 1904; BLS OIICS Event or Exposure Classification

attributes.name: incident_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the workplace injury or illness event occurred. This is the principal real-world event date used for OSHA 300 log entry, workers comp filing deadlines, and annual 300A summary reporting. Serves as the BUSINESS_EVENT_TIMESTAMP (date precision) for this transaction.
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR Part 1904.29; OSHA Form 300

attributes.name: incident_description
attributes.description: Narrative description of how the injury or illness occurred, including the sequence of events, equipment involved, and environmental conditions. Required for OSHA Form 301 and used for root cause analysis and corrective action planning.
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR Part 1904.29; OSHA Form 301 Section G

attributes.name: incident_number
attributes.description: Externally-known, human-readable business identifier for the incident (e.g., INC-2024-000123). Used in OSHA 300 log entries, workers comp filings, client communications, and regulatory correspondence. Serves as the BUSINESS_IDENTIFIER for this transaction.
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR Part 1904.29; OSHA Form 300

attributes.name: incident_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the OSHA incident record. 'open' indicates active investigation; 'under_review' indicates pending recordability determination; 'closed' indicates fully resolved with corrective actions documented; 'appealed' indicates contested recordability; 'voided' indicates duplicate or erroneous entry.
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR Part 1904; ASA Safety Standards

attributes.name: incident_time
attributes.description: The time of day (HH:MM, 24-hour format) at which the workplace incident occurred. Used for shift-pattern analysis, root cause investigation, and OSHA 300 log documentation.
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR Part 1904.29; OSHA Form 301

attributes.name: injury_illness_type
attributes.description: OSHA-defined classification of the nature of the workplace injury or illness. Maps directly to the OSHA Form 300 column headers: injury, skin disorder, respiratory condition, poisoning, hearing loss, or all other illness. Required for OSHA 300 log and 300A annual summary.
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR Part 1904.7; OSHA Form 300 Column M

attributes.name: injury_nature
attributes.description: Detailed description of the specific nature of the injury or illness (e.g., laceration, fracture, sprain, burn, contusion, amputation, concussion). Provides granularity beyond the OSHA Form 300 type classification for root cause analysis and trend reporting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: laceration|fracture|sprain|strain|burn|contusion|amputation|concussion|puncture|abrasion|dislocation|crush_injury — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR Part 1904; BLS Occupational Injury and Illness Classification Manual (OIICS)

attributes.name: investigation_completed_date
attributes.description: The date on which the formal incident investigation was completed and the investigation report was finalized. Used to track investigation timeliness and ensure compliance with internal safety program SLAs.
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR Part 1904; ASA Safety Standards; ANSI/ASSE Z10

attributes.name: is_fatality
attributes.description: Indicates whether the incident resulted in the death of the worker. True = fatality. Triggers mandatory OSHA reporting within 8 hours of employer knowledge under 29 CFR Part 1904.39 and activates escalation protocols.
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR Part 1904.39; OSHA Severe Injury Reporting Rule

attributes.name: is_hospitalized
attributes.description: Indicates whether the worker was admitted to a hospital (inpatient) as a result of the incident. True = inpatient hospitalization. Triggers mandatory OSHA reporting within 24 hours under 29 CFR Part 1904.39.
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR Part 1904.39; OSHA Severe Injury Reporting Rule

attributes.name: is_osha_recordable
attributes.description: Indicates whether the incident meets OSHA recordability criteria under 29 CFR Part 1904.7 (i.e., results in days away from work, restricted duty, medical treatment beyond first aid, loss of consciousness, or diagnosis of a significant injury/illness). True = recordable; False = first-aid only. Drives OSHA 300 log entry requirement.
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR Part 1904.7; OSHA Recordkeeping Rule

attributes.name: is_privacy_case
attributes.description: Indicates whether this incident qualifies as a privacy case under OSHA recordkeeping rules (e.g., sexual assault, mental illness, HIV/AIDS, needlestick, tuberculosis). True = privacy case. When true, the worker's name must be withheld from the OSHA 300 log and replaced with 'privacy case'.
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR Part 1904.29(b)(6)-(10); OSHA Privacy Case Rules

attributes.name: ita_submission_reference
attributes.description: The confirmation identifier returned by OSHA's Injury Tracking Application (ITA) upon electronic submission of the OSHA 300A annual summary data. Required for establishments with 250+ employees or in high-hazard industries under the OSHA Electronic Recordkeeping Rule.
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR Part 1904.41; OSHA Electronic Recordkeeping Rule (ITA)

attributes.name: naics_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: North American Industry Classification System (NAICS) Code
attributes.description: The six-digit NAICS code for the client establishment where the incident occurred. Required for OSHA 300A annual summary and OSHA electronic submission (ITA/OSHA Data Collection) to classify the industry for benchmarking incidence rates.
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR Part 1904.32; OSHA Form 300A; BLS NAICS Classification

attributes.name: osha_300_log_entry_number
attributes.description: The sequential entry number assigned to this incident on the OSHA Form 300 (Log of Work-Related Injuries and Illnesses) for the applicable calendar year. Required for OSHA 300A annual summary reconciliation and regulatory audit. Null if incident is not recordable.
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR Part 1904.29; OSHA Form 300

attributes.name: osha_300_log_year
attributes.description: The calendar year of the OSHA Form 300 log in which this incident is recorded. Used to partition OSHA 300A annual summary reporting and multi-year trend analysis.
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR Part 1904.32; OSHA Form 300A

attributes.name: osha_report_submitted
attributes.description: Indicates whether the required OSHA severe injury report (fatality, amputation, loss of eye, or inpatient hospitalization) has been submitted to OSHA within the mandated timeframe (8 hours for fatalities, 24 hours for other severe injuries).
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR Part 1904.39; OSHA Severe Injury Reporting Rule

attributes.name: osha_report_submitted_timestamp
attributes.description: The exact date and time at which the OSHA severe injury report was submitted to OSHA (via phone or online). Used to verify compliance with the 8-hour (fatality) and 24-hour (severe injury) reporting deadlines under 29 CFR Part 1904.39.
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR Part 1904.39; OSHA Severe Injury Reporting Rule

attributes.name: outcome_type
attributes.description: The most severe outcome classification of the incident per OSHA recordkeeping hierarchy: fatality, days away from work, restricted duty or job transfer, medical treatment beyond first aid, or first aid only. Maps to OSHA Form 300 columns G through J. Drives recordability and severity classification.
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR Part 1904.7; OSHA Form 300 Columns G-J

attributes.name: recordability_determination_date
attributes.description: The date on which the safety officer or compliance team made the final determination of whether the incident is OSHA recordable. Required for audit trail and to ensure timely OSHA 300 log entry within the 7-calendar-day requirement.
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR Part 1904.29(b)(3); OSHA Recordkeeping Rule

attributes.name: reported_date
attributes.description: The date on which the incident was formally reported to the staffing agency or client safety officer. Used to measure reporting lag compliance against OSHA 24-hour and 8-hour reporting requirements for severe injuries.
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR Part 1904.39; OSHA Severe Injury Reporting Rule

attributes.name: return_to_work_date
attributes.description: The date on which the injured worker returned to full or modified duty following the incident. Used to calculate actual days away from work, manage assignment continuity, and track workers comp claim closure.
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR Part 1904.7; DOL Workers Compensation Guidelines; ASA Safety Standards

attributes.name: root_cause
attributes.description: Narrative or structured description of the underlying root cause(s) identified through incident investigation (e.g., inadequate training, equipment failure, unsafe work practice, environmental hazard, lack of PPE). Required for corrective action planning and OSHA compliance program documentation.
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR Part 1904; OSHA Injury and Illness Prevention Program (I2P2) Guidelines

attributes.name: root_cause_category
attributes.description: Standardized categorical classification of the primary root cause of the incident. Enables structured trend analysis and corrective action program tracking across the contingent workforce portfolio. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: human_error|equipment_failure|environmental|process_deficiency|training_gap|ppe_failure|other — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR Part 1904; ASA Safety Standards; ANSI/ASSE Z10 Occupational Health and Safety Management Systems

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this OSHA incident record was last modified. Serves as the RECORD_AUDIT_UPDATED field for audit trail, change tracking, and data lineage purposes.
attributes.references: SOC 2 Type II; OSHA 29 CFR Part 1904

attributes.name: worker_job_title
attributes.description: The job title or occupation of the contingent worker at the time of the incident. Required for OSHA Form 301 and used for occupation-level risk analysis and EEOC/OFCCP workforce safety reporting.
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR Part 1904.29; OSHA Form 301; EEOC Reporting Requirements

attributes.name: worker_tenure_days
attributes.description: The number of days the worker had been on the current assignment at the client site at the time of the incident. Used for new-worker safety risk analysis, as OSHA data consistently shows elevated injury rates in the first 90 days of an assignment.
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR Part 1904; ASA Safety Standards; OSHA Temporary Worker Initiative

attributes.name: workers_comp_policy_id
attributes.description: Reference to the associated workers compensation insurance claim filed in TempWorks Payroll or the workers comp carrier system. Links the OSHA incident record to the financial claim for injury cost tracking.
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR Part 1904; IRS Workers Compensation Rules; DOL FECA

products.name: coe_risk_assessment
products.description: Master record for co-employment (Co-E) and joint employment risk assessments conducted for client engagements. Captures assessment date, client account, engagement type (temp, contract, SOW, managed service, RPO), risk factors evaluated (supervision level, equipment provision, integration into client workforce, assignment duration, client control over work methods, disciplinary authority, pay rate setting), risk rating (low/medium/high/critical), recommended mitigation actions (contract language, worker communication protocols, supervisor training, co-employment insurance rider), legal counsel review status, and reassessment schedule. SSOT for co-employment liability management per DOL joint employer standards, NLRB Browning-Ferris framework, and state-specific joint employer tests. Critical for staffing firms where co-employment is the #1 structural legal risk.

attributes.name: coe_risk_assessment_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each co-employment and joint employment risk assessment record. Primary key for the coe_risk_assessment data product. Entity role: TRANSACTION_HEADER — represents a discrete compliance assessment event with its own lifecycle.
attributes.references: DOL Joint Employer Standards; NLRB Browning-Ferris Industries Decision (2015)

attributes.name: assignment_id

attributes.name: client_account_id

attributes.references: DOL Joint Employer Rule; NLRB Browning-Ferris Framework

attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link
