attributes.name: state_province_code
attributes.description: Two-letter state or province code for the establishment location.

attributes.name: total_employee_count
attributes.description: Total number of employees working at this establishment for EEOC and OFCCP headcount reporting.

attributes.name: workers_compensation_policy_number
attributes.description: Policy number for workers compensation insurance coverage at this establishment.

attributes.name: parent_establishment_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on establishment (parent_establishment_id)

domains.name: credentialing
domains.description: Owns all candidate credential, certification, license, screening verification, and qualification data. Covers BGC (Background Check) results from Sterling, drug screen outcomes, professional license verification, skills assessments, training records, skill validations, credential expiration tracking, renewal requirements, and compliance with industry-specific certification mandates. Supports credentialing requirements for healthcare, IT, skilled trades, finance, government, and other specialized staffing verticals.
domains.references: FCRA (Fair Credit Reporting Act) / ASA Credentialing Standards

products.name: credential
products.description: Master record for every credential, certification, license, qualification, immunization, or safety certification type recognized by Staffing Hr across all staffing verticals (healthcare, IT, skilled trades, finance, government). Defines the credential taxonomy including credential name, issuing authority, governing body, credential category (license, certification, clearance, assessment, immunization, safety_certification), applicable industry vertical, required renewal cycle, expiration rules, and whether the credential is mandatory for placement eligibility. Covers professional licenses (RN, CPA, PE, CDL), safety certifications (OSHA 10/30/510), immunizations (Hep B, MMR, TB, COVID-19), security clearances, and skills assessments. This is the SSOT for credential definitions — distinct from a candidate's actual held credential instance.

attributes.name: credential_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated identifier for each credential definition record. This is the primary key for the credential master catalog. Entity role: MASTER_RESOURCE — this product defines the taxonomy of credential types recognized by Staffing Hr, not a candidate-held instance.
attributes.references: ISO 30405:2016 Human Resource Management

attributes.name: advance_notice_days
attributes.description: Number of days before expiration that the system should trigger a renewal notification to the candidate and recruiter (e.g., 30, 60, 90 days). Enables proactive credential management to prevent placement disruptions due to lapsed credentials.
attributes.references: American Staffing Association (ASA); ISO 30405:2016

attributes.name: assessment_passing_score
attributes.description: Minimum passing score required for skills assessments or competency tests associated with this credential type (e.g., 70.00 for 70%). Null for non-assessment credential types. Used to evaluate candidate assessment results against the required threshold.
attributes.references: ISO 30405:2016; SHRM; American Staffing Association (ASA)

attributes.name: assessment_score_type
attributes.description: Defines how the assessment result is measured and reported for this credential type. Percentage (0-100%), raw score (numeric count), pass/fail (binary outcome), or grade (letter grade). Determines how passing_score is interpreted.

attributes.name: bgc_check_type
attributes.description: Specifies the type of background check (BGC) associated with this credential when it involves a Sterling Background Check screening. Drives the BGC order type submitted to Sterling. None indicates the credential does not involve a background check component. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: criminal|drug_screen|employment_verification|education_verification|license_verification|credit|none|reference_check|sex_offender|mvr — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Fair Credit Reporting Act (FCRA); Sterling Background Check; EEOC

attributes.name: ceu_hours_required
attributes.description: Number of Continuing Education Unit (CEU) or professional development hours required per renewal cycle for this credential. Null if CEU is not required. Used to validate renewal completeness before credential re-issuance.
attributes.references: ISO 30405:2016; SHRM; American Staffing Association (ASA)

attributes.name: ceu_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether this credential requires completion of Continuing Education Units (CEU) or Continuing Professional Development (CPD) hours as part of the renewal process. When True, the renewal workflow must capture CEU completion evidence.
attributes.references: ISO 30405:2016; SHRM; American Staffing Association (ASA)

attributes.name: clearance_level
attributes.description: For security clearance credential types, specifies the clearance level (e.g., Confidential, Secret, Top Secret, Top Secret/SCI). Null or 'none' for non-clearance credentials. Critical for government staffing vertical placement eligibility.
attributes.references: Office of Federal Contract Compliance Programs (OFCCP); U.S. Department of Labor (DOL)

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this credential definition record was first created in the Staffing Hr data platform. Supports audit trail, data lineage, and SOC 2 Type II compliance requirements.
attributes.references: SOC 2 Type II; GDPR Article 5; CCPA

attributes.name: credential_category
attributes.description: High-level classification of the credential type. Drives workflow routing, compliance rules, and renewal logic. Values: license (professional state/federal license), certification (industry-recognized cert), clearance (security clearance), assessment (skills/competency test), immunization (health/vaccination record), safety_certification (OSHA, HAZMAT, etc.). Satisfies MASTER_RESOURCE CLASSIFICATION_OR_TYPE category.
attributes.references: American Staffing Association (ASA); OSHA; INA I-9 Compliance

attributes.name: credential_code
attributes.description: Externally-known, human-readable unique code identifying this credential type across all systems (e.g., RN_LICENSE, OSHA_30, CDL_CLASS_A, CPA_CERT). Used as the business key in ATS, VMS, and compliance systems. Satisfies MASTER_RESOURCE BUSINESS_IDENTIFIER category.
attributes.references: American Staffing Association (ASA); ISO 30405:2016

attributes.name: credential_description
attributes.description: Full narrative description of the credential, including its purpose, scope, and any special requirements or conditions. Provides context for recruiters, compliance officers, and candidates about what the credential entails and why it is required.
attributes.references: ISO 30405:2016; American Staffing Association (ASA)

attributes.name: credential_name
attributes.description: Full human-readable name of the credential, certification, license, or qualification (e.g., 'Registered Nurse License', 'OSHA 30-Hour Construction Safety', 'Commercial Driver License Class A', 'Certified Public Accountant'). Satisfies MASTER_RESOURCE IDENTITY_LABEL category.
attributes.references: ISO 30405:2016; American Staffing Association (ASA)

attributes.name: credential_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of this credential definition in the Staffing Hr catalog. Active credentials are available for assignment to candidates and placement eligibility checks. Deprecated credentials are retained for historical reference only. Satisfies MASTER_RESOURCE LIFECYCLE_STATUS category.
attributes.references: ISO 30405:2016; American Staffing Association (ASA)

attributes.name: drug_screen_panel
attributes.description: Specifies the drug screening panel type when this credential involves a drug screen (e.g., '5-Panel', '10-Panel', '12-Panel', 'DOT 5-Panel'). Null if the credential does not involve drug screening. Aligns with DOT and employer-specific drug testing requirements.
attributes.references: U.S. Department of Transportation (DOT); U.S. Department of Labor (DOL); OSHA

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date from which this credential definition became active and applicable in the Staffing Hr catalog. Used to determine which credential definitions were in effect at any given point in time for historical compliance audits.
attributes.references: ISO 30405:2016; SOC 2 Type II

attributes.name: everify_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether this credential type triggers an E-Verify case submission requirement. Relevant for federal contractor placements and states with mandatory E-Verify laws. Integrates with the compliance.everify_case product.
attributes.references: Immigration and Nationality Act (INA) - I-9 Compliance; E-Verify; OFCCP

attributes.name: external_credential_code
attributes.description: The identifier for this credential type as recorded in the originating source system (e.g., Bullhorn credential type ID, Sterling check type code, SAP SuccessFactors qualification ID). Enables cross-system reconciliation and deduplication.
attributes.references: SOC 2 Type II; American Staffing Association (ASA)

attributes.name: flsa_relevance
attributes.description: Indicates whether this credential is relevant to FLSA worker classification determinations (e.g., professional exemption credentials like CPA, PE, RN may support exempt classification). Supports wage and hour compliance analysis.
attributes.references: Fair Labor Standards Act (FLSA); U.S. Department of Labor (DOL); EEOC

attributes.name: governing_body
attributes.description: The regulatory or professional body that oversees and mandates this credential (e.g., 'EEOC', 'DOL', 'OSHA', 'OFCCP', 'ASA', 'SHRM', 'State Nursing Board'). May differ from the issuing authority. Used for regulatory reporting and compliance mapping.
attributes.references: EEOC; OFCCP; OSHA; U.S. Department of Labor (DOL); American Staffing Association (ASA)

attributes.name: grace_period_days
attributes.description: Number of days after the credential expiration date during which the credential is still considered valid for placement purposes (e.g., 30-day grace period while renewal is in process). Zero or null means no grace period is allowed.
attributes.references: American Staffing Association (ASA); U.S. Department of Labor (DOL)

attributes.name: i9_supporting_doc
attributes.description: Indicates whether this credential type can serve as a supporting document for I-9 Employment Eligibility Verification (e.g., U.S. Passport, Permanent Resident Card, Employment Authorization Document). Drives I-9 document collection workflows during onboarding.
attributes.references: Immigration and Nationality Act (INA) - I-9 Compliance; E-Verify; U.S. Department of Homeland Security

attributes.name: immunization_type
attributes.description: For immunization credential types, specifies the vaccine or immunization name (e.g., 'Hepatitis B', 'MMR', 'TB Test', 'COVID-19', 'Influenza', 'Varicella'). Null for non-immunization credentials. Required for healthcare staffing vertical compliance.
attributes.references: OSHA; U.S. Department of Labor (DOL); CDC Immunization Guidelines

attributes.name: industry_vertical
attributes.description: The staffing industry vertical for which this credential is applicable. Drives placement eligibility rules and compliance checks by vertical. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: healthcare|information_technology|skilled_trades|finance|government|general|education|energy|legal|manufacturing — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Staffing Industry Analysts (SIA); American Staffing Association (ASA)

attributes.name: is_expirable
attributes.description: Indicates whether this credential type has an expiration date. When True, candidate credential instances must track expiration and renewal. When False, the credential is considered permanent once earned (e.g., some degree-based certifications). Drives renewal workflow triggers.
attributes.references: ISO 30405:2016; American Staffing Association (ASA)

attributes.name: is_multi_state
attributes.description: Indicates whether this credential is recognized across multiple states or jurisdictions (e.g., Nurse Licensure Compact states, CDL federal reciprocity). When True, a single credential instance may satisfy requirements in multiple states. Relevant for travel staffing and multi-state workforce deployments.
attributes.references: Nurse Licensure Compact (NLC); U.S. Department of Transportation (DOT); FLSA

attributes.name: is_placement_mandatory
attributes.description: Indicates whether possession of this credential is a mandatory prerequisite for placement eligibility in the applicable industry vertical or job type. When True, candidates without a valid instance of this credential cannot be submitted or placed. Drives automated compliance gates in the ATS and VMS.
attributes.references: American Staffing Association (ASA); ISO 30405:2016; OFCCP

attributes.name: issuing_authority
attributes.description: Name of the organization, agency, or body that issues this credential (e.g., 'State Board of Nursing', 'OSHA', 'PMI', 'CompTIA', 'IRS', 'Department of Transportation'). Critical for verification routing and compliance validation.
attributes.references: U.S. Department of Labor (DOL); OSHA; IRS; ISO 30405:2016

attributes.name: issuing_country
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the country in which this credential is issued and recognized (e.g., USA, CAN, GBR). Supports international staffing operations and GDPR/CCPA compliance scoping.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1; GDPR; CCPA; Immigration and Nationality Act (INA)

attributes.name: issuing_state_province
attributes.description: Two-letter state or province code where this credential is issued and valid (e.g., CA, NY, TX). Applicable for state-specific professional licenses (e.g., state nursing licenses, state CPA licenses, state CDL). Null for nationally or internationally recognized credentials.
attributes.references: U.S. Department of Labor (DOL); FLSA; ISO 30405:2016

attributes.name: license_number_format
attributes.description: Regular expression or format pattern that defines the valid format for license or certification numbers issued under this credential type (e.g., '^RN[0-9]{6}$' for a state nursing license). Used for data validation when candidates enter their credential instance details.
attributes.references: ISO 30405:2016; American Staffing Association (ASA)

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text operational notes or special instructions related to this credential type (e.g., 'Requires notarized copy', 'Must be verified within 30 days of placement start', 'Accepted only from accredited institutions'). Visible to credentialing coordinators and compliance staff.
attributes.references: American Staffing Association (ASA)

attributes.name: osha_standard_ref
attributes.description: For safety certifications, the specific OSHA standard or regulation that mandates or governs this credential (e.g., '29 CFR 1926.503' for fall protection, '29 CFR 1910.120' for HAZWOPER). Null for non-safety credentials. Supports OSHA compliance reporting.
attributes.references: Occupational Safety and Health Administration (OSHA); U.S. Department of Labor (DOL)

attributes.name: redeployment_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether a valid instance of this credential contributes to a candidate's eligibility for redeployment to a new assignment without re-credentialing. Supports the redeployment workflow in the placement domain.
attributes.references: American Staffing Association (ASA); ISO 30405:2016

attributes.name: renewal_cycle_months
attributes.description: Standard renewal period for this credential expressed in months (e.g., 12 for annual, 24 for biennial, 36 for triennial). Null if the credential does not expire. Used to calculate expected renewal dates and trigger advance notification workflows. Satisfies MASTER_RESOURCE MEASUREMENT_OR_VALUE category.
attributes.references: ISO 30405:2016; U.S. Department of Labor (DOL); OSHA

attributes.name: retirement_date
attributes.description: The date on which this credential definition was retired or deprecated from the Staffing Hr catalog. Null if the credential is still active. Retained for historical reference and audit trail purposes.
attributes.references: ISO 30405:2016; SOC 2 Type II

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Identifies the operational system of record from which this credential definition originated (e.g., Bullhorn ATS, Sterling Background Check, SAP SuccessFactors, Beeline VMS). Supports data lineage and master data management reconciliation.
attributes.references: SOC 2 Type II; ISO 30405:2016

attributes.name: subcategory
attributes.description: More granular classification within the credential category (e.g., within 'license': nursing, engineering, financial, transportation; within 'certification': project management, IT, healthcare). Enables fine-grained filtering and reporting across staffing verticals.
attributes.references: American Staffing Association (ASA); Staffing Industry Analysts (SIA)

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this credential definition record was last modified in the Staffing Hr data platform. Supports change tracking, audit trail, and data quality monitoring.
attributes.references: SOC 2 Type II; GDPR Article 5; CCPA

attributes.name: verification_method
attributes.description: The required method for verifying this credential type. Primary source verification contacts the issuing authority directly (required for healthcare licenses). Document review accepts copies of certificates. Third-party uses services like Sterling Background Check. Self-attestation accepts candidate declaration. Automated uses API-based verification.
attributes.references: Fair Credit Reporting Act (FCRA); Sterling Background Check; ISO 30405:2016; SHRM

attributes.name: verification_source
attributes.description: The specific system, database, or service used to verify this credential (e.g., 'Sterling Background Check', 'NURSYS National Nurse License Verification', 'SAM.gov Exclusions', 'State DOT CDL Database', 'FINRA BrokerCheck'). Informs the verification workflow routing.
attributes.references: Fair Credit Reporting Act (FCRA); Sterling Background Check; U.S. Department of Labor (DOL)

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: Incrementing version number for this credential definition record, supporting optimistic concurrency control and change history tracking. Incremented each time the credential definition is materially updated (e.g., renewal cycle change, new governing body).
attributes.references: SOC 2 Type II; ISO 30405:2016

products.name: credential_instance
products.description: Transactional record capturing a specific credential held by a candidate — the instance of a credential type owned by a worker. Tracks credential number, issuing authority, issue date, expiration date, current verification status (pending, verified, expired, revoked), verification method, verification date, source system (Sterling BGC, manual upload, third-party registry), and extended attributes for specialized credential types (e.g., lot number and titer results for immunizations, card number for OSHA certifications, clearance level/granting agency/investigation type/polygraph details for security clearances). Also owns the full renewal lifecycle for the credential instance: renewal application date, submission date, renewal authority, renewal fee, renewal status (initiated, submitted, approved, denied, pending_documentation), new expiration date upon approval, and CEU requirements fulfilled. This is the operational SSOT for 'does this candidate currently hold this credential?' and 'what is the renewal status?' — drives placement eligibility checks, expiry alerting, and renewal workflows.

attributes.name: credential_instance_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated surrogate key identifying a specific credential instance held by a candidate. This is the primary key for the credential_instance product and serves as the operational SSOT identifier for placement eligibility checks, expiry alerting, and renewal workflows.
attributes.references: ISO 30405:2016 Human Resource Management

attributes.name: bgc_order_id
attributes.description: The Sterling Background Check order identifier associated with this credential instance when the credential category is 'background_check' or 'drug_screen'. Enables direct lookup and reconciliation with Sterling BGC system records.
attributes.references: FCRA; Sterling Background Check; ASA Credentialing Standards

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to credentialing.credential_document. attributes.description: The number of days before expiration at which automated renewal alerts should be triggered for this credential instance. Allows per-credential override of the default system alert threshold to accommodate varying renewal lead times by credential type.

attributes.name: bgc_result
attributes.description: The adjudicated result of the background check from Sterling BGC. 'Clear' = no disqualifying findings; 'Consider' = findings requiring individualized assessment per FCRA adverse action rules; 'Adverse' = disqualifying finding. Applicable only when credential_category = 'background_check'.
attributes.references: FCRA; EEOC; Sterling Background Check; ASA

attributes.name: ceu_completed
attributes.description: The number of Continuing Education Units (CEUs) or contact hours the candidate has completed toward the current renewal cycle requirement. Compared against ceu_required to determine renewal readiness.
attributes.references: ASA Credentialing Standards; SHRM; SAP SuccessFactors LMS

attributes.name: ceu_required
attributes.description: The total number of Continuing Education Units (CEUs) or contact hours required to renew this credential for the current renewal cycle. Used to track renewal readiness and drive learning management system (LMS) enrollment recommendations.
attributes.references: ASA Credentialing Standards; SHRM; ISO 30405:2016

attributes.name: clearance_granting_agency
attributes.description: The U.S. government agency that granted the security clearance (e.g., 'DoD', 'DHS', 'CIA', 'NSA'). Applicable only when credential_category = 'security_clearance'. Required for government contract staffing compliance.
attributes.references: OFCCP; Executive Order 12968; DOD 5200.2-R

attributes.name: clearance_level
attributes.description: The U.S. government security clearance level granted to the candidate. Applicable only when credential_category = 'security_clearance'. Drives eligibility for government and defense staffing placements requiring cleared personnel.
attributes.references: INA; OFCCP; Executive Order 12968; DOD 5200.2-R

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this credential instance record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail requirements under SOC 2 Type II, FCRA, and GDPR data processing records.
attributes.references: SOC 2 Type II; GDPR Article 30; FCRA

attributes.name: credential_category
attributes.description: High-level classification of the credential type for reporting and eligibility filtering. Drives specialized attribute applicability (e.g., titer results for immunizations, clearance level for security clearances). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: license|certification|background_check|drug_screen|immunization|security_clearance|training|assessment|education — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ASA Credentialing Standards; SHRM; DOL

attributes.name: days_until_expiration
attributes.description: Calculated number of calendar days remaining until this credential expires as of the last refresh. Stored for alerting threshold comparisons and dashboard KPI reporting without requiring real-time date arithmetic. Negative values indicate already-expired credentials.
attributes.references: ASA Credentialing Standards; Power BI Analytics Platform

attributes.name: document_url
attributes.description: Secure URL or storage path to the scanned or digital copy of the credential document (certificate, license card, BGC report, immunization record) stored in the document management system. Access is role-restricted per SOC 2 Type II controls.
attributes.references: SOC 2 Type II; FCRA; GDPR Article 5; CCPA

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: The date on which this credential instance expires and is no longer valid for placement purposes. Null indicates a non-expiring credential. Drives automated expiry alerting and renewal workflow initiation.
attributes.references: ASA Credentialing Standards; DOL; OSHA; SHRM

attributes.name: investigation_type
attributes.description: The type of background investigation conducted for the security clearance (e.g., NACLC, SSBI, Tier 1-5). Applicable only when credential_category = 'security_clearance'. Determines depth of vetting and clearance eligibility.
attributes.references: SEAD 4; Executive Order 13467; OFCCP

attributes.name: is_placement_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether this credential instance currently satisfies placement eligibility requirements. Computed and stored as an operational flag to enable fast eligibility gate checks in the Bullhorn ATS without real-time recalculation. True = eligible; False = ineligible.
attributes.references: ASA Credentialing Standards; DOL; OSHA

attributes.name: is_primary
attributes.description: Indicates whether this is the primary active instance of this credential type for the candidate when multiple instances exist (e.g., multi-state licenses, renewed credentials with overlapping validity). True = primary instance used for eligibility checks.
attributes.references: ASA Credentialing Standards; Bullhorn ATS/CRM

attributes.name: issue_date
attributes.description: The date on which the issuing authority originally issued or granted this credential to the candidate. Used to calculate credential age, validity windows, and continuing education unit (CEU) cycle start dates.
attributes.references: ISO 30405:2016; ASA Credentialing Standards

attributes.name: issuing_authority_name
attributes.description: The name of the organization, government body, or professional association that issued this credential (e.g., 'State of California Board of Registered Nursing', 'OSHA Training Institute', 'PMI', 'DOT'). Used for primary source verification routing.
attributes.references: ISO 30405:2016; ASA Credentialing Standards; SHRM

attributes.name: issuing_country
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the country in which this credential was issued. Supports international staffing operations and GDPR/CCPA compliance for cross-border credential data.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1; GDPR; CCPA; INA

attributes.name: issuing_state
attributes.description: The U.S. state (two-letter USPS abbreviation) or country subdivision in which this credential was issued. Critical for multi-state license portability analysis and compact license determinations (e.g., Nurse Licensure Compact).
attributes.references: INA; DOL; SHRM; Nurse Licensure Compact

attributes.name: lot_number
attributes.description: The manufacturer lot number of the vaccine administered for immunization credentials. Applicable only when credential_category = 'immunization'. Required for healthcare facility compliance documentation and adverse event tracking.
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR 1910.1030; CDC; FDA; ASA Healthcare Staffing Standards

attributes.name: new_expiration_date
attributes.description: The updated expiration date assigned to this credential instance upon successful renewal approval. Populated when renewal_status = 'approved'. Replaces the prior expiration_date for ongoing validity tracking.
attributes.references: ASA Credentialing Standards; SHRM; DOL

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for credentialing coordinators to capture supplemental context about this credential instance — e.g., adjudication rationale for BGC 'consider' results, special conditions attached to a license, or renewal exception approvals.
attributes.references: FCRA Adverse Action Requirements; ASA Credentialing Standards

attributes.name: polygraph_completed
attributes.description: Indicates whether a polygraph examination was completed as part of the security clearance investigation. Applicable only when credential_category = 'security_clearance'. Required for TS/SCI and certain agency-specific clearances.
attributes.references: Executive Order 12968; DOD 5200.2-R; OFCCP

attributes.name: renewal_application_date
attributes.description: The date on which the candidate or staffing coordinator initiated the renewal application with the issuing authority. Marks the start of the renewal lifecycle and is used to calculate renewal processing lead time.
attributes.references: ASA Credentialing Standards; SHRM

attributes.name: renewal_authority_name
attributes.description: The name of the organization or body responsible for processing the credential renewal (may differ from the original issuing authority in cases of delegated renewal processing).
attributes.references: ASA Credentialing Standards; SHRM

attributes.name: renewal_fee_amount
attributes.description: The monetary fee charged by the issuing authority for processing the credential renewal. Used for cost tracking, candidate reimbursement workflows, and workforce program budgeting.
attributes.references: ASA Credentialing Standards; Oracle NetSuite ERP

attributes.name: renewal_fee_paid_by
attributes.description: Indicates which party is responsible for paying the credential renewal fee. Drives accounts payable routing and candidate reimbursement processing in Oracle NetSuite ERP.
attributes.references: ASA Credentialing Standards; Oracle NetSuite ERP; FLSA

attributes.name: renewal_status
attributes.description: Current state of the credential renewal lifecycle for this instance. Drives renewal workflow routing and compliance alerting. 'Pending_documentation' indicates the candidate must supply additional materials before the renewal authority can process the application.
attributes.references: ASA Credentialing Standards; SHRM; DOL

attributes.name: renewal_submission_date
attributes.description: The date on which the completed renewal application and supporting documentation were formally submitted to the issuing authority. Distinct from renewal_application_date (initiation) — this is the official submission date.
attributes.references: ASA Credentialing Standards; SHRM

attributes.name: source_system

products.name: bgc_result
products.description: Consolidated SSOT for all screening and verification outcome data returned from Sterling or another screening vendor. Each record represents a single component result within a background check order or standalone screening event. Captures the check component type (criminal_search, employment_verification, education_verification, reference_check, sex_offender_registry, global_watchlist, drug_screen, credit_check, MVR), result status (clear, consider, adverse, pending, negative, positive, dilute, adulterated, substituted), finding details, county/jurisdiction searched, adjudication decision, adverse action flag, FCRA compliance flags, result received timestamp, and component-specific extended attributes. Drug screen attributes: panel type (5/10/12-panel), specimen type (urine, hair, oral fluid), collection site, collection date, lab processing date, MRO review status and decision, DOT vs. non-DOT flag, substances detected. Education verification attributes: institution name, degree type, field of study, graduation date, verification source (NSC, direct institution, third-party), verification outcome. Employment verification attributes: employer name, employment dates, job title, verification method (direct, The Work Number/Equifax), discrepancies found. Reference check attributes: reference contact name, relationship to candidate, structured ratings (work quality, reliability, communication, rehire eligibility), verbatim comments, overall recommendation. One bgc_order produces multiple bgc_result records. This is the single authoritative source for all screening outcomes — no separate sub-type products exist.

attributes.references: INA I-9 Compliance; E-Verify Program (USCIS); OFCCP Federal Contractor Requirements

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date on which this credential requirement record ceases to be enforceable. Null indicates the requirement is open-ended with no planned end date. Used to manage time-bound client contract requirements or regulatory mandates with sunset provisions.
attributes.references: ISO 30405:2016; DocuSign CLM Contract Lifecycle

attributes.name: gap_analysis_blocking
attributes.description: Indicates whether a gap in this credential (missing or expired) will block a candidate submittal in the Applicant Tracking System (ATS). When True, the ATS prevents submission until the credential is satisfied. When False, a warning is raised but submission is permitted.
attributes.references: Bullhorn ATS/CRM Credentialing Workflow; ASA Quality of Submission (QoS) Standards

attributes.name: grace_period_days
attributes.description: Number of days after assignment start within which a non-pre-placement credential must be obtained and verified. Applicable only when applies_to_assignment_start is False. Enables phased onboarding for credentials that can be completed post-start.
attributes.references: ASA Credentialing Best Practices; Joint Commission Provisional Credentialing

attributes.name: i9_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether a completed I-9 Employment Eligibility Verification form is required before placement under this requirement. Standard for all US-based placements but may be explicitly flagged for audit and compliance tracking purposes.
attributes.references: INA I-9 Compliance; USCIS Form I-9; IRCA

attributes.name: industry_vertical
attributes.description: The staffing industry vertical for which this credential requirement applies. Healthcare may require Joint Commission credentials; Government may require security clearances; Skilled Trades may require OSHA certifications. Enables vertical-specific credentialing rule enforcement.
attributes.references: ASA Industry Sector Standards; Joint Commission; OSHA

attributes.name: is_mandatory
attributes.description: Indicates whether this credential is a hard requirement (mandatory) or a preferred qualification. When True, a candidate cannot be submitted or placed without satisfying this credential. When False, the credential is preferred but not blocking.
attributes.references: ASA Credentialing Best Practices; OFCCP Compliance Guidelines

attributes.name: issuing_authority
attributes.description: Name of the organization or regulatory body that issues or governs this credential (e.g., State Board of Nursing, OSHA, CompTIA, PMI, DOT). Used for primary source verification routing and compliance documentation.
attributes.references: Joint Commission; OSHA; DOL; State Licensing Boards

attributes.name: license_state_code
attributes.description: Two-letter US state code indicating the jurisdiction in which the professional license must be valid. Applicable for state-issued licenses such as RN, LPN, CPA, or contractor licenses. Null when the credential is federally issued or not state-specific.
attributes.references: INA I-9 Compliance; State Licensing Board Standards; SHRM

attributes.name: max_credential_age_days
attributes.description: Maximum age in days that a credential result remains valid from its completion or issue date. For example, a BGC result may only be valid for 365 days. After this period, a new credential must be obtained. Null indicates no age restriction.
attributes.references: FCRA; Sterling Background Check; ASA Credentialing Standards

attributes.name: oig_exclusion_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether an Office of Inspector General (OIG) exclusion list check is required as part of this credential requirement. Mandatory for healthcare staffing placements to ensure candidates are not excluded from federally funded programs.
attributes.references: OIG Exclusion Database; CMS Conditions of Participation; ASA Healthcare Staffing Standards

attributes.name: placement_type_code
attributes.description: Classification of the placement type to which this credential requirement applies when not tied to a specific job order. Supports requirement templates across placement categories such as Contract, Temp-to-Perm (Contract-to-Hire), Direct Hire, Statement of Work (SOW), or Per Diem engagements.
attributes.references: American Staffing Association (ASA) Placement Classification Standards

attributes.name: renewal_lead_time_days
attributes.description: Number of days before credential expiration that a renewal notification should be triggered. Enables proactive credentialing management to prevent assignment disruptions due to lapsed credentials. Applicable only when renewal_required is True.
attributes.references: ASA Credentialing Best Practices; Joint Commission Standards

attributes.name: renewal_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether this credential requires periodic renewal. When True, the system tracks expiration and triggers renewal workflows. When False, the credential is a one-time requirement (e.g., a completed training module with no expiry).
attributes.references: ISO 30405:2016; ASA Credentialing Best Practices

attributes.name: requirement_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of the credential requirement including scope, acceptable documentation, and any special instructions for recruiters or candidates. Supports recruiter guidance and candidate communication during the onboarding process.
attributes.references: ASA Credentialing Best Practices; ISO 30405:2016

attributes.name: requirement_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name or label for this credential requirement as displayed in the ATS, VMS, or credentialing portal. Examples: 'RN License - CA', 'OSHA 10 Certification', '7-Year Criminal Background Check', '10-Panel Drug Screen'. Used for recruiter-facing display and reporting.
attributes.references: Bullhorn ATS/CRM; ASA Credentialing Best Practices

attributes.name: requirement_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of this credential requirement record. ACTIVE requirements are enforced during candidate submission and onboarding. SUPERSEDED records have been replaced by a newer version. DRAFT records are pending approval before enforcement.
attributes.references: ISO 30405:2016 Human Resource Management

attributes.name: security_clearance_level
attributes.description: Required federal security clearance level for government staffing placements. Applicable when industry_vertical is GOVERNMENT. Values align with US federal clearance tiers: Public Trust, Secret, Top Secret, and Top Secret/Sensitive Compartmented Information (TS/SCI).
attributes.references: OFCCP; Executive Order 12968; NISPOM; DOD Security Clearance Standards

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Operational system of record from which this credential requirement originated. Bullhorn ATS/CRM for job-order-level requirements, Beeline VMS for program-level requirements, SAP SuccessFactors for onboarding-driven requirements, Sterling for BGC package mandates, or MANUAL for requirements entered directly.
attributes.references: Bullhorn ATS/CRM; Beeline VMS; SAP SuccessFactors; Sterling Background Check

attributes.name: source_system_req_code
attributes.description: The native identifier of this credential requirement record in the originating operational system (e.g., Bullhorn requirement ID, Beeline compliance rule ID). Supports data lineage, reconciliation, and bi-directional sync with source systems.
attributes.references: Bullhorn ATS/CRM; Beeline VMS; SAP SuccessFactors

attributes.name: training_course_code
attributes.description: Identifier for the specific training course or Learning Management System (LMS) module required when credential_category is TRAINING. Maps to the course catalog in SAP SuccessFactors Learning Management System. Examples include OSHA 10, OSHA 30, HIPAA Awareness, or client-specific safety training.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors LMS; OSHA Training Standards; HIPAA

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this credential requirement record. Used for change detection, incremental data loads, and audit trail maintenance in the Databricks Silver layer.
attributes.references: SOC 2 Type II; GDPR Article 5; ISO 30405:2016

attributes.name: verification_level
attributes.description: Required level of verification rigor for this credential. PRIMARY_SOURCE requires direct confirmation from the issuing authority (e.g., state licensing board). SELF_REPORTED accepts candidate attestation. THIRD_PARTY requires an independent verification vendor such as Sterling. EMPLOYER_VERIFIED requires confirmation from a prior employer.
attributes.references: FCRA; Joint Commission Credentialing Standards; ISO 30405:2016

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: Sequential version number of this credential requirement record. Incremented each time the requirement is modified. Supports audit trails and historical analysis of how credentialing rules have evolved over time for a given job order or placement type.
attributes.references: ISO 30405:2016; SOC 2 Type II Audit Trail Requirements

attributes.name: waiver_allowed
attributes.description: Indicates whether a client or compliance officer can grant a waiver for this credential requirement on a case-by-case basis. When True, a waiver workflow is available in the ATS. When False, no exceptions are permitted regardless of circumstances.
attributes.references: ASA Credentialing Best Practices; Client MSA Waiver Provisions

attributes.name: waiver_approval_level
attributes.description: The organizational role level required to approve a waiver for this credential requirement. Applicable only when waiver_allowed is True. Drives the waiver approval workflow routing in the ATS and compliance management system.
attributes.references: ASA Credentialing Best Practices; SOC 2 Type II Access Control

products.name: adverse_action
products.description: Transactional record managing the FCRA-mandated adverse action process triggered when a BGC result leads to a decision not to hire or place a candidate. Captures the pre-adverse action notice date, candidate notification method, dispute period start and end dates, candidate dispute response, final adverse action notice date, basis for adverse action (specific BGC finding reference), individualized assessment performed flag, EEOC compliance review flag, and final disposition (withdrawn, confirmed, overturned). Critical for FCRA, EEOC, and OFCCP compliance in the staffing industry. Supports the full pre-adverse → dispute → final adverse action workflow required by federal and state fair chance hiring laws. Note: This product captures the credentialing-triggered adverse action workflow; the compliance domain may own broader FCRA reporting and regulatory audit aggregation. Cross-domain SSOT boundary requires global architect resolution.
products.reference: Adverse Action / FCRA Adverse Action Notice

attributes.name: adverse_action_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated identifier for the adverse action record. Primary key for the adverse_action data product. Entity role: TRANSACTION_HEADER — represents a discrete FCRA-mandated compliance workflow event with a clear lifecycle.
attributes.references: Fair Credit Reporting Act (FCRA) § 615

attributes.name: assignment_id
attributes.description: Reference to the placement record if the adverse action was triggered post-placement (e.g., during a periodic re-screen). Nullable when adverse action occurs pre-placement during the hiring process.
attributes.references: Fair Credit Reporting Act (FCRA) § 615; Bullhorn ATS/CRM

attributes.name: bgc_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the Background Check (BGC) order from Sterling that triggered this adverse action workflow. Links the adverse action to the specific screening result that was the basis for the adverse decision.
attributes.references: Fair Credit Reporting Act (FCRA) § 604; Sterling Background Check

attributes.name: bgc_result_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to credentialing.bgc_result. Business justification: adverse_action is triggered by a specific finding in a bgc_result record. Currently adverse_action → bgc_order, but bgc_order can have MULTIPLE bgc_result records (one per check component: criminal, e
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: client_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the client account for whose position the candidate was being considered. Supports client-level adverse action reporting, SLA compliance, and MSA audit requirements.
attributes.references: Fair Credit Reporting Act (FCRA); Bullhorn ATS/CRM; MSA

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Adverse action compliance costs allocated to cost centers for legal/compliance expense tracking by department. Supports risk management cost analysis and departmental budget monitoring.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: credential_instance_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to credentialing.credential_instance. Business justification: An adverse action may be triggered by a specific credential instance failure (e.g., expired license, failed drug screen). This allows tracking which credential instance caused the adverse action. No c
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: gl_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.gl_account. Business justification: Legal and compliance costs from adverse action processes posted to GL accounts for compliance expense tracking and financial reporting. Required for accurate legal expense recognition.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: order_header_id
attributes.description: Reference to the job order (requisition) for which the candidate was being considered when the adverse action was triggered. Provides context for the position type and client requirements that informed the adverse decision.
attributes.references: Fair Credit Reporting Act (FCRA) § 615; Bullhorn ATS/CRM

attributes.name: profile_id
attributes.description: Reference to the candidate subject to the adverse action process. PARTY_REFERENCE category per TRANSACTION_HEADER role minimum requirements. Links to the candidate master record in Bullhorn ATS.
attributes.references: Fair Credit Reporting Act (FCRA) § 615; EEOC Enforcement Guidance

attributes.name: action_number
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier for the adverse action case, used in candidate correspondence, compliance audits, and regulatory reporting. Format typically follows AA-YYYY-NNNNNN. BUSINESS_IDENTIFIER category per TRANSACTION_HEADER role minimum requirements.
attributes.references: Fair Credit Reporting Act (FCRA) § 615; OFCCP Compliance

attributes.name: action_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the adverse action workflow. Tracks progression from pre-adverse notice through dispute period to final disposition. LIFECYCLE_STATUS category per TRANSACTION_HEADER role minimum requirements. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: pre_adverse_notice_sent|dispute_period_open|dispute_received|under_individualized_assessment|final_adverse_issued|withdrawn|overturned — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Fair Credit Reporting Act (FCRA) § 615(a); EEOC Enforcement Guidance on Consideration of Arrest and Conviction Records

attributes.name: applicable_jurisdiction
attributes.description: State or local jurisdiction whose fair chance or adverse action laws govern this case, in addition to federal FCRA requirements. Stored as two-letter US state code or city/state combination (e.g., CA, NYC-NY). Determines additional procedural requirements.
attributes.references: California AB 1008; NYC Fair Chance Act; FCRA; American Staffing Association (ASA)

attributes.name: candidate_notified_of_cra_rights
attributes.business_glossary_term: Candidate Notified of Consumer Reporting Agency (CRA) Rights Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the candidate was informed of their right to dispute the accuracy or completeness of the consumer report directly with the CRA, as required by FCRA § 615(a)(1)(C).
attributes.references: Fair Credit Reporting Act (FCRA) § 615(a)(1)(C); FTC FCRA Guidance

attributes.name: client_required_action
attributes.description: Indicates whether the adverse action was initiated at the client's request based on their screening standards, as opposed to the staffing firm's own adjudication policy. Relevant for co-employment risk management and MSA compliance.
attributes.references: Fair Credit Reporting Act (FCRA); American Staffing Association (ASA) Co-Employment Guidelines; MSA

attributes.name: consumer_reporting_agency_name
attributes.description: Name of the Consumer Reporting Agency (CRA) that provided the BGC report used as the basis for the adverse action (e.g., Sterling Talent Solutions). FCRA requires the CRA name, address, and phone be included in the adverse action notice.
attributes.references: Fair Credit Reporting Act (FCRA) § 615(a)(1)(B); FTC FCRA Guidance

attributes.name: copy_of_report_provided
attributes.business_glossary_term: Copy of BGC Report Provided Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a copy of the consumer report (BGC report) was provided to the candidate with the pre-adverse action notice, as required by FCRA § 615(a)(1)(A).
attributes.references: Fair Credit Reporting Act (FCRA) § 615(a)(1)(A); Sterling Background Check

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the adverse action record was first created in the system, marking the initiation of the FCRA adverse action workflow. RECORD_AUDIT_CREATED category per TRANSACTION_HEADER role minimum requirements.
attributes.references: SOC 2 Type II; Fair Credit Reporting Act (FCRA); ISO 30405:2016

attributes.name: disposition_date
attributes.description: Date the final disposition was recorded, marking the closure of the adverse action workflow. Used for compliance reporting timelines and SLA measurement.
attributes.references: Fair Credit Reporting Act (FCRA) § 615; American Staffing Association (ASA) Compliance Guidelines

attributes.name: disposition_reason
attributes.description: Narrative explanation for the final disposition, particularly when the adverse action was withdrawn or overturned. Documents the business rationale for compliance audit purposes.
attributes.references: Fair Credit Reporting Act (FCRA) § 615; OFCCP Compliance

attributes.name: dispute_period_end_date
attributes.description: Date the candidate dispute period expires. FCRA requires a reasonable waiting period (commonly 5 business days) before a final adverse action notice may be issued. Final adverse action cannot be issued before this date.
attributes.references: Fair Credit Reporting Act (FCRA) § 615(a)(1); FTC FCRA Guidance

attributes.name: dispute_period_start_date
attributes.description: Date the candidate dispute period begins, typically the same as or the day after the pre-adverse action notice date. Marks the start of the minimum waiting period during which the candidate may dispute the BGC findings.
attributes.references: Fair Credit Reporting Act (FCRA) § 615(a)(1); FTC FCRA Guidance

attributes.name: dispute_received
attributes.description: Indicates whether the candidate submitted a formal dispute of the BGC findings during the dispute period. Drives the individualized assessment and review workflow when True.
attributes.references: Fair Credit Reporting Act (FCRA) § 611; EEOC Enforcement Guidance

attributes.name: dispute_received_date
attributes.description: Date the candidate's formal dispute response was received by the staffing organization. Nullable when no dispute was submitted. Triggers the individualized assessment review process.
attributes.references: Fair Credit Reporting Act (FCRA) § 611; EEOC Enforcement Guidance

attributes.name: dispute_response_summary
attributes.description: Summary of the candidate's dispute response content, including any mitigating information, documentation, or explanation provided by the candidate regarding the BGC findings. Confidential business record supporting the individualized assessment.
attributes.references: Fair Credit Reporting Act (FCRA) § 611; EEOC Enforcement Guidance on Consideration of Arrest and Conviction Records (2012)

attributes.name: document_reference_code
attributes.description: Reference identifier for the adverse action notice documents stored in the document management system (e.g., DocuSign CLM). Links to the pre-adverse and final adverse action notice documents for audit retrieval.
attributes.references: Fair Credit Reporting Act (FCRA) § 615; DocuSign CLM; SOC 2 Type II

attributes.name: eeoc_review_completed
attributes.business_glossary_term: Equal Employment Opportunity Commission (EEOC) Compliance Review Completed Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether an EEOC compliance review was performed as part of the adverse action process, confirming the decision does not constitute unlawful discrimination based on protected class characteristics.
attributes.references: EEOC Enforcement Guidance; Title VII of the Civil Rights Act; OFCCP Compliance

attributes.name: final_adverse_notice_date
attributes.description: Date the final adverse action notice was issued to the candidate after the dispute period expired and any dispute review was completed. Must be on or after the dispute_period_end_date. Nullable until final adverse action is issued.
attributes.references: Fair Credit Reporting Act (FCRA) § 615(a)(2); 15 U.S.C. § 1681m

attributes.name: final_adverse_notice_method
attributes.business_glossary_term: Final Adverse Action Notice Delivery Method
attributes.description: Method used to deliver the final adverse action notice to the candidate. Required for FCRA compliance documentation.
attributes.references: Fair Credit Reporting Act (FCRA) § 615(a)(2); FTC FCRA Guidance

attributes.name: final_disposition
attributes.description: Final outcome of the adverse action process. Confirmed = adverse action upheld and candidate not hired/placed. Withdrawn = staffing firm withdrew the adverse action (e.g., position filled, business decision). Overturned = adverse action reversed after dispute review, candidate cleared for placement.
attributes.references: Fair Credit Reporting Act (FCRA) § 615; EEOC Enforcement Guidance

attributes.name: individualized_assessment_date
attributes.description: Date the individualized assessment was completed. Nullable when no individualized assessment was required (e.g., non-criminal BGC findings). Documents the timeline of the EEOC-compliant review process.
attributes.references: EEOC Enforcement Guidance on Consideration of Arrest and Conviction Records (2012)

attributes.name: individualized_assessment_notes
attributes.description: Documented rationale and findings from the individualized assessment, including evaluation of offense nature, time elapsed since offense, and nexus to the job duties. Required for EEOC and OFCCP audit defense.
attributes.references: EEOC Enforcement Guidance on Consideration of Arrest and Conviction Records (2012); OFCCP Compliance

attributes.name: individualized_assessment_performed
attributes.description: Indicates whether an individualized assessment was conducted before issuing the final adverse action, as required by EEOC guidance for criminal record-based adverse actions. Evaluates the nature of the offense, time elapsed, and job relevance.
attributes.references: EEOC Enforcement Guidance on Consideration of Arrest and Conviction Records (2012); OFCCP Compliance

attributes.name: legal_review_date
attributes.description: Date legal review was completed for this adverse action case. Nullable when legal_review_required is False. Documents the legal clearance timeline for compliance audit purposes.
attributes.references: Fair Credit Reporting Act (FCRA); EEOC Enforcement Guidance

attributes.name: legal_review_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether this adverse action case was escalated for legal review prior to issuing the final adverse action notice, typically triggered by complex criminal history, dispute responses, or high-risk jurisdictions.
attributes.references: Fair Credit Reporting Act (FCRA); EEOC Enforcement Guidance; American Staffing Association (ASA)

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes field for compliance officers to document additional context, escalation details, or case-specific observations not captured in structured fields.
attributes.references: Fair Credit Reporting Act (FCRA); American Staffing Association (ASA) Compliance Guidelines

attributes.name: ofccp_review_completed
attributes.business_glossary_term: Office of Federal Contract Compliance Programs (OFCCP) Review Completed Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether an OFCCP compliance review was performed for this adverse action, required when the staffing firm is placing workers on federal contracts. Ensures adverse action decisions comply with affirmative action obligations.
attributes.references: OFCCP Regulations 41 CFR Part 60; Executive Order 11246

attributes.name: position_type
attributes.description: Type of staffing engagement for which the candidate was being considered when the adverse action was triggered. Relevant for determining applicable screening standards and fair chance law requirements by position type.
attributes.references: Fair Credit Reporting Act (FCRA); American Staffing Association (ASA); FLSA

attributes.name: pre_adverse_notice_date
attributes.description: Date the pre-adverse action notice was sent to the candidate, initiating the mandatory FCRA waiting period before a final adverse action decision can be issued. BUSINESS_EVENT_TIMESTAMP category per TRANSACTION_HEADER role minimum requirements.
attributes.references: Fair Credit Reporting Act (FCRA) § 615(a)(1); 15 U.S.C. § 1681m

attributes.name: pre_adverse_notice_method
attributes.description: Method used to deliver the pre-adverse action notice to the candidate. Required for FCRA compliance documentation to demonstrate the candidate received proper notification.
attributes.references: Fair Credit Reporting Act (FCRA) § 615(a)(1); FCRA Summary of Rights

attributes.name: reviewed_by_user
attributes.description: Username or employee identifier of the compliance officer or recruiter who reviewed and processed the adverse action decision. Supports audit trail and accountability requirements.
attributes.references: Fair Credit Reporting Act (FCRA) § 615; SOC 2 Type II; OFCCP Compliance

attributes.name: staffing_vertical
attributes.description: Industry vertical for which the candidate was being screened. Determines the applicable credentialing standards and permissible BGC criteria (e.g., healthcare requires OIG exclusion checks; government may require security clearance checks).
attributes.references: American Staffing Association (ASA); EEOC Enforcement Guidance; OFCCP Compliance

attributes.name: state_fair_chance_law_applied
attributes.business_glossary_term: State Fair Chance Law Applied Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a state or local fair chance (ban-the-box) law applied to this adverse action, requiring additional procedural steps beyond federal FCRA minimums. Relevant for California (AB 1008), New York City, and other jurisdictions.
attributes.references: California AB 1008; NYC Fair Chance Act; EEOC Enforcement Guidance; American Staffing Association (ASA) Compliance Guidelines

attributes.name: summary_of_rights_provided
attributes.business_glossary_term: FCRA Summary of Rights Provided Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the FCRA Summary of Rights (A Summary of Your Rights Under the Fair Credit Reporting Act) was provided to the candidate along with the pre-adverse action notice, as mandated by FCRA § 615(a)(1)(A).
attributes.references: Fair Credit Reporting Act (FCRA) § 615(a)(1)(A); FTC FCRA Guidance

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the adverse action record was last modified, supporting audit trail and change tracking requirements. RECORD_AUDIT_UPDATED category per TRANSACTION_HEADER role minimum requirements.
attributes.references: SOC 2 Type II; Fair Credit Reporting Act (FCRA); GDPR Article 5(1)(f)

products.name: credential_package
products.description: Master record defining a named bundle of credentialing requirements (BGC checks, drug screens, license verifications, training completions, assessments) that must be satisfied for a specific client, industry vertical, or job category. Examples: Healthcare Travel Nurse Package, Federal Government IT Clearance Package, Light Industrial Warehouse Package. Captures package name, applicable vertical, client or program scope, list of required credential types, required BGC components, drug screen panel, effective and expiry dates, and package version for change tracking. Enables standardized credentialing workflows across similar placements and drives the candidate_readiness evaluation.

attributes.description: Reference to the Vendor Management System (VMS) program or Managed Service Provider (MSP) program scope under which this credential package is required. Null if the package is not tied to a specific VMS program.

attributes.name: sow_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to contract.sow. Business justification: SOWs reference specific credential packages for project delivery (e.g., healthcare SOW requires RN license + BLS + facility-specific training package). SOW fulfillment requires workers meeting package

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or user identifier of the compliance officer or manager who formally approved this credential package version for use. Supports audit trail requirements under SOC 2 and internal governance policies.

attributes.name: approved_date
attributes.description: The date on which this credential package version was formally approved by the compliance officer or designated authority. Required for audit trail and change management documentation.

attributes.name: bgc_components_required
attributes.description: Pipe-delimited list of required BGC components for this package (e.g., criminal_check|employment_verification|education_verification|mvr|oig_exclusion|sex_offender_registry|credit_check). Drives the BGC order configuration in Sterling.
