attributes.description: The Sterling Background Check package code that defines the specific BGC components required (e.g., criminal check, employment verification, education verification, MVR, OIG exclusion). Maps directly to a Sterling-configured screening package.
attributes.references: Sterling Background Check Package Management; FCRA Background Check Requirements

attributes.name: client_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether this credential package was mandated by a specific client as a condition of placement. When true, the client_id field identifies the requiring client. Client-mandated packages may have stricter requirements than standard vertical packages.
attributes.references: MSA Client Credentialing Requirements; Beeline VMS Compliance Rules

attributes.name: compliance_notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for compliance team annotations regarding regulatory basis, client-specific exceptions, state-specific requirements, or audit findings related to this credential package. Supports SOC 2 and FCRA compliance documentation.
attributes.references: SOC 2 Type II; FCRA; EEOC; OFCCP; ASA Compliance Guidelines

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this credential package record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail, data lineage, and SOC 2 compliance requirements.
attributes.references: SOC 2 Type II Audit Trail Requirements; GDPR Article 5 (Data Integrity)

attributes.name: credential_validity_days
attributes.description: The number of days for which a completed credential package remains valid before re-credentialing is required. Drives expiration tracking and renewal alerts for active placements (e.g., 365 days for annual re-credentialing).
attributes.references: ASA Credentialing Standards; Joint Commission Healthcare Credentialing; ISO 30405:2016

attributes.name: drug_screen_panel_type
attributes.description: The specific drug screen panel required by this credential package (e.g., 5-panel, 10-panel, DOT 5-panel, hair follicle). Null if drug_screen_required is false.
attributes.references: DOT 49 CFR Part 40; SAMHSA Drug Testing Guidelines; Sterling Drug Screen

attributes.name: drug_screen_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether a drug screen is a mandatory component of this credential package. When true, the drug_screen_panel_type field specifies the required panel.
attributes.references: DOL Drug-Free Workplace Requirements; DOT Drug Testing Regulations

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date on which this version of the credential package becomes effective and can be applied to new candidate credentialing workflows. Candidates onboarded on or after this date must satisfy this package version.
attributes.references: ASA Credentialing Standards; SOC 2 Type II Change Management

attributes.name: everify_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether E-Verify electronic employment eligibility confirmation is required for this credential package. Mandatory for federal contractors and certain state-regulated placements.
attributes.references: INA E-Verify Program; OFCCP Federal Contractor Requirements; DHS E-Verify

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: The date on which this credential package version expires and is no longer valid for new placements. Null for open-ended packages. Supports version lifecycle management and ensures compliance with updated client or regulatory requirements.
attributes.references: ASA Credentialing Standards; SOC 2 Type II

attributes.name: i9_required
attributes.business_glossary_term: I-9 Employment Eligibility Verification Required Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether I-9 Employment Eligibility Verification is required as part of this credential package. Typically true for all packages but may be explicitly flagged for compliance audit purposes.
attributes.references: INA I-9 Compliance; USCIS Form I-9; Immigration and Nationality Act

attributes.name: immunization_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether proof of immunization records is required as part of this credential package. Primarily applicable to healthcare staffing verticals (e.g., flu shot, hepatitis B, MMR, TB test).
attributes.references: CDC Immunization Guidelines; CMS Conditions of Participation; Joint Commission Healthcare Standards

attributes.name: industry_vertical
attributes.description: The staffing industry vertical this credential package is designed to serve (e.g., healthcare, information_technology, light_industrial). Drives vertical-specific credentialing workflows and compliance requirements. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: healthcare|information_technology|light_industrial|finance|government|skilled_trades|education|other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SIA Industry Vertical Classification; ASA Staffing Verticals

attributes.name: is_dot_regulated
attributes.description: Indicates whether the drug screen component of this package must comply with U.S. Department of Transportation (DOT) regulations (49 CFR Part 40). Applicable for transportation, logistics, and safety-sensitive positions.
attributes.references: DOT 49 CFR Part 40; FMCSA Drug and Alcohol Testing

attributes.name: job_category
attributes.description: The job category or occupational classification for which this package applies (e.g., Registered Nurse, Software Engineer, Forklift Operator, Security Analyst). Enables package assignment logic in the ATS based on requisition job category.
attributes.references: DOL Standard Occupational Classification (SOC); Bullhorn Job Order Management

attributes.name: license_verification_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether professional license verification is a mandatory component of this credential package. When true, the required_license_types field specifies which license types must be verified.
attributes.references: ASA Credentialing Standards; ISO 30405:2016; State Licensing Boards

attributes.name: oig_exclusion_check_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether an Office of Inspector General (OIG) exclusion list check is required. Mandatory for healthcare placements to ensure candidates are not excluded from federally funded programs (Medicare/Medicaid).
attributes.references: OIG Exclusion Database; HHS OIG; CMS Conditions of Participation

attributes.name: onboarding_checklist_template
attributes.description: Code or identifier referencing the onboarding checklist template in SAP SuccessFactors or the ATS that is automatically assigned to candidates when this credential package is applied. Ensures consistent onboarding task generation.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Onboarding; Bullhorn ATS Onboarding Workflow

attributes.name: package_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric code uniquely identifying this credential package across systems (e.g., HC-TRV-NURSE-V2, FED-IT-CLR-V1, LI-WH-STD-V3). Used for cross-system reference in Bullhorn, Sterling, and Beeline VMS.
attributes.references: Sterling Background Check Package Management; Beeline VMS Rate and Credential Management

attributes.name: package_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of the credential package, including its intended use case, applicable roles, and any special compliance notes. Used by recruiters and compliance teams to understand the full scope of requirements.
attributes.references: ASA Credentialing Standards; ISO 30405:2016

attributes.name: package_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the credential package (e.g., Healthcare Travel Nurse Package, Federal Government IT Clearance Package, Light Industrial Warehouse Package). Used in candidate-facing and recruiter-facing workflows.
attributes.references: ASA Credentialing Standards; ISO 30405:2016

attributes.name: package_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the credential package. Active packages are available for assignment to candidates. Superseded packages have been replaced by a newer version. Archived packages are retained for historical compliance reference.
attributes.references: ASA Credentialing Standards; SOC 2 Type II

attributes.name: package_version
attributes.description: Integer version number of this credential package definition, incremented each time the package requirements are materially changed. Enables change tracking and ensures candidates are evaluated against the correct version at time of placement.
attributes.references: ASA Best Practices; SOC 2 Type II Change Management

attributes.name: physical_exam_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether a pre-placement physical examination is required as part of this credential package. Common for healthcare, light industrial, and safety-sensitive positions.
attributes.references: OSHA Medical Surveillance Requirements; DOT Physical Examination Standards

attributes.name: placement_type
attributes.description: The type of placement engagement this credential package applies to: temporary, contract, temp-to-perm (Contract-to-Hire), direct hire, or Statement of Work (SOW). Different placement types may require different credentialing depth.
attributes.references: ASA Placement Classification Standards; FLSA Worker Classification

attributes.name: renewal_lead_days
attributes.description: The number of days before credential expiration that the renewal process should be initiated. Used to trigger automated renewal alerts and recruiter tasks in the ATS (e.g., 30 days before expiry).
attributes.references: ASA Credentialing Standards; Bullhorn ATS Task Automation

attributes.name: required_assessment_codes
attributes.description: Pipe-delimited list of skills assessment or competency test codes required by this package (e.g., MS_OFFICE_BASIC|TYPING_40WPM|FORKLIFT_WRITTEN|CLINICAL_SKILLS_RN). Drives assessment assignment in the ATS onboarding workflow.
attributes.references: Bullhorn ATS Assessment Management; ASA QoS Standards

attributes.name: required_immunizations
attributes.description: Pipe-delimited list of required immunizations or health screenings for this credential package (e.g., FLU|HEP_B|MMR|VARICELLA|TB_TEST|COVID_VAX). Null if immunization_required is false.
attributes.references: CDC Immunization Guidelines; CMS Conditions of Participation; Joint Commission

attributes.name: required_license_types
attributes.description: Pipe-delimited list of professional license types that must be verified as part of this credential package (e.g., RN|LPN|CNA|CDL_A|PMP|CISSP). Drives license verification workflows in Sterling and the credentialing team.
attributes.references: State Licensing Boards; ASA Healthcare Credentialing Standards; SHRM

attributes.name: required_training_codes
attributes.description: Pipe-delimited list of training course codes or LMS module identifiers that must be completed as part of this credential package (e.g., OSHA_10|HIPAA_PRIVACY|BLOODBORNE_PATHOGENS|FORKLIFT_CERT). Maps to SAP SuccessFactors LMS course catalog.
attributes.references: OSHA Training Standards; HIPAA Training Requirements; SAP SuccessFactors LMS

attributes.name: security_clearance_level
attributes.description: The minimum government security clearance level required by this credential package (e.g., Public Trust, Secret, Top Secret, TS/SCI). Null if security_clearance_required is false.
attributes.references: ODNI Security Clearance Classification; NISPOM; OFCCP Federal Contractor Requirements

attributes.name: security_clearance_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether a government security clearance is required as part of this credential package. Applicable to federal government IT and defense staffing placements.
attributes.references: OFCCP Federal Contractor Compliance; NISPOM Security Clearance Requirements; ODNI

attributes.name: skills_assessment_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether a formal skills assessment or competency test is required as part of this credential package. When true, the required_assessment_codes field specifies which assessments must be passed.
attributes.references: ASA Quality of Submission (QoS) Standards; SHRM Competency Framework

attributes.name: training_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether completion of specific training courses or modules is a mandatory component of this credential package. When true, required_training_codes specifies the training requirements.
attributes.references: OSHA Training Requirements; SAP SuccessFactors LMS; ASA Safety Training Standards

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this credential package record was last modified. Tracks changes to package requirements over time and supports version control and compliance audit trails.
attributes.references: SOC 2 Type II Audit Trail Requirements; GDPR Article 5 (Data Integrity)

products.name: readiness_status
products.description: Operational summary record representing the current overall credentialing readiness status of a candidate for a specific job order, placement, or credentialing package. Captures the candidate reference, job order or package reference, overall status (fully credentialed, partially credentialed, not credentialed, expired, pending review), count of required vs. completed credentials, outstanding items list, last status evaluation date, and placement eligibility flag. This is the operational 'go/no-go' record used by recruiters and compliance teams before submitting or placing a candidate.

attributes.name: readiness_status_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the credentialing readiness status record. Primary key for this operational go/no-go summary record used by recruiters and compliance teams.
attributes.references: Staffing Hr Internal Data Standards

attributes.name: assignment_id
attributes.description: Reference to the placement or assignment record associated with this readiness evaluation. Nullable when the assessment precedes placement creation.
attributes.references: Bullhorn ATS/CRM - Placement Object

attributes.name: client_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the client account for whom this credentialing readiness is being evaluated. Drives client-specific credentialing requirements and compliance rules.
attributes.references: Bullhorn ATS/CRM - Client Account Object

attributes.name: credential_package_id
attributes.description: Reference to the credentialing package definition that specifies the set of required credentials, licenses, and screenings for this evaluation context. Used when readiness is assessed against a package rather than a specific job order.
attributes.references: Sterling Background Check - Package Configuration; ASA Credentialing Standards

attributes.name: order_header_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific job order (Req) for which this credentialing readiness is being assessed. Nullable when the readiness record is tied to a credentialing package rather than a specific job order.
attributes.references: Bullhorn ATS/CRM - Job Order Object

attributes.name: primary_readiness_staff_profile_id
attributes.description: Reference to the internal user (recruiter, compliance officer, or system account) who performed or triggered the most recent credentialing readiness evaluation. Supports accountability and audit trail requirements.
attributes.references: SOC 2 Type II Audit Trail Requirements; Staffing Hr Internal Credentialing Operations Standards

attributes.name: profile_id
attributes.description: Reference to the candidate whose credentialing readiness is being evaluated. Links to the candidate master record in Bullhorn ATS/CRM.
attributes.references: Bullhorn ATS/CRM - Candidate Object

attributes.name: sow_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to contract.sow. Business justification: Worker readiness is evaluated against SOW-specific credential requirements to determine placement eligibility. SOW staffing decisions depend on readiness status showing all SOW-mandated credentials ar
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: The date on which the placement eligibility determination was formally approved by the compliance officer or manager. Populated when approved_by_user_id is set. Used for audit trail and compliance reporting.
attributes.references: SOC 2 Type II Audit Trail Requirements; OFCCP; ASA Compliance Standards

attributes.name: bgc_status
attributes.description: Current status of the background check (BGC) component of the credentialing evaluation. Sourced from Sterling Background Check. Values: not_ordered = BGC has not yet been initiated; ordered = BGC order placed but not started; in_progress = BGC is being processed; clear = BGC returned no disqualifying findings; consider = BGC returned findings requiring individualized assessment; adverse_action = adverse action process initiated; cancelled = BGC order was cancelled. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: not_ordered|ordered|in_progress|clear|consider|adverse_action|cancelled — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Fair Credit Reporting Act (FCRA); Sterling Background Check; EEOC Guidance on Criminal Records

attributes.name: blocking_items_summary
attributes.description: Free-text summary of specific items that are actively blocking placement eligibility (as opposed to items that are outstanding but not yet blocking). Distinguishes hard-stop blockers (e.g., adverse BGC result, positive drug screen, OIG exclusion) from soft items that are in progress. Used for escalation and compliance review.
attributes.references: FCRA; EEOC Guidance; ASA Credentialing Standards; OFCCP

attributes.name: client_specific_requirements_met
attributes.description: Indicates whether all client-specific credentialing requirements (beyond standard package requirements) have been satisfied. Clients may impose additional requirements via their MSA, VMS program rules, or SOW specifications that go beyond the standard credentialing package.
attributes.references: Client MSA Requirements; Beeline VMS Program Rules; DocuSign CLM; ASA Credentialing Standards

attributes.name: completed_credential_count
attributes.description: Number of required credentials, licenses, certifications, and screenings that have been successfully completed and verified as of the last evaluation date. Used alongside required_credential_count to determine partial vs. full credentialing status.
attributes.references: ASA Credentialing Standards; ISO 30405:2016

attributes.name: compliance_hold
attributes.description: Indicates whether the candidate has been placed on a formal compliance hold that prevents placement regardless of other credentialing status. A compliance hold may be triggered by adverse action proceedings, regulatory violations, OIG exclusion findings, or other compliance-related issues requiring formal review before placement can proceed.
attributes.references: FCRA Adverse Action Requirements; EEOC; OFCCP; ASA Compliance Standards

attributes.name: compliance_hold_reason
attributes.description: Description of the reason for the compliance hold when compliance_hold is True. Documents the specific regulatory, legal, or policy basis for the hold to support audit trails and adverse action documentation.
attributes.references: FCRA Adverse Action Requirements; EEOC; OFCCP; ASA Compliance Standards

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this credentialing readiness status record was first created in the system. Serves as the audit trail creation marker for the Silver Layer record. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: SOC 2 Type II Audit Trail Requirements; GDPR Article 5 (Data Integrity); CCPA

attributes.name: drug_screen_status
attributes.description: Current status of the drug screening component of the credentialing evaluation. Sourced from Sterling Background Check / drug screening lab. Values: not_ordered = screen not yet initiated; ordered = order placed; pending_collection = awaiting specimen collection; in_lab = specimen received and being analyzed; negative = passed (no substances detected); positive = failed (substances detected); cancelled = screen was cancelled. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: not_ordered|ordered|pending_collection|in_lab|negative|positive|cancelled — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: DOT Drug and Alcohol Testing Regulations (49 CFR Part 40); OSHA; Sterling Background Check

attributes.name: earliest_credential_expiration_date
attributes.description: The earliest expiration date among all active credentials, licenses, and certifications held by the candidate for this evaluation context. Used to proactively alert recruiters and compliance teams of impending credential lapses that could affect placement eligibility.
attributes.references: ASA Credentialing Standards; applicable state licensing boards; SHRM Credentialing Guidelines

attributes.name: evaluation_number
attributes.description: Externally-visible business identifier for this readiness evaluation record, used by recruiters and compliance teams to reference and communicate about a specific assessment (e.g., RDNS-2024-00123). Generated by the credentialing system.
attributes.references: Staffing Hr Internal Credentialing Operations Standards

attributes.name: evaluation_triggered_by
attributes.description: The business event or action that triggered this credentialing readiness evaluation. Used for audit trail and process analytics. Values: submittal = triggered by candidate submittal to a job order; placement_creation = triggered by placement record creation; assignment_extension = triggered by an assignment extension request; periodic_review = triggered by scheduled periodic re-evaluation; credential_expiration = triggered by an upcoming or past credential expiration; manual_request = triggered by a recruiter or compliance team member; system_automated = triggered by an automated system rule. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: submittal|placement_creation|assignment_extension|periodic_review|credential_expiration|manual_request|system_automated — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ASA Credentialing Standards; Staffing Hr Internal Credentialing Operations Standards; ISO 30405:2016

attributes.name: everify_status
attributes.description: Current E-Verify case status for the candidate. E-Verify is an internet-based system that compares I-9 information to DHS and SSA records to confirm employment eligibility. Required for federal contractors and certain state-mandated employers. Values: not_initiated = E-Verify case not yet created; pending = case submitted and awaiting result; employment_authorized = work authorization confirmed; tentative_nonconfirmation = initial mismatch requiring candidate response; final_nonconfirmation = employment eligibility could not be confirmed; not_required = E-Verify not required for this placement.
attributes.references: Immigration and Nationality Act (INA); USCIS E-Verify Program; OFCCP Federal Contractor Requirements

attributes.name: expired_credential_count
attributes.description: Number of credentials, licenses, or certifications that were previously valid but have since expired. A non-zero value may trigger an overall_status of 'expired' or 'partially_credentialed' and blocks placement eligibility until renewals are completed.
attributes.references: ASA Credentialing Standards; SHRM Credentialing Guidelines; applicable state licensing boards

attributes.name: i9_status
attributes.description: Current status of the I-9 Employment Eligibility Verification for the candidate. Required by the Immigration and Nationality Act (INA) for all U.S. employees. Values: not_started = I-9 process not yet initiated; section1_complete = candidate has completed Section 1; section2_complete = employer has completed Section 2 (fully compliant); reverification_required = work authorization document is expiring and reverification is needed; compliant = I-9 is fully complete and compliant; non_compliant = I-9 has deficiencies requiring correction.
attributes.references: Immigration and Nationality Act (INA) - I-9 Compliance; USCIS Form I-9; OFCCP

attributes.name: last_evaluated_date
attributes.description: The most recent date on which the overall credentialing readiness status was evaluated or recalculated. Used to determine whether the readiness assessment is current and whether a re-evaluation is needed before placement.
attributes.references: ASA Credentialing Standards; Staffing Hr Internal Credentialing Operations Standards

attributes.name: license_verification_status
attributes.description: Current status of professional license verification for the candidate in the context of this readiness evaluation. Applicable primarily to healthcare, skilled trades, finance, and government staffing verticals. Values: not_required = no license verification required for this role; pending = verification initiated but not yet complete; verified = license confirmed valid and current; failed = license could not be verified or is invalid; expired = license has lapsed; waived = verification requirement formally waived.
attributes.references: State Licensing Boards; SHRM; ASA Healthcare Staffing Standards; ISO 30405:2016

attributes.name: next_evaluation_date
attributes.description: The date on which the credentialing readiness status is scheduled to be re-evaluated. Driven by upcoming credential expiration dates, periodic re-verification requirements, or compliance mandates. Supports proactive credentialing management and prevents placement disruptions.
attributes.references: ASA Credentialing Standards; applicable state licensing board renewal schedules; SHRM

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes entered by recruiters or compliance team members regarding the credentialing readiness evaluation. May include context about exceptions, client communications, candidate explanations, or special circumstances affecting the readiness determination.
attributes.references: Staffing Hr Internal Credentialing Operations Standards

attributes.name: oig_exclusion_status
attributes.business_glossary_term: Office of Inspector General (OIG) Exclusion Check Status
attributes.description: Status of the OIG (Office of Inspector General) exclusion list check for the candidate. Required for healthcare staffing placements to ensure the candidate is not excluded from participation in federal healthcare programs (Medicare, Medicaid). Values: not_checked = check not yet performed; clear = candidate not found on OIG exclusion list; excluded = candidate is on the OIG exclusion list and cannot be placed in healthcare roles; not_required = OIG check not required for this staffing vertical.
attributes.references: OIG List of Excluded Individuals/Entities (LEIE); HHS OIG; ASA Healthcare Staffing Standards; SHRM

attributes.name: outstanding_credential_count
attributes.description: Number of required credentials, licenses, certifications, and screenings that remain incomplete, pending, or expired as of the last evaluation date. Equals required_credential_count minus completed_credential_count. Drives urgency and follow-up actions.
attributes.references: ASA Credentialing Standards; ISO 30405:2016

attributes.name: outstanding_items_summary
attributes.description: Free-text or structured summary listing the specific credentials, verifications, screenings, or training items that remain outstanding and are blocking full credentialing status. Used by recruiters and compliance teams to communicate action items to candidates and coordinate completion. Example: 'BGC in progress; Drug screen pending collection; OSHA 10 training not started'.
attributes.references: ASA Credentialing Standards; Staffing Hr Internal Credentialing Operations Standards

attributes.name: overall_status
attributes.description: Current overall credentialing readiness status of the candidate for the associated job order, placement, or credentialing package. Drives the go/no-go placement eligibility decision. Values: fully_credentialed = all required credentials are valid and current; partially_credentialed = some credentials are complete but others are outstanding; not_credentialed = no required credentials have been completed; expired = one or more previously valid credentials have lapsed; pending_review = evaluation is in progress or awaiting compliance team review.
attributes.references: ASA Credentialing Standards; SHRM Credentialing Guidelines; ISO 30405:2016

attributes.name: placement_eligible
attributes.description: Operational go/no-go flag indicating whether the candidate is currently eligible to be placed or submitted for the associated job order or assignment based on their credentialing readiness. True = eligible to place; False = not eligible. Used by recruiters as the primary clearance indicator before submittal.
attributes.references: ASA Credentialing Standards; OFCCP Compliance Requirements; FLSA

attributes.name: placement_eligible_from_date
attributes.description: The date from which the candidate is eligible to be placed based on their credentialing readiness. May be a future date if credentials are in progress and expected to be completed by a specific date. Supports advance planning for assignment start dates.
attributes.references: ASA Credentialing Standards; Staffing Hr Internal Placement Operations Standards

attributes.name: placement_eligible_until_date
attributes.description: The date through which the candidate's credentialing readiness is valid for placement, typically driven by the earliest credential expiration date. After this date, re-credentialing or renewal is required before the candidate can continue in or be placed in a new assignment.
attributes.references: ASA Credentialing Standards; applicable state licensing boards; SHRM Credentialing Guidelines

attributes.name: required_credential_count
attributes.description: Total number of distinct credentials, licenses, certifications, and screenings required for the candidate to be fully credentialed for the associated job order, placement, or credentialing package. Used to calculate completion percentage and track outstanding items.
attributes.references: ASA Credentialing Standards; ISO 30405:2016

attributes.name: skills_assessment_status
attributes.description: Current status of required skills assessments or competency tests for the candidate in the context of this readiness evaluation. Skills assessments may include technical tests, clinical competency evaluations, or trade-specific proficiency tests depending on the staffing vertical and client requirements.
attributes.references: ASA Staffing Standards; SHRM Competency Framework; ISO 30405:2016

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: The operational system of record from which this readiness status record originated or was primarily populated. Supports data lineage tracking in the Databricks Silver Layer. Values: bullhorn = Bullhorn ATS/CRM; sterling = Sterling Background Check; sap_successfactors = SAP SuccessFactors; beeline = Beeline VMS; manual = manually entered by a user; system_generated = generated by automated credentialing rules engine.
attributes.references: SOC 2 Type II Data Lineage Requirements; Staffing Hr Data Governance Standards

attributes.name: staffing_vertical
attributes.description: Industry vertical or staffing specialty for which this credentialing readiness is being assessed. Determines the applicable credentialing requirements and compliance mandates (e.g., healthcare requires clinical license verification; government may require security clearance checks). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: healthcare|information_technology|skilled_trades|finance|government|light_industrial|professional|education|legal|other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ASA Industry Vertical Classification; SIA Staffing Vertical Standards

attributes.name: training_completion_status
attributes.description: Current status of mandatory training requirements (e.g., OSHA safety training, HIPAA compliance training, client-specific onboarding training) that must be completed before the candidate can be placed. Tracked via SAP SuccessFactors Learning Management System (LMS).
attributes.references: OSHA Training Requirements; HIPAA Training Mandates; SAP SuccessFactors LMS; ASA Safety Standards

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this credentialing readiness status record was most recently modified. Updated whenever the overall_status, component statuses, credential counts, or eligibility flags change. Supports change tracking and data freshness monitoring in the Silver Layer. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: SOC 2 Type II Audit Trail Requirements; GDPR Article 5 (Data Integrity); CCPA

attributes.name: vms_clearance_status
attributes.description: Clearance status within the client's Vendor Management System (VMS), such as Beeline, for candidates being placed through a VMS-managed contingent workforce program. Some clients require VMS-level credentialing clearance before a candidate can be activated on an assignment. Values: not_required = VMS clearance not applicable; pending = clearance submitted and awaiting client approval; cleared = VMS clearance granted; rejected = VMS clearance denied; not_submitted = clearance not yet submitted to VMS.
attributes.references: Beeline VMS Program Management; ASA VMS/MSP Standards; SIA Contingent Workforce Standards

attributes.name: waived_credential_count
attributes.description: Number of normally required credentials that have been formally waived by the client or compliance team for this specific candidate and job order context. Waivers must be documented and approved. Affects the effective required count for placement eligibility determination.
attributes.references: ASA Credentialing Standards; Client MSA Waiver Provisions; DocuSign CLM

products.name: work_authorization
products.description: Master record capturing a candidate's work authorization status and documentation in the United States or other jurisdictions. Tracks authorization type (US Citizen, Permanent Resident, H-1B, OPT, TN, EAD, L-1, O-1, etc.), sponsorship required flag, visa number, visa category, authorized start date, authorized end date, country of authorization, sponsoring employer (if applicable), and USCIS case number. Distinct from I-9 verification (which is the compliance process) — this is the authoritative record of the worker's legal right to work. Critical for placement eligibility, co-employment risk management, and ensuring compliance with immigration law in staffing engagements.

attributes.name: work_authorization_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate primary key for the work authorization record. Serves as the authoritative identifier for a candidate's legal right-to-work record within the Staffing Hr credentialing domain.
attributes.references: Internal Data Governance Standard

attributes.name: client_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to client.client_account. Business justification: Work authorization requirements vary by client (federal contractors require E-Verify, some clients sponsor visas, client-specific I-9 policies). Real business process: client-specific work authorizati
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: credential_document_id
attributes.description: Reference identifier for the scanned or digitally stored work authorization document (e.g., visa copy, EAD card, passport) in the document management system (DocuSign CLM or equivalent). Enables retrieval of the underlying document for audit and compliance review without storing the document directly in the data lakehouse.
attributes.references: DocuSign CLM; FCRA; GDPR Article 5 (data minimization); SOC 2 Type II; CCPA

attributes.name: credential_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to credentialing.credential. Business justification: Link work authorization to the master credential definition (e.g., H1B Visa, Green Card, US Citizen). This allows standardizing work authorization types across all work authorization records. Removing
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: profile_id
attributes.description: Reference to the candidate whose work authorization is being recorded. Links this authorization record to the candidate master profile in Bullhorn ATS/CRM.
attributes.references: Bullhorn ATS/CRM — Candidate Object

attributes.name: authorization_notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for compliance officers or recruiters to capture additional context about the candidate's work authorization status, including pending renewals, special conditions, attorney notes, or immigration counsel observations. Not used for structured data — structured fields take precedence.
attributes.references: ASA Compliance Guidelines; Internal Credentialing Policy; FCRA

attributes.name: authorization_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the work authorization record. 'active' indicates the candidate is currently authorized to work; 'expired' indicates the authorization period has lapsed; 'pending' indicates verification or renewal is in progress; 'revoked' indicates authorization was withdrawn; 'under_review' indicates a compliance review is ongoing. Critical for placement eligibility gating.
attributes.references: Immigration and Nationality Act (INA); ASA Compliance Guidelines; USCIS

attributes.name: authorized_end_date
attributes.description: The date on which the candidate's work authorization expires. Null for permanent authorizations (e.g., US Citizens, Permanent Residents with no expiry). Drives credential expiration alerts, renewal workflows, and assignment end-date compliance checks. Critical for avoiding unauthorized employment liability.
attributes.references: Immigration and Nationality Act (INA); USCIS; FLSA; ASA Compliance Guidelines

attributes.name: authorized_start_date
attributes.description: The date on which the candidate's work authorization becomes effective. Used to determine earliest eligible placement start date and to enforce compliance with immigration law. Corresponds to the 'authorized to work from' date on the underlying visa or EAD document.
attributes.references: Immigration and Nationality Act (INA); USCIS EAD Form I-766; IRS Worker Classification Rules

attributes.name: authorized_to_work_unrestricted
attributes.description: Indicates whether the candidate has unrestricted authorization to work for any employer without limitation (e.g., US Citizens, Permanent Residents). True = no employer or occupation restrictions; False = authorization is tied to a specific employer, occupation, or time period. Used for rapid placement eligibility screening.
attributes.references: Immigration and Nationality Act (INA); USCIS Work Authorization Categories; ASA Compliance Guidelines

attributes.name: bullhorn_candidate_ref
attributes.description: The external candidate identifier from Bullhorn ATS/CRM corresponding to this work authorization record. Enables cross-system reconciliation between the Staffing Hr data lakehouse and the Bullhorn operational system without relying solely on the internal surrogate key.
attributes.references: Bullhorn ATS/CRM — Candidate Object; Internal Data Integration Standards

attributes.name: cap_exempt
attributes.description: Indicates whether the candidate's H-1B petition is exempt from the annual USCIS H-1B numerical cap (e.g., employed by a cap-exempt institution such as a university, nonprofit research organization, or government research entity). True = cap-exempt; False = subject to annual cap lottery. Relevant only for H-1B authorization type.
attributes.references: Immigration and Nationality Act (INA) §214(g)(5); USCIS H-1B Cap Exemption Rules

attributes.name: country_of_authorization
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code representing the jurisdiction in which the candidate is authorized to work (e.g., USA, CAN, GBR). Supports multi-jurisdiction staffing operations and international placement compliance.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3; Immigration and Nationality Act (INA); GDPR Article 4 (for international operations)

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this work authorization record was first created in the Staffing Hr data platform. Supports audit trail requirements, data lineage tracking, and compliance with SOC 2 Type II record-keeping obligations. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: SOC 2 Type II; GDPR Article 5 (accountability); CCPA; Internal Data Governance Standard

attributes.name: ead_card_number
attributes.description: The USCIS-issued Employment Authorization Document (EAD) card number (Form I-766) for candidates whose work authorization is evidenced by an EAD card. Distinct from visa_number. Applicable for OPT, CPT, H-4 EAD, TPS, and other EAD-based authorization types. Sensitive PII.
attributes.references: USCIS Form I-766; Immigration and Nationality Act (INA); FCRA

attributes.name: everify_case_number
attributes.description: The case number assigned by the DHS E-Verify system when the candidate's work authorization was electronically verified. Links this authorization record to the corresponding E-Verify transaction. Null if E-Verify was not used. Supports compliance with federal contractor E-Verify mandates.
attributes.references: DHS E-Verify Program; Executive Order 13465; FAR 52.222-54; Immigration and Nationality Act (INA)

attributes.name: expiration_alert_date
attributes.description: The date on which the expiration alert notification was sent. Null if expiration_alert_sent is False. Used to audit the timeliness of expiration notifications and to ensure compliance with internal SLA requirements for credential renewal management.
attributes.references: ASA Compliance Guidelines; Internal Credentialing SLA Policy

attributes.name: expiration_alert_sent
attributes.description: Indicates whether an automated expiration alert notification has been sent to the responsible recruiter or compliance team regarding the upcoming expiration of this work authorization. True = alert sent; False = alert not yet sent. Supports proactive credential management and prevents unauthorized employment.
attributes.references: ASA Compliance Guidelines; Internal Credentialing SLA Policy; SOC 2 Type II

attributes.name: green_card_priority_date
attributes.description: The priority date established when a PERM labor certification or I-140 immigrant petition was filed on behalf of the candidate. Determines the candidate's place in the immigrant visa queue. Null if no green card process is underway. Used for long-term workforce planning and retention risk assessment.
attributes.references: DOL PERM Labor Certification (20 CFR Part 656); USCIS I-140 Immigrant Petition; DOS Visa Bulletin

attributes.name: i140_approved
attributes.description: Indicates whether USCIS has approved an I-140 Immigrant Petition for Alien Workers on behalf of the candidate. True = I-140 approved; False = not approved or not filed. An approved I-140 enables H-1B extensions beyond the standard 6-year cap and supports AC21 portability analysis.
attributes.references: USCIS Form I-140; Immigration and Nationality Act (INA) §203(b); AC21

attributes.name: i94_admission_number
attributes.description: The 11-digit admission number from the candidate's USCIS Form I-94 (Arrival/Departure Record), which establishes the authorized period of admission and status. Used to verify current lawful status and authorized stay duration. Sensitive immigration PII.
attributes.references: USCIS Form I-94; Immigration and Nationality Act (INA); CBP Admission Records

attributes.name: lca_number
attributes.description: The Department of Labor (DOL)-assigned Labor Condition Application (LCA) case number associated with an H-1B or H-1B1 visa. The LCA certifies that the employer will pay the prevailing wage and maintain required working conditions. Required for H-1B compliance tracking and DOL audit readiness.
attributes.references: DOL LCA Requirements (20 CFR Part 655); Immigration and Nationality Act (INA) §101(a)(15)(H)

attributes.name: opt_stem_extension
attributes.business_glossary_term: Optional Practical Training (OPT) STEM Extension Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the candidate is on a 24-month STEM OPT extension (applicable to F-1 students with STEM degrees). True = STEM extension applies, extending OPT authorization by 24 months beyond standard 12-month OPT. Relevant only when authorization_type = OPT. Drives extended placement eligibility windows.
attributes.references: USCIS STEM OPT Extension (8 CFR 214.2(f)(10)(ii)(C)); Immigration and Nationality Act (INA)

attributes.name: opt_stem_extension_end_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Optional Practical Training (OPT) STEM Extension End Date
attributes.description: The end date of the 24-month STEM OPT extension period. Null if opt_stem_extension is False or not applicable. Used to track the outer boundary of OPT-based work authorization for STEM candidates and to trigger timely H-1B sponsorship or transition planning.
attributes.references: USCIS STEM OPT Extension (8 CFR 214.2(f)(10)(ii)(C)); Immigration and Nationality Act (INA)

attributes.name: passport_country
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the country that issued the candidate's passport (e.g., IND, CHN, MEX, CAN). Used for immigration compliance, co-employment risk assessment, and OFCCP reporting. Distinct from country_of_authorization.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3; USCIS Form I-9; OFCCP Compliance Requirements

attributes.name: passport_expiration_date
attributes.description: The expiration date of the candidate's passport as presented during work authorization verification. Used to ensure the underlying identity document remains valid throughout the placement period. Triggers renewal alerts when approaching expiry.
attributes.references: USCIS Form I-9; Immigration and Nationality Act (INA); ASA Compliance Guidelines

attributes.name: passport_number
attributes.description: The candidate's passport number as presented during work authorization verification. Used as a supporting identity document for I-9 compliance and immigration record-keeping. Sensitive government-issued PII — access restricted to authorized compliance personnel.
attributes.references: USCIS Form I-9; Immigration and Nationality Act (INA); FCRA; GDPR Article 9

attributes.name: placement_restriction_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the candidate's work authorization imposes restrictions on placement (e.g., H-1B candidates restricted to the petitioning employer's worksite, TN candidates restricted to specific occupations). True = placement restrictions apply; False = no restrictions. Triggers compliance review before assignment to a new client or location.
attributes.references: Immigration and Nationality Act (INA); DOL LCA Site of Employment Rules; USCIS H-1B Compliance

attributes.name: placement_restriction_notes
attributes.description: Free-text description of any specific placement restrictions associated with the work authorization (e.g., 'H-1B restricted to client XYZ worksite in Chicago, IL per LCA', 'TN restricted to Software Engineer occupation only'). Null if placement_restriction_flag is False. Used by recruiters and compliance teams during placement eligibility review.
attributes.references: Immigration and Nationality Act (INA); DOL LCA Requirements; ASA Compliance Guidelines

attributes.name: portability_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether the candidate is eligible for H-1B portability under AC21 (American Competitiveness in the 21st Century Act), allowing them to change employers while an I-140 petition is pending. True = portability applies; False = not eligible. Critical for assessing whether a candidate can be placed with a new client without a new H-1B petition.
attributes.references: AC21 §105; Immigration and Nationality Act (INA); USCIS AC21 Portability Guidance

attributes.name: reverification_due_date
attributes.description: The date by which the candidate's work authorization must be re-verified to maintain placement eligibility. Typically set to the authorized_end_date or a configurable number of days prior. Null if reverification_required is False. Drives proactive expiration alerts and compliance workflows.
attributes.references: USCIS Form I-9 Re-verification Rules; Immigration and Nationality Act (INA); ASA Compliance Guidelines

attributes.name: reverification_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the candidate's work authorization requires re-verification before or upon expiration (e.g., EAD renewals, OPT extensions, TN renewals). True = re-verification is required; False = no re-verification needed (e.g., US Citizens). Drives automated renewal workflow triggers in the credentialing system.
attributes.references: USCIS Form I-9 Re-verification Rules; Immigration and Nationality Act (INA); ASA Compliance Guidelines

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: The operational system of record from which this work authorization record was sourced or last updated. Supports data lineage tracking and reconciliation across Bullhorn ATS/CRM, SAP SuccessFactors, and manual compliance entry workflows.
attributes.references: SOC 2 Type II; Internal Data Governance Standard; Bullhorn ATS/CRM; SAP SuccessFactors

attributes.name: sponsoring_employer
attributes.description: The legal name of the employer currently sponsoring the candidate's work visa or authorization (e.g., the H-1B petitioner or PERM sponsor). May be Staffing Hr itself (as Employer of Record) or a client company. Null if no sponsorship is required. Critical for co-employment risk management and portability analysis.
attributes.references: Immigration and Nationality Act (INA); DOL LCA H-1B Requirements; IRS EOR Rules

attributes.name: sponsoring_employer_ein
attributes.description: The IRS-assigned Employer Identification Number (EIN) of the sponsoring employer. Used to verify the legal entity responsible for the sponsorship obligation and to support DOL Labor Condition Application (LCA) compliance. Format: XX-XXXXXXX. Confidential business financial identifier.
attributes.references: IRS EIN Assignment; DOL LCA H-1B Requirements; Immigration and Nationality Act (INA)

attributes.name: sponsorship_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the candidate requires employer sponsorship (e.g., H-1B petition, PERM labor certification) to maintain or obtain work authorization. True = sponsorship required; False = no sponsorship needed. Critical for client placement eligibility screening — many clients explicitly exclude candidates requiring sponsorship.
attributes.references: Immigration and Nationality Act (INA); DOL PERM Labor Certification; ASA Compliance Guidelines

attributes.name: staffing_vertical
attributes.description: The industry vertical for which this work authorization record is primarily relevant. Different verticals have distinct credentialing and authorization requirements (e.g., healthcare requires additional license verification; government may require security clearance alignment). Supports vertical-specific compliance reporting.
attributes.references: ASA Staffing Industry Verticals; SIA Industry Classification; OFCCP Compliance

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this work authorization record was most recently modified. Used to detect stale records, support incremental data loads in the Databricks Silver layer, and maintain audit trail integrity for immigration compliance reviews. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: SOC 2 Type II; GDPR Article 5 (accountability); CCPA; Internal Data Governance Standard

attributes.name: uscis_case_number
attributes.description: The official case number assigned by the United States Citizenship and Immigration Services (USCIS) for the candidate's immigration petition or application (e.g., I-129 H-1B petition receipt number). Format: three-letter service center code followed by 10 digits (e.g., EAC2312345678). Used to track petition status and employer sponsorship obligations.
attributes.references: USCIS Receipt Number Format; Immigration and Nationality Act (INA); DOL LCA Requirements

attributes.name: verification_date
attributes.description: The date on which the work authorization documents were verified by the staffing firm. Used to establish the verification timeline for I-9 compliance audits and to calculate re-verification due dates for time-limited authorizations.
attributes.references: USCIS Form I-9 (3-day rule); Immigration and Nationality Act (INA); FCRA

attributes.name: verification_method
attributes.description: The method used to verify the candidate's work authorization documents. 'document_review' = physical or digital document inspection; 'e_verify' = electronic verification via DHS E-Verify system; 'manual' = manual internal review; 'third_party_vendor' = verification performed by a credentialing vendor such as Sterling. Supports audit trail and FCRA compliance.
attributes.references: USCIS E-Verify Program; Immigration and Nationality Act (INA); FCRA; ASA Compliance Guidelines

attributes.name: verified_by
attributes.description: The name or user identifier of the Staffing Hr compliance officer, recruiter, or authorized representative who performed the work authorization verification. Supports audit trail requirements and accountability for I-9 and immigration compliance.
attributes.references: USCIS Form I-9 Employer Responsibilities; Immigration and Nationality Act (INA); SOC 2 Type II

attributes.name: visa_category
attributes.description: The specific visa category or classification code as issued by the relevant immigration authority (e.g., H-1B, L-1A, L-1B, O-1A, O-1B, TN-1, TN-2, F-1 OPT, J-1). More granular than authorization_type and maps directly to the visa stamp classification. Used for precise immigration compliance reporting.
attributes.references: USCIS Visa Classification Codes; Immigration and Nationality Act (INA); Department of State (DOS)

attributes.name: visa_number
attributes.description: The official visa number or foil number as printed on the candidate's visa stamp or entry document. Uniquely identifies the specific visa issuance. Required for immigration compliance tracking and USCIS case management. Sensitive PII — access restricted to authorized compliance personnel.
attributes.references: Immigration and Nationality Act (INA); USCIS; FCRA; GDPR Article 9

products.name: credential_document
products.description: Master record for physical or digital documents submitted by a candidate to support credentialing verification — diplomas, transcripts, license copies, certification cards, immunization records, professional references, and government-issued IDs. Captures document type, document title, issuing institution or authority, issue date, expiration date, document storage reference (DocuSign CLM or document vault URI), verification status, and the credential or verification record it supports. Provides the document audit trail required for FCRA, HIPAA, and client audit purposes.

attributes.name: credential_document_id
attributes.description: Primary key for credential_document

attributes.name: assignment_id
attributes.description: Reference to the placement or assignment record this document supports. Links the credential document to the specific temporary or permanent placement for audit and compliance purposes.
attributes.references: ISO 30405:2016; ASA; DOL; FCRA

attributes.name: bgc_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the Background Check (BGC) order in Sterling Background Check that this document supports or was collected as part of. Nullable when the document is not associated with a BGC order.
attributes.references: Fair Credit Reporting Act (FCRA); Sterling Background Check

attributes.name: client_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the client account that mandated this document as part of their credentialing requirements. Nullable when the document is a general credentialing requirement not tied to a specific client.
attributes.references: ASA; MSA; Bullhorn ATS/CRM

attributes.name: credential_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to credentialing.credential. Business justification: Link the document to the master credential definition it supports (e.g., RN License document supports RN License credential). This allows standardizing credential types across all documents. Removing
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: docusign_envelope_id
attributes.description: Unique envelope identifier assigned by DocuSign CLM when the document was executed or stored electronically. Enables direct retrieval and audit trail linkage within the DocuSign Contract Lifecycle Management system.
attributes.references: SOC 2 Type II; FCRA; DocuSign CLM

attributes.name: license_verification_id
attributes.description: Reference to the license verification record this document supports. Links the physical or digital license copy to the corresponding verification record in the credentialing domain.
attributes.references: ISO 30405:2016; American Staffing Association (ASA)

attributes.name: order_header_id
attributes.description: Reference to the job order (Req/Requisition) for which this document was collected as part of the candidate credentialing process. Nullable when the document is collected independently of a specific job order.
attributes.references: ISO 30405:2016; Bullhorn ATS/CRM

attributes.name: profile_id
attributes.description: Reference to the candidate who submitted this credential document. Links the document to the candidate profile in Bullhorn ATS/CRM for credentialing and compliance tracking.
attributes.references: ISO 30405:2016 Human Resource Management

attributes.name: superseded_by_document_credential_document_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing identifier pointing to the newer credential document record that replaced this one. Enables document version lineage tracking and audit trail for FCRA and client audit compliance.
attributes.references: FCRA; SOC 2 Type II; ISO 30405:2016

attributes.name: candidate_consent_obtained
attributes.description: Indicates whether the candidate has provided explicit written consent for the collection, storage, and use of this document for credentialing and background screening purposes. Required under FCRA, GDPR, and CCPA.
attributes.references: FCRA; GDPR Article 6; CCPA; INA I-9 Compliance

attributes.name: client_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether this document was required by a specific client as part of their onboarding or credentialing program. When true, the document must be verified before the candidate can be placed with that client.
attributes.references: ASA; MSA (Master Service Agreement); SLA (Service Level Agreement)

attributes.name: consent_date
attributes.description: The date on which the candidate provided consent for the collection and use of this document. Required for FCRA, GDPR, and CCPA audit trails.
attributes.references: FCRA; GDPR Article 7; CCPA

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this credential document record was first created in the Staffing Hr credentialing system. Serves as the RECORD_AUDIT_CREATED field for the master resource lifecycle. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: SOC 2 Type II; GDPR Article 5; CCPA; ISO 30405:2016

attributes.name: document_number
attributes.description: Externally-known unique identifier or reference number assigned to the document by the issuing authority or institution (e.g., license number on a license copy, diploma serial number, passport number). Serves as the BUSINESS_IDENTIFIER for this master resource.
attributes.references: FCRA; Immigration and Nationality Act (INA) I-9 Compliance; GDPR Article 4

attributes.name: document_status
attributes.description: Current operational status of the document itself, independent of its verification status. Tracks whether the document is currently valid, expired, revoked by the issuing authority, or superseded by a newer version.
attributes.references: ISO 30405:2016; FCRA; ASA; DOL

attributes.name: document_title
attributes.description: Human-readable title or name of the document as it appears on the physical or digital artifact (e.g., 'Registered Nurse License', 'Bachelor of Science in Computer Science', 'CPR Certification Card'). Serves as the IDENTITY_LABEL for this master resource.
attributes.references: ISO 30405:2016; American Staffing Association (ASA)

attributes.name: document_type
attributes.description: Categorical classification of the credential document type submitted by the candidate. Drives downstream routing, verification workflows, and compliance checks. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: license|certification|diploma|transcript|government_id|immunization_record|drug_screen_result|reference_letter|background_check_consent|other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ISO 30405:2016; ASA; FCRA; HIPAA

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date from which the document is considered active and valid for credentialing purposes. May differ from issue_date for documents with a delayed activation period (e.g., renewed licenses effective on a future date).
attributes.references: ISO 30405:2016; ASA; DOL

attributes.name: expiration_alert_date
attributes.description: The date on which the expiration alert notification was sent for this document. Used to track notification compliance and follow-up cadence for credential renewal.

attributes.name: expiration_alert_sent
attributes.description: Indicates whether an automated expiration alert notification has been sent to the candidate and/or credentialing team for this document. Supports proactive renewal management and assignment continuity.
attributes.references: ISO 30405:2016; ASA; DOL

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: The date on which the document expires and is no longer valid for credentialing or placement purposes. Drives automated expiration alerts, renewal workflows, and assignment eligibility checks. Null for documents with no expiration.
attributes.references: ISO 30405:2016; ASA; FCRA; HIPAA; DOL

attributes.name: fcra_compliant
attributes.business_glossary_term: Fair Credit Reporting Act (FCRA) Compliant Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the collection, storage, and use of this document complies with Fair Credit Reporting Act (FCRA) requirements, including candidate consent and permissible purpose. Critical for background check document types.
attributes.references: Fair Credit Reporting Act (FCRA); EEOC; OFCCP

attributes.name: file_format
attributes.description: File format of the stored digital document (e.g., PDF, JPG, PNG, TIFF). Used for document rendering, archival compliance, and integration with document management systems.
attributes.references: SOC 2 Type II; FCRA; HIPAA

attributes.name: file_size_kb
attributes.description: Size of the stored document file in kilobytes. Used for storage management, upload validation, and document vault capacity planning.
attributes.references: SOC 2 Type II

attributes.name: hipaa_applicable
attributes.business_glossary_term: Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act (HIPAA) Applicable Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this document contains Protected Health Information (PHI) subject to HIPAA regulations (e.g., immunization records, drug screen results, medical clearance letters). Drives PHI handling, access controls, and retention policies.
attributes.references: HIPAA; OSHA; ASA; SIA

attributes.name: is_primary_document
attributes.description: Indicates whether this document is the primary or most current version of a given document type for the candidate. When false, the document may be a historical or superseded version retained for audit purposes.
attributes.references: FCRA; ISO 30405:2016; SOC 2 Type II

attributes.name: issue_date
attributes.description: The date on which the issuing authority originally issued or granted the document. Used to determine document age, validity windows, and renewal eligibility.
attributes.references: ISO 30405:2016; FCRA; INA I-9 Compliance

attributes.name: issuing_authority
attributes.description: Name of the institution, government body, or organization that issued the document (e.g., 'California Board of Registered Nursing', 'CompTIA', 'U.S. Department of Homeland Security'). Critical for verification routing and source validation.
attributes.references: ISO 30405:2016; INA I-9 Compliance; FCRA

attributes.name: issuing_country
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the nation that issued the document. Required for I-9 employment eligibility verification and international credential validation.
attributes.references: INA I-9 Compliance; GDPR; ISO 3166-1

attributes.name: issuing_state
attributes.description: Two-letter U.S. state code of the authority that issued the document. Applicable for state-issued licenses, certifications, and government IDs. Null for federally or internationally issued documents.
attributes.references: INA I-9 Compliance; U.S. Department of Labor (DOL); FLSA

attributes.name: next_renewal_date
attributes.description: The calculated or manually set date by which the candidate must renew this document to maintain credentialing compliance. Drives scheduling of renewal outreach and placement hold triggers.
attributes.references: ISO 30405:2016; ASA; DOL; HIPAA

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for credentialing specialists to record observations, exceptions, follow-up actions, or contextual information about the document that is not captured in structured fields.
attributes.references: ISO 30405:2016; FCRA; ASA

attributes.name: rejection_reason
attributes.description: Free-text explanation of why the document was rejected during the verification review process (e.g., expired, illegible, mismatched name, suspected fraud). Populated only when verification_status is 'rejected'.
attributes.references: FCRA; ISO 30405:2016; ASA

attributes.name: renewal_frequency_days
attributes.description: The number of days between required renewals for this document type. Used to calculate the next renewal due date and schedule proactive outreach to the candidate.
attributes.references: ISO 30405:2016; ASA; DOL

attributes.name: renewal_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether this document requires periodic renewal to maintain its validity for credentialing and placement eligibility. Drives renewal workflow triggers and expiration tracking.
attributes.references: ISO 30405:2016; ASA; DOL; HIPAA

attributes.name: staffing_vertical
attributes.description: The staffing industry vertical for which this document is required or relevant. Drives vertical-specific credentialing rules (e.g., healthcare requires immunization records; government requires security clearance documents). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: healthcare|information_technology|skilled_trades|finance|government|general_staffing|other — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ASA; SIA; ISO 30405:2016; OSHA; DOL

attributes.name: storage_uri
attributes.description: Uniform Resource Identifier (URI) pointing to the physical or digital document stored in DocuSign CLM or the enterprise document vault. Enables retrieval for audits, client requests, and FCRA/HIPAA compliance reviews. Access is governed by role-based security controls.
attributes.references: SOC 2 Type II; FCRA; HIPAA; GDPR Article 17; CCPA; DocuSign CLM

attributes.name: submitted_date
attributes.description: The date on which the candidate submitted this document to the staffing organization for credentialing review. Serves as the principal business event date (BUSINESS_EVENT_TIMESTAMP at day granularity) for the document intake lifecycle.
attributes.references: ISO 30405:2016; FCRA; ASA

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this credential document record was last modified in the Staffing Hr credentialing system. Supports audit trail, change detection, and incremental data pipeline processing. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: SOC 2 Type II; GDPR Article 5; CCPA; ISO 30405:2016

attributes.name: verification_method
attributes.description: The method used to verify the authenticity and validity of the document (e.g., primary source verification with issuing authority, third-party vendor such as Sterling, manual review, E-Verify for employment eligibility).
attributes.references: FCRA; INA I-9 Compliance; E-Verify; ISO 30405:2016; ASA

attributes.name: verification_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the document's verification process. Drives credentialing workflow actions, placement eligibility, and compliance holds. Serves as the LIFECYCLE_STATUS for this master resource.
attributes.references: FCRA; ISO 30405:2016; ASA; NAPEO

attributes.name: verified_by
attributes.description: Name or system identifier of the credentialing specialist or automated system that performed the document verification. Supports audit trail requirements under FCRA and client audit programs.
attributes.references: FCRA; SOC 2 Type II; ISO 30405:2016

attributes.name: verified_date
attributes.description: The date on which the document was confirmed as authentic and valid by the credentialing team or automated verification system. Null until verification is completed.
attributes.references: FCRA; ISO 30405:2016; ASA; HIPAA

products.name: education_verification
products.description: Transactional record capturing the verification of a candidate's educational credentials against issuing institutions or the National Student Clearinghouse. Tracks institution name, degree or diploma type, field of study, graduation date, verification method (NSC, direct institution contact, third-party), verification date, verification outcome (verified, not verified, discrepancy found, institution not participating), and the BGC order that triggered the verification. Supports quality of submission (QoS) standards and client-mandated degree requirements.

attributes.name: education_verification_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated primary key for each education verification record. TRANSACTION_HEADER role — canonical entity with full lifecycle.
attributes.references: ISO 30405:2016 Human Resource Management - Guidelines on Recruitment

attributes.name: assignment_id
attributes.description: Reference to the placement or assignment record associated with this education verification, if the verification was triggered post-offer or at onboarding.
attributes.references: ISO 30405:2016 Human Resource Management - Guidelines on Recruitment

attributes.name: bgc_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the Background Check (BGC) order in Sterling Background Check that triggered this education verification. Links to the bgc_order record in the credentialing domain.
attributes.references: Fair Credit Reporting Act (FCRA); Sterling Background Check

attributes.name: client_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the client account that mandated this education verification as part of their screening package or QoS requirements.
attributes.references: American Staffing Association (ASA)

attributes.name: credential_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to credentialing.credential. Business justification: Link the education verification to the master credential definition (e.g., BSN Degree, MBA). This allows standardizing educational credential types across all verification transactions. Removing degre
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: order_header_id
attributes.description: Reference to the job order (requisition) that required this education verification, linking the credential check to the specific client requirement.
attributes.references: ISO 30405:2016 Human Resource Management - Guidelines on Recruitment

attributes.name: profile_id
attributes.description: Reference to the candidate whose educational credential is being verified. Links to the candidate master record in Bullhorn ATS/CRM.
attributes.references: ISO 30405:2016 Human Resource Management - Guidelines on Recruitment

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to vendor.supplier. Business justification: Education verifications performed by third-party vendors (National Student Clearinghouse, etc.). Required for vendor selection, turnaround tracking, billing reconciliation, and service quality monitor
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: actual_turnaround_hours
attributes.description: The actual number of hours elapsed from order_date to verification_date. Used to measure SLA compliance and vendor performance for education verification.
attributes.references: American Staffing Association (ASA); Staffing Industry Analysts (SIA)

attributes.name: adverse_action_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this education verification result triggered an adverse action process under FCRA. True when the outcome negatively impacts the candidate's employment eligibility.
attributes.references: Fair Credit Reporting Act (FCRA); Equal Employment Opportunity Commission (EEOC)

attributes.name: billable_to_client
attributes.description: Indicates whether the cost of this education verification is billable to the client as part of the screening fee pass-through arrangement in the MSA.
attributes.references: Oracle NetSuite ERP; Salesforce Revenue Cloud

attributes.name: client_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this education verification was mandated by a specific client as part of their Quality of Submission (QoS) standards or Master Service Agreement (MSA) requirements.
