products.name: package_requirement
products.description: This association product represents the requirement relationship between credential_package and credential. It captures the specific rules and constraints that govern how each credential must be satisfied within the context of a specific credentialing package. Each record links one credential_package to one credential with attributes that define whether the credential is mandatory, verification requirements, expiry windows, renewal policies, and waiver rules for that specific package-credential combination.. Existence Justification: In staffing and recruitment operations, credential packages are reusable bundles that combine multiple credentials with package-specific rules. A single package (e.g., Healthcare Travel Nurse Package) requires multiple credentials (RN license, BLS, immunizations, background check), and a single credential (e.g., RN license) is required by multiple packages across different clients and verticals. Compliance teams actively configure and manage these package-credential relationships, setting mandatory/optional flags, verification levels, expiry windows, and waiver policies for each combination.

attributes.name: package_requirement_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated identifier for this package requirement record. Primary key.

attributes.name: credential_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the credential that is required by this package
attributes.references: Internal - M:N Association FK

attributes.name: credential_package_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the credential package that contains this requirement
attributes.references: Internal - M:N Association FK

attributes.name: last_modified_by_user_staff_profile_id
attributes.description: Reference to the user who last modified this package requirement configuration.

attributes.name: staff_profile_id
attributes.description: Reference to the user who created this package requirement configuration.

attributes.name: acceptable_expiry_window_days
attributes.description: Number of days before credential expiration that the credential is still considered acceptable for placement under this package. Allows package-specific tolerance (e.g., client may accept credential expiring within 30 days for short-term assignments).

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when this package requirement record was created.

attributes.name: display_order
attributes.description: Numeric sort order for displaying this credential requirement within the package checklist presented to candidates and recruiters.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date on which this credential requirement becomes effective for this package. Supports phased rollout of new requirements.

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: The date on which this credential requirement is no longer applicable for this package. Supports time-bound requirements (e.g., COVID-19 vaccination required only during pandemic period).

attributes.name: grace_period_days
attributes.description: Number of days after credential expiration during which the credential is still considered acceptable for this package. Package-specific override of the credential's default grace_period_days.

attributes.name: is_mandatory
attributes.description: Indicates whether this credential is mandatory for the package (true) or optional/preferred (false). Drives candidate readiness evaluation logic.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when this package requirement record was last modified.

attributes.name: renewal_lead_time_days
attributes.description: Number of days before credential expiration that the renewal process must be initiated for this package. Drives proactive renewal notifications.

attributes.name: renewal_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the candidate must renew this credential if it expires during the assignment period covered by this package.

attributes.name: requirement_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of this requirement within the package. Allows individual requirements to be deprecated without removing the entire package.

attributes.name: verification_level
attributes.description: The level of verification rigor required for this credential within this package context. May differ from the credential's default verification_method based on client or program requirements.

attributes.name: waiver_allowed
attributes.description: Indicates whether this credential requirement can be waived for this package under exceptional circumstances (e.g., pending license transfer, temporary assignment).

attributes.name: waiver_approval_level
attributes.description: The organizational approval level required to grant a waiver for this credential requirement within this package context.

products.name: checklist_credential_requirement
products.description: This association product represents the requirement relationship between a task checklist template and a credential type. It captures the specific mandate, verification, and timing rules that govern when and how a credential must be verified as part of completing an onboarding or offboarding checklist. Each record links one credential to one task checklist with attributes that define the enforcement policy, verification level, timing offset, blocking behavior, and waiver eligibility for that specific checklist-credential combination.. Existence Justification: In staffing operations, task checklist templates require multiple credentials (licenses, certifications, immunizations, background checks, drug screens) based on placement type, client requirements, and regulatory mandates. Each credential type applies to multiple checklist templates across different roles, geographies, and client accounts. The business actively manages these requirements as configuration rules, specifying for each checklist-credential pair whether the credential is mandatory, what verification level is required, timing offsets, blocking behavior, and waiver eligibility. This is a true operational M:N relationship recognized by the business as 'Checklist Credential Requirements' or 'Credential Requirement Rules.'

attributes.name: checklist_credential_requirement_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated identifier for this checklist credential requirement record. Primary key.

attributes.name: credential_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the credential definition that is required by this checklist template
attributes.references: Internal - M:N Association FK

attributes.name: task_checklist_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Checklist Credential Requirement - Task Checklist Id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the task checklist template that requires this credential
attributes.references: Internal - M:N Association FK

attributes.name: active_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of this credential requirement. Values: active (currently enforced), inactive (not enforced, may be reactivated), pending (scheduled to become active), superseded (replaced by a newer version of the requirement).

attributes.name: blocking_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether failure to meet this credential requirement blocks progression or completion of the checklist (True) or is tracked as non-compliant but does not prevent checklist completion (False). When True and is_mandatory is True, the worker cannot be placed or onboarded until this credential is verified. Drives workflow gating logic.

attributes.name: due_date_offset_days
attributes.description: Number of days relative to the checklist start date (typically assignment start date or onboarding initiation date) by which this credential must be verified and compliant. Negative values indicate credential must be verified before checklist start (e.g., -7 means 7 days before assignment start). Positive values allow verification after start (e.g., 30 means within 30 days of assignment start). Zero means must be verified by start date.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date from which this credential requirement becomes active for this checklist template. Supports versioning and phased rollout of new credential requirements (e.g., new client contract effective date, new regulatory requirement effective date).

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date after which this credential requirement is no longer active for this checklist template. Nullable for ongoing requirements. Supports sunsetting of requirements when contracts end or regulations change.

attributes.name: is_mandatory
attributes.description: Indicates whether this credential is mandatory (True) or optional/recommended (False) for completion of this specific checklist. Drives enforcement logic and blocking behavior.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional context, special instructions, or exceptions related to this credential requirement for this checklist. May include client-specific instructions, alternative verification methods, or conditional logic notes.

attributes.name: requirement_source
attributes.description: The origin or authority that mandates this credential requirement for this checklist. Drives auditability and explains why the requirement exists. Values: regulatory (mandated by law or regulation), client_contract (required by specific client agreement), company_policy (internal Staffing Hr policy), industry_standard (best practice or industry norm), risk_mitigation (added to reduce operational or liability risk).

attributes.name: sort_order
attributes.description: Display sequence for this credential requirement within the checklist template. Used to present credentials in a logical order to recruiters and candidates (e.g., licenses first, then certifications, then immunizations).

attributes.name: verification_level
attributes.description: The required verification rigor for this credential within this checklist context. May differ from the credential's default verification_method based on client requirements, placement type, or risk profile. Values: primary_source (verify directly with issuer), secondary_source (verify via third-party database), self_attestation (candidate provides documentation), visual_inspection (recruiter reviews copy), not_required (credential tracked but not verified for this checklist).

attributes.name: waiver_allowed
attributes.description: Indicates whether this credential requirement can be waived by an authorized approver (True) or is non-waivable due to regulatory or client contractual mandate (False). When True, a waiver workflow can be initiated; when False, the credential must be satisfied without exception.

products.name: service
products.description: This association product represents the service agreement between credential types and suppliers who provide verification, assessment, or compliance services for those credentials. It captures the operational catalog of which suppliers are approved to verify/assess which credential types, along with service-level agreements, pricing, turnaround times, and performance metrics. Each record links one credential type to one approved supplier with attributes that exist only in the context of this service relationship.. Existence Justification: In staffing operations, credential verification is outsourced to specialized suppliers who provide services like background checks, drug screening, license verification, and skills assessments. A single credential type (e.g., RN license, OSHA 10, TB immunization) can be verified by multiple approved suppliers, each with different pricing, turnaround times, and service quality. Conversely, a single supplier typically provides verification services for multiple credential types across their service portfolio. The business actively manages this service catalog, tracking SLAs, costs, performance ratings, and approval status for each supplier-credential combination.

Owns vendor profiles, tier classifications, rate cards, rate agreements, Beeline VMS program enrollment, SOW vendor agreements, IC (Independent Contractor) supplier records, vendor performance scorecards, vendor contracts, and vendor compliance tracking. products.name: supplier
products.description: Master record for all third-party staffing suppliers, subcontractors, independent contractor (IC) suppliers, and service providers participating in MSP/VMS-managed contingent workforce programs. Captures vendor identity, legal entity details, business type (staffing agency, IC supplier, SOW provider, subcontractor), tax classification (W-2, 1099, Corp-to-Corp), EIN, DUNS number, NAICS code, diversity certifications (MBE, WBE, SDVOB), primary contact, headquarters address, operational regions, onboarding status, and Beeline VMS enrollment status. For IC supplier subtypes, additionally captures IRS worker classification determination, IC compliance program enrollment status, IC compliance vendor (e.g., MBO Partners, Shiftpixy), indemnification agreement status, right-to-audit clause, insurance minimums, IC risk score, and business structure (sole prop, LLC, S-Corp, C-Corp). SSOT for ALL vendor identity across all programs — all vendor types including staffing agencies, IC suppliers, SOW providers, and subcontractors are unified in this single master record. The ic_supplier subtype is distinguished by business_type and carries additional IC-specific compliance attributes within this same entity to avoid data divergence across staffing agency and IC supplier workflows.

attributes.description: Most recent date on which the supplier's insurance certificates (general liability, workers compensation, E&O) were verified and confirmed to meet program minimums.
