attributes.name: insurance_wc_limit
attributes.description: Minimum required Workers Compensation (WC) insurance coverage amount (in USD) that the supplier must maintain. Applicable to staffing agencies placing W-2 workers. Validated during onboarding.
attributes.references: DOL Workers Compensation Requirements; OSHA; ASA Risk Management Standards

attributes.name: legal_name
attributes.description: Full legal registered name of the supplier entity as it appears on government filings, MSA, and tax documents. Used for contract execution, invoicing, and compliance reporting.
attributes.references: IRS Business Entity Registration; ASA Supplier Standards

attributes.name: msa_effective_date
attributes.description: Date on which the Master Service Agreement (MSA) with the supplier became legally binding and operative.
attributes.references: DocuSign CLM; ASA Supplier Contract Standards

attributes.name: msa_expiry_date
attributes.description: Date on which the Master Service Agreement (MSA) with the supplier expires. Triggers contract renewal workflow in DocuSign CLM. Null indicates an evergreen/open-ended agreement.
attributes.references: DocuSign CLM; ASA Supplier Contract Standards

attributes.name: msa_status
attributes.description: Current status of the Master Service Agreement (MSA) between the MSP/staffing firm and the supplier. Governs the legal framework for all placements and SOW engagements. Managed via DocuSign CLM.
attributes.references: DocuSign CLM MSA Management; ASA Supplier Contract Standards

attributes.name: naics_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: North American Industry Classification System (NAICS) Code
attributes.description: 6-digit North American Industry Classification System (NAICS) code identifying the supplier's primary industry sector. Used for spend analytics, diversity reporting, and regulatory classification.
attributes.references: U.S. Census Bureau NAICS; SBA Small Business Size Standards

attributes.name: nda_executed
attributes.description: Indicates whether a Non-Disclosure Agreement (NDA) has been fully executed between the MSP/staffing firm and the supplier. Managed via DocuSign CLM.
attributes.references: DocuSign CLM; ASA Supplier Contract Standards

attributes.name: non_compete_executed
attributes.description: Indicates whether a non-compete or non-solicitation agreement has been executed with the supplier, restricting direct placement of workers with clients outside the MSP program.
attributes.references: DocuSign CLM; ASA Supplier Contract Standards

attributes.name: onboarding_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the supplier's onboarding and program participation within the MSP/VMS-managed contingent workforce program. Drives eligibility to submit candidates and receive job orders.
attributes.references: Beeline VMS Supplier Lifecycle Management; ASA Supplier Onboarding Standards

attributes.name: operational_regions
attributes.description: Comma-delimited list of geographic regions (U.S. states, metro areas, or country codes) where the supplier actively places workers or delivers services. Used for job order routing, geographic coverage analytics, and program expansion planning.
attributes.references: Beeline VMS Rate Management; SIA Contingent Workforce Analytics

attributes.name: performance_score
attributes.description: Composite performance score (0.00–100.00) from the supplier's most recent scorecard evaluation. Derived from KPIs including Quality of Submission (QoS), Time to Fill (TTF), fill rate, fall-off rate, and SLA compliance. Used for tier reclassification and program allocation decisions.
attributes.references: Beeline VMS Vendor Scorecard; SIA Supplier Performance Standards; ASA KPI Framework

attributes.name: performance_score_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent supplier performance scorecard evaluation. Used to determine score currency and trigger re-evaluation workflows.
attributes.references: Beeline VMS Vendor Scorecard; ASA KPI Framework

attributes.name: preferred_supplier
attributes.description: Indicates whether the supplier holds preferred supplier status within the MSP program, granting priority job order routing, higher volume allocation, and preferred rate card terms.
attributes.references: Beeline VMS Rate Management; ASA MSP Program Standards

attributes.name: primary_contact_email
attributes.description: Business email address of the supplier's primary program contact. Used for job order notifications, compliance communications, and VMS system alerts.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; CCPA; Beeline VMS Vendor Contact Management

attributes.name: primary_contact_name
attributes.description: Full name of the primary business contact at the supplier organization responsible for program management, escalations, and relationship management with the MSP.
attributes.references: Beeline VMS Vendor Contact Management

attributes.name: primary_contact_phone
attributes.description: Business phone number of the supplier's primary program contact for operational communications and escalation.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; CCPA

attributes.name: right_to_audit
attributes.description: Indicates whether the supplier's MSA or IC compliance agreement includes a right-to-audit clause allowing the MSP or client to audit the supplier's worker classification practices, payroll records, and compliance documentation.
attributes.references: ASA Supplier Contract Standards; OFCCP Audit Requirements; SOC 2 Type II

attributes.name: tax_classification
attributes.description: IRS tax classification governing how workers supplied by this vendor are compensated and taxed. Determines payroll tax obligations, worker classification risk, and billing structure. W-2 = employer-employee; 1099 = independent contractor; Corp-to-Corp (C2C) = business-to-business engagement.
attributes.references: IRS Worker Classification Rules; IRS Publication 15-A; FLSA

attributes.name: trade_name
attributes.description: Doing-business-as (DBA) or trade name used in day-to-day operations, marketing, and client-facing communications when different from the legal entity name.
attributes.references: ASA Supplier Standards

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to the supplier record. Used for change data capture (CDC), data freshness monitoring, and audit trail compliance.
attributes.references: SOC 2 Type II; GDPR Article 5; ISO 30405:2016

attributes.name: vms_enrollment_status
attributes.description: Enrollment status of the supplier within the Beeline Vendor Management System (VMS). Indicates whether the supplier is actively enrolled and eligible to participate in VMS-managed requisitions and rate card agreements.
attributes.references: Beeline VMS Contingent Workforce Program Management

attributes.name: vms_supplier_code
attributes.description: Supplier identifier assigned by the Beeline Vendor Management System (VMS) at enrollment. Used for cross-system reconciliation between Beeline VMS, Bullhorn ATS/CRM, and Oracle NetSuite ERP.
attributes.references: Beeline VMS Vendor Management

products.name: tier_classification
products.description: Reference and history table defining vendor tier levels and tracking tier reclassification events within MSP/VMS programs. Tier definitions capture tier code, tier name (e.g., Tier 1 Preferred, Tier 2 Approved, Tier 3 Conditional, Tier 4 Probationary), tier description, program eligibility rules, submission priority order, maximum fill-rate allocation percentage, SLA requirements per tier, and review cycle frequency. Tier review history captures review date, vendor ID, previous tier, proposed tier, review trigger (scheduled, performance-based, compliance failure, client request), scorecard period referenced, review committee members, decision outcome (upgraded, downgraded, maintained, suspended), effective date of tier change, rationale notes, and approval status. Drives vendor routing logic in Beeline VMS and provides full audit trail for tier movement decisions.

attributes.name: tier_classification_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each tier classification definition or tier review history record within the vendor MSP/VMS program. Serves as the primary key for this table.
attributes.references: Beeline VMS Data Model; ASA Vendor Management Best Practices

attributes.name: managed_program_id
attributes.description: Reference to the MSP/VMS-managed contingent workforce program under which this tier classification applies. A vendor may hold different tier levels across different client programs.
attributes.references: Beeline VMS Program Configuration; MSP Program Management Standards

attributes.name: reviewed_by_staff_profile_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Reviewed By Staff Profile Id (Foreign Key)
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to employee.staff_profile. Business justification: Identifies internal vendor management analyst who conducted tier review and scorecard evaluation. Required for audit trail, governance accountability, and tier change approval workflows in supplier pe
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Reference to the vendor (staffing supplier or subcontractor) whose tier classification is being defined or reviewed. Links to the vendor master record in the vendor domain.
attributes.references: Beeline VMS Supplier Profile; ASA Vendor Management Standards

attributes.name: vendor_agreement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to contract.vendor_agreement. Business justification: Tier status is contractually defined in vendor agreements and impacts rate schedules, allocation percentages, and submission priority. Business needs to link tier to governing agreement for tier chang
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: The approval workflow status of the tier review decision. 'pending' = awaiting approver action; 'approved' = decision ratified; 'rejected' = decision overturned; 'escalated' = referred to senior governance. Drives the Beeline VMS tier activation workflow.
attributes.references: Beeline VMS Approval Workflow; DocuSign CLM Approval Routing

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time at which the tier review decision was formally approved by the designated authority. Used for SLA compliance on review turnaround time and audit trail.
attributes.references: SOC 2 Type II Audit Trail Requirements; ASA Vendor Governance Standards

attributes.name: compliance_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the vendor has an active compliance issue (e.g., expired insurance, failed background check, I-9 deficiency, E-Verify non-compliance) that is a factor in this tier classification or review. True = compliance issue present.
attributes.references: EEOC Compliance Standards; INA I-9 Compliance; FCRA Background Check Requirements; ASA Credentialing Standards

attributes.name: compliance_issue_type
attributes.description: Categorizes the type of compliance deficiency flagged for this vendor at the time of tier review (e.g., insurance_lapse, background_check_failure, i9_deficiency, everify_non_compliance, license_expiry). Populated when compliance_flag is True. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: insurance_lapse|background_check_failure|i9_deficiency|everify_non_compliance|license_expiry|drug_screen_failure|osha_violation — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: INA I-9 Compliance; FCRA; OSHA; ASA Credentialing Standards

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time at which this tier classification record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail, data lineage, and Silver layer ingestion tracking.
attributes.references: SOC 2 Type II Audit Trail Requirements; GDPR Article 5 (Data Integrity)

attributes.name: decision_outcome
attributes.description: The final decision made by the review committee regarding the vendor's tier classification. 'upgraded' = moved to a higher-preference tier; 'downgraded' = moved to a lower-preference tier; 'maintained' = no change; 'suspended' = tier privileges temporarily halted; 'terminated' = removed from program.
attributes.references: Beeline VMS Tier Decision Workflow; ASA Vendor Governance Standards

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date on which this tier classification definition or tier assignment becomes effective for the vendor within the program. For tier review records, this is the date the reclassification decision takes effect.
attributes.references: Beeline VMS Tier Effective Dating; ASA Contract Effective Date Standards

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: The date on which this tier classification definition or vendor tier assignment expires and requires renewal or review. Null indicates an open-ended tier with no scheduled expiration.
attributes.references: Beeline VMS Tier Lifecycle Management; ASA Vendor Program Standards

attributes.name: is_exclusive_supplier
attributes.description: Indicates whether the vendor has been designated as the exclusive supplier for a specific skill category, geography, or client within this program tier. True = exclusive supplier designation applies.
attributes.references: Beeline VMS Exclusive Supplier Configuration; ASA MSP Contract Standards

attributes.name: is_preferred_vendor
attributes.description: Indicates whether the vendor holds preferred status within this tier, granting first-right-of-refusal on requisitions before other vendors at the same tier level. True = preferred vendor within tier.
attributes.references: Beeline VMS Preferred Vendor Configuration; ASA MSP Program Standards

attributes.name: max_fill_rate_pct
attributes.description: The maximum percentage of total program requisition fill volume that vendors at this tier level are permitted to fulfill. Used to enforce program diversity and prevent over-concentration with a single tier. Expressed as a percentage (e.g., 60.00 = 60%).
attributes.references: Beeline VMS Rate Allocation Rules; SIA MSP Program Governance Standards

attributes.name: min_scorecard_score
attributes.description: The minimum vendor performance scorecard score required to qualify for or maintain this tier level. Scores below this threshold trigger a tier review or automatic downgrade. Expressed as a numeric score (e.g., 75.00 out of 100).
attributes.references: Beeline VMS Scorecard Thresholds; SIA Vendor Performance Management Standards

attributes.name: next_review_date
attributes.description: The date on which the next scheduled tier review is due for this vendor within the program. Calculated based on the review_cycle_frequency and the last review date. Used to drive MSP governance calendar and automated review notifications.
attributes.references: Beeline VMS Review Scheduling; ASA Vendor Governance Standards

attributes.name: previous_tier_code
attributes.description: The tier code held by the vendor immediately prior to a reclassification event. Populated only for tier_review records. Enables full audit trail of tier movement history and trend analysis.
attributes.references: Beeline VMS Tier History; ASA Vendor Audit Trail Standards

attributes.name: program_eligibility_rules
attributes.description: Structured text or rule expression defining the criteria a vendor must meet to qualify for this tier level. May include minimum scorecard thresholds, compliance certification requirements, insurance minimums, and contract status conditions.
attributes.references: Beeline VMS Supplier Qualification Rules; ASA Vendor Credentialing Standards

attributes.name: proposed_tier_code
attributes.description: The tier code proposed for the vendor as a result of a review event. May differ from the final decision outcome if the review committee overrides the initial proposal. Populated only for tier_review records.
attributes.references: Beeline VMS Tier Review Workflow; ASA Vendor Governance Standards

attributes.name: rationale_notes
attributes.description: Free-text narrative documenting the business rationale for the tier review decision, including key performance factors, compliance issues, or client feedback that influenced the outcome. Required for audit trail completeness.
attributes.references: ASA Vendor Governance Standards; SOC 2 Type II Documentation Requirements

attributes.name: record_type
attributes.description: Discriminator indicating whether this record represents a tier definition (the tier level itself), a tier assignment (a vendor assigned to a tier), or a tier review event (a reclassification decision). Enables the table to serve as both reference and history.
attributes.references: Beeline VMS Data Model; SIA Vendor Tier Management Standards

attributes.name: review_committee_members
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of names or identifiers of individuals who participated in the tier review committee. Provides governance accountability and audit trail for the review decision.
attributes.references: ASA MSP Governance Standards; SOC 2 Type II Audit Requirements

attributes.name: review_cycle_frequency
attributes.description: The scheduled frequency at which vendors assigned to this tier are reviewed for potential reclassification. Drives the automated review scheduling in the MSP governance calendar.
attributes.references: ASA Vendor Management Best Practices; SIA MSP Program Governance

attributes.name: review_date
attributes.description: The date on which the tier review committee convened and evaluated the vendor's tier classification. Populated only for tier_review records. Used for audit trail and review cycle compliance tracking.
attributes.references: Beeline VMS Review Audit Trail; ASA Vendor Governance Standards

attributes.name: review_trigger
attributes.description: The business reason that initiated this tier review event. 'scheduled' = routine review cycle; 'performance_based' = scorecard threshold breach; 'compliance_failure' = credentialing or regulatory non-compliance; 'client_request' = client-initiated review; 'contract_renewal' = triggered at MSA renewal.
attributes.references: Beeline VMS Review Trigger Configuration; ASA Vendor Governance Standards

attributes.name: scorecard_period_end
attributes.description: The end date of the vendor performance scorecard period referenced in this tier review. Together with scorecard_period_start, defines the evaluation window for the tier decision.
attributes.references: Beeline VMS Scorecard Period Configuration; SIA Vendor Performance Standards

attributes.name: scorecard_period_start
attributes.description: The start date of the vendor performance scorecard period referenced in this tier review. Defines the evaluation window used to assess vendor performance metrics that informed the tier decision.
attributes.references: Beeline VMS Scorecard Period Configuration; SIA Vendor Performance Standards

attributes.name: scorecard_score_at_review
attributes.description: The vendor's actual performance scorecard score at the time of the tier review, as referenced from the scorecard period. Provides the quantitative basis for the tier decision and is preserved for audit purposes.
attributes.references: Beeline VMS Scorecard Metrics; SIA Vendor Performance Management Standards

attributes.name: sla_fill_rate_target_pct
attributes.business_glossary_term: Service Level Agreement (SLA) Fill Rate Target Percentage
attributes.description: The target fill rate percentage that vendors at this tier are contractually expected to achieve. Expressed as a percentage of requisitions successfully filled (e.g., 85.00 = 85%). Used in SLA compliance monitoring and tier review scoring.
attributes.references: Beeline VMS SLA Metrics; ASA Staffing Program SLA Standards

attributes.name: sla_quality_of_submission_target
attributes.business_glossary_term: Service Level Agreement (SLA) Quality of Submission (QoS) Target
attributes.description: The minimum Quality of Submission (QoS) score that vendors at this tier must maintain. QoS measures the percentage of submitted candidates who meet the job requirements and advance to interview or placement. Expressed as a percentage.
attributes.references: Beeline VMS QoS Metrics; SIA Quality of Submission Standards

attributes.name: sla_time_to_submit_hours
attributes.business_glossary_term: Service Level Agreement (SLA) Time to Submit Hours
attributes.description: The maximum number of hours within which a vendor at this tier must submit qualified candidates after receiving a requisition. This is the SLA requirement specific to this tier level, used to enforce vendor responsiveness in the VMS.
attributes.references: Beeline VMS SLA Configuration; ASA SLA Standards for Staffing Programs

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Identifies the operational system of record from which this tier classification record originated. Supports data lineage tracking and multi-source reconciliation in the Databricks Silver layer.
attributes.references: Beeline VMS Integration Standards; SOC 2 Type II Data Lineage Requirements

attributes.name: submission_priority_order
attributes.description: The sequential order in which vendors at this tier level receive job requisition submissions from the MSP. Determines the cascade sequence when a higher-tier vendor does not fill a requisition within the SLA window.
attributes.references: Beeline VMS Requisition Routing Rules; ASA MSP Program Guidelines

attributes.name: tier_code
attributes.description: Short alphanumeric code uniquely identifying the tier level within the program (e.g., T1, T2, T3, T4). Used as the primary routing key in Beeline VMS vendor dispatch logic and rate card lookups.
attributes.references: Beeline VMS Tier Configuration; SIA Contingent Workforce Program Standards

attributes.name: tier_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of the tier level, including eligibility criteria, expected performance standards, and program privileges associated with this tier. Used for program documentation and vendor communication.
attributes.references: ASA Vendor Management Best Practices; SIA MSP Program Standards

attributes.name: tier_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the tier level as displayed in the VMS and MSP program documentation (e.g., Tier 1 Preferred, Tier 2 Approved, Tier 3 Conditional, Tier 4 Probationary). Drives vendor routing labels in Beeline VMS.
attributes.references: Beeline VMS Supplier Tier Naming; ASA MSP Program Guidelines

attributes.name: tier_rank
attributes.description: Numeric rank indicating the priority order of this tier relative to other tiers within the same program. Lower values indicate higher preference (e.g., 1 = most preferred). Drives submission priority sequencing in Beeline VMS requisition routing.
attributes.references: Beeline VMS Vendor Routing Logic; SIA Contingent Workforce Program Standards

attributes.name: tier_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of this tier classification record. 'active' indicates the tier definition is in use; 'inactive' means retired; 'suspended' means temporarily halted; 'pending_review' means under evaluation for change.
attributes.references: Beeline VMS Tier Lifecycle Management; ASA Vendor Program Standards

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time at which this tier classification record was last modified. Used for change detection, incremental data pipeline processing, and audit trail in the Databricks Silver layer.
attributes.references: SOC 2 Type II Audit Trail Requirements; GDPR Article 5 (Data Integrity)

attributes.name: vms_tier_code
attributes.description: The native tier identifier assigned by the Beeline VMS system for this tier classification record. Used for system-of-record reconciliation and integration with Beeline VMS vendor routing and rate management modules.
attributes.references: Beeline VMS Integration Standards; SIA VMS Data Exchange Standards

products.name: vms_enrollment
products.description: Tracks each vendor's enrollment, participation record, and onboarding task completion within the Beeline VMS contingent workforce program. Captures enrollment date, program name, client program ID, enrollment status (active, suspended, terminated, pending), approved job categories, approved work locations, VMS portal credentials status, electronic onboarding completion flag, MSP sponsor, enrollment agreement reference, and vendor onboarding workflow tasks (document submission, insurance verification, system access provisioning, training completion, contract execution, compliance attestation) with task status, due dates, completion dates, assigned reviewers, and blocking flags. One record per vendor per VMS program. Supports multi-client MSP program management and tracks the full supplier-organization-level onboarding lifecycle from initial enrollment through full program activation. Distinct from worker onboarding (owned by the onboarding domain) — this is supplier-organization-level enrollment and onboarding.

attributes.name: vms_enrollment_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each vendor VMS program enrollment record. One record per vendor per VMS program. Entity role: MASTER_AGREEMENT — represents a long-running supplier-organization-level enrollment and participation binding within a VMS-managed contingent workforce program.
attributes.references: Beeline VMS — Supplier Enrollment Module

attributes.name: client_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the client account that owns or sponsors the VMS program in which the vendor is enrolled. Supports multi-client MSP program management.
attributes.references: Beeline VMS — Client Program Management

attributes.name: client_program_id
attributes.description: The client-assigned or VMS-assigned identifier for the specific contingent workforce program, as referenced in client-facing documentation, SOW agreements, and MSP reporting.
attributes.references: Beeline VMS — Client Program Management

attributes.name: credential_package_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to credentialing.credential_package. Business justification: VMS enrollment requires specific credentialing packages for program participation. Critical for vendor onboarding requirements, compliance verification, program eligibility determination, and enrollme
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Reference to the vendor (staffing supplier, subcontractor, or service provider) being enrolled in the VMS program. Links to the vendor master record.
attributes.references: Beeline VMS — Supplier Profile

attributes.name: vendor_agreement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to contract.vendor_agreement. Business justification: VMS enrollment is formalized through a vendor agreement. Business needs to link enrollment record to the executed agreement for validating enrollment terms, tracking agreement-driven onboarding tasks,
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: vms_program_id
attributes.description: Reference to the VMS contingent workforce program in which the vendor is being enrolled. Links to the client VMS program record.
attributes.references: Beeline VMS — Program Configuration

attributes.name: approved_job_categories
attributes.description: Comma-separated list or free-text description of the job categories or labor categories for which the vendor is approved to submit candidates within this VMS program (e.g., 'IT, Engineering, Administrative'). Governs which requisitions the vendor may respond to.
attributes.references: Beeline VMS — Supplier Category Management; SIA Workforce Classification

attributes.name: approved_work_locations
attributes.description: Comma-separated list or free-text description of geographic locations or client site identifiers where the vendor is approved to place workers under this VMS program enrollment. Restricts vendor activity to authorized geographies.
attributes.references: Beeline VMS — Supplier Location Management; OFCCP Geographic Compliance

attributes.name: assigned_reviewer
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the MSP program staff member or VMS administrator assigned to review and manage this vendor's enrollment and onboarding workflow tasks.
attributes.references: Beeline VMS — Supplier Onboarding Workflow; MSP Program Operations

attributes.name: blocking_task_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether any onboarding task is currently flagged as blocking, meaning the vendor cannot achieve full program activation until the blocking task is resolved. True = one or more blocking tasks outstanding; False = no blocking tasks.
attributes.references: Beeline VMS — Supplier Onboarding Workflow

attributes.name: compliance_attestation_status
attributes.description: Status of the vendor's completion of required compliance attestations within the VMS onboarding workflow, including acknowledgment of program rules, EEOC/OFCCP policies, co-employment guidelines, and data security requirements.
attributes.references: Beeline VMS — Compliance Attestation; EEOC; OFCCP; SOC 2 Type II; GDPR; CCPA

attributes.name: contract_execution_status
attributes.description: Status of the vendor's enrollment contract execution within the DocuSign CLM workflow. Executed = fully signed by all parties; Pending_Signature = awaiting one or more signatures; Under_Review = legal or compliance review in progress; Expired = contract term has ended.
attributes.references: DocuSign CLM — Contract Lifecycle Management; ASA MSA Standards

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this VMS enrollment record was first created in the system. Satisfies RECORD_AUDIT_CREATED category for MASTER_AGREEMENT role. Used for audit trail and data lineage.
attributes.references: SOC 2 Type II Audit Trail Requirements; GDPR Article 5 (Data Integrity); CCPA

attributes.name: diversity_certification_expiry
attributes.description: Expiry date of the vendor's diversity or small business certification. Used to trigger renewal reminders and ensure diversity spend reporting accuracy. Null if no diversity certification is held.
attributes.references: OFCCP; SBA Certification Programs; ASA Diversity Supplier Standards

attributes.name: diversity_certification_type
attributes.description: Type of diversity or small business certification held by the vendor (e.g., MBE, WBE, SDVOSB, HUBZone, 8(a)). Relevant for client diversity spend reporting and OFCCP compliance. Null if vendor holds no diversity certification. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: MBE|WBE|SDVOSB|HUBZone|8a|DVBE|SBE|none — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: OFCCP; EEOC; SBA Small Business Certification Programs; ASA Diversity Supplier Standards

attributes.name: document_submission_status
attributes.description: Overall status of the vendor's required document submission task within the VMS onboarding workflow. Documents typically include W-9, certificates of insurance, business licenses, and diversity certifications.
attributes.references: Beeline VMS — Supplier Document Management; IRS W-9 Requirements; FCRA

attributes.name: electronic_onboarding_complete
attributes.description: Indicates whether the vendor has completed all required electronic onboarding steps within the VMS portal, including document submission, system training, and compliance attestation. True = fully completed; False = incomplete or in progress.
attributes.references: Beeline VMS — Supplier Onboarding Workflow

attributes.name: enrollment_agreement_ref
attributes.description: Reference number or document identifier for the executed enrollment agreement between the vendor and the MSP/client program. Links to the DocuSign CLM contract record for audit and compliance purposes.
attributes.references: DocuSign CLM — Contract Lifecycle Management; ASA Supplier Agreement Standards

attributes.name: enrollment_date
attributes.description: The date on which the vendor was formally enrolled or first submitted for enrollment in the VMS program. Represents the start of the supplier-organization-level onboarding lifecycle. Satisfies EFFECTIVE_FROM category for MASTER_AGREEMENT role.
attributes.references: Beeline VMS — Supplier Enrollment Module

attributes.name: enrollment_expiry_date
attributes.description: The date on which the vendor's enrollment in the VMS program expires or is scheduled for renewal review. Null for open-ended enrollments. Satisfies EFFECTIVE_UNTIL category for MASTER_AGREEMENT role.
attributes.references: Beeline VMS — Supplier Enrollment Module; MSA Renewal Governance

attributes.name: enrollment_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes entered by the MSP program administrator or VMS coordinator regarding special conditions, exceptions, escalations, or context relevant to this vendor's enrollment record.
attributes.references: Beeline VMS — Supplier Enrollment Module

attributes.name: enrollment_number
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier for this enrollment record, assigned by the VMS system or MSP program administrator. Used in correspondence, audit trails, and supplier communications. Satisfies BUSINESS_IDENTIFIER category for MASTER_AGREEMENT role.
attributes.references: Beeline VMS — Supplier Enrollment Module

attributes.name: enrollment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the vendor's participation in the VMS program. Active = fully enrolled and eligible to submit workers; Pending = enrollment initiated but not yet complete; Under_Review = compliance or performance issue under investigation; Suspended = temporarily barred from submitting; Terminated = permanently removed from program. Satisfies LIFECYCLE_STATUS category for MASTER_AGREEMENT role.
attributes.references: Beeline VMS — Supplier Enrollment Module; ASA Supplier Management Standards

attributes.name: insurance_expiry_date
attributes.description: The date on which the vendor's primary insurance coverage (e.g., general liability, workers compensation) expires. Used to trigger renewal reminders and compliance holds within the VMS program.
attributes.references: Beeline VMS — Supplier Compliance; OSHA; Workers Comp (Workers Compensation Insurance)

attributes.name: insurance_verification_status
attributes.description: Status of the vendor's required insurance documentation verification within the VMS onboarding workflow. Verified = all required certificates of insurance confirmed; Pending = documents submitted but not yet reviewed; Expired = previously verified but coverage has lapsed; Waived = requirement waived by program administrator.
attributes.references: Beeline VMS — Supplier Compliance; OSHA; Workers Comp Compliance; ASA

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this VMS enrollment record was most recently modified. Used for change tracking, data synchronization with Beeline VMS, and audit compliance.
attributes.references: SOC 2 Type II Audit Trail Requirements; GDPR Article 5; Beeline VMS — Data Sync

attributes.name: msa_reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier for the Master Service Agreement (MSA) governing the vendor's participation in the program. The MSA establishes the overarching legal and commercial terms under which the vendor operates.
attributes.references: DocuSign CLM — MSA Management; ASA; NAPEO

attributes.name: msp_sponsor
attributes.description: Name of the Managed Service Provider (MSP) organization that sponsors and manages this vendor's enrollment in the VMS program. Identifies the MSP entity responsible for vendor oversight and program compliance.
attributes.references: Beeline VMS — MSP Program Management; SIA MSP Standards

attributes.name: nda_executed
attributes.description: Indicates whether a Non-Disclosure Agreement (NDA) has been fully executed between the vendor and the client or MSP as part of the program enrollment requirements. True = NDA executed; False = not yet executed.
attributes.references: DocuSign CLM — NDA (Non-Disclosure Agreement) Management; ASA

attributes.name: non_compete_executed
attributes.description: Indicates whether a non-compete or non-solicitation agreement has been fully executed between the vendor and the client or MSP as part of the program enrollment. True = executed; False = not executed.
attributes.references: DocuSign CLM — Contract Lifecycle Management; ASA Supplier Agreement Standards

attributes.name: onboarding_due_date
attributes.description: Target date by which the vendor must complete all onboarding tasks to achieve full program activation. Used for SLA tracking and escalation management within the MSP program.
attributes.references: Beeline VMS — Supplier Onboarding Workflow; SLA (Service Level Agreement) Management

attributes.name: onboarding_task_count
attributes.description: Total number of onboarding workflow tasks defined for this vendor's enrollment in the VMS program. Used to calculate completion percentage and track overall onboarding progress.
attributes.references: Beeline VMS — Supplier Onboarding Workflow

attributes.name: onboarding_tasks_completed
attributes.description: Number of onboarding workflow tasks that have been completed for this vendor's enrollment. Compared against onboarding_task_count to determine overall completion progress.
attributes.references: Beeline VMS — Supplier Onboarding Workflow

attributes.name: portal_credentials_status
attributes.description: Status of the vendor's VMS portal access credentials. Provisioned = active login credentials issued; Pending = credentials requested but not yet issued; Revoked = access removed due to termination or suspension; Expired = credentials have lapsed and require renewal.
attributes.references: Beeline VMS — System Access Provisioning; SOC 2 Type II Access Control

attributes.name: program_activation_date
attributes.description: The date on which the vendor achieved full program activation status, meaning all onboarding tasks were completed and the vendor was cleared to submit workers or SOW resources into the program.
attributes.references: Beeline VMS — Supplier Enrollment Module

attributes.name: suspension_date
attributes.description: The date on which the vendor's enrollment was suspended. Null if the vendor has never been suspended. Used for compliance tracking and reinstatement workflows.
attributes.references: Beeline VMS — Supplier Compliance Management; ASA

attributes.name: system_access_status
attributes.description: Status of the vendor's VMS system access provisioning task, distinct from portal credentials status. Tracks whether IT/system access provisioning workflow has been completed for the vendor organization's designated users.
attributes.references: Beeline VMS — System Access Provisioning; SOC 2 Type II Access Control

attributes.name: termination_date
attributes.description: The date on which the vendor's enrollment was permanently terminated from the VMS program. Null if the vendor is still active or suspended. Required for offboarding and compliance audit trails.
attributes.references: Beeline VMS — Supplier Enrollment Module; ASA Supplier Management Standards

attributes.name: termination_reason
attributes.description: Reason code for the termination of the vendor's enrollment. Performance = removed due to poor performance metrics; Compliance_Failure = removed due to compliance violations; Voluntary_Exit = vendor chose to exit the program; Program_Restructure = program eliminated or restructured; Contract_Expiry = enrollment agreement expired without renewal.
attributes.references: Beeline VMS — Supplier Enrollment Module; ASA

attributes.name: training_completion_status
attributes.description: Status of the vendor's completion of required VMS portal and program training modules. Training typically covers system usage, submission workflows, timesheet approval processes, and compliance requirements.
attributes.references: Beeline VMS — Supplier Training; SAP SuccessFactors LMS

attributes.name: vendor_tier
attributes.description: Tier classification of the vendor within the VMS program, reflecting performance standing and preferred supplier status. Preferred = top-tier, first-look suppliers; Approved = standard program participants; Conditional = approved with conditions or restrictions; Probationary = under performance improvement plan.
attributes.references: Beeline VMS — Supplier Tier Management; SIA Contingent Workforce Best Practices

attributes.name: vendor_type
attributes.description: Classification of the vendor's business model within the program. Staffing_Agency = traditional temp/perm staffing; IC_Supplier = Independent Contractor (IC) supplier; SOW_Vendor = Statement of Work (SOW) project vendor; RPO_Provider = Recruitment Process Outsourcing (RPO) partner; MSP_Subvendor = subvendor operating under the MSP umbrella.
attributes.references: Beeline VMS — Supplier Classification; IRS Worker Classification Rules; ASA

attributes.name: w9_on_file
attributes.business_glossary_term: W-9 (IRS Request for Taxpayer Identification) On File Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a valid IRS Form W-9 (Request for Taxpayer Identification Number and Certification) has been received and is on file for this vendor. Required for tax reporting and 1099 issuance. True = W-9 on file; False = not on file.
attributes.references: IRS W-9 Requirements; IRS 1099 (Independent Contractor Tax Form) Reporting; IRS Worker Classification Rules

products.name: vendor_rate_card
products.description: Defines the standard bill rate and pay rate schedule negotiated with a vendor for specific job categories, skill levels, and labor classifications within a VMS program or MSP engagement. Captures vendor ID, job category, labor category (e.g., IT, light industrial, clerical, professional), skill level (e.g., junior, mid, senior, lead), standard bill rate, standard pay rate, OT bill rate, OT pay rate, DT bill rate, DT pay rate, per diem rate, currency, effective date, expiration date, geographic market, and rate card version. Serves as the rate template from which binding rate_agreement records are executed. Supports rate benchmarking, spread analysis, and market rate comparison across the vendor supply chain.
products.reference: Vendor Rate Card / Bill Rate Schedule

attributes.name: vendor_rate_card_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated surrogate key identifying a vendor rate card record within the VMS/MSP program. Primary key for this entity.
attributes.references: Beeline VMS Rate Management

attributes.name: contract_rate_schedule_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to contract.contract_rate_schedule. Business justification: Vendor rate cards map to contract rate schedules. Business needs to reconcile vendor-submitted rates against contractually approved schedules for rate exception approvals, markup validation, and ensur
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Reference to the staffing supplier or subcontractor for whom this rate card is defined. Links to the vendor master record.
attributes.references: Beeline VMS Vendor Management

attributes.name: vms_program_id
attributes.description: Reference to the Vendor Management System (VMS) or Managed Service Provider (MSP) program under which this rate card is negotiated and enforced.
attributes.references: Beeline VMS Contingent Workforce Program Management

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: The date on which this rate card was formally approved by the authorized approver. Establishes the governance timestamp for rate card authorization and supports compliance audit trails.
attributes.references: DocuSign CLM Contract Lifecycle Management; SOC 2 Type II; Beeline VMS Rate Management

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the MSP program manager, procurement officer, or client representative who formally approved this rate card. Supports audit trail and governance requirements for rate card authorization.
attributes.references: DocuSign CLM Contract Lifecycle Management; SOC 2 Type II Audit Controls

attributes.name: burden_rate
attributes.description: The total employer cost rate applied on top of the base pay rate to cover mandatory employer taxes and insurance costs including FICA, FUTA, SUTA, Workers Compensation (Workers Comp), and benefits. Expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.18 = 18%). Used in gross margin and profitability analysis.
attributes.references: Beeline VMS Rate Management; IRS FICA; DOL FUTA; SUTA State Requirements; OSHA Workers Compensation

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 three-letter country code for the country in which this rate card applies (e.g., USA, CAN, GBR). Supports international MSP programs and multi-country vendor rate management.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3; Beeline VMS Rate Management; GDPR (for EU operations); CCPA (for California)

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this rate card record was first created in the system, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Supports audit trail, data lineage, and SOC 2 compliance requirements.
attributes.references: SOC 2 Type II Audit Controls; GDPR Article 5 (Data Integrity); CCPA

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code in which all rates on this rate card are denominated (e.g., USD, CAD, GBP). Supports multi-currency vendor programs for international MSP engagements.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; Beeline VMS Rate Management

attributes.name: dt_bill_rate
attributes.description: The negotiated hourly rate charged to the client for double time (DT) hours, typically applicable for holidays, Sundays, or hours beyond a defined daily/weekly threshold per the client MSA or state labor law. Expressed in the currency defined by the currency_code field.
attributes.references: Beeline VMS Rate Management; Salesforce Revenue Cloud; State Labor Laws; DOL

attributes.name: dt_pay_rate
attributes.description: The negotiated hourly rate paid to the worker or vendor for double time (DT) hours. Expressed in the currency defined by the currency_code field. Applicable in states or contracts requiring double-time compensation.
attributes.references: Beeline VMS Rate Management; TempWorks Payroll; State Labor Laws; DOL

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date on which this rate card becomes binding and applicable for worker placements and billing. Rates may not be applied to assignments prior to this date.
attributes.references: Beeline VMS Rate Management; FLSA Rate Compliance; DOL Wage Standards

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: The date on which this rate card ceases to be valid. After this date, a new rate agreement or rate card version must be executed. Nullable for open-ended rate cards.
attributes.references: Beeline VMS Rate Management; DocuSign CLM MSA Management

attributes.name: flsa_classification
attributes.description: The Fair Labor Standards Act (FLSA) exemption status for workers placed under this rate card. 'exempt' workers are not entitled to overtime pay; 'non_exempt' workers must receive overtime at 1.5x the regular rate for hours over 40 per week. Critical for OT rate applicability.
attributes.references: FLSA Section 13; DOL Wage and Hour Division; EEOC

attributes.name: geographic_market
attributes.description: The geographic market or region for which this rate card applies (e.g., 'Northeast US', 'California', 'Chicago Metro', 'National'). Rates vary by market due to cost-of-living, prevailing wage laws, and local labor market conditions. Supports market rate comparison and geographic spread analysis.
attributes.references: Beeline VMS Rate Management; DOL Prevailing Wage; Davis-Bacon Act; SIA Market Rate Benchmarks

attributes.name: is_prevailing_wage
attributes.description: Indicates whether this rate card is subject to prevailing wage requirements under the Davis-Bacon Act, Service Contract Act (SCA), or state prevailing wage laws. When True, the pay rate must meet or exceed the applicable prevailing wage determination.
attributes.references: DOL Davis-Bacon Act; DOL Service Contract Act; OFCCP Prevailing Wage Compliance

attributes.name: is_union_rate
attributes.description: Indicates whether this rate card applies to unionized workers governed by a Collective Bargaining Agreement (CBA). When True, the rates must comply with the applicable CBA wage scales and benefit requirements.
attributes.references: NLRA National Labor Relations Act; DOL Collective Bargaining; ASA Union Staffing Standards

attributes.name: job_category
attributes.description: The broad occupational category for which this rate card applies (e.g., Information Technology, Light Industrial, Clerical, Professional, Healthcare, Engineering, Finance). Aligns with VMS job category taxonomy used in Beeline for rate benchmarking. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: information_technology|light_industrial|clerical|professional|healthcare|engineering|finance|legal|creative|scientific — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Beeline VMS Rate Management; SIA Labor Category Standards; DOL Occupational Classification

attributes.name: job_title
attributes.description: The specific job title or role designation associated with this rate card entry (e.g., 'Java Developer', 'Warehouse Associate', 'Data Analyst'). Provides granular role-level rate definition within a broader job category and skill level combination.
attributes.references: Beeline VMS Rate Management; DOL Standard Occupational Classification (SOC); O*NET

attributes.name: labor_category
attributes.description: The labor engagement classification that determines how the worker is engaged and billed. 'staff_augmentation' covers standard contingent placements; 'sow_resource' covers Statement of Work (SOW) deliverable-based engagements; 'independent_contractor' covers IC/1099 supplier resources; 'temp_to_perm' covers contract-to-hire arrangements; 'direct_hire' covers permanent placement; 'managed_service' covers MSP-managed resources.
attributes.references: Beeline VMS Contingent Workforce Program Management; IRS Worker Classification Rules; ASA Staffing Classifications

attributes.name: markup_percentage
attributes.description: The negotiated markup percentage applied over the pay rate to derive the bill rate, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.35 = 35%). Represents the vendor's margin and covers burden costs including FICA, FUTA, SUTA, Workers Compensation, and administrative overhead. Used in spread analysis and vendor benchmarking.
attributes.references: Beeline VMS Rate Management; ASA Markup Standards; IRS Burden Rate Guidelines; FUTA; SUTA; FICA

attributes.name: max_bill_rate
attributes.description: The ceiling bill rate above which the vendor may not submit candidates for this job category and skill level within the VMS program. Enforces rate card compliance and controls program spend in the Beeline VMS.
attributes.references: Beeline VMS Rate Management; ASA Rate Compliance Standards

attributes.name: min_bill_rate
attributes.description: The floor bill rate below which the vendor may not submit candidates for this job category and skill level within the VMS program. Enforces rate card compliance and prevents below-floor rate submissions in the Beeline VMS.
attributes.references: Beeline VMS Rate Management; ASA Rate Compliance Standards

attributes.name: negotiation_notes
attributes.description: Free-text field capturing key points, concessions, or conditions from the rate card negotiation process. Confidential business information used by MSP program managers and procurement teams for future rate renegotiations.
attributes.references: DocuSign CLM Contract Lifecycle Management; ASA Vendor Management Best Practices

attributes.name: ot_bill_rate
attributes.description: The negotiated hourly rate charged to the client for overtime (OT) hours worked beyond the standard threshold (typically 40 hours/week per FLSA). Expressed in the currency defined by the currency_code field.
attributes.references: Beeline VMS Rate Management; FLSA Overtime Provisions; DOL Wage and Hour Division

attributes.name: ot_pay_rate
attributes.description: The negotiated hourly rate paid to the worker or vendor for overtime (OT) hours. Must comply with FLSA overtime requirements (minimum 1.5x regular pay rate). Expressed in the currency defined by the currency_code field.
attributes.references: Beeline VMS Rate Management; TempWorks Payroll; FLSA Section 7; DOL Wage and Hour Division

attributes.name: per_diem_rate
attributes.description: The daily allowance paid to the worker for meals, lodging, and incidental expenses when working away from their tax home. Expressed in the currency defined by the currency_code field. Must comply with IRS per diem guidelines to maintain tax-free status.
attributes.references: Beeline VMS Rate Management; IRS Publication 463; GSA Per Diem Rates; DOL

attributes.name: rate_card_description
attributes.description: Free-text description providing additional context about the scope, applicability, or special conditions of this rate card (e.g., specific client programs, project types, or negotiation notes).
attributes.references: Beeline VMS Rate Management; DocuSign CLM

attributes.name: rate_card_name
attributes.description: Human-readable descriptive name for this rate card (e.g., 'FY2025 IT Staff Aug - Northeast - Senior'). Used in VMS program management, vendor communications, and reporting dashboards for easy identification.
attributes.references: Beeline VMS Rate Management; Power BI Analytics Platform

attributes.name: rate_card_number
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric identifier for this rate card, used in vendor communications, contract references, and VMS system cross-referencing. Typically prefixed with 'RC-' followed by a program-specific code.
attributes.references: Beeline VMS Rate Management; ASA Rate Card Standards

attributes.name: rate_card_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the rate card. 'draft' indicates pending negotiation; 'active' indicates currently in effect; 'expired' indicates past the expiration date; 'superseded' indicates replaced by a newer version; 'suspended' indicates temporarily inactive.
attributes.references: Beeline VMS Rate Management; ASA Staffing Industry Standards

attributes.name: rate_type
attributes.description: The unit basis on which the bill rate and pay rate are expressed. 'hourly' is standard for contingent staffing; 'daily' and 'weekly' apply to certain professional and light industrial engagements; 'monthly' applies to long-term retained resources; 'fixed_fee' applies to SOW deliverable-based engagements.
attributes.references: Beeline VMS Rate Management; ASA Staffing Industry Standards

attributes.name: skill_level
attributes.description: The experience and seniority tier of the worker for which this rate applies. Used to differentiate bill rates and pay rates within the same job category. Aligns with VMS skill level taxonomy for rate benchmarking and spread analysis.
attributes.references: Beeline VMS Rate Management; SIA Workforce Analytics Standards

attributes.name: soc_code
attributes.description: The U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics Standard Occupational Classification (SOC) code associated with the job title on this rate card. Enables labor market benchmarking, prevailing wage compliance, and regulatory reporting alignment.
attributes.references: DOL Bureau of Labor Statistics SOC System; O*NET; OFCCP Compliance Reporting

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: The operational system of record from which this rate card record originated. Supports data lineage tracking and reconciliation across the technology stack. 'beeline' is the primary source for VMS-managed rate cards.
attributes.references: Beeline VMS Rate Management; Bullhorn ATS/CRM; Salesforce Revenue Cloud; SOC 2 Type II Data Lineage

attributes.name: source_system_rate_card_code
attributes.description: The native identifier of this rate card record in the originating source system (e.g., Beeline VMS rate card ID). Enables cross-system reconciliation and traceability between the lakehouse Silver layer and the operational system of record.
attributes.references: Beeline VMS Rate Management; SOC 2 Type II Data Lineage

attributes.name: standard_bill_rate
attributes.description: The negotiated hourly rate charged to the client for a worker at this job category and skill level during standard (straight-time) hours. Expressed in the currency defined by the currency_code field. This is the primary rate used for client invoicing.
attributes.references: Beeline VMS Rate Management; Salesforce Revenue Cloud Billing; ASA Bill Rate Standards; FLSA

attributes.name: standard_pay_rate
attributes.description: The negotiated hourly rate paid to the worker or vendor for standard (straight-time) hours. Expressed in the currency defined by the currency_code field. Used in spread analysis and gross margin calculations.
attributes.references: Beeline VMS Rate Management; TempWorks Payroll; DOL Wage and Hour Division; FLSA

attributes.name: state_code
attributes.description: Two-letter US state code (ISO 3166-2:US) for the primary state jurisdiction of this rate card. Drives state-specific compliance requirements including SUTA rates, Workers Compensation classifications, and state minimum wage compliance.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-2:US; DOL State Wage Laws; SUTA State Requirements; OSHA State Plans

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this rate card record was last modified, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Tracks the most recent change for audit trail and data freshness monitoring.
attributes.references: SOC 2 Type II Audit Controls; GDPR Article 5 (Data Integrity); CCPA

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Version identifier for this rate card (e.g., v1.0, v2.1), enabling tracking of rate card revisions over time and supporting historical rate benchmarking and audit trails.
attributes.references: Beeline VMS Rate Management; DocuSign CLM Contract Lifecycle Management

attributes.name: workers_comp_code
attributes.description: The National Council on Compensation Insurance (NCCI) or state-specific Workers Compensation classification code associated with the job category on this rate card. Determines the Workers Comp insurance premium rate applied to the pay rate.
attributes.references: NCCI Workers Compensation Classification; OSHA; DOL; TempWorks Payroll Workers Compensation

products.name: rate_agreement
products.description: Captures the formally executed rate agreement between the MSP/staffing firm and a vendor supplier for a specific client program or engagement period. Tracks agreement reference number, vendor ID, client program, negotiated markup percentage, spread floor, rate lock period, rate escalation clauses, approved rate exceptions, signatory names, execution date, effective start date, expiration date, and DocuSign CLM document reference. Distinct from the rate card template — this is the binding executed agreement.
products.reference: Vendor Rate Agreement / Negotiated Rate Schedule

attributes.name: rate_agreement_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated surrogate key identifying this executed rate agreement record in the vendor domain.
attributes.references: Internal Data Governance Standard

attributes.name: client_rate_card_id
attributes.description: Reference to the rate card template from which this executed agreement was derived. Distinct from the agreement itself — the rate card is the template; this record is the binding executed instrument.
attributes.references: Beeline VMS — Rate Management

attributes.name: contract_msa_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to contract.msa. Business justification: Rate agreements in staffing are executed under MSAs. Business needs to trace rate terms back to governing master agreement for compliance audits, dispute resolution, and validating rate agreement term
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: contract_rate_schedule_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to contract.contract_rate_schedule. Business justification: Rate agreements reference specific contract rate schedules. Business needs to link to the detailed schedule for billing validation, pay rate verification, and ensuring rate agreement terms match the a
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: docusign_envelope_id
attributes.description: The DocuSign CLM envelope identifier for the executed rate agreement document, enabling direct retrieval of the signed contract from the DocuSign document repository.
attributes.references: DocuSign CLM — Envelope Reference; ESIGN Act; UETA

attributes.name: managed_program_id
attributes.description: Reference to the Vendor Management System (VMS) client program under which this rate agreement is executed.
attributes.references: Beeline VMS — Program Configuration

attributes.name: msp_signatory_staff_profile_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Msp Signatory Staff Profile Id (Foreign Key)
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to employee.staff_profile. Business justification: Identifies internal employee (procurement director/VP) who signed rate agreement on behalf of MSP. Required for contract authority validation, legal compliance, and signature audit trails in vendor co
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Reference to the vendor supplier party that is a signatory to this rate agreement.
attributes.references: Beeline VMS — Vendor Profile

attributes.name: agreement_name
attributes.description: Human-readable descriptive name of the rate agreement, typically including vendor name, client program, and engagement period (e.g., 'Acme Staffing — TechCorp IT Program FY2025').
attributes.references: Beeline VMS — Rate Management; DocuSign CLM

attributes.name: agreement_number
attributes.description: Externally-known unique reference number assigned to this executed rate agreement, used for cross-system reconciliation between Beeline VMS, DocuSign CLM, and Oracle NetSuite ERP.
attributes.references: DocuSign CLM — Contract Reference; Beeline VMS — Agreement Number

attributes.name: agreement_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the rate agreement. Controls whether rates under this agreement may be applied to active placements and job orders.
attributes.references: Beeline VMS — Agreement Lifecycle; DocuSign CLM — Contract Status

attributes.name: agreement_type
attributes.description: Classification of the rate agreement by engagement model. Determines applicable rate structures and compliance obligations. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: msp_vendor|sow_vendor|ic_supplier|direct_placement|temp_to_perm|rpo_vendor — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: American Staffing Association (ASA) — Engagement Classification; Staffing Industry Analysts (SIA)

attributes.name: auto_renewal
attributes.description: Indicates whether this rate agreement automatically renews upon expiration unless either party provides written notice of termination within the notice period.
attributes.references: DocuSign CLM — Contract Renewal Terms; MSA Auto-Renewal Clause

attributes.name: burden_rate_included
attributes.description: Indicates whether the employer burden rate (FICA, FUTA, SUTA, Workers Compensation, benefits) is embedded within the agreed markup percentage or billed separately as a pass-through cost.
attributes.references: IRS — Employer Tax Obligations; FUTA/SUTA; FICA; ASA — Burden Rate Standard

attributes.name: clm_document_reference
attributes.description: The internal DocuSign CLM document reference number or URL for the executed rate agreement, used for contract audit trail and legal record retention.
attributes.references: DocuSign CLM — Document Management; SOC 2 Type II — Record Retention

attributes.name: conversion_fee_percentage
attributes.description: The agreed conversion fee percentage charged when a contingent worker placed under this agreement is converted to a permanent (FTE) hire by the client (Temp-to-Perm or Contract-to-Hire conversion).
attributes.references: ASA — Conversion Fee Standard; Beeline VMS — Temp-to-Perm Policy

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this rate agreement record was first created in the system, supporting audit trail and data lineage requirements.
attributes.references: SOC 2 Type II — Audit Trail; GDPR Article 5 — Data Integrity

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code applicable to all monetary amounts in this rate agreement (e.g., USD, CAD, GBP). Supports multi-currency MSP programs.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 — Currency Codes; Oracle NetSuite ERP — Multi-Currency

attributes.name: dt_markup_percentage
attributes.description: Negotiated markup percentage applied to double time (DT) hours billed under this agreement, applicable in states or contracts requiring double-time pay.
attributes.references: FLSA — Wage and Hour; California Labor Code — Double Time; ASA

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: The date on which the negotiated rates and terms of this agreement become binding and applicable to placements and job orders.
attributes.references: FLSA — Wage Rate Effective Date; Beeline VMS — Rate Lock Period

attributes.name: escalation_clause
attributes.description: Indicates whether this rate agreement contains a rate escalation clause permitting periodic rate adjustments (e.g., annual CPI-linked increases) after the rate lock period expires.
attributes.references: Beeline VMS — Rate Escalation; MSA Rate Escalation Clause

attributes.name: escalation_frequency
attributes.description: The frequency at which rate escalations may be applied under the escalation clause. Null if escalation_clause is False.
attributes.references: Beeline VMS — Rate Escalation; MSA Rate Escalation Clause

attributes.name: escalation_percentage
attributes.description: The maximum allowable rate escalation percentage per escalation period as defined in the escalation clause. Null if escalation_clause is False. Expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.0300 = 3%).
attributes.references: Beeline VMS — Rate Escalation; CPI Index — U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics

attributes.name: execution_date
attributes.description: The date on which all required signatories completed execution of the rate agreement, making it legally binding. Captured from DocuSign CLM completion event.
attributes.references: DocuSign CLM — Completion Timestamp; ESIGN Act

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: The date on which this rate agreement expires and rates are no longer binding. Null indicates an open-ended agreement. Triggers renewal workflow when approaching.
attributes.references: Beeline VMS — Rate Lock Period; DocuSign CLM — Contract Expiry

attributes.name: governing_law_state
attributes.description: Two-letter US state code indicating the jurisdiction whose laws govern interpretation and enforcement of this rate agreement.
attributes.references: MSA Governing Law Clause; FLSA; State Labor Laws

attributes.name: markup_percentage
attributes.description: The agreed markup percentage applied over the pay rate to derive the bill rate for contingent workers placed under this agreement. Expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.4500 = 45%). Core financial term in staffing: Markup % = (Bill Rate - Pay Rate) / Pay Rate.
attributes.references: ASA — Markup Percentage Standard; Beeline VMS — Rate Management; Staffing Industry Analysts (SIA)

attributes.name: max_exception_markup_pct
attributes.description: The maximum markup percentage permitted for approved rate exceptions under this agreement. Null if rate_exception_allowed is False.
attributes.references: Beeline VMS — Rate Exception Management; MSP Program Policy

attributes.name: msp_fee_percentage
attributes.description: The MSP program management fee percentage charged to the vendor supplier under this agreement, deducted from the bill rate or invoiced separately depending on program structure.
attributes.references: Beeline VMS — MSP Fee Configuration; SIA — MSP Program Standards

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for capturing special terms, negotiation context, approved exceptions, or operational notes associated with this rate agreement that are not captured in structured fields.
attributes.references: Internal Data Governance Standard

attributes.name: ot_markup_percentage
attributes.description: Negotiated markup percentage applied to overtime (OT) hours billed under this agreement. May differ from the standard markup percentage per FLSA overtime billing conventions.
attributes.references: FLSA — Overtime Provisions; ASA — OT Billing Standard

attributes.name: per_diem_included
attributes.description: Indicates whether per diem allowances for travel, lodging, and meals are included within the rate structure of this agreement or handled as separate expense reimbursements.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 463 — Travel Expenses; ASA — Per Diem Policy

attributes.name: program_scope
attributes.description: Geographic or organizational scope of this rate agreement — whether rates apply nationally, regionally, to a specific site, or globally across the client's enterprise.
attributes.references: Beeline VMS — Program Configuration; MSA Scope of Services

attributes.name: rate_exception_allowed
attributes.description: Indicates whether approved rate exceptions above the negotiated rate card are permitted under this agreement for specialized skill sets or market-driven rate adjustments.
attributes.references: Beeline VMS — Rate Exception Management; MSP Program Policy

attributes.name: rate_lock_end_date
attributes.description: End date of the rate lock period. After this date, rates may be renegotiated per the escalation clause terms defined in this agreement.
attributes.references: Beeline VMS — Rate Lock Period; MSA Rate Stability Clause

attributes.name: rate_lock_start_date

attributes.description: Indicates whether a compliance expiration alert has been triggered for this record based on the configured alert threshold. True when the current date is within alert_threshold_days of document_expiration_date.
