attributes.name: auto_renewal
attributes.description: Indicates whether the insurance policy is set to auto-renew upon expiration. When True, the compliance team may rely on automatic renewal; when False, proactive renewal tracking is required to prevent coverage lapses. Applicable only when is_insurance_record is True.
attributes.references: Beeline VMS — Insurance Renewal Tracking; ASA Compliance Guidelines

attributes.name: carrier_name
attributes.description: Legal name of the insurance carrier or underwriter that issued the policy documented in this compliance record. Used to verify carrier financial strength ratings and validate certificate authenticity. Applicable only when is_insurance_record is True.
attributes.references: ACORD 25 Certificate of Insurance Standard; ASA Compliance Guidelines

attributes.name: certificate_holder
attributes.description: Name of the entity listed as the certificate holder on the COI — typically the MSP, the end client, or both. The certificate holder is notified by the carrier in the event of policy cancellation or material change. Applicable only when is_insurance_record is True.
attributes.references: ACORD 25 Certificate of Insurance Standard; ASA Compliance Guidelines

attributes.name: certificate_number
attributes.description: Unique certificate number printed on the Certificate of Insurance (COI) issued by the vendor's insurance carrier. Used to uniquely identify and track the specific COI document. Applicable only when is_insurance_record is True.
attributes.references: ACORD 25 Certificate of Insurance Standard; ASA Compliance Guidelines

attributes.name: coi_document_reference
attributes.description: File path, document management system reference, or DocuSign CLM document ID for the actual Certificate of Insurance (COI) PDF submitted by the vendor. Distinct from the general document_reference field; specifically tracks the COI artifact. Applicable only when is_insurance_record is True.
attributes.references: DocuSign CLM — Document Reference; ACORD 25; ASA Compliance Guidelines

attributes.name: compliance_category
attributes.description: High-level category of the compliance obligation being tracked. Covers insurance certificates, E-Verify enrollment, EEOC/OFCCP obligations, OSHA safety programs, FCRA background check policies, I-9 audit readiness, workers compensation registration, FUTA/SUTA tax registration, non-compete policy, and data security (SOC 2). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: insurance|e_verify|eeoc|ofccp|osha|fcra|i9_audit|workers_comp|futa_suta|non_compete|data_security|other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ASA Compliance Guidelines; DOL; EEOC; OFCCP; IRS; SOC 2 Type II

attributes.name: compliance_status
attributes.description: Current compliance disposition for this obligation. 'compliant' indicates all requirements are met; 'non_compliant' indicates a deficiency exists; 'pending_review' indicates documents have been submitted and are under evaluation; 'waived' indicates the MSP or client has formally waived this requirement for the vendor.
attributes.references: Beeline VMS — Compliance Status; ASA Compliance Guidelines

attributes.name: coverage_limit_amount
attributes.description: Maximum dollar amount of coverage provided under the insurance policy per occurrence or in aggregate, as stated on the Certificate of Insurance (COI). Expressed in USD. Used to verify that vendor coverage meets MSP/client minimum requirements. Applicable only when is_insurance_record is True.
attributes.references: ACORD 25 Certificate of Insurance Standard; ASA Compliance Guidelines; Client MSA Requirements

attributes.name: coverage_limit_type
attributes.description: Specifies whether the coverage_limit_amount represents a per-occurrence limit, an aggregate annual limit, or a per-claim limit. Critical for accurately assessing whether vendor coverage meets program requirements. Applicable only when is_insurance_record is True.
attributes.references: ACORD 25 Certificate of Insurance Standard; ASA Compliance Guidelines

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this vendor compliance record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail requirements and data lineage tracking in the Databricks Silver Layer.
attributes.references: SOC 2 Type II — Audit Trail Requirements; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: document_effective_date
attributes.description: Date on which the submitted compliance document or certificate becomes effective and valid. For insurance certificates, this is the policy inception date. For regulatory filings, this is the filing effective date.
attributes.references: ASA Compliance Guidelines; ISO 30405:2016

attributes.name: document_expiration_date
attributes.description: Date on which the compliance document or certificate expires and must be renewed. Triggers automated compliance alerts when the expiration date is within the configured alert threshold. Critical for insurance COIs, SOC 2 reports, and E-Verify MOUs.
attributes.references: Beeline VMS — Expiration Tracking; ASA Compliance Guidelines

attributes.name: everify_employer_number
attributes.description: The E-Verify employer identification number assigned by USCIS to the vendor upon enrollment in the E-Verify program. Required for vendors operating under federal contracts subject to FAR E-Verify clause. Applicable for compliance_category = 'e_verify'.
attributes.references: INA — Immigration and Nationality Act; USCIS E-Verify Program; OFCCP

attributes.name: everify_enrollment_date
attributes.description: Date on which the vendor enrolled in the E-Verify program with USCIS. Used to verify continuous enrollment and compliance with federal contractor E-Verify requirements. Applicable for compliance_category = 'e_verify'.
attributes.references: INA — Immigration and Nationality Act; USCIS E-Verify Program

attributes.name: insurance_type
attributes.description: Type of insurance coverage documented in this compliance record. Covers the five standard insurance types required in MSP/VMS programs: general liability, professional liability (Errors & Omissions/E&O), workers compensation, cyber liability, and umbrella/excess liability. Applicable only when is_insurance_record is True.
attributes.references: ASA Compliance Guidelines; ACORD 25; DOL Workers Compensation Requirements

attributes.name: is_insurance_record
attributes.description: Indicates whether this compliance record is an insurance-category record requiring additional insurance-specific fields (certificate number, carrier, policy number, coverage limit, etc.). When True, all insurance sub-fields must be populated.
attributes.references: Beeline VMS — Insurance Compliance Module; ASA Compliance Guidelines

attributes.name: item_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative describing the compliance obligation, regulatory basis, and what the vendor must demonstrate to satisfy the requirement. Provides context for compliance officers and auditors reviewing the record.
attributes.references: ASA Compliance Guidelines; DOL; EEOC; OFCCP

attributes.name: item_name
attributes.description: Short, human-readable name of the specific compliance item or obligation (e.g., 'General Liability Insurance Certificate', 'E-Verify Employer Enrollment', 'OSHA 300 Log Submission', 'SOC 2 Type II Report'). Used as the display label in compliance dashboards and audit reports.
attributes.references: ASA Compliance Guidelines; Beeline VMS — Compliance Tracking

attributes.name: last_audit_date
attributes.description: Date on which the most recent compliance audit or review was conducted for this compliance item. Used to track audit cadence and identify overdue reviews.
attributes.references: ASA Compliance Guidelines; SOC 2 Type II; OFCCP Audit Requirements

attributes.name: next_review_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next compliance review or audit of this item. Drives compliance calendar and workload planning for compliance officers. May be set automatically based on document expiration or audit frequency rules.
attributes.references: Beeline VMS — Review Scheduling; ASA Compliance Guidelines

attributes.name: non_compete_policy_on_file
attributes.description: Indicates whether the vendor has a documented non-compete or non-solicitation policy on file with the MSP program, as required by the Master Service Agreement (MSA). Prevents vendors from directly soliciting placed workers or end clients.
attributes.references: DocuSign CLM — MSA Non-Compete Clause; ASA Compliance Guidelines

attributes.name: policy_effective_date
attributes.description: Date on which the insurance policy becomes effective, as stated on the Certificate of Insurance. May differ from document_effective_date if the COI was issued after the policy inception date. Applicable only when is_insurance_record is True.
attributes.references: ACORD 25 Certificate of Insurance Standard

attributes.name: policy_expiration_date
attributes.description: Date on which the insurance policy expires, as stated on the Certificate of Insurance. Used as the primary expiration trigger for insurance-category compliance alerts. Applicable only when is_insurance_record is True.
attributes.references: ACORD 25 Certificate of Insurance Standard; Beeline VMS — Expiration Tracking

attributes.name: policy_number
attributes.description: Unique policy number assigned by the insurance carrier for the coverage documented in this compliance record. Used to verify coverage with the carrier and cross-reference against the COI. Applicable only when is_insurance_record is True.
attributes.references: ACORD 25 Certificate of Insurance Standard; ASA Compliance Guidelines

attributes.name: remediation_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes documenting the remediation plan, corrective actions taken, or outstanding steps required to bring a non-compliant vendor into compliance. Captured by the assigned compliance officer and visible in audit trails.
attributes.references: ASA Compliance Guidelines; OFCCP; DOL

attributes.name: required_document_type
attributes.description: Type of document the vendor must submit to satisfy this compliance item (e.g., 'Certificate of Insurance (COI)', 'E-Verify MOU', 'OSHA 300 Log', 'SOC 2 Report', 'W-9', 'I-9 Audit Report'). Drives document collection workflows in the VMS program.
attributes.references: Beeline VMS — Document Requirements; FCRA; INA I-9; OSHA

attributes.name: soc2_report_type
attributes.description: Specifies whether the vendor's data security compliance is evidenced by a SOC 2 Type I (point-in-time design assessment) or SOC 2 Type II (operational effectiveness over a period) report. Type II is the standard requirement for MSP/VMS data security compliance. Applicable for compliance_category = 'data_security'.
attributes.references: SOC 2 Type II — AICPA Trust Services Criteria; CCPA; GDPR

attributes.name: source_record_code
attributes.description: The native record identifier from the originating source system (e.g., Beeline VMS compliance record ID, DocuSign envelope ID). Used for cross-system reconciliation and deduplication in the Silver Layer.
attributes.references: Beeline VMS; DocuSign CLM; Internal Data Governance

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Identifies the operational system of record from which this compliance record originated. Supports data lineage, reconciliation, and multi-system integration in the Silver Layer. Primary source is Beeline VMS; manual entries and DocuSign CLM are secondary sources.
attributes.references: Beeline VMS; DocuSign CLM; Bullhorn ATS/CRM; Internal Data Governance

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this vendor compliance record was most recently modified. Used to detect stale records and support incremental data pipeline processing in the Databricks Silver Layer.
attributes.references: SOC 2 Type II — Audit Trail Requirements; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: waiver_approved_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the authorized individual (compliance director, MSP program manager, or client representative) who approved the waiver of this compliance requirement.
attributes.references: Internal Compliance Governance; ASA Compliance Guidelines

attributes.name: waiver_expiration_date
attributes.description: Date on which an approved compliance waiver expires and the vendor must re-demonstrate compliance or obtain a new waiver. Prevents indefinite waivers from masking persistent compliance gaps.
attributes.references: Internal Compliance Governance; ASA Compliance Guidelines

attributes.name: waiver_reason
attributes.description: Documented business justification for waiving a compliance requirement for this vendor. Required when compliance_status is 'waived'. Must be approved by an authorized compliance officer or program director.
attributes.references: ASA Compliance Guidelines; Internal Compliance Governance

products.name: preferred_supplier_list
products.description: Manages the Preferred Supplier List (PSL) — the curated, approved roster of vendors authorized to supply contingent workers or SOW services for a specific client program or job category. Captures client program ID, vendor ID, job category, PSL status (preferred, approved, conditional, excluded), inclusion date, exclusion date, PSL version, approval authority, and client-specific notes. Governs which vendors are visible and eligible to receive requisitions in the VMS for each client engagement.
products.reference: PSL (Preferred Supplier List) / Approved Vendor List

attributes.name: preferred_supplier_list_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated identifier for a Preferred Supplier List (PSL) entry. Primary key for this entity. Entity role: JUNCTION — associates a vendor with a client program and job category within a governed PSL framework, carrying its own lifecycle attributes (status, dates, approval authority, version).
attributes.references: Beeline VMS — Preferred Supplier List Module

attributes.name: approval_authority_staff_profile_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Approval Authority Staff Profile Id (Foreign Key)
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to employee.staff_profile. Business justification: Tracks internal procurement/vendor management director who approved PSL inclusion. Critical for strategic sourcing governance, PSL audit compliance, and supplier selection authority validation in pref
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: client_rate_card_id
attributes.description: Reference to the client-specific rate card that governs the bill rates and pay rates applicable to this vendor for the job category within the client program. Ensures rate compliance when the vendor submits candidates.
attributes.references: Beeline VMS — Rate Card; client.rate_card

attributes.name: managed_program_id
attributes.description: Reference to the client VMS program for which this PSL entry governs vendor eligibility. Links the PSL entry to the specific managed service program under which requisitions are issued.
attributes.references: Beeline VMS — Program Configuration

attributes.name: msa_id
attributes.description: Reference to the Master Service Agreement (MSA) governing the vendor's participation in this client program. The MSA must be executed before a vendor can be placed on the PSL. Links to the contract lifecycle management record.
attributes.references: DocuSign CLM — MSA Record; ASA Master Service Agreement Standards

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Reference to the staffing supplier or subcontractor record authorized (or excluded) under this PSL entry. Identifies which vendor the PSL status applies to within the client program.
attributes.references: Beeline VMS — Supplier Record

attributes.name: vendor_agreement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to contract.vendor_agreement. Business justification: PSL inclusion is contractually governed by vendor agreements. Business needs to link PSL entry to the vendor agreement that grants preferred status for validating PSL eligibility, enforcing PSL-specif
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: vms_enrollment_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Vendor Management System (VMS) Program Enrollment ID
attributes.description: The vendor's enrollment or registration identifier within the Beeline VMS for this specific client program. Used to cross-reference the PSL entry with the vendor's VMS program participation record and to confirm active enrollment status.
attributes.references: Beeline VMS — Supplier Enrollment

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: The date on which the approval authority formally approved the vendor's PSL status for this entry. Distinct from inclusion_date, which reflects when the vendor became operationally active on the PSL.
attributes.references: Beeline VMS — Approval Workflow; SOC 2 Type II — Change Management Controls

attributes.name: avg_time_to_fill_days
attributes.description: The vendor's average Time to Fill (TTF) in calendar days for requisitions fulfilled under this client program and job category. Measures responsiveness and is a core KPI for PSL tier classification and SLA compliance.
attributes.references: Beeline VMS — TTF KPI; SIA Time-to-Fill Benchmarks; client.sla_measurement

attributes.name: client_notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for client-specific instructions, preferences, or annotations related to this vendor's PSL entry. May include preferred contact protocols, special billing instructions, or program-specific requirements communicated by the client.
attributes.references: Beeline VMS — Client Notes; CRM Program Notes

attributes.name: compliance_status
attributes.description: Current compliance status of the vendor for this PSL entry, reflecting whether all required credentialing, insurance, and regulatory requirements have been met. 'compliant' = all requirements satisfied; 'non_compliant' = one or more requirements unmet; 'pending_review' = under evaluation; 'waived' = client-approved exception granted.
attributes.references: Beeline VMS — Compliance Tracking; SOC 2 Type II; OSHA; EEOC

attributes.name: conditional_notes
attributes.description: Free-text field capturing client-specific conditions, restrictions, or instructions applicable to this PSL entry when the status is 'conditional'. Examples include geographic restrictions, role-level caps, or specific compliance prerequisites the vendor must meet.
attributes.references: Beeline VMS — Supplier Notes; MSP Program Governance

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this PSL entry record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail requirements and data lineage tracking in the Silver Layer lakehouse.
attributes.references: SOC 2 Type II — Audit Trail; GDPR Article 5 — Data Integrity and Accountability

attributes.name: diversity_certified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the vendor holds a current, verified diversity certification applicable to this PSL entry. Supports client diversity spend reporting and OFCCP compliance without requiring the full classification detail.
attributes.references: OFCCP — Supplier Diversity; SBA Certification Programs

attributes.name: diversity_classification
attributes.description: Diversity certification category of the vendor as recognized under this PSL entry (e.g., MBE, WBE, SDVOSB, HUBZone, LGBTBE, SBE). Used for client diversity spend reporting and OFCCP compliance tracking. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: MBE|WBE|SDVOSB|HUBZone|LGBTBE|SBE|DBE|VOSB — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: OFCCP — Supplier Diversity Requirements; SBA — Small Business Certifications; SHRM Diversity Sourcing Standards

attributes.name: exclusion_date
attributes.description: The date on which the vendor was removed or excluded from the Preferred Supplier List for this client program and job category. Null if the vendor remains active on the PSL. Marks the end of the vendor's eligibility window.
attributes.references: Beeline VMS — PSL End Date; ASA Vendor Management Standards

attributes.name: exclusion_reason
attributes.description: Documented reason for the vendor's exclusion or suspension from this PSL entry. Required when psl_status is 'excluded' or 'suspended'. Supports audit trails, vendor dispute resolution, and governance reporting.
attributes.references: Beeline VMS — Supplier Exclusion; SOC 2 Type II — Audit Trail; ASA Ethical Standards

attributes.name: exclusive_supplier
attributes.description: Indicates whether this vendor holds exclusive rights to supply workers for the specified job category within the client program. When true, no other vendor on the PSL may submit candidates for that category.
attributes.references: Beeline VMS — Exclusivity Rules; MSP Program Governance Standards

attributes.name: fall_off_rate_pct
attributes.description: The vendor's fall-off rate percentage for placements made under this client program and job category — calculated as placements that ended prematurely (fall-offs) divided by total placements. A key quality metric used in PSL performance evaluation.
attributes.references: Beeline VMS — Vendor Scorecard; SIA Fall-Off Rate KPI; ASA Quality Standards

attributes.name: fill_rate_pct
attributes.description: The vendor's historical fill rate percentage for requisitions received under this client program and job category — calculated as filled requisitions divided by total requisitions assigned. A key performance indicator (KPI) used in PSL tier evaluation and renewal decisions.
attributes.references: Beeline VMS — Vendor KPI; SIA Staffing Industry KPI Standards

attributes.name: ic_supplier
attributes.description: Indicates whether this vendor is classified as an Independent Contractor (IC) supplier, providing 1099 workers rather than W-2 employees. Affects worker classification compliance checks and tax treatment for placements under this PSL entry.
attributes.references: IRS — Worker Classification Rules; FLSA; Beeline VMS — IC Supplier Configuration

attributes.name: inclusion_date
attributes.description: The date on which the vendor was added to the Preferred Supplier List for this client program and job category. Marks the start of the vendor's eligibility window under this PSL entry.
attributes.references: Beeline VMS — PSL Effective Date; ASA Vendor Management Standards

attributes.name: insurance_expiry_date
attributes.description: Date on which the vendor's insurance coverage expires. Used to trigger renewal alerts and compliance reviews. If insurance lapses, the vendor's PSL status may be automatically suspended pending re-verification.
attributes.references: Beeline VMS — Insurance Compliance Tracking; OSHA; Workers Comp Requirements

attributes.name: insurance_verified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the vendor's required insurance certificates (general liability, workers compensation, professional liability) have been verified and are current for this PSL entry. A prerequisite for PSL active status in most client programs.
attributes.references: Beeline VMS — Insurance Compliance; Workers Comp Policy Requirements; OSHA

attributes.name: job_category
attributes.description: The labor category or skill classification for which this PSL entry governs vendor eligibility (e.g., IT, Engineering, Administrative, Clinical, Light Industrial). Determines which requisition types the vendor is authorized to fulfill within the client program.
attributes.references: Beeline VMS — Labor Category; DOL Occupational Classification

attributes.name: job_category_code
attributes.description: Standardized alphanumeric code representing the job category within the VMS or client program. Used for system-level routing of requisitions to eligible vendors and for cross-program reporting.
attributes.references: Beeline VMS — Labor Category Code; DOL Standard Occupational Classification (SOC)

attributes.name: last_reviewed_date
attributes.description: Date on which this PSL entry was most recently reviewed by the approval authority or program governance team. Used to track review cadence compliance and identify stale PSL entries.
attributes.references: Beeline VMS — Supplier Review Cycle; SOC 2 Type II — Periodic Access Review

attributes.name: nda_executed
attributes.description: Indicates whether a Non-Disclosure Agreement (NDA) has been executed between the vendor and the client for this program. Required for vendors accessing sensitive client information as part of the staffing engagement.
attributes.references: DocuSign CLM — NDA Execution; GDPR Article 28 — Data Processing Agreements; CCPA

attributes.name: non_compete_executed
attributes.description: Indicates whether a non-compete or non-solicitation agreement has been executed with the vendor for this client program. Protects the client's workforce and candidate pipeline from direct solicitation by the vendor.
attributes.references: DocuSign CLM — Non-Compete Agreement; ASA Ethical Standards

attributes.name: performance_score
attributes.description: Composite performance score assigned to the vendor for this client program and job category, typically on a 0–100 scale. Derived from scorecard metrics including fill rate, time-to-fill (TTF), quality of submission (QoS), and retention. Used to inform PSL tier assignments and renewal decisions.
attributes.references: Beeline VMS — Vendor Scorecard; SIA KPI Standards; ASA Performance Benchmarks

attributes.name: psl_number
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier for this PSL entry, used in VMS communications, audit trails, and client-facing documentation. Follows the format PSL-{alphanumeric code}.
attributes.references: Beeline VMS — PSL Reference Number

attributes.name: psl_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the vendor on this PSL entry. 'preferred' = top-tier vendor with priority routing; 'approved' = eligible to receive requisitions; 'conditional' = eligible with restrictions or conditions; 'excluded' = blocked from receiving requisitions; 'suspended' = temporarily ineligible pending review.
attributes.references: Beeline VMS — Supplier Status; ASA Vendor Management Standards

attributes.name: psl_tier
attributes.description: Tier classification assigned to the vendor within the PSL for this client program and job category. Tier 1 vendors receive first-right-of-refusal on requisitions; lower tiers receive requisitions only when higher tiers cannot fulfill. Governs requisition routing priority in the VMS.
attributes.references: Beeline VMS — Supplier Tier; MSP Program Governance Standards

attributes.name: psl_version
attributes.description: Version identifier of the PSL under which this entry was created or last revised (e.g., v1.0, v2.3). Supports PSL versioning and audit trails when the client program updates its approved vendor roster.
attributes.references: Beeline VMS — PSL Version Control; DocuSign CLM — Contract Versioning

attributes.name: requisition_visibility
attributes.description: Controls whether the vendor can see and respond to open requisitions in the VMS for this client program and job category. 'visible' = vendor sees all eligible reqs; 'hidden' = vendor is on PSL but not shown reqs; 'restricted' = vendor sees only specific reqs per conditional rules.
attributes.references: Beeline VMS — Supplier Visibility Settings

attributes.name: review_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next periodic review of this vendor's PSL status for the client program and job category. Supports governance cadence for PSL maintenance and vendor performance evaluation cycles.
attributes.references: Beeline VMS — Supplier Review Cycle; ASA Vendor Management Standards

attributes.name: right_to_represent_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the vendor must obtain a Right to Represent (RTR) confirmation from the candidate before submitting to this client program. When true, the VMS enforces RTR capture prior to submittal acceptance.
attributes.references: Beeline VMS — RTR Policy; ASA Ethical Standards for Candidate Representation

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Identifies the operational system of record from which this PSL entry originated or was last synchronized. Supports data lineage tracking in the Silver Layer lakehouse and reconciliation between VMS and ATS records.
attributes.references: Beeline VMS; Bullhorn ATS/CRM; SOC 2 Type II — Data Lineage

attributes.name: source_system_record_code
attributes.description: The native record identifier from the originating source system (e.g., Beeline VMS PSL record ID). Enables traceability from the Silver Layer lakehouse record back to the operational system of record for reconciliation and audit purposes.
attributes.references: Beeline VMS — PSL Record ID; SOC 2 Type II — Data Lineage

attributes.name: sow_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether the vendor is authorized to deliver Statement of Work (SOW) engagements under this PSL entry, in addition to or instead of contingent staffing. Governs SOW requisition routing in the VMS.
attributes.references: Beeline VMS — SOW Supplier Configuration; DocuSign CLM — SOW Management

attributes.name: submission_cap
attributes.description: Maximum number of candidate submittals the vendor is permitted to make per requisition for this client program and job category. Enforced by the VMS to manage submittal volume and ensure quality of submission (QoS).
attributes.references: Beeline VMS — Submission Rules; SIA Contingent Workforce Program Standards

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this PSL entry record was most recently modified. Tracks the last change event for audit trail purposes and supports incremental data loading in the Silver Layer lakehouse pipeline.
attributes.references: SOC 2 Type II — Audit Trail; GDPR Article 5 — Data Integrity and Accountability

products.name: diversity_certification
products.description: Tracks vendor diversity certifications required for OFCCP compliance, client diversity spend reporting, and supplier diversity program participation. Captures certification type (MBE, WBE, SDVOB, HUBZone, 8(a), LGBTBE, VOSB), certifying body (NMSDC, WBENC, SBA, USVBA), certification number, issue date, expiration date, certification status (active, expired, pending renewal, revoked), and supporting document reference. Enables diversity spend analytics and OFCCP supplier diversity reporting.
products.reference: Vendor Diversity Certification / Supplier Diversity Record

attributes.name: diversity_certification_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each vendor diversity certification record in the Silver Layer lakehouse. Primary key for this entity.
attributes.references: OFCCP Supplier Diversity Reporting; ASA Data Standards

attributes.name: previous_certification_diversity_certification_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing identifier pointing to the prior certification record that this record supersedes or renews. Enables certification history chain tracking for audit and compliance reporting.
attributes.references: OFCCP Record Retention; SOC 2 Type II Audit Trail; ASA Compliance Standards

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Reference to the vendor (staffing supplier, subcontractor, or service provider) that holds this diversity certification. Links to the vendor master record in the vendor domain.
attributes.references: Beeline VMS Vendor Profile; OFCCP Supplier Diversity

attributes.name: vendor_document_id
attributes.description: Reference identifier or URL to the supporting certification document stored in the document management system (e.g., DocuSign CLM or document repository). Links to the actual certificate, letter of certification, or renewal confirmation.
attributes.references: DocuSign CLM; SOC 2 Type II Document Management; OFCCP Record Retention

attributes.name: vms_program_id
attributes.description: Reference to the Beeline VMS contingent workforce program under which this diversity certification is tracked and reported. Enables diversity spend analytics at the program level for MSP-managed client programs.
attributes.references: Beeline VMS Vendor Management; MSP Supplier Diversity Program

attributes.name: annual_revenue_usd
attributes.description: The vendor's annual gross revenue in US dollars as reported at the time of certification, used to verify small business size standard eligibility for applicable certification types (HUBZone, 8(a), SDVOB).
attributes.references: SBA Small Business Size Standards; OFCCP Supplier Diversity

attributes.name: auto_renewal_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this certification type supports automatic renewal processing through the certifying body's online portal or VMS integration. True = auto-renewal available; False = manual renewal required.
attributes.references: NMSDC Online Recertification; WBENC Recertification Portal; Beeline VMS

attributes.name: beeline_vendor_cert_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Beeline Vendor Management System (VMS) Certification ID
attributes.description: The external certification record identifier assigned by the Beeline VMS system for this diversity certification. Used for system-of-record reconciliation and VMS data synchronization.
attributes.references: Beeline VMS Vendor Management; Contingent Workforce Program Management

attributes.name: certification_notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for compliance officers or supplier diversity program managers to record observations, exceptions, conditions, or special circumstances related to this diversity certification (e.g., conditional approval, pending documentation, audit findings).
attributes.references: OFCCP Supplier Diversity Compliance; SOC 2 Type II Audit Documentation

attributes.name: certification_number
attributes.description: The official certificate number or registration identifier issued by the certifying body (e.g., NMSDC, WBENC, SBA) for this diversity designation. Used for verification and OFCCP supplier diversity reporting.
attributes.references: NMSDC Certification Standards; WBENC Certification Program; SBA 8(a) Program; OFCCP Supplier Diversity Reporting

attributes.name: certification_scope
attributes.description: The geographic scope of this diversity certification. National = recognized across the US; Regional = recognized within a multi-state region; State = state-level certification only; Local = city or county level certification.
attributes.references: NMSDC National/Regional Certification; WBENC National Certification; DOT DBE State Programs

attributes.name: certification_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the diversity certification. Active = valid and in good standing; Expired = past expiration date without renewal; Pending Renewal = renewal application submitted and under review; Revoked = certification withdrawn by certifying body; Suspended = temporarily inactive pending investigation or documentation.
attributes.references: OFCCP Supplier Diversity Compliance; ASA Supplier Diversity Standards

attributes.name: certification_type
attributes.description: The category of diversity designation held by the vendor. products.name: exclusion
products.description: Maintains the vendor exclusion and debarment registry — suppliers that are prohibited from participating in specific client programs, job categories, or the entire MSP program due to compliance failures, performance issues, legal disputes, client blacklisting, or regulatory debarment (SAM.gov, OFAC, OIG). Captures vendor ID, exclusion scope (program-level, client-level, global), exclusion reason category, exclusion narrative, exclusion effective date, exclusion authority (MSP program manager, client, regulatory body), reinstatement eligibility flag, reinstatement conditions, reinstatement date if applicable, appeal status, and supporting documentation reference. Critical for risk management — the VMS must check this registry before routing any requisition to prevent excluded vendors from receiving job orders. Feeds into preferred_supplier_list eligibility and program_allocation enforcement.
products.reference: Vendor Exclusion List / Supplier Debarment Registry

attributes.name: authority_type

products.name: vendor_document
products.description: Master record for all vendor-submitted and vendor-related documents stored and versioned within the MSP/VMS program. Captures document type (W-9, COI, NDA, MSA, rate agreement, diversity certificate, insurance policy, compliance attestation, executed SOW, training certificate, subcontractor agreement), document title, file reference/URL, upload date, uploaded by, document version, effective date, expiration date, document status (current, superseded, expired, archived), associated vendor ID, retention policy classification, and document category (legal, compliance, financial, operational). Provides a centralized document repository for vendor management teams who manage hundreds of documents per supplier. Supports document expiration alerting and version control. Distinct from compliance-specific status tracking (owned by vendor_compliance) — this product owns the physical document inventory, version history, and storage references, while vendor_compliance owns the compliance status determination and audit workflow that references these documents.

products.name: desk_supplier_allocation
products.description: This association product represents the operational allocation and access control between VMS-enrolled suppliers and internal recruiter desks. It captures how VMS supplier access is distributed across recruiting desks by job category, geography, or client segment. Each record links one enrolled supplier to one recruiter desk with allocation percentages, submission priorities, job category scope, and exclusive arrangement flags that exist only in the context of this desk-level supplier access relationship. Enables desk-level supplier management, req routing logic, and supplier utilization tracking.. Existence Justification: In staffing operations with VMS programs, suppliers are distributed across multiple internal recruiting desks based on job categories, geographies, and client segments, and each desk works with multiple enrolled suppliers simultaneously. The business actively manages desk-level supplier allocations with specific percentages, priority rankings, job category scopes, submission caps, and exclusive arrangements. This is an operational relationship that humans create, update, and monitor as part of supplier access control and req distribution workflows.

products.name: supplier_compliance_obligation
products.description: This association product represents the compliance obligation relationship between compliance requirements and suppliers in staffing operations. It captures which regulatory and contractual compliance requirements apply to which suppliers, tracking the compliance status, verification dates, expiration dates, waivers, and supporting documentation for each supplier-requirement pair. Each record links one compliance_requirement to one supplier with attributes that exist only in the context of this specific compliance obligation.. Existence Justification: In staffing operations, compliance requirements apply to multiple suppliers (e.g., I-9 verification applies to all staffing agencies, insurance requirements apply to all IC suppliers), and each supplier must meet multiple compliance requirements (federal regulations, client-specific mandates, industry standards). The compliance team actively manages these supplier-requirement obligations as operational records, tracking compliance status, verification dates, waivers, and documentation for each unique supplier-requirement pair.

attributes.description: Result of the most recent compliance audit for this supplier-requirement pair: pass (audit confirmed compliance), fail (audit identified non-compliance), conditional_pass (compliance achieved with corrective action plan), not_audited (no audit conducted yet).

attributes.description: Current compliance status of this supplier for this specific requirement: compliant (supplier has met the requirement and verification is current), non_compliant (supplier has failed to meet or maintain compliance), pending_verification (documentation submitted awaiting compliance team review), waived (requirement waived per waiver_reason), expired (compliance was achieved but has lapsed), not_applicable (requirement determined not to apply to this supplier)

products.name: supplier_package_qualification
products.description: This association product represents the formal approval and qualification of a supplier to provide workers meeting a specific credential package. It captures the vendor approval process, compliance verification status, and package-specific vendor qualifications. Each record links one credential package to one supplier with attributes that exist only in the context of this qualification relationship, including approval status, verification dates, and expiration tracking.. Existence Justification: In staffing operations, credential packages define standardized bundles of requirements (BGC, drug screens, licenses, training) for specific client programs or job categories, while suppliers are third-party staffing agencies and IC suppliers who provide workers. The business actively manages a Supplier Qualification Matrix where each supplier must be formally approved to provide workers meeting specific credential packages. One credential package (e.g., Healthcare Travel Nurse Package) can be fulfilled by multiple approved suppliers, and one supplier can be qualified to provide workers for multiple credential packages across different verticals or client programs. This is an operational relationship that humans create, audit, and revoke as part of vendor management and compliance workflows.

products.name: supplier_checklist_assignment
products.description: This association product represents the Assignment between supplier and task_checklist. It captures the configuration of which onboarding/offboarding checklists are required for which suppliers based on client program requirements, union status, healthcare credentialing needs, and client-mandated training. Each record links one supplier to one task_checklist with attributes that define when the assignment is effective, whether it has been approved, and any customization notes specific to that supplier-checklist combination.. Existence Justification: In staffing operations, suppliers participate in multiple client programs with different compliance requirements, and each program may require multiple checklists (union vs non-union, healthcare credentialing, client-mandated training). One supplier uses multiple checklists across programs; one checklist template applies to multiple approved suppliers. The business actively manages these assignments as supplier program configurations change, client requirements evolve, and new compliance rules are introduced.

products.name: supplier_orientation_attendance

It captures supplier participation in scheduled orientation events, tracking registration, attendance outcomes, cost allocation, and no-show patterns used for supplier performance scorecarding. Stores restricted activity scope (client solicitation, candidate poaching, competitive employment), geographic restriction radius or territory, duration in months, enforceability jurisdiction and governing law, and linkage to the originating placement, assignment, or employment record. products.name: sla
products.description: Service Level Agreement record defining measurable performance commitments within an MSA or SOW, along with periodic measurement results tracking actual performance against those targets. Stores SLA metric name (TTF, TTS, QoS, fill rate, NPS, submittal-to-interview ratio, first-day no-show rate), target threshold, measurement frequency (weekly, monthly, quarterly), penalty/credit terms, and governing contract reference. Enables SLA compliance reporting, penalty/credit calculation, client QBR (Quarterly Business Review) preparation, and trend analysis across measurement periods.

products.name: envelope
products.description: DocuSign CLM e-signature envelope record representing a single signature workflow execution with full signatory audit trail. Captures envelope ID (DocuSign native), document type, sent timestamp, completed timestamp, voided/declined status, and IP address capture for audit. Includes per-recipient signatory detail: signer name, title, organization, signing order, authentication method (email, SMS, ID verification, knowledge-based), signing authority level (e.g., VP and above, C-suite only), delegation scope (full authority, limited to SOW under $X), active/inactive signer status, individual sign/decline timestamp, and recipient status. Person/contact identity is resolved via the client or candidate domain contact master — this product stores signing-role attributes and execution events only. SSOT for all electronic execution events and signatory audit trails across MSAs, SOWs, NDAs, amendments, IC agreements, and non-competes.

products.name: template
products.description: Contract template and clause library master record defining the standard structure, default clauses, configurable parameters, and complete reusable clause inventory for each contract type (MSA, SOW, NDA, non-compete, amendment, IC agreement, vendor agreement). Stores template name, version, applicable contract type, default jurisdiction, required clause set, optional clause menu, and approval status. Includes the full clause library: standard and custom clause text for all clause types (indemnification, limitation of liability, IP ownership, co-employment, EEOC, OFCCP, FLSA, workers comp, governing law, data privacy, non-solicitation), clause version, jurisdiction applicability, mandatory vs. optional flag, regulatory source reference, and clause approval status. Used by DocuSign CLM to generate new contract drafts consistently while enabling clause-level compliance tracking, template governance, and regulatory clause audit. SSOT for all contract generation configuration and reusable clause management.

products.name: msa_credential_requirement
products.description: This association product represents the contractual credentialing requirements between credential and msa. It captures the specific credential compliance standards mandated by each Master Service Agreement. Each record links one credential type to one MSA with attributes that define how that credential must be verified, maintained, and enforced for placements under that contract.. Existence Justification: In staffing operations, each MSA specifies multiple credential requirements (licenses, certifications, background checks, drug screens, immunizations) that candidates must hold to be eligible for placement under that contract. Conversely, each credential type (e.g., RN license, OSHA 10, Hep B immunization) is required by multiple MSAs across different clients with varying enforcement rules. The business actively manages these requirements as 'MSA Credential Requirements' or 'Contract Credentialing Standards' with client-specific parameters for verification depth, expiry tolerances, and renewal lead times.

attributes.description: Number of days before credential expiration that the client will still accept the credential for new placements under this MSA. Client-specific tolerance for near-expiry credentials.

attributes.name: client_specific_notes
attributes.description: Free-text field capturing client-specific nuances, exceptions, or clarifications about how this credential requirement should be interpreted and enforced for this MSA.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date when this credential requirement becomes effective for placements under this MSA. May differ from MSA effective date if requirements are added via amendment.

attributes.name: requirement_status

attributes.description: The level of verification rigor required by this MSA for this credential type. May override the default verification_method from the credential definition based on client-specific requirements.

attributes.name: waiver_allowed_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the client allows case-by-case waivers for this credential requirement under this MSA. If true, placements may proceed with documented waiver approval.

products.name: sow_credential_requirement
products.description: This association product represents the credential requirements specified for a Statement of Work. It captures the project-specific credentialing rules that govern which credentials are mandatory, how they must be verified, and what exceptions or grace periods apply for workers assigned to this SOW. Each record links one credential to one SOW with attributes that define the enforcement rules, verification depth, timing requirements, and waiver policies specific to that engagement.. Existence Justification: In staffing operations, a single SOW typically requires multiple credentials (e.g., RN license, BLS certification, TB test, background check) to ensure workers meet client and regulatory requirements, and each credential definition applies to many different SOWs across various clients and engagements. The business actively manages SOW-specific credential requirements during contract negotiation and SOW setup, defining which credentials are mandatory, how strictly they must be verified, what grace periods apply, and whether waivers are permitted—rules that vary by client risk tolerance, industry vertical, and regulatory context.

products.name: allocation
products.description: This association product represents the financial allocation between a Statement of Work and a Cost Center. It captures how SOW delivery and costs are distributed across multiple organizational cost centers, enabling multi-location delivery tracking, shared services allocation, and accurate P&L attribution. Each record links one SOW to one cost center with allocation percentages, budget amounts, and actual costs that exist only in the context of this relationship.. Existence Justification: In staffing operations, a single Statement of Work frequently spans multiple cost centers when delivery involves multiple branches, regions, or shared service units. Conversely, a cost center typically serves multiple active SOWs concurrently as part of normal operations. The business actively manages these allocations by tracking allocation percentages, budgeted amounts, and actual costs for each SOW-cost-center pairing to enable accurate P&L reporting and profitability analysis by organizational unit.

products.name: vendor_cost_center_allocation
products.description: This association product represents the allocation relationship between vendor agreements and cost centers within MSP/VMS-managed staffing programs. It captures the business rules governing which vendors are authorized to supply workers to which cost centers, including spend limits, allocation percentages, and effective date ranges. Each record links one vendor agreement to one cost center with attributes that exist only in the context of this allocation relationship. This enables multi-cost-center vendor agreements and multi-vendor cost center sourcing strategies.. Existence Justification: In MSP/VMS-managed staffing programs, vendor agreements are routinely allocated to multiple cost centers (e.g., IT, Finance, Operations branches), and each cost center sources workers from multiple approved vendors. The business actively manages these allocations with spend limits, allocation percentages, priority rankings, and effective date ranges. This is an operational relationship that procurement and MSP program managers create, monitor, and adjust based on vendor performance, budget constraints, and sourcing strategy.

products.name: orientation_attendance
products.description: This association product represents the attendance event between orientation_session and staff_profile. It captures the participation of internal staff members in orientation sessions, tracking their attendance status, completion, and assessment performance. Each record links one orientation_session to one staff_profile with attributes that exist only in the context of this specific attendance relationship.. Existence Justification: In staffing and recruitment operations, orientation sessions are group training events where multiple internal staff members (recruiters, account managers, operations staff) attend, and each staff member participates in multiple orientation sessions over their employment lifecycle (initial onboarding, compliance refreshers, new client-specific orientations, role-change orientations). The business actively manages attendance records as operational entities, tracking registration, attendance status, completion, assessment scores, and certificate issuance for each staff-member-session combination.
