domains.name: finance
domains.description: Owns all financial accounting, accounts receivable, accounts payable, general ledger, revenue recognition, and financial reporting data for the staffing enterprise

products.name: gl_account
products.description: Chart of Accounts master record defining every general ledger account used in the staffing enterprise. Captures account number, account name, account type (asset, liability, equity, revenue, expense), account class, normal balance (debit/credit), parent account for hierarchy rollup, cost center applicability, intercompany flag, consolidation account mapping, GAAP/IFRS classification, active status, and effective date range. SSOT for all GL account definitions used across journal entries, cost allocations, and financial reporting.

attributes.name: gl_account_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the general ledger account. Primary key for the chart of accounts.
attributes.references: GAAP Accounting Standards Codification (ASC) 105

attributes.name: legal_entity_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the legal entity that owns this GL account. Supports multi-entity accounting and consolidation for staffing enterprises operating multiple legal entities.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 810; IFRS 10

attributes.name: parent_account_gl_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the parent GL account in the chart of accounts hierarchy. Enables roll-up reporting and consolidation. Null for top-level accounts.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 105; IFRS Framework

attributes.name: accepts_postings
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this account can accept direct journal entry postings (True) or is restricted to rollup/consolidation only (False). Detail accounts accept postings; summary accounts typically do not.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 105

attributes.name: account_class
attributes.description: The sub-classification or category within the account type (e.g., 'Current Asset', 'Fixed Asset', 'Operating Expense', 'Cost of Goods Sold'). Provides additional granularity for financial statement presentation and analysis.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 210; IFRS IAS 1

attributes.name: account_description
attributes.description: Extended textual description providing additional context, usage guidelines, and business purpose for this GL account. Used for training, documentation, and audit trail purposes.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 105

attributes.name: account_level
attributes.description: The depth level of this account in the chart of accounts hierarchy (e.g., 1 for top-level summary accounts, 2 for sub-accounts, 3 for detail accounts). Supports hierarchical rollup and drill-down reporting.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 105

attributes.name: account_name
attributes.description: The human-readable descriptive name of the GL account (e.g., 'Cash - Operating Account', 'Accounts Receivable - Trade', 'Payroll Tax Expense - FICA').
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 105; IFRS Framework

attributes.name: account_number
attributes.description: The externally-known unique account number used to identify this GL account in financial transactions, journal entries, and reporting. Typically a 4-10 digit numeric code structured to reflect account hierarchy and classification.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 105; IFRS Framework

attributes.name: account_status
attributes.description: The current lifecycle status of the GL account. Active accounts accept postings; inactive accounts are temporarily disabled; suspended accounts are under review; closed accounts are permanently retired and no longer accept postings.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 105

attributes.name: account_type
attributes.description: The fundamental accounting classification of the account per the accounting equation: Asset, Liability, Equity, Revenue, or Expense. Determines placement on balance sheet or income statement.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 210; IFRS IAS 1

attributes.name: audit_trail_required
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether all transactions posted to this account require enhanced audit trail documentation and approval workflows. Typically True for high-risk accounts subject to SOX or internal control requirements.
attributes.references: Sarbanes-Oxley Act (SOX) Section 404; COSO Internal Control Framework

attributes.name: budget_account
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this account is included in the annual budgeting and forecasting process. Typically True for expense and revenue accounts; False for balance sheet accounts.
attributes.references: Management Accounting Best Practices

attributes.name: cash_flow_classification
attributes.description: The cash flow statement category for this account: Operating Activities, Investing Activities, or Financing Activities. Used for automated cash flow statement preparation per GAAP ASC 230 or IFRS IAS 7.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 230; IFRS IAS 7

attributes.name: consolidation_account
attributes.description: The mapped consolidation account code or identifier used when rolling up financial results across multiple legal entities or business units for consolidated financial reporting.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 810; IFRS 10

attributes.name: cost_center_applicable
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether transactions posted to this account require a cost center assignment for departmental or divisional cost tracking and allocation.
attributes.references: Management Accounting Best Practices

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this GL account record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; COSO Internal Control Framework

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: The three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for this account (e.g., 'USD', 'CAD', 'GBP'). Supports multi-currency accounting for international staffing operations.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes

attributes.name: department_code
attributes.description: The default department or cost center code associated with this account for departmental expense allocation and management reporting. May be overridden at the journal entry level.
attributes.references: Management Accounting Best Practices

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: The date on which this GL account is retired or becomes inactive. Null for accounts with no planned end date. Supports temporal validity and historical chart of accounts tracking.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 105

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: The date from which this GL account becomes active and available for use in journal entries and financial transactions. Supports temporal validity and chart of accounts versioning.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 105

attributes.name: external_reporting_code
attributes.description: The mapped account code or identifier used for external regulatory reporting to agencies such as the U.S. Department of Labor (DOL), Equal Employment Opportunity Commission (EEOC), or industry bodies like the American Staffing Association (ASA).
attributes.references: U.S. Department of Labor (DOL) Reporting Requirements; American Staffing Association (ASA) Standards

attributes.name: gaap_classification
attributes.description: The specific GAAP financial statement line item classification for this account (e.g., 'Cash and Cash Equivalents', 'Accounts Receivable, Net', 'Accrued Payroll Liabilities'). Used for GAAP-compliant financial statement preparation.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 210; ASC 220

attributes.name: ifrs_classification
attributes.description: The specific IFRS financial statement line item classification for this account. Used when the staffing enterprise operates internationally and must prepare IFRS-compliant financial statements.
attributes.references: IFRS IAS 1

attributes.name: intercompany_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this account is used for intercompany transactions between legal entities within the staffing enterprise. Used for consolidation elimination entries.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 810; IFRS 10

attributes.name: is_summary_account
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this is a summary/parent account used for rollup reporting (True) or a detail/leaf account that accepts direct postings (False). Summary accounts typically do not accept journal entries.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 105

attributes.name: modified_by
attributes.description: The user ID or name of the person who last modified this GL account record. Used for audit trail and accountability.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; COSO Internal Control Framework

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this GL account record was last modified. Used for audit trail, change tracking, and data lineage.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; COSO Internal Control Framework

attributes.name: normal_balance
attributes.description: Indicates whether this account normally carries a debit or credit balance per double-entry bookkeeping conventions. Assets and expenses typically have debit balances; liabilities, equity, and revenue have credit balances.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 105; Double-Entry Bookkeeping Principles

attributes.name: reconciliation_frequency
attributes.description: The required frequency for reconciling this account (daily, weekly, monthly, quarterly, annually). Applicable only when reconciliation_required is True. Supports internal control compliance and audit readiness.
attributes.references: COSO Internal Control Framework; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: reconciliation_required
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this account requires periodic reconciliation to external statements or subsidiary ledgers (e.g., bank reconciliation for cash accounts, AR sub-ledger reconciliation). Used for internal control and SOX compliance.
attributes.references: Sarbanes-Oxley Act (SOX) Section 404; COSO Internal Control Framework

attributes.name: statistical_account
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this is a statistical (non-monetary) account used to track operational metrics such as headcount, FTE (Full-Time Equivalent), placement count, or billable hours. Statistical accounts do not impact financial statements.
attributes.references: Management Accounting Best Practices

attributes.name: tax_line_mapping
attributes.description: The mapped tax return line item or schedule reference for this account (e.g., 'Form 1120 Line 1a', 'Schedule C Line 8'). Used for automated tax return preparation and IRS compliance.
attributes.references: Internal Revenue Service (IRS) Tax Code; IRS Form 1120

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: The unit of measure for statistical accounts (e.g., 'FTE', 'Headcount', 'Hours', 'Placements'). Applicable only when statistical_account is True. Null for monetary accounts.
attributes.references: Management Accounting Best Practices

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: The user ID or name of the person who created this GL account record. Used for audit trail and accountability.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; COSO Internal Control Framework

attributes.name: parent_gl_account_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on gl_account (parent_gl_account_id)

products.name: cost_center
products.description: Organizational cost center master record representing a financial accountability unit within the staffing enterprise. Captures cost center code, name, description, cost center type (branch, division, corporate, shared services), owning business unit, regional hierarchy, manager, budget owner, active status, and effective dates. Used to allocate revenues and expenses across branches, divisions, and service lines for internal P&L reporting and profitability analysis.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the cost center record. Primary key.
attributes.references: ISO 8000-110 Master Data Quality

attributes.name: business_unit_id
attributes.description: Reference to the owning business unit or operating entity. Links cost center to the organizational hierarchy for consolidated financial reporting.
attributes.references: GAAP Segment Reporting Standards

attributes.name: last_modified_by_user_staff_profile_id
attributes.description: User identifier of the person who last modified this cost center record. Used for audit trail and accountability.
attributes.references: SOX Audit Trail Requirements; Data Governance Standards

attributes.name: legal_entity_id
attributes.description: Reference to the legal entity that owns this cost center. Used for statutory financial reporting, tax filings, and legal compliance. Critical for multi-entity staffing organizations.
attributes.references: GAAP Consolidation Standards; SOX Compliance

attributes.name: parent_cost_center_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent cost center in a hierarchical cost center structure. Enables roll-up reporting and multi-level profitability analysis. Null for top-level cost centers.
attributes.references: Management Accounting Hierarchy Standards

attributes.name: primary_cost_staff_profile_id
attributes.description: Reference to the employee who manages this cost center. Responsible for operational performance and budget adherence.
attributes.references: HR Master Data Standards

attributes.name: staff_profile_id
attributes.description: User identifier of the person who created this cost center record. Used for audit trail and accountability.
attributes.references: SOX Audit Trail Requirements; Data Governance Standards

attributes.name: allocation_method
attributes.description: Method used to allocate shared costs or overhead to this cost center. Direct = costs directly attributable; Headcount = allocated by employee count; Revenue = allocated by revenue contribution; FTE = allocated by Full-Time Equivalent count; Square Footage = allocated by physical space; Transaction Volume = allocated by activity volume.
attributes.references: Management Accounting Cost Allocation Standards; GAAP Indirect Cost Guidelines

attributes.name: annual_budget_amount
attributes.description: Total budgeted amount for the current fiscal year for this cost center. Used for budget vs. actual variance analysis and financial planning. Expressed in the reporting currency.
attributes.references: GAAP Budgeting Standards; Management Accounting Framework

attributes.name: cost_center_code
attributes.description: Externally-known unique alphanumeric code identifying the cost center. Used in general ledger postings, financial reports, and ERP integrations. Typically follows organizational coding standards (e.g., branch codes, division codes, department codes).
attributes.references: GAAP Chart of Accounts Standards; ISO 8000-110

attributes.name: cost_center_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the cost center's purpose, scope, and responsibilities. Provides context for financial accountability and reporting.
attributes.references: GAAP Financial Reporting Standards

attributes.name: cost_center_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the cost center. Used for display in financial reports, dashboards, and user interfaces.
attributes.references: ISO 8000-110 Master Data Quality

attributes.name: cost_center_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the cost center. Active = operational and accepting transactions; Inactive = temporarily not in use; Suspended = under review or restricted; Pending Closure = scheduled for deactivation; Closed = permanently deactivated and archived.
attributes.references: Master Data Lifecycle Management Standards

attributes.name: cost_center_type
attributes.description: Classification of the cost center by organizational function. Branch = field office or local staffing branch; Division = business unit or service line; Corporate = headquarters or enterprise functions; Shared Services = centralized support functions (HR, IT, Finance); Regional = multi-branch geographic area; Department = functional unit within a larger entity.
attributes.references: GAAP Segment Reporting; Management Accounting Best Practices

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO country code where the cost center operates. Used for international financial consolidation and statutory reporting.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3 Country Codes

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this cost center record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.
attributes.references: ISO 8601 Timestamp Format; SOX Audit Trail Requirements

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for financial transactions and reporting associated with this cost center. Used for multi-currency consolidation and foreign exchange management.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date when this cost center ceased or will cease to be active. Null for currently active cost centers with no planned end date. Used for historical reporting and cost center lifecycle management.
attributes.references: GAAP Period Accounting Standards; ISO 8601 Date Format

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date when this cost center became or will become active and eligible for financial transactions. Used for temporal reporting and historical analysis.
attributes.references: GAAP Period Accounting Standards; ISO 8601 Date Format

attributes.name: external_reporting_code
attributes.description: Code used for external financial reporting, regulatory filings, or industry benchmarking. May differ from internal cost center code to meet external reporting requirements (e.g., EEOC, OFCCP, SIA benchmarking).
attributes.references: GAAP External Reporting Standards; EEOC Reporting Requirements; SIA Benchmarking Standards

attributes.name: gl_account_segment
attributes.description: The cost center segment value used in the chart of accounts structure within the general ledger. Enables automated posting and financial statement mapping.
attributes.references: GAAP Chart of Accounts; Oracle NetSuite ERP GL Segment Standards

attributes.name: industry_vertical
attributes.description: Primary industry vertical or sector focus for this cost center (e.g., Healthcare, IT, Finance, Manufacturing, Logistics). Used for vertical-specific performance analysis and market segmentation. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: healthcare|information_technology|finance|manufacturing|logistics|retail|hospitality|energy|construction — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: NAICS Industry Classification; SIA Industry Vertical Standards

attributes.name: intercompany_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this cost center participates in intercompany transactions (True) requiring elimination entries during consolidation, or operates solely within a single legal entity (False).
attributes.references: GAAP Consolidation Standards; Intercompany Accounting Framework

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this cost center record was last updated. Used for change tracking and audit trail.
attributes.references: ISO 8601 Timestamp Format; SOX Audit Trail Requirements

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-form notes or comments about the cost center. Used for documenting special circumstances, organizational changes, or operational context.
attributes.references: Master Data Documentation Standards

attributes.name: overhead_rate_percentage
attributes.description: Standard overhead allocation rate applied to this cost center, expressed as a percentage. Used for burden rate calculations and full-cost profitability analysis. Example: 15.50 represents 15.50%.
attributes.references: Management Accounting Overhead Allocation Standards

attributes.name: profit_center_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this cost center is also a profit center (True) or purely a cost center (False). Profit centers track both revenue and expenses for full P&L accountability; pure cost centers track only expenses.
attributes.references: Management Accounting Best Practices

attributes.name: region_code
attributes.description: Geographic region code for the cost center. Used for regional P&L reporting and geographic performance analysis. Examples: NE (Northeast), SE (Southeast), MW (Midwest), W (West), CAN (Canada).
attributes.references: ISO 3166-2 Subdivision Codes; Internal Regional Taxonomy

attributes.name: revenue_generating_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this cost center directly generates revenue (True) such as a staffing branch, or is a support/overhead function (False) such as corporate HR or IT.
attributes.references: Management Accounting Standards

attributes.name: service_line
attributes.description: Primary service line or business offering associated with this cost center. Used for service-line profitability analysis and strategic planning. RPO = Recruitment Process Outsourcing; MSP = Managed Service Provider. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: temporary_staffing|permanent_placement|rpo|msp|payroll_services|workforce_consulting|executive_search — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Staffing Industry Analysts (SIA) Service Line Taxonomy

attributes.name: tax_jurisdiction_code
attributes.description: Tax jurisdiction identifier for this cost center. Used for SUTA (State Unemployment Tax Act), local tax reporting, and workers compensation allocation. Format varies by country (e.g., US state codes, Canadian province codes).
attributes.references: IRS Tax Jurisdiction Standards; SUTA State Codes; CRA Provincial Codes

products.name: journal_entry
products.description: General ledger journal entry header record representing a balanced accounting transaction posted to the staffing enterprise's general ledger. Captures journal entry number, journal date, posting date, period, fiscal year, journal type (standard, adjusting, reversing, accrual, intercompany), source system (payroll, billing, AP, AR), description, total debit amount, total credit amount, currency, exchange rate, preparer, approver, approval date, reversal flag, reversal date, and posting status. Core transactional record for all financial accounting activity.

attributes.name: journal_entry_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the journal entry record. Primary key for the journal entry entity.
attributes.references: GAAP - Generally Accepted Accounting Principles

attributes.name: accounting_period_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.accounting_period. Business justification: Journal entry should link to accounting period master for proper period management. Currently uses accounting_period (STRING) and fiscal_year (INT) which should be normalized to FK. Removes redundant
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: approver_staff_profile_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the user or employee who approved the journal entry. Used for audit trail and segregation of duties compliance.
attributes.references: SOX - Sarbanes-Oxley Act Section 404

attributes.name: business_unit_id
attributes.description: FK to finance.business_unit

attributes.name: legal_entity_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.legal_entity. Business justification: Journal entry should link to legal entity master for proper entity-level accounting. Currently uses legal_entity_code (STRING) which should be normalized to FK. Removes redundant code column.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: primary_journal_staff_profile_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the user or employee who prepared the journal entry. Used for audit trail and segregation of duties.
attributes.references: SOX - Sarbanes-Oxley Act Section 404

attributes.name: recurring_schedule_id
attributes.description: Identifier linking this journal entry to its recurring schedule template. Used for automated recurring journal entry processing.
attributes.references: Oracle NetSuite ERP - General Ledger Module

attributes.name: reversed_journal_entry_id
attributes.description: Reference to the original journal entry that this entry reverses. Creates a link between reversing entries and their originals.
attributes.references: GAAP - Generally Accepted Accounting Principles

attributes.name: adjustment_reason
attributes.description: Explanation or reason code for adjusting journal entries. Documents the business justification for period-end adjustments and corrections.
attributes.references: GAAP - Generally Accepted Accounting Principles

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: The date on which the journal entry was approved for posting. Part of the approval workflow audit trail.
attributes.references: SOX - Sarbanes-Oxley Act Section 404

attributes.name: approver_name
attributes.description: Name of the individual who approved the journal entry for posting to the general ledger.
attributes.references: SOX - Sarbanes-Oxley Act Section 404

attributes.name: audit_trail_notes
attributes.description: Additional notes or comments added during the journal entry lifecycle for audit trail purposes. Captures reviewer comments and change justifications.
attributes.references: SOX - Sarbanes-Oxley Act Section 404

attributes.name: batch_number
attributes.description: Identifier for the batch or group of journal entries processed together. Used for bulk posting and reconciliation.
attributes.references: Oracle NetSuite ERP - General Ledger Module

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp indicating when the journal entry record was first created in the general ledger system.
attributes.references: SOX - Sarbanes-Oxley Act Section 404

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code indicating the currency in which the journal entry amounts are denominated.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 - Currency Codes

attributes.name: exchange_rate
attributes.description: The foreign exchange rate applied to convert foreign currency amounts to the functional currency. Applicable for multi-currency journal entries.
attributes.references: GAAP - Foreign Currency Translation Standards

attributes.name: functional_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 code for the functional currency of the reporting entity. Used for multi-currency translation.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 - Currency Codes

attributes.name: intercompany_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator specifying whether this journal entry represents an intercompany transaction between legal entities within the enterprise.
attributes.references: GAAP - Consolidation and Intercompany Accounting

attributes.name: journal_date
attributes.description: The business date on which the journal entry transaction occurred. Represents the effective date of the accounting event.
attributes.references: GAAP - Generally Accepted Accounting Principles

attributes.name: journal_entry_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of the journal entry explaining the business purpose and nature of the accounting transaction.
attributes.references: GAAP - Generally Accepted Accounting Principles

attributes.name: journal_entry_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the journal entry. Human-readable unique number assigned to the journal entry for external reference and audit trail purposes.
attributes.references: GAAP - Generally Accepted Accounting Principles

attributes.name: journal_type
attributes.description: Classification of the journal entry indicating its purpose and nature in the accounting cycle.
attributes.references: GAAP - Generally Accepted Accounting Principles

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp indicating when the journal entry record was last modified. Used for audit trail and change tracking.
attributes.references: SOX - Sarbanes-Oxley Act Section 404

attributes.name: posted_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp indicating when the journal entry was posted to the general ledger. Marks the point at which the entry became part of the official books.
attributes.references: GAAP - Generally Accepted Accounting Principles

attributes.name: posting_date
attributes.description: The date on which the journal entry was posted to the general ledger. May differ from journal date for period-end adjustments and accruals.
attributes.references: GAAP - Generally Accepted Accounting Principles

attributes.name: posting_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the journal entry in the posting workflow. Indicates whether the entry is draft, awaiting approval, posted to GL, or cancelled.
attributes.references: GAAP - Generally Accepted Accounting Principles

attributes.name: preparer_name
attributes.description: Name of the individual who prepared or created the journal entry.
attributes.references: SOX - Sarbanes-Oxley Act Section 404

attributes.name: recurring_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator specifying whether this journal entry is part of a recurring journal entry template that posts automatically each period.
attributes.references: Oracle NetSuite ERP - General Ledger Module

attributes.name: reference_number
attributes.description: External reference number linking this journal entry to source documents such as invoices, payroll runs, or vendor bills.
attributes.references: GAAP - Generally Accepted Accounting Principles

attributes.name: reversal_date
attributes.description: The date on which this journal entry will be or was reversed. Applicable only for reversing journal entries.
attributes.references: GAAP - Generally Accepted Accounting Principles

attributes.name: reversal_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator specifying whether this journal entry is a reversing entry that will be automatically reversed in a subsequent period.
attributes.references: GAAP - Generally Accepted Accounting Principles

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: The originating system or module that generated this journal entry. Identifies whether the entry came from payroll processing, billing, AP, AR, or was manually created.
attributes.references: Oracle NetSuite ERP - General Ledger Module

attributes.name: total_credit_amount
attributes.description: The sum of all credit amounts across all line items in this journal entry. Must equal total debit amount for a balanced entry.
attributes.references: GAAP - Generally Accepted Accounting Principles

attributes.name: total_debit_amount
attributes.description: The sum of all debit amounts across all line items in this journal entry. Must equal total credit amount for a balanced entry.
attributes.references: GAAP - Generally Accepted Accounting Principles

attributes.name: reversing_journal_entry_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on journal_entry (reversing_journal_entry_id)

products.name: journal_entry_line
products.description: Individual debit or credit line within a general ledger journal entry. Captures line sequence number, GL account, cost center, department, project code, intercompany entity, debit amount, credit amount, functional currency amount, transaction currency amount, exchange rate, line description, tax code, and reconciliation status. Each journal entry must have balanced lines (total debits = total credits). Enables granular GL drill-down and account-level financial analysis.
products.reference: Journal Entry Line / GL Line Item

Captures budget name, budget version (original, revised, forecast), fiscal year, budget period, budget type (operating, capital, headcount), owning cost center or business unit, GL account, budgeted amount, currency, budget status (draft, approved, locked), approved by, approval date, and budget notes. Supports branch-level, division-level, and enterprise-level budget management for revenue, gross margin, SG&A, and headcount planning.

attributes.references: Internal Data Management Standard

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Budget should link to cost center master for organizational tracking. Currently uses cost_center_code (STRING) which should be normalized to FK. Removes redundant code column.
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: gl_account_id

attributes.name: parent_budget_id

attributes.name: vms_program_id

attributes.name: allocation_method
attributes.description: The method used to allocate or distribute this budget across organizational units or time periods. Direct allocation assigns to a single entity, proportional spreads by percentage, activity-based allocates by usage, headcount allocates by FTE count, and revenue allocates by revenue contribution.
attributes.references: Cost Accounting Standards; Financial Planning and Analysis (FP&A) Best Practices

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: The date on which this budget was formally approved by the authorized approver. Establishes the official start of budget enforcement.
attributes.references: Internal Financial Governance Standards

attributes.name: budget_category
attributes.description: High-level financial category of the budget. Revenue tracks income targets, gross margin tracks profitability, SG&A (Selling, General & Administrative) tracks operating expenses, COGS (Cost of Goods Sold) tracks direct costs, payroll tracks compensation, recruiting tracks talent acquisition costs, overhead tracks indirect costs, and other captures miscellaneous items. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: revenue|gross_margin|sga|cogs|payroll|recruiting|overhead|other — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Generally Accepted Accounting Principles (GAAP); Staffing Industry Financial Standards

attributes.name: budget_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name or title of the budget (e.g., 'FY2024 Operating Budget', 'Q2 Headcount Plan', 'Branch Expansion Capital Budget'). Provides business context and identification.
attributes.references: Internal Financial Planning Standards

attributes.name: budget_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the budget. Draft indicates work in progress, submitted indicates pending approval, approved indicates executive sign-off, locked indicates no further changes allowed, rejected indicates not approved, and archived indicates historical record.
attributes.references: Financial Planning and Analysis (FP&A) Best Practices

attributes.name: budget_type
attributes.description: Classification of the budget by its purpose. Operating budgets cover day-to-day expenses, capital budgets cover long-term investments, headcount budgets track FTE (Full-Time Equivalent) planning, revenue budgets track income targets, expense budgets track cost allocations, and project budgets track initiative-specific funding.
attributes.references: Financial Planning and Analysis (FP&A) Best Practices

attributes.name: budgeted_amount
attributes.description: The planned or allocated monetary amount for this budget line. Represents the financial target or limit for the specified period, account, and organizational unit.
attributes.references: Generally Accepted Accounting Principles (GAAP)

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this budget record was first created in the system. Provides audit trail for budget lifecycle tracking.
attributes.references: Internal Data Management Standard

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the budgeted amount (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Supports multi-currency budget management for international operations.

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: The fiscal year to which this budget applies (e.g., 2024, 2025). Represents the annual financial planning period.

attributes.name: headcount_fte
attributes.description: The budgeted headcount expressed in Full-Time Equivalents. Used for workforce planning budgets to track planned staffing levels. Supports fractional FTE for part-time or contract roles.

attributes.name: is_active
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this budget is currently active and in use. True for active budgets, false for superseded or archived budgets.
attributes.references: Internal Data Management Standard

attributes.name: is_capital_expenditure
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this budget line represents a capital expenditure (CapEx) rather than an operating expense (OpEx). True for long-term asset investments, false for day-to-day operational costs.
attributes.references: Generally Accepted Accounting Principles (GAAP)

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this budget record was last updated or modified. Tracks the most recent change for audit and version control purposes.
attributes.references: Internal Data Management Standard

attributes.name: modified_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the user who last modified this budget record. Provides accountability for budget changes.
attributes.references: Internal Data Management Standard

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes, comments, or justifications related to this budget. Captures assumptions, rationale for amounts, special conditions, or variance explanations.
attributes.references: Internal Financial Planning Standards

attributes.name: owner
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the individual responsible for managing and monitoring this budget (e.g., department head, branch manager, finance controller). Accountable for budget performance.
attributes.references: Internal Financial Governance Standards

attributes.name: period
attributes.description: The time granularity of the budget (annual, quarterly, monthly, or weekly). Defines the planning and reporting frequency.
attributes.references: Financial Planning and Analysis (FP&A) Best Practices

attributes.name: period_end_date
attributes.description: The end date of the budget period. Defines when the budget expires or is superseded.
attributes.references: Generally Accepted Accounting Principles (GAAP)

attributes.name: period_start_date
attributes.description: The start date of the budget period. Defines when the budget becomes effective.
attributes.references: Generally Accepted Accounting Principles (GAAP)

attributes.name: variance_threshold_percent
attributes.description: The acceptable variance percentage threshold for this budget line (e.g., 5.00 for 5%). Used to trigger alerts or reviews when actual spending deviates from budget by more than this threshold.
attributes.references: Financial Planning and Analysis (FP&A) Best Practices

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Version or iteration of the budget. Tracks whether this is the original approved budget, a revised budget after adjustments, a forecast update, or actual results for comparison.

attributes.name: revised_budget_id

products.name: budget_line
products.description: Individual line-item record within a financial budget, capturing the granular GL account and cost center level budget allocation. Captures budget reference, GL account, cost center, department, period (monthly/quarterly), budgeted amount, prior year actual amount, variance to prior year, budget notes, and last updated timestamp. Enables detailed budget-vs-actual variance analysis at the account and cost center level across branches, divisions, and service lines.

attributes.name: line_sequence

attributes.name: period_end_date
attributes.description: The end date of the fiscal period covered by this budget line. Defines the temporal boundary for budget applicability.
attributes.references: GAAP Fiscal Period Standard

attributes.name: period_start_date
attributes.description: The start date of the fiscal period covered by this budget line. Enables time-series analysis and period-over-period comparisons.

attributes.name: prior_year_actual_amount
attributes.description: The actual amount spent or earned in the same period of the prior fiscal year. Used for year-over-year variance analysis and budget benchmarking.

attributes.name: service_line_code

attributes.name: variance_to_prior_year

attributes.name: version_number

attributes.references: Internal Data Governance Standard

Captures bank name, bank routing number, account number (masked), account type (operating, payroll, trust, concentration), currency, legal entity owner, account status (active, dormant, closed), signatory list, overdraft limit, and associated GL cash account. Covers operating accounts, payroll funding accounts, client trust accounts, and concentration accounts used across the staffing firm's treasury operations.

products.name: budget_allocation
products.description: This association product represents the allocation of budget amounts across organizational departments within Staffing Hr. It captures the distribution of financial budgets (operating, capital, headcount) to specific departments for a defined time period. Each record links one budget to one department with allocation-specific attributes including allocated amount, allocation percentage, effective dates, and budget category. This enables multi-department budget distribution, departmental cost tracking, and variance analysis by department.. Existence Justification: In staffing firms, budgets are allocated across multiple departments to distribute financial resources for different purposes (headcount, operations, technology, facilities). A single enterprise or division-level budget is split among multiple departments (recruiting, sales, operations, support), and each department receives allocations from multiple budget categories and fiscal periods. The business actively manages these allocations with specific amounts, percentages, effective dates, and approval workflows.

attributes.name: budget_allocation_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for this budget allocation record. Primary key for the budget_allocation association.

attributes.name: budget_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the budget being allocated. References the master budget record that defines the total budgeted amount, fiscal year, budget type, and approval status.
attributes.references: Internal - M:N Association FK

attributes.name: department_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the department receiving the budget allocation. References the organizational department that will consume and be accountable for the allocated budget amount.
attributes.references: Internal - M:N Association FK

attributes.name: allocated_amount
attributes.description: The monetary amount allocated from the budget to this specific department. Represents the portion of the total budget assigned to this department for the allocation period.

attributes.name: allocated_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the finance user who created or approved this budget allocation. Provides accountability for allocation decisions.

attributes.name: allocation_date
attributes.description: The date when this budget allocation was formally created or approved. Used for audit trail and allocation history tracking.

attributes.name: allocation_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or justifications for this specific allocation. Captures business rationale, special conditions, or allocation assumptions for this department.

attributes.name: allocation_percentage
attributes.description: The percentage of the total budget amount allocated to this department. Used for proportional budget distribution and variance analysis. Should sum to 100% across all departments for a given budget.

attributes.name: allocation_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of this budget allocation. Draft indicates pending approval, Approved indicates ready for use, Active indicates in-use, Frozen indicates temporarily locked, Closed indicates period ended, Revised indicates superseded by a new allocation.

attributes.name: budget_category
attributes.description: The financial category of this budget allocation. Classifies the allocation by its purpose (e.g., Headcount, SG&A, Technology, Facilities). Enables category-level tracking and reporting by department.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this budget allocation record was first created in the system. Provides audit trail for allocation creation.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: The date when this budget allocation expires or is superseded. Defines the end of the period during which the department can utilize this allocation. Null indicates an open-ended allocation.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: The date when this budget allocation becomes effective. Defines when the department can begin utilizing the allocated budget amount.

attributes.name: is_active
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this budget allocation is currently active and in effect. True means the allocation is operational, false means it has been superseded or closed.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this budget allocation record was last updated or modified. Tracks changes to allocation amounts, dates, or status.

attributes.name: modified_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the user who last modified this budget allocation record. Provides accountability for allocation changes.

attributes.name: variance_threshold_percent
attributes.description: The acceptable variance percentage threshold for this specific allocation. Overrides the budget-level threshold when department-specific variance tolerances are needed.

products.name: compensation
products.description: Master record defining the current and historical compensation structure for each internal employee. Captures compensation type (salary, hourly, draw-plus-commission, commission-only), base salary or hourly rate, pay frequency (weekly, bi-weekly, semi-monthly, monthly), currency, effective date, end date, compensation band, pay grade, overtime eligibility, and the reason for the compensation record (new hire, merit increase, promotion, market adjustment, equity correction). SSOT for internal employee pay rates — distinct from payroll.pay_rate (contingent worker pay) and billing.bill_rate (client-facing rates).

attributes.name: compensation_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the compensation record. Primary key for the compensation data product.
attributes.references: Internal Data Management Standard

attributes.name: compensation_approved_by_employee_staff_profile_id
attributes.description: Reference to the internal employee (typically manager, HR director, or executive) who approved this compensation record. Links to the employee master data product.
attributes.references: Internal Approval Workflow Standards

attributes.name: compensation_staff_profile_id
attributes.description: Reference to the internal employee who is the subject of this compensation record. Links to the employee master data product.
attributes.references: Internal HR Data Standard

attributes.name: plan_id
attributes.description: Reference to the formal compensation plan or structure under which this compensation record is governed. Links to compensation plan master data defining rules, bands, and eligibility criteria.
attributes.references: Internal Compensation Framework

attributes.name: annual_hours_expected
attributes.description: The expected number of work hours per year for this employee based on their FTE and schedule. Typically 2080 for full-time employees (40 hours/week * 52 weeks). Used for hourly rate calculations and capacity planning.
attributes.references: Internal HR Policy; FLSA Standards

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: The date on which this compensation record was formally approved by the authorized approver. Used for audit trail and compliance verification.
attributes.references: Internal Approval Workflow Standards

attributes.name: band
attributes.description: The compensation band or salary range classification assigned to this employee. Used for internal equity analysis and compensation planning. Examples: Band A, Band B, Executive, Senior, Mid-Level, Entry.
attributes.references: Internal Compensation Framework; Pay Equity Standards

attributes.name: base_salary_amount
attributes.description: The annual base salary amount for salaried employees. Null for hourly or commission-only employees. Represents the fixed component of total compensation before bonuses, commissions, or other variable pay.
attributes.references: Internal Compensation Policy; FLSA Exempt Employee Standards

attributes.name: change_reason
attributes.description: The business reason for creating this compensation record. Captures the driver for the compensation change or establishment. New hire indicates initial compensation upon hire, merit increase indicates performance-based raise, promotion indicates advancement to higher role, market adjustment indicates alignment with external market rates, equity correction indicates internal pay equity adjustment. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: new_hire|merit_increase|promotion|market_adjustment|equity_correction|cost_of_living|title_change|demotion|transfer|annual_review — 10 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Internal HR Policy; Compensation Change Management

attributes.name: change_reason_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes providing additional context or justification for the compensation change. May include performance review scores, market data references, or approval details.
attributes.references: Internal HR Documentation Standards

attributes.name: commission_rate
attributes.description: The commission percentage or rate applied to revenue, placements, or other performance metrics for commission-eligible employees. Expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.0500 for 5%).
attributes.references: Internal Commission Plan; Sales Compensation Policy

attributes.name: compa_ratio
attributes.description: The comparative ratio expressing the employees compensation relative to the midpoint of their compensation band or market rate. Calculated as (actual compensation / band midpoint) * 100. Values below 100 indicate below-midpoint pay, above 100 indicate above-midpoint pay. Used for pay equity analysis.
attributes.references: Internal Compensation Analytics; Pay Equity Standards

attributes.name: compensation_type
attributes.description: The classification of compensation structure for the employee. Salary indicates fixed annual pay, hourly indicates pay per hour worked, draw_plus_commission indicates guaranteed draw with commission upside, commission_only indicates pure variable pay, contract indicates fixed-term contractor rate, stipend indicates allowance-based pay.
attributes.references: Fair Labor Standards Act (FLSA); Internal Compensation Policy

attributes.name: cost_center_code
attributes.description: The cost center code to which this employees compensation expense is allocated. Used for financial reporting and budgeting. May differ from current employee cost center if this is a historical record.
attributes.references: Internal Financial Management; General Ledger Chart of Accounts

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this compensation record was first created in the data platform. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.
attributes.references: Internal Data Management Standard

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: The three-letter ISO 4217 currency code in which the compensation is denominated. Supports multi-currency operations for international employees.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes

attributes.name: department_code
attributes.description: The department code associated with this compensation record at the time of its creation. Used for cost allocation and departmental compensation analysis. May differ from current employee department if this is a historical record.
attributes.references: Internal Organizational Structure; General Ledger Chart of Accounts

attributes.name: draw_amount
attributes.description: The guaranteed draw amount for draw-plus-commission employees. Represents the minimum compensation paid regardless of commission performance, typically recoverable against future commissions.
attributes.references: Internal Commission Plan; Draw Policy

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date on which this compensation record becomes active and applicable to the employee. Marks the start of the compensation period.

attributes.name: end_date
attributes.description: The date on which this compensation record ceases to be active. Null for current active compensation records. Populated when a new compensation record supersedes this one or when employment ends.

attributes.name: equity_grant_value
attributes.description: The value of equity compensation (stock options, RSUs, or other equity instruments) granted to the employee as part of this compensation package. Null for employees without equity compensation.

attributes.name: hourly_rate

attributes.name: is_current_record

attributes.name: job_title
attributes.description: The job title associated with this compensation record. Captured here to provide historical context for compensation changes tied to role changes. May differ from current employee job title if this is a historical record.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this compensation record was last modified in the data platform. Used for audit trail and change tracking.
attributes.references: Internal Data Management Standard

attributes.name: market_percentile
attributes.description: The market percentile at which this compensation is positioned relative to external market data for comparable roles. Values range from 1 to 100, where 50 represents median market pay. Used for competitive positioning analysis.

attributes.name: overtime_eligible_flag

attributes.name: pay_frequency

attributes.name: pay_grade

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: The name of the source system from which this compensation record originated. Examples: SAP SuccessFactors, Workday, ADP, Oracle HCM. Used for data lineage and reconciliation.

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: The unique identifier for this compensation record in the source system. Used for data lineage, reconciliation, and troubleshooting.

attributes.name: target_bonus_amount

attributes.description: The target bonus expressed as a percentage of base salary. Used for bonus-eligible employees where bonus is calculated as a percentage of base. Null for fixed bonus amounts or non-bonus-eligible employees.

attributes.name: work_location_code

products.name: commission_plan
products.description: Master record defining the commission and incentive compensation plan assigned to a revenue-generating internal employee (recruiter, account manager, business development rep). Captures plan name, plan type (gross margin split, placement fee percentage, spread-based, hybrid), commission rate tiers, accelerator thresholds, draw amount (if applicable), draw recovery terms, plan effective date, plan end date, and the approving manager. Critical for recruiter and account manager incentive management in staffing firms where variable compensation drives behavior.

attributes.name: commission_plan_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the commission plan record. Primary key.
attributes.references: Internal Data Management Standard

attributes.name: primary_commission_staff_profile_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the internal employee (recruiter, account manager, business development rep) to whom this commission plan is assigned.
attributes.references: Internal HR Data Standard

attributes.name: staff_profile_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the user who last modified this commission plan record.
attributes.references: Internal Data Management Standard

attributes.name: accelerator_rate
attributes.description: Enhanced commission rate as a decimal applied when accelerator threshold is met (e.g., 0.3500 for 35%). Null if plan does not include accelerators.
attributes.references: American Staffing Association (ASA) Compensation Best Practices

attributes.name: accelerator_threshold
attributes.description: Revenue or gross margin threshold that triggers an accelerated commission rate (bonus multiplier). Null if plan does not include accelerators.
attributes.references: American Staffing Association (ASA) Compensation Best Practices

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date when the commission plan was formally approved by management.
attributes.references: Internal Compensation Management Standard

attributes.name: base_commission_rate
attributes.description: The baseline commission rate as a decimal (e.g., 0.2500 for 25%). Represents the starting tier or standard rate before accelerators or adjustments.
attributes.references: Internal Compensation Management Standard

attributes.name: calculation_basis
attributes.description: The financial metric on which commission is calculated. Gross margin: bill rate minus pay rate and burden. Bill rate: total amount billed to client. Placement fee: one-time fee for direct hire. Spread: bill rate minus pay rate. Revenue: total invoiced revenue. Net revenue: revenue after adjustments.
attributes.references: American Staffing Association (ASA) Compensation Best Practices

attributes.name: cap_amount
attributes.description: Maximum commission amount that can be earned in a single period (monthly, quarterly, annually depending on plan). Null if no cap.
attributes.references: Internal Compensation Management Standard

attributes.name: cap_period
attributes.description: Time period over which the commission cap is applied. Null if no cap.
attributes.references: Internal Compensation Management Standard

attributes.name: clawback_condition
attributes.description: Condition that triggers commission clawback. Candidate termination: candidate leaves before guarantee period. Invoice non-payment: client does not pay. Client cancellation: client cancels assignment. Any failure: any of the above. Null if no clawback provision.
attributes.references: American Staffing Association (ASA) Compensation Best Practices

attributes.name: clawback_period_days
attributes.description: Number of days after commission payment during which the commission can be clawed back if the placement fails or invoice is not collected. Null if no clawback provision.
attributes.references: American Staffing Association (ASA) Compensation Best Practices

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this commission plan record was first created in the system.
attributes.references: Internal Data Management Standard

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary amounts in this commission plan (e.g., USD, CAD, GBP).
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes

attributes.name: draw_amount
attributes.description: Fixed advance payment amount provided to the employee against future commissions (recoverable draw). Null if plan does not include a draw.
attributes.references: Fair Labor Standards Act (FLSA) Draw Against Commission Rules

attributes.name: draw_frequency
attributes.description: Frequency at which the draw amount is paid to the employee. Null if plan does not include a draw.
attributes.references: Fair Labor Standards Act (FLSA) Draw Against Commission Rules

attributes.name: draw_recovery_method
attributes.description: Method by which draw amounts are recovered from earned commissions. Full recovery: entire draw deducted from commissions. Partial recovery: percentage deducted. Non-recoverable: draw is guaranteed (not a true draw). Rolling recovery: recovery over multiple periods. Null if plan does not include a draw.
attributes.references: Fair Labor Standards Act (FLSA) Draw Against Commission Rules

attributes.name: draw_recovery_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of earned commissions withheld to recover draw advances (e.g., 0.5000 for 50%). Null if plan does not include a draw or uses full recovery.
attributes.references: Fair Labor Standards Act (FLSA) Draw Against Commission Rules

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date when the commission plan becomes active and starts governing compensation calculations.
attributes.references: Fair Labor Standards Act (FLSA) Compensation Documentation

attributes.name: end_date
attributes.description: Date when the commission plan expires or is scheduled to terminate. Null for open-ended plans.
attributes.references: Fair Labor Standards Act (FLSA) Compensation Documentation

attributes.name: minimum_payout_amount
attributes.description: Minimum commission amount that must be earned before payout is issued. Amounts below this threshold are carried forward to the next period. Null if no minimum.
attributes.references: Internal Compensation Management Standard

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this commission plan record was last modified.
attributes.references: Internal Data Management Standard

attributes.name: payment_frequency
attributes.description: Frequency at which earned commissions are paid to the employee.
attributes.references: Fair Labor Standards Act (FLSA) Compensation Payment Requirements

attributes.name: payment_timing
attributes.description: Trigger event that determines when commission is paid. Upon invoice: when client is invoiced. Upon payment: when client pays invoice. Upon placement: when candidate is placed. Upon start date: when candidate starts work. Deferred: paid after a waiting period.
attributes.references: American Staffing Association (ASA) Compensation Best Practices

attributes.name: plan_code
attributes.description: Unique business identifier code for the commission plan, used for external reference and reporting.
attributes.references: Internal Compensation Management Standard

attributes.name: plan_description
attributes.description: Detailed textual description of the commission plan terms, conditions, and calculation methodology.
attributes.references: Internal Compensation Management Standard

attributes.name: plan_name
attributes.description: Descriptive name of the commission plan (e.g., 'Senior Recruiter Gross Margin Split Q1 2024', 'Account Manager Placement Fee Plan').
attributes.references: Internal Compensation Management Standard

attributes.name: plan_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the commission plan. Draft: plan is being designed. Active: plan is in effect. Suspended: temporarily paused. Expired: plan end date has passed. Terminated: plan was cancelled before expiration.
attributes.references: Internal Compensation Management Standard

attributes.name: plan_type
attributes.description: Classification of the commission plan structure. Gross margin split: percentage of gross margin (bill rate minus pay rate). Placement fee percentage: percentage of placement fee for direct hire. Spread-based: commission on the spread (markup). Hybrid: combination of multiple methods. Tiered revenue: commission rate changes based on revenue thresholds. Flat rate: fixed amount per placement or milestone.
attributes.references: American Staffing Association (ASA) Compensation Best Practices

attributes.name: split_default_percentage
attributes.description: Default percentage of commission allocated to this employee when commission is split (e.g., 0.6000 for 60%). Null if splits are not allowed or no default is defined.
attributes.references: Internal Compensation Management Standard

attributes.name: split_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether this commission plan allows commission splitting with other employees (e.g., recruiter and account manager split on a placement). True if splits are allowed, False otherwise.
attributes.references: Internal Compensation Management Standard

attributes.name: tier_1_rate
attributes.description: Commission rate as a decimal for the first performance tier (e.g., 0.2000 for 20%). Null if plan does not use tiered structure.
attributes.references: American Staffing Association (ASA) Compensation Best Practices

attributes.name: tier_1_threshold
attributes.description: Revenue or gross margin threshold amount that triggers the first commission rate tier. Null if plan does not use tiered structure.
attributes.references: American Staffing Association (ASA) Compensation Best Practices

attributes.name: tier_2_rate
attributes.description: Commission rate as a decimal for the second performance tier (e.g., 0.2500 for 25%). Null if plan does not use tiered structure or has fewer than 2 tiers.
attributes.references: American Staffing Association (ASA) Compensation Best Practices

attributes.name: tier_2_threshold
attributes.description: Revenue or gross margin threshold amount that triggers the second commission rate tier. Null if plan does not use tiered structure or has fewer than 2 tiers.
attributes.references: American Staffing Association (ASA) Compensation Best Practices

attributes.name: tier_3_rate
attributes.description: Commission rate as a decimal for the third performance tier (e.g., 0.3000 for 30%). Null if plan does not use tiered structure or has fewer than 3 tiers.
attributes.references: American Staffing Association (ASA) Compensation Best Practices

attributes.name: tier_3_threshold
attributes.description: Revenue or gross margin threshold amount that triggers the third commission rate tier. Null if plan does not use tiered structure or has fewer than 3 tiers.
attributes.references: American Staffing Association (ASA) Compensation Best Practices

attributes.name: superseded_commission_plan_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on commission_plan (superseded_commission_plan_id)

products.name: commission_earning
products.description: Transactional record capturing each individual commission earning event for an internal employee. Tracks the triggering event type (placement start, direct hire fee collected, temp-to-perm conversion, spread milestone), associated placement or billing reference, gross margin or fee amount used as the basis, commission rate applied, commission amount earned, pay period, payment status (pending, approved, paid, clawed back), and any adjustments for fall-offs or reversals. Enables recruiter and account manager commission statement generation and dispute resolution.

attributes.name: commission_earning_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the commission earning transaction record.
attributes.references: Internal Data Management Standard

attributes.name: assignment_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the placement that triggered this commission earning event. Nullable for non-placement-based commissions.
attributes.references: Internal Placement Management Standard

attributes.name: commission_plan_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the commission plan or compensation structure under which this earning was calculated.
attributes.references: Internal Compensation Plan Standard

attributes.name: invoice_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the invoice associated with this commission earning, if applicable. Used for billing-based commission triggers.
attributes.references: Internal Billing Standard

attributes.name: order_header_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the job order (requisition) associated with this commission earning event.
attributes.references: Internal Job Order Management Standard

attributes.name: primary_commission_staff_profile_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the internal employee (recruiter, account manager, operations staff) who earned this commission.
attributes.references: Internal HR Data Standard

attributes.name: accelerator_applied
attributes.description: Indicates whether a commission accelerator (bonus multiplier for exceeding targets) was applied to this earning. True if accelerator was applied; false otherwise.
attributes.references: Internal Compensation Plan Standard

attributes.name: accelerator_rate
attributes.description: Additional commission rate applied as an accelerator for exceeding performance targets, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.0200 for an additional 2%).
attributes.references: Internal Compensation Plan Standard

attributes.name: adjustment_amount
attributes.description: Any adjustment applied to the commission amount due to fall-offs, reversals, clawbacks, or corrections. Negative values represent reductions; positive values represent additions.
attributes.references: Internal Payroll Standard

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date on which this commission earning was approved by the manager. Null if not yet approved.
attributes.references: Internal Approval Workflow Standard

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Current approval workflow status for this commission earning. Pending approval indicates awaiting manager review; approved indicates manager has approved; rejected indicates manager has rejected; under review indicates additional scrutiny is required.
attributes.references: Internal Approval Workflow Standard

attributes.name: basis_amount
attributes.description: Gross margin, fee amount, or revenue amount used as the basis for calculating this commission. For direct hire, this is the placement fee; for temp placements, this is the spread (bill rate minus pay rate) or cumulative gross margin.
attributes.references: Internal Financial Reporting Standard

attributes.name: basis_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the basis amount (e.g., USD, CAD, GBP).
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes

attributes.name: clawback_date
attributes.description: Date on which the commission clawback was processed. Null if no clawback has occurred.
attributes.references: Internal Payroll Standard

attributes.name: clawback_reason
attributes.description: Reason for commission clawback or reversal, such as candidate fall-off before guarantee period, client non-payment, placement termination within guarantee period, or policy violation.
attributes.references: Internal Compensation Plan Standard

attributes.name: commission_amount
attributes.description: Total commission amount earned by the employee for this transaction, calculated as basis amount multiplied by commission rate, before any adjustments.
attributes.references: Internal Payroll Standard

attributes.name: commission_rate
attributes.description: Commission rate applied to the basis amount to calculate the commission earned, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.1000 for 10%, 0.0500 for 5%).
attributes.references: Internal Compensation Plan Standard

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this commission earning record was first created in the system.
attributes.references: Internal Data Management Standard

attributes.name: dispute_date
attributes.description: Date on which the employee raised the dispute. Null if no dispute has been raised.
attributes.references: Internal Payroll Standard

attributes.name: dispute_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the employee has raised a dispute regarding this commission earning. True if disputed; false otherwise.
attributes.references: Internal Payroll Standard

attributes.name: dispute_reason
attributes.description: Employee-provided reason for disputing this commission earning, such as incorrect rate applied, missing split credit, or incorrect basis amount.

attributes.name: earning_date
attributes.description: Date on which the commission was earned based on the triggering business event (e.g., placement start date, fee collection date, conversion date).

attributes.name: earning_event_type
attributes.description: Type of business event that triggered this commission earning. Placement start occurs when a candidate begins assignment; direct hire fee when permanent placement fee is collected; temp-to-perm conversion when temporary worker converts to permanent; spread milestone when cumulative gross margin threshold is reached; extension when assignment is extended; backfill when a replacement placement is made.
attributes.references: American Staffing Association (ASA) Compensation Guidelines

attributes.name: guarantee_end_date
attributes.description: Date on which the guarantee period expires and the commission becomes fully vested and no longer subject to clawback.
attributes.references: Internal Compensation Plan Standard

attributes.name: guarantee_period_days
attributes.description: Number of days in the guarantee period for this placement. Commission may be subject to clawback if the placement ends within this period.
attributes.references: Internal Compensation Plan Standard

attributes.name: is_active
attributes.description: Indicates whether this commission earning record is currently active and valid. False if the record has been voided, superseded, or logically deleted.
attributes.references: Internal Data Management Standard

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this commission earning record was last modified or updated.
attributes.references: Internal Data Management Standard

attributes.name: net_commission_amount
attributes.description: Final net commission amount payable to the employee after applying all adjustments. Calculated as commission amount plus adjustment amount.
attributes.references: Internal Payroll Standard

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional notes or comments regarding this commission earning, including special circumstances, manual adjustments, or clarifications.
attributes.references: Internal Data Management Standard

attributes.name: pay_period_end_date
attributes.description: End date of the pay period in which this commission earning will be paid.
attributes.references: Internal Payroll Standard

attributes.name: pay_period_start_date
attributes.description: Start date of the pay period in which this commission earning will be paid.
attributes.references: Internal Payroll Standard

attributes.name: payment_date
attributes.description: Actual date on which the commission payment was issued to the employee. Null if not yet paid.
attributes.references: Internal Payroll Standard

attributes.name: payment_status
attributes.description: Current payment status of this commission earning. Pending indicates awaiting approval; approved indicates ready for payment; paid indicates payment has been issued; clawed back indicates commission was reversed due to fall-off or policy violation; disputed indicates employee has raised a dispute; cancelled indicates the earning was voided.
attributes.references: Internal Payroll Standard

attributes.name: resolution_notes
attributes.description: Notes documenting the resolution of any dispute or adjustment, including actions taken and final decision.

attributes.name: source_record_reference
attributes.description: Unique identifier of this commission earning record in the source system, used for traceability and reconciliation.
attributes.references: Internal Data Integration Standard

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Name of the source system from which this commission earning record originated (e.g., TempWorks Payroll, Oracle NetSuite ERP, Bullhorn ATS/CRM).
attributes.references: Internal Data Integration Standard

attributes.name: split_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of the total commission allocated to this employee when commission is split among multiple employees (e.g., recruiter and account manager). Expressed as a percentage (e.g., 50.00 for 50%, 100.00 for 100%).
attributes.references: Internal Compensation Plan Standard

attributes.name: split_reason
attributes.description: Business reason for commission split, such as shared responsibility between recruiter and account manager, team collaboration, or management override.
attributes.references: Internal Compensation Plan Standard

attributes.name: tier_level
attributes.description: Commission tier or level applicable to this earning, if the commission plan uses tiered rates based on performance thresholds (e.g., Bronze, Silver, Gold, Platinum).

attributes.name: adjustment_commission_earning_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on commission_earning (adjustment_commission_earning_id)

attributes.name: next_review_due_date

attributes.name: overall_rating

attributes.name: parent_goal_performance_goal_id

attributes.name: goal_description
