attributes.name: measurement_unit
attributes.description: The unit of measure for the target and actual values (e.g., 'placements', 'USD', 'percentage', 'days', 'ratio', 'count').
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Performance Management

attributes.name: progress_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes documenting progress, challenges, or updates on this performance goal throughout the review period.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Performance Management

attributes.name: rating_label
attributes.description: The qualitative performance rating label for this goal: exceeds_expectations, meets_expectations, needs_improvement, unsatisfactory, not_rated.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Performance Management

attributes.name: rating_score
attributes.description: The performance rating score assigned to this goal (e.g., on a scale of 1.00 to 5.00, where 5.00 is exceptional). Null if not yet rated.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Performance Management

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: The name of the source system from which this performance goal record originated (e.g., 'SAP SuccessFactors', 'Bullhorn', 'Manual Entry').
attributes.references: Internal Data Lineage Standard

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: The unique identifier of this performance goal in the source system (e.g., SAP SuccessFactors Goal ID).
attributes.references: Internal Data Lineage Standard

attributes.name: start_date
attributes.description: The date when this performance goal becomes active and measurement begins.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Performance Management

attributes.name: target_completion_date
attributes.description: The date by which this performance goal is expected to be achieved or measured.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Performance Management

attributes.name: target_metric
attributes.description: The specific Key Performance Indicator (KPI) or metric being measured (e.g., 'Placements per Month', 'Gross Margin Target', 'Submittal-to-Hire Ratio', 'Time to Fill (TTF)', 'Quality of Submission (QoS)').
attributes.references: American Staffing Association (ASA) KPI Standards

attributes.name: target_value
attributes.description: The numeric target value the employee is expected to achieve for this goal (e.g., 15 placements, 500000 revenue, 0.25 ratio).
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Performance Management

attributes.name: parent_performance_goal_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on performance_goal (parent_performance_goal_id)

products.name: pip_record
products.description: Master record for Performance Improvement Plans (PIPs) issued to internal employees who are not meeting performance expectations. Captures PIP start date, PIP end date, improvement areas identified, specific measurable targets required, check-in frequency, PIP outcome (successfully completed, extended, terminated, resigned), HR business partner assigned, and whether legal review was conducted. Critical for HR compliance, documentation of progressive discipline, and wrongful termination risk mitigation in staffing firms.

attributes.name: pip_record_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the Performance Improvement Plan record. Primary key for the pip_record product.
attributes.references: Internal HR System Standard

attributes.name: primary_pip_staff_profile_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the internal employee (recruiter, account manager, operations staff) who is subject to this Performance Improvement Plan.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Core HR

attributes.name: quaternary_pip_created_by_user_staff_profile_id
attributes.description: System user ID of the HR professional or manager who created this PIP record. Used for audit trail and accountability.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Audit Standards

attributes.name: quinary_pip_updated_by_user_staff_profile_id
attributes.description: System user ID of the person who last modified this PIP record. Used for audit trail and change tracking.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Audit Standards

attributes.name: tertiary_pip_hrbp_staff_profile_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Human Resources Business Partner (HRBP) Employee ID
attributes.description: Identifier of the HR Business Partner assigned to oversee this PIP, ensure compliance with progressive discipline policies, and provide guidance to the manager.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Core HR

attributes.name: actual_end_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Actual Performance Improvement Plan (PIP) End Date
attributes.description: The actual date when the PIP was concluded, which may differ from original_end_date if the plan was extended, terminated early, or the employee resigned.
attributes.references: HR Policy - Progressive Discipline Framework

attributes.name: check_in_frequency
attributes.description: The cadence at which the manager and employee will meet to review progress against PIP targets. More frequent check-ins indicate higher severity or urgency.
attributes.references: HR Policy - Progressive Discipline Framework

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this PIP record was first created in the HR system. Used for audit trail and compliance reporting.
attributes.references: ISO 8601 Timestamp Standard

attributes.name: documentation_complete
attributes.description: Indicates whether all required PIP documentation is complete and stored in the employees personnel file, including signed acknowledgement, check-in notes, final evaluation, and legal review (if applicable). Critical for audit and litigation defense.
attributes.references: HR Documentation Standards

attributes.name: employee_acknowledgement_date
attributes.description: The date when the employee signed or electronically acknowledged receipt and understanding of the PIP documentation. Critical for legal defensibility.
attributes.references: HR Documentation Standards

attributes.name: employee_comments
attributes.description: Optional comments or rebuttal provided by the employee at the time of PIP acknowledgement. Captures employee perspective for documentation completeness.
attributes.references: HR Documentation Standards

attributes.name: extension_count
attributes.description: Number of times this PIP has been extended beyond the original end date. Multiple extensions may indicate unclear expectations or insufficient support.
attributes.references: HR Policy - Progressive Discipline Framework

attributes.name: final_evaluation_date
attributes.description: The date when the manager and HRBP conducted the final evaluation of the employees performance against PIP targets and determined the outcome.
attributes.references: HR Policy - Progressive Discipline Framework

attributes.name: final_evaluation_summary
attributes.description: Detailed summary of the final evaluation, documenting whether each measurable target was met, partially met, or not met, and the rationale for the pip_outcome decision.
attributes.references: HR Policy - Progressive Discipline Framework

attributes.name: improvement_areas
attributes.description: Detailed description of the specific performance deficiencies, behavioral issues, or skill gaps that triggered the PIP. May include metrics such as low placement rates, client complaints, missed KPIs, or policy violations.
attributes.references: HR Policy - Progressive Discipline Framework

attributes.name: legal_review_conducted
attributes.description: Indicates whether the PIP documentation and process were reviewed by legal counsel to mitigate wrongful termination risk. Critical for high-risk terminations or employees in protected classes.
attributes.references: Equal Employment Opportunity Commission (EEOC) Guidelines

attributes.name: legal_review_date
attributes.description: The date when legal counsel completed their review of the PIP documentation and termination risk assessment. Null if legal_review_conducted is false.
attributes.references: Equal Employment Opportunity Commission (EEOC) Guidelines

attributes.name: measurable_targets
attributes.description: Specific, quantifiable goals the employee must achieve to successfully complete the PIP. Examples: achieve 5 placements per month, reduce client escalations to zero, maintain 95% attendance, complete compliance training by specified date.
attributes.references: HR Policy - Progressive Discipline Framework

attributes.name: original_end_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Original Performance Improvement Plan (PIP) End Date
attributes.description: The initially scheduled end date for the PIP period, typically 30, 60, or 90 days from start. This date remains unchanged even if the PIP is extended.
attributes.references: HR Policy - Progressive Discipline Framework

attributes.name: pip_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the PIP record, typically formatted as PIP-YYYYNNNNNN for external reference and documentation.
attributes.references: HR Documentation Standards

attributes.name: pip_outcome
attributes.description: Final result of the PIP process. Successfully_completed means employee met all targets and PIP closed favorably; extended means additional time granted; employment_terminated means termination occurred due to failure to meet targets; employee_resigned means voluntary separation during PIP; pip_withdrawn means plan was cancelled (e.g., due to error or changed circumstances).
attributes.references: HR Policy - Progressive Discipline Framework

attributes.name: pip_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the PIP. Active indicates the plan is in progress; successfully_completed means the employee met all targets; extended means the PIP period was lengthened; terminated means employment ended during PIP; resigned means employee voluntarily left during PIP; withdrawn means PIP was cancelled before completion.
attributes.references: HR Policy - Progressive Discipline Framework

attributes.name: pip_type
attributes.description: The primary category of deficiency being addressed: performance (quality/productivity issues), conduct (behavioral issues), attendance (absenteeism/tardiness), or combination (multiple areas).
attributes.references: HR Policy - Progressive Discipline Framework

attributes.name: prior_action_date
attributes.description: The date of the most recent prior disciplinary action. Used to establish timeline of progressive discipline and ensure appropriate escalation intervals.
attributes.references: HR Policy - Progressive Discipline Framework

attributes.name: prior_disciplinary_action
attributes.description: The most recent formal disciplinary action taken before this PIP was issued, demonstrating progressive discipline. None indicates this is the first formal action; prior_pip indicates a repeat PIP scenario.
attributes.references: HR Policy - Progressive Discipline Framework

attributes.name: protected_class_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the employee belongs to one or more protected classes under EEOC regulations (race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age 40+, disability, genetic information). Heightens documentation and legal review requirements.
attributes.references: Equal Employment Opportunity Commission (EEOC)

attributes.name: severance_offered
attributes.description: Indicates whether a severance package was offered to the employee upon termination. Typically offered in exchange for release of claims to mitigate litigation risk.
attributes.references: HR Policy - Separation and Severance

attributes.name: start_date
attributes.description: The date when the Performance Improvement Plan officially begins and the employee is formally notified.
attributes.references: Fair Labor Standards Act (FLSA)

attributes.name: support_resources_provided
attributes.description: Description of training, coaching, tools, or other resources provided to the employee to help them succeed during the PIP period. Examples: additional training courses, mentorship assignment, access to performance analytics tools.
attributes.references: HR Policy - Progressive Discipline Framework

attributes.name: termination_date
attributes.description: The date employment was terminated if pip_outcome is employment_terminated. Null for other outcomes. Used for severance calculation and compliance reporting.
attributes.references: Fair Labor Standards Act (FLSA)

attributes.name: termination_risk_level
attributes.description: HR and legal assessment of wrongful termination litigation risk if employment is terminated following this PIP. Factors include protected class status, prior complaints, documentation quality, and consistency with past practice.
attributes.references: Equal Employment Opportunity Commission (EEOC) Guidelines

attributes.name: unemployment_eligibility
attributes.description: Companys position on the employees eligibility for unemployment benefits. Ineligible typically applies when termination was for cause (failure to meet PIP targets); contested means the company will challenge any unemployment claim.
attributes.references: Federal Unemployment Tax Act (FUTA) / State Unemployment Tax Act (SUTA)

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this PIP record was last modified. Tracks changes to status, outcome, dates, or other fields throughout the PIP lifecycle.
attributes.references: ISO 8601 Timestamp Standard

attributes.name: extended_pip_record_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on pip_record (extended_pip_record_id)

products.name: leave_request
products.description: Transactional record for all internal employee leave requests and approved leave events. Captures leave type (PTO, sick, FMLA, parental, bereavement, jury duty, military, unpaid), request date, leave start date, leave end date, total days requested, approval status (pending, approved, denied, cancelled), approving manager, FMLA eligibility flag, intermittent leave flag, and return-to-work date. Distinct from timesheet.absence_record (which tracks contingent worker absences) — this entity owns internal staff leave management.

attributes.name: leave_request_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the leave request record. Primary key.

attributes.name: accrual_policy_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the leave accrual policy governing this leave type for the employee. Links to the accrual policy master record defining accrual rates, carryover rules, and caps.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Time Off Accrual

attributes.name: primary_leave_staff_profile_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the internal employee submitting the leave request. Links to the employee master record.

attributes.name: actual_days_taken
attributes.description: Actual number of leave days taken by the employee, recorded after the leave concludes. May differ from total_days_requested if the employee returned early or extended the leave.
attributes.references: FMLA 29 CFR 825.205; Payroll Records

attributes.name: actual_hours_taken
attributes.description: Actual number of leave hours taken by the employee, recorded after the leave concludes. Used for hourly tracking and intermittent leave reconciliation.
attributes.references: FMLA 29 CFR 825.205; Payroll Records

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date on which the leave request was approved or denied by the manager. Null if still pending or withdrawn.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Time Off Workflow

attributes.name: balance_after_leave
attributes.description: Employee's remaining leave balance (in days or hours) after this leave is taken. Calculated as balance_before_leave minus actual leave taken.
attributes.references: Company Leave Accrual Policy

attributes.name: balance_before_leave
attributes.description: Employee's available leave balance (in days or hours, depending on accrual policy) immediately before this leave request was approved. Used for tracking accrual consumption.
attributes.references: Company Leave Accrual Policy

attributes.name: benefits_continuation_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether employee benefits (health insurance, retirement contributions) continue during this leave (True) or are suspended (False). Typically True for FMLA and paid leave, False for extended unpaid leave.
attributes.references: FMLA 29 CFR 825.209; ERISA

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this leave request record was first created in the system. Audit trail for record creation.
attributes.references: SOC 2 Type II Audit Trail Requirements

attributes.name: denial_reason
attributes.description: Free-text explanation provided by the manager for denying the leave request. Null if approved or pending.
attributes.references: Company Leave Policy; EEOC Recordkeeping

attributes.name: documentation_received_date
attributes.description: Date on which required supporting documentation (e.g., medical certificate, FMLA certification) was received by HR. Null if documentation not yet received or not required.
attributes.references: FMLA 29 CFR 825.305

attributes.name: documentation_status
attributes.description: Status of required supporting documentation. Not_required if no documentation needed, pending if awaiting submission, received if submitted and under review, approved if documentation accepted, rejected if documentation insufficient.
attributes.references: FMLA 29 CFR 825.305; Company Leave Policy

attributes.name: employee_comments
attributes.description: Optional free-text comments or notes provided by the employee when submitting the leave request, such as reason for leave or special circumstances.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Time Off Request

attributes.name: fmla_case_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: FMLA (Family and Medical Leave Act) Case Number
attributes.description: Unique case number assigned to FMLA-eligible leave requests for tracking and compliance reporting. Null for non-FMLA leave.
attributes.references: FMLA 29 CFR 825; DOL Recordkeeping Requirements

attributes.name: fmla_hours_used_ytd
attributes.business_glossary_term: FMLA (Family and Medical Leave Act) Hours Used Year-to-Date (YTD)
attributes.description: Cumulative FMLA hours used by the employee in the current 12-month FMLA eligibility period, including this leave request. Used to track the 480-hour (12-week) FMLA entitlement cap.
attributes.references: FMLA 29 CFR 825.200 - Amount of Leave

attributes.name: is_fmla_eligible
attributes.business_glossary_term: Is FMLA (Family and Medical Leave Act) Eligible
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this leave request qualifies for FMLA protection based on employee tenure, hours worked, and reason for leave. True if FMLA-eligible.
attributes.references: FMLA 29 CFR 825.110 - Eligibility Requirements

attributes.name: is_intermittent_leave
attributes.description: Indicates whether this is an intermittent leave request (True), allowing the employee to take leave in separate blocks of time or on a reduced schedule, versus a continuous block of leave (False).
attributes.references: FMLA 29 CFR 825.202 - Intermittent Leave

attributes.name: is_paid_leave
attributes.description: Indicates whether the leave request is for paid time off (True) or unpaid leave (False). Determines payroll impact and benefit accrual continuation.
attributes.references: FLSA; Company Compensation Policy

attributes.name: is_reduced_schedule
attributes.description: Indicates whether the leave involves a reduced work schedule (True), where the employee works fewer hours per day or week, versus full-day absences (False).
attributes.references: FMLA 29 CFR 825.202

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this leave request record was last updated in the system. Audit trail for record modification.
attributes.references: SOC 2 Type II Audit Trail Requirements

attributes.name: leave_end_date
attributes.description: Last calendar date of the requested leave period. Employee is expected to return to work the following business day.
attributes.references: FMLA 29 CFR 825; FLSA

attributes.name: leave_start_date
attributes.description: First calendar date of the requested leave period. Employee is expected to be absent starting this date.
attributes.references: FMLA 29 CFR 825; FLSA

attributes.name: leave_subtype
attributes.description: Optional granular classification within the leave type (e.g., maternity, paternity, adoption under parental; personal illness vs family care under FMLA).
attributes.references: FMLA 29 CFR 825; Company Leave Policy

attributes.name: leave_type
attributes.description: Category of leave being requested. PTO (Paid Time Off), sick leave, FMLA (Family and Medical Leave Act), parental leave, bereavement, jury duty, military leave, unpaid leave, or sabbatical. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: PTO|sick|FMLA|parental|bereavement|jury_duty|military|unpaid|sabbatical — 9 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: FMLA 29 CFR 825; FLSA; Company Leave Policy

attributes.name: manager_comments
attributes.description: Optional free-text comments or notes provided by the approving manager during the review process, such as approval conditions or denial rationale.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Time Off Workflow

attributes.name: payroll_impact_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this leave request impacts payroll processing (True), such as unpaid leave reducing gross pay or paid leave consuming accrued balance, versus no payroll impact (False).
attributes.references: FLSA; Company Payroll Policy

attributes.name: request_date
attributes.description: Date on which the employee submitted the leave request. Used for tracking request lead time and compliance with advance notice policies.
attributes.references: FMLA 29 CFR 825.302 - Notice Requirements

attributes.name: request_number
attributes.description: Human-readable business identifier for the leave request, typically auto-generated and used for tracking and reference in HR systems and communications.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Time Off Request Number

attributes.name: request_status
attributes.description: Current approval status of the leave request in the workflow. Pending indicates awaiting manager review, approved indicates manager approval granted, denied indicates request rejected, cancelled indicates system or admin cancellation, withdrawn indicates employee retracted the request.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Time Off Workflow

attributes.name: requires_documentation
attributes.description: Indicates whether this leave request requires supporting documentation (True), such as a medical certificate for sick leave or FMLA certification, versus no documentation required (False).
attributes.references: FMLA 29 CFR 825.305; Company Leave Policy

attributes.name: return_to_work_date
attributes.description: Actual date the employee returned to work following the leave. May differ from the planned leave end date if leave was extended or employee returned early. Null if leave has not yet concluded.
attributes.references: FMLA 29 CFR 825.312; Company Leave Policy

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Name of the operational system from which this leave request record originated, such as SAP SuccessFactors, Kronos, or internal HRIS.
attributes.references: Data Lineage Standard

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Unique identifier of this leave request record in the source system. Used for data lineage, reconciliation, and troubleshooting.
attributes.references: Data Lineage Standard

attributes.name: total_days_requested
attributes.description: Total number of leave days requested, calculated as business days or calendar days depending on company policy. May include fractional days for partial-day leave.
attributes.references: FMLA 29 CFR 825.205; Company Leave Policy

attributes.name: total_hours_requested
attributes.description: Total number of leave hours requested, used for hourly tracking and intermittent leave scenarios. Supports partial-day and hourly leave increments.
attributes.references: FMLA 29 CFR 825.205; FLSA

attributes.name: amended_leave_request_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on leave_request (amended_leave_request_id)

products.name: benefit_enrollment
products.description: Master record capturing an internal employee's enrollment in company-sponsored benefit plans. Tracks benefit plan type (medical, dental, vision, life insurance, STD, LTD, 401k, HSA, FSA, EAP), plan name, carrier name, coverage tier (employee only, employee + spouse, employee + children, family), enrollment effective date, termination date, employee contribution amount, employer contribution amount, enrollment source (open enrollment, new hire, qualifying life event), and dependent count. SSOT for internal employee benefits — distinct from any contingent worker benefit arrangements.

attributes.name: benefit_enrollment_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the benefit enrollment record. Primary key for the benefit enrollment entity.
attributes.references: Internal Data Management Standard

attributes.name: benefit_plan_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the benefit plan in which the employee is enrolled. Links to the benefit plan master record.
attributes.references: Internal Benefits Administration Standard

attributes.name: primary_benefit_staff_profile_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the internal employee enrolling in the benefit plan. Links to the employee master record.
attributes.references: Internal HR Data Standard

attributes.name: approved_date
attributes.description: Date on which the enrollment was approved by HR or benefits administration. Null if pending or auto-approved.
attributes.references: Benefits Administration Best Practice

attributes.name: beneficiary_name
attributes.description: Name of the primary beneficiary designated by the employee for life insurance or retirement plans. Null if not applicable or not yet designated.
attributes.references: ERISA Beneficiary Designation Rules

attributes.name: beneficiary_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of benefit proceeds allocated to the primary beneficiary (0.00 to 100.00). Null if not applicable.
attributes.references: ERISA Beneficiary Designation Rules

attributes.name: beneficiary_relationship
attributes.description: Relationship of the beneficiary to the employee (e.g., 'Spouse', 'Child', 'Parent', 'Other'). Null if not applicable.
attributes.references: ERISA Beneficiary Designation Rules

attributes.name: carrier_name
attributes.description: Name of the insurance carrier or benefits provider administering the plan (e.g., 'Blue Cross Blue Shield', 'Fidelity', 'MetLife').
attributes.references: Benefits Administration Best Practice

attributes.name: cobra_election_deadline
attributes.business_glossary_term: Consolidated Omnibus Budget Reconciliation Act (COBRA) Election Deadline
attributes.description: Deadline by which the employee must elect COBRA continuation coverage. Null if not COBRA eligible or coverage is active.
attributes.references: COBRA

attributes.name: cobra_eligible
attributes.business_glossary_term: Consolidated Omnibus Budget Reconciliation Act (COBRA) Eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether the employee is eligible for COBRA continuation coverage upon termination of this enrollment. True if eligible, False otherwise.
attributes.references: COBRA (Consolidated Omnibus Budget Reconciliation Act)

attributes.name: confirmation_date
attributes.description: Date on which the enrollment was confirmed by the carrier or benefits administrator. Null if still pending.
attributes.references: Benefits Administration Best Practice

attributes.name: contribution_frequency
attributes.description: Frequency at which employee and employer contributions are deducted or paid. Values: weekly, biweekly, semimonthly, monthly, annual.
attributes.references: Payroll Administration Best Practice

attributes.name: coverage_amount
attributes.description: Face value or coverage limit of the benefit (e.g., life insurance coverage amount, disability benefit maximum), in USD. Null for plans without a fixed coverage amount.
attributes.references: Insurance Industry Standard

attributes.name: coverage_tier
attributes.description: Level of coverage elected by the employee. Values: employee_only, employee_spouse, employee_children, family (employee + spouse + children), employee_domestic_partner.
attributes.references: ERISA; Benefits Administration Best Practice

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this enrollment record was first created in the data platform.
attributes.references: Internal Data Management Standard

attributes.name: deductible_amount
attributes.description: Annual deductible amount the employee must pay before the plan begins to pay benefits, in USD. Applicable to medical, dental, vision plans. Null if not applicable.
attributes.references: Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act (HIPAA)

attributes.name: dependent_count
attributes.description: Number of dependents covered under this enrollment (spouse, children, domestic partner). Zero if employee_only coverage.
attributes.references: Benefits Administration Best Practice

attributes.name: election_date
attributes.description: Date on which the employee made the enrollment election or submitted the enrollment form.
attributes.references: Benefits Administration Best Practice

attributes.name: employee_contribution_amount
attributes.description: Amount the employee contributes per pay period toward the benefit premium or plan cost, in USD. Pre-tax or post-tax depending on plan design.
attributes.references: ERISA; IRS Publication 15-B

attributes.name: employer_contribution_amount
attributes.description: Amount the employer contributes per pay period toward the benefit premium or plan cost, in USD.
attributes.references: ERISA; IRS Publication 15-B

attributes.name: enrollment_effective_date
attributes.description: Date on which the benefit coverage becomes effective and the employee is covered under the plan.
attributes.references: ERISA; HIPAA Special Enrollment Rules

attributes.name: enrollment_method
attributes.description: Method or channel through which the employee completed the enrollment. Values: online_portal, paper_form, phone, benefits_fair, auto_enrollment, hr_system.
attributes.references: Benefits Administration Best Practice

attributes.name: enrollment_number
attributes.description: Business-facing unique enrollment confirmation number or certificate number assigned by the benefits system or carrier.
attributes.references: Benefits Administration Best Practice

attributes.name: enrollment_source
attributes.description: Event or process that triggered the enrollment. Values: open_enrollment (annual election period), new_hire (initial eligibility), qualifying_life_event (QLE such as marriage, birth, loss of other coverage), annual_renewal (automatic continuation), rehire, status_change (e.g., part-time to full-time).
attributes.references: HIPAA Special Enrollment Provisions; IRS Section 125 Cafeteria Plan Rules

attributes.name: enrollment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the enrollment. Values: active (coverage in force), pending (awaiting carrier confirmation), terminated (coverage ended), suspended (temporarily paused), waived (employee declined coverage), cancelled (enrollment voided).
attributes.references: Benefits Administration Best Practice

attributes.name: enrollment_termination_date
attributes.description: Date on which the benefit coverage ends. Null if coverage is currently active or has no scheduled end date.
attributes.references: ERISA; COBRA Continuation Coverage Rules

attributes.name: is_active
attributes.description: Indicates whether this enrollment record is currently active and valid. True if active, False if superseded or logically deleted.
attributes.references: Internal Data Management Standard

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this enrollment record was last updated in the data platform.
attributes.references: Internal Data Management Standard

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments related to the enrollment, such as special circumstances, documentation requirements, or follow-up actions.
attributes.references: Internal Data Management Standard

attributes.name: out_of_pocket_maximum
attributes.description: Maximum amount the employee will pay out-of-pocket in a plan year before the plan covers 100% of costs, in USD. Applicable to medical plans. Null if not applicable.
attributes.references: Affordable Care Act (ACA); HIPAA

attributes.name: plan_name
attributes.description: Full name of the benefit plan as presented to employees (e.g., 'PPO Gold Plan', 'Basic Life Insurance', 'Traditional 401k').
attributes.references: Benefits Administration Best Practice

attributes.name: plan_type
attributes.description: Category of benefit plan. Values: medical (health insurance), dental, vision, life_insurance, std (Short-Term Disability), ltd (Long-Term Disability), 401k (retirement savings), hsa (Health Savings Account), fsa (Flexible Spending Account), eap (Employee Assistance Program), other. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: medical|dental|vision|life_insurance|std|ltd|401k|hsa|fsa|eap|other — 11 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ERISA (Employee Retirement Income Security Act); IRS Publication 15-B

attributes.name: policy_number
attributes.description: Master policy or group policy number under which the employee is covered. Issued by the carrier.
attributes.references: Insurance Industry Standard

attributes.name: qualifying_event_date
attributes.description: Date on which the qualifying life event occurred. Used to validate enrollment timing and eligibility. Null if not applicable.
attributes.references: HIPAA Special Enrollment; IRS Section 125

attributes.name: qualifying_event_type
attributes.description: Specific type of qualifying life event if enrollment_source is qualifying_life_event (e.g., 'Marriage', 'Birth of Child', 'Loss of Other Coverage', 'Divorce'). Null if not applicable.
attributes.references: HIPAA Special Enrollment; IRS Section 125

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Name of the source system from which this enrollment record originated (e.g., 'SAP SuccessFactors', 'TempWorks Payroll', 'Benefits Portal').
attributes.references: Internal Data Lineage Standard

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Unique identifier of this enrollment record in the source system. Used for traceability and reconciliation.
attributes.references: Internal Data Lineage Standard

attributes.name: termination_reason
attributes.description: Reason for termination of the enrollment (e.g., 'Employment termination', 'Employee request', 'Loss of eligibility', 'COBRA conversion', 'Retirement'). Null if coverage is active.
attributes.references: ERISA; COBRA

attributes.name: total_premium_amount
attributes.description: Total premium cost per pay period for the benefit plan (employee contribution + employer contribution), in USD.
attributes.references: Benefits Administration Best Practice

attributes.name: waiver_reason
attributes.description: Reason provided by the employee for waiving or declining coverage (e.g., 'Covered under spouse plan', 'Cost', 'Not needed'). Null if coverage was not waived.
attributes.references: Benefits Administration Best Practice

attributes.name: prior_benefit_enrollment_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on benefit_enrollment (prior_benefit_enrollment_id)

products.name: org_change_event

Serves as the authoritative audit trail for employee lifecycle changes, supporting HRIS reconciliation and compliance reporting.

attributes.name: primary_org_prior_department_id

attributes.name: primary_org_prior_office_location_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the office location where the employee was based before this change event. Null if the change did not involve a location change.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Employee Central

attributes.name: primary_org_staff_profile_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the internal employee who experienced this organizational change event.

attributes.name: quaternary_org_initiating_manager_staff_profile_id
attributes.description: Employee identifier of the manager who initiated or requested this organizational change event.

attributes.name: quinary_org_hr_approver_staff_profile_id

attributes.name: tertiary_org_new_manager_staff_profile_id
attributes.description: Employee identifier of the manager who supervises this employee after this change event. Null if the change did not involve a manager change.

attributes.name: approval_date

attributes.name: change_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code indicating the business reason for the organizational change. attributes.name: change_reason_description

attributes.name: changed_attribute_name

attributes.name: comments

attributes.name: compensation_change_triggered_flag

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this organizational change event record was first created in the data lakehouse. Audit field for data lineage.
attributes.references: Internal Data Management Standard

attributes.name: event_effective_date
attributes.description: The date on which this organizational change became effective. This is the business event date, distinct from the record creation timestamp.

attributes.name: event_status
attributes.description: Current status of the organizational change event in its lifecycle. Tracks whether the event is pending approval, approved, effective, cancelled, or reversed.

attributes.name: event_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise timestamp when the organizational change event was recorded in the system.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Employee Central

attributes.name: event_type

attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Organizational Management

attributes.name: is_termination_event

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp

attributes.name: last_working_date

attributes.name: new_cost_center_code
attributes.description: The cost center code assigned to the employee after this organizational change event. Null if the change did not involve a cost center change.

attributes.name: new_employment_type
attributes.description: The employment type classification after this change event. Null if the change did not involve an employment type change.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Employee Central

attributes.name: new_job_title
attributes.description: The job title assigned to the employee as a result of this organizational change event. Null if the change did not involve a title change.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Position Management

attributes.name: new_value
attributes.description: The value of the changed attribute after this event. For example, new job title, new department ID, new manager ID, or new employment type. Stored as string to accommodate various data types.

attributes.name: prior_cost_center_code
attributes.description: The cost center code assigned to the employee before this organizational change event. Null if the change did not involve a cost center change.

attributes.name: prior_employment_type
attributes.description: The employment type classification before this change event. Null if the change did not involve an employment type change.

attributes.name: prior_job_title
attributes.description: The job title held by the employee before this organizational change event. Null if the change did not involve a title change.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Position Management

attributes.name: prior_value
attributes.description: The value of the changed attribute before this event. For example, prior job title, prior department ID, prior manager ID, or prior employment type. Stored as string to accommodate various data types.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Employee Central - Audit Trail

attributes.name: rehire_eligibility_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the employee is eligible for rehire if this is a termination event. True if eligible, False if not eligible, Null if not a termination event.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Employee Central

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Name of the source system from which this organizational change event record originated. Typically SAP SuccessFactors or the primary HRIS.

attributes.name: source_system_event_reference
attributes.description: Unique identifier of this organizational change event in the source system. Used for reconciliation and audit trail purposes.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Employee Central

attributes.name: termination_type
attributes.description: Classification of the termination type if this event represents an employee termination. Null if not a termination event.
attributes.references: U.S. Department of Labor (DOL) - Separation Reporting

attributes.name: workflow_instance_reference
attributes.description: Identifier of the workflow instance in the source HRIS system that processed this organizational change event.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Workflow

attributes.name: reversal_org_change_event_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on org_change_event (reversal_org_change_event_id)

attributes.name: quaternary_recruiter_modified_by_employee_staff_profile_id

attributes.name: team_id

attributes.name: current_headcount

attributes.name: desk_close_date

attributes.name: desk_code

attributes.name: desk_name

products.name: territory_assignment
products.description: Transactional record capturing the assignment of a geographic territory, industry vertical, or named account portfolio to an internal account manager or business development representative. Tracks territory name, territory type (geographic, vertical, named account), assigned employee, effective start date, effective end date, assignment status, and whether the territory is exclusive. Supports sales territory management, account ownership routing, and commission attribution for account managers in staffing firms.

attributes.name: territory_assignment_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the territory assignment record. Primary key for the territory assignment entity.
attributes.references: Internal Data Management Standard

attributes.name: commission_plan_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the commission plan applicable to this territory assignment. Links to the commission plan master defining payout rates, accelerators, and thresholds.
attributes.references: Sales Compensation Standard

attributes.name: office_location_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the branch office or location to which this territory assignment is aligned. Links to the office location master record. Used for geographic reporting and operational coordination.
attributes.references: Internal HR Data Standard

attributes.name: primary_predecessor_assignment_territory_assignment_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the previous territory assignment record that this assignment replaces or succeeds. Used for tracking territory transition history and ensuring continuity in account ownership.
attributes.references: Sales Territory Management Standard

attributes.name: primary_territory_staff_profile_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the internal employee (account manager, business development representative, or recruiter) assigned to this territory. Links to the employee master record.
attributes.references: Internal HR Data Standard

attributes.name: territory_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the territory being assigned. Links to the territory master record defining geographic boundaries, industry verticals, or named account portfolios.
attributes.references: Sales Territory Management Standard

attributes.name: tertiary_territory_approved_by_employee_staff_profile_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the employee who approved this territory assignment. Links to the employee master record. Supports audit trail and governance requirements.
attributes.references: Internal HR Data Standard

attributes.name: vms_program_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the Vendor Management System (VMS) program associated with this territory, if applicable. Links to the VMS program master record. Relevant for territories serving Managed Service Provider (MSP) clients.

attributes.name: account_segment
attributes.description: Client account segment targeted by this territory assignment (e.g., enterprise, mid-market, small business). Aligns territory assignments with account segmentation strategy.

attributes.name: approved_date
attributes.description: Date when this territory assignment was formally approved. Used for audit trail and compliance tracking.
attributes.references: Internal Data Management Standard

attributes.name: assignment_reason
attributes.description: Business reason for creating this territory assignment. Supports workforce planning analysis and territory optimization initiatives. attributes.name: assignment_role
attributes.description: Role of the employee in this territory assignment. attributes.name: assignment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the territory assignment. Active assignments are operational; pending assignments are approved but not yet effective; suspended assignments are temporarily paused; expired assignments have passed their end date; transferred assignments have been reassigned to another employee.
attributes.references: Sales Territory Management Standard

attributes.name: cost_center_code
attributes.description: Cost center code for financial tracking and reporting of expenses related to this territory assignment. Used for budget allocation and profitability analysis.
attributes.references: Financial Accounting Standard

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this territory assignment record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.
attributes.references: Internal Data Management Standard

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date when the territory assignment ends or is scheduled to end. Null indicates an open-ended assignment. Used for territory transition planning and historical analysis.
attributes.references: Sales Territory Management Standard

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date when the territory assignment becomes active and the employee assumes responsibility for the territory. Used for temporal tracking and commission attribution.
attributes.references: Sales Territory Management Standard

attributes.name: geographic_scope

attributes.name: is_exclusive
attributes.description: Indicates whether this territory assignment is exclusive to the assigned employee. True means the employee has sole rights to the territory; False means the territory may be shared with other employees or overlapping assignments exist.

attributes.name: is_remote_territory
attributes.description: Indicates whether this territory is managed remotely without a physical office presence. True for remote territories; False for office-based territories. Supports remote work arrangements and distributed workforce models.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp

attributes.references: Internal Data Management Standard

attributes.name: named_accounts_count
attributes.description: Number of named client accounts included in this territory assignment. Applicable for named account territory types. Used for workload balancing and capacity planning.

attributes.name: notes

attributes.name: ownership_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of territory ownership allocated to this employee, used for commission attribution and quota allocation in split or shared territory scenarios. Value ranges from 0.00 to 100.00. For exclusive assignments, this is typically 100.00.

attributes.name: performance_tier

attributes.name: priority_level

attributes.name: quota_amount

attributes.name: service_level_agreement_tier

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Name of the source system from which this territory assignment record originated (e.g., 'Salesforce', 'SAP SuccessFactors', 'Bullhorn'). Used for data lineage and integration troubleshooting.

attributes.name: source_system_code

attributes.name: specialization_tags

attributes.name: target_headcount
attributes.description: Target number of placements or Full-Time Equivalent (FTE) assignments expected from this territory during the assignment period. Used for workforce planning and performance measurement.
attributes.references: Workforce Planning Standard

attributes.name: transition_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes documenting territory transition details, handoff instructions, client relationship context, or special considerations for the assigned employee. Supports knowledge transfer during territory reassignments.
attributes.references: Sales Territory Management Standard

attributes.name: vertical_focus
attributes.description: Industry vertical or sector focus of the territory (e.g., 'Healthcare', 'Financial Services', 'Technology', 'Manufacturing'). Applicable for vertical territory types. Supports industry specialization and targeted business development.
attributes.references: Sales Territory Management Standard

attributes.name: prior_territory_assignment_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on territory_assignment (prior_territory_assignment_id)

products.name: internal_training
products.description: Master record for internal training programs, certifications, and professional development courses available to Staffing Hr employees. Captures training name, training type (onboarding, compliance, product knowledge, sales skills, leadership development, DEI, safety), delivery method (in-person, virtual, LMS, on-the-job), duration hours, provider (internal, external vendor, LMS platform), required vs. elective flag, applicable job families, and recertification frequency. Distinct from credentialing.training_record (which tracks contingent worker training completions).

attributes.name: internal_training_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the internal training program. Primary key for the internal training master record.
attributes.references: ISO 30405:2016 Human Resource Management - Guidelines on Recruitment

attributes.name: credential_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to credentialing.credential. Business justification: Internal training courses often fulfill specific credential requirements (e.g., OSHA safety training, compliance certifications). Linking training to credentials enables automated compliance tracking,
attributes.references: Internal - LLM Generated Cross-Domain Link

attributes.name: primary_internal_staff_profile_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the internal employee who created this training record in the system. Typically an HR or Learning & Development team member.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Learning Management

attributes.name: applicable_job_families
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of job families or roles for which this training is applicable or required. Examples: recruiter, account_manager, operations_staff, leadership, all_employees. Used to determine training assignment eligibility.
attributes.references: SHRM Job Family Classification; SAP SuccessFactors Learning Management

attributes.name: assessment_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether employees must pass an assessment or exam to complete this training. True for compliance and certification training, False for informational or awareness training.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Learning Management; OSHA Training Assessment Requirements

attributes.name: certification_awarded
attributes.description: Name of the certification, credential, or certificate awarded upon successful completion of this training. Null if no formal certification is provided. Examples: EEOC Compliance Certificate, Leadership Development Certificate, ATS Power User Certification.
attributes.references: American Staffing Association (ASA) Certification Programs; SHRM Certification Standards

attributes.name: competency_category
attributes.description: Primary competency area addressed by this training. Technical for ATS/VMS/CRM system skills, behavioral for soft skills and communication, leadership for management capabilities, compliance for regulatory knowledge, sales for business development and client relationship skills, operational for process and workflow proficiency.
attributes.references: SHRM Competency Model; SAP SuccessFactors Performance Management

attributes.name: compliance_framework
attributes.description: Regulatory framework or standard that this training addresses. Examples: EEOC, OFCCP, OSHA, FLSA, FCRA, GDPR, CCPA, SOC 2, I-9 Compliance. Null for non-compliance training. Used for audit trail and regulatory reporting.
attributes.references: EEOC Training Requirements; OFCCP Compliance; OSHA Standards; FCRA Background Check Training; GDPR Article 4; CCPA

attributes.name: content_url
attributes.description: Web URL or LMS link to access the training content, course materials, or enrollment page. Used for employee self-service access and manager assignment workflows.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Learning Management

attributes.name: cost_per_participant
attributes.description: Cost in USD per employee to deliver this training. Includes vendor fees, materials, instructor time, and facility costs. Used for training budget planning and ROI analysis.
attributes.references: Oracle NetSuite ERP General Ledger; SHRM Training Budget Standards

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this training record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.
attributes.references: SOC 2 Type II Audit Trail Requirements

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the cost per participant. Typically USD for US-based Staffing Hr operations.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes

attributes.name: delivery_method
attributes.description: Method by which the training is delivered to employees. In-person for classroom sessions, virtual for live online sessions, LMS for self-paced e-learning modules, on-the-job for hands-on mentoring, blended for combination of methods.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Learning Management; ISO 30405:2016

attributes.name: duration_hours
attributes.description: Total duration of the training program measured in hours. Used for scheduling, capacity planning, and compliance reporting. Includes all instructional time and assessments.
attributes.references: FLSA Training Time Compensation Rules; SHRM Learning Standards

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date when this training program is no longer available for new enrollments. Null for ongoing programs. Used for course lifecycle management and historical reporting.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Learning Management

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date when this training program becomes available for employee enrollment and assignment. Used for course catalog management and compliance tracking.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Learning Management

attributes.name: instructor_name
attributes.description: Name of the primary instructor or facilitator for this training program. Null for self-paced LMS courses. May be internal employee or external vendor trainer.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Learning Management

attributes.name: internal_training_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the training program. Active for available courses, inactive for temporarily unavailable, draft for courses under development, retired for discontinued courses, under review for courses being updated or audited.
attributes.references: SAP SuccessFactors Learning Management

attributes.name: is_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the training is mandatory or elective for applicable employees. True for required training (compliance, onboarding, safety), False for optional professional development courses.
attributes.references: EEOC Training Requirements; OSHA Mandatory Training Standards; FLSA Compliance

attributes.name: language
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 639-2 language code for the primary language of the training content. Examples: ENG for English, SPA for Spanish. Used for multilingual workforce support.
attributes.references: ISO 639-2 Language Codes

attributes.name: last_content_update_date
